sections.title: Chapter 1: Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī's Second Meeting with the Lord

verses.devanagari: পঙ্গুং লঙ্ঘয়তে শৈলং মূকমাবর্তয়েচ্ছ্রুতিম্ ।\\nযত্কৃপা তমহং বন্দে কৃষ্ণচৈতন্যমীশ্বরম্ ॥১॥
verses.transliteration: paṅguṁ laṅghayate śailaṁ\\nmūkam āvartayec chrutim\\nyat-kṛpā tam ahaṁ vande\\nkṛṣṇa-caitanyam īśvaram
verses.translation: I offer my respectful obeisances to Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya Mahāprabhu, by whose mercy even a lame man can cross over a mountain and a dumb man recite Vedic literature.

verses.devanagari: দুর্গমে পথি মেঽন্ধস্য স্খলৎপাদগতের্মুহুঃ ।\\nস্বকৃপা-যষ্টিদানেন সন্তঃ সন্ত্ববলম্বনম্ ॥২॥
verses.transliteration: durgame pathi me 'ndhasya\\nskhalat-pāda-gater muhuḥ\\nsva-kṛpā-yaṣṭi-dānena\\nsantaḥ santv avalambanam
verses.translation: My path is very difficult. I am blind, and my feet are slipping again and again. Therefore, may the saints help me by granting me the stick of their mercy as my support.

verses.devanagari: শ্রীরূপ, সনাতন, ভট্ট-রঘুনাথ ।\\nশ্রীজীব, গোপালভট্ট, দাস-রঘুনাথ ॥৩॥\\nএই ছয় গুরুর করোঁ চরণ বন্দন ।\\nযাহা হৈতে বিঘ্ননাশ, অভীষ্ট-পূরণ ॥৪॥
verses.transliteration: ei chaya gurura karoṅ caraṇa vandana\\nyāhā haite vighna-nāśa, abhīṣṭa-pūraṇa
verses.translation: I pray to the lotus feet of the six Gosvāmīs-Śrī Rūpa, Sanātana, Bhaṭṭa Raghunātha, Śrī Jīva, Gopāla Bhaṭṭa and Dāsa Raghunātha-so that all impediments to my writing this literature will be annihilated and my real desire will be fulfilled.
verses.purport: PURPORT\nIf one wants to benefit the entire world, he will certainly find persons like hogs and pigs who will put forward many impediments. That is natural. But if a devotee seeks shelter at the lotus feet of the six Gosvāmīs, the merciful Gosvāmīs will certainly give the Lord's servitor all protection. It is not astonishing that impediments are placed before those who are spreading the Kṛṣṇa consciousness movement all over the world. Nevertheless, if we adhere to the lotus feet of the six Gosvāmīs and pray for their mercy, all impediments will be annihilated, and the transcendental devotional desire to serve the Supreme Lord will be fulfilled.

verses.devanagari: জয়তাং সুরতৌ পঙ্গোর্মম মন্দমতের্গতী ।\\nমৎসর্বস্বপদাম্ভোজৌ রাধা-মদনমোহনৌ ॥৫॥
verses.transliteration: jayatāṁ suratau paṅgor\\nmama manda-mater gatī\\nmat-sarvasva-padāmbhojau\\nrādhā-madana-mohanau
verses.translation: Glory to the all-merciful Rādhā and Madana-mohana! I am lame and ill-advised, yet They are my directors, and Their lotus feet are everything to me.

verses.devanagari: দীব্যদ্বৃন্দারণ্যকল্পদ্রুমাধঃ-\\nশ্রীমদ্রত্নাগারসিংহাসনস্থৌ ।\\nশ্রীমদ্রাধা-শ্রীলগোবিন্দদেবৌ\\nপ্রেষ্ঠালীভিঃ সেব্যমানৌ স্মরামি ॥৬॥
verses.transliteration: dīvyad-vṛndāraṇya-kalpa-drumādhaḥ\\nśrīmad-ratnāgāra-siṁhāsana-sthau\\nśrīmad-rādhā-śrīla-govinda-devau\\npreṣṭhālībhiḥ sevyamānau smarāmi
verses.translation: In a temple of jewels in Vṛndāvana, underneath a desire tree, Śrī Śrī Rādhā-Govinda, served by Their most confidential associates, sit upon an effulgent throne. I offer my humble obeisances unto Them.

verses.devanagari: শ্রীমান্রাসরসারম্ভী বংশীবটতটস্থিতঃ ।\\nকর্ষন্ বেণুস্বনৈর্গোপীর্গোপীনাথঃ শ্রিয়েঽস্তু নঃ ॥৭॥
verses.transliteration: śrīmān-rāsa-rasārambhī\\nvaṁśīvaṭa-sthitaḥ\\nkarṣan veṇu-svanair gopīr\\ngopī-nāthaḥ śriye 'stu naḥ
verses.translation: Śrī Śrīla Gopīnātha, who originated the transcendental mellow of the rāsa dance, stands on the shore at Vaṁśīvaṭa and attracts the attention of the cowherd damsels with the sound of His celebrated flute. May they all confer upon us their benediction.

verses.devanagari: জয় জয় শ্রীচৈতন্য জয় নিত্যানন্দ ।\\nজয়াদ্বৈতচন্দ্র জয় গৌরভক্তবৃন্দ ॥৮॥
verses.transliteration: jaya jaya śrī-caitanya jaya nityānanda\\njayādvaita-candra jaya gaura-bhakta-vṛnda
verses.translation: All glories to Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu! All glories to Lord Nityānanda! All glories to Advaita Ācārya! All glories to the devotees of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu!

verses.devanagari: মধ্যলীলা সংক্ষেপেতে করিলুঁ বর্ণন ।\\nঅন্ত্যলীলা-বর্ণন কিছু শুন, ভক্তগণ ॥৯॥
verses.transliteration: madhya-līlā saṅkṣepete kariluṅ varṇana\\nantya-līlā-varṇana kichu śuna, bhakta-gaṇa
verses.translation: I have briefly described the pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu in the madhya-līlā. Now I shall attempt to describe something about His last pastimes, which are known as the antya-līlā.

verses.devanagari: মধ্যলীলা-মধ্যে অন্ত্যলীলা-সূত্রগণ ।\\nপূর্বগ্রন্থে সংক্ষেপেতে করিয়াছি বর্ণন ॥১০॥
verses.transliteration: madhya-līlā-madhye antya-līlā-sūtra-gaṇa\\npūrva-granthe saṅkṣepete kariyāchi varṇana
verses.synonyms:
madhya-līlā-madhye
—within the
madhya-līlā
chapters;
antya-līlā-sūtra-gaṇa
—the codes of the
antya-līlā
;
pūrva-granthe
—in the previous chapter;
saṅkṣepete
—in brief;
kariyāchi varṇana
—I have described.
verses.translation: I have briefly described the Antya-līlā in codes within the Madhya-līlā.

verses.devanagari: আমি জরাগ্রস্ত, নিকটে জানিয়া মরণ ।\\nঅন্ত্য কোনো কোনো লীলা করিয়াছি বর্ণন ॥১১॥
verses.transliteration: āmi jarā-grasta, nikaṭe jāniyā maraṇa\\nantya kono kono līlā kariyāchi varṇana
verses.translation: I am now almost an invalid because of old age, and I know that at any moment I may die. Therefore I have already described some portions of the antya-līlā.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Following in the footsteps of Śrīla Kṛṣṇadāsa Kavirāja Gosvāmī, I am trying to translate the
Bhāgavata
literatures as quickly as possible. However, knowing myself to be an old man and almost an invalid because of rheumatism, I have already translated the essence of all literatures, the Tenth Canto of
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam,
as a summary study in English. I started the Kṛṣṇa consciousness movement at the age of seventy. Now I am seventy-eight, and so my death is imminent. I am trying to finish the translation of
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
as soon as possible, but before finishing it, I have given my readers the book
Kṛṣṇa, the Supreme Personality of Godhead,
so that if I die before finishing the whole task they may enjoy this book, which is the essence of
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam.

verses.devanagari: পূর্বলিখিত গ্রন্থসূত্র-অনুসারে ।\\nযেই নাহি লিখি, তাহা লিখিয়ে বিস্তারে ॥১২॥
verses.transliteration: pūrva-likhita grantha-sūtra-anusāre\\nyei nāhi likhi, tāhā likhiye vistāre
verses.translation: In accordance with the synopsis previously written, I shall describe in detail whatever I have not mentioned.

verses.devanagari: বৃন্দাবন হৈতে প্রভু নীলাচলে আইলা ।\\nস্বরূপ-গোসাঞি গৌড়ে বার্তা পাঠাইলা ॥১৩॥
verses.transliteration: vṛndāvana haite prabhu nīlācale āilā\\nsvarūpa-gosāñi gauḍe vārtā pāṭhāilā
verses.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu returned to Jagannātha Purī from Vṛndāvana, Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosāñi immediately sent news of the Lord's arrival to the devotees in Bengal.

verses.devanagari: শুনি’ শচী আনন্দিত, সব ভক্তগণ ।\\nসবে মিলি’ নীলাচলে করিলা গমন ॥১৪॥
verses.transliteration: śuni' śacī ānandita, saba bhakta-gaṇa\\nsabe mili' nīlācale karilā gamana
verses.translation: Upon hearing this news, mother Śacī and all the other devotees of Navadvīpa were very joyful, and they all departed together for Nīlācala [Jagannātha Purī].

verses.devanagari: কুলীনগ্রামী ভক্ত আর যত খণ্ডবাসী ।\\nআচার্য শিবানন্দ সনে মিলিলা সবে আসি’ ॥১৫॥
verses.transliteration: kulīna-grāmī bhakta āra yata khaṇḍa-vāsī\\nācārya śivānanda sane mililā sabe āsi'
verses.translation: Thus all the devotees of Kulīna-grāma and Śrī Khaṇḍa, as well as Advaita Ācārya, came together to meet Śivānanda Sena.

verses.devanagari: শিবানন্দ করে সবার ঘাটি সমাধান ।\\nসবারে পালন করে, দেয় বাসা-স্থান ॥১৬॥
verses.transliteration: śivānanda kare sabāra ghāṭi samādhāna\\nsabāre pālana kare, deya vāsā-sthāna
verses.translation: Śivānanda Sena arranged for the journey. He maintained everyone and provided residential quarters.

verses.devanagari: এক কুক্কুর চলে শিবানন্দ-সনে ।\\nভক্ষ্য দিয়া লঞা চলে করিয়া পালনে ॥১৭॥
verses.transliteration: eka kukkura cale śivānanda-sane\\nbhakṣya diyā lañā cale kariyā pālane
verses.translation: While going to Jagannātha Purī, Śivānanda Sena allowed a dog to go with him. He supplied it food to eat and maintained it.

verses.devanagari: একদিন একস্থানে নদী পার হৈতে  ।\\nউড়িয়া নাবিক কুক্কুর না চড়ায় নৌকাতে ॥১৮॥
verses.transliteration: eka-dina eka-sthāne nadī pāra haite\\nuḍiyā nāvika kukkura nā caḍāya naukāte
verses.translation: One day, when they needed to cross a river, an Orissan boatman would not allow the dog to get in the boat.

verses.devanagari: কুক্কুর রহিলা, — শিবানন্দ দুঃখী হৈলা  ।\\nদশ পণ কড়ি দিয়া কুক্কুরে পার কৈলা ॥১৯॥
verses.transliteration: kukkura rahilā,—śivānanda duḥkhī hailā\\ndaśa paṇa kaḍi diyā kukkure pāra kailā
verses.translation: Śivānanda Sena, unhappy that the dog had to stay behind, paid the boatman ten paṇa of conchshells to take the dog across the river.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
One
paṇa
is eighty
kaḍis,
or small conchshells. Formerly, even fifty or sixty years ago, there was no paper currency in India. Coins were generally made not of base metal but of gold, silver and copper. In other words, the medium of exchange was really something valuable. Four pieces of
kaḍi
made one
gaṇḍā,
and twenty such
gaṇḍās
equaled one
paṇa.
This
kaḍi
was also used as a medium of exchange; therefore Śivānanda Sena paid for the dog with
daśa paṇa,
or eighty times ten pieces of
kaḍi.
In those days one paisa was also subdivided into small conchshells, but at the present moment the prices for commodities have gone so high that there is nothing one can get in exchange for only one paisa. With one paisa in those days, however, one could purchase sufficient vegetables to provide for a whole family. Even thirty years ago, vegetables were occasionally so inexpensive that one paisa's worth could provide for a whole family for a day.

verses.devanagari: একদিন শিবানন্দে ঘাটিয়ালে রাখিলা ।\\nকুক্কুরকে ভাত দিতে সেবক পাসরিলা ॥২০॥
verses.transliteration: eka-dina śivānande ghāṭiyāle rākhila\\nkukkurake bhāta dite sevaka pāsarilā
verses.translation: One day while Śivānanda was detained by a tollman, his servant forgot to give the dog its cooked rice.

verses.devanagari: রাত্রে আসি’ শিবানন্দ ভোজনের কালে ।\\n‘কুক্কুর পাঞাছে ভাত?’ — সেবকে পুছিলে ॥২১॥
verses.transliteration: rātre asi' śivānanda bhojanera kale\\n'kukkura pāñāche bhāta?'—sevake puchile
verses.translation: At night, when Śivānanda Sena returned and was taking his meal, he inquired from the servant whether the dog had gotten its meals.

verses.devanagari: কুক্কুর নাহি পায় ভাত শুনি’ দুঃখী হৈলা ।\\nকুক্কুর চাহিতে দশ-মনুষ্য পাঠাইলা ॥২২॥
verses.transliteration: kukkura nāhi pāya bhāta śuni' duḥkhī hailā\\nkukkura cāhite daśa-manuṣya pāṭhāilā
verses.translation: When he learned that the dog had not been supplied food in his absence, he was very unhappy. He then immediately sent ten men to find the dog.

verses.devanagari: চাহিয়া না পাইল কুক্কুর, লোক সব আইলা ।\\nদুঃখী হঞা শিবানন্দ উপবাস কৈলা ॥২৩॥
verses.transliteration: cāhiyā nā pāila kukkura, loka saba āilā\\nduḥkhī hañā śivānanda upavāsa kailā
verses.translation: When the men returned without success, Śivānanda Sena became very unhappy and fasted for the night.

verses.devanagari: প্রভাতে কুক্কুর চাহি’ কাঁহা না পাইল ।\\nসকল বৈষ্ণবের মনে চমৎকার হৈল ॥২৪॥
verses.transliteration: prabhāte kukkura cāhi' kāṅhā nā pāila\\nsakala vaiṣṇavera mane camatkāra haila
verses.translation: In the morning they looked for the dog, but it could not be found anywhere. All the Vaiṣṇavas were astonished.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Śivānanda Sena's attachment to the dog was a great boon for that animal. The dog appears to have been a street dog. Since it naturally began to follow Śivānanda Sena while he was going to Jagannātha Purī with his party, he accepted it into his party and maintained it the same way he was maintaining the other devotees. It appears that although on one occasion the dog was not allowed aboard a boat, Śivānanda did not leave the dog behind but paid more money just to induce the boatman to take the dog across the river. Then when the servant forgot to feed the dog and the dog disappeared, Śivānanda, being very anxious, sent ten men to find it. When they could not find it, Śivānanda observed a fast. Thus it appears that somehow or other Śivānanda had become attached to the dog.
As will be evident from the following verses, the dog got the mercy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and was immediately promoted to Vaikuṇṭha to become an eternal devotee. Śrīla Bhaktivinoda Ṭhākura has therefore sung,
tumi ta' ṭhākura, tomāra kukkura, baliyā jānaha more
(
Śaraṇāgati
19). He thus offers to become the dog of a Vaiṣṇava. There are many other instances in which the pet animal of a Vaiṣṇava was delivered back home to Vaikuṇṭhaloka, back to Godhead. Such is the benefit of somehow or other becoming the favorite of a Vaiṣṇava. Śrīla Bhaktivinoda Ṭhākura has also sung,
kīṭa-janma ha-u yathā tuyā dāsa
(
Śaraṇāgati
11). There is no harm in taking birth again and again. Our only desire should be to take birth under the care of a Vaiṣṇava. Fortunately we had the opportunity to be born of a Vaiṣṇava father who took care of us very nicely. He prayed to Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī that in the future we would become a servant of the eternal consort of Śrī Kṛṣṇa. Thus somehow or other we are now engaged in that service. We may conclude that even as dogs we must take shelter of a Vaiṣṇava. The benefit will be the same as that which accrues to an advanced devotee under a Vaiṣṇava's care.

verses.devanagari: উৎকণ্ঠায় চলি’ সবে আইলা নীলাচলে ।\\nপূর্ববৎ মহাপ্রভু মিলিলা সকলে ॥২৫॥
verses.transliteration: utkaṇṭhāya cali' sabe āilā nīlācale\\npūrvavat mahāprabhu mililā sakale
verses.translation: Thus in great anxiety they all walked to Jagannātha Purī, where Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu met them as usual.

verses.devanagari: সবা লঞা কৈলা জগন্নাথ দরশন ।\\nসবা লঞা মহাপ্রভু করেন ভোজন ॥২৬॥
verses.transliteration: sabā lañā kailā jagannātha daraśana\\nsabā lañā mahāprabhu karena bhojana
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went with them to see the Lord in the temple, and on that day He also took lunch in the company of all those devotees.

verses.devanagari: পূর্ববৎ সবারে প্রভু পাঠাইলা বাসা-স্থানে ।\\nপ্রভু-ঠাঞি প্রাতঃকালে আইলা আর দিনে ॥২৭॥
verses.transliteration: pūrvavat sabāre prabhu pāṭhāilā vāsā-sthāne\\nprabhu-ṭhāñi prātaḥ-kāle āilā āra dine
verses.translation: As previously, the Lord provided them all with residential quarters. And the next morning all the devotees came to see the Lord.

verses.devanagari: আসিয়া দেখিল সবে সেই ত কুক্কুরে ।\\nপ্রভু-পাশে বসিয়াছে কিছু অল্পদূরে ॥২৮॥
verses.transliteration: āsiyā dekhila sabe sei ta kukkure\\nprabhu-pāśe vasiyāche kichu alpa-dūre
verses.translation: When all the devotees came to the place of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, they saw the same dog was sitting a little apart the Lord.

verses.devanagari: প্রসাদ নারিকেল-শস্য দেন ফেলাঞা ।\\n‘রাম’ ‘কৃষ্ণ’ ‘হরি’ কহ’ — বলেন হাসিয়া ॥২৯॥
verses.transliteration: prasāda nārikela-śasya dena phelāñā\\n'rāma' 'kṛṣṇa' 'hari' kaha'—balena hāsiyā
verses.translation: Furthermore, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was throwing remnants of green coconut pulp to the dog. Smiling in His own way, He was saying to the dog, "Chant the holy names Rāma, Kṛṣṇa, and Hari."

verses.devanagari: শস্য খায় কুক্কুর, ‘কৃষ্ণ’ কহে বার বার ।\\nদেখিয়া লোকের মনে হৈল চমৎকার ॥৩০॥
verses.transliteration: śasya khāya kukkura, 'kṛṣṇa' kahe bāra bāra\\ndekhiyā lokera mane haila camatkāra
verses.translation: Seeing the dog eating the green coconut pulp and chanting "Kṛṣṇa, Kṛṣṇa" again and again, all the devotees present were very much surprised.

verses.devanagari: শিবানন্দ কুক্কুর দেখি’ দণ্ডবৎ কৈলা ।\\nদৈন্য করি’ নিজ অপরাধ ক্ষমাইলা ॥৩১॥
verses.transliteration: śivānanda kukkura dekhi' daṇḍavat kailā\\ndainya kari' nija aparādha kṣamāilā
verses.translation: When he saw the dog sitting in that way and chanting the name of Kṛṣṇa, Śivānanda, because of his natural humility, immediately offered his obeisances to the dog just to counteract his offenses to it.

verses.devanagari: আর দিন কেহ তার দেখা না পাইলা ।\\nসিদ্ধ-দেহ পাঞা কুক্কুর বৈকুণ্ঠেতে গেলা ॥৩২॥
verses.transliteration: āra dina keha tāra dekhā nā pāilā\\nsiddha-deha pāñā kukkura vaikuṇṭhete gelā
verses.translation: The next day, no one saw that dog, for it had obtained its spiritual body and departed for Vaikuṇṭha, the spiritual kingdom.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This is the result of
sādhu-saṅga,
consequent association with Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and promotion back home, back to Godhead. This result is possible even for a dog, by the mercy of the Vaiṣṇava. Therefore, everyone in the human form of life should be induced to associate with devotees. By rendering a little service, even by eating
prasāda,
not to speak of chanting and dancing, everyone could be promoted to Vaikuṇṭhaloka. It is therefore requested that all our devotees in the ISKCON community become pure Vaiṣṇavas, so that by their mercy all the people of the world will be transferred to Vaikuṇṭhaloka, even without their knowledge. Everyone should be given a chance to take
prasāda
and thus be induced to chant the holy names Hare Kṛṣṇa and also dance in ecstasy. By these three processes, although performed without knowledge or education, even an animal went back to Godhead.

verses.devanagari: ঐছে দিব্যলীলা করে শচীর নন্দন ।\\nকুক্কুরকে কৃষ্ণ কহাঞা করিলা মোচন ॥৩৩॥
verses.transliteration: aiche divya-līlā kare śacīra nandana\\nkukkurake kṛṣṇa kahāñā karilā mocana
verses.translation: Such are the transcendental pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the son of mother Śacī. He even delivered a dog simply by inducing it to chant the mahā-mantra, Hare Kṛṣṇa.

verses.devanagari: এথা প্রভু-আজ্ঞায় রূপ আইলা বৃন্দাবন ।\\nকৃষ্ণলীলা-নাটক করিতে হৈল মন ॥৩৪॥
verses.transliteration: ethā prabhu-ājñāya rūpa āilā vṛndāvana\\nkṛṣṇa-līlā-nāṭaka karite haila mana
verses.translation: Meanwhile, following the order of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī returned to Vṛndāvana. He desired to write dramas concerning the pastimes of Lord Kṛṣṇa.

verses.devanagari: বৃন্দাবনে নাটকের আরম্ভ করিলা ।\\nমঙ্গলাচরণ ‘নান্দী-শ্লোক’ তথাই লিখিলা ॥৩৫॥
verses.transliteration: vṛndāvane nāṭakera ārambha karilā\\nmaṅgalācaraṇa 'nāndī-śloka' tathāi likhilā
verses.translation: In Vṛndāvana, Rūpa Gosvāmī began to write a drama. In particuIar, he composed the introductory verses to invoke good fortune.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura quotes his notes from the
Nāṭaka-candrikā,
wherein he has written:
prastāvanāyās tu mukhe
nāndī kāryāśubhāvahā
āśīr-namaskriyā-vastu-
nirdeśānyatamānvitā
aṣṭābhir daśabhir yuktā
kiṁvā dvādaśabhiḥ padaiḥ
candranāmāṅkitā prāyo
maṅgalārtha-padojjvalā
maṅgalaṁ cakra-kamala-
cakora-kumudādikam
Similarly, in the Sixth Chapter of the
Sāhitya-darpaṇa,
text 282, he has said:
āśīr-vacana-saṁyuktā
stutir yasmāt prayujyate
deva-dvija-nṛ-pādīnāṁ
tasmān nāndīti saṁjñitā
The introductory portion of a drama, which is written to invoke good fortune, is called
nāndī-śloka.

verses.devanagari: পথে চলি’ আইসে নাটকের ঘটনা ভাবিতে ।\\nকড়চা করিয়া কিছু লাগিলা লিখিতে ॥৩৬॥
verses.transliteration: pathe cali' āise nāṭakera ghaṭanā bhāvite\\nkaḍacā kariyā kichu lāgilā likhite
verses.translation: On his way to Gauḍa-deśa, Rūpa Gosvāmī had been thinking of how to write the action of the drama. Thus he had made some notes and begun to write.

verses.devanagari: এইমতে দুই ভাই গৌড়দেশে আইলা ।\\nগৌড়ে আসি’ অনুপমের গঙ্গা-প্রাপ্তি হৈলা ॥৩৭॥
verses.transliteration: ei-mate dui bhāi gauḍa-deśe āilā\\ngauḍe āsi' anupamera gaṅgā-prāpti hailā
verses.translation: In this way the two brothers Rūpa and Anupama reached Bengal, but when they arrived there Anupama died.
verses.purport: PURPORT\nFormerly when a person died it was commonly said that he had attained the shelter of mother Ganges, even if he did not die on the bank of the Ganges. It is customary among Hindus to carry a dying person to a nearby bank of the Ganges, for if one dies on the bank of the Ganges, his soul is considered to reach the lotus feet of Lord Viṣṇu, wherefrom the Ganges flows.

verses.devanagari: রূপ-গোসাঞি প্রভুপাশে করিলা গমন ।\\nপ্রভুরে দেখিতে তাঁর উৎকণ্ঠিত মন ॥৩৮॥
verses.transliteration: rūpa-gosāñi prabhu-pāśe karilā gamana\\nprabhure dekhite tāṅra utkaṇṭhita mana
verses.translation: Rūpa Gosvāmī then departed to see Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, for he was very eager to see Him.

verses.devanagari: অনুপমের লাগি’ তাঁর কিছু বিলম্ব হইল ।\\nভক্তগণ-পাশ আইলা, লাগ্ না পাইল ॥৩৯॥
verses.transliteration: anupamera lāgi' tāṅra kichu vilamba ha-ila\\nbhakta-gaṇa-pāśa āilā, lāg nā pāila
verses.translation: There was some delay because of the death of Anupama, and therefore when Rūpa Gosvāmī went to Bengal to see the devotees there, he could not get in touch with them because they had already left.

verses.devanagari: উড়িয়া-দেশে ‘সত্যভামাপুর’-নামে গ্রাম ।\\nএক রাত্রি সেই গ্রামে করিলা বিশ্রাম ॥৪০॥
verses.transliteration: uḍiyā-deśe 'satyabhāmā-pura'-nāme grāma\\neka rātri sei grāme karilā viśrāma
verses.translation: In the province of Orissa there is a place known as Satyabhāmā-pura. Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī rested for a night in that village on his way to Jagannātha Purī.
verses.purport: PURPORT\nThere is a place known as Satyabhāmā-pura in the district of Kaṭaka (Cuttak) in Orissa. It is near the village known as Jānkādei-pura.

verses.devanagari: রাত্রে স্বপ্নে দেখে, — এক দিব্যরূপা নারী  ।\\nসম্মুখে আসিয়া আজ্ঞা দিলা বহু কৃপা করি’ ॥৪১॥
verses.transliteration: rātre svapne dekhe,—eka divya-rūpā nārī\\nsammukhe āsiyā ājñā dilā bahu kṛpā kari'
verses.translation: While resting in Satyabhāmā-pura, he dreamed that a celestiaIly beautiful woman had come before him and very mercifully gave him the folIowing order.

verses.devanagari: “আমার নাটক পৃথক্ করহ রচন  ।\\nআমার কৃপাতে নাটক হৈবে বিলক্ষণ ।।” ৪২ ॥৪২॥
verses.transliteration: āmāra nāṭaka pṛthak karaha racana\\n"āmāra kṛpāte nāṭaka haibe vilakṣaṇa"
verses.translation: "Write a separate drama about me," she said. "By my mercy, it will be extraordinarily beautiful."

verses.devanagari: স্বপ্ন দেখি’ রূপ-গোসাঞি করিলা বিচার ।\\nসত্যভামার আজ্ঞা — পৃথক্ নাটক করিবার ॥৪৩॥
verses.transliteration: svapna dekhi' rūpa-gosāñi karilā vicāra\\nsatya-bhāmāra ājñā—pṛthak nāṭaka karibāra
verses.translation: After having that dream, Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī considered, "It is the order of Satyabhāmā that I write a separate drama for her.

verses.devanagari: ব্রজ-পুর-লীলা একত্র করিয়াছি ঘটনা ।\\nদুই ভাগ করি’ এবে করিমু রচনা ॥৪৪॥
verses.transliteration: vraja-pura-līlā ekatra kariyāchi ghaṭanā\\ndui bhāga kari' ebe karimu racanā
verses.translation: I have brought together in one work all the pastimes performed by Lord Kṛṣṇa in Vṛndāvana and in Dvārakā. Now I shall have to divide them into two dramas."

verses.devanagari: ভাবিতে ভাবিতে শীঘ্র আইলা নীলাচলে ।\\nআসি’ উত্তরিলা হরিদাস-বাসাস্থলে ॥৪৫॥
verses.transliteration: bhāvite bhāvite śīghra āilā nīlācale\\nāsi' uttarilā haridāsa-vāsā-sthale
verses.translation: Thus absorbed in thought, he quickly reached Jagannātha Purī. When he arrived, he approached the hut of Haridāsa Ṭhākura.

verses.devanagari: হরিদাস-ঠাকুর তাঁরে বহুকৃপা কৈলা ।\\n‘তুমি আসিবে, — মোরে প্রভু যে কহিলা’ ॥৪৬॥
verses.transliteration: haridāsa-ṭhākura tāṅre bahu-kṛpā kailā\\n'tumi āsibe,—more prabhu ye kahilā'
verses.translation: Out of affectionate love and mercy, Haridāsa Ṭhākura told Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī, "Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu has already informed me that you would come here."

verses.devanagari: ‘উপল-ভোগ’ দেখি’ হরিদাসেরে দেখিতে ।\\nপ্রতিদিন আইসেন, প্রভু আইলা আচম্বিতে ॥৪৭॥
verses.transliteration: 'upala-bhoga' dekhi' haridāsere dekhite\\npratidina āisena, prabhu āilā ācambite
verses.translation: After seeing the upala-bhoga ceremony at the Jagannātha temple, Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would regularly come to see Haridāsa every day. Thus He suddenly arrived there.

verses.devanagari: ‘রূপ দণ্ডবৎ করে’, — হরিদাস কহিলা ।\\nহরিদাসে মিলি’ প্রভু রূপে আলিঙ্গিলা ॥৪৮॥
verses.transliteration: 'rūpa daṇḍavat kare',—haridāsa kahilā\\nharidāse mili' prabhu rūpe āliṅgilā
verses.translation: When the Lord arrived, Rūpa Gosvāmī immediately offered his obeisances. Haridāsa informed the Lord, "This is Rūpa Gosvāmī offering You obeisances" and the Lord embraced him.

verses.devanagari: হরিদাস-রূপে লঞা প্রভু বসিলা একস্থানে ।\\nকুশল-প্রশ্ন, ইষ্টগোষ্ঠী কৈলা কতক্ষণে ॥৪৯॥
verses.transliteration: haridāsa-rūpe lañā prabhu vasilā eka-sthāne\\nkuśala-praśna, iṣṭa-goṣṭhī kailā kata-kṣaṇe
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then sat down with Haridāsa and Rūpa Gosvāmī. They inquired from one another about auspicious news, and then continued to talk together for some time.

verses.devanagari: সনাতনের বার্তা যবে গোসাঞি পুছিল  ।\\nরূপ কহে, — ‘তার সঙ্গে দেখা না হইল ॥৫০॥
verses.transliteration: sanātanera vārtā yabe gosāñi puchila\\nrūpa kahe,—'ta-ra saṅge dekhā nā ha-ila
verses.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu inquired about Sanātana Gosvāmī, Rūpa Gosvāmī replied, "I did not meet him.

verses.devanagari: আমি গঙ্গাপথে আইলাঙ, তিঁহো রাজপথে  ।\\nঅতএব আমার দেখা নহিল তাঁর সাথে ॥৫১॥
verses.transliteration: āmi gaṅgā-pathe āilāṅa, tiṅho rāja-pathe\\nataeva āmāra dekhā nahila tāṅra sāthe
verses.translation: I came by the path on the bank of the Ganges, whereas Sanātana Gosvāmī came by the public road. Therefore we did not meet.

verses.devanagari: প্রয়াগে শুনিলুঁ, — তেঁহো গেলা বৃন্দাবনে  ।\\nঅনুপমের গঙ্গা-প্রাপ্তি কৈল নিবেদনে ।।” ৫২ ॥৫২॥
verses.transliteration: prayāge śuniluṅ,—teṅho gelā vṛndāvane\\nanupamera gaṅgā-prāpti kaila nivedane"
verses.translation: "In Prayāga I heard that he had already gone to Vṛndāvana." Rūpa Gosvāmī next informed the Lord about the death of Anupama.

verses.devanagari: রূপে তাহাঁ বাসা দিয়া গোসাঞি চলিলা ।\\nগোসাঞির সঙ্গী ভক্ত রূপেরে মিলিলা ॥৫৩॥
verses.transliteration: rūpe tāhāṅ vāsā diyā gosāñi calilā\\ngosāñira saṅgī bhakta rūpere mililā
verses.translation: After allotting residential quarters there to Rūpa Gosvāmī, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu left. Then all of the Lord's personal associates met Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī.

verses.devanagari: আর দিন মহাপ্রভু সব ভক্ত লঞা ।\\nরূপে মিলাইলা সবায় কৃপা ত’ করিয়া ॥৫৪॥
verses.transliteration: āra dina mahāprabhu saba bhakta lañā\\nrūpe milāilā sabāya kṛpā ta' kariyā
verses.translation: On the next day, Caitanya Mahāprabhu again met Rūpa Gosvāmī, and with great mercy the Lord introduced him to all the devotees.

verses.devanagari: সবার চরণ রূপ করিলা বন্দন ।\\nকৃপা করি’ রূপে সবে কৈলা আলিঙ্গন ॥৫৫॥
verses.transliteration: sabāra caraṇa rūpa karilā vandana\\nkṛpā kari' rūpe sabe kailā āliṅgana
verses.translation: Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī offered his respectful obeisances unto the lotus feet of them all, and all the devotees, by their mercy, embraced him.

verses.devanagari: ‘অদ্বৈত নিত্যানন্দ, তোমরা দুইজনে’  ।\\nপ্রভু কহে — রূপে কৃপা কর কায়মনে ॥৫৬॥
verses.transliteration: 'advaita nityānanda, tomarā dui-jane\\nprabhu kahe—rūpe kṛpā kara kāya-mane
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu told Advaita Ācārya and Nityānanda Prabhu, "You should both show Your mercy wholeheartedly to Rūpa Gosvāmī.

verses.devanagari: তোমা-দুঁহার কৃপাতে ইহাঁর হউ তৈছে শক্তি  ।\\nযাতে বিবরিতে পারেন কৃষ্ণরসভক্তি ॥৫৭॥
verses.transliteration: tomā-duṅhāra kṛpāte iṅhāra ha-u taiche śakti\\nyāte vivarite pārena kṛṣṇa-rasa-bhakti
verses.translation: May Rūpa Gosvāmī, by Your mercy, become so powerful that he will be able to describe the transcendental mellows of devotional service."

verses.devanagari: গৌড়িয়া, উড়িয়া, যত প্রভুর ভক্তগণ ।\\nসবার হইল রূপ স্নেহের ভাজন ॥৫৮॥
verses.transliteration: gauḍiyā, uḍiyā, yata prabhura bhakta-gaṇa\\nsabāra ha-ila rūpa snehera bhājana
verses.translation: Thus Rūpa Gosvāmī became the object of love and affection for all the devotees of the Lord, including those who came from Bengal and those who resided in Orissa.

verses.devanagari: প্রতিদিন আসি’ রূপে করেন মিলনে ।\\nমন্দিরে যে প্রসাদ পান, দেন দুই জনে ॥৫৯॥
verses.transliteration: pratidina āsi' rūpe karena milane\\nmandire ye prasāda pāna, dena dui jane
verses.translation: Every day Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would go to see Rūpa Gosvāmī, and whatever prasāda He received from the temple He would deliver to Rūpa Gosvāmī and Haridāsa Ṭhākura.

verses.devanagari: ইষ্টগোষ্ঠী দুঁহা সনে করি’ কতক্ষণ ।\\nমধ্যাহ্ন করিতে প্রভু করিলা গমন ॥৬০॥
verses.transliteration: iṣṭa-goṣṭhī duṅhā sane kari' kata-kṣaṇa\\nmadhyāhna karite prabhu karilā gamana
verses.translation: He would talk for some time with them both and then leave to perform His noontime duties.

verses.devanagari: এইমত প্রতিদিন প্রভুর ব্যবহার ।\\nপ্রভুকৃপা পাঞা রূপের আনন্দ অপার ॥৬১॥
verses.transliteration: ei-mata pratidina prabhura vyavahāra\\nprabhu-kṛpā pāñā rūpera ānanda apāra
verses.translation: In this way Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu's dealings with them continued every day. Thus receiving the transcendental favor of the Lord, Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī felt unlimited pleasure.

verses.devanagari: ভক্তগণ লঞা কৈলা গুণ্ডিচা মার্জন ।\\nআইটোটা আসি’ কৈলা বন্য-ভোজন ॥৬২॥
verses.transliteration: bhakta-gaṇa lañā kailā guṇḍicā mārjana\\nāiṭoṭā āsi' kailā vanya-bhojana
verses.translation: After Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, taking all His devotees with Him, performed the Guṇḍicā-mārjana [washing and cleansing the temple Guṇḍicā], He went to the garden known as Āiṭoṭā and accepted prasāda at a picnic within the garden.

verses.devanagari: প্রসাদ খায়, ‘হরি’ বলে সর্বভক্তজন ।\\nদেখি’ হরিদাস-রূপের হরষিত মন ॥৬৩॥
verses.transliteration: prasāda khāya, 'hari' bale sarva-bhakta-jana\\ndekhi' haridāsa-rūpera haraṣita mana
verses.translation: When Haridāsa Ṭhākura and Rūpa Gosvāmī saw that all the devotees were accepting prasāda and chanting the holy name of Hari, they both were greatly pleased.

verses.devanagari: গোবিন্দদ্বারা প্রভুর শেষ-প্রসাদ পাইলা ।\\nপ্রেমে মত্ত দুইজন নাচিতে লাগিলা ॥৬৪॥
verses.transliteration: govinda-dvārā prabhura śeṣa-prasāda pāilā\\npreme matta dui-jana nācite lāgilā
verses.translation: When they received the remnants of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's prasāda through Govinda, they respected it, and then they both began to dance in ecstasy.

verses.devanagari: আর দিন প্রভু রূপে মিলিয়া বসিলা  ।\\nসর্বজ্ঞ-শিরোমণি প্রভু কহিতে লাগিলা ॥৬৫॥
verses.transliteration: āra dina prabhu rūpe miliyā vasilā\\nsarvajña-śiromaṇi prabhu kahite lāgilā
verses.translation: On the next day, when Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went to see Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī, the omniscient Lord spoke as follows.

verses.devanagari: “কৃষ্ণেরে বাহির নাহি করিহ ব্রজ হৈতে  ।\\nব্রজ ছাড়ি’ কৃষ্ণ কভু না যান কাহাঁতে ॥৬৬॥
verses.transliteration: 'kṛṣṇere bāhira nāhi kariha vraja haite\\nvraja chāḍi' kṛṣṇa kabhu nā yāna kāhāṅte
verses.translation: Do not try to take Kṛṣṇa out of Vṛndāvana, for He does not go anywhere else at any time.

verses.devanagari: কৃষ্ণোঽন্যো যদুসম্ভূতো যঃ পূর্ণঃ সোঽস্ত্যতঃ পরঃ ।\\nবৃন্দাবনং পরিত্যজ্য স ক্কচিন্নৈব গচ্ছতি ॥৬৭॥
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇo 'nyo yadu-sambhūto\\nyaḥ pūrṇaḥ so 'sty ataḥ paraḥ\\nvṛndāvanaṁ parityajya\\nsa kvacin naiva gacchati
verses.translation: “ 'The Kṛṣṇa known as Yadukumāra is Vāsudeva Kṛṣṇa. He is different from the Kṛṣṇa who is the son of Nanda Mahārāja. Yadukumāra Kṛṣṇa manifests His pastimes in the cities of Mathurā and Dvārakā, but Kṛṣṇa the son of Nanda Mahārāja never at any time leaves Vṛndāvana.' "
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This verse is included in the
Laghu-bhāgavatāmṛta
(1.5.461), by Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī.

verses.devanagari: এত কহি’ মহাপ্রভু মধ্যাহ্নে চলিলা ।\\nরূপ-গোসাঞি মনে কিছু বিস্ময় হইলা ॥৬৮॥
verses.transliteration: eta kahi' mahāprabhu madhyāhne calilā\\nrūpa-gosāñi mane kichu vismaya ha-ilā
verses.translation: After saying this, Caitanya Mahāprabhu went to perform His noontime duties, leaving Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī somewhat surprised.

verses.devanagari: “পৃথক্ নাটক করিতে সত্যভামা আজ্ঞা দিল ।\\nজানিলু, পৃথক্ নাটক করিতে প্রভু-আজ্ঞা হৈল ॥৬৯॥
verses.transliteration: "pṛthak nāṭaka karite satyabhāmā ājñā dila\\njānilu, pṛthak nāṭaka karite prabhu-ājñā haila
verses.translation: "Satyabhāmā ordered me to write two different dramas," Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī thought. "Now I understand that this order has been confirmed by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: পূর্বে দুই নাটক ছিল একত্র রচনা ।\\nদুইভাগ করি এবে করিমু ঘটনা ॥৭০॥
verses.transliteration: pūrve dui nāṭaka chila ekatra racanā\\ndui-bhāga kari ebe karimu ghaṭanā
verses.translation: FormerIy I wrote the two dramas as one composition. Now I shall divide it and describe the incidents in two separate works.

verses.devanagari: দুই ‘নান্দী’ ‘প্রস্তাবনা’, দুই ‘সংঘটনা’ ।\\nপৃথক্ করিয়া লিখি করিয়া ভাবনা ॥৭১॥
verses.transliteration: dui'nāndī' 'prastāvanā', dui'saṁghaṭanā'\\npṛthak kariyā likhi kariyā bhāvanā
verses.translation: I shall write two separate invocations of good fortune and two different introductions. Let me think deeply about the matter and then describe two different sets of incidents."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
The two works are
Vidagdha-mādhava
and
Lalita-mādhava. Vidagdha-mādhava
describes pastimes in Vṛndāvana, and
Lalita-mādhava
describes pastimes in Dvārakā and Mathurā.

verses.devanagari: রথযাত্রায় জগন্নাথ দর্শন করিলা ।\\nরথ-অগ্রে প্রভুর নৃত্য-কীর্তন দেখিলা ॥৭২॥
verses.transliteration: ratha-yātrāya jagannātha darśana karilā\\nratha-agre prabhura nṛtya-kīrtana dekhilā
verses.translation: During the Ratha-yātrā ceremony Rūpa Gosvāmī saw Lord Jagannātha. He also saw Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu dancing and chanting in front of the ratha.

verses.devanagari: প্রভুর নৃত্য-শ্লোক শুনি’ শ্রীরূপ-গোসাঞি ।\\nসেই শ্লোকার্থ লঞা শ্লোক করিলা তথাই ॥৭৩॥
verses.transliteration: prabhura nṛtya-śloka śuni' śrī-rūpa-gosāñi\\nsei ślokārtha lañā śloka karilā tathāi
verses.translation: When Rūpa Gosvāmī heard a verse uttered by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu during the ceremony, he immediately composed another verse dealing with the same subject.

verses.devanagari: পূর্বে সেই সব কথা করিয়াছি বর্ণন ।\\nতথাপি কহিয়ে কিছু সংক্ষেপে কথন ॥৭৪॥
verses.transliteration: pūrve sei saba kathā kariyāchi varṇana\\ntathāpi kahiye kichu saṅkṣepe kathana
verses.translation: I have already described all these incidents, but I still wish to add briefly something more.

verses.devanagari: সামান্য এক শ্লোক প্রভু পড়েন কীর্তনে ।\\nকেনে শ্লোক পড়ে — ইহা কেহ নাহি জানে ॥৭৫॥
verses.transliteration: sāmānya eka śloka prabhu paḍena kīrtane\\nkene śloka paḍe—ihā keha nāhi jāne
verses.translation: Generally Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu recited a verse while dancing and chanting before the ratha, but no one knew why He was reciting that particular verse.

verses.devanagari: সবে একা স্বরূপ গোসাঞি শ্লোকের অর্থ জানে ।\\nশ্লোকানুরূপ পদ প্রভুকে করান আস্বাদনে ॥৭৬॥
verses.transliteration: sabe ekā svarūpa gosāñi ślokera artha jāne\\nślokānurūpa pada prabhuke karāna āsvādane
verses.translation: Only Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī knew the purpose for which the Lord recited that verse. According to the Lord's attitude, he used to quote other verses to enable the Lord to relish mellows.

verses.devanagari: রূপ-গোসাঞি প্রভুর জানিয়া অভিপ্রায় ।\\nসেই অর্থে শ্লোক কৈলা প্রভুরে যে ভায় ॥৭৭॥
verses.transliteration: rūpa-gosāñi prabhura jāniyā abhiprāya\\nsei arthe śloka kailā prabhure ye bhāya
verses.translation: Rūpa Gosvāmī, however, could understand the intention of the Lord, and thus he composed another verse that appealed to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: যঃ কৌমারহরঃ স এব হি বরস্তা এব চৈত্রক্ষপা-\\nস্তে চোন্মীলিতমালতীসুরভয়ঃ প্রৌঢ়াঃ কদম্বানিলাঃ ।\\nসা চৈবাস্মি তথাপি তত্র সুরতব্যাপারলীলাবিধৌ\\nরেবারোধসি বেতসীতরুতলে চেতঃ সমুৎকণ্ঠতে ॥৭৮॥
verses.transliteration: yaḥ kaumāra-haraḥ sa eva hi varas tā eva caitra-kṣapās\\nte conmīlita-mālatī-surabhayaḥ prauḍhāḥ kadambānilāḥ\\nsā caivāsmi tathāpi tatra surata-vyāpāra-līlā-vidhau\\nrevā-rodhasi vetasī-taru-tale cetaḥ samutkaṇṭhate
verses.translation: That very personality who stole my heart during my youth is now again my master. These are the same moonlit nights of the month of Caitra. The same fragrance of mālatī flowers is there, and the same sweet breezes are blowing from the kadamba forest. In our intimate relationship, I am also the same lover, yet still my mind is not happy here. I am eager to go back to that place on the bank of the Revā under the Vetasī tree. That is my desire."
verses.purport: PURPORT\nThis is the verse recited by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: প্রিয়ঃ সোঽয়ং কৃষ্ণঃ সহচরি কুরুক্ষেত্রমিলিত-\\nস্তথাহং সা রাধা তদিদমুভয়োঃ সঙ্গমসুখম্ ।\\nতথাপ্যন্তঃখেলন্মধুরমুরলীপঞ্চমজুষে\\nমনো মে কালিন্দীপুলিনবিপিনায় স্পৃহয়তি ॥৭৯॥
verses.transliteration: priyaḥ so 'yaṁ kṛṣṇaḥ saha-cari kuru-kṣetra-militas\\ntathāhaṁ sā rādhā tad idam ubhayoḥ saṅgama-sukham\\ntathāpy antaḥ-khelan-madhura-muralī-pañcama-juṣe\\nmano me kālindī-pulina-vipināya spṛhayati
verses.translation: My dear friend, now I have met My very old and dear friend Kṛṣṇa on this field of Kurukṣetra. I am the same Rādhārāṇī, and now We are meeting together. It is very pleasant, but I would still like to go to the bank of the Yamunā beneath the trees of the forest there. I wish to hear the vibration of His sweet flute playing the fifth note within that forest of Vṛndāvana."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This is the verse composed by Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī. It is included in his book
Padyāvalī
(383).

verses.devanagari: তালপত্রে শ্লোক লিখি’ চালেতে রাখিলা ।\\nসমুদ্রস্নান করিবারে রূপ-গোসাঞি গেলা ॥৮০॥
verses.transliteration: tāla-patre śloka likhi' cālete rākhilā\\nsamudra-snāna karibāre rūpa-gosāñi gelā
verses.translation: After writing this verse on a palm leaf, Rūpa Gosvāmī put it somewhere in his thatched roof and went to bathe in the sea.

verses.devanagari: হেনকালে প্রভু আইলা তাঁহারে মিলিতে ।\\nচালে শ্লোক দেখি প্রভু লাগিলা পড়িতে ॥৮১॥
verses.transliteration: hena-kāle prabhu āilā tāṅhāre milite\\ncāle śloka dekhi prabhu lāgilā paḍite
verses.translation: At that time, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went there to meet him, and when He saw the leaf pushed into the roof and saw the verse, He began to read it.

verses.devanagari: শ্লোক পড়ি’ প্রভু সুখে প্রেমাবিষ্ট হৈলা ।\\nহেনকালে রূপ-গোসাঞি স্নান করি’ আইলা ॥৮২॥
verses.transliteration: śloka paḍi' prabhu sukhe premāviṣṭa hailā\\nhena-kāle rūpa-gosāñi snāna kari' āilā
verses.translation: After reading the verse, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was overwhelmed by ecstatic love. At that very time, Rūpa Gosvāmī returned, having finished bathing in the sea.

verses.devanagari: প্রভু দেখি’ দণ্ডবৎ প্রাঙ্গণে পড়িলা  ।\\nপ্রভু তাঁরে চাপড় মারি’ কহিতে লাগিলা ॥৮৩॥
verses.transliteration: prabhu tāṅre cāpaḍa māri' kahite lāgilā\\nprabhu dekhi' daṇḍavat prāṅgaṇe padilā
verses.translation: Seeing the Lord, Śrī Rūpa Gosvāmī fell flat in the courtyard to offer obeisances. The Lord slapped him mildly in love and spoke as follows.

verses.devanagari: ‘গূঢ় মোর হৃদয় তুঞি জানিলা কেমনে ?’ এত কহি’ রূপে কৈলা দৃঢ় আলিঙ্গনে ॥৮৪॥
verses.transliteration: 'gūḍha mora hṛdaya tuñi jānilā kemane?'\\neta kahi' rūpe kailā dṛḍha āliṅgane
verses.translation: My heart is very confidential. How did you know My mind in this way?" After saying this, He firmly embraced Rūpa Gosvāmī.

verses.devanagari: সেই শ্লোক লঞা প্রভু স্বরূপে দেখাইলা  ।\\nস্বরূপের পরীক্ষা লাগি’ তাঁহারে পুছিলা ॥৮৫॥
verses.transliteration: sei śloka lañā prabhu svarūpe dekhāilā\\nsvarūpera parīkṣā lāgi' tāṅhāre puchilā
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu took that verse and showed it to Svarūpa Dāmodara for him to examine. Then the Lord questioned him.

verses.devanagari: ‘মোর অন্তর-বার্তা রূপ জানিল কেমনে ?’ স্বরূপ কহে — “জানি, কৃপা করিয়াছ আপনে ॥৮৬॥
verses.transliteration: 'mora antara-vārtā rūpa jānila kemane?'\\nsvarūpa kahe—'jāni, kṛpā kariyācha āpane
verses.translation: How could Rūpa Gosvāmī have understood My heart?" the Lord asked. Svarūpa Dāmodara replied, "I can understand that You have already bestowed Your causeless mercy upon him.

verses.devanagari: অন্যথা এ অর্থ কার নাহি হয় জ্ঞান  ।\\nতুমি পূর্বে কৃপা কৈলা, করি অনুমান ।।” ৮৭ ॥৮৭॥
verses.transliteration: anyathā e artha kāra nāhi haya jñāna\\ntumi pūrve kṛpā kailā, kari anumāna"
verses.translation: No one could otherwise understand this meaning. I can therefore guess that previously You bestowed upon him Your causeless mercy."

verses.devanagari: প্রভু কহে, — “ইঁহো আমায় প্রয়াগে মিলিল ।\\nযোগ্যপাত্র জানি ইঁহায় মোর কৃপা ত’ হইল ॥৮৮॥
verses.transliteration: prabhu kahe,—"iṅho āmāya prayāge milila\\nyogya-pātra jāni iṅhāya mora kṛpā ta' ha-ila
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied, "Rūpa Gosvāmī met Me at Prayāga. Knowing him to be a suitable person, I naturally bestowed My mercy upon him.

verses.devanagari: তবে শক্তি সঞ্চারি’ আমি কৈলুঁ উপদেশ ।\\nতুমিহ কহিও ইহাঁয় রসের বিশেষ ।।” ॥ ৮৯ ॥
verses.transliteration: tabe śakti sañcāri' āmi kailuṅ upadeśa\\ntumiha kahio ihāṅya rasera viśeṣa"
verses.translation: I thereupon also bestowed upon him My transcendental potency. Now you also should give him instructions. In particular, instruct him in transcendental mellows."

verses.devanagari: স্বরূপ কহে — “যাতে এই শ্লোক দেখিলুঁ ।\\nতুমি করিয়াছ কৃপা, তবঁহি জানিলু ॥৯০॥
verses.transliteration: svarūpa kahe—"yāte ei śloka dekhiluṅ\\ntumi kariyācha kṛpā, tavaṅhi jānilu
verses.translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara said, "As soon as I saw the unique composition of this verse, I could immediately understand that You had bestowed upon him Your special mercy.

verses.devanagari: “ফলেন ফলকারণমনুমীয়তে ॥৯১॥
verses.transliteration: phalena phala-kāraṇam anumīyate
verses.translation: By seeing a result, one can understand the cause of that result.'
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This verse is from the doctrines of
nyāya,
or logic.

verses.devanagari: “স্বর্গাপগা-হেমমৃণালিনীনাং\\nনানা-মৃণালাগ্রভুজো ভজামঃ ।\\nঅন্নানুরূপাং তনুরূপঋদ্ধিং\\nকার্যং নিদানাদ্ধি গুণানধীতে ।।” ॥ ৯২ ॥
verses.transliteration: svargāpagā-hema-mṛṇālinīnāṁ\\nnānā-mṛṇālāgra-bhujo bhajāmaḥ\\nannānurūpāṁ tanu-rūpa-ṛddhiṁ\\nkāryaṁ nidānād dhi guṇān adhīte
verses.translation: The River Ganges flowing from the heavenly planets is full of golden lotus flowers, and we, the residents of those planets, eat the stems of the flowers. Thus we are very beautiful, more so than the inhabitants of any other planet. This is due to the law of cause and effect, for if one eats food in the mode of goodness, the mode of goodness increases the beauty of his body.' "
verses.purport:
PURPORT
One's bodily luster and beauty, one's constitution, one's activities and one's qualities all depend on the law of cause and effect. There are three qualities in material nature, and as stated in
Bhagavad-gītā
(Bg. 13.22),
kāraṇaṁ guṇa-saṅgo 'sya sad-asad-yoni-janmasu:
one takes birth in a good or bad family according to his previous association with the qualities of material nature. Therefore one seriously eager to achieve transcendental perfection, Kṛṣṇa consciousness, must eat Kṛṣṇa
prasāda.
Such food is
sāttvika,
or in the material quality of goodness, but when offered to Kṛṣṇa it becomes transcendental. Our Kṛṣṇa consciousness movement distributes Kṛṣṇa
prasāda,
and those who eat such transcendental food are sure to become devotees of the Lord. This is a very scientific method, as stated in this verse from
Nala-naiṣadha
(3.17):
kāryaṁ nidānād dhi guṇān adhīte.
If in all one's activities he strictly adheres to the mode of goodness, he will certainly develop his dormant Kṛṣṇa consciousness and ultimately become a pure devotee of Lord Kṛṣṇa.
Unfortunately at the present moment the bodily constitutions of the leaders of society, especially the governmental leaders, are polluted. As described in
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
(12.1.40):
asaṁskṛtāḥ kriyā-hīnā
rajasā tamasāvṛtāḥ
prajās te bhakṣayiṣyanti
mlecchā rājanya-rūpiṇaḥ
Such leaders have no chance to purify their eating. Politicians meet together and exchange good wishes by drinking liquor, which is so polluted and sinful that naturally drunkards and meat-eaters develop a degraded mentality in the mode of ignorance. The processes of eating in different modes are explained in
Bhagavad-gītā,
wherein it is stated that those who eat rice, wheat, vegetables, milk products, fruit and sugar are situated in the elevated quality of goodness. Therefore if we want a happy and tranquil political situation, we must select leaders who eat Kṛṣṇa
prasāda.
Otherwise the leaders will eat meat and drink wine, and thus they will be
asaṁskṛtāḥ,
unreformed, and
kriyā-hīnāḥ,
devoid of spiritual behavior. In other words, they will be
mlecchas
and
yavanas,
or men who are unclean in their habits. Through taxation, such men exploit the citizens as much as possible, and in this way they devour the citizens of the state instead of benefiting them. We therefore cannot expect a government to be efficient if it is headed by such unclean
mlecchas
and
yavanas.

verses.devanagari: চাতুর্মাস্য রহি’ গৌড়ে বৈষ্ণব চলিলা ।\\nরূপ-গোসাঞি মহাপ্রভুর চরণে রহিলা ॥৯৩॥
verses.transliteration: cāturmāsya rahi' gauḍe vaiṣṇava calilā\\nrūpa-gosāñi mahāprabhura caraṇe rahilā
verses.translation: After the four months of Cāturmāsya [Śrāvaṇa, Bhādra, Āśvina and Kārttika], all the Vaiṣṇavas of Bengal returned to their homes, but Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī remained in Jagannātha Purī under the shelter of the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: একদিন রূপ করেন নাটক লিখন ।\\nআচম্বিতে মহাপ্রভুর হৈল আগমন ॥৯৪॥
verses.transliteration: eka-dina rūpa karena nāṭaka likhana\\nācambite mahāprabhura haila āgamana
verses.translation: One day while Rūpa Gosvāmī was writing his book, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu suddenly appeared.

verses.devanagari: সম্ভ্রমে দুঁহে উঠি’ দণ্ডবৎ হৈলা ।\\nদুঁহে আলিঙ্গিয়া প্রভু আসনে বসিলা ॥৯৫॥
verses.transliteration: sambhrame duṅhe uṭhi' daṇḍavat hailā\\nduṅhe āliṅgiyā prabhu āsane vasilā
verses.translation: As soon as Haridāsa Ṭhākura and Rūpa Gosvāmī saw the Lord coming, they both stood up and then fell down to offer Him their respectful obeisances. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu embraced them both and then sat down.

verses.devanagari: ‘ক্যা পুঁথি লিখ?’ বলি’ একপত্র নিলা ।\\nঅক্ষর দেখিয়া প্রভু মনে সুখী হৈলা ॥৯৬॥
verses.transliteration: 'kyā puṅthi likha?' bali' eka-patra nilā\\nakṣara dekhiyā prabhu mane sukhī hailā
verses.translation: The Lord inquired, "What kind of book are you writing?" He held up a palm leaf that was a page of the manuscript, and when He saw the fine handwriting, His mind was very pleased.

verses.devanagari: শ্রীরূপের অক্ষর — যেন মুকুতার পাঁতি ।\\nপ্রীত হঞা করেন প্রভু অক্ষরের স্তুতি ॥৯৭॥
verses.transliteration: śrī-rūpera akṣara—yena mukutāra pāṅti\\nprīta hañā karena prabhu akṣarera stuti
verses.translation: Thus being pleased, the Lord praised the writing by saying, "The handwriting of Rūpa Gosvāmī is just like rows of pearls."

verses.devanagari: সেই পত্রে প্রভু এক শ্লোক যে দেখিলা ।\\nপড়িতেই শ্লোক, প্রেমে আবিষ্ট হইলা ॥৯৮॥
verses.transliteration: sei patre prabhu eka śloka ye dekhilā\\npaḍitei śloka, preme āviṣṭa ha-ilā
verses.translation: While reading the manuscript, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu saw a verse on that page, and as soon as He read it He was overwhelmed by ecstatic love.

verses.devanagari: তুণ্ডে তাণ্ডবিনী রতিং বিতনুতে তুণ্ডাবলীলব্ধয়ে\\nকর্ণক্রোড়কড়ম্বিনী ঘটয়তে কর্ণার্বুদেভ্যঃ স্পৃহাম্ ।\\nচেতঃপ্রাঙ্গণসঙ্গিনী বিজয়তে সর্বেন্দ্রিয়াণাং কৃতিং\\nনো জানে জনিতা কিয়দ্ভিরমৃতৈঃ কৃষ্ণেতি বর্ণদ্বয়ী ॥৯৯॥
verses.transliteration: tuṇḍe tāṇḍavinī ratiṁ vitanute tuṇḍāvalī-labdhaye\\nkarṇa-kroḍa-kaḍambinī ghaṭayate karṇārbudebhyaḥ spṛhām\\ncetaḥ-prāṅgaṇa-saṅginī vijayate sarvendriyāṇāṁ kṛtiṁ\\nno jāne janitā kiyadbhir amṛtaiḥ kṛṣṇeti varṇa-dvayī
verses.translation: "I do not know how much nectar the two syllables 'Kṛṣ-ṇa' have produced. When the holy name of Kṛṣṇa is chanted, it appears to dance within the mouth. We then desire many, many mouths. When that name enters the holes of the ears, we desire many millions of ears. And when the holy name dances in the courtyard of the heart, it conquers the activities of the mind, and therefore all the senses become inert."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This verse is included in the
Vidagdha-mādhava
(1.15), a seven-act play written by Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī describing the pastimes of Śrī Kṛṣṇa in Vṛndāvana.

verses.devanagari: শ্লোক শুনি’ হরিদাস হইলা উল্লাসী ।\\nনাচিতে লাগিলা শ্লোকের অর্থ প্রশংসি’ ॥১০০॥
verses.transliteration: śloka śuni haridāsa ha-ila ullāsī\\nnācite lāgilā ślokera artha praśaṁsi'
verses.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu chanted this verse, Haridāsa Ṭhākura, upon hearing the vibration, became jubilant and began dancing and praising its meaning.

verses.devanagari: কৃষ্ণনামের মহিমা শাস্ত্র-সাধু-মুখে জানি ।\\nনামের মাধুরী ঐছে কাহাঁ নাহি শুনি ॥১০১॥
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇa-nāmera mahimā śāstra-sādhu-mukhe jāni\\nnāmera mādhurī aiche kāhāṅ nāhi śuni
verses.translation: One has to learn about the beauty and transcendental position of the holy name of the Lord by hearing the revealed scriptures from the mouths of devotees. Nowhere else can we hear of the sweetness of the Lord's holy name.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
It is said in the P
adma Purāṇa, ataḥ śrī-kṛṣṇa-nāmādi na bhaved grāhyam indriyaiḥ.
Chanting and hearing of the transcendental holy name of the Lord cannot be performed by the ordinary senses. The transcendental vibration of the Lord's holy name is completely spiritual. Thus it must be received from spiritual sources and must be chanted after having been heard from a spiritual master. One who hears the chanting of the Hare Kṛṣṇa
mantra
must receive it from the spiritual master by aural reception. Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī has forbidden us to hear the holy name of Kṛṣṇa chanted by non-Vaiṣṇavas, such as professional actors and singers, for it will have no effect. It is like milk touched by the lips of a serpent, as stated in the
padma purāṇa:
avaiṣṇava-mukhodgīrṇaṁ
pūtaṁ hari-kathāmṛtam
śravaṇaṁ naiva kartavyaṁ
sarpocchiṣṭaṁ yathā payaḥ
As far as possible, therefore, the devotees in the Kṛṣṇa consciousness movement gather to chant the holy name of Kṛṣṇa in public so that both the chanters and the listeners may benefit.

verses.devanagari: তবে মহাপ্রভু দুঁহে করি’ আলিঙ্গন ।\\nমধ্যাহ্ন করিতে সমুদ্রে করিলা গমন ॥১০২॥
verses.transliteration: tabe mahāprabhu duṅhe kari' āliṅgana\\nmadhyāhna karite samudre karilā gamana
verses.translation: Thus Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu embraced both Haridāsa and Rūpa Gosvāmī and left for the seaside to perform His noontime duties.

verses.devanagari: আর দিন মহাপ্রভু দেখি’ জগন্নাথ ।\\nসার্বভৌম-রামানন্দ-স্বরূপাদি-সাথ ॥১০৩॥\\nসবে মিলি’ চলি আইলা শ্রীরূপে মিলিতে ।\\nপথে তাঁর গুণ সবারে লাগিলা কহিতে ॥১০৪॥
verses.transliteration: sabe mili' cali āilā śrī-rūpe milite\\npathe tāṅra guṇa sabāre lāgilā kahite
verses.translation: On the next day, after visiting the temple of Jagannātha as usual, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu met Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya, Rāmānanda Rāya and Svarūpa Dāmodara. They all went together to Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī, and on the way the Lord greatly praised his qualities.

verses.devanagari: দুই শ্লোক কহি’ প্রভুর হৈল মহাসুখ ।\\nনিজ-ভক্তের গুণ কহে হঞা পঞ্চমুখ ॥১০৫॥
verses.transliteration: dui śloka kahi' prabhura haila mahā-sukha\\nnija-bhaktera guna kahe hañā pañca-mukha
verses.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu recited the two important verses, He felt great pleasure; thus, as if He had five mouths, He began to praise His devotee.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
The two verses referred to are those beginning with
priyaḥ so 'yam
(79) and
tuṇḍe tāṇḍavinī
(99).

verses.devanagari: সার্বভৌম-রামানন্দে পরীক্ষা করিতে ।\\nশ্রীরূপের গুণ দুঁহারে লাগিলা কহিতে ॥১০৬॥
verses.transliteration: sārvabhauma-rāmānande parīkṣā karite\\nśrī-rūpera guṇa duṅhāre lāgilā kahite
verses.translation: Just to examine Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya and Rāmānanda Rāya, the Lord began to praise the transcendental qualities of Śrī Rūpa Gosvāmī before them.

verses.devanagari: ‘ঈশ্বর-স্বভাব’ — ভক্তের না লয় অপরাধ ।\\nঅল্পসেবা বহু মানে আত্মপর্যন্ত প্রসাদ ॥১০৭॥
verses.transliteration: 'īśvara-svabhāva'—bhaktera nā laya aparādha\\nalpa-sevā bahu māne ātma-paryanta prasāda
verses.translation: Characteristically, the Supreme Personality of Godhead does not take seriously an offense committed by a pure devotee. The Lord accepts whatever small service a devotee renders as being such a great service that He is prepared to give even Himself, not to speak of other benedictions.

verses.devanagari: ভৃত্যস্য পশ্যতি গুরূনপি নাপরাধান্\\nসেবাং মনাগপি কৃতাং বহুধাভ্যুপৈতি ।\\nআবিষ্করোতি পিশুনেষ্বপি নাভ্যসূয়াং\\nশীলেন নির্মলমতিঃ পুরুষোত্তমোঽয়ম্ ॥১০৮॥
verses.transliteration: bhṛtyasya paśyati gurūn api nāparādhān\\nsevāṁ manāg api kṛtāṁ bahudhābhyupaiti\\nāviṣkaroti piśuneṣv api nābhyasūyāṁ\\nśīlena nirmala-matiḥ puruṣottamo 'yam
verses.translation: "The Supreme Personality of Godhead, who is known as Puruṣottama, the greatest of all persons, has a pure mind. He is so gentle that even if His servant is implicated in a great offense, He does not take it very seriously. Indeed, if His servant renders some small service, the Lord accepts it as being very great. Even if an envious person blasphemes the Lord, the Lord never manifests anger against him. Such are His great qualities."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This verse is from the
Bhakti-rasāmṛta-sindhu
(2.1.138) by Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī.

verses.devanagari: ভক্তসঙ্গে প্রভু আইলা, দেখি’ দুই জন ।\\nদণ্ডবৎ হঞা কৈলা চরণ বন্দন ॥১০৯॥
verses.transliteration: bhakta-saṅge prabhu āilā, dekhi' dui jana\\ndaṇḍavat hañā kailā caraṇa vandana
verses.translation: When Haridāsa Ṭhākura and Rūpa Gosvāmī saw that Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had come with His intimate devotees, they both immediately fell down like logs and offered prayers to their lotus feet.

verses.devanagari: ভক্তসঙ্গে কৈলা প্রভু দুঁহারে মিলন ।\\nপিণ্ডাতে বসিলা প্রভু লঞা ভক্তগণ ॥১১০॥
verses.transliteration: bhakta-saṅge kailā prabhu duṅhāre milana\\npiṇḍāte vasilā prabhu lañā bhakta-gaṇa
verses.translation: Thus Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and His personal devotees met Rūpa Gosvāmī and Haridāsa Ṭhākura. The Lord then sat down in an elevated place with His devotees.

verses.devanagari: রূপ হরিদাস দুঁহে বসিলা পিণ্ডাতলে ।\\nসবার আগ্রহে না উঠিলা পিঁড়ার উপরে ॥১১১॥
verses.transliteration: rūpa haridāsa duṅhe vasilā piṇḍā-tale\\nsabāra āgrahe nā uṭhilā piṅḍāra upare
verses.translation: Rūpa Gosvāmī and Haridāsa Ṭhākura sat at the foot of the elevated place where Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was sitting. Although everyone asked them to sit on the same level as the Lord and His associates, they did not do so.

verses.devanagari: ‘পূর্বশ্লোক পড়, রূপ’ প্রভু আজ্ঞা কৈলা ।\\nলজ্জাতে না পড়ে রূপ মৌন ধরিলা ॥১১২॥
verses.transliteration: 'pūrva-śloka paḍa, rūpa' prabhu ājñā kailā\\nlajjāte nā paḍe rūpa mauna dharilā
verses.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu ordered Rūpa Gosvāmī to read the verse they had previously heard, Rūpa Gosvāmī, because of great shyness, did not read it but instead remained silent.

verses.devanagari: স্বরূপ-গোসাঞি তবে সেই শ্লোক পড়িল ।\\nশুনি’ সবাকার চিত্তে চমৎকার হৈল ॥১১৩॥
verses.transliteration: svarūpa-gosāñi tabe sei śloka paḍila\\nśuni' sabākāra citte camatkāra haila
verses.translation: Then Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī recited the verse, and when all the devotees heard it, their minds were struck with wonder.

verses.devanagari: প্রিয়ঃ সোঽয়ং কৃষ্ণঃ সহচরি কুরুক্ষেত্রমিলিত-\\nস্তথাহং সা রাধা তদিদমুভয়োঃ সঙ্গমসুখম্ ।\\nতথাপ্যন্তঃখেলন্মধুরমুরলীপঞ্চমজুষে\\nমনো মে কালিন্দীপুলিনবিপিনায় স্পৃহয়তি ॥১১৪॥
verses.transliteration: priyaḥ so 'yaṁ kṛṣṇaḥ saha-cari kuru-kṣetra-militas\\ntathāhaṁ sā rādhā tad idam ubhayoḥ saṅgama-sukham\\ntathāpy antaḥ-khelan-madhura-muralī-pañcama-juṣe\\nmano me kālindī-pulina-vipināya spṛhayati
verses.translation: "My dear friend, now I have met My very old and dear friend Kṛṣṇa on this field of Kurukṣetra. I am the same Rādhārāṇī, and now We are meeting together. It is very pleasant, but I would still like to go to the bank of the Yamunā beneath the trees of the forest there. I wish to hear the vibration of His sweet flute playing the fifth note within that forest of Vṛndāvana."

verses.devanagari: রায়, ভট্টাচার্য বলে, — “তোমার প্রসাদ বিনে ।\\nতোমার হৃদয় এই জানিল কেমনে ॥১১৫॥
verses.transliteration: rāya, bhaṭṭācārya bale,—"tomāra prasāda vine\\ntomāra hṛdaya ei jānila kemane
verses.translation: After hearing this verse, both Rāmānanda Rāya and Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya said to Caitanya Mahāprabhu, "Without Your special mercy, how could this Rūpa Gosvāmī have understood Your mind?"

verses.devanagari: আমাতে সঞ্চারি’ পূর্বে কহিলা সিদ্ধান্ত ।\\nযে সব সিদ্ধান্তে ব্রহ্মা নাহি পায় অন্ত ॥১১৬॥
verses.transliteration: āmāte sañcāri' pūrve kahilā siddhānta\\nye saba siddhānte brahmā nāhi pāya anta
verses.translation: Śrīla Rāmānanda Rāya admitted that previously Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had empowered his heart so that he could express elevated and conclusive statements to which even Lord Brahmā has no access.

verses.devanagari: তাতে জানি — পূর্বে তোমার পাঞাছে প্রসাদ ।\\nতাহা বিনা নহে তোমার হৃদয়ানুবাদ ।।” ॥ ১১৭ ॥
verses.transliteration: tāte jāni—pūrve tomāra pāñāche prasāda\\ntāhā vinā nahe tomāra hṛdayānuvāda"
verses.translation: "Had you not previously bestowed Your mercy on him," they said, "it would not have been possible for him to express Your internal feelings."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Devotees acknowledge Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's special mercy upon Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī in the following words:
śrī-caitanya-mano 'bhīṣṭaṁ-
sthāpitaṁ yena bhū-tale
svayaṁ rūpaḥ kadā mahyaṁ
dadāti sva-padāntikam
"When will Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī Prabhupāda, who has established within this material world the mission to fulfill the desire of Lord Caitanya, give me shelter under his lotus feet?"
The special function of Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī is to establish the feelings of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. These feelings are His desires that His special mercy be spread throughout the world in this Kali-yuga.
pṛthivīte āche yata nagarādi-grāma
sarvatra pracāra haibe mora nāma
His desire is that all over the world everyone, in every village and every town, know of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and His
saṅkīrtana
movement. These are the inner feelings of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Śrī Rūpa Gosvāmī committed to writing all these feelings of the Lord. Now again, by the mercy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the same feelings are being spread all over the world by the servants of the Gosvāmīs, and devotees who are pure and simple will appreciate this attempt. As concluded by Śrīla Kṛṣṇadāsa Kavirāja Gosvāmī, however, those who are on the level of hogs and dogs will never appreciate such a great attempt. Yet this does not matter to the preachers of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's cult, for all over the world they will continue to perform this responsible work, even though persons who are like cats and dogs do not appreciate them.

verses.devanagari: প্রভু কহে, — “কহ রূপ, নাটকের শ্লোক ।\\nযে শ্লোক শুনিলে লোকের যায় দুঃখ-শোক ।।” ॥ ১১৮ ॥
verses.transliteration: prabhu kahe,—"kaha rūpa, nāṭakera śloka\\nye śloka śunile lokera yāya duḥkha-śoka
verses.translation: Thus Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "My dear Rūpa, please recite that verse from your drama which, upon being heard, makes all people's unhappiness and lamentation go away."

verses.devanagari: বার বার প্রভু যদি তারে আজ্ঞা দিল ।\\nতবে সেই শ্লোক রূপগোসাঞি কহিল ॥১১৯॥
verses.transliteration: bāra bāra prabhu yadi tāre ājñā dila\\ntabe sei śloka rūpa-gosāñi kahila
verses.translation: When the Lord persisted in asking this again and again, Rūpa Gosvāmī recited that verse [as follows].

verses.devanagari: তুণ্ডে তাণ্ডবিনী রতিং বিতনুতে তুণ্ডাবলীলব্ধয়ে\\nকর্ণক্রোড়কড়ম্বিনী ঘটয়তে কর্ণার্বুদেভ্যঃ স্পৃহাম্ ।\\nচেতঃপ্রাঙ্গণসঙ্গিনী বিজয়তে সর্বেন্দ্রিয়াণাং কৃতিং\\nনো জানে জনিতা কিয়দ্ভিরমৃতৈঃ কৃষ্ণেতি বর্ণদ্বয়ী ॥১২০॥
verses.transliteration: tuṇḍe tāṇḍavinī ratiṁ vitanute tuṇḍāvalī-labdhaye\\nkarṇa-kroḍa-kaḍambinī ghaṭayate karṇārbudebhyaḥ spṛhām\\ncetaḥ-prāṅgaṇa-saṅginī vijayate sarvendriyāṇāṁ kṛtiṁ\\nno jāne janitā kiyadbhir amṛtaiḥ kṛṣṇeti varṇa-dvayī
verses.translation: "I do not know how much nectar the two syllables 'Kṛṣ-ṇa' have produced. When the holy name of Kṛṣṇa is chanted, it appears to dance within the mouth. We then desire many, many mouths. When that name enters the holes of the ears, we desire many millions of ears. And when the holy name dances in the courtyard of the heart, it conquers the activities of the mind, and therefore all the senses become inert."

verses.devanagari: যত ভক্তবৃন্দ আর রামানন্দ রায় ।\\nশ্লোক শুনি’ সবার হইল আনন্দ-বিস্ময় ॥১২১॥
verses.transliteration: yata bhakta-vṛnda āra rāmānanda rāya\\nśloka śuni' sabāra ha-ila ānanda-vismaya
verses.translation: When all the devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, especially Śrī Rāmānanda Rāya, heard this verse, they were all filled with transcendental bliss and were struck with wonder.

verses.devanagari: সবে বলে, — ‘নাম-মহিমা শুনিয়াছি অপার ।\\nএমন মাধুর্য কেহ নাহি বর্ণে আর ।।’ ॥ ১২২ ॥
verses.transliteration: sabe bale,—'nāma-mahimā śuniyāchi apāra\\nemana mādhurya keha nāhi varṇe āra'
verses.translation: Everyone admitted that although they had heard many statements glorifying the holy name of the Lord, they had never heard such sweet descriptions as those of Rūpa Gosvāmī.

verses.devanagari: রায় কহে, — “কোন্ গ্রন্থ কর হেন জানি ?\\nযাহার ভিতরে এই সিদ্ধান্তের খনি ?” ॥ ১২৩ ॥
verses.transliteration: rāya kahe,—"kon grantha kara hena jāni?\\nyāhāra bhitare ei siddhāntera khani?"
verses.translation: Rāmānanda Rāya inquired, "What kind of drama are you writing? We ca understand that it is a mine of conclusive statements."

verses.devanagari: স্বরূপ কহে, — “কৃষ্ণলীলার নাটক করিতে  ।\\nব্রজলীলা-পুরলীলা একত্র বর্ণিতে ॥১২৪॥
verses.transliteration: svarūpa kahe,—"kṛṣṇa-līlāra nāṭaka karite\\nvraja-līlā-pura-līlā ekatra varṇite
verses.translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara replied for Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī: "He wanted to compose a drama about the pastimes of Lord Kṛṣṇa. He planned to describe in one book both the pastimes of Vṛndāvana and those of Dvārakā and Mathurā.

verses.devanagari: আরম্ভিয়াছিলা, এবে প্রভু-আজ্ঞা পাঞা  ।\\nদুই নাটক করিতেছে বিভাগ করিয়া ॥১২৫॥
verses.transliteration: ārambhiyāchilā, ebe prabhu-ājñā pāñā\\ndui nāṭaka kariteche vibhāga kariyā
verses.translation: "He began it in that way, but now, following the order of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, he has divided it in two and is writing two plays, one concerning the pastimes of Mathurā and Dvārakā and the other concerning the pastimes of Vṛndāvana.

verses.devanagari: বিদগ্ধমাধব আর ললিতমাধব ।\\nদুই নাটকে প্রেমরস অদভুত সব ।।” ॥ ১২৬ ॥
verses.transliteration: vidagdha-mādhava āra lalita-mādhava\\ndui nāṭake prema-rasa adabhuta saba"
verses.translation: "The two plays are called Vidagdha-mādhava and Lalita-mādhava. Both of them wonderfully describe ecstatic emotional love of God."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura informs us in this connection that Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī composed the drama known as
Vidagdha-mādhava
in the year Śakābda 1454, and he finished
Lalita-mādhava
in Śakābda 1459. The discussion between Rāmānanda Rāya and Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī at Jagannātha Purī took place in Śakābda 1437.

verses.devanagari: রায় কহে, — “নান্দী-শ্লোক পড় দেখি, শুনি ?”\\nশ্রীরূপ শ্লোক পড়ে প্রভু-আজ্ঞা মানি’ ॥১২৭॥
verses.transliteration: rāya kahe,—"nāndī-śloka paḍa dekhi, śuni?"\\nśrī-rūpa śloka paḍe prabhu-ājñā māni'
verses.translation: Rāmānanda Rāya said, "PIease recite the introductory verse of Vidagdhamādhava so that I can hear and examine it." Thus Śrī Rūpa Gosvāmī, being ordered by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, recited the verse (1.1).

verses.devanagari: সুধানাং চান্দ্রীণামপি মধুরিমোন্মাদ-দমনী\\nদধানা রাধাদিপ্রণয়ঘনসারৈঃ সুরভিতাম্ ।\\nসমন্তাৎ সন্তাপোদ্গম-বিষমসংসার-সরণী-\\nপ্রণীতাং তে তৃষ্ণাং হরতু হরিলীলা-শিখরিণী ॥১২৮॥
verses.transliteration: sudhānāṁ cāndrīṇām api madhurimonmāda-damanī\\ndadhānā rādhādi-praṇaya-ghana-sāraiḥ surabhitām\\nsamantāt santāpodgama-viṣama-saṁsāra-saraṇī-\\npraṇītāṁ te tṛṣṇāṁ haratu hari-līlā-śikhariṇī
verses.translation: "May the pastimes of Śrī Kṛṣṇa reduce the miseries existing in the material world and nullify all unwanted desires. The pastimes of the Supreme Personality of Godhead are like śikhariṇī, a blend of yogurt and sugar candy. They overpower the pride of even the nectar produced on the moon, for they distribute the sweet fragrance of the concentrated loving affairs of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī and the gopīs."

verses.devanagari: রায় কহে, — ‘কহ ইষ্টদেবের বর্ণন’ ।\\nপ্রভুর সঙ্কোচে রূপ না করে পঠন ॥১২৯॥
verses.transliteration: rāya kahe,—'kaha iṣṭa-devera varṇana'\\nprabhura saṅkoce rūpa nā kare paṭhana
verses.translation: Rāmānanda Rāya said, "Now please recite the description of the glories of your worshipable Deity." Rūpa Gosvāmī, however, hesitated due to embarrassment because Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was present.

verses.devanagari: প্রভু কহে, — “কহ, কেনে কর সঙ্কোচ-লাজে ?\\nগ্রন্থের ফল শুনাইবা বৈষ্ণব-সমাজে ?” ॥ ১৩০ ॥
verses.transliteration: prabhu kahe,—"kaha, kene kara saṅkoca-lāje?\\ngranthera phala śunāibā vaiṣṇava samāje?"
verses.translation: The Lord, however, encouraged Rūpa Gosvāmī, saying, "Why are you embarrassed? You should recite it so the devotees can hear the good fruit of your writing."

verses.devanagari: তবে রূপ-গোসাঞি যদি শ্লোক পড়িল ।\\nশুনি’ প্রভু কহে, — ‘এই অতি স্তুতি হৈল’ ॥১৩১॥
verses.transliteration: tabe rūpa-gosāñi yadi śloka paḍila\\nśuni' prabhu kahe,—'ei ati stuti haila'
verses.translation: When Rūpa Gosvāmī thus recited his verse, Caitanya Mahāprabhu disapproved of it because it described His personal glories. He expressed the opinion that it was an exaggerated explanation.

verses.devanagari: অনর্পিতচরীং চিরাৎ করুণয়াবতীর্ণঃ কলৌ ।\\nসমর্পয়িতুমুন্নতোজ্জ্বলরসাং স্বভক্তিশ্রিয়ম্ ।\\nহরিঃ পুরটসুন্দরদ্যুতিকদম্বসন্দীপিতঃ\\nসদা হৃদয়কন্দরে স্ফুরতু বঃ শচীনন্দনঃ ॥১৩২॥
verses.transliteration: anarpita-carīṁ cirāt karuṇayāvatīrṇaḥ kalau\\nsamarpayitum unnatojjvala-rasāṁ sva-bhakti-śriyam\\nhariḥ puraṭa-sundara-dyuti-kadamba-sandīpitaḥ\\nsadā hṛdaya-kandare sphuratu vaḥ śacī-nandanaḥ
verses.translation: "May the Supreme Lord, who is known as the son of Śrīmatī Śacīdevī, be transcendentally situated in the innermost core of your heart. Resplendent with the radiance of molten gold, He has descended in the Age of Kali by His causeless mercy to bestow what no incarnation has ever offered before: the most elevated mellow of devotional service, the mellow of conjugal love."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This verse (
Vidagdha-mādhava
1.2) also appears in
Ādi-līlā
(1.4 and 3.4). In his commentary on
Vidagdha-mādhava,
Śrīla Viśvanātha Cakravartī  Ṭhākura remarks:
mahā-prabhoḥ sphūrtiṁ vinā hari-līlā-rasāsvādanānupapatter iti bhāvaḥ.
Without the mercy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, one cannot describe the pastimes of the Supreme personality of Godhead. Therefore Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī said,
vaḥ yuṣmākaṁ hṛdaya-rūpa-guhā yāṁ śacī-nandano hariḥ, pakṣe, siṁhaḥ sphuratu:
"May Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, who is exactly like a lion that kills all the elephants of desire, be awakened within everyone's heart, for by His merciful blessings one can understand the transcendental pastimes of Kṛṣṇa."

verses.devanagari: সব ভক্তগণ কহে শ্লোক শুনিয়া ।\\nকৃতার্থ করিলা সবায় শ্লোক শুনাঞা ॥১৩৩॥
verses.transliteration: saba bhakta-gaṇa kahe śloka śuniyā\\nkṛtārtha karilā sabāya śloka śunāñā
verses.translation: All the devotees present so greatly appreciated this verse that they expressed their gratitude to Śrī Rūpa Gosvāmī for his transcendental recitation.

verses.devanagari: রায় কহে, — “কোন্ আমুখে পাত্র-সন্নিধান ?”\\nরূপ কহে, — “কালসাম্যে ‘প্রবর্তক’ নাম” ॥১৩৪॥
verses.transliteration: rāya kahe,—"kon āmukhe pātra-sannidhāna?"\\nrūpa kahe,—"kāla-sāmye 'pravartaka' nāma"
verses.translation: Rāmānanda Rāya inquired, "How have you introduced the assembly of the players?" Rūpa Gosvāmī replied, "The players assemble at a suitable time under the heading of pravartaka.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
In a drama all the actors are called
pātra,
or players. This is stated by Viśvanātha Kavirāja in the
Sāhitya-darpaṇa
(6.283):
divya-martye sa tad-rūpo
miśram anyataras tayoḥ
sūcayed vastu-bījaṁ vā-
mukhaṁ pātram athāpi vā
The meaning of
āmukha
is stated by Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī in the
Nāṭaka-candrikā:
sūtra-dhāro naṭī brūte
sva-kāryaṁ pratiyuktitaḥ
prastutākṣepicitroktyā
yat tad āmukham īritam
When Śrīla Rāmānanda Rāya inquired about the arrangement for introducing the assembly of players in the drama, Rūpa Gosvāmī replied that when the players first enter the stage in response to the time, the introduction is technically called
pravartaka.
For an example one may consult the
Antya-līlā,
First Chapter, verse 17. Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura says that the introduction, which is technically called
āmukha,
may be of five different kinds, according to the
Sāhitya-darpaṇa
(6.288):
udghātyakaḥ kathodghātaḥ
prayogātiśayas tathā
pravartakāvalagite
pañca prastāvanā-bhidāḥ
Introductions may be classified as follows: (1)
udghātyaka,
(2)
kathodghāta,
(3)
prayogātiśaya,
(4)
pravartaka
and (5)
avalagita.
These five kinds of introduction are called
āmukha.
Thus Śrīla Rāmānanda Rāya asked which of the five introductions had been employed, and Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī replied that he had used the introduction called the
pravartaka.

verses.devanagari: আক্ষিপ্তঃ কালসাম্যেন প্রবেশঃ স্যাৎ প্রবর্তকঃ ॥১৩৫॥
verses.transliteration: ākṣiptaḥ kāla-sāmyena\\npraveśaḥ syāt pravartakaḥ
verses.translation: 'When the entrance of the actors is set in motion by the arrival of a suitable time, the entrance is called pravartaka.'
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This verse is from
Nāṭaka-candrikā
(12) by Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī.

verses.devanagari: সোঽয়ং বসন্তসময়ঃ সমিয়ায় যস্মিন্\\nপূর্ণং তমীশ্বরমুপোঢ়-নবানুরাগম্ ।\\nগূঢ়গ্রহা রুচিরয়া সহ রাধয়াসৌ\\nরঙ্গায় সঙ্গময়িতা নিশি পৌর্ণমাসী ॥১৩৬॥
verses.transliteration: so 'yaṁ vasanta-samayaḥ samiyāya yasmin\\npūrṇaṁ tam īśvaram upoḍha-navānurāgam\\ngūḍha-grahā rucirayā saha rādhayāsau\\nraṅgāya saṅgamayitā niśi paurṇamāsī
verses.translation: 'Springtime had arrived, and the fuIl moon of that season inspired the Supreme Personality of Godhead, who is complete in everything, with new attraction to meet the beautiful Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī at night to increase the beauty of Their pastimes.' "
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Śrīla Bhaktivinoda Ṭhākura interprets this verse (
Vidagdha-mādhava
1.10) in two ways, for Lord Kṛṣṇa and for Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī. When interpreted for Kṛṣṇa, the night is understood to have been a dark moon night, and when interpreted for Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī, it is considered to have been a full moon night.

verses.devanagari: রায় কহে, — “প্ররোচনাদি কহ দেখি, শুনি ?”\\nরূপ কহে, — মহাপ্রভুর শ্রবণেচ্ছা জানি ॥১৩৭॥
verses.transliteration: rāya kahe,—"prarocanādi kaha dekhi, śuni?"\\nrūpa kahe,—"mahāprabhura śravaṇecchā jāni"
verses.translation: Rāmānanda Rāya said, "Please recite the prarocanā portion so that I may hear and examine it." Śrī Rūpa replied, "I think that the desire to hear of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is prarocanā.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
The method of inducing the audience to become more and more eager to hear by praising the time and place, the hero and the audience is called
prarocanā.
This is the statement regarding
prarocanā
in the
Nāṭaka-candrikā:
deśa-kāla-kathā-vastu-
sabhyādīnāṁ praśaṁsayā
śrotṝṇām unmukhī-kāraḥ
kathiteyaṁ prarocanā
Similarly the
Sāhitya-darpaṇa
(6.286) says:
tasyāḥ prarocanā vīthī
tathā prahasanā-mukhe
aṅgānyatronmukhī-kāraḥ
praśaṁsātaḥ prarocanā
Any literature presented in Sanskrit must follow the rules and regulations mentioned in the authoritative reference books. The technical inquiries by Śrīla Rāmānanda Rāya and the replies of Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī indicate that both of them were expert and fully conversant with the techniques of writing drama.

verses.devanagari: ভক্তানামুদগাদনর্গলধিয়াং বর্গো নিসর্গোজ্জ্বলঃ\\nশীলৈঃ পল্লবিতঃ স বল্লববধূবন্ধোঃ প্রবন্ধোঽপ্যসৌ ।\\nলেভে চত্বরতাঞ্চ তাণ্ডববিধের্বৃন্দাটবীগর্ভভূ-\\nর্মন্যে মদ্বিধপুণ্যমণ্ডলপরীপাকোঽয়মুন্মীলতি ॥১৩৮॥
verses.transliteration: bhaktānām udagād anargala-dhiyāṁ vargo nisargojjvalaḥ\\nśīlaiḥ pallavitaḥ sa ballava-vadhū-bandho prabandho 'py asau\\nlebhe catvaratāṁ ca tāṇḍava-vidher vṛndāṭavī-garbha-bhūr\\nmanye mad-vidha-puṇya-maṇḍala-parīpāko 'yam unmīlati
verses.translation: 'The devotees now present are constantly thinking of the Supreme Lord and are therefore highly advanced. This work named Vidagdha-mādhava depicts the characteristic pastimes of Lord Kṛṣṇa with decorations of poetic ornaments. And the inner grounds of the forest of Vṛndāvana provide a suitable platform for the dancing of Kṛṣṇa with the gopīs. Therefore I think that the pious activities of persons like us, who have tried to advance in devotional service, have now attained maturity.'
verses.purport: PURPORT\nThis is verse eight of the First Act of\nVidagdha-mādhava.

verses.devanagari: অভিব্যক্তা মত্তঃ প্রকৃতিলঘুরূপাদপি বুধা\\nবিধাত্রী সিদ্ধার্থান্ হরিগুণময়ী বঃ কৃতিরিয়ম্ ।।\\nপুলিন্দেনাপ্যগ্নিঃ কিমু সমিধমুন্মথ্য জনিতো\\nহিরণ্যশ্রেণীনামপহরতি নান্তঃকলুষতাম্ ॥১৩৯॥
verses.transliteration: abhivyaktā mattaḥ prakṛti-laghu-rūpād api budhā\\nvidhātrī siddhārthān hari-guṇa-mayī vaḥ kṛtir iyam\\npulindenāpy agniḥ kimu samidham-unmathya janito\\nhiraṇya-śreṇīnām apaharati nāntaḥ-kaluṣatām
verses.translation: "O learned devotees, I am by nature ignorant and low, yet even though it is from me that Vidagdha-mādhava has come, it is filled with descriptions of the transcendental attributes of the Supreme Personality of Godhead. Therefore, wiIl not such literature bring about the attainment of the highest goal of life? Although its wood may be ignited by a low-class ma, fire can nevertheless purify gold. Although I am very low by nature, this book may help cleanse the dirt from within the hearts of the golden devotees.' "
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This verse is also from
Vidagdha-mādhava
(1.6).

verses.devanagari: রায় কহে, — “কহ দেখি প্রেমোৎপত্তি-কারণ ?\\nপূর্বরাগ, বিকার, চেষ্টা, কামলিখন?” ॥১৪০॥
verses.transliteration: rāya kahe,—"kaha dekhi premotpatti-kāraṇa?\\npūrva-rāga, vikāra, ceṣṭā, kāma-likhana?"
verses.translation: Then Rāmānanda Rāya inquired from Rūpa Gosvāmī about the causes of the loving affairs between Kṛṣṇa and the gopīs, such as previous attachment, transformations of love, endeavors for love, and exchanges of letters disclosing the gopīs' awakening love for Kṛṣṇa.

verses.devanagari: ক্রমে শ্রীরূপ-গোসাঞি সকলি কহিল ।\\nশুনি’ প্রভুর ভক্তগণের চমৎকার হৈল ॥১৪১॥
verses.transliteration: krame śrī-rūpa-gosāñi sakali kahila\\nśuni' prabhura bhakta-gaṇera camatkāra haila
verses.translation: Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī gradually informed Rāmānanda Rāya about everything he asked. Hearing his explanations, all the devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu were struck with wonder.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī has explained
kāma-likhana
in his book
Ujjvala-nīlamaṇi
(
Vipralambha-prakaraṇa
26):
sa lekhaḥ kāma-lekhaḥ syāt
yaḥ sva-prema-prakāśakaḥ
yuvatyā yūni yūnā ca
yuvatyāṁ saṁprahīyate
"Exchanges of letters between a young boy and young girl concerning their awakening of attachment for one another are called
kāma-lekha.
"

verses.devanagari: একস্য শ্রুতমেব লুম্পতি মতিং কৃষ্ণেতি নামাক্ষরং\\nসান্দ্রোন্মাদ-পরম্পরামুপনয়ত্যন্যস্য বংশীকলঃ ।\\nএষ স্নিগ্ধঘনদ্যুতির্মনসি মে লগ্নঃ পটে বীক্ষণাৎ\\nকষ্টং ধিক্ পুরুষত্রয়ে রতিরভূন্মন্যে মৃতিঃ শ্রেয়সী ॥১৪২॥
verses.transliteration: ekasya śrutam eva lumpati matiṁ kṛṣṇeti nāmākṣaraṁ\\nsāndronmāda-paramparām upanayaty anyas ya vaṁśī-kalaḥ\\neṣa snigdha-ghana-dyutir manasi me lagnaḥ paṭe vīkṣaṇāt\\nkaṣṭaṁ dhik puruṣa-traye ratir abhūn manye mṛtiḥ śreyasī
verses.translation: Experiencing previous attachment to Kṛṣṇa [pūrva-rāga], Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī thought: "Since I have heard the name of a person called Kṛṣṇa, I have practically lost My good sense. Then, there is another person who plays His flute in such a way that after I hear the vibration, intense madness arises in My heart. And again there is still another person to whom My mind becomes attached when I see His beautiful lightning effulgence in His picture. Therefore I think that I am greatly condemned, for I have become simultaneously attached to three persons. It would be better for Me to die because of this."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This verse is from
Vidagdha-mādhava
(2.9).

verses.devanagari: ইয়ং সখি সুদুঃসাধ্যা রাধা-হৃদয়বেদনা ।\\nকৃতা যত্র চিকিৎসাপি কুৎসায়াং পর্যবস্যতি ॥১৪৩॥
verses.transliteration: iyam sakhi suduḥsādhyā\\nrādhā hṛdaya-vedanā\\nkṛtā yatra cikitsāpi\\nkutsāyāṁ paryavasyati
verses.translation: "My dear friend, these palpitations of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī's heart are extremely difficult to cure. Even if one applied some medical treatment, it would only end in defamation."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This verse (
Vidagdha-mādhava
2.8) is spoken by Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī Herself.

verses.devanagari: ধরিঅ পরিচ্ছন্দগুণং\\nসুন্দর মহ মন্দিরে তুমং বসসি ।\\nতহ তহ রুন্ধসি বলিঅং\\nজহ জহ চইদা পলাএম্হি ? ॥ ১৪৪ ॥
verses.transliteration: dhari-a paḍicchanda-guṇaṁ\\nsundara maha mandire tumaṁ vasasi\\ntaha taha rundhasi bali-aṁ\\njaha jaha ca-idā palāemhi
verses.translation: "O dearly beautiful, the artistic loveliness of Your picture is now impressed within My mind. Since You are now living within My mind, wherever I wish to run because I am agitated by impressions of You, I find that You, O My friend, are blocking My way."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This verse (
Vidagdha-mādhava
2.33) is written in the Prākṛta language, not in Sanskrit. When transformed into Sanskrit, it reads as follows:
dhṛtvā praticchanda-guṇaṁ sundara mama mandire tvaṁ vasasi
tathā tathā ruṇatsi balitaṁ yathā yathā cakitā palāye
The meaning is the same, but the native language is different. It
was
spoken by Madhumaṅgala to Śrī Kṛṣṇa.

verses.devanagari: অগ্রে বীক্ষ্য শিখণ্ডখণ্ডমচিরাদুৎকম্পমালম্বতে\\nগুঞ্জানাঞ্চ বিলোকনান্মুহুরসৌ সাস্রং পরিক্রোশতি ।\\nনো জানে জনয়ন্নপূর্বনটনক্রীড়া-চমৎকারিতাং ।\\nবালায়াঃ কিল চিত্তভূমিমবিশৎ কোঽয়ং নবীনগ্রহঃ ॥১৪৫॥
verses.transliteration: agre vīkṣya śikhaṇḍa-khaṇḍam acirād utkampam ālambate\\nguñjānāṁ ca vilokanān muhur asau sāsraṁ parikrośati\\nno jāne janayann apūrva-naṭana-krīḍā-camatkāritāṁ\\nbālāyāḥ kila citta-bhūmim aviśat ko 'yaṁ navīna-grahaḥ
verses.translation: "Upon seeing peacock feathers in front of Her, this girl suddenly begins trembling. When She sometimes sees a necklace of guñjā [small conchshells], She sheds tears and cries Ioudly. I do not know what kind of new ecstatic influence has entered the heart of this poor girl. It has imbued Her with the dancing attitude of a player creating wonderful, unprecedented dances on a stage."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This verse (
Vidagdha-mādhava
2.15) is spoken by Mukharā, Lord Kṛṣṇa's grandmother, in a conversation with the grandmother of Rādhārāṇī, Paurṇamāsī.

verses.devanagari: অকারুণ্যঃ কৃষ্ণো যদি ময়ি তবাগঃ কথমিদং\\nমুধা মা রোদীর্মে কুরু পরমিমামুত্তরকৃতিম্ ।\\nতমালস্য স্কন্ধে বিনিহিত-ভুজবল্লরিরিয়ং\\nযথা বৃন্দারণ্যে চিরমবিচলা তিষ্ঠতি তনুঃ ॥১৪৬॥
verses.transliteration: akāruṇyaḥ kṛṣṇo yadi mayi tavāgaḥ katham idaṁ\\nmudhā mā rodīr me kuru param imām uttara-kṛtim\\ntamālasya skandhe vinihita-bhuja-vallarir iyaṁ\\nyathā vṛndāraṇye ciram avicalā tiṣṭhati tanuḥ
verses.translation: Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī said to Her constant companion Viśākhā: "My dear friend, if Kṛṣṇa is unkind to Me, there will be no need for you to cry, for it wiIl not be due to any fault of yours. I shall then have to die, but afterwards please do one thing for Me: to observe My funeral ceremony, place My body with its arms embracing a tamāla tree like creepers so that I may remain forever in Vṛndāvana undisturbed. That is My last request."(Vidagdha-mādhava 2.47)

verses.devanagari: রায় কহে, — “কহ দেখি ভাবের স্বভাব ?”\\nরূপ কহে, — “ঐছে হয় কৃষ্ণবিষয়ক ‘ভাব’ ।।” ॥ ১৪৭ ॥
verses.transliteration: rāya kahe,—"kaha dekhi bhāvera svabhāva?"\\nrūpa kahe,—"aiche haya kṛṣṇa-viṣayaka 'bhāva"
verses.translation: Rāmānanda Rāya inquired, "What are the characteristics of emotional love?" Rūpa Gosvāmī replied, "This is the nature of emotional love for Kṛṣṇa.
