verses.purport:
PURPORT
This is a verse from
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
(6.2.49).

verses.devanagari: যে মুক্তি ভক্ত না লয়, সে কৃষ্ণ চাহে দিতে ।।” ॥ ১৮৮ ॥
verses.transliteration: ye mukti bhakta nā laya, se kṛṣṇa cāhe dite"
verses.translation: "Liberation, which is unacceptable for a pure devotee, is always offered by Kṛṣṇa without difficulty.

verses.devanagari: সালোক্য-সার্ষ্টি-সারূপ্য-সামীপ্যৈকত্বমপ্যুত ।\\nদীয়মানং ন গৃহ্ণন্তি বিনা মৎসেবনং জনাঃ ॥১৮৯॥
verses.transliteration: sālokya-sārṣṭi-sārūpya-\\nsāmīpyaikatvam apy uta\\ndīyamānaṁ na gṛhṇanti\\nvinā mat-sevanaṁ janāḥ
verses.translation: "My devotees do not accept sālokya, sārṣṭi, sārūpya, sāmīpya, or oneness with Me-even if I offer these liberations-in preference to serving Me.' "
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This verse is spoken by Lord Kapila, an
avatāra
of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, in
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
(3.29.13).

verses.devanagari: ‘গোপাল চক্রবর্তী’ নাম একজন ।\\nমজুমদারের ঘরে সেই আরিন্দা প্রধান ॥১৯০॥
verses.transliteration: 'gopāla cakravartī' nāma eka-jana\\nmajumadārera ghare sei ārindā pradhāna
verses.translation: At the house of Hiraṇya and Govardhana Majumadāra, a person named Gopāla Cakravartī was officially the chief tax collector.

verses.devanagari: গৌড়ে রহি’ পাৎসাহা-আগে আরিন্দাগিরি করে ।\\nবার-লক্ষ মুদ্রা সেই পাৎসার ঠাঞি ভরে ॥১৯১॥
verses.transliteration: gauḍe rahi' pātsāhā-āge ārindā-giri kare\\nbāra-lakṣa mudrā sei pātsāra ṭhāñi bhare
verses.translation: This Gopāla Cakravartī lived in Bengal. His duty as chief tax collector was to collect 1,200,000 coins to deposit in the treasury of the emperor.

verses.devanagari: পরম-সুন্দর, পণ্ডিত, নূতন-যৌবন ।\\nনামাভাসে ‘মুক্তি’ শুনি’ না হইল সহন ॥১৯২॥
verses.transliteration: parama-sundara, paṇḍita, nūtana-yauvana\\nnāmābhāse 'mukti' śuni' nā ha-ila sahana
verses.translation: He had handsome bodily features, and he was learned and youthful, but he could not tolerate the statement that simply by glimpsing the awakening of the Lord's holy name one can attain liberation.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Vaiṣṇavas strictly follow the directions of the
śāstras
regarding how one can be liberated simply by a slight awakening of pure chanting of the holy name. Māyāvādīs cannot tolerate the statements of the
śāstras
about how easily liberation can be achieved, for as stated in
Bhagavad-gītā
(12.5),
kleśo 'dhikataras teṣām avyaktāsakta-cetasām:
impersonalists must work hard for many, many births, and only then will they perhaps be liberated. Vaiṣṇavas know that simply by chanting the holy name of the Lord offenselessly, one achieves liberation as a by-product. Thus there is no need to endeavor separately for liberation. Śrīla Bilvamaṅgala Ṭhākura has said,
muktiḥ svayaṁ mukulitāñjali sevate 'smān:
liberation stands at one's door, ready to render any kind of service, if one is a pure devotee with unflinching faith and reverence. This the Māyāvādīs cannot tolerate. Therefore the
ārindā pradhāna,
chief tax collector, although very learned, handsome and youthful, could not tolerate the statements of Haridāsa Ṭhākura

verses.devanagari: ক্রুদ্ধ হঞা বলে সেই সরোষ বচন  ।\\n“ভাবুকের সিদ্ধান্ত শুন, পণ্ডিতের গণ ॥১৯৩॥
verses.transliteration: kruddha hañā bale sei saroṣa vacana\\n"bhāvukera siddhānta śuna, paṇḍitera gaṇa
verses.translation: This young man, Gopāla Cakravartī, became very angry upon hearing the statements of Haridāsa Ṭhākura. He immediately criticized him. "O assembly of learned scholars," he said, "just hear the conclusion of the emotional devotee.

verses.devanagari: কোটি-জন্মে ব্রহ্মজ্ঞানে যেই ‘মুক্তি’ নয়  ।\\nএই কহে, — নামাভাসে সেই ‘মুক্তি’ হয় ।।” ১৯৪ ॥১৯৪॥
verses.transliteration: koṭi-janme brahma-jñāne yei 'mukti' naya\\nei kahe,—nāmābhāse sei 'mukti' haya"
verses.translation: "After many millions upon millions of births, when one is complete in absolute knowledge, one still may not attain liberation, yet this ma says that one may attain it simply by the awakening of a glimpse of the holy name."

verses.devanagari: হরিদাস কহেন, — কেনে করহ সংশয় ?\\nশাস্ত্রে কহে, — নামাভাস-মাত্রে ‘মুক্তি’ হয় ॥১৯৫॥
verses.transliteration: haridāsa kahena,—kene karaha saṁśaya?\\nśāstre kahe,—nāmābhāsa-mātre 'mukti' haya
verses.purport: PURPORT\nHaridāsa Ṭhākura said, "Why are you doubtful? The revealed scriptures say that one can attain liberation simply by a glimpse of offenseless chanting of the holy name.

verses.devanagari: ভক্তিসুখ-আগে ‘মুক্তি’ অতি-তুচ্ছ হয় ।\\nঅতএব ভক্তগণ ‘মুক্তি’ নাহি লয় ॥১৯৬॥
verses.transliteration: bhakti-sukha-āge 'mukti' ati-tuccha haya\\nataeva bhakta-gaṇa 'mukti' nāhi laya
verses.translation: "For a devotee who enjoys the transcendental bliss of devotional service, liberation is most insignificant. Therefore pure devotees never desire to achieve liberation.

verses.devanagari: ত্বৎসাক্ষাৎকরণাহ্লাদবিশুদ্ধাব্ধিস্থিতস্য মে ।\\nসুখানি গোষ্পদায়ন্তে ব্রাহ্মাণ্যপি জগদ্গুরো ॥১৯৭॥
verses.transliteration: tvat-sākṣātkaraṇāhlāda-\\nviśuddhābdhi-sthitasya me\\nsukhāni goṣpadāyante\\nbrāhmāṇy api jagad-guro
verses.translation: "My dear Lord, O master of the universe, since I have directly seen You, my transcendental bliss has taken the shape of a great ocean. Being situated in that ocean, I now realize all other so-called happiness, including even brahmānanda, to be like the water contained in the hoofprint of a calf.' "
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This verse is quoted from the
Hari-bhakti-sudhodaya
(14.36).

verses.devanagari: বিপ্র কহে, — “নামাভাসে যদি ‘মুক্তি’ নয় ।\\nতবে তোমার নাক কাটি’ করহ নিশ্চয় ।।” ॥ ১৯৮ ॥
verses.transliteration: vipra kahe,—"nāmābhāse yadi 'mukti' naya\\ntabe tomāra nāka kāṭi' karaha niścaya"
verses.translation: Gopāla Cakravartī said, "if one is not liberated by nāmābhāsa, then you may be certain that I shall cut off your nose."

verses.devanagari: হরিদাস কহেন, — “যদি নামাভাসে ‘মুক্তি’ নয় ।\\nতবে আমার নাক কাটিমু, — এই সুনিশ্চয় ।।” ॥ ১৯৯ ॥
verses.transliteration: haridāsa kahena,—"yadi nāmābhāse 'mukti' naya\\ntabe āmāra nāka kāṭimu,—ei suniścaya"
verses.translation: Then Haridāsa Ṭhākura accepted the challenge offered by Gopāla Cakravartī. "If by nāmābhāsa liberation is not available," he said, "certainly I shall cut off my nose."

verses.devanagari: শুনি’ সভাসদ্ উঠে করি’ হাহাকার ।\\nমজুমদার সেই বিপ্রে করিল ধিক্কার ॥২০০॥
verses.transliteration: śuni' sabhā-sad uṭhe kari' hāhākāra\\nmajumadāra sei vipre karila dhikkāra
verses.translation: All the members of the assembly who had heard the challenge were greatly agitated, and they got up, making a tumultuous sound. Hiraṇya and Govardhana Majumadāra both immediately chastised the brāhmaṇa tax collector.

verses.devanagari: বলাই-পুরোহিত তারে করিলা ভর্ৎসন ।\\n“ঘট-পটিয়া মূর্খ তুঞি ভক্তি কাঁহা জান ? ॥ ২০১ ॥
verses.transliteration: balāi-purohita tāre karilā bhartsana\\n"ghaṭa-paṭiyā mūrkha tuñi bhakti kāṅhā jāna?
verses.translation: The priest named Balarāma Ācārya chastised Gopāla Cakravartī. "You are a foolish logician," he said, "What do you know about the devotional service of the Lord?
verses.purport:
PURPORT
The philosophy enunciated by the Māyāvādīs is called
ghaṭa-paṭiyā
philosophy. According to this philosophy, everything is one, everything is earth, and therefore anything made of earth, such as different pots, is also the same earth. Such philosophers see no distinction between a pot made of earth and the earth itself. Since Gopāla Cakravartī was a
ghaṭa-paṭiyā
logician, a gross materialist, what could he understand about the transcendental devotional service of the Lord?

verses.devanagari: হরিদাস-ঠাকুরে তুঞি কৈলি অপমান !\\nসর্বনাশ হবে তোর, না হবে কল্যাণ ।।” ॥ ২০২ ॥
verses.transliteration: haridāsa-ṭhākure tuñi kaili apamāna!\\nsarva-nāśa habe tora, nā habe kalyāṇa"
verses.translation: "You have insulted Haridāsa Ṭhākura. Thus there will be a dangerous position for you. You should not expect anything auspicious."

verses.devanagari: শুনি’ হরিদাস তবে উঠিয়া চলিলা ।\\nমজুমদার সেই বিপ্রে ত্যাগ করিলা ॥২০৩॥
verses.transliteration: śuni' haridāsa tabe uṭhiyā calilā\\nmajumadāra sei vipre tyāga karilā
verses.translation: Then Haridāsa Ṭhākura got up to leave, and the Majumadāras, the masters of Gopāla Cakravartī, immediately dismissed Gopāla Cakravartī from their service.

verses.devanagari: সভা-সহিতে হরিদাসের পড়িলা চরণে  ।\\nহরিদাস হাসি’ কহে মধুর-বচনে ॥২০৪॥
verses.transliteration: sabhā-sahite haridāsera paḍilā caraṇe\\nharidāsa hāsi' kahe madhura-vacane
verses.translation: With all the members of the assembly, the two Majumadāras fell at the lotus feet of Haridāsa Ṭhākura. Haridāsa Ṭhākura was smiling, however, and he spoke in a sweet voice.

verses.devanagari: “তোমা-সবার দোষ নাহি, এই অজ্ঞ ব্রাহ্মণ  ।\\nতার দোষ নাহি, তার তর্কনিষ্ঠ মন ॥২০৫॥
verses.transliteration: "tomā-sabāra doṣa nāhi, ei ajña brāhmaṇa\\ntāra doṣa nāhi, tāra tarka-niṣṭha mana
verses.translation: "None of you are at fault," he said. "Indeed, even this ignorant so-called brāhmaṇa is not at fault, for he is accustomed to dry speculation and logic.

verses.devanagari: তর্কের গোচর নহে নামের মহত্ত্ব । কোথা হৈতে জানিবে সে এই সব তত্ত্ব ? ২০৬ ।। যাহ ঘর, কৃষ্ণ করুন কুশল সবার  ।\\nআমার সম্বন্ধে দুঃখ না হউক কাহার ।।” ২০৭ ॥২০৬॥
verses.transliteration: tarkera gocara nahe nāmera mahattva\\nkothā haite jānibe se ei saba tattva?
verses.translation: "One cannot understand the glories of the holy name simply by logic and argument. Therefore this man cannot possibly understand the glories of the holy name.

verses.devanagari: যাহ ঘর, কৃষ্ণ করুন কুশল সবার ।\\nআমার সম্বন্ধে দুঃখ না হউক কাহার" ॥২০৭॥
verses.transliteration: yāha ghara, kṛṣṇa karuna kuśala sabāra\\nāmāra sambandhe duḥkha nā ha-uka kāhāra"
verses.translation: "All of you may now go to your homes. May Lord Kṛṣṇa bestow his blessings upon you all. Do not be sorry because of my being insulted."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
From this statement by Haridāsa Ṭhākura, it is understood that a pure Vaiṣṇava never takes anyone's insults seriously. This is the teaching of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu:
tṛṇād api sunīcena
taror api sahiṣṇunā
amāninā mānadena
kīrtanīyaḥ sadā hariḥ
"One should chant the holy name of the Lord in a humble state of mind, thinking oneself lower than the straw in the street. One should be more tolerant than a tree, devoid of all sense of false prestige and ready to offer all respects to others. In such a state of mind one can chant the holy name of the Lord constantly." A Vaiṣṇava is always tolerant and submissive like trees and grass. He tolerates insults offered by others, for he is simply interested in chanting the holy name of the Lord without being disturbed.

verses.devanagari: তবে সে হিরণ্যদাস নিজ ঘরে আইল ।\\nসেই ব্রাহ্মণে নিজ দ্বার-মানা কৈল ॥২০৮॥
verses.transliteration: tabe se hiraṇya-dāsa nija ghare āila\\nsei brāhmaṇe nija dvāra-mānā kaila
verses.translation: Then Hiraṇya dāsa Majumadāra returned to his home and ordered that Gopāla Cakravartī not be admitted therein.

verses.devanagari: তিন দিন ভিতরে সেই বিপ্রের ‘কুষ্ঠ’ হৈল ।\\nঅতি উচ্চ নাসা তার গলিয়া পড়িল ॥২০৯॥
verses.transliteration: tina dina bhitare sei viprera 'kuṣṭha' haila\\nati ucca nāsā tāra galiyā paḍila
verses.translation: Within three days that brāhmaṇa was attacked by leprosy, and as a result his highly raised nose melted away and fell off.

verses.devanagari: চম্পক-কলি-সম হস্ত-পদাঙ্গুলি ।\\nকোঁকড় হইল সব, কুষ্ঠে গেল গলি’ ॥২১০॥
verses.transliteration: campaka-kali-sama hasta-padāṅguli\\nkoṅkaḍa ha-ila saba, kuṣṭhe gela gali'
verses.translation: The brāhmaṇa's toes and fingers were beautiful like golden-colored campaka buds, but because of leprosy they all withered and gradually melted away.

verses.devanagari: দেখিয়া সকল লোক হৈল চমৎকার ।\\nহরিদাসে প্রশংসি’ তাঁরে করে নমস্কার ॥২১১॥
verses.transliteration: dekhiyā sakala loka haila camatkāra\\nharidāse praśaṁsi' tāṅre kare namaskāra
verses.translation: Seeing the condition of Gopāla Cakravartī, everyone was astonished. Everyone praised the influence of Haridāsa Ṭhākura and offered him obeisances.

verses.devanagari: যদ্যপি হরিদাস বিপ্রের দোষ না লইলা ।\\nতথাপি ঈশ্বর তারে ফল ভুঞ্জাইলা ॥২১২॥
verses.transliteration: yadyapi haridāsa viprera doṣa nā la-ilā\\ntathāpi īśvara tāre phala bhuñjāilā
verses.translation: Although Haridāsa Ṭhākura, as a Vaiṣṇava, did not take seriously the brāhmaṇa's offense, the Supreme Personality of Godhead could not tolerate it, and thus he made the brāhmaṇa suffer the consequences.

verses.devanagari: ভক্ত-স্বভাব, — অজ্ঞ-দোষ ক্ষমা করে ।\\nকৃষ্ণ-স্বভাব, — ভক্ত-নিন্দা সহিতে না পারে ॥২১৩॥
verses.transliteration: bhakta-svabhāva,—ajña-doṣa kṣamā kare\\nkṛṣṇa-svabhāva,—bhakta-nindā sahite nā pāre
verses.translation: A characteristic of a pure devotee is that he excuses any offense by an ignorant rascal. The characteristic of Kṛṣṇa, however, is that He cannot tolerate blasphemy of His devotees.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
tṛṇād api sunīcena \ taror api sahiṣṇunā \ amāninā mānadena \ kīrtanīyaḥ sadā hariḥ
A Vaiṣṇava strictly follows this principle of being humbler than the grass and more tolerant than a tree, expecting no honor from others but offering honor to everyone. In this way, a Vaiṣṇava is simply interested in chanting about the Supreme personality of Godhead and glorifying Him. Haridāsa Ṭhākura epitomized this foremost order of Vaiṣṇavism. Kṛṣṇa cannot tolerate any insults or blasphemy against a Vaiṣṇava. For example, Prahlāda Mahārāja was chastised by his father, Hiraṇyakaśipu, in so many ways, but although Prahlāda tolerated this, Kṛṣṇa did not. The Lord therefore came in the form of Nṛsiṁhadeva to kill Hiraṇyakaśipu. Similarly, although Śrīla Haridāsa Ṭhākura tolerated the insult by Gopāla Cakravartī, Kṛṣṇa could not. The Lord immediately punished Gopāla Cakravartī by making him suffer from leprosy. While instructing Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī about the many restrictive rules and regulations for Vaiṣṇavas, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu has very vividly described the effects of offenses at the lotus feet of a Vaiṣṇava.
Yadi vaiṣṇava-aparādha uṭhe hātī mātā
(Madhya 19.156). Offending or blaspheming a Vaiṣṇava has been described as the greatest offense, and it has been compared to a mad elephant. When a mad elephant enters a garden, it ruins all the creepers, flowers and trees. Similarly, if a devotee properly executing his devotional service becomes an offender at the lotus feet of his spiritual master or a Vaiṣṇava, his devotional service is spoiled.

verses.devanagari: বিপ্রের কুষ্ঠ শুনি’ হরিদাস মনে দুঃখী হৈলা ।\\nবলাই-পুরোহিতে কহি’ শান্তিপুর আইলা ॥২১৪॥
verses.transliteration: viprera kuṣṭha śuni' haridāsa mane duḥkhī hailā\\nbalāi-purohite kahi' śāntipura āilā
verses.translation: Haridāsa Ṭhākura was unhappy when he heard that the brāhmaṇa Gopāla Cakravartī had been attacked by leprosy. Thus after informing Balarāma Ācārya, the priest of Hiraṇya Majumadāra, he went to Śāntipura, the home of Advaita Ācārya.

verses.devanagari: আচার্যে মিলিয়া কৈলা দণ্ডবৎ প্রণাম ।\\nঅদ্বৈত আলিঙ্গন করি’ করিলা সম্মান ॥২১৫॥
verses.transliteration: ācārye miliyā kailā daṇḍavat praṇāma\\nadvaita āliṅgana kari' karilā sammāna
verses.translation: Upon meeting Advaita Ācārya, Haridāsa Ṭhākura offered Him respect and obeisances. Advaita Ācārya embraced him and showed respect to him in return.

verses.devanagari: গঙ্গা তীরে গোঁফা করি’ নির্জনে তাঁরে দিলা ।\\nভাগবত-গীতার ভক্তি-অর্থ শুনাইলা ॥২১৬॥
verses.transliteration: gaṅgā-tīre goṅphā kari' nirjane tāṅre dilā\\nbhāgavata-gītāra bhakti-artha śunāilā
verses.translation: On the bank of the Ganges, in a solitary place, Advaita Ācārya made a cavelike home for Haridāsa Ṭhākura and spoke to him about the real meaning of Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam and Bhagavad-gītā in terms of devotional service.

verses.devanagari: আচার্যের ঘরে নিত্য ভিক্ষা-নির্বাহণ ।\\nদুই জনা মিলি’ কৃষ্ণ-কথা-আস্বাদন ॥২১৭॥
verses.transliteration: ācāryera ghare nitya bhikṣā-nirvāhaṇa\\ndui janā mili' kṛṣṇa-kathā-āsvādana
verses.translation: Haridāsa Ṭhākura accepted food daily at the house of Advaita Ācārya. Meeting together, the two of them would taste the nectar of discourses on the subject matter of Kṛṣṇa.

verses.devanagari: হরিদাস কহে, — “গোসাঞি, করি নিবেদনে ।\\nমোরে প্রত্যহ অন্ন দেহ’ কোন্ প্রয়োজনে ? ॥ ২১৮ ॥
verses.transliteration: haridāsa kahe,—"gosāñi, kari nivedane\\nmore pratyaha anna deha' kon prayojane?
verses.translation: Haridāsa Ṭhākura said, "My dear Advaita Ācārya, let me submit something before Your Honor. Every day You give me alms of food to eat. What is the necessity of this?

verses.devanagari: মহা-মহা-বিপ্র এথা কুলীন-সমাজ ।\\nনীচে আদর কর, না বাসহ ভয় লাজ !! ॥ ২১৯ ॥
verses.transliteration: mahā-mahā-vipra ethā kulīna-samāja\\nnīce ādara kara, nā vāsaha bhaya lāja!!
verses.translation: "Sir, You are living within a society of great, great brāhmaṇas and aristocrats, but without fear or shame You adore a lower-class man like me.

verses.devanagari: অলৌকিক আচার তোমার কহিতে পাই ভয় ।\\nসেই কৃপা করিবা, — যাতে মোর রক্ষা হয় ।।” ॥ ২২০ ॥
verses.transliteration: alaukika ācāra tomāra kahite pāi bhaya\\nsei kṛpā karibā,—yāte mora rakṣā haya"
verses.translation: "My dear sir, Your behavior is uncommon. Indeed, sometimes I am afraid to speak to You. But please favor me by protecting me from the behavior of society."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
While Haridāsa Ṭhākura was staying under the care of Advaita Ācārya, he was afraid of the behavior of society in Śāntipura, Navadvīpa, which was full of exceedingly aristocratic
brāhmaṇas, kṣatriyas
and
vaiśyas.
Haridāsa Ṭhākura was born in a Mohammedan family and was later recognized as a great Vaiṣṇava, but nevertheless the
brāhmaṇas
were very critical of him. Thus Haridāsa Ṭhākura was afraid that Advaita Ācārya would be put into some difficulty because of His familiarity with Haridāsa Ṭhākura. Śrī Advaita Ācārya treated Haridāsa Ṭhākura as a most elevated Vaiṣṇava, but others, like Rāmacandra Khān, were envious of Haridāsa Ṭhākura. Of course, we have to follow in the footsteps of Advaita Ācārya, not caring for people like Rāmacandra Khān. At present, many Vaiṣṇavas are coming to our Kṛṣṇa consciousness movement from among the Europeans and Americans, and although a man like Rāmacandra Khān is always envious of such Vaiṣṇavas, one should follow in the footsteps of Śrī Advaita Ācārya by treating all of them as Vaiṣṇavas. Although they are not as exalted as Haridāsa Ṭhākura, such Americans and Europeans, having accepted the principles of Vaiṣṇava philosophy and behavior, should never be excluded from Vaiṣṇava society.

verses.devanagari: আচার্য কহেন, — “তুমি না করিহ ভয় ।\\nসেই আচরিব, যেই শাস্ত্রমত হয় ॥২২১॥
verses.transliteration: ācārya kahena,—"tumi nā kariha bhaya\\nsei ācariba, yei śāstra-mata haya
verses.translation: Advaita Ācārya replied, "My dear Haridāsa, do not be afraid. I shall behave strictly according to the principles of the revealed scriptures.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Śrīla Advaita Ācārya was not afraid of the strict brahminical culture and customs of society. As stated in the śāstric injunctions, which are the true medium of evidence or proof, anyone can go back to Godhead, even if born of a low family. Kṛṣṇa says in
Bhagavad-gītā:
māṁ hi pārtha vyapāśritya
ye 'pi syuḥ pāpa-yonayaḥ
striyo vaiśyās tathā śūdrās
te 'pi yānti parāṁ gatim
"O son of Pṛthā, those who take shelter in Me, though they be of lower birth-women,
vaiśyas
[merchants], as well as
śūdras
[workers]—can approach the supreme destination." (Bg. 9.32) Though having taken a low birth in human society, one who accepts Kṛṣṇa as the Supreme Personality of Godhead is quite competent to go back home, back to Godhead; and one who is a bona fide candidate for going back to Godhead should not be considered lowborn, or
caṇḍāla.
That is also a śāstric injunction. As stated in
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
(2.4.18):
kirāta-hūṇāndhra-pulinda-pulkaśā
ābhīra-śumbhā yavanāḥ khasādayaḥ
ye 'nye ca pāpā yad-apāśrayāśrayāḥ
śudhyanti tasmai prabhaviṣṇave namaḥ
Not only the
yavanas
and
khasādayaḥ
but even those born in still lower families can be purified (
śudhyanti
) by the grace of a devotee of Lord Kṛṣṇa, for Kṛṣṇa empowers such devotees to perform this purification. Advaita Ācārya had confidence in the śāstric evidence and did not care about social customs. The Kṛṣṇa consciousness movement, therefore, is a cultural movement that does not care about local social conventions. Following in the footsteps of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and Advaita Ācārya, we can accept a devotee from any part of the world and recognize him as a
brāhmaṇa
as soon as he is qualified due to following the principles of Vaiṣṇava behavior.

verses.devanagari: তুমি খাইলে হয় কোটিব্রাহ্মণ-ভোজন ।”\\nএত বলি, শ্রাদ্ধ-পাত্র করাইলা ভোজন ॥২২২॥
verses.transliteration: tumi khāile haya koṭi-brāhmaṇa-bhojana"\\neta bali, śrāddha-pātra karāilā bhojana
verses.translation: "Feeding you is equal to feeding ten million brāhmaṇas," Advaita Ācārya said. "Therefore, accept this śrāddha-pātra." Thus Advaita Ācārya made him eat.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Śrāddha
is
prasāda
offered to the forefathers at a certain date of the year or month. The
śrāddha-pātra,
or plate offered to the forefathers, is then offered to the best of the
brāhmaṇas
in society. instead of offering the
śrāddha-pātra
to any other
brāhmaṇa,
Advaita Ācārya offered it to Haridāsa Ṭhākura, considering him greater than any of the foremost
brāhmaṇas.
This act by Śrī Advaita Ācārya proves that Haridāsa Ṭhākura was always situated in a transcendental position and was therefore always greater than even the most exalted
brāhmaṇa,
for he was situated above the mode of goodness of the material world. Referring to the
Bhakti-sandarbha,
verse 177, Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura quotes the following statements from the
Garuḍa Purāṇa
in this connection:
brāhmaṇānāṁ sahasrebhyaḥ
satra-yājī viśiṣyate
satra-yāji-sahasrebhyaḥ
sarva-vedānta-pāragaḥ
sarva-vedānta-vit-koṭyā
viṣṇu-bhakto viśiṣyate
vaiṣṇavānāṁ sahasrebhya
ekānty eko viśiṣyate
"A
brāhmaṇa
qualified to offer sacrifices is better than an ordinary
brāhmaṇa
and better than such a
brāhmaṇa
is one who has studied all the Vedic scriptures. Among many such
brāhmaṇas,
one who is a devotee of Lord Viṣṇu is the best; and among many such Vaiṣṇavas, one who fully engages in the service of the Lord is the best."
bhaktir aṣṭa-vidhā hy eṣā
yasmin mlecche 'pi vartate
sa viprendro muni-śreṣṭhaḥ
sa jñānī sa ca paṇḍitaḥ
tasmai deyaṁ tato grāhyaṁ
sa ca pūjyo yathā hariḥ
"There are many different kinds of devotees, but even a Vaiṣṇava coming from a family of
mlecchas
or
yavanas
is understood to be a learned scholar, complete in knowledge, if he knows the Vaiṣṇava philosophy. He should therefore be given charity, for such a Vaiṣṇava is as worshipable as the Supreme Personality of Godhead."
na me 'bhaktaś catur-vedī
mad-bhaktaḥ śva-pacaḥ priyaḥ
tasmai deyaṁ tato grāhyaṁ
sa ca pūjyo yathā hy aham
Lord Kṛṣṇa says, "Even if a nondevotee comes from a
brāhmaṇa
family and is expert in studying the
Vedas,
he is not very dear to Me, whereas even if a sincere devotee comes from a low family of meat-eaters, he is very dear to Me. Such a sincere pure devotee should be given charity, for he is as worshipable as I."

verses.devanagari: জগৎ-নিস্তার লাগি’ করেন চিন্তন ।\\nঅবৈষ্ণব-জগৎ কেমনে হইবে মোচন ? ॥ ২২৩ ॥
verses.transliteration: jagat-nistāra lāgi' karena cintana\\navaiṣṇava-jagat kemane ha-ibe mocana?
verses.translation: Advaita Ācārya was always absorbed in thoughts of how to deliver the fallen souls of the entire world. "The entire world is full of nondevotees," He thought. "How will they be delivered?"
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Śrīla Advaita Ācārya sets the standard for
ācāryas
in the Vaiṣṇava
sampradāya.
An
ācārya
must always be eager to deliver the fallen souls. A person who establishes a temple or maṭha to take advantage of people's sentiments by using for his livelihood what people contribute for the worship of the Deity cannot be called a
gosvāmī
or
ācārya.
One who knows the conclusion of the
śāstras,
follows in the footsteps of his predecessors and endeavors to preach the
bhakti
cult all over the world is to be considered an
ācārya.
The role of an
ācārya
is not to earn his livelihood through the income of the temple. Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura used to say that if one earns his livelihood by displaying the Deity in the temple, he is not an
ācārya
or
gosvāmī.
it would be better for him to accept service even as a sweeper in the street, for that is a more honorable means of earning one's living.

verses.devanagari: কৃষ্ণে অবতারিতে অদ্বৈত প্রতিজ্ঞা করিলা ।\\nজল-তুলসী দিয়া পূজা করিতে লাগিলা ॥২২৪॥
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇe avatārite advaita pratijñā karilā\\njala-tulasī diyā pūjā karite lāgilā
verses.translation: Determined to deliver all the fallen souls, Advaita Ācārya decided to cause Kṛṣṇa to descend. With this vow, he began to offer Ganges water and tulasī leaves to worship the Lord.

verses.devanagari: হরিদাস করে গোঁফায় নাম-সঙ্কীর্তন ।\\nকৃষ্ণ অবতীর্ণ হইবেন, — এই তাঁর মন ॥২২৫॥
verses.transliteration: haridāsa kare goṅphāya nāma-saṅkīrtana\\nkṛṣṇa avatīrṇa ha-ibena,—ei tāṅra mana
verses.translation: Similarly, Haridāsa Ṭhākura chanted in his cave on the bank of the Ganges with the intention to cause Kṛṣṇa's descent.

verses.devanagari: দুইজনের ভক্ত্যে চৈতন্য কৈলা অবতার ।\\nনাম-প্রেম প্রচারি’ কৈলা জগৎ উদ্ধার ॥২২৬॥
verses.transliteration: dui-janera bhaktye caitanya kailā avatāra\\nnāma-prema pracāri' kailā jagat uddhāra
verses.translation: Because of the devotional service of these two persons, Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu descended as an incarnation. Thus He preached the holy name of the Lord and ecstatic love of Kṛṣṇa to deliver the entire world.

verses.devanagari: আর অলৌকিক এক চরিত্র তাঁহার ।\\nযাহার শ্রবণে লোকে হয় চমৎকার ॥২২৭॥
verses.transliteration: āra alaukika eka caritra tāṅhāra\\nyāhāra śravaṇe loke haya camatkāra
verses.translation: There is another incident concerning Haridāsa Ṭhākura's uncommon behavior. One will be astonished to hear about it.

verses.devanagari: তর্ক না করিহ, তর্কাগোচর তাঁর রীতি ।\\nবিশ্বাস করিয়া শুন করিয়া প্রতীতি ॥২২৮॥
verses.transliteration: tarka nā kariha, tarkāgocara tāṅra rīti\\nviśvāsa kariyā śuna kariyā pratīti
verses.translation: Hear about such incidents without putting forth dry arguments, for these incidents are beyond our material reasoning. One must believe in them with faith.

verses.devanagari: একদিন হরিদাস গোঁফাতে বসিয়া ।\\nনাম-সঙ্কীর্তন করেন উচ্চ করিয়া ॥২২৯॥
verses.transliteration: eka-dina haridāsa goṅphāte vasiyā\\nnāma-saṅkīrtana karena ucca kariyā
verses.translation: One day Haridāsa Ṭhākura was sitting in his cave, reciting very loudly the holy name of the Lord.

verses.devanagari: জ্যোৎস্নাবতী রাত্রি, দশ দিক্ সুনির্মল ।\\nগঙ্গার লহরী জ্যোত্স্নায় করে ঝল-মল ॥২৩০॥
verses.transliteration: jyotsnāvatī rātri, daśa dik sunirmala\\ngaṅgāra laharī jyotsnāya kare jhala-mala
verses.translation: The night was full of moonlight, which made the waves of the Ganges look dazzling. All directions were clear and bright.

verses.devanagari: দ্বারে তুলসী লেপা-পিণ্ডির উপর ।\\nগোঁফার শোভা দেখি’ লোকের জুড়ায় অন্তর ॥২৩১॥
verses.transliteration: dvāre tulasī lepā-piṇḍira upara\\ngoṅphāra śobhā dekhi' lokera juḍāya antara
verses.translation: Thus everyone who saw the beauty of the cave, with the tulasī plant on a clean altar, was astonished and satisfied at heart.

verses.devanagari: হেনকালে এক নারী অঙ্গনে আইল ।\\nতাঁর অঙ্গকান্ত্যে স্থান পীতবর্ণ হইল ॥২৩২॥
verses.transliteration: hena-kāle eka nārī aṅgane āila\\ntāṅra aṅga-kāntye sthāna pīta-varṇa ha-ila
verses.translation: At that time, in that beautiful scene, a woman appeared in the courtyard. The beauty of her body was so bright that it tinged the entire place with a hue of yellow.

verses.devanagari: তাঁর অঙ্গ-গন্ধে দশ দিক্ আমোদিত ।\\nভূষণ-ধ্বনিতে কর্ণ হয় চমকিত ॥২৩৩॥
verses.transliteration: tāṅra aṅga-gandhe daśa dik āmodita\\nbhūṣaṇa-dhvanite karṇa haya camakita
verses.translation: The scent of her body perfumed all directions, and the tinkling of her ornaments startled the ear.

verses.devanagari: আসিয়া তুলসীরে সেই কৈলা নমস্কার ।\\nতুলসী পরিক্রমা করি’ গেলা গোঁফা-দ্বার ॥২৩৪॥
verses.transliteration: āsiyā tulasīre sei kailā namaskāra\\ntulasī parikramā kari' gelā goṅphā-dvāra
verses.translation: After coming there, the woman offered obeisances to the tulasī plant, and after circumambulating the tulasī plant she came to the door of the cave where Haridāsa Ṭhākura was sitting.

verses.devanagari: যোড়-হাতে হরিদাসের বন্দিলা চরণ  ।\\nদ্বারে বসি’ কহে কিছু মধুর বচন ॥২৩৫॥
verses.transliteration: yoḍa-hāte haridāsera vandilā caraṇa\\ndvāre vasi' kahe kichu madhura vacana
verses.translation: With folded hands she offered obeisances at the lotus feet of Haridāsa Ṭhākura. Sitting at the door, she then spoke in a very sweet voice.

verses.devanagari: “জগতের বন্ধু তুমি রূপগুণবান্  ।\\nতব সঙ্গ লাগি’ মোর এথাকে প্রয়াণ ॥২৩৬॥
verses.transliteration: "jagatera bandhu tumi rūpa-guṇavān\\ntava saṅga lāgi' mora ethāke prayāṇa
verses.translation: "My dear friend," she said, "you are the friend of the entire world. You are so beautiful and qualified. I have come here only for union with you.

verses.devanagari: মোরে অঙ্গীকার কর হঞা সদয়  ।\\nদীনে দয়া করে, — এই সাধু-স্বভাব হয় ।।” ২৩৭ ॥২৩৭॥
verses.transliteration: more aṅgīkāra kara hañā sadaya\\ndīne dayā kare,—ei sādhu-svabhāva haya"
verses.translation: "My dear sir, kindly accept me and be merciful toward me, for it is a characteristic of all saintly persons to be kind toward the poor and fallen."

verses.devanagari: এত বলি’ নানা-ভাব করয়ে প্রকাশ ।\\nযাহার দর্শনে মুনির হয় ধৈর্যনাশ ॥২৩৮॥
verses.transliteration: eta bali' nānā-bhāva karaye prakāśa\\nyāhāra darśane munira haya dhairya-nāśa
verses.translation: After saying this, she began to manifest various postures, which even the greatest philosopher would lose his patience upon seeing.

verses.devanagari: নির্বিকার হরিদাস গম্ভীর-আশয়  ।\\nবলিতে লাগিলা তাঁরে হঞা সদয় ॥২৩৯॥
verses.transliteration: nirvikāra haridāsa gambhīra-āśaya\\nbalite lāgilā tāṅre hañā sadaya
verses.translation: Haridāsa Ṭhākura was immovable, for he was deeply determined. He began to speak to her, being very merciful toward her.

verses.devanagari: “সংখ্যা-নাম-সঙ্কীর্তন — এই ‘মহাযজ্ঞ’ মন্যে  ।\\nতাহাতে দীক্ষিত আমি হই প্রতিদিনে ॥২৪০॥
verses.transliteration: "saṅkhyā-nāma-saṅkīrtana—ei 'mahā-yajña' manye\\ntāhāte dīkṣita āmi ha-i prati-dine
verses.translation: "I have been initiated into a vow to perform a great sacrifice by chanting the holy name a certain number of times every day.

verses.devanagari: যাবৎ কীর্তন সমাপ্ত নহে, না করি অন্য কাম  ।\\nকীর্তন সমাপ্ত হৈলে, হয় দীক্ষার বিশ্রাম ॥২৪১॥
verses.transliteration: yāvat kīrtana samāpta nahe, nā kari anya kāma\\nkīrtana samāpta haile, haya dīkṣāra viśrāma
verses.translation: "As long as the vow to chant is unfulfilled, I do not desire anything else. When I finish my chanting, then I have an opportunity to do anything.

verses.devanagari: দ্বারে বসি’ শুন তুমি নাম-সঙ্কীর্তন  ।\\nনাম সমাপ্ত হৈলে করিমু তব প্রীতি-আচরণ ॥২৪২॥
verses.transliteration: dvāre vasi' śuna tumi nāma-saṅkīrtana\\nnāma samāpta haile karimu tava prīti-ācaraṇa
verses.translation: "Sit down at the door and hear the chanting of the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra. As soon as the chanting is finished, I shall satisfy you as you desire."

verses.devanagari: এত বলি’ করেন তেঁহো নাম-সঙ্কীর্তন ।\\nসেই নারী বসি’ করে শ্রীনাম-শ্রবণ ॥২৪৩॥
verses.transliteration: eta bali' karena teṅho nāma-saṅkīrtana\\nsei nārī vasi' kare śrī-nāma-śravaṇa
verses.translation: After saying this, Haridāsa Ṭhākura continued to chant the holy name of the Lord. Thus the woman sitting before him began to hear the chanting of the holy name.

verses.devanagari: কীর্তন করিতে আসি’ প্রাতঃকাল হৈল ।\\nপ্রাতঃকাল দেখি’ নারী উঠিয়া চলিল ॥২৪৪॥
verses.transliteration: kīrtana karite āsi' prātaḥ-kāla haila\\nprātaḥ-kāla dekhi' nārī uṭhiyā calila
verses.translation: In this way, as he chanted and chanted, the morning approached, and when the woman saw that it was morning, she got up and left.

verses.devanagari: এইমত তিনদিন করে আগমন ।\\nনানা ভাব দেখায়, যাতে ব্রহ্মার হরে মন ॥২৪৫॥
verses.transliteration: ei-mata tina-dina kare āgamana\\nnānā bhāva dekhāya, yāte brahmāra hare mana
verses.translation: For three days she approached Haridāsa Ṭhākura in this way, exhibiting various feminine postures that would bewilder the mind of even Lord Brahmā.

verses.devanagari: কৃষ্ণে নামাবিষ্ট-মনা সদা হরিদাস ।\\nঅরণ্যে রোদিত হৈল স্ত্রীভাব-প্রকাশ ॥২৪৬॥
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇe nāmāviṣṭa-manā sadā haridāsa\\naraṇye rodita haila strī-bhāva-prakāśa
verses.translation: Haridāsa Ṭhākura was always absorbed in thoughts of Kṛṣṇa and the holy name of Kṛṣṇa. Therefore the feminine poses the woman exhibited were just like crying in the forest.

verses.devanagari: তৃতীয় দিবসের রাত্রি-শেষ যবে হৈল  ।\\nঠাকুরের স্থানে নারী কহিতে লাগিল ॥২৪৭॥
verses.transliteration: tṛtīya divasera rātri-śeṣa yabe haila\\nṭhākurera sthāne nārī kahite lāgila
verses.translation: At the end of the night of the third day, the woman spoke to Haridāsa Ṭhākura as follows.

verses.devanagari: “তিন দিন বঞ্চিলা আমা করি’ আশ্বাসন  ।\\nরাত্রি-দিনে নহে তোমার নাম-সমাপন ।।” ২৪৮ ॥২৪৮॥
verses.transliteration: "tina dina vañcilā āmā kari' āśvāsana\\nrātri-dine nahe tomāra nāma-samāpana"
verses.translation: "My dear sir, for three days you have cheated me by giving me false assurances, for I see that throughout the entire day and night your chanting of the holy name is never finished."

verses.devanagari: হরিদাস ঠাকুর কহেন, — “আমি কি করিমু ?\\nনিয়ম করিয়াছি, তাহা কেমনে ছাড়িমু ?” ॥ ২৪৯ ॥
verses.transliteration: haridāsa ṭhākura kahena,—"āmi ki karimu?\\nniyama kariyāchi, tāhā kemane chāḍimu?"
verses.translation: Haridāsa Ṭhākura said, "My dear friend, what ca I do? I have made a vow. How, then, can I give it up?"

verses.devanagari: তবে নারী কহে তাঁরে করি’ নমস্কার ।\\n‘আমি — মায়া’ করিতে আইলাঙ পরীক্ষা তোমার ॥২৫০॥
verses.transliteration: tabe nārī kahe tāṅre kari' namaskāra\\n'āmi—māyā' karite āilāṅa parīkṣā tomāra
verses.translation: After offering obeisances to Haridāsa Ṭhākura, the woman said: "I am the illusory energy of the Supreme Personality of Godhead. I came here to test you.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
In
Bhagavad-gītā
(Bg. 7.14) Lord Kṛṣṇa says:
daivī hy eṣā guṇa-mayī
mama māyā duratyayā
mām eva ye prapadyante
māyām etāṁ taranti te
"This divine energy of Mine, consisting of the three modes of material nature, is difficult to overcome. But those who have surrendered unto Me can easily cross beyond it." This was actually proved by the behavior of Haridāsa Ṭhākura.
Māyā
enchants the entire world. Indeed, people have forgotten the ultimate goal of life because of the dazzling attractions of the material world. But this dazzling attraction, especially the attractive beauty of a woman, is meant for persons who are not surrendered to the Supreme Personality of Godhead. The Lord says,
mām eva ye prapadyante māyām etāṁ taranti te:
"One who is surrendered unto Me cannot be conquered by the illusory energy." The illusory energy personally came to test Haridāsa Ṭhākura, but herein she admits her defeat, for she was unable to captivate him. How is this possible? it was because Haridāsa Ṭhākura, fully surrendered to the lotus feet of Kṛṣṇa, was always absorbed in thoughts of Kṛṣṇa by chanting the holy names of the Lord 300,000 times daily as a vow.

verses.devanagari: ব্রহ্মাদি জীব, আমি সবারে মোহিলুঁ ।\\nএকেলা তোমারে আমি মোহিতে নারিলুঁ ॥২৫১॥
verses.transliteration: brahmādi jīva, āmi sabāre mohiluṅ\\nekelā tomāre āmi mohite nāriluṅ
verses.translation: "I have previously captivated the mind of even Brahmā, not to speak of others. Your mind alone have I failed to attract.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Beginning from Lord Brahmā down to the insignificant ant, everyone, without exception, is attracted by the illusory energy of the Supreme Personality of Godhead. The demigods, human beings, animals, birds, beasts, trees and plants are all attracted by sexual desire. That is the illusion of
māyā.
Everyone, whether man or woman, thinks that he is the enjoyer of the illusory energy. In this way, everyone is captivated and engaged in material activities. However, because Haridāsa Ṭhākura was always thinking of the Supreme Personality of Godhead and was always busy satisfying the senses of the Lord, this process alone saved him from the captivation of
māyā.
This is practical proof of the strength of devotional service. Because of his full engagement in the service of the Lord, he could not be induced to enjoy
māyā.
The verdict of the
śāstras
is that a pure Vaiṣṇava, or devotee of the Lord, never thinks of enjoying the material world, which culminates in sex life. He never thinks himself an enjoyer; instead, he always wants to be enjoyed by the Supreme Personality of Godhead. Therefore the conclusion is that the Supreme Personality of Godhead is eternal, transcendental, beyond the perception of sense gratification and beyond the material qualities. Only if a living entity gives up the false conception that the body is the self and always thinks himself an eternal servant of Kṛṣṇa and the Vaiṣṇavas can he surpass the influence of
māyā
(
mām eva ye prapadyante māyām etāṁ taranti te).
A pure living entity who thus attains the stage of
anartha-nivṛtti,
cessation of everything unwanted, has nothing to enjoy in the material world. One attains this stage only by properly performing the functions of devotional service. Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī has written:
ādau śraddhā tataḥ sādhu-
saṅgo 'tha bhajana-kriyā
tato 'nartha-nivṛttiḥ syāt
tato niṣṭhā rucis tataḥ
"In the beginning one must have a preliminary desire for self-realization. This will bring one to the stage of trying to associate with persons who are spiritually elevated. In the next stage, one becomes initiated by an elevated spiritual master, and under his instruction the neophyte devotee begins the process of devotional service. By execution of devotional service under the guidance of the spiritual master, one becomes freed from all material attachments, attains steadiness in self-realization and acquires a taste for hearing about the Absolute Personality of Godhead, Śrī Kṛṣṇa." (
Bhakti-rasāmṛta-sindhu
1.4.15) If one is actually executing devotional service, then
anarthas,
the unwanted things associated with material enjoyment, will automatically disappear.

verses.devanagari: মহাভাগবত তুমি, — তোমার দর্শনে ।\\nতোমার কৃষ্ণনাম-কীর্তন-শ্রবণে ॥২৫২॥\\nচিত্ত শুদ্ধ হৈল, চাহে কৃষ্ণনাম লৈতে ।\\nকৃষ্ণনাম উপদেশি’ কৃপা কর মোতে ॥২৫৩॥
verses.transliteration: citta śuddha haila, cāhe kṛṣṇa-nāma laite\\nkṛṣṇa-nāma upadeśi' kṛpā kara mote
verses.translation: "My dear sir, you are the foremost devotee. Simply seeing you and hearing you chant the holy name of Kṛṣṇa has purified my consciousness. Now I want to chant the holy name of the Lord. Please be kind to me by instructing me about the ecstasy of chanting the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra.

verses.devanagari: চৈতন্যাবতারে বহে প্রেমামৃত-বন্যা ।\\nসব জীব প্রেমে ভাসে, পৃথিবী হৈল ধন্যা ॥২৫৪॥
verses.transliteration: caitanyāvatāre vahe premāmṛta-vanyā\\nsaba jīva preme bhāse, pṛthivī haila dhanyā
verses.translation: "There is now a flood of the eternal nectar of love of Godhead due to the incarnation of Lord Caitanya, All living entities are floating in that flood. The entire world is now thankful to the Lord.

verses.devanagari: এ-বন্যায় যে না ভাসে, সেই জীব ছার ।\\nকোটিকল্পে কভু তার নাহিক নিস্তার ॥২৫৫॥
verses.transliteration: e-vanyāya ye nā bhāse, sei jīva chāra\\nkoṭi-kalpe kabhu tāra nāhika nistāra
verses.translation: "Anyone who does not float in this inundation is most condemned. Such a person cannot be delivered for millions of kalpas.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
The
kalpa
is explained in
Bhagavad-gītā. Sahasra-yuga-paryantam ahar yad brahmaṇo viduḥ.
One day of Brahmā is called a
kalpa.
A
yuga,
or
mahā-yuga,
consists of 4,320,000 years, and one thousand such
mahā-yugas
constitute one
kalpa.
The author of
Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta
says that if one does not take advantage of the Kṛṣṇa consciousness movement of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, he cannot be delivered for millions of such
kalpas.

verses.devanagari: পূর্বে আমি রাম-নাম পাঞাছি ‘শিব’ হৈতে ।\\nতোমার সঙ্গে লোভ হৈল কৃষ্ণনাম লৈতে ॥২৫৬॥
verses.transliteration: pūrve āmi rāma-nāma pāñāchi 'śiva' haite\\ntomāra saṅge lobha haila kṛṣṇa-nāma laite
verses.translation: "Formerly I received the holy name of Lord Rāma from Lord Śiva, but now, due to your association, I am greatly eager to chant the holy name of Lord Kṛṣṇa.

verses.devanagari: মুক্তি-হেতুক তারক হয় ‘রামনাম’ ।\\n‘কৃষ্ণনাম’ পারক হঞা করে প্রেমদান ॥২৫৭॥
verses.transliteration: mukti-hetuka tāraka haya 'rāma-nāma'\\n'kṛṣṇa-nāma' pāraka hañā kare prema-dāna
verses.translation: "The holy name of Lord Rāma certainly gives liberation, but the holy name of Kṛṣṇa transports one to the other side of the ocean of nescience and at last gives one ecstatic love of Kṛṣṇa.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
In an indirect way, this verse explains the chanting of the Hare Kṛṣṇa
mahā-mantra.
The Hare Kṛṣṇa
mahā-mantra
—Hare Kṛṣṇa, Hare Kṛṣṇa, Kṛṣṇa Kṛṣṇa, Hare Hare Hare Rāma, Hare Rāma, Rāma Rāma, Hare Hare—includes both the holy name of Lord Kṛṣṇa and the name of Lord Rāma. Lord Rāma gives one the opportunity to be liberated, but simply by liberation one does not get actual spiritual benefit. Sometimes if one is liberated from the material world but has no shelter at the lotus feet of Kṛṣṇa, one falls down to the material world again. Liberation is like a state of convalescence, in which one is free from a fever but is still not healthy. Even in the stage of convalescence, if one is not very careful, one may have a relapse. Similarly, liberation does not offer as much security as the shelter of the lotus feet of Kṛṣṇa. It is stated in the
śāstra:
ye 'nye 'ravindākṣa vimukta-māninas
tvayy asta-bhāvād aviśuddha-buddhayaḥ
āruhya kṛcchreṇa paraṁ padaṁ tataḥ
patanty adho 'nādṛta-yuṣmad-aṅghrayaḥ
"O Lord, the intelligence of those who think themselves liberated but who have no devotion is impure. Even though they rise to the highest point of liberation by dint of severe penances and austerities, they are sure to fall down again into material existence, for they do not take shelter at Your lotus feet." (Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam 10.2.32)
Yuṣmad-aṅghrayaḥ
refers to the lotus feet of Kṛṣṇa. If one does not take shelter of Kṛṣṇa's lotus feet, he falls down (
patanty adhaḥ),
even from liberation. The Hare Kṛṣṇa
mahā-mantra,
however, gives liberation and at the same time offers shelter at the lotus feet of Kṛṣṇa. If one takes shelter at the lotus feet of Kṛṣṇa after liberation, he develops his dormant ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa. That is the highest perfection of life.

verses.devanagari: কৃষ্ণনাম দেহ’ তুমি মোরে কর ধন্যা ।\\nআমারে ভাসায় যৈছে এই প্রেমবন্যা ॥২৫৮॥
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇa-nāma deha' tumi more kara dhanyā\\nāmāre bhāsāya yaiche ei prema-vanyā
verses.translation: "Please give me the holy name of Kṛṣṇa and thus make me fortunate, so that I also may float in the flood of love of Godhead inaugurated by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu."

verses.devanagari: এত বলি’ বন্দিলা হরিদাসের চরণ ।\\nহরিদাস কহে, — “কর কৃষ্ণ-সঙ্কীর্তন” ॥২৫৯॥
verses.transliteration: eta bali' vandilā haridāsera caraṇa\\nharidāsa kahe,—"kara kṛṣṇa-saṅkīrtana"
verses.translation: After speaking in this way, Māyā worshiped the lotus feet of Haridāsa Ṭhākura, who initiated her by saying, "Just perform chanting of the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra."
verses.purport: PURPORT\nNow even Māyā wanted to be favored by Haridāsa Ṭhākura. Therefore Haridāsa Ṭhākura formally initiated her by asking her to chant the Hare Kṛṣṇa\nmahā-mantra.

verses.devanagari: উপদেশ পাঞা মায়া চলিলা হঞা প্রীত ।\\nএ-সব কথাতে কারো না জন্মে প্রতীত ॥২৬০॥
verses.transliteration: upadeśa pāñā māyā calilā hañā prīta\\ne-saba kathāte kāro nā janme pratīta
verses.translation: After thus being instructed by Haridāsa Ṭhākura, Māyā left with great pleasure. Unfortunately, some people have no faith in these narrations.

verses.devanagari: প্রতীত করিতে কহি কারণ ইহার ।\\nযাহার শ্রবণে হয় বিশ্বাস সবার ॥২৬১॥
verses.transliteration: pratīta karite kahi kāraṇa ihāra\\nyāhāra śravaṇe haya viśvāsa sabāra
verses.translation: Therefore I shall explain the reasons why people should have faith. Everyone who hears this will be faithful.

verses.devanagari: চৈতন্যাবতারে কৃষ্ণপ্রেমে লুব্ধ হঞা  ।\\nব্রহ্মা-শিব-সনকাদি পৃথিবীতে জন্মিয়া ॥২৬২॥
verses.transliteration: caitanyāvatāre kṛṣṇa-preme lubdha hañā\\nbrahma-śiva-sanakādi pṛthivīte janmiyā
verses.translation: During the incarnation of Lord Caitanya to inaugurate the Kṛṣṇa consciousness movement, even such personalities as Lord Brahmā, Lord Śiva and the four Kumāras took birth upon this earth, being allured by ecstatic love of Lord Kṛṣṇa.

verses.devanagari: কৃষ্ণনাম লঞা নাচে, প্রেমবন্যায় ভাসে  ।\\nনারদ-প্রহ্লাদাদি আসে মনুষ্য-প্রকাশে ॥২৬৩॥
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇa-nāma lañā nāce, prema-vanyāya bhāse\\nnārada-prahlādādi āse manuṣya-prakāśe
verses.translation: All of them, including the great sage Nārada and devotees like Prahlāda, came here as if human beings, chanting the holy names of Lord Kṛṣṇa together and dancing and floating in the inundation of love of Godhead.

verses.devanagari: লক্ষ্মী-আদি করি’ কৃষ্ণপ্রেমে লুব্ধ হঞা ।\\nনাম-প্রেম আস্বাদিলা মনুষ্যে জন্মিয়া ॥২৬৪॥
verses.transliteration: lakṣmī-ādi kari' kṛṣṇa-preme lubdha hañā\\nnāma-prema āsvādilā manuṣye janmiyā
verses.translation: The goddess of fortune and others, allured by love of Kṛṣṇa, also came down in the form of human beings and tasted the holy name of the Lord in love.

verses.devanagari: অন্যের কা কথা, আপনে ব্রজেন্দ্রনন্দন ।\\nঅবতরি’ করেন প্রেম-রস আস্বাদন ॥২৬৫॥
verses.transliteration: anyera kā kathā, āpane vrajendra-nandana\\navatari' karena prema-rasa āsvādana
verses.translation: What to speak of others, even Kṛṣṇa, the son of Nanda Mahārāja, personally descends to taste the nectar of love of Godhead in the form of the chanting of Hare Kṛṣṇa.

verses.devanagari: মায়া-দাসী ‘প্রেম’ মাগে, — ইথে কি বিস্ময় ?\\n‘সাধুকৃপা’-‘নাম’ বিনা ‘প্রেম’ না জন্মায় ॥২৬৬॥
verses.transliteration: māyā-dāsī 'prema' māge,—ithe ki vismaya?\\n'sādhu-kṛpā-'nāma' vinā 'prema' nā janmaya
verses.translation: What is the wonder if the maidservant of Kṛṣṇa, His external energy, begs for love of Godhead? Without the mercy of a devotee and without the chanting of the holy name of the Lord, love of Godhead cannot be possible.

verses.devanagari: চৈতন্য-গোসাঞির লীলার এই ত’ স্বভাব ।\\nত্রিভুবন নাচে, গায়, পাঞা প্রেমভাব ॥২৬৭॥
verses.transliteration: caitanya-gosāñira līlāra ei ta' svabhāva\\ntribhuvana nāce, gāya, pāñā prema-bhāva
verses.translation: In the activities of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the three worlds dance and chant, having come in touch with love of Godhead. This is the characteristic of His pastimes.

verses.devanagari: কৃষ্ণ-আদি, আর যত স্থাবর-জঙ্গমে ।\\nকৃষ্ণপ্রেমে মত্ত করে কৃষ্ণ-সঙ্কীর্তনে ॥২৬৮॥
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇa-ādi, āra yata sthāvara-jaṅgame\\nkṛṣṇa-preme matta kare kṛṣṇa-saṅkīrtane
verses.translation: The holy name of Kṛṣṇa is so attractive that anyone who chants it-including all living entities, moving and nonmoving, and even Lord Kṛṣṇa Himself-becomes imbued with love of Kṛṣṇa. This is the effect of chanting the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra.

verses.devanagari: স্বরূপ-গোসাঞি কড়চায় যে-লীলা লিখিল  ।\\nরঘুনাথদাস-মুখে যে সব শুনিল ॥২৬৯॥
verses.transliteration: svarūpa-gosāñi kaḍacāya ye-līlā likhila\\nraghunātha-dāsa-mukhe ye saba śunila
verses.translation: I have heard from the mouth of Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī all that Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī recorded in his notes about the pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: সেই সব লীলা কহি সংক্ষেপ করিয়া  ।\\nচৈতন্য-কৃপাতে লিখি ক্ষুদ্রজীব হঞা ॥২৭০॥
verses.transliteration: sei saba līlā kahi saṅkṣepa kariyā\\ncaitanya-kṛpāte likhi kṣudra-jīva hañā
verses.translation: I have briefly described those pastimes. Whatever I have written is by the mercy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, since I am an insignificant living being.

verses.devanagari: হরিদাস ঠাকুরের কহিলুঁ মহিমার কণ ।\\nযাহার শ্রবণে ভক্তের জুড়ায় শ্রবণ ॥২৭১॥
verses.transliteration: haridāsa ṭhākurera kahiluṅ mahimāra kaṇa\\nyāhāra śravaṇe bhaktera juḍāya śravaṇa
verses.translation: I have described but a fragment of the glories of Haridāsa Ṭhākura, Hearing this satisfies the aural reception of every devotee.

verses.devanagari: শ্রীরূপ-রঘুনাথ-পদে যার আশ ।\\nচৈতন্যচরিতামৃত কহে কৃষ্ণদাস ॥২৭২॥
verses.transliteration: śrī-rūpa-raghunātha-pade yāra āśa\\ncaitanya-caritāmṛta kahe kṛṣṇadāsa
verses.translation: Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.
verses.purport: PURPORT\nThus end the Bhaktivedanta purports to Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā,  Third Chapter, describing the glories of Śrīla Haridāsa Ṭhākura.

sections.title: Chapter 4: Sanātana Gosvāmī Visits the Lord at Jagannātha Purī

verses.devanagari: বৃন্দাবনাৎ পুনঃ প্রাপ্তং শ্রীগৌরঃ শ্রীসনাতনম্ ।\\nদেহপাতাদবন্ স্নেহাৎ শুদ্ধং চক্রে পরীক্ষয়া ॥১॥
verses.transliteration: vṛndāvanāt punaḥ prāptaṁ\\nśrī-gauraḥ śrī-sanātanam\\ndeha-pātād avan snehāt\\nśuddhaṁ cakre parīkṣayā
verses.translation: When Sanātana Gosvāmī returned from Vṛndāvana, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu affectionately saved him from his determination to commit suicide. Then, after testing him, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu purified his body.

verses.devanagari: জয় জয় শ্রীচৈতন্য জয় নিত্যানন্দ ।\\nজয়াদ্বৈতচন্দ্র জয় গৌরভক্তবৃন্দ ॥২॥
verses.transliteration: jaya jaya śrī-caitanya jaya nityānanda\\njayādvaita-candra jaya gaura-bhakta-vṛnda
verses.translation: All glories to Lord Caitanya! All glories to Lord Nityānanda! All glories to Advaitacandra! And all glories to all the devotees of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu!

verses.devanagari: নীলাচল হৈতে রূপ গৌড়ে যবে গেলা ।\\nমথুরা হৈতে সনাতন নীলাচল আইলা ॥৩॥
verses.transliteration: nīlācala haite rūpa gauḍe yabe gelā\\nmathurā haite sanātana nīlācala āilā
verses.translation: When Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī returned from Jagannātha Purī to Bengal, Sanātana Gosvāmī went from Mathurā to Jagannātha Purī to see Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: ঝারিখণ্ড-বনপথে আইলা একেলা চলিয়া ।\\nকভু উপবাস, কভু চর্বণ করিয়া ॥৪॥
verses.transliteration: jhārikhaṇḍa-vanapathe āilā ekelā caliyā\\nkabhu upavāsa, kabhu carvaṇa kariyā
verses.translation: Sanātana Gosvāmī walked alone on the path through Jhārikhaṇḍa Forest in central India. Sometimes he fasted, and sometimes he would eat.

verses.devanagari: ঝারিখণ্ডের জলের দোষে, উপবাস হৈতে ।\\nগাত্রে কণ্ডু হৈল, রসা পড়ে খাজুয়াইতে ॥৫॥
verses.transliteration: jhārikhaṇḍera jalera doṣe, upavāsa haite\\ngātre kaṇḍu haila, rasā paḍe khājuyāite
verses.translation: Because of bad water in Jhārikhaṇḍa and because of fasting, Sanātana Gosvāmī contracted a disease that made his body itch. Thus he was afflicted with itching sores from which fluid oozed.

verses.devanagari: নির্বেদ হইল পথে, করেন বিচার  ।\\n‘নীচ-জাতি, দেহ মোর — অত্যন্ত অসার ॥৬॥
verses.transliteration: nirveda ha-ila pathe, karena vicāra\\n'nīca-jāti, deha mora—atyanta asāra
verses.translation: In disappointment, Sanātana Gosvāmī considered, "I am of a low caste, and my body is useless for devotional service.

verses.devanagari: জগন্নাথে গেলে তাঁর দর্শন না পাইমু  ।\\nপ্রভুর দর্শন সদা করিতে নারিমু ॥৭॥
verses.transliteration: jagannāthe gele tāṅra darśana nā pāimu\\nprabhura darśana sadā karite nārimu
verses.translation: "When I go to Jagannātha Purī, I shall not be able to see Lord Jagannātha, nor shall I always be able to see Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: মন্দির-নিকটে শুনি তাঁর বাসা-স্থিতি  ।\\nমন্দির-নিকটে যাইতে মোর নাহি শক্তি ॥৮॥
verses.transliteration: mandira-nikaṭe śuni tāṅra vāsā-sthiti\\nmandira-nikaṭe yāite mora nāhi śakti
verses.translation: "I have heard that the residential quarters of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu are near the temple of Jagannātha. But I shall not have the power to go near the temple.

verses.devanagari: জগন্নাথের সেবক ফেরে কার্য-অনুরোধে ।\\nতাঁর স্পর্শ হৈলে মোর হবে অপরাধে ॥৯॥
verses.transliteration: jagannāthera sevaka phere kārya-anurodhe\\ntāṅra sparśa haile mora habe aparādhe
verses.translation: "The servants of Lord Jagannātha generally move about tending to their duties, but if they touch me I shall be an offender.

verses.devanagari: তাতে যদি এই দেহ, ভাল-স্থানে দিয়ে ।\\nদুঃখ-শান্তি হয় আর সদ্গতি পাইয়ে ॥১০॥
verses.transliteration: tāte yadi ei deha bhāla-sthāne diye\\nduḥkha-śānti haya āra sad-gati pāiye
verses.translation: "Therefore if I sacrifice this body in a good place, my unhappiness will be mitigated, and I shall attain an exalted destination.

verses.devanagari: জগন্নাথ রথযাত্রায় হইবেন বাহির ।\\nতাঁর রথ-চাকায় ছাড়িমু এই শরীর ॥১১॥
verses.transliteration: jagannātha ratha-yātrāya ha-ibena bāhira\\ntāṅra ratha-cākāya chāḍimu ei śarīra
verses.translation: "During the Ratha-yātrā festival, when Lord Jagannātha comes out of the temple, I shall give up this body under the wheel of His cart.

verses.devanagari: মহাপ্রভুর আগে, আর দেখি’ জগন্নাথ ।\\nরথে দেহ ছাড়িমু, — এই পরম-পুরুষার্থ ।।’ ॥ ১২ ॥
verses.transliteration: mahāprabhura āge, āra dekhi' jagannātha\\nrathe deha chāḍimu,—ei parama-puruṣārtha'
verses.translation: "After seeing Lord Jagannātha, I shall give up my body under the wheel of the cart in the presence of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. This will be the highest benediction of my life."

verses.devanagari: এই ত’ নিশ্চয় করি’ নীলাচলে আইলা ।\\nলোকে পুছি’ হরিদাস-স্থানে উত্তরিলা ॥১৩॥
verses.transliteration: ei ta' niścaya kari' nīlācale āilā\\nloke puchi' haridāsa-sthāne uttarilā
verses.translation: Having made this resolution, Sanātana Gosvāmī went to Nīlācala, where he inquired directions from people and approached the residence of Haridāsa Ṭhākura.

verses.devanagari: হরিদাসের কৈলা তেঁহ চরণ বন্দন ।\\nজানি’ হরিদাস তাঁরে কৈলা আলিঙ্গন ॥১৪॥
verses.transliteration: haridāsera kailā teṅha caraṇa vandana\\njāni' haridāsa tāṅre kailā āliṅgana
verses.translation: He offered his respects to the lotus feet of Haridāsa Ṭhākura, who knew him and thus embraced him.

verses.devanagari: মহাপ্রভু দেখিতে তাঁর উৎকণ্ঠিত মন ।\\nহরিদাস কহে, — ‘প্রভু আসিবেন এখন ।।’ ॥ ১৫ ॥
verses.transliteration: mahāprabhu dekhite tāṅra utkaṇṭhita mana\\nharidāsa kahe,—'prabhu āsibena ekhana'
verses.translation: Sanātana Gosvāmī was very eager to see the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Therefore Haridāsa Ṭhākura said, "The Lord is coming here very soon."

verses.devanagari: হেনকালে প্রভু ‘উপলভোগ’ দেখিয়া ।\\nহরিদাসে মিলিতে আইলা ভক্তগণ লঞা ॥১৬॥
verses.transliteration: hena-kāle prabhu 'upala-bhoga' dekhiyā\\nharidāse milite āilā bhakta-gaṇa lañā
verses.translation: At that very moment, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, after visiting the temple of Jagannātha to see the offering of upala-bhoga [morning refreshments], came with His other devotees to see Haridāsa Ṭhākura.

verses.devanagari: প্রভু দেখি’ দুঁহে পড়ে দণ্ডবৎ হঞা ।\\nপ্রভু আলিঙ্গিলা হরিদাসেরে উঠাঞা ॥১৭॥
verses.transliteration: prabhu dekhi' duṅhe paḍe daṇḍavat hañā\\nprabhu āliṅgilā haridāsere uṭhāñā
verses.translation: Seeing Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, they both immediately fell flat like rods to offer obeisances. The Lord then lifted Haridāsa and embraced him.

verses.devanagari: হরিদাস কহে, — ‘সনাতন করে নমস্কার’ ।\\nসনাতনে দেখি’ প্রভু হৈলা চমৎকার ॥১৮॥
verses.transliteration: haridāsa kahe,—'sanātana kare namaskāra'\\nsanātane dekhi' prabhu hailā camatkāra
verses.translation: Haridāsa Ṭhākura said to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, "Here is Sanātana Gosvāmī offering his obeisances." Seeing Sanātana Gosvāmī, the Lord was greatly surprised.

verses.devanagari: সনাতনে আলিঙ্গিতে প্রভু আগু হৈলা  ।\\nপাছে ভাগে সনাতন কহিতে লাগিলা ॥১৯॥
verses.transliteration: sanātane āliṅgite prabhu āgu hailā\\npāche bhāge sanātana kahite lāgilā
verses.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu came forward to embrace him, Sanātana backed away and spoke as folIows.

verses.devanagari: “মোরে না ছুঁইহ, প্রভু, পড়োঁ তোমার পায়  ।\\nএকে নীচজাতি অধম, আর কণ্ডুরসা গায় ।।” ২০ ॥২০॥
verses.transliteration: "more nā chuṅiha, prabhu, paḍoṅ tomāra pāya\\neke nīca-jāti adhama, āra kaṇḍu-rasā gāya
verses.translation: "My Lord, please do not touch me. I fall at Your lotus feet. I am the lowest of men, having been born of a low caste. Besides that, I have infections on my body."

verses.devanagari: বলাৎকারে প্রভু তাঁরে আলিঙ্গন কৈল ।\\nকণ্ডুক্লেদ মহাপ্রভুর শ্রীঅঙ্গে লাগিল ॥২১॥
verses.transliteration: balātkāre prabhu tāṅre āliṅgana kaila\\nkaṇḍu-kleda mahāprabhura śrī-aṅge lāgila
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, however, embraced Sanātana Gosvāmī by force. Thus the moisture oozing from the itching sores touched the transcendental body of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: সব ভক্তগণে প্রভু মিলাইলা সনাতনে ।\\nসনাতন কৈলা সবার চরণ বন্দনে ॥২২॥
verses.transliteration: saba bhakta-gaṇe prabhu milāilā sanātane\\nsanātana kailā sabāra caraṇa vandane
verses.translation: The Lord introduced all the devotees to Sanātana Gosvāmī, who offered his respectful obeisances unto the lotus feet of them all.

verses.devanagari: প্রভু লঞা বসিলা পিণ্ডার উপরে ভক্তগণ ।\\nপিণ্ডার তলে বসিলা হরিদাস সনাতন ॥২৩॥
verses.transliteration: prabhu lañā vasilā piṇḍāra upare bhakta-gaṇa\\npiṇḍāra tale vasilā haridāsa sanātana
verses.translation: The Lord and His devotees sat on a raised platform, and below that sat Haridāsa Ṭhākura and Sanātana Gosvāmī.

verses.devanagari: কুশলবার্তা মহাপ্রভু পুছেন সনাতনে ।\\nতেঁহ কহেন, — ‘পরম মঙ্গল দেখিনু চরণে ।।’ ॥ ২৪ ॥
verses.transliteration: kuśala-vārtā mahāprabhu puchena sanātane\\nteṅha kahena,—'parama maṅgala dekhinu caraṇe'
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu inquired from Sanātana about news of his well-being. Sanātana replied, "Everything is auspicious because I have seen Your lotus feet."

verses.devanagari: মথুরার বৈষ্ণব-সবের কুশল পুছিলা ।\\nসবার কুশল সনাতন জানাইলা ॥২৫॥
verses.transliteration: mathurāra vaiṣṇava-sabera kuśala puchilā\\nsabāra kuśala sanātana jānāilā
verses.translation: When the Lord asked about all the Vaiṣṇavas at Mathurā, Sanātana Gosvāmī informed Him of their good health and fortune.

verses.devanagari: প্রভু কহে, — “ইহাঁ রূপ ছিল দশমাস ।\\nইহাঁ হৈতে গৌড়ে গেলা, হৈল দিন দশ ॥২৬॥
verses.transliteration: prabhu kahe,—"ihāṅ rūpa chila daśa-māsa\\nihāṅ haite gauḍe gelā, haila dina daśa
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu informed Sanātana Gosvāmī, "Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī was here for ten months. He left for Bengal just ten days ago.

verses.devanagari: তোমার ভাই অনুপমের হৈল গঙ্গা-প্রাপ্তি ।\\nভাল ছিল, রঘুনাথে দৃঢ় তার ভক্তি ।।” ॥ ২৭ ॥
verses.transliteration: tomāra bhāi anupamera haila gaṅgā-prāpti\\nbhāla chila, raghunāthe dṛḍha tāra bhakti"
verses.translation: "Your brother Anupama is now dead. He was a very good devotee who had firm conviction in Raghunātha [Lord Rāmacandra]."

verses.devanagari: সনাতন কহে, — “নীচ-বংশে মোর জন্ম  ।\\nঅধর্ম অন্যায় যত, — আমার কুলধর্ম ॥২৮॥
verses.transliteration: sanātana kahe,—"nīca-vaṁśe mora janma\\nadharma anyāya yata,—āmāra kula-dharma
verses.translation: Sanātana Gosvāmī said, "I was born in a low family, for my family commits all kinds of irreligious acts that violate the scriptural injunctions.

verses.devanagari: হেন বংশ ঘৃণা ছাড়ি’ কৈলা অঙ্গীকার  ।\\nতোমার কৃপায় বংশে মঙ্গল আমার ॥২৯॥
verses.transliteration: hena vaṁśa ghṛṇā chāḍi' kailā aṅgīkāra\\ntomāra kṛpāya vaṁśe maṅgala āmāra
verses.translation: "My Lord, without hatred for my family You have accepted me as Your servant. Only by Your mercy is there good fortune in my family.

verses.devanagari: সেই অনুপম-ভাই শিশুকাল হৈতে  ।\\nরঘুনাথ-উপাসনা করে দৃঢ়চিত্তে ॥৩০॥
verses.transliteration: sei anupama-bhāi śiśu-kāla haite\\nraghunātha-upāsanā kare dṛḍha-citte
verses.translation: "From the very beginning of his childhood, my younger brother Anupama was a great devotee of Raghunātha [Lord Rāmacandra], and he worshiped Him with great determination.

verses.devanagari: রাত্রি-দিনে রঘুনাথের ‘নাম’ আর ‘ধ্যান’  ।\\nরামায়ণ নিরবধি শুনে, করে গান ॥৩১॥
verses.transliteration: rātri-dine raghunāthera 'nāma' āra 'dhyāna'\\nrāmāyaṇa niravadhi śune, kare gāna
verses.translation: "He always chanted the holy name of Raghunātha and meditated upon Him. He continuously heard about the activities of the Lord from the Rāmāyaṇa and chanted about them.

verses.devanagari: আমি আর রূপ — তার জ্যেষ্ঠ-সহোদর ।\\nআমা-দোঁহা-সঙ্গে তেঁহ রহে নিরন্তর ॥৩২॥
verses.transliteration: āmi āra rūpa—tāra jyeṣṭha-sahodara\\nāmā-doṅhā-saṅge teṅha rahe nirantara
verses.translation: "Rūpa and I are his elder brothers. He stayed with us continuously.

verses.devanagari: আমা-সবা-সঙ্গে কৃষ্ণকথা, ভাগবত শুনে ।\\nতাহার পরীক্ষা কৈলুঁ আমি-দুইজনে ॥৩৩॥
verses.transliteration: āmā-sabā-saṅge kṛṣṇa-kathā, bhāgavata śune\\ntāhāra parīkṣā kailuṅ āmi-dui-jane
verses.translation: "He heard Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam and talks about Lord Kṛṣṇa with us, and both of us examined him.

verses.devanagari: “শুনহ বল্লভ, কৃষ্ণ — পরম-মধুর  ।\\nসৌন্দর্য, মাধুর্য, প্রেম-বিলাস — প্রচুর ॥৩৪॥
verses.transliteration: śunaha vallabha, kṛṣṇa—parama-madhura\\nsaundarya, mādhurya, prema-vilāsa—pracura
verses.translation: “ 'Dear Vallabha,' we said, 'please hear from us. Lord Kṛṣṇa is supremely attractive. His beauty, sweetness and pastimes of love are without limit.

verses.devanagari: কৃষ্ণভজন কর তুমি আমা-দুহাঁর সঙ্গে  ।\\nতিন ভাই একত্র রহিমু কৃষ্ণকথা-রঙ্গে ।।” ৩৫ ॥৩৫॥
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇa-bhajana kara tumi āmā-duṅhāra saṅge\\ntina bhāi ekatra rahimu kṛṣṇa-kathā-raṅge"
verses.translation: “ 'Engage yourself in devotional service to Kṛṣṇa with both of us. We three brothers shall stay together and enjoy discussing the pastimes of Lord Kṛṣṇa.'

verses.devanagari: এইমত বারবার কহি দুইজন  ।\\nআমা-দুঁহার গৌরবে কিছু ফিরি’ গেল মন ॥৩৬॥
verses.transliteration: ei-mata bāra-bāra kahi dui-jana\\nāmā-duṅhāra gaurave kichu phiri' gela mana
verses.translation: "In this way we both spoke to him again and again, and because of this persuasion and his respect for us, his mind turned somewhat toward our instructions.

verses.devanagari: “তোমা-দুঁহার আজ্ঞা আমি কেমনে লঙ্ঘিমু ? দীক্ষা-মন্ত্র দেহ’ কৃষ্ণ-ভজন করিমু ।।” ৩৭ ॥৩৭॥
verses.transliteration: "tomā-duṅhāra ājñā āmi kemane laṅghimu?\\ndīkṣā-mantra deha' kṛṣṇa-bhajana karimu"
verses.translation: "Vallabha replied, 'My dear brothers, how can I disobey your orders? Initiate me into the Kṛṣṇa mantra so that I may perform devotional service to Lord Kṛṣṇa.'

verses.devanagari: এত কহি’ রাত্রিকালে করেন চিন্তন ।\\nকেমনে ছাড়িমু রঘুনাথের চরণ ॥৩৮॥
verses.transliteration: eta kahi' rātri-kāle karena cintana\\nkemane chāḍimu raghunāthera caraṇa
verses.translation: "After saying this, at night he began to think, 'How shall I give up the lotus feet of Lord Raghunātha?'

verses.devanagari: সব রাত্রি ক্রন্দন করি’ কৈল জাগরণ  ।\\nপ্রাতঃকালে আমা-দুঁহায় কৈল নিবেদন ॥৩৯॥
verses.transliteration: saba rātri krandana kari' kaila jāgaraṇa\\nprātaḥ-kāle āmā-duṅhāya kaila nivedana
verses.translation: "He stayed up all night and cried. In the morning, he came to us and submitted the following plea.

verses.devanagari: ‘রঘুনাথের পাদপদ্মে বেচিয়াছোঁ মাথা  ।\\nকাড়িতে না পারোঁ মাথা, পাঙ বড় ব্যথা ॥৪০॥
verses.transliteration: 'raghunāthera pāda-padme veciyāchoṅ māthā\\nkāḍite nā pāroṅ māthā, pāṅa baḍa vyathā
verses.translation: “ 'I have sold my head at the lotus feet of Lord Rāmacandra. I cannot take it away. That would be too painful for me.

verses.devanagari: কৃপা করি’ মোরে আজ্ঞা দেহ’ দুইজন  ।\\nজন্মে-জন্মে সেবোঁ রঘুনাথের চরণ ॥৪১॥
verses.transliteration: kṛpā kari' more ājñā deha' dui-jana\\njanme-janme sevoṅ raghunāthera caraṇa
verses.translation: “ 'Both of you please be merciful to me and order me in such a way so that life after life I may serve the lotus feet of Lord Raghunātha.

verses.devanagari: রঘুনাথের পাদপদ্ম ছাড়ান না যায়  ।\\nছাড়িবার মন হৈলে প্রাণ ফাটি’ যায় ।।’ ৪২ ॥৪২॥
verses.transliteration: raghunāthera pāda-padma chāḍāna nā yāya\\nchāḍibāra mana haile prāṇa phāṭi' yāya'
verses.translation: “ 'It is impossible for me to give up the lotus feet of Lord Raghunātha. When I even think of giving them up, my heart breaks.'

verses.devanagari: তবে আমি-দুঁহে তারে আলিঙ্গন কৈলুঁ ।\\n‘সাধু, দৃঢ়ভক্তি তোমার’ — কহি’ প্রশংসিলুঁ ॥৪৩॥
verses.transliteration: tabe āmi-duṅhe tāre āliṅgana kailuṅ\\n'sādhu, dṛḍha-bhakti tomāra '—kahi' praśaṁsiluṅ
verses.translation: "Upon hearing this, both of us embraced him and encouraged him by saying, 'You are a great saintly devotee, for your determination in devotional service is fixed.' In this way we both praised him.

verses.devanagari: যে বংশের উপরে তোমার হয় কৃপা-লেশ ।\\nসকল মঙ্গল তাহে খণ্ডে সব ক্লেশ ॥৪৪॥
verses.transliteration: ye vaṁśera upare tomāra haya kṛpā-leśa\\nsakala maṅgala tāhe khaṇḍe saba kleśa'
verses.translation: "My dear Lord, the family upon which You bestow even a little mercy is always fortunate, for such mercy makes all miseries disappear."

verses.devanagari: গোসাঞি কহেন, — “এইমত মুরারি-গুপ্ত ।\\nপূর্বে আমি পরীক্ষিলুঁ তার এই রীত ॥৪৫॥
verses.transliteration: gosāñi kahena,—"ei-mata murāri-gupta\\npūrve āmi parīkṣiluṅ tāra ei rīta
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "There was a similar incident concerning Murāri Gupta. Formerly I examined him, and his determination was similar.

verses.devanagari: সেই ভক্ত ধন্য, যে না ছাড়ে প্রভুর চরণ ।\\nসেই প্রভু ধন্য, যে না ছাড়ে নিজ-জন ॥৪৬॥
verses.transliteration: sei bhakta dhanya, ye nā chāḍe prabhura caraṇa\\nsei prabhu dhanya, ye nā chāḍe nija-jana
verses.translation: "Glorious is that devotee who does not give up the shelter of his Lord, and glorious is that Lord who does not abandon His servant.

verses.devanagari: দুর্দৈবে সেবক যদি যায় অন্য স্থানে ।\\nসেই ঠাকুর ধন্য তারে চুলে ধরি’ আনে ॥৪৭॥
verses.transliteration: durdaive sevaka yadi yāya anya sthāne\\nsei ṭhākura dhanya tāre cule dhari' āne
verses.translation: "If by chance a servant falls down and goes somewhere else, glorious is that master who captures him and brings him back by the hair.

verses.devanagari: ভাল হৈল, তোমার ইহাঁ হৈল আগমনে ।\\nএই ঘরে রহ ইহাঁ হরিদাস-সনে ॥৪৮॥
verses.transliteration: bhāla haila, tomāra ihāṅ haila āgamane\\nei ghare raha ihāṅ haridāsa-sane
verses.translation: "It is very good that you have arrived here. Now stay in this room with Haridāsa Ṭhākura.

verses.devanagari: কৃষ্ণভক্তিরসে দুঁহে পরম প্রধান ।\\nকৃষ্ণরস আস্বাদন কর, লহ কৃষ্ণনাম ।।” ॥ ৪৯ ॥
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇa-bhakti-rase duṅhe parama pradhāna\\nkṛṣṇa-rasa āsvādana kara, laha kṛṣṇa-nāma"
verses.translation: "Both of you are expert in understanding the mellows of Lord Kṛṣṇa's devotional service. Therefore you should both continue relishing the taste for such activities and chanting the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra."

verses.devanagari: এত বলি’ মহাপ্রভু উঠিয়া চলিলা ।\\nগোবিন্দ-দ্বারায় দুঁহে প্রসাদ পাঠাইলা ॥৫০॥
verses.transliteration: eta bali' mahāprabhu uṭhiyā calilā\\ngovinda-dvārāya duṅhe prasāda pāṭhāilā
verses.translation: Having said this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu got up and left, and through Govinda He sent prasāda for them to eat.

verses.devanagari: এইমত সনাতন রহে প্রভু-স্থানে ।\\nজগন্নাথের চক্র দেখি’ করেন প্রণামে ॥৫১॥
verses.transliteration: ei-mata sanātana rahe prabhu-sthāne\\njagannāthera cakra dekhi' karena praṇāme
verses.translation: In this way, Sanātana Gosvāmī stayed under the care of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. He would see the wheel on the pinnacle of the Jagannātha temple and offer respectful obeisances.

verses.devanagari: প্রভু আসি’ প্রতিদিন মিলেন দুইজনে ।\\nইষ্টগোষ্ঠী, কৃষ্ণকথা কহে কতক্ষণে ॥৫২॥
verses.transliteration: prabhu āsi' prati-dina milena dui-jane\\niṣṭa-goṣṭhī, kṛṣṇa-kathā kahe kata-kṣaṇe
verses.translation: Every day Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would go there to meet these two stalwart devotees and discuss topics of Kṛṣṇa with them for some time.

verses.devanagari: দিব্য প্রসাদ পায় নিত্য জগন্নাথ-মন্দিরে ।\\nতাহা আনি’ নিত্য অবশ্য দেন দোঁহাকারে ॥৫৩॥
verses.transliteration: divya prasāda pāya nitya jagannātha-mandire\\ntāhā āni' nitya avaśya dena doṅhākāre
verses.translation: The offerings of prasāda in the temple of Lord Jagannātha were of the highest quality. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would bring this prasāda and deliver it to both devotees.

verses.devanagari: একদিন আসি’ প্রভু দুঁহারে মিলিলা  ।\\nসনাতনে আচম্বিতে কহিতে লাগিলা ॥৫৪॥
verses.transliteration: eka-dina āsi' prabhu duṅhāre mililā\\nsanātane ācambite kahite lāgilā
verses.translation: One day when the Lord came to meet them, He suddenly began speaking to Sanātana Gosvāmī.

verses.devanagari: “সনাতন, দেহত্যাগে কৃষ্ণ যদি পাইয়ে  ।\\nকোটি-দেহ ক্ষণেকে তবে ছাড়িতে পারিয়ে ॥৫৫॥
verses.transliteration: "sanātana, deha-tyāge kṛṣṇa yadi pāiye\\nkoṭi-deha kṣaṇeke tabe chāḍite pāriye
verses.translation: "My dear Sanātana," He said, "if I could attain Kṛṣṇa by committing suicide, I would certainly give up millions of bodies without a moment's hesitation.

verses.devanagari: দেহত্যাগে কৃষ্ণ না পাই, পাইয়ে ভজনে ।\\nকৃষ্ণপ্রাপ্ত্যের উপায় কোন নাহি ‘ভক্তি’ বিনে ॥৫৬॥
verses.transliteration: deha-tyāge kṛṣṇa nā paī, pāiye bhajane\\nkṛṣṇa-prāptyera upāya kona nāhi 'bhakti' vine
verses.translation: "You should know that one cannot attain Kṛṣṇa simply by giving up the body. Kṛṣṇa is attainable by devotional service. There is no other meas to attain Him.

verses.devanagari: দেহত্যাগাদি যত, সব — তমো-ধর্ম ।\\nতমো-রজো-ধর্মে কৃষ্ণের না পাইয়ে মর্ম ॥৫৭॥
verses.transliteration: deha-tyāgādi yata, saba—tamo-dharma\\ntamo-rajo-dharme kṛṣṇera nā pāiye marma
verses.translation: "Acts such as suicide are influenced by the mode of ignorance, and in ignorance and passion one cannot understand who Kṛṣṇa is.

verses.devanagari: ‘ভক্তি’ বিনা কৃষ্ণে কভু নহে ‘প্রেমোদয়’ ।\\nপ্রেম বিনা কৃষ্ণপ্রাপ্তি অন্য হৈতে নয় ॥৫৮॥
verses.transliteration: 'bhakti' vinā kṛṣṇe kabhu nahe 'premodaya'\\nprema vinā kṛṣṇa-prāpti anya haite naya
verses.translation: "Unless one discharges devotional service, one cannot awaken one's dormant love for Kṛṣṇa, and there is no means to attain Him other than awakening that dormant love.

verses.devanagari: ন সাধয়তি মাং যোগো ন সাংখ্যং ধর্ম উদ্ধব ।\\nন স্বাধ্যায়স্তপস্ত্যাগো যথা ভক্তির্মমোর্জিতা ॥৫৯॥
verses.transliteration: na sādhayati māṁ yogo\\nna sāṅkhyaṁ dharma uddhava\\nna svādhyāyas tapas tyāgo\\nyathā bhaktir mamorjitā
verses.translation: [The Supreme Personality of Godhead, Kṛṣṇa, said:] " 'My dear Uddhava, neither through aṣṭāṅga-yoga [the mystic yoga system to control the senses], nor through impersonal monism or an analytical study of the Absolute Truth, nor through study of the Vedas, nor through austerities, charity or acceptance of sannyāsa can one satisfy Me as much as by developing unalloyed devotional service unto Me.'
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This verse is from
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
(11.14.20).

verses.devanagari: দেহত্যাগাদি তমো-ধর্ম — পাতক-কারণ ।\\nসাধক না পায় তাতে কৃষ্ণের চরণ ॥৬০॥
verses.transliteration: deha-tyāgādi tamo-dharma—pātaka-kāraṇa\\nsādhaka nā pāya tāte kṛṣṇera caraṇa
verses.translation: "Measures like suicide are causes for sin. A devotee never achieves shelter at Kṛṣṇa's lotus feet by such actions.

verses.devanagari: প্রেমী ভক্ত বিয়োগে চাহে দেহ ছাড়িতে ।\\nপ্রেমে কৃষ্ণ মিলে, সেহ না পারে মরিতে ॥৬১॥
verses.transliteration: premī bhakta viyoge cāhe deha chāḍite\\npreme kṛṣṇa mile, seha nā pāre marite
verses.translation: "Because of feelings of separation from Kṛṣṇa, an exalted devotee sometimes wants to give up his life. By such ecstatic love, however, one attains the audience of Kṛṣṇa, and at that time he cannot give up his body.

verses.devanagari: গাঢ়ানুরাগের বিয়োগ না যায় সহন ।\\nতাতে অনুরাগী বাঞ্ছে আপন মরণ ॥৬২॥
verses.transliteration: gāḍhānurāgera viyoga nā yāya sahana\\ntāte anurāgī vāñche āpana maraṇa
verses.translation: "One who is deeply in love with Kṛṣṇa cannot tolerate separation from the Lord. Therefore such a devotee always desires his own death.

verses.devanagari: যস্যাঙ্ঘ্রিপঙ্কজরজঃস্নপনং মহান্তো\\nবাঞ্ছন্ত্যুমাপতিরিবাত্মতমোঽপহত্যৈ ।\\nযর্হ্যম্বুজাক্ষ ন লভেয় ভবৎপ্রসাদং\\nজহ্যামসূন্ ব্রতকৃশাঞ্ছতজন্মভিঃ স্যাৎ ॥৬৩॥
verses.transliteration: yasyāṅghri-paṅkaja-rajaḥ-snapanaṁ mahānto\\nvāñchanty umā-patir ivātma-tamo 'pahatyai\\nyarhy ambujākṣa na labheya bhavat-prasādaṁ\\njahyām asūn vrata-kṛśāñ chata-janmabhiḥ syāt
verses.translation: “ 'O lotus-eyed one, great personalities like Lord Śiva desire to bathe in the dust of Your lotus feet to drive away ignorance. If I do not get the mercy of Your Lordship, I shall observe vows to reduce the duration of my life, and thus I shall give up bodies for hundreds of births if it is possible to get Your mercy in that way.'
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This verse was spoken by Rukmiṇīdevī in
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
(10.52.43). Rukmiṇīdevī, the daughter of King Bhīṣmaka, had heard about Kṛṣṇa's transcendental attributes, and thus she desired to get Kṛṣṇa as her husband. Unfortunately, her elder brother Rukmī was envious of Kṛṣṇa and therefore wanted her to be offered to Śiśupāla. When Rukmiṇī became aware of this, she was greatly aggrieved. Thus she wrote Kṛṣṇa a confidential letter, which was presented and read to Him by a
brāhmaṇa
messenger. This verse appeared in that letter.

verses.devanagari: সিঞ্চাঙ্গ নস্ত্বদধরামৃতপূরকেণ\\nহাসাবলোক-কলগীতজ-হৃচ্ছয়াগ্নিম্ ।\\nনো চেদ্বয়ং বিরহজাগ্ন্যুপযুক্তদেহা\\nধ্যানেন যাম পদয়োঃ পদবীং সখে তে ॥৬৪॥
verses.transliteration: siñcāṅga nas tvad-adharāmṛta-pūrakeṇa\\nhāsāvaloka-kala-gītaja-hṛc-chayāgnim\\nno ced vayaṁ virahajāgny-upayukta-dehā\\ndhyānena yāma padayoḥ padavīṁ sakhe te
verses.translation: “ 'O dear Kṛṣṇa, by Your smiling glances and melodious talk, You have awakened a fire of lusty desire in our hearts. Now You should extinguish that fire with a stream of nectar from Your lips by kissing us. Kindly do this. Otherwise, dear friend, the fire within our hearts will burn our bodies to ashes because of separation from You. Thus by meditation we shall claim shelter at Your lotus feet.' "
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This verse (
Bhāg.
10.29.35) was spoken by the
gopīs
when they were attracted by the vibration of Kṛṣṇa's flute in the moonlight of autumn. All of them, being maddened, came to Kṛṣṇa, but to increase their ecstatic love, Kṛṣṇa gave them moral instructions to return home. The
gopīs
did not care for these instructions. They wanted to be kissed by Kṛṣṇa, for they had come there with lusty desires to dance with Him.

verses.devanagari: কুবুদ্ধি ছাড়িয়া কর শ্রবণ-কীর্তন ।\\nঅচিরাৎ পাবে তবে কৃষ্ণের চরণ ॥৬৫॥
verses.transliteration: kubuddhi chāḍiyā kara śravaṇa-kīrtana\\nacirāt pābe tabe kṛṣṇera caraṇa
verses.translation: Caitanya Mahāprabhu told Sanātana Gosvāmī, "Give up all your nonsensical desires, for they are unfavorable for getting shelter at the lotus feet of Kṛṣṇa. Engage yourself in chanting and hearing. Then you will soon achieve the shelter of Kṛṣṇa without a doubt.

verses.devanagari: নীচ-জাতি নহে কৃষ্ণভজনে অযোগ্য ।\\nসৎকুল-বিপ্র নহে ভজনের যোগ্য ॥৬৬॥
verses.transliteration: nīca-jāti nahe kṛṣṇa-bhajane ayogya\\nsat-kula-vipra nahe bhajanera yogya
verses.translation: "A person born in a low family is not unfit for discharging devotional service to Lord Kṛṣṇa, nor is one fit for devotional service simply because he is born in an aristocratic family of brāhmaṇas.

verses.devanagari: যেই ভজে সেই বড়, অভক্ত — হীন, ছার ।\\nকৃষ্ণভজনে নাহি জাতি-কুলাদি-বিচার ॥৬৭॥
verses.transliteration: yei bhaje sei baḍa, abhakta—hīna, chāra\\nkṛṣṇa-bhajane nāhi jāti-kulādi-vicāra
verses.translation: "Anyone who takes to devotional service is exalted, whereas a nondevotee is always condemned and abominable. Therefore in the discharge of devotional service to the Lord, there is no consideration of the status of one's family.

verses.devanagari: দীনেরে অধিক দয়া করেন ভগবান্ ।\\nকুলীন, পণ্ডিত, ধনীর বড় অভিমান ॥৬৮॥
verses.transliteration: dīnere adhika dayā kare bhagavān\\nkulīna, paṇḍita, dhanīra baḍa abhimāna
verses.translation: "The Supreme Personality of Godhead, Kṛṣṇa, is always favorable to the humble and meek, but aristocrats, learned scholars and the wealthy are always proud of their positions.

verses.devanagari: বিপ্রাদ্দ্বিষড়্গুণযুতাদরবিন্দনাভ-\\nপাদারবিন্দবিমুখাৎ শ্বপচং বরিষ্ঠম্ ।\\nমন্যে তদর্পিতমনোবচনেহিতার্থ-\\nপ্রাণং পুনাতি স কুলং ন তু ভূরিমানঃ ॥৬৯॥
verses.transliteration: viprād dviṣaḍ-guṇa-yutād aravinda-nābha-\\npādāravinda-vimukhāt śvapacaṁ variṣṭham\\nmanye tad-arpita-mano-vacane 'hitārtha-\\nprāṇaṁ punāti sa kulaṁ na tu bhūrimānaḥ
verses.translation: “ 'One may be born in a brāhmaṇa family and have all twelve brahminical qualities, but if in spite of being thus qualified he is not devoted to the lotus feet of Lord Kṛṣṇa, who has a navel shaped like a lotus, he is not as good as a caṇḍāla who has dedicated his mind, words, activities, wealth and life to the service of the Lord. Simply to take birth in a brāhmaṇa family or to have brahminical qualities is not sufficient. One must be a pure devotee of the Lord. Thus if a śvapaca, or caṇḍāla, is a devotee, he delivers not only himself but his entire family as well, whereas a brāhmaṇa who is not a devotee but simply has brahminical qualifications cannot even purify himself, what to speak of his family.'
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This is a verse from
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
(7.9.9).

verses.devanagari: ভজনের মধ্যে শ্রেষ্ঠ নববিধা ভক্তি ।\\n‘কৃষ্ণপ্রেম’, ‘কৃষ্ণ’ দিতে ধরে মহাশক্তি ॥৭০॥
verses.transliteration: bhajanera madhye śreṣṭha nava-vidhā bhakti\\n'kṛṣṇa-prema', 'kṛṣṇa' dite dhare mahā-śakti
verses.translation: "Among the ways of executing devotional service, the nine prescribed methods are the best, for these processes have great potency to deliver Kṛṣṇa and ecstatic love for Him.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
The nine kinds of devotional service are mentioned in
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
(7.5.23):
śravaṇaṁ kīrtanaṁ viṣṇoḥ
smaraṇaṁ pāda-sevanam
arcanaṁ vandanaṁ dāsyaṁ
sakhyam ātma-nivedanam
These nine are hearing, chanting, remembering Kṛṣṇa, offering service to Kṛṣṇa's lotus feet, offering worship in the temple, offering prayers, working as a servant, making friendship with Kṛṣṇa and unreservedly surrendering to Kṛṣṇa. These nine processes of devotional service can grant one Kṛṣṇa and ecstatic love for Him. In the beginning one has to discharge devotional service according to regulative principles, but gradually, as devotional service becomes one's life and soul, one achieves the most exalted position of ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa. Ultimately, Kṛṣṇa is the goal of life. One need not have taken birth in an aristocratic
brāhmaṇa
family to attain the lotus feet of Kṛṣṇa, nor is a person born in a low family unfit to achieve Kṛṣṇa's lotus feet. In
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
(3.33.7) Devahūti says to Kapiladeva:
aho bata śva-paco 'to garīyān
yaj-jihvāgre vartate nāma tubhyam
tepus tapas te juhuvuḥ sasnur āryā
brahmānūcur nāma gṛṇanti ye te
"O my Lord, even a person born in a low family of dog-eaters is glorious if he always chants the holy name of the Lord. Such a person has already performed all types of austerities, penances and Vedic sacrifices, has already bathed in the sacred rivers, and has also studied all the Vedic literature. Thus he has become an exalted personality." Similarly, Kuntīdevī says to Lord Kṛṣṇa:
janmaiśvarya-śruta-śrībhir
edhamāna-madaḥ pumān
naivārhaty abhidhātuṁ vai
tvām akiñcana-gocaram
"A person who is proud of his birth, opulence, knowledge and beauty cannot achieve Your lotus feet. You are available only to the humble and meek, not to the proud." (Bhāg. 1.8.26).

verses.devanagari: তার মধ্যে সর্বশ্রেষ্ঠ ন়াম-সঙ্কীর্তন ।\\nনিরপরাধে নাম লৈলে পায় প্রেমধন ॥৭১॥
verses.transliteration: tāra madhye sarva-śreṣṭha nāma-saṅkīrtana\\nniraparādhe nāma laile pāya prema-dhana
verses.translation: "Of the nine processes of devotional service, the most important is to always chant the holy name of the Lord. If one does so, avoiding the ten kinds of offenses, one very easily obtains the most valuable love of Godhead."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Śrīla Jīva Gosvāmī Prabhu gives the following directions in his
Bhakti-sandarbha
(270):
