iyaṁ ca kīrtanākhyā bhaktir bhagavato dravya-jāti-guṇa-kriyābhir dīna-janaika-viṣayāpāra-karuṇā-mayīti śruti-purāṇādi-viśrutiḥ. ataeva kalau svabhāvata evātidīneṣu lokeṣu āvirbhūya tān anāyāsenaiva tat tad yuga-gata-mahā-sādhanānāṁ sarvam eva phalaṁ dadānā sā kṛtārthayati. yata eva tayaiva kalau bhagavato viśeṣataś ca santoṣo bhavati.
"Chanting the holy name is the chief means of attaining love of Godhead. This chanting or devotional service does not depend on any paraphernalia, nor on one's having taken birth in a good family. By humility and meekness one attracts the attention of Kṛṣṇa. That is the verdict of all the
Vedas.
Therefore if one becomes very humble and meek, he can easily attain the lotus feet of Kṛṣṇa in this age of Kali. That is the fulfillment of all great sacrifices, penances and austerities because when one achieves ecstatic love of Godhead, he attains the complete perfection of life. Therefore whatever one does in executing devotional service must be accompanied with the chanting of the holy name of the Lord." The chanting of the holy name of Kṛṣṇa-Hare Kṛṣṇa, Hare Kṛṣṇa, Kṛṣṇa Kṛṣṇa, Hare Hare Hare Rāma, Hare Rāma, Rāma Rāma, Hare Hare-has been praised by Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī in his
Nāmāṣṭaka
(verse 1):
nikhila-śruti-mauli-ratna-mālā-
dyuti-nīrājita-pāda-paṅkajānta
ayi mukta-kulair upāsyamānaṁ
paritas tvāṁ hari-nāma saṁśrayāmi
"O Hari-nāma! The tips of the toes of Your lotus feet are constantly being worshiped by the glowing radiance emanating from the string of gems known as the
Upaniṣads,
the crown jewels of all the
Vedas.
You are eternally adored by liberated souls such as Nārada and Śukadeva. O Hari-nāma! I take complete shelter of You."
Similarly, Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī has praised the chanting of the holy name as follows in his
Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta
(Chapter One, verse 9):
jayati jayati nāmānanda-rūpaṁ murārer
viramita-nija-dharma-dhyāna-pūjādi-yatnam
kathamapi sakṛd-āttaṁ muktidaṁ prāṇīnāṁ yat
paramam amṛtam ekaṁ jīvanaṁ bhūṣaṇaṁ me
"All glories, all glories to the all-blissful holy name of Śrī Kṛṣṇa, which causes the devotee to give up all conventional religious duties, meditation and worship. When somehow or other uttered even once by a living entity, the holy name awards him liberation. The holy name of Kṛṣṇa is the highest nectar. It is my very life and my only treasure."
In
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
(2.1.11) Śukadeva Gosvāmī says:
etan nirvidyamānānām
icchatām akuto-bhayam
yogināṁ nṛpa nirṇītaṁ
harer nāmānukīrtanam
"O King, constant chanting of the holy name of the Lord after the ways of the great authorities is the doubtless and fearless way of success for all, including those who are free from all material desires, those who are desirous of all material enjoyment, and those who are self-satisfied by dint of transcendental knowledge."
Similarly, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu has said in His
Śikṣāṣṭaka
(3):
tṛṇād api sunīcena
taror api sahiṣṇunā
amāninā mānadena
kīrtanīyaḥ sadā hariḥ
"One should chant the holy name of the Lord in a humble state of mind, thinking oneself lower than the straw in the street. One should be more tolerant than a tree, devoid of all sense of false prestige and ready to offer all respect to others. In such a state of mind one can chant the holy name of the Lord constantly." Regarding the ten offenses in chanting the holy name, one may refer to the
Ādi-līlā,
Chapter Eight, verse 24.

verses.devanagari: এত শুনি’ সনাতনের হৈল চমৎকার ।\\nপ্রভুরে না ভায় মোর মরণ-বিচার ॥৭২॥
verses.transliteration: eta śuni' sanātanera haila camatkāra\\nprabhure nā bhāya mora maraṇa-vicāra
verses.translation: After hearing this, Sanātana Gosvāmī was exceedingly astonished. He could understand, "My decision to commit suicide has not been greatly appreciated by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu."

verses.devanagari: সর্বজ্ঞ মহাপ্রভু নিষেধিলা মোরে  ।\\nপ্রভুর চরণ ধরি’ কহেন তাঁহারে ॥৭৩॥
verses.transliteration: sarvajña mahāprabhu niṣedhilā more\\nprabhura caraṇa dhari' kahena tāṅhāre
verses.translation: Sanātana Gosvāmī concIuded, "Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, who knows everything-past, present and future-has forbidden me to commit suicide." He then fell down, touching the lotus feet of the Lord, and spoke to Him as follows.

verses.devanagari: “সর্বজ্ঞ, কৃপালু তুমি ঈশ্বর স্বতন্ত্র  ।\\nযৈছে নাচাও, তৈছে নাচি, — যেন কাষ্ঠযন্ত্র ॥৭৪॥
verses.transliteration: "sarvajña, kṛpālu tumi īśvara svatantra\\nyaiche nācāo, taiche nāci,—yena kāṣṭha-yantra
verses.translation: "My Lord, You are the omniscient, merciful, independent Supreme Lord. Exactly like an instrument of wood, I dance as You make me do so.

verses.devanagari: নীচ, অধম, পামর মুঞি পামর-স্বভাব  ।\\nমোরে জিয়াইলে তোমার কিবা হবে লাভ ?” ৭৫ ॥৭৫॥
verses.transliteration: nīca, adhama, pāmara muñi pāmara-svabhāva\\nmore jiyāile tomāra kibā habe lābha?"
verses.translation: "I am lowborn. Indeed, I am the lowest. I am condemned, for I have all the characteristics of a sinful man. If You keep me alive, what will be the profit?"

verses.devanagari: প্রভু কহে, — “তোমার দেহ মোর নিজ-ধন  ।\\nতুমি মোরে করিয়াছ আত্মসমর্পণ ॥৭৬॥
verses.transliteration: prabhu kahe,—"tomāra deha mora nija-dhana\\ntumi more kariyācha ātma-samarpaṇa
verses.translation: Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "Your body is My property. You have already surrendered unto Me. Therefore you no longer have any claim to your body.

verses.devanagari: পরের দ্রব্য তুমি কেনে চাহ বিনাশিতে ? ধর্মাধর্ম বিচার কিবা না পার করিতে ? ৭৭ ।। তোমার শরীর — মোর প্রধান ‘সাধন’  ।\\nএ শরীরে সাধিমু আমি বহু প্রয়োজন ॥৭৭॥
verses.transliteration: parera dravya tumi kene cāha vināśite?\\ndharmādharma vicāra kibā nā pāra karite?
verses.translation: "Why should you want to destroy another's property? Can't you consider what is right and wrong?

verses.devanagari: তোমার শরীর — মোর প্রধান 'সাধন' ।\\nএ শরীরে সাধিমু আমি বহু প্রয়োজন ॥৭৮॥
verses.transliteration: tomāra śarīra—mora pradhāna 'sādhana'\\ne śarīre sādhimu āmi bahu prayojana
verses.translation: "Your body is My principal instrument for executing many necessary functions. By your body I shall carry out many tasks.

verses.devanagari: ভক্ত-ভক্তি-কৃষ্ণপ্রেম-তত্ত্বের নিধার ।\\nবৈষ্ণবের কৃত্য, আর বৈষ্ণব-আচার ॥৭৯॥
verses.transliteration: bhakta-bhakti-kṛṣṇaprema-tattvera nidhāra\\nvaiṣṇavera kṛtya, āra vaiṣṇava-ācāra
verses.translation: "You shall have to ascertain the basic principles of a devotee, devotional service, love of Godhead, Vaiṣṇava duties, and Vaiṣṇava characteristics.

verses.devanagari: কৃষ্ণভক্তি, কৃষ্ণপ্রেমসেবা-প্রবর্তন ।\\nলুপ্ততীর্থ-উদ্ধার আর বৈরাগ্য-শিক্ষণ ॥৮০॥
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇa-bhakti, kṛṣṇaprema-sevā-pravartana\\nlupta-tīrtha-uddhāra, āra vairāgya-śikṣaṇa
verses.translation: "You will also have to explain Kṛṣṇa's devotional service, establish centers for cultivation of love of Kṛṣṇa, excavate lost places of pilgrimage and teach people how to adopt the renounced order.

verses.devanagari: নিজ-প্রিয়স্থান মোর — মথুরা-বৃন্দাবন ।\\nতাঁহা এত ধর্ম চাহি করিতে প্রচারণ ॥৮১॥
verses.transliteration: nija-priya-sthāna mora—mathurā-vṛndāvana\\ntāhāṅ eta dharma cāhi karite pracāraṇa
verses.translation: "Mathurā-Vṛndāvana is My own very dear abode. I want to do many things there to preach Kṛṣṇa consciousness.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu wanted to accomplish many purposes through the exegetical endeavors of Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī. First Sanātana Gosvāmī compiled the book called
Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta
to teach people how to become devotees, execute devotional service and attain love of Kṛṣṇa. Second, he compiled the
Hari-bhakti-vilāsa,
wherein he collected authoritative statements from scriptural injunctions regarding how a Vaiṣṇava should behave. Only by the endeavors of Śrī Sanātana Gosvāmī were all the lost places of pilgrimage in the Vṛndāvana area excavated. He established Madana-mohana, the first Deity in the Vṛndāvana area, and by his personal behavior he taught how one should act in the renounced order, completely devoted to the service of the Lord. By his personal example, he taught people how to stay in Vṛndāvana to execute devotional service. The principal mission of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was to preach Kṛṣṇa consciousness. Mathurā and Vṛndāvana are the abodes of Lord Kṛṣṇa. Therefore these two places are very dear to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, and He wanted to develop their glories through Sanātana Gosvāmī.

verses.devanagari: মাতার আজ্ঞায় আমি বসি নীলাচলে ।\\nতাহাঁ ‘ধর্ম’ শিখাইতে নাহি নিজ-বলে ॥৮২॥
verses.transliteration: mātāra ājñāya āmi vasi nīlācale\\ntāhāṅ 'dharma' śikhāite nāhi nija-bale
verses.translation: "By the order of My mother I am sitting here in Jagannātha Purī; therefore, I cannot go to Mathurā-Vṛndāvana to teach people how to live there according to religious principles.

verses.devanagari: এত সব কর্ম আমি যে-দেহে করিমু ।\\nতাহা ছাড়িতে চাহ তুমি, কেমনে সহিমু ?” ॥ ৮৩ ॥
verses.transliteration: eta saba karma āmi ye-dehe karimu\\ntāhā chāḍite cāha tumi, kemane sahimu?"
verses.translation: "I have to do all this work through your body, but you want to give it up. How can I tolerate this?"

verses.devanagari: তবে সনাতন কহে, — “তোমাকে নমস্কারে ।\\nতোমার গম্ভীর হৃদয় কে বুঝিতে পারে ? ॥ ৮৪ ॥
verses.transliteration: tabe sanātana kahe,—"tomāke namaskāre\\ntomāra gambhīra hṛdaya ke bujhite pāre?
verses.translation: At that time Sanātana Gosvāmī said to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, "I offer my respectful obeisances unto You. No one can understand the deep ideas You plan within Your heart.

verses.devanagari: কাষ্ঠের পুতলী যেন কুহকে নাচায় । আপনে না জানে, পুতলী কিবা নাচে গায় ! ৮৫ ।। যারে যৈছে নাচাও, সে তৈছে করে নর্তনে  ।\\nকৈছে নাচে, কেবা নাচায়, সেহ নাহি জানে ।।” ৮৬ ॥৮৫॥
verses.transliteration: kāṣṭhera putalī yena kuhake nācāya\\nāpane nā jāne, putalī kibā nāce gāya!
verses.translation: "A wooden doll chants and dances according to the direction of a magician but does not know how he is dancing and singing.

verses.devanagari: যারে যৈছে নাচাও, সে তৈছে করে নর্তনে ।\\nকৈছে নাচে, কেবা নাচায়, সেহ নাহি জানে" ॥৮৬॥
verses.transliteration: yāre yaiche nācāo, se taiche kare nartane\\nkaiche nāce, kebā nācāya, seha nāhi jāne"
verses.translation: "My dear Lord, as You cause one to dance, he dances accordingly, but how he dances and who is causing him to dance he does not know."

verses.devanagari: হরিদাসে কহে প্রভু, — “শুন, হরিদাস  ।\\nপরের দ্রব্য ইঁহো চাহেন করিতে বিনাশ ॥৮৭॥
verses.transliteration: haridāse kahe prabhu,—"śuna, haridāsa\\nparera dravya iṅho cāhena karite vināśa
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then said to Haridāsa Ṭhākura, "My dear Haridāsa, please hear Me. This gentleman wants to destroy another's property.

verses.devanagari: পরের স্থাপ্য দ্রব্য কেহ না খায়, বিলায়  ।\\nনিষেধিহ ইঁহারে, — যেন না করে অন্যায় ।।” ৮৮ ॥৮৮॥
verses.transliteration: parera sthāpya dravya keha nā khāya, vilāya\\nniṣedhiha iṅhāre,—yena nā kare anyāya"
verses.translation: "One who is entrusted with another's property does not distribute it or use it for his own purposes. Therefore, tell him not to do such an unlawful thing."

verses.devanagari: হরিদাস কহে, — “মিথ্যা অভিমান করি  ।\\nতোমার গম্ভীর হৃদয় বুঝিতে না পারি ॥৮৯॥
verses.transliteration: haridāsa kahe,—"mithyā abhimāna kari\\ntomāra gambhīra hṛdaya bujhite nā pāri
verses.translation: Haridāsa Ṭhākura replied, "We are falsely proud of our capabilities. Actually we cannot understand Your deep intentions.

verses.devanagari: কোন্ কোন্ কার্য তুমি কর কোন্ দ্বারে  ।\\nতুমি না জানাইলে কেহ জানিতে না পারে ॥৯০॥
verses.transliteration: kon kon kārya tumi kara kon dvāre\\ntumi nā jānāile keha jānite nā pāre
verses.translation: "Unless You inform us, we cannot understand what Your purpose is nor what You want to do through whom.

verses.devanagari: এতাদৃশ তুমি ইঁহারে করিয়াছ অঙ্গীকার  ।\\nএত সৌভাগ্য ইহাঁ না হয় কাহার ।।” ৯১ ॥৯১॥
verses.transliteration: etādṛśa tumi iṅhāre kariyācha aṅgīkāra\\neta saubhāgya ihāṅ nā haya kāhāra"
verses.translation: "My dear sir, since You, a great personality, have accepted Sanātana Gosvāmī, he is greatly fortunate; no one can be as fortunate as he."

verses.devanagari: তবে মহাপ্রভু করি’ দুঁহারে আলিঙ্গন ।\\n‘মধ্যাহ্ন’ করিতে উঠি’ করিলা গমন ॥৯২॥
verses.transliteration: tabe mahāprabhu kari' duṅhāre āliṅgana\\n'madhyāhna' karite uṭhi' karilā gamana
verses.translation: Thus Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu embraced both Haridāsa Ṭhākura and Sanātana Gosvāmī and then got up and left to perform His noon duties.

verses.devanagari: সনাতনে কহে হরিদাস করি’ আলিঙ্গন  ।\\n“তোমার ভাগ্যের সীমা না যায় কথন ॥৯৩॥
verses.transliteration: sanātane kahe haridāsa kari' āliṅgana\\n"tomāra bhāgyera sīmā nā yāya kathana
verses.translation: "My dear Sanātana," Haridāsa Ṭhākura said, embracing him, "no one can find the limits of your good fortune.

verses.devanagari: তোমার দেহ কহেন প্রভু ‘মোর নিজ-ধন’  ।\\nতোমা-সম ভাগ্যবান্ নাহি কোন জন ॥৯৪॥
verses.transliteration: tomāra deha kahena prabhu 'mora nija-dhana'\\ntomā-sama bhāgyavān nāhi kona jana
verses.translation: "Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu has accepted your body as His own property. Therefore no one can equal you in good fortune.

verses.devanagari: নিজ-দেহে যে কার্য না পারেন করিতে  ।\\nসে কার্য করাইবে তোমা, সেহ মথুরাতে ॥৯৫॥
verses.transliteration: nija-dehe ye kārya nā pārena karite\\nse kārya karāibe tomā, seha mathurāte
verses.translation: "What Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu cannot do with His personal body He wants to do through you, and He wants to do it in Mathurā.

verses.devanagari: যে করাইতে চাহে ঈশ্বর, সেই সিদ্ধ হয়  ।\\nতোমার সৌভাগ্য এই কহিলুঁ নিশ্চয় ॥৯৬॥
verses.transliteration: ye karāite cāhe īśvara, sei siddha haya\\ntomāra saubhāgya ei kahiluṅ niścaya
verses.translation: "Whatever the Supreme Personality of Godhead wants us to do will successfully be accomplished. This is your great fortune. That is my mature opinion.

verses.devanagari: ভক্তিসিদ্ধান্ত, শাস্ত্র-আচার-নির্ণয়  ।\\nতোমা-দ্বারে করাইবেন, বুঝিলুঁ আশয় ॥৯৭॥
verses.transliteration: bhakti-siddhānta, śāstra-ācāra-nirṇaya\\ntomā-dvāre karāibena, bujhiluṅ āśaya
verses.translation: "I can understand from the words of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu that He wants you to write books about the conclusive decision of devotional service and about the regulative principles ascertained from the revealed scriptures.

verses.devanagari: আমার এই দেহ প্রভুর কার্যে না লাগিল ।\\nভারত-ভূমিতে জন্মি’ এই দেহ ব্যর্থ হৈল ।।” ॥ ৯৮ ॥
verses.transliteration: āmāra ei deha prabhura kārye nā lāgila\\nbhārata-bhūmite janmi' ei deha vyartha haila
verses.translation: "My body could not be used in the service of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Therefore although it took birth in the land of India, this body has been useless."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
For a further explanation of the importance of Bhārata-bhūmi, one may refer to the
Ādi-līlā
(9.41) and also
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
(5.19.19-27). The special feature of a birth in India is that a person born in India becomes automatically God conscious. In every part of India, and especially in the holy places of pilgrimage, even an ordinary uneducated man is inclined toward Kṛṣṇa consciousness, and as soon as he sees a Kṛṣṇa conscious person, he offers obeisances. India has many sacred rivers like the Ganges, Yamunā, Narmadā, Kāverī and Kṛṣṇā, and simply by bathing in these rivers people are liberated and become Kṛṣṇa conscious. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu therefore says:
bhārata-bhūmite haila manuṣya-janma yāra
janma sārthaka kari' kara para-upakāra
One who has taken birth in the land of Bhārata-bhūmi, India, should take full advantage of his birth. He should become completely well versed in the knowledge of the
Vedas
and spiritual culture and should distribute the experience of Kṛṣṇa consciousness all over the world. People all over the world are madly engaging in sense gratification and in this way spoiling their human lives, with the risk that in the next life they may become animals or less. Human society should be saved from such a risky civilization and the danger of animalism by awakening to God consciousness, Kṛṣṇa consciousness. The Kṛṣṇa consciousness movement has been started for this purpose. Therefore unbiased men of the highest echelon should study the principles of the Kṛṣṇa consciousness movement and fully cooperate with this movement to save human society.

verses.devanagari: সনাতন কহে, — “তোমা-সম কেবা আছে আন । মহাপ্রভুর গণে তুমি — মহাভাগ্যবান্ ! ৯৯ ।। অবতার-কার্য প্রভুর — নাম-প্রচারে  ।\\nসেই নিজ-কার্য প্রভু করেন তোমার দ্বারে ॥৯৯॥
verses.transliteration: sanātana kahe,—"tomā-sama kebā āche āna\\nmahāprabhura gaṇe tumi—mahā-bhāgyavān!
verses.translation: Sanātana Gosvāmī replied, "O Haridāsa Ṭhākura, who is equal to you? You are one of the associates of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Therefore you are the most fortunate.

verses.devanagari: অবতারকার্য প্রভুর — নামপ্রচারে ।\\nসেই নিজকার্য প্রভু করেন তোমার দ্বারে ॥১০০॥
verses.transliteration: avatāra-kārya prabhura—nāma-pracāre\\nsei nija-kārya prabhu karena tomāra dvāre
verses.translation: "The mission of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, for which He has descended as an incarnation, is to spread the importance of chanting the holy name of the Lord. Now instead of personally doing so, He is spreading it through you.

verses.devanagari: প্রত্যহ কর তিনলক্ষ নাম-সঙ্কীর্তন  ।\\nসবার আগে কর নামের মহিমা কথন ॥১০১॥
verses.transliteration: pratyaha kara tina-lakṣa nāma-saṅkīrtana\\nsabāra āge kara nāmera mahimā kathana
verses.translation: "My dear sir, you are chanting the holy name 300,000 times daily and informing everyone of the importance of such chanting.

verses.devanagari: আপনে আচরে কেহ, না করে প্রচার  ।\\nপ্রচার করেন কেহ, না করেন আচার ॥১০২॥
verses.transliteration: āpane ācare keha, nā kare pracāra\\npracāra karena keha, nā karena ācāra
verses.translation: "Some behave very well but do not preach the cult of Kṛṣṇa consciousness, whereas others preach but do not behave properly.

verses.devanagari: ‘আচার’, ‘প্রচার’, — নামের করহ ‘দুই’ কার্য  ।\\nতুমি — সর্ব-গুরু, তুমি জগতের আর্য ।।” ১০৩ ॥১০৩॥
verses.transliteration: 'ācāra', 'pracāra',—nāmera karaha 'dui' kārya\\ntumi—sarva-guru, tumi jagatera ārya
verses.translation: "You simultaneously perform both duties in relation to the holy name by your personal behavior and by your preaching. Therefore you are the spiritual master of the entire world, for you are the most advanced devotee in the world."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Sanātana Gosvāmī clearly defines herein the bona fide spiritual master of the world. The qualifications expressed in this connection are that one must act according to the scriptural injunctions and at the same time preach. One who does so is a bona fide spiritual master. Haridāsa Ṭhākura was the ideal spiritual master because he regularly chanted on his beads a prescribed number of times. Indeed, he was chanting the holy name of the Lord 300,000 times a day. Similarly, the members of the Kṛṣṇa consciousness movement chant a minimum of sixteen rounds a day, which can be done without difficulty, and at the same time they must preach the cult of Caitanya Mahāprabhu according to the gospel of
Bhagavad-gītā As It Is.
One who does so is quite fit to become a spiritual master for the entire world.

verses.devanagari: এইমত দুইজন নানা-কথা-রঙ্গে ।\\nকৃষ্ণকথা আস্বাদয় রহি’ একসঙ্গে ॥১০৪॥
verses.transliteration: ei-mata dui-jana nānā-kathā-raṅge\\nkṛṣṇa-kathā āsvādaya rahi' eka-saṅge
verses.translation: In this way the two of them passed their time discussing subjects concerning Kṛṣṇa. Thus they enjoyed life together.

verses.devanagari: যাত্রাকালে আইলা সব গৌড়ের ভক্তগণ ।\\nপূর্ববৎ কৈলা সবে রথযাত্রা দরশন ॥১০৫॥
verses.transliteration: yātrā-kāle āilā saba gauḍera bhakta-gaṇa\\npūrvavat kailā sabe ratha-yātrā daraśana
verses.translation: During the time of Ratha-yātrā, all the devotees arrived from Bengal to visit the cart festival as they had done previously.

verses.devanagari: রথ-অগ্রে প্রভু তৈছে করিলা নর্তন ।\\nদেখি চমৎকার হৈল সনাতনের মন ॥১০৬॥
verses.transliteration: ratha-agre prabhu taiche karilā nartana\\ndekhi camatkāra haila sanātanera mana
verses.translation: During the Ratha-yātrā festival, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu again danced before the cart of Jagannātha. When Sanātana Gosvāmī saw this, his mind was astonished.

verses.devanagari: বর্ষার-চারি-মাস রহিলা সব নিজ ভক্তগণে ।\\nসবা-সঙ্গে প্রভু মিলাইলা সনাতনে ॥১০৭॥
verses.transliteration: varṣāra cāri-māsa rahilā saba nija bhakta-gaṇe\\nsabā-saṅge prabhu milāilā sanātane
verses.translation: The Lord's devotees from Bengal stayed at Jagannātha Purī during the four months of the rainy season, and Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu introduced Sanātana Gosvāmī to them all.

verses.devanagari: অদ্বৈত, নিত্যানন্দ, শ্রীবাস, বক্রেশ্বর ।\\nবাসুদেব, মুরারি, রাঘব, দামোদর ॥১০৮॥\\nপুরী, ভারতী, স্বরূপ, পণ্ডিত-গদাধর ।\\nসার্বভৌম, রামানন্দ, জগদানন্দ, শঙ্কর ॥১০৯॥\\nকাশীশ্বর, গোবিন্দাদি যত ভক্তগণ ।\\nসবা-সনে সনাতনের করাইলা মিলন ॥১১০॥
verses.transliteration: kāśīśvara, govindādi yata bhakta-gaṇa\\nsabā-sane sanātanera karāilā milana
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu introduced Sanātana Gosvāmī to these and other selected devotees: Advaita, Nityānanda, Śrīvāsa, Vakreśvara, Vāsudeva, Murāri, Rāghava, Dāmodara, Paramānanda Purī, Brahmānanda Bhāratī, Svarūpa Dāmodara, Gadādhara Paṇḍita, Sārvabhauma, Rāmānanda, Jagadānanda, Śaṅkara, Kāśīśvara and Govinda.

verses.devanagari: যথাযোগ্য করাইল সবার চরণ বন্দন ।\\nতাঁরে করাইলা সবার কৃপার ভাজন ॥১১১॥
verses.transliteration: yathā-yogya karāila sabāra caraṇa vandana\\ntāṅre karāilā sabāra kṛpāra bhājana
verses.translation: The Lord asked Sanātana Gosvāmī to offer obeisances to all the devotees in a way that befitted each one. Thus He introduced Sanātana Gosvāmī to them all, just to make him an object of their mercy.

verses.devanagari: সদ্গুণে, পাণ্ডিত্যে, সবার প্রিয় — সনাতন ।\\nযথাযোগ্য কৃপা-মৈত্রী-গৌরব-ভাজন ॥১১২॥
verses.transliteration: sad-guṇe, pāṇḍitye, sabāra priya—sanātana\\nyathā-yogya kṛpā-maitrī-gaurava-bhājana
verses.translation: Sanātana Gosvāmī was dear to everyone because of his exalted qualities in learning. Suitably, therefore, they bestowed upon him mercy, friendship and honor.

verses.devanagari: সকল বৈষ্ণব যবে গৌড়দেশে গেলা ।\\nসনাতন মহাপ্রভুর চরণে রহিলা ॥১১৩॥
verses.transliteration: sakala vaiṣṇava yabe gauḍa-deśe gelā\\nsanātana mahāprabhura caraṇe rahilā
verses.translation: When all the other devotees returned to Bengal after the Ratha-yātrā festival, Sanātana Gosvāmī stayed under the care of the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: দোলযাত্রা-আদি প্রভুর সঙ্গেতে দেখিল ।\\nদিনে-দিনে প্রভু-সঙ্গে আনন্দ বাড়িল ॥১১৪॥
verses.transliteration: dola-yātrā-ādi prabhura saṅgete dekhila\\ndine-dine prabhu-saṅge ānanda bāḍila
verses.translation: Sanātana Gosvāmī observed the Dola-yātrā ceremony with Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. In this way, his pleasure increased in the company of the Lord.

verses.devanagari: পূর্বে বৈশাখ-মাসে সনাতন যবে আইলা ।\\nজ্যৈষ্ঠমাসে প্রভু তাঁরে পরীক্ষা করিলা ॥১১৫॥
verses.transliteration: pūrve vaiśākha-māse sanātana yabe āilā\\njyaiṣṭha-māse prabhu tāṅre parīkṣā karilā
verses.translation: Sanātana Gosvāmī had come to see Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu at Jagannātha Purī during the month of April-May, and during the month of May-June Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu tested him.

verses.devanagari: জ্যৈষ্ঠমাসে প্রভু যমেশ্বর-টোটা আইলা ।\\nভক্ত-অনুরোধে তাহাঁ ভিক্ষা যে করিলা ॥১১৬॥
verses.transliteration: jyaiṣṭha-māse prabhu yameśvara-ṭoṭā āilā\\nbhakta-anurodhe tāhāṅ bhikṣā ye karilā
verses.translation: In that month of May-June, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu came to the garden of Yameśvara [Lord Śiva] and accepted prasāda there at the request of the devotees.

verses.devanagari: মধ্যাহ্ন-ভিক্ষাকালে সনাতনে বোলাইল ।\\nপ্রভু বোলাইলা, তাঁর আনন্দ বাড়িল ॥১১৭॥
verses.transliteration: madhyāhna-bhikṣā-kāle sanātane bolāila\\nprabhu bolāilā, tāṅra ānanda bāḍila
verses.translation: At noon, when it was time for lunch, the Lord called for Sanātana Gosvāmī, whose happiness increased because of the call.

verses.devanagari: মধ্যাহ্নে সমুদ্র-বালু হঞাছে অগ্নি-সম ।\\nসেইপথে সনাতন করিলা গমন ॥১১৮॥
verses.transliteration: madhyāhne samudra-vālu hañāche agni-sama\\nsei-pathe sanātana karilā gamana
verses.translation: At noon the sand on the beach was as hot as fire, but Sanātana Gosvāmī came by that path.

verses.devanagari: ‘প্রভু বোলাঞাছে’, — এই আনন্দিত মনে ।\\nতপ্ত-বালুকাতে পা পোড়ে, তাহা নাহি জানে ॥১১৯॥
verses.transliteration: 'prabhu bolāñāche',—ei ānandita mane\\ntapta-vālukāte pā poḍe, tāhā nāhi jāne
verses.translation: Overwhelmed by joy at being called by the Lord, Sanātana Gosvāmī did not feel that his feet were burning in the hot sand.

verses.devanagari: দুই পায়ে ফোস্কা হৈল, তবু গেলা প্রভুস্থানে ।\\nভিক্ষা করি’ মহাপ্রভু করিয়াছেন বিশ্রামে ॥১২০॥
verses.transliteration: dui pāye phoskā haila, tabu gelā prabhu-sthāne\\nbhikṣā kari' mahāprabhu kariyāchena viśrāme
verses.translation: Although the soles of both his feet were blistered because of the heat, he nevertheless went to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. There he found that the Lord, having taken His lunch, was resting.

verses.devanagari: ভিক্ষা-অবশেষ-পাত্র গোবিন্দ তারে দিলা ।\\nপ্রসাদ পাঞা সনাতন প্রভুপাশে আইলা ॥১২১॥
verses.transliteration: bhikṣā-avaśeṣa-pātra govinda tāre dilā\\nprasāda pāñā sanātana prabhu-pāśe āilā
verses.translation: Govinda gave Sanātana Gosvāmī the plate with the remnants of Lord Caitanya's food. After taking the prasāda, Sanātana Gosvāmī approached Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: প্রভু কহে, — ‘কোন্ পথে আইলা, সনাতন ?’\\nতেঁহ কহে, — ‘সমুদ্র-পথে, করিলুঁ আগমন ।।’ ॥ ১২২ ॥
verses.transliteration: prabhu kahe,—'kon pathe āilā, sanātana?'\\nteṅha kahe,—'samudra-pathe, kariluṅ āgamana'
verses.translation: When the Lord inquired, "By which path have you come?" Sanātana Gosvāmī replied, "I have come on the path along the beach."

verses.devanagari: প্রভু কহে, — “তপ্ত-বালুকাতে কেমনে আইলা ?\\nসিংহদ্বারের পথ — শীতল, কেনে না আইলা ? ॥ ১২৩ ॥
verses.transliteration: prabhu kahe,—"tapta-vālukāte kemane āilā?\\nsiṁha-dvārera patha—śītala, kene nā āilā?
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "How did you come through the beach where the sand is so hot? Why didn't you come by the path in front of the Siṁha-dvāra gate? It is very cool.
verses.purport: PURPORT\nSiṁha-dvāra refers to the main gate on the eastern side of the Jagannātha temple.

verses.devanagari: তপ্ত-বালুকায় তোমার পায় হৈল ব্রণ ।\\nচলিতে না পার, কেমনে করিলা সহন ?” ॥ ১২৪ ॥
verses.transliteration: tapta-vālukāya tomāra pāya haila vraṇa\\ncalite nā pāra, kemane karilā sahana?"
verses.translation: "The hot sand must have blistered your soles. Now you cannot walk. How did you tolerate it?"

verses.devanagari: সনাতন কহে, — “দুখ বহুত না পাইলুঁ ।\\nপায়ে ব্রণ হঞাছে তাহা না জানিলুঁ ॥১২৫॥
verses.transliteration: sanātana kahe,—"dukha bahuta nā pāiluṅ\\npāye vraṇa hañāche tāhā nā jāniluṅ
verses.translation: Sanātana Gosvāmī replied, "I did not feel much pain, nor did I know that there are blisters because of the heat.

verses.devanagari: সিংহদ্বারে যাইতে মোর নাহি অধিকার ।\\nবিশেষে — ঠাকুরের তাহাঁ সেবকের প্রচার ॥১২৬॥
verses.transliteration: siṁha-dvāre yāite mora nāhi adhikāra\\nviśeṣe—ṭhākurera tāhāṅ sevakera pracāra
verses.translation: "I have no right to pass by the Siṁha-dvāra, for the servants of Jagannātha are always coming and going there.

verses.devanagari: সেবক গতাগতি করে, নাহি অবসর ।\\nতার স্পর্শ হৈলে, সর্বনাশ হবে মোর ।।” ॥ ১২৭ ॥
verses.transliteration: sevaka gatāgati kare, nāhi avasara\\ntāra sparśa haile, sarva-nāśa habe mora"
verses.translation: "The servants are always coming and going without interval. If I touch them, I shall be ruined."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Herein it is very clearly indicated that priests performing Deity worship should be careful to keep themselves completely pure and not be touched by outsiders. Sanātana Gosvāmī and Haridāsa Ṭhākura, thinking themselves
mlecchas
and
yavanas
because of their past association with Mohammedans, did not enter the temple nor even travel on the path in front of the temple gate. It is customary for the priests of temples in India not even to touch outsiders nor enter the Deity room after having been touched. This is a very important item in temple worship.

verses.devanagari: শুনি’ মহাপ্রভু মনে সন্তোষ পাইলা  ।\\nতুষ্ট হঞা তাঁরে কিছু কহিতে লাগিলা ॥১২৮॥
verses.transliteration: śuni' mahāprabhu mane santoṣa pāilā\\ntuṣṭa hañā tāṅre kichu kahite lāgilā
verses.translation: Having heard all these details, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, greatly pleased, spoke as follows.

verses.devanagari: “যদ্যপিও তুমি হও জগৎপাবন ।\\nতোমা-স্পর্শে পবিত্র হয় দেব-মুনিগণ ॥১২৯॥\\nতথাপি ভক্ত-স্বভাব — মর্যাদা-রক্ষণ ।\\nমর্যাদা-পালন হয় সাধুর ভূষণ ॥১৩০॥
verses.transliteration: tathāpi bhakta-svabhāva—maryādā-rakṣaṇa\\nmaryādā-pālana haya sādhura bhūṣaṇa
verses.translation: "My dear Sanātana, although you are the deliverer of the entire universe and although even the demigods and great saints are purified by touching you, it is the characteristic of a devotee to observe and protect the Vaiṣṇava etiquette. Maintenance of the Vaiṣṇava etiquette is the ornament of a devotee.

verses.devanagari: মর্যাদা-লঙ্ঘনে লোক করে উপহাস  ।\\nইহলোক, পরলোক — দুই হয় নাশ ॥১৩১॥
verses.transliteration: maryādā-laṅghane loka kare upahāsa\\niha-loka, para-loka—dui haya nāśa
verses.translation: "If one transgresses the laws of etiquette, people make fun of him, and thus he is vanquished in both this world and the next.

verses.devanagari: মর্যাদা রাখিলে, তুষ্ট কৈলে মোর মন  ।\\nতুমি ঐছে না করিলে করে কোন্ জন ?” ১৩২ ॥১৩২॥
verses.transliteration: maryādā rākhile, tuṣṭa kaile mora mana\\ntumi aiche nā karile kare kon jana?"
verses.translation: "By observing the etiquette, you have satisfied My mind. Who else but you will show this example?"

verses.devanagari: এত বলি’ প্রভু তাঁরে আলিঙ্গন কৈল ।\\nতাঁর কণ্ডুরসা প্রভুর শ্রীঅঙ্গে লাগিল ॥১৩৩॥
verses.transliteration: eta bali' prabhu tāṅre āliṅgana kaila\\ntāṅra kaṇḍu-rasā prabhura śrī-aṅge lāgila
verses.translation: After saying this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu embraced Sanātana Gosvāmī, and the moisture oozing from the itching sores on Sanātana's body smeared the body of the Lord.

verses.devanagari: বার বার নিষেধেন, তবু করে আলিঙ্গন ।\\nঅঙ্গে রসা লাগে, দুঃখ পায় সনাতন ॥১৩৪॥
verses.transliteration: bāra bāra niṣedhena, tabu kare āliṅgana\\naṅge rasā lāge, duḥkha pāya sanātana
verses.translation: Although Sanātana Gosvāmī forbade Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to embrace him, the Lord did so. Thus His body was smeared with the moisture from Sanātana's body, and Sanātana became greatly distressed.

verses.devanagari: এইমতে সেবক-প্রভু দুঁহে ঘর গেলা ।\\nআর দিন জগদানন্দ সনাতনেরে মিলিলা ॥১৩৫॥
verses.transliteration: ei-mate sevaka-prabhu duṅhe ghara gelā\\nāra dina jagadānanda sanātanere mililā
verses.translation: Thus both servant and master departed for their respective homes. The next day, Jagadānanda Paṇḍita went to meet Sanātana Gosvāmī.

verses.devanagari: দুইজন বসি’ কৃষ্ণকথা-গোষ্ঠী কৈলা ।\\nপণ্ডিতেরে সনাতন দুঃখ নিবেদিলা ॥১৩৬॥
verses.transliteration: dui-jana vasi' kṛṣṇa-kathā-goṣṭhī kailā\\npaṇḍitere sanātana duḥkha nivedilā
verses.translation: When Jagadānanda Paṇḍita and Sanātana Gosvāmī sat together and began to discuss topics about Kṛṣṇa, Sanātana Gosvāmī submitted to Jagadānanda Paṇḍita the cause of his distress.

verses.devanagari: “ইহাঁ আইলাঙ প্রভুরে দেখি’ দুঃখ খণ্ডাইতে ।\\nযেবা মনে, তাহা প্রভু না দিলা করিতে ॥১৩৭॥
verses.transliteration: "ihāṅ āilāṅ prabhure dekhi' duḥkha khaṇḍāite\\nyebā mane, tāhā prabhu nā dilā karite
verses.translation: "I came here to diminish my unhappiness by seeing Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, but the Lord did not allow me to execute what was in my mind.

verses.devanagari: নিষেধিতে প্রভু আলিঙ্গন করেন মোরে ।\\nমোর কণ্ডুরসা লাগে প্রভুর শরীরে ॥১৩৮॥
verses.transliteration: niṣedhite prabhu āliṅgana karena more\\nmora kaṇḍu-rasā lāge prabhura śarīre
verses.translation: "Although I forbid Him to do so, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu nevertheless embraces me, and therefore His body becomes smeared with the discharges from my itching sores.

verses.devanagari: অপরাধ হয় মোর, নাহিক নিস্তার ।\\nজগন্নাথেহ না দেখিয়ে, — এ দুঃখ অপার ॥১৩৯॥
verses.transliteration: aparādha haya mora, nāhika nistāra\\njagannātheha nā dekhiye,—e duḥkha apāra
verses.translation: "In this way I am committing offenses at His lotus feet, for which I shall certainly not be delivered. At the same time, I cannot see Lord Jagannātha. This is my great unhappiness.

verses.devanagari: হিত-নিমিত্ত আইলাঙ আমি, হৈল বিপরীতে ।\\nকি করিলে হিত হয় নারি নির্ধারিতে ।।” ॥ ১৪০ ॥
verses.transliteration: hita-nimitta āilāṅa āmi, haila viparīte\\nki karile hita haya nāri nirdhārite"
verses.translation: "I came here for my benefit, but now I see that I am getting just the opposite. I do not know, nor can I ascertain, how there will be benefit for me."

verses.devanagari: পণ্ডিত কহে, — “তোমার বাসযোগ্য ‘বৃন্দাবন’ ।\\nরথযাত্রা দেখি’ তাহাঁ করহ গমন ॥১৪১॥
verses.transliteration: paṇḍita kahe,—"tomāra vāsa-yogya 'vṛndāvana'\\nratha-yātrā dekhi' tāhāṅ karaha gamana
verses.translation: Jagadānanda Paṇḍita said, "The most suitable place for you to reside is Vṛndāvana. After seeing the Ratha-yātrā festival, you can return there.

verses.devanagari: প্রভুর আজ্ঞা হঞাছে তোমা’ দুই ভায়ে ।\\nবৃন্দাবনে বৈস, তাহাঁ সর্বসুখ পাইয়ে ॥১৪২॥
verses.transliteration: prabhura ājñā hañāche tomā' dui bhāye\\nvṛndāvane vaisa, tāhāṅ sarva-sukha pāiye
verses.translation: "The Lord has already ordered both of you brothers to situate yourselves in Vṛndāvana. There you will achieve all happiness.

verses.devanagari: যে-কার্যে আইলা, প্রভুর দেখিলা চরণ ।\\nরথে জগন্নাথ দেখি’ করহ গমন ।।” ॥ ১৪৩ ॥
verses.transliteration: ye-kārye āilā, prabhura dekhilā caraṇa\\nrathe jagannātha dekhi' karaha gamana"
verses.translation: 'Your purpose in coming has been fulfilled, for you have seen the lotus feet of the Lord. Therefore, after seeing Lord Jagannātha on the Ratha-yātrā car, you can leave."

verses.devanagari: সনাতন কহে, — “ভাল কৈলা উপদেশ ।\\nতাহাঁ যাব, সেই মোর ‘প্রভুদত্ত দেশ’ ।।” ॥ ১৪৪ ॥
verses.transliteration: sanātana kahe,—"bhāla kailā upadeśa\\ntāhāṅ yāba, sei mora 'prabhu-datta deśa' "
verses.translation: Sanātana Gosvāmī replied, "You have given me very good advice. I shall certainly go there, for that is the place the Lord has given me for my residence."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
The words
prabhu-datta deśa
are very significant. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's devotional cult teaches one not to sit down in one place but to spread the devotional cult all over the world. The Lord dispatched Sanātana Gosvāmī and Rūpa Gosvāmī to Vṛndāvana to excavate and renovate the holy places and from there establish the cult of
bhakti.
Therefore Vṛndāvana was given to Sanātana Gosvāmī and Rūpa Gosvāmī as their place of residence. Similarly, everyone in the line of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's devotional cult should accept the words of the spiritual master and thus spread the Kṛṣṇa consciousness movement. They should go everywhere, to all parts of the world, accepting those places as
prabhu-datta deśa,
the places of residence given by the spiritual master or Lord Kṛṣṇa. The spiritual master is the representative of Lord Kṛṣṇa; therefore one who has carried out the orders of the spiritual master is understood to have carried out the orders of Kṛṣṇa or Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu wanted to spread the
bhakti
cult all over the world (
pṛthivīte āche yata nagarādi grāma
). Therefore devotees in the line of Kṛṣṇa consciousness must go to different parts of the world and preach, as ordered by the spiritual master. That will satisfy Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: এত বলি’ দুঁহে নিজ-কার্যে উঠি’ গেলা ।\\nআর দিন মহাপ্রভু মিলিবারে আইলা ॥১৪৫॥
verses.transliteration: eta bali' duṅhe nija-kārye uṭhi' gelā\\nāra dina mahāprabhu milibāre āilā
verses.translation: After talking in this way, Sanātana Gosvāmī and Jagadānanda Paṇḍita returned to their respective duties. The next day, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went to see Haridāsa and Sanātana Gosvāmī.

verses.devanagari: হরিদাস কৈলা প্রভুর চরণ বন্দন ।\\nহরিদাসে কৈলা প্রভু প্রেম-আলিঙ্গন ॥১৪৬॥
verses.transliteration: haridāsa kailā prabhura caraṇa vandana\\nharidāse kailā prabhu prema-āliṅgana
verses.translation: Haridāsa Ṭhākura offered obeisances to the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, and the Lord embraced him in ecstatic love.

verses.devanagari: দূর হৈতে দণ্ড-পরণাম করে সনাতন ।\\nপ্রভু বোলায় বার বার করিতে আলিঙ্গন ॥১৪৭॥
verses.transliteration: dūra haite daṇḍa-paraṇāma kare sanātana\\nprabhu bolāya bāra bāra karite āliṅgana
verses.translation: Sanātana Gosvāmī offered his obeisances and daṇḍavats from a distant place, but Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu called him again and again to embrace him.

verses.devanagari: অপরাধ-ভয়ে তেঁহ মিলিতে না আইল ।\\nমহাপ্রভু মিলিবারে সেই ঠাঞি গেল ॥১৪৮॥
verses.transliteration: aparādha-bhaye teṅha milite nā āila\\nmahāprabhu milibāre sei ṭhāñi gela
verses.translation: Out of fear of committing offenses, Sanātana Gosvāmī did not come forward to meet Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. The Lord, however, went forward to meet him.

verses.devanagari: সনাতন ভাগি’ পাছে করেন গমন ।\\nবলাৎকারে ধরি, প্রভু কৈলা আলিঙ্গন ॥১৪৯॥
verses.transliteration: sanātana bhāgi' pāche karena gamana\\nbalātkāre dhari, prabhu kailā āliṅgana
verses.translation: Sanātana Gosvāmī backed away, but Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu caught him by force and embraced him.

verses.devanagari: দুই জন লঞা প্রভু বসিলা পিণ্ডাতে  ।\\nনির্বিণ্ণ সনাতন লাগিলা কহিতে ॥১৫০॥
verses.transliteration: dui jana lañā prabhu vasilā piṇḍāte\\nnirviṇṇa sanātana lāgilā kahite
verses.translation: The Lord took them both with Him and sat down in a sacred place. Then Sanātana Gosvāmī, who was advanced in renunciation, began to speak.

verses.devanagari: “হিত লাগি’ আইনু মুঞি, হৈল বিপরীত  ।\\nসেবাযোগ্য নহি, অপরাধ করোঁ নিতি নিতি ॥১৫১॥
verses.transliteration: "hita lāgi' āinu muñi, haila viparīta\\nsevā-yogya nahi, aparādha karoṅ niti niti
verses.translation: "I came here for my benefit," he said, "but I see that I am getting just the opposite. I am unfit to render service. I simply commit offenses day after day.

verses.devanagari: সহজে নীচ-জাতি মুঞি, দুষ্ট, ‘পাপাশয়’ ।\\nমোরে তুমি ছুঁইলে মোর অপরাধ হয় ॥১৫২॥
verses.transliteration: sahaje nīca-jāti muñi, duṣṭa, 'pāpāśaya'\\nmore tumi chuṅile mora aparādha haya
verses.translation: "By nature I am lowborn. I am a contaminated reservoir of sinful activities. If You touch me, sir, that will be a great offense on my part.

verses.devanagari: তাহাতে আমার অঙ্গে কণ্ডু-রসা-রক্ত চলে ।\\nতোমার অঙ্গে লাগে, তবু স্পর্শহ তুমি বলে ॥১৫৩॥
verses.transliteration: tāhāte āmāra aṅge kaṇḍu-rasā-rakta cale\\ntomāra aṅge lāge, tabu sparśaha tumi bale
verses.translation: "Moreover, blood is running from infected itching sores on my body, smearing Your body with moisture, but still You touch me by force.

verses.devanagari: বীভৎস স্পর্শিতে না কর ঘৃণা-লেশে ।\\nএই অপরাধে মোর হবে সর্বনাশে ॥১৫৪॥
verses.transliteration: bībhatsa sparśite nā kara ghṛṇā-leśe\\nei aparādhe mora habe sarva-nāśe
verses.translation: "My dear sir, You do not have even a pinch of aversion to touching my body, which is in a horrible condition. Because of this offense, everything auspicious will be vanquished for me.

verses.devanagari: তাতে ইহাঁ রহিলে মোর না হয় ‘কল্যাণ’ ।\\nআজ্ঞা দেহ’ — রথ দেখি’ যাঙ বৃন্দাবন ॥১৫৫॥
verses.transliteration: tāte ihāṅ rahile mora nā haya 'kalyāṇa'\\nājñā deha'—ratha dekhi' yāṅa vṛndāvana
verses.translation: "Therefore I see that I will get nothing auspicious by staying here. Kindly give me orders allowing me to return to Vṛndāvana after the Ratha-yātrā festival.

verses.devanagari: জগদানন্দ-পণ্ডিতে আমি যুক্তি পুছিল ।\\nবৃন্দাবন যাইতে তেঁহ উপদেশ দিল ।।” ॥ ১৫৬ ॥
verses.transliteration: jagadānanda-paṇḍite āmi yukti puchila\\nvṛndāvana yāite teṅha upadeśa dila"
verses.translation: "I have consulted Jagadānanda Paṇḍita for his opinion, and he has also advised me to return to Vṛndāvana."

verses.devanagari: এত শুনি’ মহাপ্রভু সরোষ-অন্তরে ।\\nজগদানন্দে ক্রুদ্ধ হঞা করে তিরস্কারে ॥১৫৭॥
verses.transliteration: eta śuni' mahāprabhu saroṣa-antare\\njagadānande kruddha hañā kare tiraṣkāre
verses.translation: Hearing this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, in an angry mood, began to chastise Jagadānanda Paṇḍita.

verses.devanagari: “কালিকার বটুয়া জগা ঐছে গর্বী হৈল  ।\\nতোমা-সবারেহ উপদেশ করিতে লাগিল ॥১৫৮॥
verses.transliteration: "kālikāra baṭuyā jagā aiche garvī haila\\ntomā-sabāreha upadeśa karite lāgila
verses.translation: "Jagā [Jagadānanda Paṇḍita] is only a new boy, but he has become so proud that he thinks himself competent to advise a person like you.

verses.devanagari: ব্যবহারে-পরমার্থে তুমি — তার গুরু-তুল্য  ।\\nতোমারে উপদেশে, না জানে আপন-মূল্য ॥১৫৯॥
verses.transliteration: vyavahāre-paramārthe tumi—tāra guru-tulya\\ntomāre upadeśe, nā jāne āpana-mūlya
verses.translation: "In affairs of spiritual advancement and even in ordinary dealings, you are on the level of his spiritual master. Yet not knowing his own value, he dares to advise you.

verses.devanagari: আমার উপদেষ্টা তুমি — প্রামাণিক আর্য ।\\nতোমারেহ উপদেশে — বালকা করে ঐছে কার্য ।।” ॥ ১৬০ ॥
verses.transliteration: āmāra upadeṣṭā tumi—prāmāṇika ārya\\ntomāreha upadeśe—bālakā kare aiche kārya
verses.translation: "My dear Sanātana, you are on the level of My adviser, for you are an authorized person. But Jagā wants to advise you. This is but the impudence of a naughty boy."

verses.devanagari: শুনি’ সনাতন পায়ে ধরি’ প্রভুরে কহিল  ।\\n“জগদানন্দের সৌভাগ্য আজি সে জানিল ॥১৬১॥
verses.transliteration: śuni' sanātana pāye dhari' prabhure kahila\\n'jagadānandera saubhāgya āji se jānila
verses.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was thus chastising Jagadānanda Paṇḍita, Sanātana Gosvāmī fell at the Lord's feet and said, "I can now understand the fortunate position of Jagadānanda.

verses.devanagari: আপনার ‘অসৌভাগ্য’ আজি হৈল জ্ঞান  ।\\nজগতে নাহি জগদানন্দ-সম ভাগ্যবান্ ॥১৬২॥
verses.transliteration: āpanāra 'asaubhāgya' āji haila jñāna\\njagate nāhi jagadānanda-sama bhāgyavān
verses.translation: "I can also understand my misfortune. No one in this world is as fortunate as Jagadānanda.

verses.devanagari: জগদানন্দে পিয়াও আত্মীয়তা-সুধারস ।\\nমোরে পিয়াও গৌরবস্তুতি-নিম্ব-নিশিন্দা-রস ॥১৬৩॥
verses.transliteration: jagadānande piyāo ātmīyatā-sudhā-rasa\\nmore piyāo gaurava-stuti-nimba-niśindā-rasa
verses.translation: "Sir, You are making Jagadānanda drink the nectar of affectionate relationships, whereas by offering me honorable prayers, You are making me drink the bitter juice of nimba and niśindā.

verses.devanagari: আজিহ নহিল মোরে আত্মীয়তা-জ্ঞান !\\nমোর অভাগ্য, তুমি — স্বতন্ত্র ভগবান্ !” ॥ ১৬৪ ॥
verses.transliteration: ājiha nahila more ātmīyatā-jñāna!\\nmora abhāgya, tumi—svatantra bhagavān!"
verses.translation: "It is my misfortune that You have not accepted me as one of Your intimate relations. But You are the completely independent Supreme Personality of Godhead."

verses.devanagari: শুনি’ মহাপ্রভু কিছু লজ্জিত হৈলা মনে ।\\nতাঁরে সন্তোষিতে কিছু বলেন বচনে ॥১৬৫॥
verses.transliteration: śuni' mahāprabhu kichu lajjita hailā mane\\ntāṅre santoṣite kichu balena vacane
verses.translation: Hearing this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was somewhat ashamed. Just to satisfy Sanātana Gosvāmī, He spoke the following words.

verses.devanagari: “জগদানন্দ প্রিয় আমার নহে তোমা হৈতে ।\\nমর্যাদা-লঙ্ঘন আমি না পারোঁ সহিতে ॥১৬৬॥
verses.transliteration: 'jagadānanda priya āmāra nahe tomā haite\\nmaryādā-laṅghana āmi nā pāroṅ sahite
verses.translation: "My dear Sanātana, please do not think that Jagadānanda is more dear to Me than you. However, I cannot tolerate transgressions of the standard etiquette.

verses.devanagari: কাহাঁ তুমি — প্রামাণিক, শাস্ত্রে প্রবীণ !\\nকাহাঁ জগা — কালিকার বটুয়া নবীন ! ॥ ১৬৭ ॥
verses.transliteration: kāhāṅ tumi—prāmāṇika, śāstre pravīṇa!\\nkāhāṅ jagā—kālikāra baṭuyā navīna!
verses.translation: "You are an experienced authority in the śāstras, whereas Jagā is just a young boy.

verses.devanagari: আমাকেহ বুঝাইতে তুমি ধর শক্তি ।\\nকত ঠাঞি বুঝাঞাছ ব্যবহার-ভক্তি ॥১৬৮॥
verses.transliteration: āmākeha bujhāite tumi dhara śakti\\nkata ṭhāñi bujhāñācha vyavahāra-bhakti
verses.translation: "You have the power to convince even Me. In many places you have already convinced Me about ordinary behavior and devotional service.

verses.devanagari: তোমারে উপদেশ করে, না যায় সহন ।\\nঅতএব তারে আমি করিয়ে ভর্ৎসন ॥১৬৯॥
verses.transliteration: tomāre upadeśa kare, nā yāya sahana\\nataeva tāre āmi kariye bhartsana
verses.translation: "Jagā's advising you is intolerable for Me. Therefore I am chastising him.

verses.devanagari: বহিরঙ্গ-জ্ঞানে তোমারে না করি স্তবন ।\\nতোমার গুণে স্তুতি করায় যৈছে তোমার গুণ ॥১৭০॥
verses.transliteration: bahiraṅga-jñāne tomāre nā kari stavana\\ntomāra guṇe stuti karāya yaiche tomāra guna
verses.translation: "I offer you praise not because I think of you as being outside an intimate relationship with Me but because you are actually so qualified that one is forced to praise your qualities.

verses.devanagari: যদ্যপি কাহার ‘মমতা’ বহুজনে হয় ।\\nপ্রীতি-স্বভাবে কাহাতে কোন ভাবোদয় ॥১৭১॥
verses.transliteration: yadyapi kāhāra 'mamatā' bahu-jane haya\\nprīti-svabhāve kāhāte kona bhāvodaya
verses.translation: "Although one has affection for many persons, different types of ecstatic love awaken according to the nature of one's personal relationships.

verses.devanagari: তোমার দেহ তুমি কর বীভৎস-জ্ঞান ।\\nতোমার দেহ আমারে লাগে অমৃত-সমান ॥১৭২॥
verses.transliteration: tomāra deha tumi kara bībhatsa-jñāna\\ntomāra deha āmāre lāge amṛta-samāna
verses.translation: "You consider your body dangerous and awful, but I think that your body is like nectar.

verses.devanagari: অপ্রাকৃত-দেহ তোমার ‘প্রাকৃত’ কভু নয় ।\\nতথাপি তোমার তাতে প্রাকৃত-বুদ্ধি হয় ॥১৭৩॥
verses.transliteration: aprākṛta-deha tomāra 'prākṛta' kabhu naya\\ntathāpi tomāra tāte prākṛta-buddhi haya
verses.translation: "Actually your body is transcendental, never material. You are thinking of it, however, in terms of a material conception.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura gives his opinion about how a person completely engaged in the service of the Lord transforms his body from material to transcendental. He says: "A pure devotee engaged in the service of Lord Kṛṣṇa has no desire for his personal sense gratification, and thus he never accepts anything for that purpose. He desires only the happiness of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, Kṛṣṇa, and because of his ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa, he acts in various ways.
Karmīs
think that the material body is an instrument for material enjoyment, and that is why they work extremely hard. A devotee, however, has no such desires. A devotee always engages wholeheartedly in the service of the Lord, forgetting about bodily conceptions and bodily activities. The body of a
karmī
is called material because the
karmī,
being too absorbed in material activities, is always eager to enjoy material facilities, but the body of a devotee who tries his best to work very hard for the satisfaction of Kṛṣṇa by fully engaging in the Lord's service must be accepted as transcendental. Whereas
karmīs
are interested only in the personal satisfaction of their senses, devotees work for the satisfaction of the Supreme Lord. Therefore one who cannot distinguish between devotion and ordinary
karma
may mistakenly consider the body of a pure devotee material. One who knows does not commit such a mistake. Nondevotees who consider devotional activities and ordinary material activities to be on the same level are offenders to the chanting of the transcendental holy name of the Lord. A pure devotee knows that a devotee's body, being always transcendental, is just suitable for rendering service to the Lord.
A devotee on the topmost platform of devotional service always humbly thinks that he is not rendering any devotional service. He thinks that he is poor in devotional service and that his body is material. On the other hand, those known as the
sahajiyās
foolishly think that their material bodies are transcendental. Because of this, they are always bereft of the association of pure devotees, and thus they cannot behave like Vaiṣṇavas. Observing the defects of the
sahajiyās,
Śrīla Bhaktivinoda Ṭhākura has sung as follows in his book
Kalyāṇa-kalpa-taru:
āmi ta' vaiṣṇava, e-buddhi ha-ile,
amānī nā haba āmi
pratiṣṭhāśā āsi', hṛdaya dūṣibe,
ha-iba niraya-gāmī
nije śreṣṭha jāni', ucchiṣṭādi-dāne,
habe abhimāna bhāra
tāi śiṣya tava, thākiyā sarvadā,
nā la-iba pūjā kāra
"If I think I am a Vaiṣṇava, I shall look forward to receiving respect from others. And if the desire for fame and reputation pollute my heart, certainly I shall go to hell. By giving others the remnants of my food, I shall consider myself superior and shall be burdened with the weight of false pride. Therefore, always remaining your surrendered disciple, I shall not accept worship from anyone else." Śrīla Kṛṣṇadāsa Kavirāja Gosvāmī has written (Antya-līlā 20.28):
premera svabhāva—yāhāṅ premera sambandha
sei māne,—'kṛṣṇe mora nāhi prema-gandha'
"Wherever there is a relationship of love of Godhead, the natural symptoms are that the devotee does not think himself a devotee, but always thinks that he has not even a drop of love for Kṛṣṇa."

verses.devanagari: ‘প্রাকৃত’ হৈলেহ তোমার বপু নারি উপেক্ষিতে ।\\nভদ্রাভদ্র-বস্তুজ্ঞান নাহিক ‘প্রাকৃতে’ ॥১৭৪॥
verses.transliteration: 'prākṛta' haile ha tomāra vapu nāri upekṣite\\nbhadrābhadra-vastu-jñāna nāhika 'prākṛte'
verses.translation: "Even if your body were material, I still could not neglect it, for the material body should be considered neither good nor bad.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu told Sanātana Gosvāmī, "Since you are a Vaiṣṇava, your body is spiritual, not material. Therefore you should not consider this body to be subjected to superior or inferior qualities. Moreover, I am a
sannyāsī.
Therefore even if your body were material, a
sannyāsī
should see no distinction between a good body and a bad body.

verses.devanagari: কিং ভদ্রং কিমভদ্রং বা দ্বৈতস্যাবস্তুনঃ কিয়ৎ ।\\nবাচোদিতং তদনৃতং মনসা ধ্যাতমেব চ ॥১৭৫॥
verses.transliteration: kiṁ bhadraṁ kim abhadraṁ vā\\ndvaitasyāvastunaḥ kiyat\\nvācoditaṁ tad anṛtaṁ\\nmanasā dhyātam eva ca
verses.translation: “ 'Anything not conceived in relationship to Kṛṣṇa should be understood to be illusion [māyā]. None of the illusions uttered by words or conceived in the mind are factual. Because illusion is not factual, there is no distinction between what we think is good and what we think is bad. When we speak of the Absolute Truth, such speculations do not apply.'
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This is a quotation from
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
(11.28.4).

verses.devanagari: ‘দ্বৈতে’ ভদ্রাভদ্র-জ্ঞান, সব — ‘মনোধর্ম’ ।\\n‘এই ভাল, এই মন্দ’, — এই সব ‘ভ্রম’ ॥১৭৬॥
verses.transliteration: 'dvaite' bhadrābhadra-jñāna, saba—'manodharma'\\n'ei bhāla, ei manda',—ei saba 'bhrama'
verses.translation: "In the material world, conceptions of good and bad are all mental speculations. Therefore, saying, 'This is good, and this is bad,' is all a mistake.
verses.purport: PURPORT\nKṛṣṇa, the Supreme Personality of Godhead, is the Absolute Truth, ever existing with different varieties of energies. When one is absorbed in the illusory energy of Kṛṣṇa and cannot understand Kṛṣṇa, one cannot ascertain what is good and bad for him. Conceptions of good and bad are all imaginations or mental speculations. When one forgets that he is an eternal servant of Kṛṣṇa, he wants to enjoy the material world through different plans. At that time he distinguishes between material plans that are good and those that are bad. Actually, however, they are all false.

verses.devanagari: বিদ্যাবিনয়সম্পন্নে ব্রাহ্মণে গবি হস্তিনি ।\\nশুনি চৈব শ্বপাকে চ পণ্ডিতাঃ সমদর্শিনঃ ॥১৭৭॥
verses.transliteration: vidyā-vinaya-sampanne\\nbrāhmaṇe gavi hastini\\nśuni caiva śvapāke ca\\npaṇḍitāḥ sama-darśinaḥ
verses.translation: “ 'The humble sage, by virtue of true knowledge, sees with equal vision a learned and gentle brāhmaṇa, a cow, an elephant, a dog and a dog-eater.'
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This is a quotation from
Bhagavad-gītā
(Bg. 5.18).

verses.devanagari: জ্ঞানবিজ্ঞানতৃপ্তাত্মা কূটস্থো বিজিতেন্দ্রিয়ঃ ।\\nযুক্ত ইত্যুচ্যতে যোগী সমলোষ্ট্রাশ্মকাঞ্চনঃ ॥১৭৮॥
verses.transliteration: jñāna-vijñāna-tṛptātmā\\nkūṭastho vijitendriyaḥ\\nyukta ity ucyate yogī\\nsama-loṣṭrāśma-kāñcanaḥ
verses.translation: “ 'One who is fully satisfied in knowledge obtained and practically applied in life, who is always determined and fixed in his spiritual position, who completely controls his senses, and who sees pebbles, stone and gold on the same level, is understood to be a perfect yogī.'
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This is also a quotation from
Bhagavad-gītā
(Bg. 6.8).

verses.devanagari: আমি ত’ — সন্ন্যাসী, আমার ‘সম-দৃষ্টি’ ধর্ম ।\\nচন্দন-পঙ্কেতে আমার জ্ঞান হয় ‘সম’ ॥১৭৯॥
verses.transliteration: āmi ta'—sannyāsī, āmāra 'sama-dṛṣṭi' dharma\\ncandana-paṅkete āmāra jñāna haya 'sama'
verses.translation: "Since I am in the renounced order, My duty is to make no distinctions but instead be equipoised. My knowledge must be equally disposed toward sandalwood pulp and dirty mud.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
It is the duty of a
sannyāsī,
a person in the renounced order, to be always equipoised, and that is also the duty of a learned man and a Vaiṣṇava. A Vaiṣṇava, a
sannyāsī
or a learned person has no conception of the material world; in other words, he has no conception of anything materially important. He has no desire to use sandalwood pulp for sense gratification, nor does sense gratification make him hate mud. Acceptance or rejection of material things is not the concern of a
sannyāsī,
a Vaiṣṇava or a learned person. An advanced devotee has no desire to enjoy or reject anything. His only duty is to accept whatever is favorable for the advancement of Kṛṣṇa consciousness. A Vaiṣṇava should be indifferent to material enjoyment and renunciation and should always hanker for the spiritual life of rendering service to the Lord.

verses.devanagari: এই লাগি’ তোমা ত্যাগ করিতে না যুয়ায় ।\\nঘৃণা-বুদ্ধি করি যদি, নিজ-ধর্ম যায় ।।” ॥ ১৮০ ॥
verses.transliteration: ei lāgi' tomā tyāga karite nā yuyāya\\nghṛṇā-buddhi kari yadi, nija-dharma yāya"
verses.translation: "For this reason, I cannot reject you. If I hated you, I would deviate from My occupational duty."

verses.devanagari: হরিদাস কহে, — “প্রভু, যে কহিলা তুমি ।\\nএই ‘বাহ্য প্রতারণা’ নাহি মানি আমি ॥১৮১॥
verses.transliteration: haridāsa kahe,—"prabhu, ye kahilā tumi\\nei 'bāhya pratāraṇā' nāhi māni āmi
verses.translation: Haridāsa said, "My dear Lord, what You have spoken deals with external formalities. I do not accept it.

verses.devanagari: আমা-সব অধমে যে করিয়াছ অঙ্গীকার ।\\nদীনদয়ালু-গুণ তোমার তাহাতে প্রচার ।।” ॥ ১৮২ ॥
verses.transliteration: āmā-saba adhame ye kariyācha aṅgīkāra\\ndīna-dayālu-guṇa tomāra tāhāte pracāra"
verses.translation: "My Lord, we are all fallen, but You have accepted us due to Your attribute of being merciful to the fallen. This is well known all over the world."

verses.devanagari: প্রভু হাসি’ কহে, — “শুন, হরিদাস, সনাতন ।\\nতত্ত্বতঃ কহি তোমা-বিষয়ে যৈছে মোর মন ॥১৮৩॥
verses.transliteration: prabhu hāsi' kahe,—"śuna, haridāsa, sanātana\\ntattvataḥ kahi tomā-viṣaye yaiche mora mana
verses.translation: Lord Caitanya smiled and said, "Listen, Haridāsa and Sanātana. Now I am speaking the truth about how My mind is attached to you.

verses.devanagari: তোমারে ‘লাল্য’, আপনাকে ‘লালক’ অভিমান ।\\nলালকের লাল্যে নহে দোষ-পরিজ্ঞান ॥১৮৪॥
verses.transliteration: tomāre 'lālya', āpanāke 'lālaka' abhimāna\\nlālakera lālye nahe doṣa-parijñāna
verses.translation: "My dear Haridāsa and Sanātana, I think of you as My little boys, to be maintained by Me. The maintainer never takes seriously any faults of the maintained.
verses.purport: PURPORT\nWhen a father maintains a child and the child is maintained by the father, the father never takes seriously the faults of the child. Even if they actually are faults, the father does not mind them.

verses.devanagari: আপনারে হয় মোর অমান্য-সমান ।\\nতোমা-সবারে করোঁ মুঞি বালক-অভিমান ॥১৮৫॥
verses.transliteration: āpanāre haya mora amānya-samāna\\ntomā-sabāre karoṅ muñi bālaka-abhimāna
verses.translation: "I always think of Myself as deserving no respect, but because of affection I always consider you to be like My little children.

verses.devanagari: মাতার যৈছে বালকের ‘অমেধ্য’ লাগে গায় ।\\nঘৃণা নাহি জন্মে, আর মহাসুখ পায় ॥১৮৬॥
verses.transliteration: mātāra yaiche bālakera 'amedhya' lāge gāya\\nghṛṇā nāhi janme, āra mahā-sukha pāya
verses.translation: "When a child passes stool and urine that touch the body of the mother, the mother never hates the child. On the contrary, she takes much pleasure in cleansing him.

verses.devanagari: ‘লাল্যামেধ্য’ লালকের চন্দন-সম ভায় ।\\nসনাতনের ক্লেদে আমার ঘৃণা না উপজায় ।।” ॥ ১৮৭ ॥
verses.transliteration: 'lālyāmedhya' lālakera candana-sama bhāya\\nsanātanera klede āmāra ghṛṇā nā upajāya"
verses.translation: "The stool and urine of the maintained child appear like sandalwood pulp to the mother. Similarly, when the foul moisture oozing from the itches of Sanātana touches My body, I have no hatred for him."

verses.devanagari: হরিদাস কহে, — “তুমি ঈশ্বর দয়াময় ।\\nতোমার গম্ভীর হৃদয় বুঝন না যায় ॥১৮৮॥
verses.transliteration: haridāsa kahe,—"tumi īśvara dayā-maya\\ntomāra gambhīra hṛdaya bujhana nā yāya
verses.translation: Haridāsa Ṭhākura said, "My dear sir, You are the Supreme Personality of Godhead and are most merciful toward us. No one can understand what is within Your deeply affectionate heart.

verses.devanagari: বাসুদেব — গলত্কুষ্ঠী, তাতে অঙ্গ — কীড়াময় ।\\nতারে আলিঙ্গন কৈলা হঞা সদয় ॥১৮৯॥
verses.transliteration: vāsudeva—galat-kuṣṭhī, tāte aṅga—kīḍā-maya\\ntāre āliṅgana kailā hañā sadaya
verses.translation: "You embraced the leper Vāsudeva, whose body was fully infected by worms. You are so kind that in spite of his condition You embraced him.

verses.devanagari: আলিঙ্গিয়া কৈলা তার কন্দর্প-সম অঙ্গ ।\\nবুঝিতে না পারি তোমার কৃপার তরঙ্গ ।।” ॥ ১৯০ ॥
verses.transliteration: āliṅgiyā kailā tāra kandarpa-sama aṅga\\nbujhite nā pāri tomāra kṛpāra taraṅga"
verses.translation: "By embracing him You made his body as beautiful as that of Cupid. We cannot understand the waves of Your mercy."

verses.devanagari: প্রভু কহে, — “বৈষ্ণব-দেহ ‘প্রাকৃত’ কভু নয় ।\\n‘অপ্রাকৃত’ দেহ ভক্তের ‘চিদানন্দময়’ ॥১৯১॥
verses.transliteration: prabhu kahe,—"vaiṣṇava-deha 'prākṛta' kabhu naya\\n'aprākṛta' deha bhaktera 'cid-ānanda-maya'
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "The body of a devotee is never material. It is considered to be transcendental, full of spiritual bliss.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is trying to convince Haridāsa Ṭhākura and Sanātana Gosvāmī that a devotee whose life is dedicated to the service of the Lord is never in the material conception. Because he always engages in the service of the Lord, his body is transcendental and full of spiritual bliss. His body should never be considered material, just as the body of the Deity worshiped in the temple is never considered to be made of stone or wood. Factually, the Deity is directly the Supreme Personality of Godhead, without a doubt. The injunctions of the
Padma Purāṇa
therefore state:
arcye viṣṇau śilādhīr guruṣu nara-matir vaiṣṇave jāti-buddhiḥ. ..yasya vā nārakī saḥ.
The Deity worshiped in the temple is never stone or wood. Similarly, the body of a Vaiṣṇava fully dedicated to the service of the Lord is never considered to belong to the material modes of nature.

verses.devanagari: দীক্ষাকালে ভক্ত করে আত্মসমর্পণ ।\\nসেইকালে কৃষ্ণ তারে করে আত্মসম ॥১৯২॥
verses.transliteration: dīkṣā-kāle bhakta kare ātma-samarpaṇa\\nsei-kāle kṛṣṇa tāre kare ātma-sama
verses.translation: "At the time of initiation, when a devotee fully surrenders unto the service of the Lord, Kṛṣṇa accepts him to be as good as Himself.

verses.devanagari: সেই দেহ করে তার চিদানন্দময় ।\\nঅপ্রাকৃত-দেহে তাঁর চরণ ভজয় ॥১৯৩॥
verses.transliteration: sei deha kare tāra cid-ānanda-maya\\naprākṛta-dehe tāṅra caraṇa bhajaya
verses.translation: "When the devotee's body is thus transformed into spiritual existence, the devotee, in that transcendental body, renders service to the lotus feet of the Lord.

verses.devanagari: মর্ত্যো যদা ত্যক্তসমস্তকর্মা\\nনিবেদিতাত্মা বিচিকীর্ষিতো মে ।\\nতদামৃতত্বং প্রতিপদ্যমানো\\nময়াত্মভূয়ায় চ কল্পতে বৈ ॥১৯৪॥
verses.transliteration: martyo yadā tyakta-samasta-karmā\\nniveditātmā vicikīrṣito me\\ntadāmṛtatvaṁ pratipadyamāno\\nmayātma-bhūyāya ca kalpate vai
verses.translation: “ 'The living entity who is subjected to birth and death, when he gives up all material activities dedicating his life to Me for executing My order, and thus acts according to My direction, at that time he reaches the platform of immortality, and becomes fit to enjoy the spiritual bliss of exchange of loving mellows with Me.'
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This is a quotation from
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
(11.29.34). At the time of initiation, a devotee gives up all his material conceptions. Therefore, being in touch with the Supreme Personality of Godhead, he is situated on the transcendental platform. Thus having attained knowledge and the spiritual platform, he always engages in the service of the spiritual body of Kṛṣṇa. When one is freed from material connections in this way, his body immediately becomes spiritual, and Kṛṣṇa accepts His service. However, Kṛṣṇa does not accept anything from a person with a material conception of life. When a devotee no longer has any desire for material sense gratification, in his spiritual identity he engages in the service of the Lord, for his dormant spiritual consciousness awakens. This awakening of spiritual consciousness makes his body spiritual, and thus he becomes fit to render service to the Lord.
Karmīs
may consider the body of a devotee material, but factually it is not, for a devotee has no conception of material enjoyment. If one thinks that the body of a pure devotee is material, he is an offender, for that is a
vaiṣṇava-aparādha.
In this connection one should consult Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī's
Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta
(1.3.45 and 2.3.139).

verses.devanagari: সনাতনের দেহে কৃষ্ণ কণ্ডু উপজাঞা ।\\nআমা পরীক্ষিতে ইহাঁ দিলা পাঠাঞা ॥১৯৫॥
verses.transliteration: sanātanera dehe kṛṣṇa kaṇḍu upajāñā\\nāmā parīkṣite ihāṅ dilā pāṭhāñā
verses.translation: "Kṛṣṇa somehow or other manifested these itching sores on the body of Sanātana Gosvāmī and sent him here to test Me.

verses.devanagari: ঘৃণা করি’ আলিঙ্গন না করিতাম যবে ।\\nকৃষ্ণ-ঠাঞি অপরাধ-দণ্ড পাইতাম তবে ॥১৯৬॥
verses.transliteration: ghṛṇā kari' āliṅgana nā karitāma yabe\\nkṛṣṇa-ṭhāñi aparādha-daṇḍa pāitāma tabe
verses.translation: "If I had hated Sanātana Gosvāmī and had not embraced him, I would certainly have been chastised for offenses to Kṛṣṇa.

verses.devanagari: পারিষদ-দেহ এই, না হয় দুর্গন্ধ ।\\nপ্রথম দিবসে পাইলুঁ চতুঃসম-গন্ধ ।।” ॥ ১৯৭ ॥
verses.transliteration: pāriṣada-deha ei, nā haya durgandha\\nprathama divase pāiluṅ catuḥsama-gandha"
verses.translation: "Sanātana Gosvāmī is one of the associates of Kṛṣṇa. There could not be any bad odor from his body. On the first day I embraced him, I smelled the aroma of catuḥsama [a mixture of sandalwood pulp, camphor, aguru and musk]."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
An associate of the Lord is one whose body is fully engaged in the service of the Lord. A materialist might see Sanātana Gosvāmī's body as being full of itching sores that exuded foul moisture and a bad smell. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, however, said that actually the aroma of his body was the excellent scent of a mixture of sandalwood pulp, camphor, musk and aguru. In the
Garuḍa Purāṇa
this mixture, which is called
catuḥsama,
is described as follows:
kastūrikāyā dvau bhāgau
catvāraś candanasya tu
kuṅkumasya trayaś caikaḥ
śaśinaḥ syāt catuḥsamam
"Two parts of musk, four parts of sandalwood, three parts of
aguru
or saffron and one part of camphor, when mixed together, form
catuḥsama.
" The aroma of
catuḥsama
is very pleasing. It is also mentioned in the
Hari-bhakti-vilāsa
(6.115).

verses.devanagari: বস্তুতঃ প্রভু যবে কৈলা আলিঙ্গন ।\\nতাঁর স্পর্শে গন্ধ হৈল চন্দনের সম ॥১৯৮॥
verses.transliteration: vastutaḥ prabhu yabe kailā āliṅgana\\ntāṅra sparśe gandha haila candanera sama
verses.translation: In fact, however, when Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu embraced the body of Sanātana Gosvāmī, by the Lord's touch alone there was manifest a fragrance exactly like that of sandalwood pulp.

verses.devanagari: প্রভু কহে, — সনাতন, না মানিহ দুঃখ ।\\nতোমার আলিঙ্গনে আমি পাই বড় সুখ ॥১৯৯॥
verses.transliteration: prabhu kahe,—"sanātana, nā māniha duḥkha\\ntomāra āliṅgane āmi pāi baḍa sukha
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu continued, "My dear Sanātana, do not be aggrieved, for when I embrace you I actually get great pleasure.

verses.devanagari: এ-বৎসর তুমি ইহাঁ রহ আমা-সনে ।\\nবৎসর রহি’ তোমারে আমি পাঠাইমু বৃন্দাবনে ॥২০০॥
verses.transliteration: e-vatsara tumi ihāṅ raha āmā-sane\\nvatsara rahi' tomāre āmi pāṭhāimu vṛndāvane
verses.translation: "Stay with Me at Jagannātha Purī for one year, and after that I shall send you to Vṛndāvana."

verses.devanagari: এত বলি’ পুনঃ তাঁরে কৈলা আলিঙ্গন ।\\nকণ্ডু গেল, অঙ্গ হৈল সুবর্ণের সম ॥২০১॥
verses.transliteration: eta bali' punaḥ tāṅre kailā āliṅgana\\nkaṇḍu gela, aṅga haila suvarṇera sama
verses.translation: After saying this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu again embraced Sanātana Gosvāmī. Thus immediately Sanātana's itches disappeared, and his entire body resembled the color of gold.

verses.devanagari: দেখি’ হরিদাস মনে হৈলা চমৎকার  ।\\nপ্রভুরে কহেন, — “এই ভঙ্গী যে তোমার ॥২০২॥
verses.transliteration: dekhi' haridāsa mane hailā camatkāra\\nprabhure kahena,—"ei bhaṅgī ye tomāra
verses.translation: Seeing the change, Haridāsa Ṭhākura, greatly astonished, told the Lord, "This is Your pastime.

verses.devanagari: সেই ঝারিখণ্ডের পানী তুমি খাওয়াইলা  ।\\nসেই পানী-লক্ষ্যে ইঁহার কণ্ডু উপজাইলা ॥২০৩॥
verses.transliteration: sei jhārikhaṇḍera pānī tumi khāoyāilā\\nsei pānī-lakṣye iṅhāra kaṇḍu upajāilā
verses.translation: "My dear Lord, You made Sanātana Gosvāmī drink the water of Jhārikhaṇḍa, and You actually generated the consequent itching sores on his body.

verses.devanagari: কণ্ডু করি’ পরীক্ষা করিলে সনাতনে  ।\\nএই লীলা-ভঙ্গী তোমার কেহ নাহি জানে ।।” ২০৪ ॥২০৪॥
verses.transliteration: kaṇḍu kari' parīkṣā karile sanātane\\nei līlā-bhaṅgī tomāra keha nāhi jāne"
verses.translation: "After thus causing these itching sores, You examined Sanātana Gosvāmī. No one can understand Your transcendental pastimes."

verses.devanagari: দুঁহে আলিঙ্গিয়া প্রভু গেলা নিজালয় ।\\nপ্রভুর গুণ কহে দুঁহে হঞা প্রেমময় ॥২০৫॥
verses.transliteration: duṅhe āliṅgiyā prabhu gelā nijālaya\\nprabhura guṇa kahe duṅhe hañā prema-maya
verses.translation: After embracing both Haridāsa Ṭhākura and Sanātana Gosvāmī, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu returned to His residence. Then both Haridāsa Ṭhākura and Sanātana Gosvāmī, in great ecstatic love, began to describe the Lord's transcendental attributes.

verses.devanagari: এইমত সনাতন রহে প্রভু-স্থানে ।\\nকৃষ্ণচৈতন্য-গুণ-কথা হরিদাস-সনে ॥২০৬॥
verses.transliteration: ei-mata sanātana rahe prabhu-sthāne\\nkṛṣṇa-caitanya-guṇa-kathā haridāsa-sane
verses.translation: In this way Sanātana Gosvāmī stayed under the care of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and discussed the transcendental qualities of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu with Haridāsa Ṭhākura.

verses.devanagari: দোলযাত্রা দেখি’ প্রভু তাঁরে বিদায় দিলা ।\\nবৃন্দাবনে যে করিবেন, সব শিখাইলা ॥২০৭॥
verses.transliteration: dola-yātrā dekhi' prabhu tāṅre vidāya dilā\\nvṛndāvane ye karibena, saba śikhāilā
verses.translation: After they saw the Dola-yātrā festival, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu instructed Sanātana Gosvāmī fully about what to do in Vṛndāvana and bade him farewell.

verses.devanagari: যে-কালে বিদায় হৈলা প্রভুর চরণে ।\\nদুইজনার বিচ্ছেদ-দশা না যায় বর্ণনে ॥২০৮॥
verses.transliteration: ye-kāle vidāya hailā prabhura caraṇe\\ndui-janāra viccheda-daśā nā yāya varṇane
verses.translation: The scene of separation that took place when Sanātana Gosvāmī and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu took leave of one another is so piteous that it cannot be described herein.

verses.devanagari: যেই বন-পথে প্রভু গেলা বৃন্দাবন ।\\nসেইপথে যাইতে মন কৈলা সনাতন ॥২০৯॥
verses.transliteration: yei vana-pathe prabhu gelā vṛndāvana\\nsei-pathe yāite mana kailā sanātana
verses.translation: Sanātana Gosvāmī decided to go to Vṛndāvana by the very forest path Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had traversed.

verses.devanagari: যে-পথে, যে-গ্রাম-নদী-শৈল, যাহাঁ যেই লীলা ।\\nবলভদ্রভট্ট-স্থানে সব লিখি’ নিলা ॥২১০॥
verses.transliteration: ye-pathe, ye-grāma-nadī-śaila, yāhāṅ yei līlā\\nbalabhadra-bhaṭṭa-sthāne saba likhi' nilā
verses.translation: Sanātana Gosvāmī noted from Balabhadra Bhaṭṭācārya all the villages, rivers and hills where Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had performed His pastimes.

verses.devanagari: মহাপ্রভুর ভক্তগণে সবারে মিলিয়া ।\\nসেইপথে চলি’ যায় সে-স্থান দেখিয়া ॥২১১॥
verses.transliteration: mahāprabhura bhakta-gaṇe sabāre miliyā\\nsei-pathe cali' yāya se-sthāna dekhiyā
verses.translation: Sanātana Gosvāmī met all the devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and then, traveling by that same path, visited the places through which Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had passed.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Śrīla Bhaktivinoda Ṭhākura writes in a song (
Śaraṇāgati
31.3):
gaura āmāra, ye saba sthāne,
karala bhramaṇa raṅge
se-saba sthāna, heriba āmi,
praṇayi-bhakata-saṅge.
"May I visit all the holy places associated with the
līlās
of Lord Caitanya and His devotees." A devotee should make a point of visiting all the places where Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu performed His pastimes. Indeed, pure devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu even want to see the places He simply visited for only hours or minutes.

verses.devanagari: যে-যে-লীলা প্রভু পথে কৈলা যে-যে-স্থানে ।\\nতাহা দেখি’ প্রেমাবেশ হয় সনাতনে ॥২১২॥
verses.transliteration: ye-ye-līlā prabhu pathe kailā ye-ye-sthāne\\ntāhā dekhi' premāveśa haya sanātane
verses.translation: As soon as Sanātana Gosvāmī visited a place where Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had performed His pastimes on the way, he was immediately filled with ecstatic love.

verses.devanagari: এইমতে সনাতন বৃন্দাবনে আইলা ।\\nপাছে আসি’ রূপ-গোসাঞি তাঁহারে মিলিলা ॥২১৩॥
verses.transliteration: ei-mate sanātana vṛndāvane āilā\\npāche āsi' rūpa-gosāñi tāṅhāre mililā
verses.translation: In this way Sanātana Gosvāmī reached Vṛndāvana. Later Rūpa Gosvāmī came and met him.

verses.devanagari: একবৎসর রূপ-গোসাঞির গৌড়ে বিলম্ব হৈল ।\\nকুটুম্বের ‘স্থিতি’-অর্থ বিভাগ করি’ দিল ॥২১৪॥
verses.transliteration: eka-vatsara rūpa-gosāñira gauḍe vilamba haila\\nkuṭumbera 'sthiti'-artha vibhāga kari' dila
verses.translation: Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī was delayed in Bengal for a year because he was dividing his money among his relatives to situate them in their proper positions.
verses.purport: PURPORT\nAlthough Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī renounced his family life, he nevertheless was not unjust to his family members. Even after renunciation, he returned to Bengal, where he properly divided whatever money he had and gave it to his relatives so that they would not be inconvenienced.

verses.devanagari: গৌড়ে যে অর্থ ছিল, তাহা আনাইলা ।\\nকুটুম্ব-ব্রাহ্মণ-দেবালয়ে বাঁটি’ দিলা ॥২১৫॥
verses.transliteration: gauḍe ye artha chila, tāhā ānāilā\\nkuṭumba-brāhmaṇa-devālaye bāṅṭi' dilā
verses.translation: He collected whatever money he had accumulated in Bengal and divided it among his relatives, the brāhmaṇas and the temples.

verses.devanagari: সব মনঃকথা গোসাঞি করি’ নির্বাহণ ।\\nনিশ্চিন্ত হঞা শীঘ্র আইলা বৃন্দাবন ॥২১৬॥
verses.transliteration: saba manaḥ-kathā gosāñi kari' nirvāhaṇa\\nniścinta hañā śīghra āilā vṛndāvana
verses.translation: Thus after finishing all the tasks he had on his mind, he returned to Vṛndāvana fully satisfied.

verses.devanagari: দুই ভাই মিলি’ বৃন্দাবনে বাস কৈলা ।\\nপ্রভুর যে আজ্ঞা, দুঁহে সব নির্বাহিলা ॥২১৭॥
verses.transliteration: dui bhāi mili' vṛndāvane vāsa kailā\\nprabhura ye ājñā, duṅhe saba nirvāhilā
verses.translation: The brothers met at Vṛndāvana, where they stayed to execute the will of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
śrī-caitanya-mano-'bhīṣṭaṁ \ sthāpitaṁ yena bhū-tale \ svayaṁ rūpaḥ kadā mahyaṁ \ dadāti sva-padāntikam
"When will Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī Prabhupāda, who has established within the material world the mission to fulfill the desire of Lord Caitanya, give me shelter under his lotus feet?" Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī and Sanātana Gosvāmī were previously ministers directly in charge of the government of Nawab Hussain Shah, and they were also householders, but later they became
gosvāmīs.
A
gosvāmī,
therefore, is one who executes the will of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. The title "
gosvāmī
" is not an inherited designation; it is meant for a person who has controlled his sense gratification and dedicated his life to executing the order of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Therefore Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī and Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī became genuine
gosvāmīs
after dedicating their lives to the service of the Lord.

verses.devanagari: নানাশাস্ত্র আনি’ লুপ্ত-তীর্থ উদ্ধারিলা ।\\nবৃন্দাবনে কৃষ্ণসেবা প্রকাশ করিলা ॥২১৮॥
verses.transliteration: nānā-śāstra āni' lupta-tīrtha uddhārilā\\nvṛndāvane kṛṣṇa-sevā prakāśa karilā
verses.translation: Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī and Sanātana Gosvāmī collected many revealed scriptures, and from the evidence in those scriptures they excavated all the lost sites of pilgrimage. Thus they established temples for the worship of Lord Kṛṣṇa.

verses.devanagari: সনাতন গ্রন্থ কৈলা ‘ভাগবতামৃতে’ ।\\nভক্ত-ভক্তি-কৃষ্ণ-তত্ত্ব জানি যাহা হৈতে ॥২১৯॥
verses.transliteration: sanātana grantha kailā 'bhāgavatāmṛte'\\nbhakta-bhakti-kṛṣṇa-tattva jāni yāhā haite
verses.translation: Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī compiled the Bhāgavatāmṛta. From this book one can understand who is a devotee, what is the process of devotional service, and who is Kṛṣṇa, the Absolute Truth.

verses.devanagari: সিদ্ধান্তসার গ্রন্থ কৈলা ‘দশম-টিপ্পনী’ ।\\nকৃষ্ণলীলারস-প্রেম যাহা হৈতে জানি ॥২২০॥
verses.transliteration: siddhānta-sāra grantha kailā 'daśama-ṭippanī'\\nkṛṣṇa-līlā-rasa-prema yāhā haite jāni
verses.translation: Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī wrote a commentary on the Tenth Canto known as Daśama-ṭippanī, from which we can understand the transcendental pastimes and ecstatic love of Lord Kṛṣṇa.

verses.devanagari: ‘হরিভক্তিবিলাস’-গ্রন্থ কৈলা বৈষ্ণব-আচার ।\\nবৈষ্ণবের কর্তব্য যাহাঁ পাইয়ে পার ॥২২১॥
verses.transliteration: 'hari-bhakti-vilāsa'-grantha kailā vaiṣṇava-ācāra\\nvaiṣṇavera kartavya yāhāṅ pāiye pāra
verses.translation: He also compiled the Hari-bhakti-vilāsa, from which we can understand the standard behavior of a devotee and the full extent of a Vaiṣṇava's duty.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura writes: "The
Hari-bhakti-vilāsa
was originally compiled by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī. Later, Gopāla Bhaṭṭa Gosvāmī produced a shortened version of it and added the
Dig-darśinī-ṭīkā.
In the
Hari-bhakti-vilāsa
there are so many quotations from the
sātvata
scriptures that sometimes it is inquired how the atheistic
smārtas
can refuse to accept them and instead imagine some other opinions. What is recorded in the
Hari-bhakti-vilāsa
strictly follows the Vedic scriptures and is certainly pure, but the attitude of the
karmīs
is always one of giving up the conclusion of pure Vaiṣṇava understanding. Because the
karmīs
are very much attached to the world and material activities, they always try to establish atheistic principles that oppose the understanding of the Vaiṣṇavas.

verses.devanagari: আর যত গ্রন্থ কৈলা, তাহা কে করে গণন ।\\n‘মদনগোপাল-গোবিন্দের সেবা’-প্রকাশন ॥২২২॥
verses.transliteration: āra yata grantha kailā, tāhā ke kare gaṇana\\n'madana-gopāla-govindera sevā'-prakāśana
verses.translation: Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī also compiled many other books. Who can enumerate them? The basic principle of all these books is to show us how to love Madana-mohana and Govindajī.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
The
Bhakti-ratnākara
refers to the following books by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī: (1)
Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta,
(2)
Hari-bhakti-vilāsa
and his commentary known as
Dig-darśinī,
(3)
Līlā-stava
and (4) the commentary on the Tenth Canto of
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
known as
Vaiṣṇava-toṣaṇī.
Sanātana Gosvāmī compiled many, many books, all with the aim of describing how to serve the principal Deities of Vṛndāvana-Govinda and Madana-gopāla. Later, other Deities were gradually established, and the importance of Vṛndāvana increased.

verses.devanagari: রূপ-গোসাঞি কৈলা ‘রসামৃতসিন্ধু’ সার  ।\\nকৃষ্ণভক্তি-রসের যাহাঁ পাইয়ে বিস্তার ॥২২৩॥
verses.transliteration: rūpa-gosāñi kailā 'rasāmṛta-sindhu' sāra\\nkṛṣṇa-bhakti-rasera yāhāṅ pāiye vistāra
verses.translation: Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī also wrote many books, the most famous of which is Bhakti-rasāmṛta-sindhu. From that book one can understand the essence of devotional service to Kṛṣṇa and the transcendental mellow one can derive from such service.

verses.devanagari: ‘উজ্জ্বলনীলমণি’-নাম গ্রন্থ কৈল আর  ।\\nরাধাকৃষ্ণ-লীলারস তাহাঁ পাইয়ে পার ॥২২৪॥
verses.transliteration: 'ujjvala-nīlamaṇi'-nāma grantha kaila āra\\nrādhā-kṛṣṇa-līlā-rasa tāhāṅ pāiye pāra
verses.translation: Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī also compiled the book named Ujjvala-nīlamaṇi, from which one can understand, to the fullest limits, the loving affairs of Śrī Śrī Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa.

verses.devanagari: ‘বিদগ্ধমাধব’, ‘ললিতমাধব’, — নাটকযুগল ।\\nকৃষ্ণলীলা-রস তাহাঁ পাইয়ে সকল ॥২২৫॥
verses.transliteration: 'vidagdha-mādhava', 'lalita-mādhava,—nāṭaka-yuga la\\nkṛṣṇa-līlā-rasa tāhāṅ pāiye sakala
verses.translation: Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī also compiled two important dramas named Vidagdha-mādhava and Lalita-mādhava, from which one can understand all the mellows derived from the pastimes of Lord Kṛṣṇa.

verses.devanagari: ‘দানকেলিকৌমুদী’ আদি লক্ষগ্রন্থ কৈল ।\\nসেই সব গ্রন্থে ব্রজের রস বিচারিল ॥২২৬॥
verses.transliteration: 'dāna-keli-kaumudī' ādi lakṣa-grantha kaila\\nsei saba granthe vrajera rasa vicārila
verses.translation: Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī compiled 100,000 verses, beginning with the book Dāna-keli-kaumudī. In all these scriptures he elaborately explained the transcendental mellows of the activities of Vṛndāvana.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Referring to the words
lakṣa-grantha
("100,000 verses"), Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura says that the total number of verses written by Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī is 100,000 (
eka-lakṣa
or
lakṣa-grantha
). The copyists count both the verses and the prose sections of the Sanskrit works. One should not mistakenly think that Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī compiled 100,000 books. He actually wrote sixteen books, as mentioned in the First Wave of the
Bhakti-ratnākara
(
śrī-rūpa-gosvāmī grantha ṣoḍaśa karila
).

verses.devanagari: তাঁর লঘুভ্রাতা — শ্রীবল্লভ-অনুপম ।\\nতাঁর পুত্র মহাপণ্ডিত — জীবগোসাঞি নাম ॥২২৭॥
verses.transliteration: tāṅra laghu-bhrātā—śrī-vallabha-anupama\\ntāṅra putra mahā-paṇḍita—jīva-gosāñi nāma
verses.translation: The son of Śrī Vallabha, or Anupama, Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī's younger brother, was the great learned scholar named Śrīla Jīva Gosvāmī.

verses.devanagari: সর্ব ত্যজি’ তেঁহো পাছে আইলা বৃন্দাবন ।\\nতেঁহ ভক্তিশাস্ত্র বহু কৈলা প্রচারণ ॥২২৮॥
verses.transliteration: sarva tyāji' teṅho pāche āilā vṛndāvana\\nteṅha bhakti-śāstra bahu kailā pracāraṇa
verses.translation: After renouncing everything, Śrīla Jīva Gosvāmī went to Vṛndāvana. Later he also wrote many books on devotional service and expanded the work of preaching.

verses.devanagari: ‘ভাগবত-সন্দর্ভ’-নাম কৈল গ্রন্থ সার ।\\nভাগবত-সিদ্ধান্তের তাহাঁ পাইয়ে পার ॥২২৯॥
verses.transliteration: 'bhāgavata-sandarbha'-nāma kaila grantha-sāra\\nbhāgavata-siddhāntera tāhāṅ pāiye pāra
verses.translation: In particular, Śrīla Jīva Gosvāmī compiled the book named Bhāgavata-sandarbha, or Ṣaṭ-sandarbha, which is the essence of all scriptures. From this book one can obtain a conclusive understanding of devotional service and the Supreme Personality of Godhead.

verses.devanagari: ‘গোপাল-চম্পূ’ নাম গ্রন্থ সার কৈল ।\\nব্রজ-প্রেম-লীলা-রস-সার দেখাইল ॥২৩০॥
