verses.translation: When the Bengali poet heard this chastisement from Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī, he was ashamed, fearfuI and astonished. Indeed, being like a duck in a society of white swans, he could not say anything.

verses.devanagari: তার দুঃখ দেখি’ স্বরূপ সদয়-হৃদয়  ।\\nউপদেশ কৈলা তারে যৈছে ‘হিত’ হয় ॥১৩০॥
verses.transliteration: tāra duḥkha dekhi, svarūpa sadaya-hṛdaya\\nupadeśa kailā tāre yaiche 'hita' haya
verses.translation: Seeing the poet's unhappiness, Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī, who was naturally very kindhearted, advised him so that he could derive some benefit.

verses.devanagari: “যাহ, ভাগবত পড় বৈষ্ণবের স্থানে  ।\\nএকান্ত আশ্রয় কর চৈতন্য-চরণে ॥১৩১॥
verses.transliteration: "yāha, bhāgavata paḍa vaiṣṇavera sthāne\\nekānta āśraya kara caitanya-caraṇe
verses.translation: "If you want to understand\nŚrīmad-Bhāgavatam,\n" he said, "you must approach a self-realized Vaiṣṇava and hear from him. You can do this when you have completely taken shelter of the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Herein Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī instructs the poet from Bengal to hear
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
from a pure Vaiṣṇava and learn from him. In India especially, there is now a class of professional
Bhāgavatam
readers whose means of livelihood is to go from village to village, town to town, reading
Bhāgavatam
and collecting
dakṣiṇa,
or rewards, in the form of money or goods, like umbrellas, cloth and fruit. Thus there is now a system of
Bhāgavata
business, with recitations called
Bhāgavata-saptāha
that continue for one week, although this is not mentioned in
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam.
Nowhere does
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
say that the
Bhāgavatam
should be heard for one week from professionals. Rather,
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
(1.2.17) says:
śṛṇvatāṁ sva-kathāḥ kṛṣṇaḥ puṇya-śravaṇa-kīrtanaḥ.
One should regularly hear
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
from a self-realized Vaiṣṇava. By such hearing, one becomes pious.
Hṛdy antaḥstho hy abhadrāṇi vidhunoti suhṛt-satām.
As one thus hears the
Bhāgavatam
regularly and sincerely, his heart is purified of all material contamination.
naṣṭa-prāyeṣv abhadreṣu
nityaṁ bhāgavata-sevayā
bhagavaty uttama-śloke
bhaktir bhavati naiṣṭhikī
"As one regularly hears the
Bhāgavatam
or renders service unto the pure devotee, all that is troublesome to the heart is practically destroyed, and loving service unto the glorious Lord, who is praised with transcendental songs, is established as an irrevocable fact." (Bhāg. 1.2.18)
This is the proper process, but people are accustomed to being misled by professional
Bhāgavatam
reciters. Therefore Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī herein advises that one should not hear
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
from professional reciters. Instead, one must hear and learn the
Bhāgavatam
from a self-realized Vaiṣṇava. Sometimes it is seen that when a Māyāvādī
sannyāsī
reads the
Bhāgavatam,
flocks of men go to hear jugglery of words that cannot awaken their dormant love for Kṛṣṇa. Sometimes people go to see professional dramas and offer food and money to the players, who are expert at collecting these offerings very nicely. The result is that the members of the audience remain in the same position of
gṛham andha-kūpam,
family affection, and do not awaken their love for Kṛṣṇa.
In the
Bhāgavatam
(7.5.30), it is said,
matir na kṛṣṇe parataḥ svato vā mitho 'bhipadyeta gṛha-vratānām:
the
gṛhavratas,
those who are determined to continue following the materialistic way of life, will never awaken their dormant love of Kṛṣṇa, fur they hear the
Bhāgavatam
only to solidify their position in household life and to be happy in family affairs and sex. Condemning this process of hearing the
Bhāgavatam
from professionals, Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī says,
yāha, bhāgavata paḍa vaiṣṇavera sthāne:
"To understand the
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam,
you must approach a self-realized Vaiṣṇava." One should rigidly avoid hearing the
Bhāgavatam
from a Māyāvādī or other nondevotee who simply performs a grammatical jugglery of words to twist some meaning from the text, collect money from the innocent public, and thus keep people in darkness.
Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī strictly prohibits the behavior of the materialistic so-called hearers of
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam.
Instead of awakening real love for Kṛṣṇa, such hearers of the
Bhāgavatam
become more and more attached to household affairs and sex life (
yan maithunādi-gṛhamedhi-sukhaṁ hi tuccham
). One should hear
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
from a person who has no connection with material activities, or, in other words, from a
paramahaṁsa
Vaiṣṇava, one who has achieved the highest stage of
sannyāsa.
This, of course, is not possible unless one takes shelter of the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. The
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
is understandable only for one who can follow in the footsteps of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: চৈতন্যের ভক্তগণের নিত্য কর ‘সঙ্গ’ ।\\nতবেত জানিবা সিদ্ধান্তসমুদ্র-তরঙ্গ ॥১৩২॥
verses.transliteration: caitanyera bhakta-gaṇera nitya kara 'saṅga'\\ntabeta jānibā siddhānta-samudra-taraṅga
verses.translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara continued, "Associate regularly with the devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, for then only will you understand the waves of the ocean of devotional service.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
It is clearly to be understood in this connection that the followers of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's way of devotional service are eternally associates of the Supreme Personality of Godhead and perfect knowers of the Absolute Truth. If one immediately follows the principles of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu by associating with His devotees, lusty desires for material enjoyment will vanish from one's heart. Then one will be able to understand the meaning of
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
and the purpose of listening to it. Otherwise such understanding is impossible.

verses.devanagari: তবেত পাণ্ডিত্য তোমার হইবে সফল ।\\nকৃষ্ণের স্বরূপ-লীলা বর্ণিবা নির্মল ॥১৩৩॥
verses.transliteration: tabeta pāṇḍitya tomāra ha-ibe saphala\\nkṛṣṇera svarūpa-līlā varṇibā nirmala
verses.translation: "Only if you follow the principles of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and His devotees will your learning be successful. Then you will be able to write about the transcendental pastimes of Kṛṣṇa without material contamination.

verses.devanagari: এই শ্লোক করিয়াছ পাঞা সন্তোষ ।\\nতোমার হৃদয়ের অর্থে দুঁহায় লাগে ‘দোষ’ ॥১৩৪॥
verses.transliteration: ei śloka kariyācha pāñā santoṣa\\ntomāra hṛdayera arthe duṅhāya lāge 'doṣa'
verses.translation: "You have composed this introductory verse to your great satisfaction, but the meaning you have expressed is contaminated by offenses to both Lord Jagannātha and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: তুমি যৈছে-তৈছে কহ, না জানিয়া রীতি ।\\nসরস্বতী সেই-শব্দে করিয়াছে স্তুতি ॥১৩৫॥
verses.transliteration: tumi yaiche-taiche kaha, nā jāniyā rīti\\nsarasvatī sei-śabde kariyāche stuti
verses.translation: "You have written something irregular, not knowing the regulative principles, but the goddess of learning, Sarasvatī, has used your words to offer her prayers to the Supreme Lord.
verses.purport: PURPORT\nSvarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī informed the Bengali poet, "Because of your ignorance and your leaning toward Māyāvāda philosophy, you cannot distinguish the difference between the Māyāvāda and Vaiṣṇava philosophies. Therefore the process you have adopted to praise Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and Lord Jagannātha does not follow the proper system; indeed, it is irregular and offensive. Fortunately, however, through your words, the goddess of learning, mother Sarasvatī, has tactfully offered her prayers to her master, Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu."

verses.devanagari: যৈছে ইন্দ্র, দৈত্যাদি করে কৃষ্ণের ভর্ৎসন ।\\nসেইশব্দে সরস্বতী করেন স্তবন ॥১৩৬॥
verses.transliteration: yaiche indra, daityādi kare kṛṣṇera bhartsana\\nsei-śabde sarasvatī karena stavana
verses.translation: "Sometimes demons, and even Lord Indra, the King of heaven, chastised Kṛṣṇa, but mother Sarasvatī, taking advantage of their words, offered prayers to the Lord.

verses.devanagari: বাচালং বালিশং স্তব্ধমজ্ঞং পণ্ডিতমানিনম্ ।\\nকৃষ্ণং মর্ত্যমুপাশ্রিত্য গোপা মে চক্রুরপ্রিয়ম্ ॥১৩৭॥
verses.transliteration: vācālaṁ bāliśaṁ stabdhaṁ\\najñaṁ paṇḍita-māninam\\nkṛṣṇaṁ martyam upāśritya\\ngopā me cakrur apriyam
verses.translation: "[Lord Indra said:] 'This Kṛṣṇa, who is an ordinary human being, is talkative, childish, impudent and ignorant, although He thinks Himself very learned. The cowherd men in Vṛndāvana have offended me by accepting Him. This has not been greatly appreciated by me.'
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This verse is from
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
(10.25.5).

verses.devanagari: ঐশ্বর্য-মদে মত্ত ইন্দ্র, — যেন মাতোয়াল ।\\nবুদ্ধিনাশ হৈল, কেবল নাহিক সাম্ভাল ॥১৩৮॥
verses.transliteration: aiśvarya-made matta indra,—yena mātoyāla\\nbuddhi-nāśa haila, kevala nāhika sāmbhāla
verses.translation: "Indra, the King of heaven, being too proud of his heavenly opulences, became like a madman. Thus bereft of his intelligence, he could not restrain himself from speaking nonsensically about Kṛṣṇa.

verses.devanagari: ইন্দ্র বলে, — “মুঞি কৃষ্ণের করিয়াছি নিন্দন ।”\\nতারই মুখে সরস্বতী করেন স্তবন ॥১৩৯॥
verses.transliteration: indra bale,—"muñi kṛṣṇera kariyāchi nindana"\\ntāra-i mukhe sarasvatī karena stavana
verses.translation: "Thus Indra thought, 'I have properly chastised Kṛṣṇa and defamed Him.' But Sarasvatī, the goddess of learning, took this opportunity to offer prayers to Kṛṣṇa.

verses.devanagari: ‘বাচাল’ কহিয়ে — ‘বেদপ্রবর্তক’ ধন্য ।\\n‘বালিশ’ — তথাপি ‘শিশু-প্রায়’ গর্বশূন্য ॥১৪০॥
verses.transliteration: 'vācāla kahiye—'veda-pravartaka' dhanya\\n'bāliśa'—tathāpi 'śiśu-prāya' garva-śūnya
verses.translation: "The word 'vācāla' is used to refer to a person who can speak according to Vedic authority, and the word 'bāliśa' means 'innocent.' Kṛṣṇa spoke the Vedic knowledge, yet He always presents Himself as a prideless, innocent boy.

verses.devanagari: বন্দ্যাভাবে ‘অনম্র’ — ‘স্তব্ধ’-শব্দে কয় ।\\nযাহা হৈতে অন্য ‘বিজ্ঞ’ নাহি — সে ‘অজ্ঞ’ হয় ॥১৪১॥
verses.transliteration: vandyābhāve 'anamra'—'stabdha'-śabde kaya\\nyāhā haite anya 'vijña' nāhi—se 'ajña' haya
verses.translation: "When there is no one else to receive obeisances, one may be called 'anamra,' or one who offers obeisances to no one. This is the meaning of the word 'stabdha.' And because no one is found to be more learned than Kṛṣṇa, He may be called 'ajña,' indicating that nothing is unknown to Him.

verses.devanagari: ‘পণ্ডিতের মান্য-পাত্র হয় ‘পণ্ডিতমানী’ ।\\nতথাপি ভক্তবাৎসল্যে ‘মনুষ্য’ অভিমানী ॥১৪২॥
verses.transliteration: 'paṇḍitera mānya-pātra—haya 'paṇḍita-mānī'\\ntathāpi bhakta-vātsalye 'manuṣya' abhimānī
verses.translation: "The word 'paṇḍita-mānī' can be used to indicate that Kṛṣṇa is honored even by learned scholars. Nevertheless, because of affection for His devotees, Kṛṣṇa appears like an ordinary human being and may therefore be called 'martya.'

verses.devanagari: জরাসন্ধ কহে, — “কৃষ্ণ — পুরুষ-অধম ।\\nতোর সঙ্গে না যুঝিমু, “যাহি বন্ধুহন্” ॥১৪৩॥
verses.transliteration: jarāsandha kahe,—"kṛṣṇa—puruṣa-adhama\\ntora saṅge nā yujhimu, "yāhi bandhu-han"
verses.translation: "The demon Jarāsandha chastised Kṛṣṇa, saying, 'You are the lowest of human beings. I shall not fight with You, for You killed Your own relatives.'
verses.purport:
PURPORT
In this verse also, mother Sarasvatī offers prayers to Kṛṣṇa. The word
puruṣa-adhama
refers to the Personality of Godhead, under whom all other persons remain, or, in other words,
puruṣa-uttama,
the best of all living beings. Similarly, the word
bandhu-han
means "the killer of māyā." In the conditioned state of life, one is closely related with
māyā
as a friend, but when one comes in contact with Kṛṣṇa one is freed from that relationship.

verses.devanagari: যাহা হৈতে অন্য পুরুষসকল — ‘অধম’ ।\\nসেই হয় ‘পুরুষাধম’ — সরস্বতীর মন ॥১৪৪॥
verses.transliteration: yāhā haite anya puruṣa-sakala—'adhama'\\nsei haya 'puruṣādhama'—sarasvatīra mana
verses.translation: "Mother Sarasvatī takes 'puruṣādhama' to mean 'puruṣottama,' He to whom all men are subordinate.

verses.devanagari: ‘বান্ধে সবারে’ — তাতে অবিদ্যা ‘বন্ধু’ হয় ।\\n‘অবিদ্যা-নাশক’ — ‘বন্ধুহন্’-শব্দে কয় ॥১৪৫॥
verses.transliteration: 'bāndhe sabāre'—tāte avidyā 'bandhu' haya\\n'avidyā-nāśaka'—'bandhu-han'-śabde kaya
verses.translation: "Nescience, or māyā, may be called 'bandhu' because she entangles everyone in the material world. Therefore by using the word 'bandhu-han,' mother Sarasvatī says that Lord Kṛṣṇa is the vanquisher of māyā.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Everyone is entangled in the illusory energy, but as stated in
Bhagavad-gītā, mām eva ye prapadyante māyām etāṁ taranti te:
as soon as one surrenders to Kṛṣṇa, he is freed from
māyā.
Therefore Kṛṣṇa may be called
bandhu-han,
the killer of
māyā.

verses.devanagari: এইমত শিশুপাল করিল নিন্দন ।\\nসেইবাক্যে সরস্বতী করেন স্তবন ॥১৪৬॥
verses.transliteration: ei-mata śiśupāla karila nindana\\nsei-vākye sarasvatī karena stavana
verses.translation: "Śiśupāla also blasphemed Kṛṣṇa in this way, but the goddess of learning, Sarasvatī, offered her prayers to Kṛṣṇa even by his words.

verses.devanagari: তৈছে এই শ্লোকে তোমার অর্থে ‘নিন্দা’ আইসে ।\\nসরস্বতীর অর্থ শুন, যাতে ‘স্তুতি’ ভাসে ॥১৪৭॥
verses.transliteration: taiche ei śloke tomāra arthe 'nindā' āise\\nsarasvatīra artha śuna, yāte 'stuti' bhāse
verses.translation: "In that way, although your verse is blasphemous according to your meaning, mother Sarasvatī has taken advantage of it to offer prayers to the Lord.

verses.devanagari: জগন্নাথ হন কৃষ্ণের ‘আত্মস্বরূপ’ ।\\nকিন্তু ইহাঁ দারুব্রহ্ম — স্থাবর-স্বরূপ ॥১৪৮॥
verses.transliteration: jagannātha hana kṛṣṇera 'ātma-svarupa'\\nkintu ihāṅ dāru-brahma—sthāvara-svarūpa
verses.translation: "There is no difference between Lord Jagannātha and Kṛṣṇa, but here Lord Jagannātha is fixed as the Absolute Person appearing in wood. Therefore He does not move.

verses.devanagari: তাঁহা-সহ আত্মতা একরূপ হঞা ।\\nকৃষ্ণ একতত্ত্বরূপ — দুই রূপ হঞা ॥১৪৯॥
verses.transliteration: tāṅhā-saha ātmatā eka-rūpa hañā\\nkṛṣṇa eka-tattva-rūpa—dui rūpa hañā
verses.translation: "Thus Lord Jagannātha and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, although appearing as two, are one because They are both Kṛṣṇa, who is one alone.

verses.devanagari: সংসারতারণ-হেতু যেই ইচ্ছা-শক্তি ।\\nতাহার মিলন করি’ একতা যৈছে প্রাপ্তি ॥১৫০॥
verses.transliteration: saṁsāra-tāraṇa-hetu yei icchā-śakti\\ntāhāra milana kari' ekatā yaiche prāpti
verses.translation: "The supreme desire to deliver the entire world meets in both of Them, and for that reason also They are one and the same.

verses.devanagari: সকল সংসারী লোকের করিতে উদ্ধার ।\\nগৌর-জঙ্গম রূপে কৈলা অবতার ॥১৫১॥
verses.transliteration: sakala saṁsārī lokera karite uddhāra\\ngaura-jaṅgama-rūpe kailā avatāra
verses.translation: "To deliver all the materially contaminated people of the world, that same Kṛṣṇa has descended, moving as Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: জগন্নাথের দর্শনে খণ্ডায় সংসার ।\\nসব-দেশের সব-লোক নারে আসিবার ॥১৫২॥
verses.transliteration: jagannāthera darśane khaṇḍāya saṁsāra\\nsaba-deśera saba-loka nāre āsibāra
verses.translation: "By visiting Lord Jagannātha one is freed from material existence, but not all men of all countries can come or be admitted here in Jagannātha Purī.

verses.devanagari: শ্রীকৃষ্ণচৈতন্যপ্রভু দেশে দেশে যাঞা ।\\nসব-লোকে নিস্তারিলা জঙ্গম-ব্রহ্ম হঞা ॥১৫৩॥
verses.transliteration: śrī-kṛṣṇa-caitanya-prabhu deśe deśe yāñā\\nsaba-loke nistārilā jaṅgama-brahma hañā
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, however, moves from one country to another, personally or by His representative. Thus He, as the moving Brahman, delivers all the people of the world.

verses.devanagari: সরস্বতীর অর্থ এই কহিলুঁ বিবরণ ।\\nএহো ভাগ্য তোমার ঐছে করিলে বর্ণন ॥১৫৪॥
verses.transliteration: sarasvatīra artha ei kahiluṅ vivaraṇa\\neho bhāgya tomāra aiche karile varṇana
verses.translation: "Thus I have explained the meaning intended by mother Sarasvatī, the goddess of learning. It is your great fortune that you have described Lord Jagannātha and Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu in that way.

verses.devanagari: কৃষ্ণে গালি দিতে করে নাম উচ্চারণ ।\\nসেই নাম হয় তার ‘মুক্তির’ কারণ ।।” ॥ ১৫৫ ॥
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇe gāli dite kare nāma uccāraṇa\\nsei nāma haya tāra 'muktira' kāraṇa"
verses.translation: "Sometimes it so happens that one who wants to chastise Kṛṣṇa utters the holy name, and thus the holy name becomes the cause of his liberation."

verses.devanagari: তবে সেই কবি সবার চরণে পড়িয়া ।\\nসবার শরণ লৈল দন্তে তৃণ লঞা ॥১৫৬॥
verses.transliteration: tabe sei kavi sabāra caraṇe paḍiyā\\nsabāra śaraṇa laila dante tṛṇa lañā
verses.translation: Upon hearing this proper explanation by Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī, the Bengali poet fell down at the feet of all the devotees and took shelter of them with a straw in his mouth.

verses.devanagari: তবে সব ভক্ত তারে অঙ্গীকার কৈলা ।\\nতার গুণ কহি’ মহাপ্রভুরে মিলাইলা ॥১৫৭॥
verses.transliteration: tabe saba bhakta tāre aṅgīkāra kailā\\ntāra guṇa kahi' mahāprabhure milāilā
verses.translation: Thereupon all the devotees accepted his association. Explaining his humble behavior, they introduced him to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: সেই কবি সর্ব ত্যজি’ রহিলা নীলাচলে ।\\nগৌরভক্তগণের কৃপা কে কহিতে পারে ? ॥ ১৫৮ ॥
verses.transliteration: sei kavi sarva tyaji' rahilā nīlācale\\ngaura-bhakta-gaṇera kṛpā ke kahite pāre?
verses.translation: By the mercy of the devotees of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, that poet from Bengal gave up all other activities and stayed with them at Jagannātha Purī. Who can explain the mercy of the devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu?

verses.devanagari: এই ত’ কহিলুঁ প্রদ্যুম্নমিশ্র-বিবরণ ।\\nপ্রভুর আজ্ঞায় কৈল কৃষ্ণকথার শ্রবণ ॥১৫৯॥
verses.transliteration: ei ta' kahiluṅ pradyumna-miśra-vivaraṇa\\nprabhura ājñāya kaila kṛṣṇa-kathāra śravaṇa
verses.translation: I have thus described the narration concerning Pradyumna Miśra and how, following the order of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, he listened to discourses about Kṛṣṇa spoken by Rāmānanda Rāya.

verses.devanagari: তার মধ্যে কহিলুঁ রামানন্দের মহিমা ।\\nআপনে শ্রীমুখে প্রভু বর্ণে যাঁর সীমা ॥১৬০॥
verses.transliteration: tāra madhye kahiluṅ rāmānandera mahimā\\nāpane śrī-mukhe prabhu varṇe yāṅra sīmā
verses.translation: Within the narration I have explained the glorious characteristics of Śrī Rāmānanda Rāya, through whom Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu personally described the limits of ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa.

verses.devanagari: প্রস্তাবে কহিলুঁ কবির নাটক-বিবরণ ।\\nঅজ্ঞ হঞা শ্রদ্ধায় পাইল প্রভুর চরণ ॥১৬১॥
verses.transliteration: prastāve kahiluṅ kavira nāṭaka-vivaraṇa\\najña hañā śraddhāya pāila prabhura caraṇa
verses.translation: In the course of the narration, I have also told about the drama by the poet from Bengal. Although he was ignorant, because of his faith and humility he nevertheless obtained the shelter of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: শ্রীকৃষ্ণচৈতন্য-লীলা — অমৃতের সার ।\\nএকলীলা-প্রবাহে বহে শত-শত ধার ॥১৬২॥
verses.transliteration: śrī-kṛṣṇa-caitanya-līlā—amṛtera sāra\\neka-līlā-pravāhe vahe śata-śata dhāra
verses.translation: The pastimes of Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya Mahāprabhu are the essence of nectar. From the stream of one of His pastimes flow hundreds and thousands of branches.

verses.devanagari: শ্রদ্ধা করি’ এই লীলা যেই পড়ে শুনে ।\\nগৌরলীলা, ভক্তি-ভক্ত-রস-তত্ত্ব জানে ॥১৬৩॥
verses.transliteration: śraddhā kari' ei līlā yei paḍe, śune\\ngaura-līlā, bhakti-bhakta-rasa-tattva jāne
verses.translation: Anyone who reads and hears these pastimes with faith and love can understand the truth about devotional service, devotees and the transcendental mellows of the pastimes of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: শ্রীরূপ-রঘুনাথ-পদে যার আশ ।\\nচৈতন্যচরিতামৃত কহে কৃষ্ণদাস ॥১৬৪॥
verses.transliteration: śrī-rūpa-raghunātha-pade yāra āśa\\ncaitanya-caritāmṛta kahe kṛṣṇadāsa
verses.translation: Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.
verses.purport: PURPORT\nThus end the Bhaktivedanta purports to Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā,  Fifth Chapter, describing how Pradyumna Miśra received instructions from Rāmānanda Rāya.

sections.title: Chapter 6: The Meeting of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī

verses.devanagari: কৃপাগুণৈর্যঃ কুগৃহান্ধকূপা-\\nদুদ্ধৃত্য ভঙ্গ্যা রঘুনাথদাসম্ ।\\nন্যস্য স্বরূপে বিদধেঽন্তরঙ্গং\\nশ্রীকৃষ্ণচৈতন্যমমুং প্রপদ্যে ॥১॥
verses.transliteration: kṛpā-guṇair yaḥ kugṛhāndha-kūpād\\nuddhṛtya bhaṅgyā raghunātha-dāsam\\nnyasya svarūpe vidadhe 'ntaraṅgaṁ-\\nśrī-kṛṣṇa-caitanyam amuṁ prapadye
verses.translation: With the ropes of His causeless mercy, Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya Mahāprabhu employed a trick to deliver Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī from the blind well of contemptible family life. He made Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī one of His personal associates, placing him under the charge of Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī. I offer my obeisances unto Him.

verses.devanagari: জয় জয় শ্রীচৈতন্য জয় নিত্যানন্দ ।\\nজয়াদ্বৈতচন্দ্র জয় গৌরভক্তবৃন্দ ॥২॥
verses.transliteration: jaya jaya śrī-caitanya, jaya nityānanda\\njayādvaita-candra, jaya gaura-bhakta-vṛnda
verses.translation: All glory to Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu! All glory to Lord Nityānanda! All glory to Śrī Advaita Ācārya! And all glory to all the devotees of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu!

verses.devanagari: এইমত গৌরচন্দ্র ভক্তগণ-সঙ্গে ।\\nনীলাচলে নানা লীলা করে নানা-রঙ্গে ॥৩॥
verses.transliteration: ei-mata gauracandra bhakta-gaṇa-saṅge\\nnīlācale nānā līlā kare nānā-raṅge
verses.translation: Thus Lord Gauracandra performed various pastimes with His associates at Jagannātha Purī in varieties of transcendental pleasure.

verses.devanagari: যদ্যপি অন্তরে কৃষ্ণ-বিয়োগ বাধয়ে ।\\nবাহিরে না প্রকাশয় ভক্ত-দুঃখ-ভয়ে ॥৪॥
verses.transliteration: yadyapi antare kṛṣṇa-viyoga bādha ye\\nbāhire nā prakāśaya bhakta-duḥkha-bhaye
verses.translation: Although Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu felt pangs of separation from Kṛṣṇa, He did not manifest His feelings externally, for He feared the unhappiness of His devotees.

verses.devanagari: উৎকট বিরহ-দুঃখ যবে বাহিরায় ।\\nতবে যে বৈকল্য প্রভুর বর্ণন না যায় ॥৫॥
verses.transliteration: utkaṭa viraha-duḥkha yabe bāhirāya\\ntabe ye vaikalya prabhura varṇana nā yāya
verses.translation: The transformations undergone by the Lord when He manifested severe unhappiness due to separation from Kṛṣṇa cannot be described.

verses.devanagari: রামানন্দের কৃষ্ণকথা, স্বরূপের গান ।\\nবিরহ-বেদনায় প্রভুর রাখয়ে পরাণ ॥৬॥
verses.transliteration: rāmānandera kṛṣṇa-kathā, svarūpera gāna\\nviraha-vedanāya prabhura rākhaye parāṇa
verses.translation: When the Lord acutely felt pangs of separation from Kṛṣṇa, only Śrī Rāma-nanda Rāya's talk about Kṛṣṇa and the sweet songs of Svarūpa Dāmodara kept Him alive.

verses.devanagari: দিনে প্রভু নানা-সঙ্গে হয় অন্য মন ।\\nরাত্রিকালে বাড়ে প্রভুর বিরহ-বেদন ॥৭॥
verses.transliteration: dine prabhu nānā-saṅge haya anya mana\\nrātri-kāle bāḍe prabhura viraha-vedana
verses.translation: Because the Lord associated with various devotees during the day, His mind was somewhat diverted, but at night the pangs of separation from Kṛṣṇa increased very rapidly.

verses.devanagari: তাঁর সুখ-হেতু সঙ্গে রহে দুই জনা ।\\nকৃষ্ণরস-শ্লোক-গীতে করেন সান্ত্বনা ॥৮॥
verses.transliteration: tāṅra sukha-hetu saṅge rahe dui janā\\nkṛṣṇa-rasa-śloka-gīte karena sāntvanā
verses.translation: Two people—Rāmānanda Rāya and Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī—stayed with the Lord to pacify Him by reciting various verses about Kṛṣṇa's pastimes and by singing appropriate songs for His satisfaction.

verses.devanagari: সুবল যৈছে পূর্বে কৃষ্ণসুখের সহায় ।\\nগৌরসুখদান-হেতু তৈছে রাম-রায় ॥৯॥
verses.transliteration: subala yaiche pūrve kṛṣṇa-sukhera sahāya\\ngaura-sukha-dāna-hetu taiche rāma-rāya
verses.translation: Previously, when Lord Kṛṣṇa was personally present, Subala, one of His cowherd boy friends, gave Him happiness when He felt separation from Rādhārāṇī. Similarly, Rāmānanda Rāya helped give happiness to Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: পূর্বে যৈছে রাধার ললিতা সহায়-প্রধান ।\\nতৈছে স্বরূপ-গোসাঞি রাখে মহাপ্রভুর প্রাণ ॥১০॥
verses.transliteration: pūrve yaiche rādhāra lalitā sahāya-pradhāna\\ntaiche svarūpa-gosāñi rākhe mahāprabhura prāṇa
verses.translation: Previously, when Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī felt the pangs of separation from Kṛṣṇa, Her constant companion Lalitā kept Her alive by helping Her in many ways. Similarly, when Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu felt Rādhārāṇī's emotions, Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī helped Him maintain His life.

verses.devanagari: এই দুই জনার সৌভাগ্য কহন না যায় ।\\nপ্রভুর ‘অন্তরঙ্গ’ বলি’ যাঁরে লোকে গায় ॥১১॥
verses.transliteration: ei dui janāra saubhāgya kahana nā yāya\\nprabhura 'antaraṅga' bali' yāṅre loke gāya
verses.translation: To describe the fortunate position of Rāmānanda Rāya and Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī is extremely difficult. They were renowned as intimately confidential friends of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: এইমত বিহরে গৌর লঞা ভক্তগণ ।\\nরঘুনাথ-মিলন এবে শুন, ভক্তগণ ॥১২॥
verses.transliteration: ei-mata vihare gaura lañā bhakta-gaṇa\\nraghunātha-milana ebe śuna, bhakta-gaṇa
verses.translation: The Lord thus enjoyed His life with His devotees. O devotees of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, now hear how Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī met the Lord.

verses.devanagari: পূর্বে শান্তিপুরে রঘুনাথ যবে আইলা ।\\nমহাপ্রভু কৃপা করি’ তাঁরে শিখাইলা ॥১৩॥
verses.transliteration: pūrve śāntipure raghunātha yabe āilā\\nmahāprabhu kṛpā kari' tāṅre śikhāilā
verses.translation: When Raghunātha dāsa, during his family life, went to meet Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu at Śāntipura, the Lord gave him worthy instructions by His causeless mercy.

verses.devanagari: প্রভুর শিক্ষাতে তেঁহো নিজ-ঘরে যায় ।\\nমর্কট-বৈরাগ্য ছাড়ি’ হৈলা ‘বিষয়ি-প্রায়’ ॥১৪॥
verses.transliteration: prabhura śikṣāte teṅho nija-ghare yāya\\nmarkaṭa-vairāgya chāḍi' hailā 'viṣayi-prāya'
verses.translation: Instead of becoming a so-called renunciate, Raghunātha dāsa, foIlowing the instructions of the Lord, returned home and played exactly like a pounds-and-shillings man.

verses.devanagari: ভিতরে বৈরাগ্য, বাহিরে করে সর্ব-কর্ম ।\\nদেখিয়া ত’ মাতা-পিতার আনন্দিত মন ॥১৫॥
verses.transliteration: bhitare vairāgya, bāhire kare sarva-karma\\ndekhiyā ta' mātā-pitāra ānandita mana
verses.translation: Raghunātha dāsa was inwardly completely renounced, even in family life, but he did not express his renunciation externally. Instead, he acted just like an ordinary businessman. Seeing this, his father and mother were satisfied.

verses.devanagari: ‘মথুরা হৈতে প্রভু আইলা’, — বার্তা যবে পাইলা ।\\nপ্রভু-পাশ চলিবারে উদ্যোগ করিলা ॥১৬॥
verses.transliteration: 'mathurā haite prabhu āilā',—vārtā yabe pāilā\\nprabhu-pāśa calibāre udyoga karilā
verses.translation: When he received a message that Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had returned from Mathurā City, Raghunātha dāsa endeavored to go to the lotus feet of the Lord.

verses.devanagari: হেন-কালে মুলুকের এক ম্লেচ্ছ অধিকারী ।\\nসপ্তগ্রাম-মুলুকের সে হয় ‘চৌধুরী’ ॥১৭॥
verses.transliteration: hena-kāle mulukera eka mleccha adhikārī\\nsaptagrāma-mulukera se haya 'caudhurī'
verses.translation: At that time there was a Mohammedan official collecting the taxes of Saptagrāma.
verses.purport: PURPORT\nFormerly, when the Mohammedan government was in power, the person appointed tax collector would collect the taxes of the local Zamindars, or landholders. He would keep one-fourth of the collection for himself as a profit, and the balance he would deliver to the treasury of the government.

verses.devanagari: হিরণ্যদাস মুলুক নিল ‘মক্ররি’ করিয়া ।\\nতার অধিকার গেল, মরে সে দেখিয়া ॥১৮॥
verses.transliteration: hiraṇya-dāsa muluka nila 'makrari' kariyā\\ntāra adhikāra gela, mare se dekhiyā
verses.translation: When Hiraṇya dāsa, Raghunātha dāsa's uncle, made an agreement with the government to collect taxes, the Mohammedan caudhurī, or tax collector, having lost his position, became extremely envious of him.

verses.devanagari: বার লক্ষ দেয় রাজায়, সাধে বিশ লক্ষ ।\\nসে ‘তুরুক্’ কিছু না পাঞা হৈল প্রতিপক্ষ ॥১৯॥
verses.transliteration: bāra lakṣa deya rājāya, sādhe biśa lakṣa\\nse 'turuk' kichu nā pāñā haila pratipakṣa
verses.translation: Hiraṇya dāsa was collecting 2,000,000 coins and therefore should have delivered 1,500,000 to the government. Instead, he was giving only 1,200,000, thus making an extra profit of 300,000 coins. Seeing this, the Mohammedan caudhurī, who was a Turk, became his rival.

verses.devanagari: রাজ-ঘরে কৈফিয়ৎ দিয়া উজীরে আনিল ।\\nহিরণ্যদাস পলাইল, রঘুনাথেরে বান্ধিল ॥২০॥
verses.transliteration: rāja-ghare kaiphiyat diyā ujīre ānila\\nhiraṇya-dāsa palāila, raghunāthere bāndhila
verses.translation: After sending a confidential account to the government treasury, the caudhurī brought the minister in charge. The caudhurī came, wanting to arrest Hiraṇya dāsa, but Hiraṇya dāsa had left home. Therefore the caudhurī arrested Raghunātha dāsa.

verses.devanagari: প্রতিদিন রঘুনাথে করয়ে ভর্ৎসনা ।\\n‘বাপ-জ্যেঠারে আন’, নহে পাইবা যাতনা ॥২১॥
verses.transliteration: prati-dina raghunāthe karaye bhartsanā\\n'bāpa-jyeṭhāre āna;, nahe pāibā yātanā
verses.translation: Every day, the Mohammedan would chastise Raghunātha dāsa and tell him, "Bring your father and his elder brother. Otherwise you will be punished."

verses.devanagari: মারিতে আনয়ে যদি দেখে রঘুনাথে ।\\nমন ফিরি’ যায়, তবে না পারে মারিতে ॥২২॥
verses.transliteration: mārite ānaye yadi dekhe raghunāthe\\nmana phiri' yāya, tabe nā pāre mārite
verses.translation: The caudhurī wanted to beat him, but as soon as he saw Raghunātha's face, his mind changed, and he could not beat him.

verses.devanagari: বিশেষে কায়স্থ-বুদ্ধ্যে অন্তরে করে ডর ।\\nমুখে তর্জে গর্জে, মারিতে সভয় অন্তর ॥২৩॥
verses.transliteration: viśeṣe kāyastha-buddhye antare kare ḍara\\nmukhe tarje garje, mārite sabhaya antara
verses.translation: Indeed, the caudhurī was afraid of Raghunātha dāsa because Raghunātha dāsa belong to the kāyastha community. Although the caudhurī would chastise him with oral vibrations, he was afraid to beat him.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Raghunātha dāsa belonged to a very aristocratic family of the
kāyastha
community. He had substantial influence with the local people, and therefore the
caudhurī,
or minister, was afraid to beat him. Superficially he would chastise Raghunātha dāsa with threatening vibrations, but he did not beat him. The members of the
kāyastha
community in India are generally very intelligent and expert in business management. Formerly they were mostly government officers. They were mentioned even by Yājñavalkya, as quoted by Śrīla Bhaktivinoda Ṭhākura in his
Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya:
cāta-taṣkara-durvṛttair
mahā-sāhasikādibhiḥ
pīḍyamānā prajā rakṣet
kāyasthaiś ca viśeṣṭaḥ
From this verse it appears that the governmental officials of the
kāyastha
community would sometimes chastise the citizens, and thus it was the duty of the king to protect the people in general from the atrocities of the
kāyasthas.
In Bengal the
kāyastha
community is honored almost as much as the
brāhmaṇa
community, but in the up-country of India the
kāyasthas
are considered
śūdras
because they generally eat meat and drink wine. In any case, from history the
kāyasthas
appear very intelligent. Thus the Mohammedan
caudhurī
was afraid of Raghunātha dāsa because he belonged to the
kāyastha
community.

verses.devanagari: তবে রঘুনাথ কিছু চিন্তিলা উপায়  ।\\nবিনতি করিয়া কহে সেই ম্লেচ্ছ-পায় ॥২৪॥
verses.transliteration: tabe raghunātha kichu cintilā upāya\\nvinati kariyā kahe sei mleccha-pāya
verses.translation: While this was going on, Raghunātha dāsa thought of a tricky method of escape. Thus he humbly submitted this plea at the feet of the Mohammedan caudhurī.

verses.devanagari: “আমার পিতা, জ্যেঠা হয় তোমার দুই ভাই  ।\\nভাই-ভাইয়ে তোমরা কলহ কর সর্বদাই ॥২৫॥
verses.transliteration: "āmāra pitā, jyeṭhā haya tomāra dui bhāi\\nbhāi-bhāiye tomarā kalaha kara sarvadāi
verses.translation: "My dear sir, my father and his elder brother are both your brothers. All brothers always fight about something.

verses.devanagari: কভু কলহ, কভু প্রীতি — ইহার নিশ্চয় নাই  ।\\nকালি পুনঃ তিন ভাই হইবা এক-ঠাঞি ॥২৬॥
verses.transliteration: kabhu kalaha, kabhu prīti—ihāra niścaya nāi\\nkāli punaḥ tina bhāi ha-ibā eka-ṭhāñi
verses.translation: "Sometimes brothers fight among themselves, and sometimes they have very friendly dealings. There is no certainty when such changes will take place. Thus I am sure that although today you are fighting, tomorrow you three brothers will be sitting together in peace.

verses.devanagari: আমি যৈছে পিতার, তৈছে তোমার বালক  ।\\nআমি তোমার পাল্য, তুমি আমার পালক ॥২৭॥
verses.transliteration: āmi yaiche pitāra, taiche tomāra bālaka\\nāmi tomāra pālya, tumi āmāra pālaka
verses.translation: "Just as I am my father's son, so I am also yours. I am your dependent, and you are my maintainer.

verses.devanagari: পালক হঞা পাল্যেরে তাড়িতে না যুয়ায়  ।\\nতুমি সর্বশাস্ত্র জান ‘জিন্দাপীর’-প্রায় ।।” ২৮ ॥২৮॥
verses.transliteration: pālaka hañā pālyere tāḍite nā yuyāya\\ntumi sarva-śāstra jāna jindā-pīra'-prāya"
verses.translation: "For a maintainer to punish the person he maintains is not good. You are expert in all the scriptures. Indeed, you are like a living saint."

verses.devanagari: এত শুনি’ সেই ম্লেচ্ছের মন আর্দ্র হৈল ।\\nদাড়ি বাহি’ অশ্রু পড়ে, কাঁদিতে লাগিল ॥২৯॥
verses.transliteration: eta śuni' sei mlecchera mana ārdra haila\\ndāḍi vāhi' aśru paḍe, kāṅdite lāgila
verses.translation: Hearing Raghunātha dāsa's appealing voice, the Mohammedan's heart softened. He began to cry, and tears glided down his beard.

verses.devanagari: ম্লেচ্ছ বলে, — “আজি হৈতে তুমি — মোর ‘পুত্র’ ।\\nআজি ছাড়াইমু তোমা’ করি’ এক সূত্র ।।” ॥ ৩০ ॥
verses.transliteration: mleccha bale,—"āji haite tumi—mora'putra'\\nāji chāḍāimu tomā' kari' eka sūtra"
verses.translation: The Mohammedan caudhurī told Raghunātha dāsa, "You are my son from this day on. Today, by some means, I shall have you released."

verses.devanagari: উজিরে কহিয়া রঘুনাথে ছাড়াইল  ।\\nপ্রীতি করি’ রঘুনাথে কহিতে লাগিল ॥৩১॥
verses.transliteration: ujire kahiyā raghunāthe chāḍāila\\nprīti kari' raghunāthe kahite lāgila
verses.translation: After informing the minister, the caudhurī released Raghunātha dāsa and then began to speak to him with great affection.

verses.devanagari: “তোমার জ্যেঠা নির্বুদ্ধি অষ্টলক্ষ খায়  ।\\nআমি — ভাগী, আমারে কিছু দিবারে যুয়ায় ॥৩২॥
verses.transliteration: "tomāra jyeṭhā nirbuddhi aṣṭa-lakṣa khāya\\nāmi—bhāgī, āmāre kichu dibāre yuyāya
verses.translation: "The elder brother of your father is less intelligent," he said. "He enjoys of it to me.

verses.devanagari: যাহ তুমি, তোমার জ্যেঠারে মিলাহ আমারে ।\\nযে-মতে ভাল হয় করুন, ভার দিলুঁ তাঁরে ।।” ॥ ৩৩ ॥
verses.transliteration: yāha tumi, tomāra jyeṭhāre milāha āmāre\\nye-mate bhāla haya karuna, bhāra diluṅ tāṅre
verses.translation: "Now you go arrange a meeting between me and your uncle. Let him do whatever he thinks best. I shall completely depend on his decision."

verses.devanagari: রঘুনাথ আসি’ তবে জ্যেঠারে মিলাইল ।\\nম্লেচ্ছ-সহিত বশ কৈল — সব শান্ত হৈল ॥৩৪॥
verses.transliteration: raghunātha āsi' tabe jyeṭhāre milāila\\nmleccha-sahita vaśa kaila—saba śānta haila
verses.translation: Raghunātha dāsa arranged a meeting between his uncle and the caudhurī. He settled the matter, and everything was peaceful.

verses.devanagari: এইমত রঘুনাথের বৎসরেক গেল ।\\nদ্বিতীয় বৎসরে পলাইতে মন কৈল ॥৩৫॥
verses.transliteration: ei-mata raghunāthera vatsareka gela\\ndvitīya vatsare palāite mana kaila
verses.translation: In this way Raghunātha dāsa passed one year exactly like a first-class business manager, but the next year he again decided to leave home.

verses.devanagari: রাত্রে উঠি’ একেলা চলিলা পলাঞা ।\\nদূর হৈতে পিতা তাঁরে আনিল ধরিয়া ॥৩৬॥
verses.transliteration: rātre uṭhi' ekelā calilā palāñā\\ndūra haite pitā tāṅre ānila dhariyā
verses.translation: He got up alone one night and left, but his father caught him in a distant place and brought him back.

verses.devanagari: এইমতে বারে বারে পলায়, ধরি’ আনে  ।\\nতবে তাঁর মাতা কহে তাঁর পিতা সনে ॥৩৭॥
verses.transliteration: ei-mate bāre bāre palāya, dhari' āne\\ntabe tāṅra mātā kahe tāṅra pitā sane
verses.translation: This became almost a daily affair. Raghunātha would run away from home, and his father would again bring him back. Then Raghunātha dāsa's mother began speaking to his father.

verses.devanagari: “পুত্র ‘বাতুল’ হইল, ইহায় রাখহ বান্ধিয়া”  ।\\nতাঁর পিতা কহে তারে নির্বিণ্ণ হঞা ॥৩৮॥
verses.transliteration: "putra bātula' ha-ila, ihāya rākhaha bāndhiyā"\\ntāṅra pitā kahe tāre nirviṇṇa hañā
verses.translation: "Our son has become mad," she said. "Just keep him by binding him with ropes." His father, being very unhappy, replied to her as follows.

verses.devanagari: “ইন্দ্রসম ঐশ্বর্য, স্ত্রী অপ্সরা-সম  ।\\nএ সব বান্ধিতে নারিলেক যাঁর মন ॥৩৯॥
verses.transliteration: "indra-sama aiśvarya, strī apsarā-sama\\ne saba bāndhite nārileka yāṅra mana
verses.translation: "Raghunātha dāsa, our son, has opulences like Indra, the heavenly King, and his wife is as beautiful as an angel. Yet all this could not tie down his mind.

verses.devanagari: দড়ির বন্ধনে তাঁরে রাখিবা কেমতে ? জন্মদাতা পিতা নারে ‘প্রারব্ধ’ খণ্ডাইতে ॥৪০॥
verses.transliteration: daḍira bandhane tāṅre rākhibā ke-mate?\\njanma-dātā-pitā nāre 'prārabdha' khaṇḍāite
verses.translation: "How then could we keep this boy home by binding him with ropes? It is not possible even for one's father to nullify the reactions of one's past activities.

verses.devanagari: চৈতন্যচন্দ্রের কৃপা হঞাছে ইঁহারে  ।\\nচৈতন্যচন্দ্রের ‘বাতুল’ কে রাখিতে পারে ?” ৪১ ॥৪১॥
verses.transliteration: caitanya-candrera kṛpā hañāche iṅhāre\\ncaitanya-candrera 'bātula' ke rākhite pāre?"
verses.translation: "Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu has fully bestowed His mercy on him. Who can keep home such a madman of Caitanyacandra?"

verses.devanagari: তবে রঘুনাথ কিছু বিচারিলা মনে ।\\nনিত্যানন্দ-গোসাঞির পাশ চলিলা আর দিনে ॥৪২॥
verses.transliteration: tabe raghunātha kichu vicārilā mane\\nnityānanda-gosāñira pāśa calilā āra dine
verses.translation: Then Raghunātha dāsa considered something in his mind, and the next day he went to Nityānanda Gosāñi.

verses.devanagari: পানিহাটি-গ্রামে পাইলা প্রভুর দরশন ।\\nকীর্তনীয়া সেবক সঙ্গে আর বহুজন ॥৪৩॥
verses.transliteration: pānihāṭi-grāme pāilā prabhura daraśana\\nkīrtanīyā sevaka saṅge āra bahu-jana
verses.translation: In the village of Pānihāṭi, Raghunātha dāsa obtained an interview with Nityānanda Prabhu, who was accompanied by many kīrtana performers, servants and others.

verses.devanagari: গঙ্গাতীরে বৃক্ষ-মূলে পিণ্ডার উপরে ।\\nবসিয়াছেন — যেন কোটী সূর্যোদয় করে ॥৪৪॥
verses.transliteration: gaṅgā-tīre vṛkṣa-mūle piṇḍāra upare\\nvasiyachena—yena koṭī sūryodaya kare
verses.translation: Sitting on a rock under a tree on the bank of the Ganges, Lord Nityānanda seemed as effulgent as hundreds and thousands of rising suns.

verses.devanagari: তলে উপরে বহুভক্ত হঞাছে বেষ্টিত ।\\nদেখি’ প্রভুর প্রভাব রঘুনাথ — বিস্মিত ॥৪৫॥
verses.transliteration: tale upare bahu-bhakta hañāche veṣṭita\\ndekhi' prabhura prabhāva raghunātha—vismita
verses.translation: Many devotees sat on the ground surrounding Him. Seeing the influence of Nityānanda Prabhu, Raghunātha dāsa was astonished.

verses.devanagari: দণ্ডবৎ হঞা সেই পড়িলা কতদূরে ।\\nসেবক কহে, — ‘রঘুনাথ দণ্ডবৎ করে ।।’ ॥ ৪৬ ॥
verses.transliteration: daṇḍavat hañā sei paḍilā kata-dūre\\nsevaka kahe,—'raghunātha daṇḍavat kare'
verses.translation: Raghunātha dāsa offered his obeisances by falling prostrate at a distant place, and the servant of Nityānanda Prabhu pointed out, "There is Raghunātha dāsa, offering You obeisances."

verses.devanagari: শুনি’ প্রভু কহে, — “চোরা দিলি দরশন ।\\nআয়, আয়, আজি তোর করিমু দণ্ডন ।।” ॥ ৪৭ ॥
verses.transliteration: śuni' prabhu kahe,—"corā dili daraśana\\nāya, āya, āji tora karimu daṇḍana"
verses.translation: Hearing this, Lord Nityānanda Prabhu said, "You are a thief. Now you have come to see Me. Come here, come here. Today I shall punish you!"

verses.devanagari: প্রভু বোলায়, তেঁহো নিকটে না করে গমন ।\\nআকর্ষিয়া তাঁর মাথে প্রভু ধরিলা চরণ ॥৪৮॥
verses.transliteration: prabhu bolāya, teṅho nikaṭe nā kare gamana\\nākarṣiyā tāṅra māthe prabhu dharilā caraṇa
verses.translation: The Lord called him, but Raghunātha dāsa did not go near the Lord. Then the Lord forcibly caught him and placed His lotus feet upon Raghunātha dāsa's head.

verses.devanagari: কৌতুকী নিত্যানন্দ সহজে দয়াময়  ।\\nরঘুনাথে কহে কিছু হঞা সদয় ॥৪৯॥
verses.transliteration: kautukī nityānanda sahaje dayāmaya\\nraghunāthe kahe kichu hañā sadaya
verses.translation: Lord Nityānanda was by nature very merciful and funny. Being merciful, He spoke to Raghunātha dāsa as follows.

verses.devanagari: “নিকটে না আইস, চোরা, ভাগ’ দূরে দূরে  ।\\nআজি লাগ্ পাঞাছি, দণ্ডিমু তোমারে ॥৫০॥
verses.transliteration: "nikaṭe nā āisa, corā, bhāga' dūre dūre\\nāji lāg pāñāchi, daṇḍimu tomāre
verses.translation: "You are just like a thief, for instead of coming near, you stay away at a distant place. Now that I have captured you, I shall punish you.

verses.devanagari: দধি, চিড়া ভক্ষণ করাহ মোর গণে ।” শুনি’ আনন্দিত হৈল রঘুনাথ মনে ॥৫১॥
verses.transliteration: dadhi, ciḍā bhakṣaṇa karāha mora gaṇe"\\nśuni' ānandita haila raghunātha mane
verses.translation: "Make a festival and feed all My associates yogurt and chipped rice." Hearing this, Raghunātha dāsa was greatly pleased.

verses.devanagari: সেইক্ষণে নিজ-লোক পাঠাইলা গ্রামে ।\\nভক্ষ্য-দ্রব্য লোক সব গ্রাম হৈতে আনে ॥৫২॥
verses.transliteration: sei-kṣaṇe nija-loka pāṭhāilā grāme\\nbhakṣya-dravya loka saba grāma haite āne
verses.translation: Raghunātha dāsa immediately sent his own men to the village to purchase all kinds of eatables and bring them back.

verses.devanagari: চিড়া দধি, দুগ্ধ, সন্দেশ, আর চিনি, কলা ।\\nসব দ্রব্য আনাঞা চৌদিকে ধরিলা ॥৫৩॥
verses.transliteration: ciḍā, dadhi, dugdha, sandeśa, āra cini, kalā\\nsaba dravya ānāñā caudike dharilā
verses.translation: Raghunātha dāsa brought chipped rice, yogurt, milk, sweetmeats, sugar, bananas and other eatables and placed them all around.

verses.devanagari: ‘মহোত্সব’-নাম শুনি’ ব্রাহ্মণ-সজ্জন ।\\nআসিতে লাগিল লোক অসংখ্য-গণন ॥৫৪॥
verses.transliteration: 'mahotsava'-nāma śuni' brāhmaṇa-sajjana\\nāsite lāgila loka asaṅkhya-gaṇana
verses.translation: As soon as they heard that a festival was going to be held, all kinds of brāhmaṇas and other gentlemen began to arrive. Thus there were innumerable people.

verses.devanagari: আর গ্রামান্তর হৈতে সামগ্রী আনিল ।\\nশত দুই-চারি হোল্না তাঁহা আনাইল ॥৫৫॥
verses.transliteration: āra grāmāntara haite sāmagrī ānila\\nśata dui-cāri holnā tāṅhā ānāila
verses.translation: Seeing the crowd increasing, Raghunātha dāsa arranged to get more eatables from other villages. He also brought two to four hundred large, round earthen pots.

verses.devanagari: বড় বড় মৃৎকুণ্ডিকা আনাইল পাঁচ সাত়ে ।\\nএক বিপ্র প্রভু লাগি’ চিড়া ভিজায় তাতে ॥৫৬॥
verses.transliteration: baḍa baḍa mṛt-kuṇḍikā ānāila pāṅca sāte\\neka vipra prabhu lāgi' ciḍā bhijāya tāte
verses.translation: He also obtained five or seven especially large earthen pots, and in these pots a brāhmaṇa began soaking chipped rice for the satisfaction of Lord Nityānanda.

verses.devanagari: এক-ঠাঞি তপ্ত-দুগ্ধে চিড়া ভিজাঞা ।\\nঅর্ধেক ছানিল দধি, চিনি, কলা দিয়া ॥৫৭॥
verses.transliteration: eka-ṭhāñi tapta-dugdhe ciḍā bhijāñā\\nardheka chānila dadhi, cini, kalā diyā
verses.translation: In one place, chipped rice was soaked in hot milk in each of the large pots. Then half the rice was mixed with yogurt, sugar and bananas.

verses.devanagari: আর অর্ধেক ঘনাবৃত-দুগ্ধেতে ছানিল ।\\nচাঁপাকলা, চিনি, ঘৃত, কর্পূর তাতে দিল ॥৫৮॥
verses.transliteration: āra ardheka ghanāvṛta-dugdhete chānila\\ncāṅpā-kalā, cini, ghṛta, karpūra tāte dila
verses.translation: The other half was mixed with condensed milk and a special type of banana known as cāṅpā-kalā. Then sugar, clarified butter and camphor were added.

verses.devanagari: ধুতি পরি’ প্রভু যদি পিণ্ডাতে বসিলা ।\\nসাতকুণ্ডী বিপ্র তাঁর আগেতে ধরিলা ॥৫৯॥
verses.transliteration: dhuti pari' prabhu yadi piṇḍāte vasilā\\nsāta-kuṇḍī vipra tāṅra āgete dharilā
verses.translation: After Nityānanda Prabhu had changed His cloth for a new one and sat on a raised platform, the brāhmaṇa brought before Him the seven huge pots.

verses.devanagari: চবুতরা-উপরে যত প্রভুর নিজগণে ।\\nবড় বড় লোক বসিলা মণ্ডলী-রচনে ॥৬০॥
verses.transliteration: cabutarā-upare yata prabhura nija-gaṇe\\nbaḍa baḍa loka vasilā maṇḍalī-racane
verses.translation: On that platform, all the most important associates of Śrī Nityānanda Prabhu, as well as other important men, sat down in a circle around the Lord.

verses.devanagari: রামদাস, সুন্দরানন্দ, দাস-গদাধর ।\\nমুরারি, কমলাকর, সদাশিব, পুরন্দর ॥৬১॥
verses.transliteration: rāmadāsa, sundarānanda, dāsa-gadādhara\\nmurāri, kamalākara, sadāśiva, purandara
verses.translation: Among them were Rāmadāsa, Sundarānanda, Gadādhara dāsa, Murāri, Kamalākara, Sadāśiva and Purandara.

verses.devanagari: ধনঞ্জয়, জগদীশ, পরমেশ্বর-দাস ।\\nমহেশ, গৌরীদাস, হোড়-কৃষ্ণদাস ॥৬২॥
verses.transliteration: dhanañjaya, jagadīśa, parameśvara-dāsa\\nmaheśa, gaurīdāsa, hoḍa-kṛṣṇadāsa
verses.translation: Dhanañjaya, Jagadīśa, Parameśvara dāsa, Maheśa, Gaurīdāsa and Hoḍa Kṛṣṇadāsa were also there.

verses.devanagari: উদ্ধারণ দত্ত আদি যত নিজগণ ।\\nউপরে বসিলা সব, কে করে গণন ? ॥ ৬৩ ॥
verses.transliteration: uddhāraṇa datta ādi yata nija-gaṇa\\nupare vasilā saba, ke kare gaṇana?
verses.translation: Similarly, Uddhāraṇa Datta Ṭhākura and many other personal associates of the Lord sat on the raised platform with Nityānanda Prabhu. No one could count them all.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
The devotees mentioned herein are described by Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura in his
Anubhāṣya.
For further information one may consult the following references in the
Ādi-līlā.
Rāmadāsa-Chapter Ten, texts 116 and 118, and Chapter Eleven, texts 13 and 16. Sundarānanda-11.23, Gadādhara dāsa-10.53, His full name is Murāri Caitanya dāsa, and he is a personal associate of Nityānanda Prabhu. Thus one should consult Chapter Eleven, text 20. Kamalākara-11.24. Sadāśiva-11.38. Purandara-11.28. Dhanañjaya-11.31. Jagadīśa-11.30. Parameśvara-11.29. Maheśa-11.32. Gaurīdāsa-11.26. Hoḍa Kṛṣṇadāsa-11.47. Uddhāraṇa Datta Ṭhākura-11.41.

verses.devanagari: শুনি’ পণ্ডিত ভট্টাচার্য যত বিপ্র আইলা ।\\nমান্য করি’ প্রভু সবারে উপরে বসাইলা ॥৬৪॥
verses.transliteration: śuni' paṇḍita bhaṭṭācārya yata vipra āilā\\nmānya kari' prabhu sabāre upare vasāilā
verses.translation: Hearing about the festival, all kinds of learned scholars, brāhmaṇas and priests went there. Lord Nityānanda Prabhu honored them and made them sit on the raised platform with Him.

verses.devanagari: দুই দুই মৃৎকুণ্ডিকা সবার আগে দিল ।\\nএকে দুগ্ধ-চিড়া, আরে দধি-চিড়া কৈল ॥৬৫॥
verses.transliteration: dui dui mṛt-kuṇḍikā sabāra āge dila\\neke dugdha-ciḍā, āre dadhi-ciḍā kaila
verses.translation: Everyone was offered two earthen pots. In one was put chipped rice with condensed milk and in the other chipped rice with yogurt.

verses.devanagari: আর যত লোক সব চৌতরা-তলানে ।\\nমণ্ডলী-বন্ধে বসিলা, তার না হয় গণনে ॥৬৬॥
verses.transliteration: āra yata loka saba cotarā-talāne\\nmaṇḍalī-bandhe vasilā, tāra nā haya gaṇane
verses.translation: All the other people sat in groups around the platform. No one could count how many people there were.

verses.devanagari: একেক জনারে দুই দুই হোল্না দিল ।\\nদধি-চিড়া দুগ্ধ-চিড়া, দুইতে ভিজাইল ॥৬৭॥
verses.transliteration: ekeka janāre dui dui holnā dila\\ndadhi-ciḍā dugdha-ciḍā, duite bhijāila
verses.translation: Each and every one of them was supplied two earthen pots-one of chipped rice soaked in yogurt and the other of chipped rice soaked in condensed milk.

verses.devanagari: কোন কোন বিপ্র উপরে স্থান না পাঞা ।\\nদুই হোল্নায় চিড়া ভিজায় গঙ্গাতীরে গিয়া ॥৬৮॥
verses.transliteration: kona kona vipra upare sthāna nā pāñā\\ndui holnāya ciḍā bhijāya gaṅgā-tīre giyā
verses.translation: Some of the brāhmaṇas, not having gotten a place on the platform, went to the bank of the Ganges with their two earthen pots and soaked their chipped rice there.

verses.devanagari: তীরে স্থান না পাঞা আর কত জন ।\\nজলে নামি’ দধি-চিড়া করয়ে ভক্ষণ ॥৬৯॥
verses.transliteration: tīre sthāna nā pāñā āra kata jana\\njale nāmi' dadhi-ciḍā karaye bhakṣaṇa
verses.translation: Others, who could not get a place even on the bank of the Ganges, got down into the water and began eating their two kinds of chipped rice.

verses.devanagari: কেহ উপরে, কেহ তলে, কেহ গঙ্গাতীরে ।\\nবিশজন তিন-ঠাঞি পরিবেশন করে ॥৭০॥
verses.transliteration: keha upare, keha tale, keha gaṅgā-tīre\\nbiśa-jana tina-ṭhāñi pariveśana kare
verses.translation: Thus some sat on the platform, some at the base of the platform, and some on the bank of the Ganges, and they were all supplied two pots each by the twenty men who distributed the food.

verses.devanagari: হেনকালে আইলা তথা রাঘব পণ্ডিত ।\\nহাসিতে লাগিলা দেখি’ হঞা বিস্মিত ॥৭১॥
verses.transliteration: hena-kāle āilā tathā rāghava paṇḍita\\nhāsite lāgilā dekhi' hañā vismita
verses.translation: At that time, Rāghava Paṇḍita arrived there. Seeing the situation, he began to laugh in great surprise.

verses.devanagari: নি-সক্ড়ি নানামত প্রসাদ আনিল ।\\nপ্রভুরে আগে দিয়া ভক্তগণে বাঁটি দিল ॥৭২॥
verses.transliteration: ni-sakḍi nānā-mata prasāda ānila\\nprabhure āge diyā bhakta-gaṇe bāṅṭi dila
verses.translation: He brought many other kinds of food cooked in ghee and offered to the Lord. This prasāda he first placed before Lord Nityānanda and then distributed among the devotees.

verses.devanagari: প্রভুরে কহে, — “তোমা লাগি’ ভোগ লাগাইল ।\\nতুমি ইহাঁ উৎসব কর, ঘরে প্রসাদ রহিল ।।” ॥ ৭৩ ॥
verses.transliteration: prabhure kahe,—"tomā lāgi' bhoga lāgāila\\ntumi ihāṅ utsava kara, ghare prasāda rahila"
verses.translation: Rāghava Paṇḍita said to Lord Nityānanda, "For You, sir, I have already offered food to the Deity, but You are engaged in a festival here, and so the food is lying there untouched."

verses.devanagari: প্রভু কহে, — “এ-দ্রব্য দিনে করিয়ে ভোজন ।\\nরাত্র্যে তোমার ঘরে প্রসাদ করিমু ভক্ষণ ॥৭৪॥
verses.transliteration: prabhu kahe,—"e-dravya dine kariye bhojana\\nrātrye tomāra ghare prasāda karimu bhakṣaṇa
verses.translation: Lord Nityānanda replied, "Let Me eat all this food here during the day, and I shall eat at your home at night.

verses.devanagari: গোপ-জাতি আমি বহু গোপগণ সঙ্গে ।\\nআমি সুখ পাই এই পুলিনভোজন-রঙ্গে ।।” ॥ ৭৫ ॥
verses.transliteration: gopa-jāti āmi bahu gopa-gaṇa saṅge\\nāmi sukha pāi ei pulina-bhojana-raṅge"
verses.translation: "I belong to a community of cowherd boys, and therefore I generally have many cowherd associates with Me. I am happy when we eat together in a picnic like this by the sandy bank of the river."

verses.devanagari: রাঘবে বসাঞা দুই কুণ্ডী দেওয়াইলা ।\\nরাঘব দ্বিবিধ চিড়া তাতে ভিজাইলা ॥৭৬॥
verses.transliteration: rāghave vasāñā dui kuṇḍī deoyāilā\\nrāghava dvividha ciḍā tāte bhijāilā
verses.translation: Lord Nityānanda made Rāghava Paṇḍita sit down and had two pots delivered to him also. There were two kinds of chipped rice soaked in them.

verses.devanagari: সকল-লোকের চিড়া পূর্ণ যবে হইল ।\\nধ্যানে তবে প্রভু মহাপ্রভুরে আনিল ॥৭৭॥
verses.transliteration: sakala-lokera ciḍā pūrṇa yabe ha-ila\\ndhyāne tabe prabhu mahāprabhure ānila
verses.translation: When chipped rice had been served to everyone, Lord Nityānanda Prabhu, in meditation, brought Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: মহাপ্রভু আইলা দেখি’ নিতাই উঠিলা ।\\nতাঁরে লঞা সবার চিড়া দেখিতে লাগিলা ॥৭৮॥
verses.transliteration: mahāprabhu āilā dekhi' nitāi uṭhilā\\ntāṅre lañā sabāra ciḍā dekhite lāgilā
verses.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu arrived, Lord Nityānanda Prabhu stood up. They then saw how the others were enjoying the chipped rice with yogurt and condensed milk.

verses.devanagari: সকল কুণ্ডীর, হোল্নার চিড়ার এক এক গ্রাস ।\\nমহাপ্রভুর মুখে দেন করি’ পরিহাস ॥৭৯॥
verses.transliteration: sakala kuṇḍīra, holnāra ciḍāra eka eka grāsa\\nmahāprabhura mukhe dena kari' parihāsa
verses.translation: From each and every pot, Lord Nityānanda Prabhu took one morsel of chipped rice and pushed it into the mouth of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu as a joke.

verses.devanagari: হাসি’ মহাপ্রভু আর এক গ্রাস লঞা ।\\nতাঁর মুখে দিয়া খাওয়ায় হাসিয়া হাসিয়া ॥৮০॥
verses.transliteration: hāsi' mahāprabhu āra eka grāsa lañā\\ntāṅra mukhe diyā khāoyāya hāsiyā hāsiyā
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, also smiling, took a morsel of food, pushed it into the mouth of Nityānanda and laughed as He made Lord Nityānanda eat it.

verses.devanagari: এইমত নিতাই বুলে সকল মণ্ডলে ।\\nদাণ্ডাঞা রঙ্গ দেখে বৈষ্ণব সকলে ॥৮১॥
verses.transliteration: ei-mata nitāi bule sakala maṇḍale\\ndāṇḍāñā raṅga dekhe vaiṣṇava sakale
verses.translation: In this way Lord Nityānanda was walking through all the groups of eaters, and all the Vaiṣṇavas standing there were seeing the fun.

verses.devanagari: কি করিয়া বেড়ায়, — ইহা কেহ নাহি জানে ।\\nমহাপ্রভুর দর্শন পায় কোন ভাগ্যবানে ॥৮২॥
verses.transliteration: ki kariyā beḍāya,—ihā keha nāhi jāne\\nmahāprabhura darśana pā ya kona bhāgyavāne
verses.translation: No one could understand what Nityānanda Prabhu was doing as He walked about. Some, however, who were very fortunate, could see that Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was also present.

verses.devanagari: তবে হাসি’ নিত্যানন্দ বসিলা আসনে ।\\nচারি কুণ্ডী আরোয়া চিড়া রাখিলা ডাহিনে ॥৮৩॥
verses.transliteration: tabe hāsi' nityānanda vasilā āsane\\ncāri kuṇḍī āroyā ciḍā rākhilā ḍāhine
verses.translation: Then Nityānanda Prabhu smiled and sat down. On His right side He kept four pots of chipped rice that had not been made from boiled paddy.

verses.devanagari: আসন দিয়া মহাপ্রভুরে তাহাঁ বসাইলা ।\\nদুই ভাই তবে চিড়া খাইতে লাগিলা ॥৮৪॥
verses.transliteration: āsana diyā mahāprabhure tāhāṅ vasāilā\\ndui bhāi tabe ciḍā khāite lāgilā
verses.translation: Lord Nityānanda offered Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu a place and had Him sit down. Then together the two brothers began eating chipped rice.

verses.devanagari: দেখি’ নিত্যানন্দপ্রভু আনন্দিত হৈলা ।\\nকত কত ভাবাবেশ প্রকাশ করিলা ॥৮৫॥
verses.transliteration: dekhi' nityānanda-prabhu ānandita hailā\\nkata kata bhāvāveśa prakāśa karilā
verses.translation: Seeing Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu eating with Him, Lord Nityānanda Prabhu became very happy and exhibited varieties of ecstatic love.

verses.devanagari: আজ্ঞা দিলা, — ‘হরি বলি’ করহ ভোজন’ ।\\n‘হরি’ ‘হরি’-ধ্বনি উঠি’ ভরিল ভুবন ॥৮৬॥
verses.transliteration: ājñā dilā,—'hari bali' karaha bhojana'\\n'hari' 'hari'-dhvani uṭhi' bharila bhuvana
verses.translation: Lord Nityānanda Prabhu ordered, "All of you eat, chanting the holy name of Hari." Immediately the holy names "Hari, Hari" resounded, filling the entire universe.

verses.devanagari: ‘হরি’ ‘হরি’ বলি’ বৈষ্ণব করয়ে ভোজন ।\\nপুলিন-ভোজন সবার হইল স্মরণ ॥৮৭॥
verses.transliteration: 'hari' 'hari' bali' vaiṣṇava karaye bhojana\\npulina-bhojana sabāra ha-ila smaraṇa
verses.translation: When all the Vaiṣṇavas were chanting the holy names"Hari, Hari" and eating, they remembered how Kṛṣṇa and Balarāma ate with Their companions the cowherd boys on the bank of the Yamunā.

verses.devanagari: নিত্যানন্দ মহাপ্রভু — কৃপালু, উদার ।\\nরঘুনাথের ভাগ্যে এত কৈলা অঙ্গীকার ॥৮৮॥
verses.transliteration: nityānanda mahāprabhu—kṛpālu, udāra\\nraghunāthera bhāgye eta kailā aṅgīkāra
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and Lord Nityānanda Prabhu are extremely merciful and liberal. It was Raghunātha dāsa's good fortune that They accepted all these dealings.

verses.devanagari: নিত্যানন্দ-প্রভাব-কৃপা জানিবে কোন্ জন ?\\nমহাপ্রভু আনি’ করায় পুলিন-ভোজন ॥৮৯॥
verses.transliteration: nityānanda-prabhāva-kṛpā jānibe kon jana?\\nmahāprabhu āni' karā ya pulina-bhojana
verses.translation: Who can understand the influence and mercy of Lord Nityānanda Prabhu? He is so powerful that He induced Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to come eat chipped rice on the bank of the Ganges.

verses.devanagari: শ্রীরামদাসাদি গোপ প্রেমাবিষ্ট হৈলা ।\\nগঙ্গাতীরে ‘যমুনা-পুলিন’ জ্ঞান কৈলা ॥৯০॥
verses.transliteration: śrī-rāmadāsādi gopa premāviṣṭa hailā\\ngaṅgā-tīre 'yamunā-pulina' jñāna kailā
verses.translation: All the confidential devotees who were cowherd boys, headed by Śrī Rāmadāsa, were absorbed in ecstatic love. They thought the bank of the Ganges to be the bank of the Yamunā.

verses.devanagari: মহোৎসব শুনি’ পসারি নানা-গ্রাম হৈতে ।\\nচিড়া, দধি, সন্দেশ, কলা আনিল বেচিতে ॥৯১॥
verses.transliteration: mahotsava śuni' pasāri nānā-grāma haite\\nciḍā, dadhi, sandeśa, kalā ānila vecite
verses.translation: When the shopkeepers of many other villages heard about the festival, they arrived there to sell chipped rice, yogurt, sweetmeats and bananas.

verses.devanagari: যত দ্রব্য লঞা আইসে, সব মূল্য করি’ লয় ।\\nতার দ্রব্য মূল্য দিয়া তাহারে খাওয়ায় ॥৯২॥
verses.transliteration: yata dravya lañā āise, saba mūlya kari' laya\\ntāra dravya mūlya diyā tāhāre khāoyāya
verses.translation: As they came, bringing all kinds of food, Raghunātha dāsa purchased it all. He gave them the price for their goods and later fed them the very same food.

verses.devanagari: কৌতুক দেখিতে আইল যত যত জন ।\\nসেই চিড়া, দধি, কলা করিল ভক্ষণ ॥৯৩॥
verses.transliteration: kautuka dekhite āila yata yata jana\\nsei ciḍā, dadhi, kalā karila bhakṣaṇa
verses.translation: Anyone who came to see how these funny things were going on was also fed chipped rice, yogurt and bananas.

verses.devanagari: ভোজন করি’ নিত্যানন্দ আচমন কৈলা ।\\nচারি কুণ্ডীর অবশেষ রঘুন়াথে দিলা ॥৯৪॥
verses.transliteration: bhojana kari' nityānanda ācamana kailā\\ncāri kuṇḍīra avaśeṣa raghunāthe dilā
verses.translation: After Lord Nityānanda Prabhu finished eating, He washed His hands and mouth and gave Raghunātha dāsa the food remaining in the four pots.

verses.devanagari: আর তিন কুণ্ডিকায় অবশেষ ছিল ।\\nগ্রাসে-গ্রাসে করি’ বিপ্র সব ভক্তে দিল ॥৯৫॥
verses.transliteration: āra tina kuṇḍikāya avaśeṣa chila\\ngrāse-grāse kari' vipra saba bhakte dila
verses.translation: There was food remaining in the three other big pots of Lord Nityānanda, and a brāhmaṇa distributed it to all the devotees, giving a morsel to each.

verses.devanagari: পুষ্পমালা বিপ্র আনি’ প্রভু-গলে দিল ।\\nচন্দন আনি প্রভুর সর্বাঙ্গে লেপিল ॥৯৬॥
verses.transliteration: puṣpa-mālā vipra āni' prabhu-gale dila\\ncandana āniyā prabhura sarvāṅge lepila
verses.translation: Then a brāhmaṇa brought a flower garland, placed the garland on Nityānanda Prabhu's neck and smeared sandalwood pulp all over His body.

verses.devanagari: সেবক তাম্বূল লঞা করে সমর্পণ ।\\nহাসিয়া হাসিয়া প্রভু করয়ে চর্বণ ॥৯৭॥
verses.transliteration: sevaka tāmbūla lañā kare samarpaṇa\\nhāsiyā hāsiyā prabhu karaye carvaṇa
verses.translation: When a servant brought betel nuts and offered them to Lord Nityānanda, the Lord smiled and chewed them.

verses.devanagari: মালা-চন্দন-তাম্বূল শেষ যে আছিল ।\\nশ্রীহস্তে প্রভু তাহা সবাকারে বাঁটি’ দিল ॥৯৮॥
verses.transliteration: mālā-candana-tāmbūla śeṣa ye āchila\\nśrī-haste prabhu tāhā sabākāre bāṅṭi' dila
verses.translation: With His own hands Lord Nityānanda Prabhu distributed to all the devotees whatever flower garlands, sandalwood pulp and betel nuts remained.

verses.devanagari: আনন্দিত রঘুনাথ প্রভুর ‘শেষ’ পাঞা ।\\nআপনার গণ-সহ খাইলা বাঁটিয়া ॥৯৯॥
verses.transliteration: ānandita raghunātha prabhura 'śeṣa, pāñā\\nāpanāra gaṇa-saha khāilā bāṅtiyā
verses.translation: After receiving the remnants of food left by Lord Nityānanda Prabhu, Raghunātha dāsa, who was greatly happy, ate some and distributed the rest among his own associates.

verses.devanagari: এই ত’ কহিলুঁ নিত্যানন্দের বিহার ।\\n‘চিড়া-দধি-মহোৎসব’-নামে খ্যাতি যার ॥১০০॥
verses.transliteration: ei ta' kahiluṅ nityānandera vihāra\\n'ciḍā-dadhi-mahotsava'-nāme khyāti yāra
verses.translation: Thus I have described the pastimes of Lord Nityānanda Prabhu in relation to the celebrated festival of chipped rice and yogurt.

verses.devanagari: প্রভু বিশ্রাম কৈলা, যদি দিন-শেষ হৈল ।\\nরাঘব-মন্দিরে তবে কীর্তন আরম্ভিল ॥১০১॥
verses.transliteration: prabhu viśrāma kailā, yadi dina-śeṣa haila\\nrāghava-mandire tabe kīrtana ārambhila
verses.translation: Nityānanda Prabhu rested for the day, and when the day ended He went to the temple of Rāghava Paṇḍita and began congregational chanting of the holy name of the Lord.

verses.devanagari: ভক্ত সব নাচাঞা নিত্যানন্দ-রায় ।\\nশেষে নৃত্য করে প্রেমে জগৎ ভাসায় ॥১০২॥
verses.transliteration: bhakta saba nācāñā nityānanda-rāya\\nśeṣe nṛtya kare preme jagat bhāsāya
verses.translation: Lord Nityānanda Prabhu first influenced all the devotees to dance, and finally He Himself began dancing, thus inundating the entire world in ecstatic love.

verses.devanagari: মহাপ্রভু তাঁর নৃত্য করেন দরশন ।\\nসবে নিত্যানন্দ দেখে, না দেখে অন্যজন ॥১০৩॥
verses.transliteration: mahāprabhu tāṅra nṛtya karena daraśana\\nsabe nityānanda dekhe, nā dekhe anya-jana
verses.translation: Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was observing the dancing of Lord Nityānanda Prabhu. Nityānanda Prabhu could see this, but the others could not.

verses.devanagari: নিত্যানন্দের নৃত্য, — যেন তাঁহার নর্তনে ।\\nউপমা দিবার নাহি এ-তিন ভুবনে ॥১০৪॥
verses.transliteration: nityānandera nṛtya,—yena tāṅhāra nartane\\nupamā dibāra nāhi e-tina bhuvane
verses.translation: The dancing of Lord Nityānanda Prabhu, like the dancing of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, cannot be compared to anything within these three worlds.

verses.devanagari: নৃত্যের মাধুরী কেবা বর্ণিবারে পারে ।\\nমহাপ্রভু আইসে যেই নৃত্য দেখিবারে ॥১০৫॥
verses.transliteration: nṛtyera mādhurī kebā varṇibāre pāre\\nmahāprabhu āise yei nṛtya dekhibāre
verses.translation: No one can properly describe the sweetness of Lord Nityānanda's dancing. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu personally comes to see it.

verses.devanagari: নৃত্য করি’ প্রভু যবে বিশ্রাম করিলা ।\\nভোজনের লাগি’ পণ্ডিত নিবেদন কৈলা ॥১০৬॥
verses.transliteration: nṛtya kari' prabhu yabe viśrāma karilā\\nbhojanera lāgi' paṇḍita nivedana kailā
verses.translation: After the dancing and after Lord Nityānanda had rested, Rāghava Paṇḍita submitted his request that the Lord take supper.

verses.devanagari: ভোজনে বসিলা প্রভু নিজগণ লঞা ।\\nমহাপ্রভুর আসন ডাহিনে পাতিয়া ॥১০৭॥
verses.transliteration: bhojane vasilā prabhu nija-gaṇa lañā\\nmahāprabhura āsana ḍāhine pātiyā
verses.translation: Lord Nityānanda Prabhu sat down for supper with His personal associates and made a sitting place on His right side for Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: মহাপ্রভু আসি’ সেই আসনে বসিল ।\\nদেখি’ রাঘবের মনে আনন্দ বাড়িল ॥১০৮॥
verses.transliteration: mahāprabhu āsi' sei āsane vasila\\ndekhi' rāghavera mane ānanda bāḍila
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu came there and sat down at His place. Seeing this, Rāghava Paṇḍita felt increasing happiness. Rāghava Paṇḍita felt increasing happiness.

verses.devanagari: দুইভাই-আগে প্রসাদ আনিয়া ধরিলা ।\\nসকল বৈষ্ণবে পিছে পরিবেশন কৈলা ॥১০৯॥
verses.transliteration: dui-bhāi-āge prasāda āniyā dharilā\\nsakala vaiṣṇave piche pariveśana kailā
verses.translation: Rāghava Paṇḍita brought the prasāda before the two brothers and thereafter distributed prasāda to all the other Vaiṣṇavas.

verses.devanagari: নানাপ্রকার পিঠা, পায়স, দিব্য শাল্যন্ন ।\\nঅমৃত নিন্দয়ে ঐছে বিবিধ ব্যঞ্জন ॥১১০॥
verses.transliteration: nānā-prakāra piṭhā, pāyasa, divya śālyanna\\namṛta nindaye aiche vividha vyañjana
verses.translation: There were varieties of cakes, sweet rice and fine cooked rice that surpassed the taste of nectar. There were also varieties of vegetables.

verses.devanagari: রাঘব-ঠাকুরের প্রসাদ অমৃতের সার  ।\\nমহাপ্রভু যাহা খাইতে আইসে বার বার ॥১১১॥
verses.transliteration: rāghava-ṭhākurera prasāda amṛtera sāra\\nmahāprabhu yāhā khāite āise bāra bāra
verses.translation: The food prepared and offered to the Deity by Rāghava Paṇḍita was like the essence of nectar. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu came there again and again to eat such prasāda.

verses.devanagari: পাক করি’ রাঘব যবে ভোগ লাগায়  ।\\nমহাপ্রভুর লাগি’ ভোগ পৃথক্ বাড়য় ॥১১২॥
verses.transliteration: pāka kari' rāghava yabe bhoga lāgāya\\nmahāprabhura lāgi' bhoga pṛthak bāḍaya
verses.translation: When Rāghava Paṇḍita offered the food to the Deity after cooking, he would make a separate offering for Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: প্রতিদিন মহাপ্রভু করেন ভোজন ।\\nমধ্যে মধ্যে প্রভু তাঁরে দেন দরশন ॥১১৩॥
verses.transliteration: prati-dina mahāprabhu karena bhojana\\nmadhye madhye prabhu tāṅre dena daraśana
verses.translation: Every day, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would eat at the house of Rāghava Paṇḍita. Sometimes He would give Rāghava Paṇḍita the opportunity to see Him.

verses.devanagari: দুই ভাইরে রাঘব আনি’ পরিবেশে ।\\nযত্ন করি’ খাওয়ায়, না রহে অবশেষে ॥১১৪॥
verses.transliteration: dui bhāire rāghava āni' pariveśe\\nyatna kari' khāoyāya, nā rahe avaśeṣe
verses.translation: Rāghava Paṇḍita would bring and distribute prasāda to the two brothers, feeding Them with great attention. They ate everything, and therefore there were no remnants left.

verses.devanagari: কত উপহার আনে, হেন নাহি জানি ।\\nরাঘবের ঘরে রান্ধে রাধা-ঠাকুরাণী ॥১১৫॥
verses.transliteration: kata upahāra āne, hena nāhi jāni\\nrāghavera ghare rāndhe rādhā-ṭhākurāṇī
verses.translation: He brought so many presentations that no one could know them perfectly. Indeed, it was a fact that the supreme mother, Rādhārāṇī, personally cooked in the house of Rāghava Paṇḍita.

verses.devanagari: দুর্বাসার ঠাঞি তেঁহো পাঞাছেন বর ।\\nঅমৃত হইতে পাক তাঁর অধিক মধুর ॥১১৬॥
verses.transliteration: durvāsāra ṭhāñi teṅho pāñāchena vara\\namṛta ha-ite pāka tāṅra adhika madhura
verses.translation: Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī received from Durvāsā Muni the benediction that whatever She cooked would be sweeter than nectar. That is the special feature of Her cooking.

verses.devanagari: সুগন্ধি সুন্দর প্রসাদ — মাধুর্যের সার ।\\nদুই ভাই তাহা খাঞা সন্তোষ অপার ॥১১৭॥
verses.transliteration: sugandhi sundara prasāda—mādhuryera sāra\\ndui bhāi tāhā khāñā santoṣa apāra
verses.translation: Aromatic and pleasing to see, the food was the essence of all sweetness. Thus the two brothers, Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu and Lord Nityānanda Prabhu, ate it with great satisfaction.

verses.devanagari: ভোজনে বসিতে রঘুনাথে কহে সর্বজন ।\\nপণ্ডিত কহে, — ‘ইঁহ পাছে করিবে ভোজন ।।’ ॥ ১১৮ ॥
verses.transliteration: bhojane vasite raghunāthe kahe sarva-jana\\npaṇḍita kahe,—iṅha pāche karibe bhojana'
verses.translation: All the devotees present requested Raghunātha dāsa to sit down and take prasāda, but Rāghava Paṇḍita told them, "He will take prasāda later."

verses.devanagari: ভক্তগণ আকণ্ঠ ভরিয়া করিল ভোজন ।\\n‘হরি’ ধ্বনি করি’ উঠি’ কৈলা আচমন ॥১১৯॥
verses.transliteration: bhakta-gaṇa ākaṇṭha bhariyā karila bhojana\\n'hari' dhvani kari' uṭhi' kailā ācamana
verses.translation: All the devotees took prasāda, filling themselves to the brim. Thereafter, chanting the holy name of Hari, they stood up and washed their hands and mouths.

verses.devanagari: ভোজন করি’ দুই ভাই কৈলা আচমন ।\\nরাঘব আনি’ পরাইলা মাল্য-চন্দন ॥১২০॥
verses.transliteration: bhojana kari' dui bhāi kailā ācamana\\nrāghava āni' parāilā mālya-candana
verses.translation: After eating, the two brothers washed Their hands and mouths. Then Rāghava Paṇḍita brought flower garlands and sandalwood pulp and decorated Them.

verses.devanagari: বিড়া খাওয়াইলা, কৈলা চরণ বন্দন ।\\nভক্তগণে দিলা বিড়া, মাল্য-চন্দন ॥১২১॥
verses.transliteration: biḍā khāoyāilā, kailā caraṇa vandana\\nbhakta-gaṇe dilā biḍā, mālya-candana
verses.translation: Rāghava Paṇḍita offered Them betel nuts and worshiped Their lotus feet. He also distributed betel nuts, flower garlands and sandalwood pulp to the devotees.

verses.devanagari: রাঘবের কৃপা রঘুনাথের উপরে ।\\nদুই ভাইএর অবশিষ্ট পাত্র দিলা তাঁরে ॥১২২॥
verses.transliteration: rāghavera kṛpā raghunāthera upare\\ndui bhāiera avaśiṣṭa pātra dilā tāṅre
verses.translation: Rāghava Paṇḍita, being very merciful toward Raghunātha dāsa, offered him the dishes with the remnants of food left by the two brothers.

verses.devanagari: কহিলা, — “চৈতন্য গোসাঞি করিয়াছেন ভোজন ।\\nতাঁর শেষ পাইলে, তোমার খণ্ডিল বন্ধন ।।” ॥ ১২৩ ॥
verses.transliteration: kahilā,—"caitanya gosāñi kariyāchena bhojana\\ntāṅra śeṣa pāile, tomāra khaṇḍila bandhana"
verses.translation: He said, "Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu has eaten this food. If you take His remnants, you will be released from the bondage of your family."

verses.devanagari: ভক্ত-চিত্তে ভক্ত-গৃহে সদা অবস্থান ।\\nকভু গুপ্ত, কভু ব্যক্ত, স্বতন্ত্র ভগবান্ ॥১২৪॥
verses.transliteration: bhakta-citte bhakta-gṛhe sadā avasthāna\\nkabhu gupta, kabhu vyakta, svatantra bhagavān
verses.translation: The Supreme Personality of Godhead always resides either in the heart or in the home of a devotee. This fact is sometimes hidden and sometimes manifest, for the Supreme Personality of Godhead is fully independent.

verses.devanagari: সর্বত্র ‘ব্যাপক’ প্রভুর সদা সর্বত্র বাস ।\\nইহাতে সংশয় যার, সেই যায় নাশ ॥১২৫॥
verses.transliteration: sarvatra 'vyāpaka' prabhura sadā sarvatra vāsa\\nihāte saṁśaya yāra, sei yāya nāśa
verses.translation: The Supreme Personality of Godhead is all-pervasive, and therefore He resides everywhere. Anyone who doubts this will be annihilated.

verses.devanagari: প্রাতে নিত্যানন্দ প্রভু গঙ্গাস্নান করিয়া ।\\nসেই বৃক্ষমূলে বসিলা নিজগণ লঞা ॥১২৬॥
verses.transliteration: prāte nityānanda prabhu gaṅgā-snāna kariyā\\nsei vṛkṣa-mūle vasilā nija-gaṇa lañā
verses.translation: In the morning, after taking His bath in the Ganges, Nityānanda Prabhu sat down with His associates beneath the same tree under which He had previously sat.

verses.devanagari: রঘুনাথ আসি’ কৈলা চরণ বন্দন  ।\\nরাঘবপণ্ডিত-দ্বারা কৈলা নিবেদন ॥১২৭॥
verses.transliteration: raghunātha āsi' kailā caraṇa vandana\\nrāghava-paṇḍita-dvārā kailā nivedana
verses.translation: Raghunātha dāsa went there and worshiped Lord Nityānanda's lotus feet. Through Rāghava Paṇḍita, he submitted his desire.

verses.devanagari: “অধম, পামর মুই হীন জীবাধম ! মোর ইচ্ছা হয় — পাঙ চৈতন্য-চরণ ॥১২৮॥
verses.transliteration: "adhama, pāmara mui hīna jīvādhama!\\nmora icchā haya—pāṅa caitanya-caraṇa
verses.translation: "I am the lowest of men, the most sinful, fallen and condemned. Nevertheless, I desire to attain the shelter of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: বামন হঞা যেন চান্দ ধরিবারে চায়  ।\\nঅনেক যত্ন কৈনু, তাতে কভু সিদ্ধ নয় ॥১২৯॥
verses.transliteration: vāmana hañā yena cānda dharibāre cāya\\naneka yatna kainu, tāte kabhu siddha naya
verses.translation: "Like a dwarf who wants to catch the moon, I have tried my best many times, but I have never been successful.

verses.devanagari: যতবার পলাই আমি গৃহাদি ছাড়িয়া  ।\\nপিতা, মাতা — দুই মোরে রাখয়ে বান্ধিয়া ॥১৩০॥
verses.transliteration: yata-bāra palāi āmi gṛhādi chādiyā\\npitā, mātā—dui more rākhaye bāndhiyā
verses.translation: "Every time I tried to go away and give up my home relationships, my father and mother unfortunately kept me bound.

verses.devanagari: তোমার কৃপা বিনা কেহ ‘চৈতন্য’ না পায়  ।\\nতুমি কৃপা কৈলে তাঁরে অধমেহ পায় ॥১৩১॥
verses.transliteration: tomāra kṛpā vinā keha 'caitanya' nā pāya\\ntumi kṛpā kaile tāṅre adhameha pāya
verses.translation: "No one can attain the shelter of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu without Your mercy, but if You are merciful, even the lowest of men ca attain shelter at His lotus feet.

verses.devanagari: অযোগ্য মুই নিবেদন করিতে করি ভয়  ।\\nমোরে ‘চৈতন্য’ দেহ’ গোসাঞি হঞা সদয় ॥১৩২॥
verses.transliteration: ayogya mui nivedana karite kari bhaya\\nmore 'caitanya' deha' gosāñi hañā sadaya
verses.translation: "Although I am unfit and greatly afraid to submit this plea, I nevertheless request You, sir, to be especially merciful toward me by granting me shelter at the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: মোর মাথে পদ ধরি’ করহ প্রসাদ  ।\\nনির্বিঘ্নে চৈতন্য পাঙ — কর আশীর্বাদ ।।” ১৩৩ ॥১৩৩॥
verses.transliteration: mora māthe pada dhari' karaha prasāda\\nnirvighne caitanya pāṅa—kara āśīrvāda"
verses.translation: "Placing Your feet on my head, give me the benediction that I may achieve the shelter of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu without difficulty. I pray for this benediction."

verses.devanagari: শুনি’ হাসি’ কহে প্রভু সব ভক্তগণে  ।\\n“ইহার বিষয়সুখ — ইন্দ্রসুখ-সমে ॥১৩৪॥
verses.transliteration: śuni' hāsi' kahe prabhu saba bhakta-gaṇe\\n"ihāra viṣaya-sukha—indra-sukha-sama
verses.translation: After hearing this appeal by Raghunātha dāsa, Lord Nityānanda Prabhu smiled and told all the devotees, "Raghunātha dāsa's standard of material happiness is equal to that of Indra, the King of heaven.

verses.devanagari: চৈতন্য-কৃপাতে সেহ নাহি ভায় মনে  ।\\nসবে আশীর্বাদ কর — পাউক চৈতন্য-চরণে ॥১৩৫॥
verses.transliteration: caitanya-kṛpāte seha nāhi bhāya mane\\nsabe āśīrvāda kara—pāuka caitanya-caraṇe
verses.translation: "Because of the mercy bestowed upon him by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Raghunātha dāsa, although situated in such material happiness, does not like it at all. Therefore let every one of you be merciful toward him and give him the benediction that he may very soon attain shelter at the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: কৃষ্ণপাদপদ্ম-গন্ধ যেই জন পায়  ।\\nব্রহ্মলোক-আদি-সুখ তাঁরে নাহি ভায় ।।” ১৩৬ ॥১৩৬॥
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇa-pāda-padma-gandha yei jana pāya\\nbrahmaloka-ādi-sukha tāṅre nāhi bhāya"
verses.translation: "One who experiences the fragrance of the lotus feet of Lord Kṛṣṇa does not even value the standard of happiness available in Brahmaloka, the topmost planet. And what to speak of heavenly happiness?

verses.devanagari: যো দুস্ত্যজান্ দারসুতান্ সুহৃদ্রাজ্যং হৃদিস্পৃশঃ ।\\nজহৌ যুবৈব মলবদুত্তম-শ্লোকলালসঃ ॥১৩৭॥
verses.transliteration: yo dustyajān dāra-sutān\\nsuhṛd-rājyaṁ hṛdi-spṛśaḥ\\njahau yuvaiva malavad\\nuttama-śloka-lālasaḥ
verses.translation: "Lord Kṛṣṇa, the Supreme Personality of Godhead, is offered sublime, poetic prayers by those trying to attain His favor. Thus He is known as Uttamaśloka. Being very eager to gain the association of Lord Kṛṣṇa, King Bharata, although in the prime of youth, gave up his very attractive wife, affectionate children, most beloved friends and opulent kingdom, exactly as one gives up stool after excreting it.' "
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This verse is from
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
(5.14.43).

verses.devanagari: তবে রঘুনাথে প্রভু নিকটে বোলাইলা  ।\\nতাঁর মাথে পদ ধরি’ কহিতে লাগিলা ॥১৩৮॥
verses.transliteration: tabe raghunāthe prabhu nikaṭe bolāila\\ntāṅra māthe pada dhari' kahite lāgilā
verses.translation: Then Lord Nityānanda Prabhu called Raghunātha dāsa near Him, placed His lotus feet upon Raghunātha dāsa's head and began to speak.

verses.devanagari: “তুমি যে করাইলা এই পুলিন-ভোজন  ।\\nতোমায় কৃপা করি’ গৌর কৈলা আগমন ॥১৩৯॥
verses.transliteration: "tumi ye karāilā ei pulina-bhojana\\ntomāya kṛpā kari' gaura kailā āgamana
verses.translation: "My dear Raghunātha dāsa," He said, "since you arranged the feast on the bank of the Ganges, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu came here just to show you His mercy.

verses.devanagari: কৃপা করি’ কৈলা চিড়া-দুগ্ধ ভোজন  ।\\nনৃত্য দেখি’ রাত্র্যে কৈলা প্রসাদ ভক্ষণ ॥১৪০॥
verses.transliteration: kṛpā kari' kailā ciḍā-dugdha bhojana\\nnṛtya dekhi' rātrye kailā prasāda bhakṣaṇa
verses.translation: "By His causeless mercy He ate the chipped rice and milk. Then, after seeing the dancing of the devotees at night, He took His supper.

verses.devanagari: তোমা উদ্ধারিতে গৌর আইলা আপনে  ।\\nছুটিল তোমার যত বিঘ্ন়াদি-বন্ধনে ॥১৪১॥
verses.transliteration: tomā uddhārite gaura āilā āpane\\nchuṭila tomāra yata vighnādi-bandhane
verses.translation: "Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Gaurahari, came here personally to deliver you. Now rest assured that all the impediments meant for your bondage are gone.

verses.devanagari: স্বরূপের স্থানে তোমা করিবে সমর্পণে  ।\\n‘অন্তরঙ্গ’ ভৃত্য বলি’ রাখিবে চরণে ॥১৪২॥
verses.transliteration: svarūpera sthāne tomā karibe samarpaṇe\\n'antaraṅga' bhṛtya bali' rākhibe caraṇe
verses.translation: "Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu will accept you and place you under the charge of His secretary, Svarūpa Dāmodara. You will thus become one of the most confidential internal servants and will attain the shelter of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: নিশ্চিন্ত হঞা যাহ আপন-ভবন  ।\\nঅচিরে নির্বিঘ্নে পাবে চৈতন্য-চরণ ।।” ১৪৩ ॥১৪৩॥
verses.transliteration: niścinta hañā yāha āpana-bhavana\\nacire nirvighne pābe caitanya-caraṇa"
verses.purport: PURPORT\n"Being assured of all this, return to your own home. Very soon, without impediments, you will attain the shelter of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu."

verses.devanagari: সব ভক্তদ্বারে তাঁরে আশীর্বাদ করাইলা ।\\nতাঁ-সবার চরণ রঘুনাথ বন্দিলা ॥১৪৪॥
verses.transliteration: saba bhakta-dvāre tāṅre āśīrvāda karāilā\\ntāṅ-sabāra caraṇa raghunātha vandilā
verses.translation: Lord Nityānanda had Raghunātha dāsa blessed by all the devotees, and Raghunātha dāsa offered his respects to their lotus feet.

verses.devanagari: প্রভু-আজ্ঞা লঞা বৈষ্ণবের আজ্ঞা লইলা ।\\nরাঘব-সহিতে নিভৃতে যুক্তি করিলা ॥১৪৫॥
verses.transliteration: prabhu-ājñā lañā vaiṣṇavera ājñā la-ilā\\nrāghava-sahite nibhṛte yukti karilā
verses.translation: After taking leave of Lord Nityānanda Prabhu and then all the other Vaiṣṇavas, Srī Raghunātha dāsa consulted secretly with Rāghava Paṇḍita.

verses.devanagari: যুক্তি করি’ শত মুদ্রা, সোণা তোলা-সাতে ।\\nনিভৃতে দিলা প্রভুর ভাণ্ডারীর হাতে ॥১৪৬॥
verses.transliteration: yukti kari' śata mudrā, soṇā tolā-sāte\\nnibhṛte dilā prabhura bhāṇḍārīra hāte
verses.translation: After consulting with Rāghava Paṇḍita, he secretly delivered one hundred gold coins and about seven tolās of gold to the hand of Nityānanda Prabhu's treasurer.

verses.devanagari: তাঁরে নিষেধিলা, — “প্রভুরে এবে না কহিবা ।\\nনিজ-ঘরে যাবেন যবে তবে নিবেদিবা ।।” ॥ ১৪৭ ॥
verses.transliteration: tāṅre niṣedhilā,—"prabhure ebe nā kahibā\\nnija-ghare yābena yabe tabe nivedibā"
verses.translation: Raghunātha dāsa admonished the treasurer, "Do not speak about this to Lord Nityānanda Prabhu now, but when He returns home, kindly inform Him about this presentation."

verses.devanagari: তবে রাঘব-পণ্ডিত তাঁরে ঘরে0ন দিলা\\nঅনেক ‘প্রসাদ’ দিলা পথে খাইবারে ।\\nতবে পুনঃ রঘুনাথ কহে পণ্ডিতেরে\\n“প্রভুর সঙ্গে যত মহান্ত, ভৃত্য, আশ্রিত জন ।\\nপূজিতে চাহিয়ে আমি সবার চরণ\\nবিশ, পঞ্চদশ, বার, দশ, পঞ্চ হয় ।\\nমুদ্রা দেহ’ বিচারি’ যার যত যোগ্য হয় ॥১৪৮॥
verses.transliteration: tabe rāghava-paṇḍita tāṅre ghare lañā gelā\\nṭhākura darśana karāñā mālā-candana dilā
verses.translation: Thereupon, Rāghava Paṇḍita took Raghunātha dāsa to his home. After inducing him to see the Deity, he gave Raghunātha dāsa a garland and sandalwood pulp.

verses.devanagari: অনেক ‘প্রসাদ’ দিলা পথে খাইবারে  ।\\nতবে পুনঃ রঘুনাথ কহে পণ্ডিতেরে ॥১৪৯॥
verses.transliteration: aneka 'prasāda' dilā pathe khāibāre\\ntabe punaḥ raghunātha kahe paṇḍitere
verses.translation: He gave Raghunātha dāsa a large quantity of prasāda to eat on his way home. Then Raghunātha dāsa again spoke to Rāghava Paṇḍita.

verses.devanagari: “প্রভুর সঙ্গে যত মহান্ত, ভৃত্য, আশ্রিত জন  ।\\nপূজিতে চাহিয়ে আমি সবার চরণ ॥১৫০॥
verses.transliteration: "prabhura saṅge yata mahānta, bhṛtya āśrita jana\\npūjite cāhiye āmi sabāra caraṇa
verses.translation: "I want to give money," he said, "just to worship the lotus feet of all the great devotees, servants and subservants of Lord Nityānanda Prabhu.

verses.devanagari: বিশ, পঞ্চদশ, বার, দশ, পঞ্চ হয়  ।\\nমুদ্রা দেহ’ বিচারি’ যার যত যোগ্য হয় ॥১৫১॥
verses.transliteration: biśa, pañca-daśa, bāra, daśa, pañca haya\\nmudrā deha' vicāri' yāra yata yogya haya
verses.translation: "As you think fit, give twenty, fifteen, twelve, ten or five coins to each of them."

verses.devanagari: সব লেখা করিয়া রাঘব-পাশ দিলা ।\\nযাঁর নামে যত রাঘব চিঠি লেখাইলা ॥১৫২॥
verses.transliteration: saba lekhā kariyā rāghava-pāśa dilā\\nyāṅra nāme yata rāghava ciṭhi lekhāilā
verses.translation: Raghunātha dāsa drew up an account of the amount to be given and submitted it to Rāghava Paṇḍita, who then made up a list showing how much money was to be paid to each and every devotee.

verses.devanagari: একশত মুদ্রা আর সোণা তোলা-দ্বয় ।\\nপণ্ডিতের আগে দিল করিয়া বিনয় ॥১৫৩॥
