verses.transliteration: eka-śata mudrā āra soṇā tolā-dvaya\\npaṇḍitera āge dila kariyā vinaya
verses.translation: With great humility, Raghunātha dāsa placed one hundred gold coins and about two tolās of gold before Rāghava Paṇḍita for all the other devotees.

verses.devanagari: তাঁর পদধূলি লঞা স্বগৃহে আইলা ।\\nনিত্যানন্দ-কৃপা পাঞা কৃতার্থ মানিলা ॥১৫৪॥
verses.transliteration: tāṅra pada-dhūli lañā svagṛhe āilā\\nnityānanda-kṛpā pāñā kṛtārtha mānilā
verses.translation: After taking dust from the feet of Rāghava Paṇḍita, Raghunātha dāsa returned to his home, feeling greatly obligated to Lord Nityānanda Prabhu because of having received His merciful benediction.

verses.devanagari: সেই হৈতে অভ্যন্তরে না করেন গমন ।\\nবাহিরে দুর্গামণ্ডপে যাঞা করেন শয়ন ॥১৫৫॥
verses.transliteration: sei haite abhyantare nā karena gamana\\nbāhire durgā-maṇḍape yāñā karena śayana
verses.translation: From that day on, he did not go into the interior section of the house. Instead, he would sleep on the Durgā-maṇḍapa [the place where mother Durgā was worshiped].

verses.devanagari: তাঁহা জাগি’ রহে সব রক্ষকগণ ।\\nপলাইতে করেন নানা উপায় চিন্তন ॥১৫৬॥
verses.transliteration: tāṅhā jāgi' rahe saba rakṣaka-gaṇa\\npalāite karena nānā upāya cintana
verses.translation: There, however, the watchmen alertly kept guard. Raghunātha dāsa was thinking of various means by which to escape their vigilance.

verses.devanagari: হেনকালে গৌড়দেশের সব ভক্তগণ ।\\nপ্রভুরে দেখিতে নীলাচলে করিলা গমন ॥১৫৭॥
verses.transliteration: hena-kāle gauḍa-deśera saba bhakta-gaṇa\\nprabhure dekhite nīlācale karilā gamana
verses.translation: At that time, all the devotees of Bengal were going to Jagannātha Purī to see Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: তাঁ-সবার সঙ্গে রঘুনাথ যাইতে না পারে ।\\nপ্রসিদ্ধ প্রকট সঙ্গ, তবহিঁ ধরা পড়ে ॥১৫৮॥
verses.transliteration: tāṅ-sabāra saṅge raghunātha yāite nā pāre\\nprasiddha prakaṭa saṅga, tabahiṅ dharā paḍe
verses.translation: Raghunātha dāsa could not accompany them, for they were so famous that he would immediately have been caught.

verses.devanagari: এইমত চিন্তিতে দৈবে একদিনে ।\\nবাহিরে দেবীমণ্ডপে করিয়াছেন শয়নে ॥১৫৯॥\\nদণ্ড-চারি রাত্রি যবে আছে অবশেষ ।\\nযদুনন্দন-আচার্য তবে করিলা প্রবেশ ॥১৬০॥
verses.transliteration: daṇḍa-cāri rātri yabe āche avaśeṣa\\nyadunandana-ācārya tabe karilā praveśa
verses.translation: Thus Raghunātha dāsa thought deeply about how to escape, and one night while he was sleeping on the Durgā-maṇḍapa, the priest Yadunandana Ācārya entered the house when only four daṇḍas remained until the end of the night.

verses.devanagari: বাসুদেব-দত্তের তেঁহ হয় ‘অনুগৃহীত’ ।\\nরঘুনাথের ‘গুরু’ তেঁহো হয় ‘পুরোহিত’ ॥১৬১॥
verses.transliteration: vāsudeva-dattera teṅha haya 'anugṛhīta'\\nraghunāthera 'guru' teṅho haya 'purohita'
verses.translation: Yadunandana Ācārya was the priest and spiritual master of Raghunātha dāsa. Although born in a brāhmaṇa family, he had accepted the mercy of Vāsudeva Datta.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura comments that although the atheists who have deviated from the order of Śrī Advaita Ācārya introduce themselves as followers of Advaita Ācārya, they do not accept Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu as the Supreme Personality of Godhead, Kṛṣṇa. Yadunandana Ācārya, one of the most confidential followers of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, was the initiated disciple of Advaita Ācārya. He was not polluted by sentimental distinctions classifying Vaiṣṇavas according to birth. Therefore although Vāsudeva Datta had not been born in a
brāhmaṇa
family, Yadunandana Ācārya accepted Vāsudeva Datta as his spiritual master.

verses.devanagari: অদ্বৈত-আচার্যের তেঁহ ‘শিষ্য অন্তরঙ্গ’ ।\\nআচার্য-আজ্ঞাতে মানে — চৈতন্য ‘প্রাণধন’ ॥১৬২॥
verses.transliteration: advaita-ācāryera teṅha 'śiṣya antaraṅga'\\nācārya-ājñāte māne—caitanya 'prāṇa-dhana'
verses.translation: Yadunandana Ācārya had been officially initiated by Advaita Ācārya. Thus he considered Lord Caitanya his life and soul.

verses.devanagari: অঙ্গনে আসিয়া তেঁহো যবে দাণ্ডাইলা ।\\nরঘুনাথ আসি’ তবে দণ্ডবৎ কৈলা ॥১৬৩॥
verses.transliteration: aṅgane āsiyā teṅho yabe dāṇḍāilā\\nraghunātha āsi' tabe daṇḍavat kailā
verses.translation: When Yadunandana Ācārya entered the house of Raghunātha dāsa and stood in the courtyard, Raghunātha dāsa went there and fell down to offer his obeisances.

verses.devanagari: তাঁর এক শিষ্য তাঁর ঠাকুরের সেবা করে ।\\nসেবা ছাড়িয়াছে, তারে সাধিবার তরে ॥১৬৪॥
verses.transliteration: tāṅra eka śiṣya tāṅra ṭhākurera sevā kare\\nsevā chāḍiyāche, tāre sādhibāra tare
verses.translation: One of Yadunandana Ācārya's disciples had been worshiping the Deity but had left that service. Yadunandana Ācārya wanted Raghunātha dāsa to induce the disciple to take up that service again.

verses.devanagari: রঘুনাথে কহে, — “তারে করহ সাধন ।\\nসেবা যেন করে, আর নাহিক ব্রাহ্মণ ।।” ॥ ১৬৫ ॥
verses.transliteration: raghunāthe kahe,—"tāre karaha sādhana\\nsevā yena kare, āra nāhika brāhmaṇa"
verses.translation: Yadunandana Ācārya requested Raghunātha dāsa, "Please induce the brāhmaṇa to resume the service, for there is no other brāhmaṇa to do it."

verses.devanagari: এত কহি’ রঘুনাথে লঞা চলিলা ।\\nরক্ষক সব শেষরাত্রে নিদ্রায় পড়িলা ॥১৬৬॥
verses.transliteration: eta kahi' raghunāthe lañā calilā\\nrakṣaka saba śeṣa-rātre nidrāya padilā
verses.translation: After saying this, Yadunandana Ācārya took Raghunātha dāsa with him and went out. By that time all the watchmen were deeply asleep because it was the end of the night.

verses.devanagari: আচার্যের ঘর ইহার পূর্বদিশাতে ।\\nকহিতে শুনিতে দুঁহে চলে সেই পথে ॥১৬৭॥
verses.transliteration: ācāryera ghara ihāra pūrva-diśāte\\nkahite śunite duṅhe cale sei pathe
verses.translation: East of the house of Raghunātha dāsa was the house of Yadunandana Ācārya. Yadunandana Ācārya and Raghunātha dāsa talked together as they went toward that house.

verses.devanagari: অর্ধপথে রঘুনাথ কহে গুরুর চরণে  ।\\n“আমি সেই বিপ্রে সাধি’ পাঠাইমু তোমা স্থানে ॥১৬৮॥
verses.transliteration: ardha-pathe raghunātha kahe gurura caraṇe\\n"āmi sei vipre sādhi' pāṭhāimu tomā sthāne
verses.translation: Halfway along the path, Raghunātha dāsa submitted at the lotus feet of his spiritual master, "I shall go to the home of that brāhmaṇa, induce him to return, and send him to your home.

verses.devanagari: তুমি সুখে ঘরে যাহ — মোরে আজ্ঞা হয় ।” এই ছলে আজ্ঞা মাগি’ করিলা নিশ্চয় ॥১৬৯॥
verses.transliteration: tumi sukhe ghare yāha—more ājñā haya"\\nei chale ājñā māgi' karilā niścaya
verses.translation: "You may go home without anxiety. Following your order, I shall persuade the brāhmaṇa." On this plea, after asking permission, he decided to go away.

verses.devanagari: “সেবক রক্ষক আর কেহ নাহি সঙ্গে  ।\\nপলাইতে আমার ভাল এইত প্রসঙ্গে ।।” ১৭০ ॥১৭০॥
verses.transliteration: "sevaka rakṣaka āra keha nāhi saṅge\\npalāite āmāra bhāla eita prasaṅge
verses.translation: Raghunātha dāsa thought, "This is the greatest opportunity to go away because this time there are no servants or watchmen with me."

verses.devanagari: এত চিন্তি’ পূর্বমুখে করিলা গমন ।\\nউলটিয়া চাহে পাছে, — নাহি কোন জন ॥১৭১॥
verses.transliteration: eta cinti' pūrva-mukhe karilā gamana\\nulaṭiyā cāhe pāche,—nāhi kona jana
verses.translation: Thinking in this way, he quickly proceeded toward the east. Sometimes he turned around and looked back, but no one was following him.

verses.devanagari: শ্রীচৈতন্য-নিত্যানন্দ-চরণ চিন্তিয়া ।\\nপথ ছাড়ি’ উপপথে যায়েন ধাঞা ॥১৭২॥
verses.transliteration: śrī-caitanya-nityānanda-caraṇa cintiyā\\npatha chāḍi' upapathe yāyena dhāñā
verses.translation: Thinking of the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and Lord Nityānanda Prabhu, he left the general path and proceeded with great haste on the one not generally used.

verses.devanagari: গ্রামে-গ্রামের পথ ছাড়ি’ যায় বনে বনে ।\\nকায়মনোবাক্যে চিন্তে চৈতন্য-চরণে ॥১৭৩॥
verses.transliteration: grāme-grāmera patha chāḍi' yāya vane vane\\nkāya-mano-vākye cinte caitanya-caraṇe
verses.translation: Giving up the general path from village to village, he passed through the jungles, thinking with heart and soul about the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: পঞ্চদশ-ক্রোশ-পথ চলি’ গেলা একদিনে ।\\nসন্ধ্যাকালে রহিলা এক গোপের বাথানে ॥১৭৪॥
verses.transliteration: pañca-daśa-krośa-patha cali' gelā eka-dine\\nsandhyā-kāle rahilā eka gopera bāthāne
verses.translation: He walked about thirty miles in one day, and in the evening he took rest in the cowshed of a milkman.

verses.devanagari: উপবাসী দেখি’ গোপ দুগ্ধ আনি’ দিলা ।\\nসেই দুগ্ধ পান করি’ পড়িয়া রহিলা ॥১৭৫॥
verses.transliteration: upavāsī dekhi' gopa dugdha āni' dilā\\nsei dugdha pāna kari' paḍiyā rahilā
verses.translation: When the milkman saw that Raghunātha dāsa was fasting, he gave him some milk. Raghunātha dāsa drank the milk and lay down to rest there for the night.

verses.devanagari: এথা তাঁর সেবক রক্ষক তাঁরে না দেখিয়া ।\\nতাঁর গুরুপাশে বার্তা পুছিলেন গিয়া ॥১৭৬॥
verses.transliteration: ethā tāṅra sevaka rakṣaka tāṅre nā dekhiyā\\ntāṅra guru-pāśe vārtā puchilena giyā
verses.translation: At the house of Raghunātha dāsa, the servant and watchman, not seeing him there, immediately went to inquire about him from his spiritual master, Yadunandana Ācārya.

verses.devanagari: তেঁহ কহে, ‘আজ্ঞা মাগি’ গেলা নিজ-ঘর ।’\\n‘পলাইল রঘুনাথ’ — উঠিল কোলাহল ॥১৭৭॥
verses.transliteration: teṅha kahe, 'ājñā māgi' gelā nija-ghara'\\n'palāila raghunātha'—uṭhila kolāhala
verses.translation: Yadunandana Ācārya said, "He has already asked my permission and returned home." Thus there arose a tumultuous sound, as everyone cried, "Now Raghunātha has gone away!"

verses.devanagari: তাঁর পিতা কহে, — “গৌড়ের সব ভক্তগণ  ।\\nপ্রভু-স্থানে নীলাচলে করিলা গমন ॥১৭৮॥
verses.transliteration: tāṅra pitā kahe,—"gauḍera saba bhakta-gaṇa\\nprabhu-sthāne nīlācale karilā gamana
verses.translation: Raghunātha dāsa's father said, "Now all the devotees from Bengal have gone to Jagannātha Purī to see Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: সেই-সঙ্গে রঘুনাথ গেল পলাঞা  ।\\nদশ জন যাহ, তারে আনহ ধরিয়া ।।” ১৭৯ ॥১৭৯॥
verses.transliteration: sei-saṅge raghunātha gela palāñā\\ndaśa jana yāha, tāre ānaha dhariyā"
verses.translation: "Raghunātha dāsa has fled with them. Ten men should immediately go catch him and bring him back."

verses.devanagari: শিবানন্দে পত্রী দিল বিনয় করিয়া ।\\n‘আমার পুত্রেরে তুমি দিবা বাহুড়িয়া’ ॥১৮০॥
verses.transliteration: śivānande patrī dila vinaya kariyā\\n'āmāra putrere tumi dibā bāhuḍiyā'
verses.translation: Raghunātha dāsa's father wrote a letter to Śivānanda Sena, asking him with great humility, "Please return my son."

verses.devanagari: ঝাঁকরা পর্যন্ত গেল সেই দশ জনে ।\\nঝাঁকরাতে পাইল গিয়া বৈষ্ণবের গণে ॥১৮১॥
verses.transliteration: jhāṅkarā paryanta gela sei daśa jane\\njhāṅkarāte pāila giyā vaiṣṇavera gaṇe
verses.translation: In Jhāṅkarā, the ten men caught up with the group of Vaiṣṇavas going to Nīlācala.

verses.devanagari: পত্রী দিয়া শিবানন্দে বার্তা পুছিল ।\\nশিবানন্দ কহে, — ‘তেঁহ এথা না আইল’ ॥১৮২॥
verses.transliteration: patrī diyā śivānande vārtā puchila\\nśivānanda kahe,—'teṅha ethā nā āila'
verses.translation: After delivering the letter, the men inquired from Śivānanda Sena about Raghunātha dāsa, but Śivānanda Sena replied, "He did not come here."

verses.devanagari: বাহুড়িয়া সেই দশ জন আইল ঘর ।\\nতাঁর মাতা-পিতা হইল চিন্তিত অন্তর ॥১৮৩॥
verses.transliteration: bāhuḍiyā sei daśa jana āila ghara\\ntāṅra mātā-pitā ha-ila cintita antara
verses.translation: The ten men returned home, and Raghunātha dāsa's father and mother were filled with anxiety.

verses.devanagari: এথা রঘুনাথ-দাস প্রভাতে উঠিয়া ।\\nপূর্বমুখ ছাড়ি’ চলে দক্ষিণ-মুখ হঞা ॥১৮৪॥
verses.transliteration: ethā raghunātha-dāsa prabhāte uṭhiyā\\npūrva-mukha chāḍi' cale dakṣiṇa-mukha hañā
verses.translation: Raghunātha dāsa, who had been resting at the milkman's house, got up early in the morning. Instead of going to the east, he turned his face south and proceeded.

verses.devanagari: ছত্রভোগ পার হঞা ছাড়িয়া সরাণ ।\\nকুগ্রাম দিয়া দিয়া করিল প্রয়াণ ॥১৮৫॥
verses.transliteration: chatrabhoga pāra hañā chāḍiyā sarāṇa\\nkugrāma diyā diyā karila prayāṇa
verses.translation: He crossed Chatrabhoga, but instead of going on the general path, he proceeded on the path that went from village to village.
verses.purport: PURPORT\nChatrabhoga, known now as Chāḍa-khāḍi, is in the district of twenty-four pargaṇās in West Bengal. It is situated near the celebrated village Jayanagara-majilapura. Formerly the Ganges or some of its branches flowed through this region. Sometimes Chatrabhoga is misunderstood to have been a village on the River Kāṅsāi-nadī in Benāpola.

verses.devanagari: ভক্ষণ অপেক্ষা নাহি, সমস্ত দিবস গমন ।\\nক্ষুধা নাহি বাধে, চৈতন্যচরণ-প্রাপ্ত্যে মন ॥১৮৬॥
verses.transliteration: bhakṣaṇa apekṣā nāhi, samasta divasa gamana\\nkṣudhā nāhi bādhe, caitanya-caraṇa-prāptye mana
verses.translation: Not caring about eating, he traveled all day. Hunger was not an impediment, for his mind was concentrated upon obtaining shelter at the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: কভু চর্বণ, কভু রন্ধন, কভু দুগ্ধপান ।\\nযবে যেই মিলে, তাহে রাখে নিজ প্রাণ ॥১৮৭॥
verses.transliteration: kabhu carvaṇa, kabhu randhana, kabhu dugdha-pāna\\nyabe yei mile, tāhe rākhe nija prāṇa
verses.translation: Sometimes he chewed fried grains, sometimes he cooked, and sometimes he drank milk. In this way he kept his life and soul together with whatever was available wherever he went.

verses.devanagari: বার দিনে চলি’ গেলা শ্রীপুরুষোত্তম ।\\nপথে তিনদিন মাত্র করিলা ভোজন ॥১৮৮॥
verses.transliteration: bāra dine cali' gelā śrī-puruṣottama\\npathe tina-dina mātra karilā bhojana
verses.translation: He reached Jagannātha Purī in twelve days but could only eat for three days on the way.

verses.devanagari: স্বরূপাদি-সহ গোসাঞি আছেন বসিয়া ।\\nহেনকালে রঘুনাথ মিলিল আসিয়া ॥১৮৯॥
verses.transliteration: svarūpādi-saha gosāñi āchena vasiyā\\nhena-kāle raghunātha milila āsiyā
verses.translation: When Raghunātha dāsa met Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the Lord was sitting with His companions, headed by Svarūpa Dāmodara.

verses.devanagari: অঙ্গনেতে দূরে রহি’ করেন প্রণিপাত ।\\nমুকুন্দ-দত্ত কহে, — ‘এই আইল রঘুনাথ’ ॥১৯০॥
verses.transliteration: aṅganete dūre rahi' karena praṇipāta\\nmukunda-datta kahe,—'ei āila raghunātha'
verses.translation: Staying at a distant place in the courtyard, he fell down to offer obeisances. Then Mukunda Datta said, "Here is Raghunātha."

verses.devanagari: প্রভু কহেন, — ‘আইস’, তেঁহো ধরিলা চরণ ।\\nউঠি’ প্রভু কৃপায় তাঁরে কৈলা আলিঙ্গন ॥১৯১॥
verses.transliteration: prabhu kahena,—'āisa;, teṅho dharilā caraṇa\\nuṭhi' prabhu kṛpāya tāṅre kailā āliṅgana
verses.translation: As soon as Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu heard these words, He immediately welcomed Raghunātha dāsa. "Come here," He said. Raghunātha dāsa then clasped the lotus feet of the Lord, but the Lord stood up and embraced him out of His causeless mercy.

verses.devanagari: স্বরূপাদি সব ভক্তের চরণ বন্দিলা ।\\nপ্রভু-কৃপা দেখি’ সবে আলিঙ্গন কৈলা ॥১৯২॥
verses.transliteration: svarūpādi saba bhaktera caraṇa vandilā\\nprabhu-kṛpā dekhi' sabe āliṅgana kailā
verses.translation: Raghunātha dāsa offered prayers at the lotus feet of all the devotees, headed by Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī. Seeing the special mercy Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had bestowed upon Raghunātha dāsa, they embraced him also.

verses.devanagari: প্রভু কহে, — “কৃষ্ণকৃপা বলিষ্ঠ সবা হৈতে ।\\nতোমারে কাড়িল বিষয়-বিষ্ঠা-গর্ত হৈতে ।।” ॥ ১৯৩ ॥
verses.transliteration: prabhu kahe,—"kṛṣṇa-kṛpā baliṣṭha sabā haite\\ntomāre kāḍila viṣaya-viṣṭhā-garta haite"
verses.translation: Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "The mercy of Lord Kṛṣṇa is stronger than anything else. Therefore the Lord has delivered you from the ditch of materialistic life, which is like a hole into which people pass stool."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
According to the law of
karma,
everyone is destined to suffer or enjoy according to a certain material standard, but the mercy of Lord Kṛṣṇa is so powerful that the Lord can change all the reactions of one's past karma, or fruitive activities. Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu specifically drew attention to the mercy of Lord Kṛṣṇa. That mercy is more powerful than anything else, for it had saved Raghunātha dāsa from the strong bondage of materialistic life, which the Lord compared to a hole where people pass stool. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu gave His verdict that those addicted to the materialistic way of life are like worms that are living in stool but cannot give it up. A
gṛhavrata,
one who has decided to live in a comfortable home although it is actually miserable, is in a condemned position. Only the mercy of Kṛṣṇa can save one from such misery. Without Kṛṣṇa's mercy, one cannot get out of the filthy entanglement of materialistic life. The poor living entity cannot give up his materialistic position on his own; only when granted the special mercy of Kṛṣṇa can he give it up. Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu knew very well that Raghunātha dāsa was already liberated. Nevertheless He emphasized that Raghunātha dāsa's life of material comfort as a very rich man's son with a very beautiful wife and many servants to attend him was like a ditch of stool. The Lord thus specifically indicated that ordinary men who are very happy with material comforts and family life are in no better position than worms in stool.

verses.devanagari: রঘুনাথ মনে কহে, — ‘কৃষ্ণ নাহি জানি ।\\nতব কৃপা কাড়িল আমা, — এই আমি মানি ।।’ ॥ ১৯৪ ॥
verses.transliteration: raghunātha mane kahe,—'kṛṣṇa nāhi jāni\\ntava kṛpā kāḍila āmā,—ei āmi māni'
verses.translation: Raghunātha dāsa answered within his mind, "I do not know who Kṛṣṇa is. I simply know that Your mercy, O my Lord, has saved me from my family life."

verses.devanagari: প্রভু কহেন, — “তোমার পিতা-জ্যেঠা দুই জনে ।\\nচক্রবর্তী-সম্বন্ধে হাম ‘আজা’ করি’ মানে ॥১৯৫॥
verses.transliteration: prabhu kahena,—"tomāra pitā-jyeṭhā dui jane\\ncakravarti-sambandhe hāma 'ājā' kari' māne
verses.translation: The Lord continued, "Your father and his elder brother are both related as brothers to My grandfather, Nīlāmbara Cakravartī. Therefore I consider them My grandfathers.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Nīlāmbara Cakravartī, the grandfather of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, was very intimately related to Raghunātha dāsa's father and uncle. Nīlāmbara Cakravartī used to call them his younger brothers because both of them were very devoted to the
brāhmaṇas
and were very respectable gentlemen. Similarly, they used to call him Dādā Cakravartī, addressing him as an elder brother
brāhmaṇa.
Raghunātha dāsa, however, was almost the same age as Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Generally a grandchild may joke about his grandfather. Therefore Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu took advantage of the relationship between His grandfather and Raghunātha dāsa's father and uncle to speak in a joking way.

verses.devanagari: চক্রবর্তীর দুহে হয় ভ্রাতৃরূপ দাস ।\\nঅতএব তারে আমি করি পরিহাস ॥১৯৬॥
verses.transliteration: cakravartīra duhe haya bhrātṛ-rūpa dāsa\\nataeva tāre āmi kari parihāsa
verses.translation: "Since your father and his elder brother are younger brothers of Nīlāmbara Cakravartī, I may joke about them in this way.

verses.devanagari: তোমার বাপ-জ্যেঠা — বিষয়বিষ্ঠা-গর্তের কীড়া ।\\nসুখ করি’ মানে বিষয়-বিষের মহাপীড়া ॥১৯৭॥
verses.transliteration: tomāra bāpa-jyeṭhā—viṣaya-viṣṭhā-gartera kīḍā\\nsukha kari' māne viṣaya-viṣera mahā-pīḍā
verses.translation: "My dear Raghunātha dāsa, your father and his elder brother are just like worms in stool in the ditch of material enjoyment, for the great disease of the poison of material enjoyment is what they consider happiness.
verses.purport: PURPORT\nWhen a man is attached to material enjoyment, he is attached to many miserable conditions, but nevertheless he accepts his condemned position as one of happiness. Sense enjoyment is so strong for such a person that he cannot give it up, exactly as a worm in stool cannot give up the stool. From the spiritual point of view, when a person is too absorbed in material enjoyment, he is exactly like a worm in stool. Although such a position is utterly miserable to the eyes of liberated souls, the materialistic enjoyer is greatly attached to it.

verses.devanagari: যদ্যপি ব্রহ্মণ্য করে ব্রাহ্মণের সহায় ।\\n‘শুদ্ধবৈষ্ণব’ নহে, হয়ে ‘বৈষ্ণবের প্রায়’ ॥১৯৮॥
verses.transliteration: yadyadi brahmaṇya kare brāhmaṇera sahāya\\n'śuddha-vaiṣṇava' nahe, haye 'vaiṣṇavera prāya'
verses.translation: "Although your father and uncle are charitable to brāhmaṇas and greatly help them, they are nevertheless not pure Vaishnavas. However, they are almost like Vaiṣṇavas.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
As stated by Śrīla Bhaktivinoda Ṭhākura in his
Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya,
some people, usually very rich men, dress like Vaiṣṇavas and give charity to
brāhmaṇas.
They are also attached to Deity worship, but because of their attachment to material enjoyment, they cannot be pure Vaiṣṇavas.
Anyābhilāṣitā-śūnyaṁ jñāna-karmādy-anāvṛtam.
The pure Vaiṣṇava has no desire for material enjoyment. That is the basic qualification of a pure Vaiṣṇava. There are men, especially rich men, who regularly worship the Deity, give charity to
brāhmaṇas
and are pious in every respect, but they cannot be pure Vaiṣṇavas. Despite their outward show of Vaiṣṇavism and charity, their inner desire is to enjoy a higher standard of material life. Raghunātha dāsa's father, Hiraṇya dāsa, and uncle, Govardhana, were both very charitable to
brāhmaṇas.
Indeed, the
brāhmaṇas
from the Gauḍīya district were practically dependent upon them. Thus they were accepted as very pious gentlemen. However, they presented themselves as Vaiṣṇavas to the eyes of people in general, although from a purely spiritual point of view they were ordinary human beings, not pure Vaiṣṇavas. Actual Vaiṣṇavas considered them almost Vaiṣṇavas, not pure Vaiṣṇavas. In other words, they were
kaniṣṭha-adhikārīs,
for they were ignorant of higher Vaiṣṇava regulative principles. Nevertheless, they could not be called
viṣayīs,
or blind materialistic enjoyers.

verses.devanagari: তথাপি বিষয়ের স্বভাব — করে মহা-অন্ধ ।\\nসেই কর্ম করায়, যাতে হয় ভব-বন্ধ ॥১৯৯॥
verses.transliteration: tathāpi viṣayera svabhāva—kare mahā-andha\\nsei karma karāya, yāte haya bhava-bandha
verses.translation: "Those who are attached to materialistic life and are blind to spiritual life must act in such a way that they are bound to repeated birth and death by the actions and reactions of their activities.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
As clearly stated in
Bhagavad-gītā
(Bg. 3.9),
yajñārthāt karmaṇo 'nyatra loko 'yam-karma-bandhanaḥ:
if one does not act as a pure devotee, whatever acts he per forms will produce reactions of fruitive bondage
(karma-bandhanaḥ).
In
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
it is said:
nūnaṁ pramattaḥ kurute vikarma
yad-indriya-prīta ya āpṛṇoti
na sādhu manye yata ātmano 'yam
asann api kleśada āsa dehaḥ
"A materialistic person, madly engaged in activities for sense enjoyment, does not know that he is entangling himself in repeated birth and death and that his body, although temporary, is full of miseries." (Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam 5.5.4) A viṣayī, a person blindly caught in a web of materialistic life, remains in the cycle of birth and death perpetually. Such a person cannot understand how to execute pure devotional service, and therefore he acts as a
karmī, jñānī, yogī
or something else, according to his desire, but he does not know that the activities of
karma, jñāna
and yoga simply bind one to the cycle of birth and death.

verses.devanagari: হেন ‘বিষয়’ হৈতে কৃষ্ণ উদ্ধারিলা তোমা’ ।\\nকহন না যায় কৃষ্ণকৃপার মহিমা ।।” ॥ ২০০ ॥
verses.transliteration: hena 'viṣaya' haite kṛṣṇa uddhārilā tomā'\\nkahana nā yāya kṛṣṇa-\\nkṛpāra mahimā"
verses.translation: "By His own free will, Lord Kṛṣṇa has delivered you from such a condemned materialistic life. Therefore the glories of Lord Kṛṣṇa's causeless mercy cannot be expressed."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
in the
Brahma-saṁhitā
(5.54) it is said,
karmāṇi nirdahati kintu ca bhakti-bha-jām.
Lord Kṛṣṇa is so merciful that He can stop the reaction of
karma
for His devotee. Everyone-from a small insect called
indra-gopa
up to Indra, the King of heaven-is bound by the reactions of fruitive activities.
yas tv indra-gopam athavendram aho sva-karma-
bandhānurūpa-phala-bhājanam ātanoti
karmāṇi nirdahati kintu ca bhakti-bhājāṁ
govindam ādi-puruṣaṁ tam ahaṁ bhajāmi
Everyone, whether like an insect or the King of heaven, is entangled and bound by the actions and reactions of his
karma
However, when one becomes a pure devotee, free from material desires and from bondage to
karma, jñāna
and yoga, one is freed from material actions and reactions by the causeless mercy of Kṛṣṇa. One cannot express sufficient gratitude to Kṛṣṇa for being freed from the materialistic way of life.

verses.devanagari: রঘুনাথের ক্ষীণতা-মালিন্য দেখিয়া  ।\\nস্বরূপেরে কহেন প্রভু কৃপার্দ্র-চিত্ত হঞা ॥২০১॥
verses.transliteration: raghunāthera kṣīṇatā-mālinya dekhiyā\\nsvarūpere kahena prabhu kṛpārdra-citta hañā
verses.translation: Seeing Raghunātha dāsa skinny and dirty because of having traveled for twelve days and fasted, Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, His heart melting due to causeless mercy, spoke to Svarūpa Dāmodara.

verses.devanagari: “এই রঘুনাথে আমি সঁপিনু তোমারে  ।\\nপুত্র-ভৃত্য-রূপে তুমি কর অঙ্গীকারে ॥২০২॥
verses.transliteration: "ei raghunāthe āmi saṅpinu tomāre\\nputra-bhṛtya-rūpe tumi kara aṅgīkāre
verses.translation: "My dear Svarūpa," He said, "I entrust this Raghunātha dāsa to you. Please accept him as your son or servant.

verses.devanagari: তিন ‘রঘুনাথ’-নাম হয় আমার গণে  ।\\n‘স্বরূপের রঘু’ — আজি হৈতে ইহার নামে ।।” ২০৩ ॥২০৩॥
verses.transliteration: tina 'raghunātha'-nāma haya āmāra gaṇe\\n'svarūpera raghu'—āji haite ihāra nāme"
verses.translation: "There are now three Raghunāthas among My associates. From this day forward, this Raghunātha should be known as the Raghu of Svarūpa Dāmodara."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had three Raghus among His associates-Vaidya Raghunātha (vide
Ādi-līlā
11.22), Bhaṭṭa Raghunātha and Dāsa Raghunātha. Dāsa Raghunātha became celebrated as the Raghunātha of Svarūpa.

verses.devanagari: এত কহি’ রঘুনাথের হস্ত ধরিলা ।\\nস্বরূপের হস্তে তাঁরে সমর্পণ কৈলা ॥২০৪॥
verses.transliteration: eta kahi' raghunāthera hasta dharilā\\nsvarūpera haste tāṅre samarpaṇa kailā
verses.translation: Saying this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu grasped the hand of Raghunātha dāsa and entrusted him to the hands of Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī.

verses.devanagari: স্বরূপ কহে, — ‘মহাপ্রভুর যে আজ্ঞা হৈল’ ।\\nএত কহি’ রঘুনাথে পুনঃ আলিঙ্গিল ॥২০৫॥
verses.transliteration: svarūpa kahe,—'mahāprabhura ye ājñā haila'\\neta kahi' raghunāthe punaḥ āliṅgila
verses.translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī accepted Raghunātha dāsa, saying, "Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, whatever You order is accepted." He then embraced Raghunātha dāsa again.

verses.devanagari: চৈতন্যের ভক্তবাৎসল্য কহিতে না পারি  ।\\nগোবিন্দেরে কহে রঘুনাথে দয়া করি’ ॥২০৬॥
verses.transliteration: caitanyera bhakta-vātsalya kahite nā pāri\\ngovindere kahe raghunāthe dayā kari'
verses.translation: I cannot properly express the affection of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu for His devotees. Being merciful toward Raghunātha dāsa, the Lord spoke as follows to Govinda.

verses.devanagari: “পথে ইঁহ করিয়াছে বহুত লবঙ্ঘন  ।\\nকতদিন কর ইহার ভাল সন্তর্পণ ।।” ২০৭ ॥২০৭॥
verses.transliteration: "pathe iṅha kariyāche bahuta laṅghana\\nkata-dina kara ihāra bhāla santarpaṇa"
verses.translation: "On the way, Raghunātha dāsa has fasted and undergone hardships for many days. Therefore, take good care of him for some days so that he may eat to his satisfaction."

verses.devanagari: রঘুনাথে কহে — “যাঞা, কর সিন্ধুস্নান ।\\nজগন্নাথ দেখি’ আসি’ করহ ভোজন ।।” ॥ ২০৮ ॥
verses.transliteration: raghunāthe kahe—"yāñā, kara sindhu-snāna\\njagannātha dekhi' āsi' karaha bhojana"
verses.translation: Then Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu told Raghunātha dāsa, "Go bathe in the sea. Then see Lord Jagannātha in the temple and return here to take your meal."

verses.devanagari: এত বলি’ প্রভু মধ্যাহ্ন করিতে উঠিলা ।\\nরঘুনাথ-দাস সব ভক্তেরে মিলিলা ॥২০৯॥
verses.transliteration: eta bali' prabhu madhyāhna karite uṭhilā\\nraghunātha-dāsa saba bhaktere mililā
verses.translation: After saying this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu got up and went to perform His midday duties, and Raghunātha met all the devotees present.

verses.devanagari: রঘুনাথে প্রভুর কৃপা দেখি, ভক্তগণ ।\\nবিস্মিত হঞা করে তাঁর ভাগ্য-প্রশংসন ॥২১০॥
verses.transliteration: raghunāthe prabhura kṛpā dekhi, bhakta-gaṇa\\nvismita hañā kare tāṅra bhāgya-praśaṁsana
verses.translation: Having seen the causeless mercy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu upon Raghunātha dāsa, all the devotees, struck with wonder, praised his good fortune.

verses.devanagari: রঘুনাথ সমুদ্রে যাঞা স্নান করিলা ।\\nজগন্নাথ দেখি’ পুনঃ গোবিন্দ-পাশ আইলা ॥২১১॥
verses.transliteration: raghunātha samudre yāñā snāna karilā\\njagannātha dekhi' punaḥ govinda-pāśa āilā
verses.translation: Raghunātha dāsa took his bath in the sea and saw Lord Jagannātha. Then he returned to Govinda, the personal servant of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: প্রভুর অবশিষ্ট পাত্র গোবিন্দ তাঁরে দিলা ।\\nআনন্দিত হঞা রঘুনাথ প্রসাদ পাইলা ॥২১২॥
verses.transliteration: prabhura avaśiṣṭa pātra govinda tāṅre dilā\\nānandita hañā raghunātha prasāda pāilā
verses.translation: Govinda offered him a plate with the remnants of food left by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, and Raghunātha dāsa accepted the prasāda with great happiness.

verses.devanagari: এইমত রহে তেঁহ স্বরূপ-চরণে ।\\nগোবিন্দ প্রসাদ তাঁরে দিল পঞ্চ দিনে ॥২১৩॥
verses.transliteration: ei-mata rahe teṅha svarūpa-caraṇe\\ngovinda prasāda tāṅre dila pañca dine
verses.translation: Raghunātha dāsa stayed under the care of Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī, and Govinda supplied him remnants of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's food for five days.

verses.devanagari: আর দিন হৈতে ‘পুষ্প-অঞ্জলি’ দেখিয়া  ।\\nসিংহদ্বারে খাড়া রহে ভিক্ষার লাগিয়া ॥২১৪॥
verses.transliteration: āra dina haite 'puṣpa-añjali' dekhiyā\\nsiṁha-dvāre khāḍā rahe bhikṣāra lāgiyā
verses.translation: Beginning from the sixth day, Raghunātha dāsa would stand at the gate known as Siṁha-dvāra to beg alms after the puṣpa-añjali ceremony, in which flowers were offered to the Lord.

verses.devanagari: জগন্নাথের সেবক যত — ‘বিষয়ীর গণ’  ।\\nসেবা সারি’ রাত্র্যে করে গৃহেতে গমন ॥২১৫॥
verses.transliteration: jagannāthera sevaka yata—'viṣayīra gaṇa'\\nsevā sāri' rātrye kare gṛhete gamana
verses.translation: After finishing their prescribed duties, the many servants of Lord Jagannātha, who are known as viṣayīs, return home at night.

verses.devanagari: সিংহদ্বারে অন্নার্থী বৈষ্ণবে দেখিয়া  ।\\nপসারির ঠাঞি অন্ন দেন কৃপা ত’ করিয়া ॥২১৬॥
verses.transliteration: siṁha-dvāre annārthī vaiṣṇave dekhiyā\\npasārira ṭhāñi anna dena kṛpā ta' kariyā
verses.translation: If they see a Vaiṣṇava standing at the Siṁha-dvāra begging alms, out of mercy they arrange with the shopkeepers to give him something to eat.

verses.devanagari: এইমত সর্বকাল আছে ব্যবহার ।\\nনিষ্কিঞ্চন ভক্ত খাড়া হয় সিংহদ্বার ॥২১৭॥
verses.transliteration: ei-mata sarva-kāla āche vyavahāra\\nniṣkiñcana bhakta khāḍā haya siṁha-dvāra
verses.translation: Thus it is a custom for all time that a devotee who has no other means of support stands at the Siṁha-dvāra gate to receive alms from the servants.

verses.devanagari: সর্বদিন করেন বৈষ্ণব নাম-সঙ্কীর্তন  ।\\nস্বচ্ছন্দে করেন জগন্নাথ দরশন ॥২১৮॥
verses.transliteration: sarva-dina karena vaiṣṇava nāma-saṅkīrtana\\nsvacchande karena jagannātha daraśana
verses.translation: A completely dependent Vaiṣṇava thus chats the holy name of the Lord all day and sees Lord Jagannātha with full freedom.

verses.devanagari: কেহ ছত্রে মাগি’ খায়, যেবা কিছু পায়  ।\\nকেহ রাত্রে ভিক্ষা লাগি’ সিংহদ্বারে রয় ॥২১৯॥
verses.transliteration: keha chatre māgi' khāya, yebā kichu pāya\\nkeha rātre bhikṣā lāgi' siṁha-dvāre raya
verses.translation: It is a custom for some Vaiṣṇavas to beg from the charity booths and eat whatever they obtain, whereas others stand at night at the Siṁha-dvāra gate, begging alms from the servants.

verses.devanagari: মহাপ্রভুর ভক্তগণের বৈরাগ্য প্রধান ।\\nযাহা দেখি’ প্রীত হন গৌর-ভগবান্ ॥২২০॥
verses.transliteration: mahāprabhura bhakta-gaṇera vairāgya pradhāna\\nyāhā dekhi' prīta hana gaura-bhagavān
verses.translation: Renunciation is the basic principle sustaining the lives of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's devotees. Seeing this renunciation, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the Supreme Personality of Godhead, is extremely satisfied.
verses.purport: PURPORT\nAnyone, whether an ordinary materialistic person or a pure devotee, can understand the behavior of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's devotees if he studies it minutely. One will thus find that the devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu are not at all attached to any kind of material enjoyment. They have completely given up sense enjoyment to engage fully in the service of Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa and dedicate their lives and souls to serving Kṛṣṇa without material desires. Because their devotional service is free from material desires, it is unimpeded by material circumstances. Although ordinary men have great difficulty understanding this attitude of the devotees, it is greatly appreciated by the Supreme Personality of Godhead, Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: প্রভুরে গোবিন্দ কহে, — “রঘুনাথ ‘প্রসাদ’ না লয় ।\\nরাত্র্যে সিংহদ্বারে খাড়া হঞা মাগি’ খায় ।।” ॥ ২২১ ॥
verses.transliteration: prabhure govinda kahe,—"raghunātha 'prasāda' nā laya\\nrātrye siṁha-dvāre khāḍā hañā māgi' khāya"
verses.translation: Govinda said to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, "Raghunātha dāsa no longer takes prasāda here. Now he stands at the Siṁha-dvāra, where he begs some alms to eat."

verses.devanagari: শুনি’ তুষ্ট হঞা প্রভু কহিতে লাগিল  ।\\n“ভাল কৈল, বৈরাগীর ধর্ম আচরিল ॥২২২॥
verses.transliteration: śuni' tuṣṭa hañā prabhu kahite lāgila\\n"bhāla kaila, vairāgīra dharma ācarila
verses.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu heard this, He was greatly satisfied. "Raghunātha dāsa has done well," He said. "He has acted suitably for a person in the renounced order.

verses.devanagari: বৈরাগী করিবে সদা নাম-সঙ্কীর্তন  ।\\nমাগিয়া খাঞা করে জীবন রক্ষণ ॥২২৩॥
verses.transliteration: vairāgī karibe sadā nāma-saṅkīrtana\\nmāgiyā khāñā kare jīvana rakṣaṇa
verses.translation: "A person in the renounced order should always chant the holy name of the Lord. He should beg some alms to eat, and he should sustain his life in this way.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
As stated in the
Hari-bhakti-vilāsa
at the end of the Twentieth
Vilāsa
(366, 379, 382):
kṛtyānyetāni tu prāyo
gṛhiṇāṁ dhanināṁ satām
likhitāni na tu tyakta-
parigraha-mahātmanām
prabhāte cārdha-rātre ca
madhyāhne divasa-kṣaye
kīrtayanti hariṁ ye vai
te taranti bhavārṇavam
evam ekāntināṁ prāyaḥ
kīrtanaṁ smaraṇaṁ prabhoḥ
kurvatāṁ parama-prītyā
kṛtyam anyan na rocate
A well-to-do householder Vaiṣṇava cannot live like a person in the renounced order who completely takes shelter of the holy name. Such a householder should chant the holy name of Kṛṣṇa in the morning, at midday and in the evening. Then he will be able to cross beyond nescience. Pure devotees in the renounced order, however, who fully surrender to the lotus feet of Kṛṣṇa, should chant the holy name of the Lord with great love and faith, always thinking of Kṛṣṇa's lotus feet. They should have no other occupation than chanting the holy name of the Lord. In the
Bhakti-sandarbha,
Śrīla Jīva Gosvāmī says:
yadyapi śrī-bhāgavata-mate pañca-rātrādivad-arcana-mārgasyāvaśyakatvaṁ nāsti, tad vināpi śaraṇāpattyādīnām ekatareṇāpi puruṣārtha-siddher abhihitatvāt.

verses.devanagari: বৈরাগী হঞা যেবা করে পরাপেক্ষা ।\\nকার্যসিদ্ধি নহে, কৃষ্ণ করেন উপেক্ষা ॥২২৪॥
verses.transliteration: vairāgī hañā yebā kare parāpeksā\\nkārya-siddhi nahe, kṛṣṇa karena upekṣā
verses.translation: "A vairāgī [a person in the renounced order] should not depend on others. 'If he does so, he will be unsuccessful, and he will be neglected by Kṛṣṇa.

verses.devanagari: বৈরাগী হঞা করে জিহ্বার লালস ।\\nপরমার্থ যায়, আর হয় রসের বশ ॥২২৫॥
verses.transliteration: vairāgī hañā kare jihvāra lālasa\\nparamārtha yāya, āra haya rasera vaśa
verses.translation: "If a renunciant is eager for his tongue to taste different foods, his spiritual life will be lost, and he will be subservient to the tastes of his tongue.

verses.devanagari: বৈরাগীর কৃত্য — সদা নাম-সঙ্কীর্তন ।\\nশাক-পত্র-ফল-মূলে উদর-ভরণ ॥২২৬॥
verses.transliteration: vairāgīra kṛtya—sadā nāma-saṅkīrtana\\nśāka-patra-phala-mūle udara-bharaṇa
verses.translation: "The duty of a person in the renounced order is to chant the Hare Kṛṣṇa mantra always. He should satisfy his belly with whatever vegetables, leaves, fruits and roots are available.

verses.devanagari: জিহ্বার লালসে যেই ইতি-উতি ধায় ।\\nশিশ্নোদরপরায়ণ কৃষ্ণ নাহি পায় ।।” ॥ ২২৭ ॥
verses.transliteration: jihvāra lālase yei iti-uti dhāya\\nśiśnodara-parāyaṇa kṛṣṇa nāhi pāya"
verses.translation: "One who is subservient to the tongue and who thus goes here and there, devoted to the genitals and the belly, cannot attain Kṛṣṇa."

verses.devanagari: আর দিন রঘুনাথ স্বরূপ-চরণে ।\\nআপনার কৃত্য লাগি’ কৈলা নিবেদনে ॥২২৮॥
verses.transliteration: āra dina raghunātha svarūpa-caraṇe\\nāpanāra kṛtya lāgi' kailā nivedane
verses.translation: The next day, Raghunātha dāsa inquired at the lotus feet of Svarūpa Dāmodara about his duty.

verses.devanagari: “কি লাগি’ ছাড়াইলা ঘর, না জানি উদ্দেশ ।\\nকি মোর কর্তব্য, প্রভু কর উপদেশ ।।” ॥ ২২৯ ॥
verses.transliteration: "ki lāgi' chāḍāilā ghara, nā jāni uddeśa\\nki mora kartavya, prabhu kara upadeśa"
verses.translation: "I do not know why I have given up household life," he said. "What is my duty? Kindly give me instructions."

verses.devanagari: প্রভুর আগে কথা-মাত্র না কহে রঘুনাথ ।\\nস্বরূপ-গোবিন্দ-দ্বারা কহায় নিজ-বাত্ ॥২৩০॥
verses.transliteration: prabhura āge kathā-mātra nā kahe raghunātha\\nsvarūpa-govinda-dvārā kahā ya nija-vāt
verses.translation: Raghunātha dāsa never even spoke a word before the Lord. Instead, he informed the Lord of his desires through Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī and Govinda.

verses.devanagari: প্রভুর আগে স্বরূপ নিবেদিলা আর দিনে  ।\\nরঘুনাথ নিবেদয় প্রভুর চরণে ॥২৩১॥
verses.transliteration: prabhura āge svarūpa nivedilā āra dine\\nraghunātha nivedaya prabhura caraṇe
verses.translation: The next day, Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī submitted to Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, "Raghunātha dāsa has this to say at Your lotus feet.

verses.devanagari: “কি মোর কর্তব্য, মুঞি না জানি উদ্দেশ  ।\\nআপনি শ্রীমুখে মোরে কর উপদেশ ।।” ২৩২ ॥২৩২॥
verses.transliteration: "ki mora kartavya, muñi nā jāni uddeśa\\nāpani śrī-mukhe more kara upadeśa"
verses.translation: "I do not know my duty or the goal of my life. Therefore, please personally give me instructions from Your transcendental mouth.' "

verses.devanagari: হাসি’ মহাপ্রভু রঘুনাথেরে কহিল  ।\\n“তোমার উপদেষ্টা করি’ স্বরূপেরে দিল ॥২৩৩॥
verses.transliteration: hāsi' mahāprabhu raghunāthere kahila\\n"tomāra upadeṣṭā kari' svarūpere dila
verses.translation: Smiling, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu told Raghunātha dāsa, "I have already appointed Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī as your instructor.

verses.devanagari: ‘সাধ্য’-‘সাধন’-তত্ত্ব শিখ ইঁহার স্থানে  ।\\nআমি তত নাহি জানি, ইঁহো যত জানে ॥২৩৪॥
verses.transliteration: 'sādhya'-'sādhana'-tattva śikha iṅhāra sthāne\\nāmi tata nāhi jāni, iṅho yata jāne
verses.translation: "You may learn from him what your duty is and how to discharge it. I do not know as much as he.

verses.devanagari: তথাপি আমার আজ্ঞায় শ্রদ্ধা যদি হয় ।\\nআমার এই বাক্যে তবে করিহ নিশ্চয় ॥২৩৫॥
verses.transliteration: tathāpi āmāra ājñā ya śraddhā yadi haya\\nāmāra ei vākye tabe kariha niścaya
verses.translation: "Nevertheless, if you want to take instructions from Me with faith and love, you may ascertain your duties from the following words.

verses.devanagari: গ্রাম্যকথা না শুনিবে, গ্রাম্যবার্তা না কহিবে  ।\\nভাল না খাইবে আর ভাল না পরিবে ॥২৩৬॥
verses.transliteration: grāmya-kathā nā śunibe, grāmya-vārtā nā kahibe\\nbhāla nā khāibe āra bhāla nā paribe
verses.translation: "Do not talk like people in general or hear what they say. You should not eat very palatable food, nor should you dress very nicely.

verses.devanagari: অমানী মানদ হঞা কৃষ্ণনাম সদা ল’বে  ।\\nব্রজে রাধাকৃষ্ণ-সেবা মানসে করিবে ॥২৩৭॥
verses.transliteration: amānī mānada hañā kṛṣṇa-nāma sadā la'be\\nvraje rādhā-kṛṣṇa-sevā mānase karibe
verses.translation: "Do not expect honor, but offer all respect to others. Always chant the holy name of Lord Kṛṣṇa, and within your mind render service to Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa in Vṛndāvana.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Śrīla Bhaktivinoda Ṭhākura says in his
Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya
that when a man and woman are married, they beget children and are thus entangled in family life. Talk concerning such family life is called
grāmya-kathā.
A person in the renounced order never indulges in either hearing or talking about such subjects. He should not eat palatable dishes, since that is unfit for a person in the renounced order. He should show all respect to others, but should not expect respect for himself. In this way, one should chant the holy name of the Lord and think of how to serve Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa in Vṛndāvana.

verses.devanagari: এই ত’ সংক্ষেপে আমি কৈলুঁ উপদেশ ।\\nস্বরূপের ঠাঞি ইহার পাইবে বিশেষ ॥২৩৮॥
verses.transliteration: ei ta' saṅkṣepe āmi kailuṅ upadeśa\\nsvarūpera ṭhāñi ihāra pāibe viśeṣa
verses.translation: "I have briefly given you My instructions. Now you will get all details about them from Svarūpa Dāmodara.

verses.devanagari: তৃণাদপি সুনীচেন তরোরিব সহিষ্ণুনা ।\\nঅমানিনা মানদেন কীর্তনীয়ঃ সদা হরিঃ ।।” ॥ ২৩৯ ॥
verses.transliteration: tṛṇād api sunīcena\\ntaror iva sahiṣṇunā\\namāninā mānadena\\nkīrtanīyaḥ sadā hariḥ"
verses.translation: "One who thinks himself lower than grass, who is more tolerant tha a tree, and who does not expect personal honor but is always prepared to give respect to others, can very easily always chant the holy name of the Lord."

verses.devanagari: এত শুনি’ রঘুনাথ বন্দিলা চরণ ।\\nমহাপ্রভু কৈলা তাঁরে কৃপা-আলিঙ্গন ॥২৪০॥
verses.transliteration: eta śuni' raghunātha vandilā caraṇa\\nmahāprabhu kailā tāṅre kṛpā-āliṅgana
verses.translation: Having heard this, Raghunātha dāsa offered prayers at the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, and the Lord, with great mercy, embraced him.

verses.devanagari: পুনঃ সমর্পিলা তাঁরে স্বরূপের স্থানে ।\\n‘অন্তরঙ্গ-সেবা’ করে স্বরূপের সনে ॥২৪১॥
verses.transliteration: punaḥ samarpilā tāṅre svarūpera sthāne\\n'antaraṅga-sevā' kare svarūpera sane
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu again entrusted him to Svarūpa Dāmodara. Thus Raghunātha dāsa rendered very confidential service with Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī.
verses.purport: PURPORT\nAntaraṅga-sevā refers to service performed in one's spiritual body. Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī was formerly Lalitādevī. Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī, who was among his assistants, now also began to serve Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa within his mind.

verses.devanagari: হেন-কালে আইলা সব গৌড়ের ভক্তগণ ।\\nপূর্ববত্ প্রভু সবায় করিলা মিলন ॥২৪২॥
verses.transliteration: hena-kāle āilā saba gauḍera bhakta-gaṇa\\npūrvavat prabhu sabāya karilā milana
verses.translation: At this time, all the devotees from Bengal arrived, and, as previously, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu met them with great feeling.

verses.devanagari: সবা লঞা কৈলা প্রভু গুণ্ডিচা-মার্জন ।\\nসবা লঞা কৈলা প্রভু বন্য-ভোজন ॥২৪৩॥
verses.transliteration: sabā lañā kailā prabhu guṇḍicā-mārjana\\nsabā lañā kailā prabhu vanya-bhojana
verses.translation: As He had previously done, He cleansed the Guṇḍicā temple and held a picnic feast in the garden with the devotees.

verses.devanagari: রথযাত্রায় সবা লঞা করিলা নর্তন ।\\nদেখি’ রঘুনাথের চমৎকার হৈল মন ॥২৪৪॥
verses.transliteration: ratha-yātrāya sabā lañā karilā nartana\\ndekhi' raghunāthera camatkāra haila mana
verses.translation: The Lord again danced with the devotees during the Ratha-yātrā festival. Seeing this, Raghunātha dāsa was struck with wonder.

verses.devanagari: রঘুনাথ-দাস যবে সবারে মিলিলা ।\\nঅদ্বৈত-আচার্য তাঁরে বহু কৃপা কৈলা ॥২৪৫॥
verses.transliteration: raghunātha-dāsa yabe sabāre mililā\\nadvaita-ācārya tāṅre bahu kṛpā kailā
verses.translation: When Raghunātha dāsa met all the devotees, Advaita Ācārya showed him great mercy.

verses.devanagari: শিবানন্দ-সেন তাঁরে কহেন বিবরণ  ।\\nতোমা লৈতে তোমার পিতা পাঠাইল দশ জন ॥২৪৬॥
verses.transliteration: śivānanda-sena tāṅre kahena vivaraṇa\\ntomā laite tomāra pitā pāṭhāila daśa jana
verses.translation: He also met Śivānanda Sena, who informed him, "Your father sent ten men to take you away.

verses.devanagari: তোমারে পাঠাইতে পত্রী পাঠাইল মোরে  ।\\nঝাঁকরা হইতে তোমা না পাঞা গেল ঘরে ॥২৪৭॥
verses.transliteration: tomāre pāṭhāite patrī pāṭhāila more\\njhāṅkarā ha-ite tomā nā pāñā gela ghare
verses.translation: "He wrote me a letter asking me to send you back, but when those ten men received no information about you, they returned home from Jhāṅkarā."

verses.devanagari: চারি মাস রহি’ ভক্তগণ গৌড়ে গেলা ।\\nশুনি’ রঘুনাথের পিতা মনুষ্য পাঠাইলা ॥২৪৮॥
verses.transliteration: cāri māsa rahi' bhakta-gaṇa gauḍe gelā\\nśuni' raghunāthera pitā manuṣya pāṭhāilā
verses.translation: When all the devotees from Bengal returned home after staying at Jagannātha Purī for four months, Raghunātha dāsa's father heard about their arrival and therefore sent a man to Śivānanda Sena.

verses.devanagari: সে মনুষ্য শিবানন্দ-সেনেরে পুছিল  ।\\n“মহাপ্রভুর স্থানে এক ‘বৈরাগী’ দেখিল ॥২৪৯॥
verses.transliteration: se manuṣya śivānanda-senere puchila\\n"mahāprabhura sthāne eka 'vairāgī' dekhila
verses.translation: That man inquired from Śivānanda Sena, "Did you see anyone in the renounced order at the residence of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu?

verses.devanagari: গোবর্ধনের পুত্র তেঁহো, নাম — ‘রঘুনাথ’  ।\\nনীলাচলে পরিচয় আছে তোমার সাথ ?” ॥২৫০॥
verses.transliteration: govardhanera putra teṅho, nāma—'raghunātha'\\nnīlācale paricaya āche tomāra sātha?"
verses.translation: "That person is Raghunātha dāsa, the son of Govardhana Majumadāra. Did you meet him in Nīlācala?"

verses.devanagari: শিবানন্দ কহে, — “তেঁহো হয় প্রভুর স্থানে ।\\nপরম বিখ্যাত তেঁহো, কেবা নাহি জানে ॥২৫১॥
verses.transliteration: śivānanda kahe,—"teṅho haya prabhura sthāne\\nparama vikhyāta teṅho, kebā nāhi jāne
verses.translation: Śivānanda Sena replied, "Yes, sir. Raghunātha dāsa is with Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and is a very famous man. Who does not know him?

verses.devanagari: স্বরূপের স্থানে তারে করিয়াছেন সমর্পণ ।\\nপ্রভুর ভক্তগণের তেঁহো হয় প্রাণসম ॥২৫২॥
verses.transliteration: svarūpera sthāne tāre kariyāchena samarpaṇa\\nprabhura bhakta-gaṇera teṅho haya prāṇa-sama
verses.translation: "Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu has placed him under the charge of Svarūpa Dāmodara. Raghunātha dāsa has become just like the life of all the Lord's devotees.

verses.devanagari: রাত্রি-দিন করে তেঁহো নাম-সঙ্কীর্তন ।\\nক্ষণমাত্র নাহি ছাড়ে প্রভুর চরণ ॥২৫৩॥
verses.transliteration: rātri-dina kare teṅho nāma-saṅkīrtana\\nkṣaṇa-mātra nāhi chāḍe prabhura caraṇa
verses.translation: "He chants the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra all day and night. He never gives up the shelter of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, not even for a moment.

verses.devanagari: পরম বৈরাগ্য তার, নাহি ভক্ষ্য-পরিধান ।\\nযৈছে তৈছে আহার করি’ রাখয়ে পরাণ ॥২৫৪॥
verses.transliteration: parama vairāgya tāra, nāhi bhakṣya-paridhāna\\nyaiche taiche āhāra kari' rākhaye parāṇa
verses.translation: "He is in the supreme order of renounced life. Indeed, he does not care about eating or dressing. Somehow or other he eats and maintains his life.

verses.devanagari: দশদণ্ড রাত্রি গেলে ‘পুষ্পাঞ্জলি’ দেখিয়া ।\\nসিংহদ্বারে খাড়া হয় আহার লাগিয়া ॥২৫৫॥
verses.transliteration: daśa-daṇḍa rātri gele 'puṣpāñjali' dekhiyā\\nsiṁha-dvāre khāḍā haya āhāra lāgiyā
verses.translation: "After ten daṇḍas [four hours] of the night have passed and Raghunātha dāsa has seen the performance of puṣpāñjali, he stands at the Siṁha-dvāra gate to beg some alms to eat.

verses.devanagari: কেহ যদি দেয়, তবে করয়ে ভক্ষণ ।\\nকভু উপবাস, কভু করয়ে চর্বণ ।।” ॥ ২৫৬ ॥
verses.transliteration: keha yadi deya, tabe karaye bhakṣaṇa\\nkabhu upavāsa, kabhu karaye carvaṇa"
verses.translation: "He eats if someone gives him something to eat. Sometimes he fasts, and sometimes he chews fried grains."

verses.devanagari: এত শুনি’ সেই মনুষ্য গোবর্ধন-স্থানে ।\\nকহিল গিয়া সব রঘুনাথ-বিবরণে ॥২৫৭॥
verses.transliteration: eta śuni' sei manuṣya govardhana-sthāne\\nkahila giyā saba raghunātha-vivaraṇe
verses.translation: After hearing this, the messenger returned to Govardhana Majumadāra and informed him all about Raghunātha dāsa.

verses.devanagari: শুনি’ তাঁর মাতা পিতা দুঃখিত হইল ।\\nপুত্র-ঠাঞি দ্রব্য-মনুষ্য পাঠাইতে মন কৈল ॥২৫৮॥
verses.transliteration: śuni' tāṅra mātā pitā duḥkhita ha-ila\\nputra-ṭhāñi dravya-manuṣya pāṭhāite mana kaila
verses.translation: Hearing the description of Raghunātha dāsa's behavior in the renounced order, his father and mother were very unhappy. Therefore they decided to send him some men with goods for his comfort.

verses.devanagari: চারিশত মুদ্রা, দুই ভৃত্য, এক ব্রাহ্মণ ।\\nশিবানন্দের ঠাঞি পাঠাইল ততক্ষণ ॥২৫৯॥
verses.transliteration: cāri-śata mudrā, dui bhṛtya, eka brāhmaṇa\\nśivānandera ṭhāñi pāṭhāila tata-kṣaṇa
verses.translation: Raghunātha dāsa's father immediately sent four hundred coins, two servants and one brāhmaṇa to Śivānanda Sena.

verses.devanagari: শিবানন্দ কহে, — “তুমি সব যাইতে নারিবা ।\\nআমি যাই যবে, আমার সঙ্গে যাইবা ॥২৬০॥
verses.transliteration: śivānanda kahe,—"tumi saba yāite nāribā\\nāmi yāi yabe, āmāra saṅge yāibā
verses.translation: Śivānanda Sena informed them, "You cannot go to Jagannātha Purī directly. When I go there, you may accompany me.

verses.devanagari: এবে ঘর যাহ, যবে আমি সব চলিমু ।\\nতবে তোমা সবাকারে সঙ্গে লঞা যামু ।।” ॥ ২৬১ ॥
verses.transliteration: ebe ghara yāha, yabe āmi saba calimu\\ntabe tomā sabākāre saṅge lañā yāmu
verses.translation: "Now go home. When all of us go, I shall take all of you with me."

verses.devanagari: এই ত’ প্রস্তাবে শ্রীকবিকর্ণপূর ।\\nরঘুনাথ-মহিমা গ্রন্থে লিখিলা প্রচুর ॥২৬২॥
verses.transliteration: ei ta' prastāve śrī kavi-karṇapūra\\nraghunātha-mahimā granthe likhilā pracura
verses.translation: Describing this incident, the great poet Śrī Kavi-karṇapūra has written extensively about the glorious activities of Raghunātha dāsa in his book.

verses.devanagari: আচার্যো যদুনন্দনঃ সুমধুরঃ শ্রীবাসুদেবপ্রিয়-\\nস্তচ্ছিষ্যো রঘুনাথ ইত্যধিগুণঃ প্রাণাধিকো মাদৃশাম্ ।\\nশ্রীচৈতন্যকৃপাতিরেকসততস্নিগ্ধঃ স্বরূপানুগো\\nবৈরাগ্যৈকনিধির্নকস্য বিদিতো নীলাচলে তিষ্ঠতাম্ ॥২৬৩॥
verses.transliteration: ācāryo yadunandanaḥ sumadhuraḥ śrī-vāsudeva-priyas\\ntac-chiṣyo raghunātha ity adhiguṇaḥ prāṇādhiko mādṛśām\\nśrī-caitanya-kṛpātireka-satata-snigdhaḥ svarūpānugo\\nvairāgyaika-nidhir na kasya vidito nīlācale tiṣṭhatām
verses.translation: "Raghunātha dāsa is a disciple of Yadunandana Ācārya, who is very gentle and is extremely dear to Vāsudeva Datta, a resident of Kāñcanapallī. Because of Raghunātha dāsa's transcendental qualities, he is always more dear than life for all of us devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Since he has been favored by the abundant mercy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, he is always pleasing. Vividly providing a superior example for the renounced order, this very dear follower of Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī is the ocean of renunciation. Who among the residents of Nīlācala [Jagannātha Purī] does not know him very well?
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This verse is from
Śrī Caitanya-candrodaya-nāṭaka
(10.3) of Kavi-karṇapūra.

verses.devanagari: যঃ সর্বলোকৈকমনোভিরুচ্যা\\nসৌভাগ্যভূঃ কাচিদকৃষ্টপচ্যা ।\\nযত্রায়মারোপণতুল্যকালং\\nতৎপ্রেমশাখী ফলবানতুল্যঃ ॥২৬৪॥
verses.transliteration: yaḥ sarva-lokaika-manobhirucyā\\nsaubhāgya-bhūḥ kācid akṛṣṭa-pacyā\\nyatrāyam āropaṇa-tulya-kālaṁ\\ntat-prema-śākhī phalavān atulyaḥ
verses.translation: "Because he is very pleasing to all the devotees, Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī easily became like the fertile earth of good fortune in which it was suitable for the seed of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu to be sown. At the same time that the seed was sown, it grew into a matchless tree of the love of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and produced fruit."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This is the next verse from
Śrī Caitanya-candrodaya-nāṭaka
(10.4).

verses.devanagari: শিবানন্দ যৈছে সেই মনুষ্যে কহিলা ।\\nকর্ণপূর সেইরূপে শ্লোক বর্ণিলা ॥২৬৫॥
verses.transliteration: śivānanda yaiche sei manuṣye kahilā\\nkarṇapūra sei-rūpe śloka varṇilā
verses.translation: In these verses, the great poet Kavi-karṇapūra gives the same information that Śivānanda Sena conveyed to the messenger from Raghunātha dāsa's father.

verses.devanagari: বর্ষান্তরে শিবানন্দ চলে নীলাচলে ।\\nরঘুনাথের সেবক, বিপ্র তাঁর সঙ্গে চলে ॥২৬৬॥
verses.transliteration: varṣāntare śivānanda cale nīlācale\\nraghunāthera sevaka, vipra tāṅra saṅge cale
verses.translation: The next year, when Śivānanda Sena was going to Jagannātha Purī as usual, the servants and the brāhmaṇa, who was a cook, went with him.

verses.devanagari: সেই বিপ্র ভৃত্য, চারি-শত মুদ্রা লঞা ।\\nনীলাচলে রঘুনাথে মিলিলা আসিয়া ॥২৬৭॥
verses.transliteration: sei vipra bhṛtya, cāri-śata mudrā lañā\\nnīlācale raghunāthe mililā āsiyā
verses.translation: The servants and brāhmaṇa brought four hundred coins to Jagannātha Purī, and there they met Raghunātha dāsa.

verses.devanagari: রঘুনাথ-দাস অঙ্গীকার না করিল ।\\nদ্রব্য লঞা দুইজন তাহাঁই রহিল ॥২৬৮॥
verses.transliteration: raghunātha-dāsa aṅgīkāra nā karila\\ndravya lañā dui-jana tāhāṅi rahila
verses.translation: Raghunātha dāsa did not accept the money and men sent by his father. Therefore a servant and the brāhmaṇa stayed there with the money.

verses.devanagari: তবে রঘুনাথ করি’ অনেক যতন ।\\nমাসে দুইদিন কৈলা প্রভুর নিমন্ত্রণ ॥২৬৯॥
verses.transliteration: tabe raghunātha kari' aneka yatana\\nmāse dui-dina kailā prabhura nimantraṇa
verses.translation: At that time, Raghunātha dāsa invited Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to his house with great attention for two days every month.

verses.devanagari: দুই নিমন্ত্রণে লাগে কৌড়ি অষ্টপণ ।\\nব্রাহ্মণ-ভৃত্য-ঠাঞি করেন এতেক গ্রহণ ॥২৭০॥
verses.transliteration: dui nimantraṇe lāge kauḍi aṣṭa-paṇa\\nbrāhmaṇa-bhṛtya-ṭhāñi karena eteka grahaṇa
verses.translation: The cost for these two occasions was 640 kauḍis. Therefore he would take that much from the servant and the brāhmaṇa.

verses.devanagari: এইমত নিমন্ত্রণ বর্ষ দুই কৈলা ।\\nপাছে রঘুনাথ নিমন্ত্রণ ছাড়ি’ দিলা ॥২৭১॥
verses.transliteration: ei-mata nimantraṇa varṣa dui kailā\\npāche raghunātha nimantraṇa chāḍi' dilā
verses.translation: Raghunātha dāsa continued to invite Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu in this way for two years, but at the end of the second year he stopped.

verses.devanagari: মাস-দুই যবে রঘুনাথ না করে নিমন্ত্রণ  ।\\nস্বরূপে পুছিলা তবে শচীর নন্দন ॥২৭২॥
verses.transliteration: māsa-dui yabe raghunātha nā kare nimantraṇa\\nsvarūpe puchilā tabe śacīra nandana
verses.translation: When Raghunātha dāsa neglected to invite Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu for two consecutive months, the Lord, the son of Śacī, questioned Svarūpa Dāmodara.

verses.devanagari: ‘রঘু কেনে আমায় নিম়ন্ত্রণ ছাড়ি’ দিল ?’ স্বরূপ কহে, — “মনে কিছু বিচার করিল ॥২৭৩॥
verses.transliteration: 'raghu kene āmāya nimantraṇa chāḍi' dila?'\\nsvarūpa kahe,—"mane kichu vicāra karila
verses.translation: The Lord asked, "Why has Raghunātha dāsa stopped inviting Me?" Svarūpa Dāmodara replied, "He must have reconsidered something in his mind.

verses.devanagari: বিষয়ীর দ্রব্য লঞা করি নিমন্ত্রণ  ।\\nপ্রসন্ন না হয় ইহায় জানি প্রভুর মন ॥২৭৪॥
verses.transliteration: viṣayīra dravya lañā kari nimantraṇa\\nprasanna nā haya ihāya jāni prabhura mana
verses.translation: “ 'I invite Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu by accepting goods from materialistic people. I know that the Lord's mind is not satisfied by this.

verses.devanagari: মোর চিত্ত দ্রব্য লইতে না হয় নির্মল ।\\nএই নিমন্ত্রণে দেখি, — ‘প্রতিষ্ঠা’-মাত্র ফল ॥২৭৫॥
verses.transliteration: mora citta dravya la-ite nā haya nirmala\\nei nimantraṇe dekhi,—'pratiṣṭhā'-mātra phala
verses.translation: “ 'My consciousness is impure because I accept all these goods from people who are interested only in pounds, shillings and pence. Therefore by this kind of invitation I only get some material reputation.
verses.purport: PURPORT\nŚrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura remarks that people who are under the bodily conception of life are called materialists. If we accept the offerings of such people, place them before the Lord and invite Vaiṣṇavas to partake of the prasāda, that attempt will gain us only a material reputation, not the actual benefit of service to a pure Vaiṣṇava. One should therefore try to serve the Supreme Personality of Godhead by fully surrendering at His lotus feet. If one engages for the service of the Lord whatever money one has honestly earned, that is spiritual service to the Supreme Personality of Godhead, the spiritual master and the Vaiṣṇavas.

verses.devanagari: উপরোধে প্রভু মোর মানেন নিমন্ত্রণ ।\\nনা মানিলে দুঃখী হইবেক মূর্খ জন ॥২৭৬॥
verses.transliteration: uparodhe prabhu mora mānena nimantraṇa\\nnā mānile duḥkhī ha-ibeka mūrkha jana
verses.translation: “ 'At my request Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu accepts the invitations because He knows that a foolish person like me would be unhappy if He did not accept them.'
verses.purport: PURPORT\nŚrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura says that people who are advanced in learning but attached to material enjoyment, who are puffed up by material possessions, by birth in an elevated aristocratic family or by education, may offer showbottle devotional service to the Deity and also offer prasāda to Vaiṣṇavas. Because of their ignorance, however, they cannot understand that since their minds are materially polluted, neither the Supreme Personality of Godhead, Lord Kṛṣṇa, nor the Vaiṣṇavas accept their offerings. If one accepts money from such materialistic persons to offer food to the Deity and Vaiṣṇavas, a pure Vaiṣṇava does not accept it. This causes unhappiness for the materialists because they are fully absorbed in the bodily conception of life. Therefore they sometimes turn against the Vaiṣṇavas.

verses.devanagari: এত বিচারিয়া নিমন্ত্রণ ছাড়ি’ দিল”  ।\\nশুনি’ মহাপ্রভু হাসি’ বলিতে লাগিল ॥২৭৭॥
verses.transliteration: eta vicāriyā nimantraṇa chāḍi' dila"\\nśuni' mahāprabhu hāsi' balite lāgila
verses.translation: "Considering all these points," Svarūpa Dāmodara concluded, "he has stopped inviting You." Hearing this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu smiled and spoke as follows.

verses.devanagari: “বিষয়ীর অন্ন খাইলে মলিন হয় মন  ।\\nমলিন মন হৈলে নহে কৃষ্ণের স্মরণ ॥২৭৮॥
verses.transliteration: "viṣayīra anna khāile malina haya mana\\nmalina mana haile nahe kṛṣṇera smaraṇa
verses.translation: "When one eats food offered by a materialistic man, one's mind becomes contaminated, and when the mind is contaminated, one is unable to think of Kṛṣṇa properly.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura suggests that people who are materialistically inclined and
sahajiyās,
or so-called Vaiṣṇavas who take everything very casually, are both
viṣayī
materialists. Eating food offered by them causes contamination, and as a result of such contamination, even a serious devotee becomes like a materialistic man. There are six kinds of association-giving charity, accepting charity, accepting food, offering food, talking confidentially and inquiring confidentially. One should very carefully avoid associating with both the
sahajiyās,
who are sometimes known as Vaiṣṇavas, and the non-Vaiṣṇavas, or avaiṣṇavas. Their association changes the transcendental devotional service of Lord Kṛṣṇa into sense gratification, and when sense gratification enters the mind of a devotee, he is contaminated. The materialistic person who aspires after sense gratification cannot properly think of Kṛṣṇa.

verses.devanagari: বিষয়ীর অন্ন হয় ‘রাজস’ নিমন্ত্রণ ।\\nদাতা, ভোক্তা — দুঁহার মলিন হয় মন ॥২৭৯॥
verses.transliteration: viṣayīra anna haya 'rājasa' nimantraṇa\\ndātā, bhoktā—duṅhāra malina haya mana
verses.translation: "When one accepts an invitation from a person contaminated by the material mode of passion, the person who offers the food and the person who accepts it are both mentally contaminated.
verses.purport: PURPORT\nŚrīla Bhaktivinoda Ṭhākura says that there are three varieties of invitations—those in the mode of goodness, those in passion and those in ignorance. An invitation accepted from a pure devotee is in the mode of goodness, an invitation accepted from a person who is pious but materially attached is in the mode of passion, and an invitation accepted from a person who is materially very sinful is in the mode of ignorance.

verses.devanagari: ইঁহার সঙ্কোচে আমি এত দিন নিল ।\\nভাল হৈল — জানিয়া আপনি ছাড়ি দিল ।।” ॥ ২৮০ ॥
verses.transliteration: iṅhāra saṅkoce āmi eta dina nila\\nbhāla haila—jāniyā āpani chāḍi dila"
verses.translation: "Because of Raghunātha dāsa's eagerness, I accepted his invitation for many days. It is very good that Raghunātha dāsa, knowing this, has now automatically given up this practice."

verses.devanagari: কত দিনে রঘুনাথ সিংহদ্বার ছাড়িলা ।\\nছত্রে যাই’ মাগিয়া খাইতে আরম্ভ করিলা ॥২৮১॥
verses.transliteration: kata dine raghunātha siṁha-dvāra chāḍilā\\nchatre yāi' māgiyā khāite ārambha karilā
verses.translation: After some days, Raghunātha dāsa gave up standing near the Siṁha-dvāra gate and instead began eating by begging alms from a booth for free distribution of food.

verses.devanagari: গোবিন্দ-পাশ শুনি’ প্রভু পুছেন স্বরূপেরে ।\\n‘রঘু ভিক্ষা লাগি’ ঠাড় কেনে নহে সিংহদ্বারে ?’ ॥২৮২॥
verses.transliteration: govinda-pāśa śuni' prabhu puchena svarūpere\\n'raghu bhikṣā lāgi' ṭhāḍa kene nahe siṁha-dvāre'?
verses.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu heard this news from Govinda, He inquired from Svarūpa Dāmodara, "Why does Raghunātha dāsa no longer stand at the Siṁha-dvāra gate to beg alms?"

verses.devanagari: স্বরূপ কহে, — “সিংহদ্বারে দুঃখ অনুভবিয়া ।\\nছত্রে মাগি’ খায় মধ্যাহ্নকালে গিয়া ।।” ॥ ২৮৩ ॥
verses.transliteration: svarūpa kahe,—"siṁha-dvāre duḥkha anubhaviyā\\nchatre māgi' khāya madhyāhna-kāle giyā"
verses.translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara replied, "Raghunātha dāsa felt unhappy standing at the Siṁha-dvāra. Therefore he is now going at midday to beg alms from the charity booth."

verses.devanagari: প্রভু কহে, — “ভাল কৈল, ছাড়িল সিংহদ্বার ।\\nসিংহদ্বারে ভিক্ষা-বৃত্তি — বেশ্যার আচার ॥২৮৪॥
verses.transliteration: prabhu kahe,—"bhāla kaila, chāḍila siṁha-dvāra\\nsiṁha-dvāre bhikṣā-vṛtti—veṣyāra ācāra
verses.translation: Hearing this news, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "He has done very well by no longer standing at the Siṁha-dvāra gate. Such begging of alms resembles the behavior of a prostitute.

verses.devanagari: তথাহি — কিমর্থময়মাগচ্ছতি,\\nঅয়ং দাস্যতি, অনেন দত্তময়-মপরঃ ।\\nসমেত্যয়ং দাস্যতি, অনেনাপি ন\\nদত্তমন্যঃ সমেষ্যতি, স দাস্যতি ইত্যাদি ॥২৮৫॥
verses.transliteration: kim artham ayam āgacchati, ayaṁ dāsyati, anena dattam ayam aparaḥ. samety ayaṁ dāsyati, anenāpi na dattam anyaḥ sameṣyati, sa dāsyati ity ādi.
verses.translation: "Here is a person coming near. He will give me something. This person gave me something last night. Now another person is coming near. He may give me something. The person who just passed did not give me anything, but another person will come, and he will give me something.' Thus a person in the renounced order gives up his neutrality and depends on the charity of this person or that. Thinking in this way, he adopts the occupation of a prostitute.

verses.devanagari: ছত্রে যাই যথা-লাভ উদর-ভরণ ।\\nঅন্য কথা নাহি, সুখে কৃষ্ণসঙ্কীর্তন ।।” ॥ ২৮৬ ॥
verses.transliteration: chatre yāi yathā-lābha udara-bharaṇa\\nanya kathā nāhi, sukhe kṛṣṇa-saṅkīrtana"
verses.translation: "If one goes to the booth where free food is distributed and fills his belly with whatever he obtains, there is no chance of further unwanted talk, and one can very peacefully chant the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra."

verses.devanagari: এত বলি’ তাঁরে পুনঃ প্রসাদ করিলা ।\\n‘গোবর্ধনের শিলা’, ‘গুঞ্জা-মালা’ তাঁরে দিলা ॥২৮৭॥
verses.transliteration: eta bali' tāṅre punaḥ prasāda karilā\\n'govardhanera śilā', 'guñjā-mālā' tāṅre dilā
verses.translation: After saying this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu again bestowed His mercy upon Raghunātha dāsa by giving him a piece of stone from Govardhana Hill and a garland of small conchshells.

verses.devanagari: শঙ্করানন্দ-সরস্বতী বৃন্দাবন হৈতে আইলা ।\\nতেঁহ সেই শিলা-গুঞ্জামালা লঞা গেলা ॥২৮৮॥
verses.transliteration: śaṅkarānanda-sarasvatī vṛndāvana haite āilā\\nteṅha sei śilā-guñjā-mālā lañā gelā
verses.translation: Previously, when Śaṅkarānanda Sarasvatī had returned from Vṛndāvana, he had brought the piece of stone from Govardhana Hill and also the garland of conchshells.

verses.devanagari: পার্শ্বে গাঁথা গুঞ্জামালা, গোবর্ধনশিলা ।\\nদুই বস্তু মহাপ্রভুর আগে আনি’ দিলা ॥২৮৯॥
verses.transliteration: pārśve gāṅthā guñjā-mālā, govardhana-śilā\\ndui vastu mahāprabhura āge āni' dilā
verses.translation: He presented Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu these two items—the garland of conchshells and the stone from Govardhana Hill.

verses.devanagari: দুই অপূর্ব-বস্তু পাঞা প্রভু তুষ্ট হৈলা ।\\nস্মরণের কালে গলে পরে গুঞ্জামালা ॥২৯০॥
verses.transliteration: dui apūrva-vastu pāñā prabhu tuṣṭa hailā\\nsmaraṇera kāle gale pare guñjā-mālā
verses.translation: Upon receiving these two uncommon items, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was extremely happy. While chanting, He would put the garland around His neck.

verses.devanagari: গোবর্ধন-শিলা প্রভু হৃদয়ে-নেত্রে ধরে ।\\nকভু নাসায় ঘ্রাণ লয়, কভু শিরে করে ॥২৯১॥
verses.transliteration: govardhana-śilā prabhu hṛdaye-netre dhare\\nkabhu nāsāya ghrāṇa laya, kabhu śire kare
verses.translation: The Lord would put the stone to His heart or sometimes to His eyes. Sometimes He would smell it with His nose and sometimes place it on His head.

verses.devanagari: নেত্রজলে সেই শিলা ভিজে নিরন্তর ।\\nশিলারে কহেন প্রভু — ‘কৃষ্ণ-কলেবর’ ॥২৯২॥
verses.transliteration: netra-jale sei śilā bhije nirantara\\nśilāre kahena prabhu—'kṛṣṇa-kalevara'
verses.translation: The stone from Govardhana was always moist with tears from His eyes. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would say, "This stone is directly the body of Lord Kṛṣṇa."

verses.devanagari: এইমত তিনবৎসর শিলা-মালা ধরিলা ।\\nতুষ্ট হঞা শিলা-মালা রঘুনাথে দিলা ॥২৯৩॥
verses.transliteration: ei-mata tina-vatsara śilā-mālā dharilā\\ntuṣṭa hañā śilā-mālā raghunāthe dilā
verses.translation: For three years He kept the stone and garland. Then, greatly satisfied by the behavior of Raghunātha dāsa, the Lord delivered both of them to him.

verses.devanagari: প্রভু কহে, — “এই শিলা কৃষ্ণের বিগ্রহ ।\\nইঁহার সেবা কর তুমি করিয়া আগ্রহ ॥২৯৪॥
verses.transliteration: prabhu kahe,—"ei śilā kṛṣṇera vigraha\\niṅhāra sevā kara tumi kariyā āgraha
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu instructed Raghunātha dāsa, "This stone is the transcendental form of Lord Kṛṣṇa. Worship the stone with great eagerness."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura writes in his
Anubhāṣya
that in the opinion of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the
govardhana-śilā,
the stone from Govardhana Hill, was directly the form of Kṛṣṇa, the son of Mahārāja Nanda. The Lord used the stone for three years, and then in the heart of Raghunātha dāsa the Lord awakened devotional service to the stone. The Lord then gave the stone to Raghunātha dāsa, accepting him as one of His most confidential servants. However, some envious people conclude that because Raghunātha dāsa had not taken birth in the family of a
brāhmaṇa,
Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu did not give him the right to worship the Deity directly, but instead gave him a stone from Govardhana. This kind of thought is
nārakī,
or hellish. As stated in the
Padma Purāṇa, arcye viṣṇau śilādhīr guruṣu nara-matir vaiṣṇave jāti-buddhiḥ. ..yasya vā nārakī saḥ:
"One who considers the
arcā-mūrti
(the worshipable Deity of Lord Viṣṇu) to be stone, the spiritual master to be an ordinary human being, or a Vaiṣṇava to belong to a particular creed is possessed of hellish intelligence." If one thinks that the worshipable
śālagrāma-śilā
is a mere stone, that the spiritual master is an ordinary human being or that a pure Vaiṣṇava preaching the
bhakti
cult all over the world is a member of a particular caste or material division of society, he is considered a
nārakī,
a candidate for hellish life. When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu instructed that the
govardhana-śilā,
the stone taken from Govardhana, is nondifferent from the body of Śrī Kṛṣṇa, the Supreme Personality of Godhead, He indirectly advised such foolish persons that one should not be envious of a Vaiṣṇava who belongs to a different caste or sect. One should accept a Vaiṣṇava as transcendental. in this way one can be saved; otherwise, one is surely awaiting a hellish life.

verses.devanagari: এই শিলার কর তুমি সাত্ত্বিক পূজন ।\\nঅচিরাৎ পাবে তুমি কৃষ্ণপ্রেমধন ॥২৯৫॥
verses.transliteration: ei śilāre kara tumi sāttvika pūjana\\nacirāt pābe tumi kṛṣṇa-prema-dhana
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu continued, "Worship this stone in the mode of goodness like a perfect brāhmaṇa, for by such worship you will surely attain ecstatic love of Kṛṣṇa without delay.

verses.devanagari: এক কুঁজা জল আর তুলসী-মঞ্জরী ।\\nসাত্ত্বিক-সেবা এই — শুদ্ধ ভাবে করি ॥২৯৬॥
verses.transliteration: eka kuṅjā jala āra tulasī-mañjarī\\nsāttvika-sevā ei—śuddha-bhāve kari
verses.translation: "For such worship, one needs a jug of water and a few flowers from a tulasī tree. This is worship in complete goodness when performed in complete purity.

verses.devanagari: দুইদিকে দুইপত্র মধ্যে কোমল মঞ্জরী ।\\nএইমত অষ্টমঞ্জরী দিবে শ্রদ্ধা করি’ ।।” ॥ ২৯৭ ॥
verses.transliteration: dui-dike dui-patra madhye komala mañjarī\\nei-mata aṣṭa-mañjarī dibe śraddhā kari" '
verses.translation: "With faith and love, you should offer eight soft tulasī flowers, each with two tulasī leaves, one on each side of each flower."

verses.devanagari: শ্রীহস্তে শিলা দিয়া এই আজ্ঞা দিলা ।\\nআনন্দে রঘুনাথ সেবা করিতে লাগিলা ॥২৯৮॥
verses.transliteration: śrī-haste śilā diyā ei ājñā dilā\\nānande raghunātha sevā karite lāgilā
verses.translation: After thus advising him how to worship, Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu personally offered Raghunātha dāsa the govardhana-śilā with His transcendental hand. As advised by the Lord, Raghunātha dāsa worshiped the śilā in great transcendental jubilation.

verses.devanagari: এক-বিতস্তি দুইবস্ত্র, পিঁড়া একখানি ।\\nস্বরূপ দিলেন কুঁজা আনিবারে পানি ॥২৯৯॥
verses.transliteration: eka-vitasti dui-vastra, piṅḍā eka-khāni\\nsvarūpa dilena kuṅjā ānibāre pāni
verses.translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara gave Raghunātha dāsa two cloths, each about six inches long, a wooden platform and a jug in which to keep water.

verses.devanagari: এইমত রঘুনাথ করেন পূজন ।\\nপূজা-কালে দেখে শিলায় ‘ব্রজেন্দ্রনন্দন’ ॥৩০০॥
verses.transliteration: ei-mata raghunātha karena pūjana\\npūjā-kāle dekhe śilāya 'vrajendra-nandana'
verses.translation: Thus Raghunātha dāsa began worshiping the stone from Govardhana, and as he worshiped he saw the Supreme Personality of Godhead, Kṛṣṇa, the son of Nanda Mahārāja, directly in the stone.

verses.devanagari: ‘প্রভুর স্বহস্ত-দত্ত গোবর্ধন-শিলা ।\\nএই চিন্তি’ রঘুনাথ প্রেমে ভাসি’ গেলা ॥৩০১॥
verses.transliteration: 'prabhura svahasta-datta govardhana-śilā\\nei cinti' raghunātha preme bhāsi' gelā
verses.translation: Thinking of how he had received the govardhana-śilā directly from the hands of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Raghunātha dāsa was always overflooded with ecstatic love.

verses.devanagari: জল-তুলসীর সেবায় তাঁর যত সুখোদয় ।\\nষোড়শোপচার-পূজায় তত সুখ নয় ॥৩০২॥
verses.transliteration: jala-tulasīra sevāya tāṅra yata sukhodaya\\nṣoḍaśopacāra-pūjāya tata sukha naya
verses.translation: The amount of transcendental bliss that Raghunātha dāsa enjoyed simply by offering water and tulasī is impossible to achieve even if one worships the Deity with sixteen kinds of paraphernalia.

verses.devanagari: এইমত কত দিন করেন পূজন  ।\\nতবে স্বরূপ-গোসাঞি তাঁরে কহিলা বচন ॥৩০৩॥
verses.transliteration: ei-mata kata dina karena pūjana\\ntabe svarūpa-gosāñi tāṅre kahilā vacana
verses.translation: After Raghunātha dāsa had thus worshiped the govardhana-śilā for some time, Svarūpa Dāmodara one day spoke to him as follows.

verses.devanagari: “অষ্ট-কৌড়ির খাজা-সন্দেশ কর সমর্পণ  ।\\nশ্রদ্ধা করি’ দিলে, সেই অমৃতের সম ।।” ৩০৪ ॥৩০৪॥
verses.transliteration: "aṣṭa-kauḍira khājā-sandeśa kara samarpaṇa\\nśraddhā kari' dile, sei amṛtera sama
verses.translation: "Offer the Govardhana stone eight kauḍis worth of the first-class sweetmeats known as khājā and sandeśa. If you offer them with faith and love, they will be just like nectar."

verses.devanagari: তবে অষ্ট-কৌড়ির খাজা করে সমর্পণ ।\\nস্বরূপ-আজ্ঞায় গোবিন্দ তাহা করে সমাধান ॥৩০৫॥
verses.transliteration: tabe aṣṭa-kauḍira khājā kare samarpaṇa\\nsvarūpa-ājñāya govinda tāhā kare samādhāna
verses.translation: Raghunātha dāsa then began offering the costly sweetmeats known as khājā, which Govinda, following the order of Svarūpa Dāmodara, would supply.

verses.devanagari: রঘুনাথ সেই শিলা-মালা যবে পাইলা  ।\\nগোসাঞির অভিপ্রায় এই ভাবনা করিলা ॥৩০৬॥
verses.transliteration: raghunātha sei śilā-mālā yabe pāilā\\ngosāñira abhiprāya ei bhāvanā karilā
verses.translation: When Raghunātha dāsa received from Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu the stone and the garland of conchshells, he could understand the Lord's intention. Thus he thought as follows.

verses.devanagari: “শিলা দিয়া গোসাঞি সমর্পিলা ‘গোবর্ধনে’  ।\\nগুঞ্জামালা দিয়া দিলা ‘রাধিকা-চরণে’ ।।” ৩০৭ ॥৩০৭॥
verses.transliteration: "śilā diyā gosāñi samarpilā 'govardhane'\\nguñjā-mālā diyā dilā 'rādhikā-caraṇe'
verses.translation: "By offering me the govardhana-śilā, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu has offered me a place near Govardhana Hill, and by offering me the garland of conch shells, He has offered me shelter at the lotus feet of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī."

verses.devanagari: আনন্দে রঘুনাথের বাহ্য বিস্মরণ ।\\nকায়মনে সেবিলেন গৌরাঙ্গ-চরণ ॥৩০৮॥
verses.transliteration: ānande raghunāthera bāhya vismaraṇa\\nkāya-mane sevilena gaurāṅga-caraṇa
verses.translation: Raghunātha dāsa's transcendental bliss was boundless. Forgetting everything external, he served the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu with his body and mind.

verses.devanagari: অনন্ত গুণ রঘুনাথের কে করিবে লেখা ?\\nরঘুনাথের নিয়ম, — যেন পাষাণের রেখা ॥৩০৯॥
verses.transliteration: ananta guṇa raghunāthera ke karibe lekhā?\\nraghunāthera niyama,—yena pāṣāṇera rekhā
verses.translation: Who could list the unlimited transcendental attributes of Raghunātha dāsa? His strict regulative principles were exactly like lines on a stone.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
The words
pasanera rekha
are very significant. Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī followed the regulative principles so strictly and rigidly that they were compared to the lines on a stone. As such lines cannot be erased at any time, so the regulative principles observed by Śrī Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī could not be changed under any circumstances.

verses.devanagari: সাড়ে সাত প্রহর যায় কীর্তন-স্মরণে ।\\nআহার-নিদ্রা চারি দণ্ড সেহ নহে কোন দিনে ॥৩১০॥
verses.transliteration: sāḍe sāta prahara yāya kīrtana-smaraṇe\\nāhāra-nidrā cāri daṇḍa seha nahe kona dine
verses.synonyms:
sāḍe sāta prahara
—7.5
praharas
(one
prahara
equals three hours);
yāya
—is spent;
kīrtana-smaraṇe
—in chanting the Hare Kṛṣṇa
mahā-mantra
and remembering the lotus feet of Kṛṣṇa;
āhāra-nidrā
—eating and sleeping;
cāri daṇḍa
—four
daṇḍas
(one
daṇḍa
equals twenty-four minutes);
seha
—that;
nahe
—is not;
kona dine
—some days.
verses.translation: Raghunātha dāsa spent more than twenty-two hours out of every twenty-four chanting the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra and remembering the lotus feet of the Lord. He ate and slept for less than an hour and a half, and on some days that also was impossible.

verses.devanagari: বৈরাগ্যের কথা তাঁর অদ্ভুত-কথন ।\\nআজন্ম না দিল জিহ্বায় রসের স্পর্শন ॥৩১১॥
verses.transliteration: vairāgyera kathā tāṅra adbhuta-kathana\\nājanma nā dila jihvāya rasera sparśana
verses.translation: Topics concerning his renunciation are wonderful. Throughout his life he never allowed his tongue sense gratification.

verses.devanagari: ছিণ্ডা কানি কাঁথা বিনা না পরে বসন ।\\nসাবধানে প্রভুর কৈলা আজ্ঞার পালন ॥৩১২॥
verses.transliteration: chiṇḍā kāni kāṅthā vinā nā pare vasana\\nsāvadhāne prabhura kailā ājñāra pālana
verses.translation: He never touched anything to wear except a small torn cloth and a patchwork wrapper. Thus he very rigidly executed the order of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
verses.purport: PURPORT\nThe principle of very rigidly carrying out the order of the spiritual master must be observed. The spiritual master gives different orders to different people. For example, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu ordered Jīva Gosvāmī, Rūpa Gosvāmī and Sanātana Gosvāmī to preach, and He ordered Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī to strictly follow the rules and regulations of the renounced order. All six Gosvāmīs strictly followed the instructions of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. This is the principle for progress in devotional service. After receiving an order from the spiritual master, one must strictly try to execute the order. That is the way of success.

verses.devanagari: প্রাণ-রক্ষা লাগি’ যেবা করেন ভক্ষণ ।\\nতাহা খাঞা আপনাকে কহে নির্বেদ-বচন ॥৩১৩॥
verses.transliteration: prāṇa-rakṣā lāgi' yebā karena bhakṣaṇa\\ntāhā khāñā āpanāke kahe nirveda-vacana
verses.translation: Whatever he ate was only to keep his body and soul together, and when he ate he would reproach himself thus.

verses.devanagari: আত্মানং চেদ্বিজানীয়াত্ পরং জ্ঞানধুতাশয়ঃ ।\\nকিমিচ্ছন্ কস্য বা হেতোর্দেহং পুষ্ণাতি লম্পটঃ ॥৩১৪॥
verses.transliteration: ātmānaṁ ced vijānīyāt\\nparaṁ jñāna-dhūtāśayaḥ\\nkim icchan kasya vā hetor\\ndehaṁ puṣṇāti lampaṭaḥ
verses.translation: "If one's heart has been cleansed by perfect knowledge and one has understood Kṛṣṇa, the Supreme Brahman, he then gains everything. Why should such a person act like a debauchee by trying very carefully to maintain his material body?"
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This verse (Bhāg. 7.15.40) was spoken by Nārada to Yudhiṣṭhira Mahārāja regarding a householder's liberation from material bondage. On the spiritual platform, one does not unnecessarily care for the body. Śrīla Narottama dāsa Ṭhākura has said,
deha-smṛti nāhi yāra, saṁsāra bandhana kāhāṅ tāra.
One who is spiritually situated does not think that he is the body. Therefore he can transcendentally execute severe penances in the renounced order of life. The best example of such renunciation is Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī.

verses.devanagari: প্রসাদান্ন পসারির যত না বিকায় ।\\nদুই-তিন দিন হৈলে ভাত সড়ি’ যায় ॥৩১৫॥
verses.transliteration: prasādānna pasārira yata nā vikāya\\ndui-tina dina haile bhāta saḍi' yāya
verses.translation: Lord Jagannātha's prasāda is sold by shopkeepers, and that which is not sold decomposes after two or three days.

verses.devanagari: সিংহদ্বারে গাভী-আগে সেই ভাত ডারে ।\\nসড়া-গন্ধে তৈলঙ্গী-গাই খাইতে না পারে ॥৩১৬॥
verses.transliteration: siṁha-dvāre gābhī-āge sei bhāta ḍāre\\nsaḍā-gandhe tailaṅgī-gāi khāite nā pāre
verses.translation: All the decomposed food is thrown before the cows from Tailaṅga at the Siṁha-dvāra gate. Because of its rotten odor, even the cows cannot eat it.

verses.devanagari: সেই ভাত রঘুনাথ রাত্রে ঘরে আনি’  ।\\nভাত পাখালিয়া ফেলে ঘরে দিয়া বহু পানি ॥৩১৭॥
verses.transliteration: sei bhāta raghunātha rātre ghare āni'\\nbhāta pākhāliyā phele ghare diyā bahu pāni
verses.translation: At night Raghunātha dāsa would collect that decomposed rice, bring it home and wash it with ample water.

verses.devanagari: ভিতরের দৃঢ় যেই মাজি ভাত পায়  ।\\nলবণ দিয়া রঘুনাথ সেই অন্ন খায় ॥৩১৮॥
verses.transliteration: bhitarera dṛḍha yei māji bhāta pāya\\nlavaṇa diyā raghunātha sei anna khāya
verses.translation: Then he ate the hard inner portion of the rice with salt.

verses.devanagari: একদিন স্বরূপ তাহা করিতে দেখিলা ।\\nহাসিয়া তাহার কিছু মাগিয়া খাইলা ॥৩১৯॥
verses.transliteration: eka-dina svarūpa tāhā karite dekhilā\\nhāsiyā tāhāra kichu māgiyā khāilā
