verses.translation: One day Svarūpa Dāmodara saw the activities of Raghunātha dāsa. Thus he smiled and asked for a small portion of that food and ate it.

verses.devanagari: স্বরূপ কহে, — “ঐছে অমৃত খাও নিতি-নিতি ।\\nআমা-সবায় নাহি দেহ’, — কি তোমার প্রকৃতি ?” ॥ ৩২০ ॥
verses.transliteration: svarūpa kahe,—"aiche amṛta khāo niti-niti\\nāmā-sabāya nāhi deha',—ki tomāra prakṛti?"
verses.translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara said, "You eat such nectar every day, but you never offer it to us. Where is your character?"

verses.devanagari: গোবিন্দের মুখে প্রভু সে বার্তা শুনিলা  ।\\nআর দিন আসি’ প্রভু কহিতে লাগিলা ॥৩২১॥
verses.transliteration: govindera mukhe prabhu se vārtā śunilā\\nāra dina āsi' prabhu kahite lāgilā
verses.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu heard news of this from the mouth of Govinda, He went there the next day and spoke as follows.

verses.devanagari: ‘কাঁহা বস্তু খাও সবে, মোরে না দেহ’ কেনে ?’ এত বলি’ এক গ্রাস করিলা ভক্ষণে ॥৩২২॥
verses.transliteration: kāṅhā vastu khāo sabe, more nā deha' kene?'\\neta bali' eka grāsa karilā bhakṣaṇe
verses.translation: "What nice things are you eating? Why don't you give anything to Me?" Saying this, He forcibly took a morsel and began to eat.

verses.devanagari: আর গ্রাস লৈতে স্বরূপ হাতেতে ধরিলা  ।\\n‘তব যোগ্য নহে’ বলি’ বলে কাড়ি’ নিলা ॥৩২৩॥
verses.transliteration: āra grāsa laite svarūpa hātete dharilā\\n'tava yogya nahe' bali' bale kāḍi' nilā
verses.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was taking another morsel of food, Svarūpa Dāmodara caught Him by the hand and said, "It is not fit for You." Thus he forcibly took the food away.

verses.devanagari: প্রভু বলে, — “নিতি-নিতি নানা প্রসাদ খাই ।\\nঐছে স্বাদ আর কোন প্রসাদে না পাই ।।” ॥ ৩২৪ ॥
verses.transliteration: prabhu bale,—"niti-niti nānā prasāda khāi\\naiche svāda āra kona prasāde nā pāi"
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "Of course, every day I eat varieties of prasāda, but I have never tasted such nice prasāda as that which Raghunātha is eating."

verses.devanagari: এইমত মহাপ্রভু নানা লীলা করে ।\\nরঘুনাথের বৈরাগ্য দেখি’ সন্তোষ অন্তরে ॥৩২৫॥
verses.transliteration: ei-mata mahāprabhu nānā līlā kare\\nraghunāthera vairāgya dekhi' santoṣa antare
verses.translation: Thus Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu performed many pastimes at Jagannātha Purī. Seeing the severe penances performed by Raghunātha dāsa in the renounced order, the Lord was greatly satisfied.

verses.devanagari: আপন-উদ্ধার এই রঘুনাথদাস ।\\n‘গৌরাঙ্গস্তবকল্পবৃক্ষে’ করিয়াছেন প্রকাশ ॥৩২৬॥
verses.transliteration: āpana-uddhāra ei raghunātha-dāsa\\n'gaurāṅga-stava-kalpa-vṛkṣe' kariyāchena prakāśa
verses.translation: In his own poem known as the Gaurāṅga-stava-kalpavṛkṣa, Raghunātha dāsa has described his personal deliverance.

verses.devanagari: মহাসম্পদ্দাবাদপি পতিতমুদ্ধৃত্য কৃপয়া\\nস্বরূপে যঃ স্বীয়ে কুজনমপি মাং ন্যস্য মুদিতঃ ।\\nউরোগুঞ্জাহারং প্রিয়মপি চ গোবর্ধনশিলাং\\nদদৌ মে গৌরাঙ্গো হৃদয় উদয়ন্মাং মদয়তি ॥৩২৭॥
verses.transliteration: mahā-sampad-dāvād api patitam uddhṛtya kṛpayā\\nsvarūpe yaḥ svīye kujanam api māṁ nyasya muditaḥ\\nuro-guñjā-hāraṁ priyam api ca govardhana-śilāṁ\\ndadau me gaurāṅgo hṛdaya udayan māṁ madayati
verses.translation: "Although I am a fallen soul, the lowest of men, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu delivered me from the blazing forest fire of great material opulence by His mercy. He handed me over in great pleasure to Svarūpa Dāmodara, His personal associate. The Lord also gave me the garland of small conchshells that He wore on His chest and a stone from Govardhana Hill, although they were very dear to Him. That same Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu awakens within my heart and makes me mad after Him."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This verse is from
Śrī Gaurāṅga-stava-kalpavṛkṣa
(11), written by Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī.

verses.devanagari: এই ত’ কহিলুঁ রঘুনাথের মিলন ।\\nইহা যেই শুনে পায় চৈতন্যচরণ ॥৩২৮॥
verses.transliteration: ei ta' kahiluṅ raghunāthera milana\\nihā yei śune pāya caitanya-caraṇa
verses.translation: Thus I have described the meeting of Raghunātha dāsa with Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Anyone who hears about this incident attains the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: শ্রীরূপ-রঘুনাথ-পদে যার আশ ।\\nচৈতন্যচরিতামৃত কহে কৃষ্ণদাস ॥৩২৯॥
verses.transliteration: śrī-rūpa-raghunātha-pade yāra āśa,\\ncaitanya-caritāmṛta kahe kṛṣṇadāsa
verses.translation: Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.
verses.purport: PURPORT\nThus end the Bhaktivedanta purports to Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā,  Sixth Chapter, describing Lord Caitanya's meeting with Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī.

sections.title: Chapter 7: The Meeting of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and Vallabha Bhaṭṭa

verses.devanagari: চৈতন্যচরণাম্ভোজমকরন্দলিহো ভজে ।\\nযেষাং প্রসাদমাত্রেণ পামরোঽপ্যমরো ভবেৎ ॥১॥
verses.transliteration: caitanya-caraṇāmbhoja-\\nmakaranda-liho bhaje\\nyeṣāṁ prasāda-mātreṇa\\npāmaro 'py amaro bhavet
verses.translation: Let me offer my respectful obeisances unto the devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Simply by the causeless mercy of the devotees engaged in licking honey from His lotus feet, even a fallen soul becomes eternally liberated.

verses.devanagari: জয় জয় শ্রীচৈতন্য জয় নিত্যানন্দ ।\\nজয়াদ্বৈতচন্দ্র জয় গৌরভক্তবৃন্দ ॥২॥
verses.transliteration: jaya jaya śrī-caitanya jaya nityānanda\\njayādvaita-candra jaya gaura-bhakta-vṛnda
verses.translation: All glories to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu! All glories to Nityānanda Prabhu! All glories to Advaitacandra! And all glories to the devotees of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu!

verses.devanagari: বর্ষান্তরে যত গৌড়ের ভক্তগণ আইলা ।\\nপূর্ববৎ মহাপ্রভু সবারে মিলিলা ॥৩॥
verses.transliteration: varṣāntare yata gauḍera bhakta-gaṇa āilā\\npūrvavat mahāprabhu sabāre mililā
verses.translation: The next year, all the devotees of Bengal went to visit Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, and as previously, the Lord met each and every one of them.

verses.devanagari: এইমত বিলাস প্রভুর ভক্তগণ লঞা ।\\nহেনকালে বল্লভ-ভট্ট মিলিল আসিয়া ॥৪॥
verses.transliteration: ei-mata vilāsa prabhura bhakta-gaṇa lañā\\nhena-kāle vallabha-bhaṭṭa milila āsiyā
verses.translation: Thus Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu performed His pastimes with His devotees. Then a learned scholar named Vallabha Bhaṭṭa went to Jagannātha Purī to meet the Lord.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
For a description of Vallabha Bhaṭṭa, one may refer to the
Madhya-līlā,
Chapter Nineteen, text 61.

verses.devanagari: আসিয়া বন্দিল ভট্ট প্রভুর চরণে ।\\nপ্রভু ‘ভাগবতবুদ্ধ্যে’ কৈলা আলিঙ্গনে ॥৫॥
verses.transliteration: āsiyā vandila bhaṭṭa prabhura caraṇe\\nprabhu 'bhāgavata-buddhye' kailā āliṅgane
verses.translation: When Vallabha Bhaṭṭa arrived, he offered his obeisances at the lotus feet of the Lord. Accepting him as a great devotee, the Lord embraced him.

verses.devanagari: মান্য করি’ প্রভু তারে নিকটে বসাইলা  ।\\nবিনয় করিয়া ভট্ট কহিতে লাগিলা ॥৬॥
verses.transliteration: mānya kari' prabhu tāre nikaṭe vasāilā\\nvinaya kariyā bhaṭṭa kahite lāgilā
verses.translation: With great respect, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu seated Vallabha Bhaṭṭa near Him. Then Vallabha Bhaṭṭa very humbly began to speak.

verses.devanagari: “বহুদিন মনোরথ তোমা’ দেখিবারে  ।\\nজগন্নাথ পূর্ণ কৈলা, দেখিলুঁ তোমারে ॥৭॥
verses.transliteration: "bahu-dina manoratha tomā' dekhibāre\\njagannātha pūrṇa kailā, dekhiluṅ tomāre
verses.translation: "For a long time," he said, "I have desired to see You, my Lord. Now Lord Jagannātha has fulfilled this desire; therefore I am seeing You.

verses.devanagari: তোমার দর্শন যে পায় সেই ভাগ্যবান্ ।\\nতোমাকে দেখিয়ে, — যেন সাক্ষাৎ ভগবান্ ॥৮॥
verses.transliteration: tomāra darśana ye pāya sei bhāgyavān\\ntomāke dekhiye,—yena sākṣāt bhagavān
verses.translation: "One who receives Your audience is fortunate indeed, for You are the Supreme Personality of Godhead Himself.

verses.devanagari: তোমারে যে স্মরণ করে, সে হয় পবিত্র ।\\nদর্শনে পবিত্র হবে, — ইথে কি বিচিত্র ? ॥৯॥
verses.transliteration: tomāre ye smaraṇa kare, se haya pavitra\\ndarśane pavitra habe,—ithe ki vicitra?
verses.translation: "Since one who remembers You is purified, why should it be astonishing that one becomes purified by seeing You?

verses.devanagari: যেষাং সংস্মরণাৎ পুংসাং সদ্যঃ শুধ্যন্তি বৈ গৃহাঃ ।\\nকিং পুনর্দর্শনস্পর্শপাদশৌচাসনাদিভিঃ ॥১০॥
verses.transliteration: yeṣāṁ saṁsmaraṇāt puṁsāṁ\\nsadyaḥ śuddhyanti vai gṛhāḥ\\nkiṁ punar darśana-sparśa-\\npāda-śaucāsanādibhiḥ
verses.translation: "One can immediately purify his entire house simply by remembering exalted personalities, to say nothing of directly seeing them, touching their lotus feet, washing their feet or offering them places to sit.'
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This is a quotation from
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
(1.19.33).

verses.devanagari: কলিকালের ধর্ম — কৃষ্ণনাম-সঙ্কীর্তন ।\\nকৃষ্ণ-শক্তি বিনা নহে তার প্রবর্তন ॥১১॥
verses.transliteration: kali-kālera dharma—kṛṣṇa-nāma-saṅkīrtana\\nkṛṣṇa-śakti vinā nahe tāra pravartana
verses.translation: "The fundamental religious system in the age of Kali is the chanting of the holy name of Kṛṣṇa. Unless empowered by Kṛṣṇa, one cannot propagate the saṅkīrtana movement.

verses.devanagari: তাহা প্রবর্তাইলা তুমি, — এই ত ‘প্রমাণ’ ।\\nকৃষ্ণশক্তি ধর তুমি, — ইথে নাহি আন ॥১২॥
verses.transliteration: tāhā pravartāilā tumi,—ei ta 'pramāṇa'\\nkṛṣṇa-śakti dhara tumi,—ithe nāhi āna
verses.translation: "You have spread the saṅkīrtana movement of Kṛṣṇa consciousness. Therefore it is evident that You have been empowered by Lord Kṛṣṇa. There is no question about it.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Śrī Madhvācārya has brought our attention to this quotation from the
Nārāyaṇa-saṁhitā:
dvāparīyair janair viṣṇuḥ
pañcarātrais tu kevalaiḥ
kalau tu nāma-mātreṇa
pūjyate bhagavān hariḥ
"in the Dvāpara-yuga one could satisfy Kṛṣṇa or Viṣṇu only by worshiping opulently according to the
pāñcarātrikī
system, but in the age of Kali one can satisfy and worship the Supreme Personality of Godhead Hari simply by chanting His holy name." Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura explains that unless one is directly empowered by the causeless mercy of Kṛṣṇa, one cannot become the spiritual master of the entire world
(jagad-guru).
One cannot become an
ācārya
simply by mental speculation. The true
ācārya
presents Kṛṣṇa to everyone by preaching the holy name of the Lord throughout the world. Thus the conditioned souls, purified by chanting the holy name, are liberated from the blazing fire of material existence. In this way, spiritual benefit grows increasingly full, like the waxing moon in the sky. The true
ācārya,
the spiritual master of the entire world, must be considered an incarnation of Kṛṣṇa's mercy. indeed, he is personally embracing Kṛṣṇa. He is therefore the spiritual master of all the
varṇas
(
brāhmaṇa, kṣatriya, vaiśya
and
śūdra
) and all the
āśramas
(
brahmacarya, gṛhastha, vānaprastha
and
sannyāsa
). Since he is understood to be the most advanced devotee, he is called
paramahaṁsa-ṭhākura.
Ṭhākura is a title of honor offered to the
paramahaṁsa.
Therefore one who acts as an ācārya, directly presenting Lord Kṛṣṇa by spreading His name and fame, is also to be called
paramahaṁsa-ṭhākura.

verses.devanagari: জগতে করিলা তুমি কৃষ্ণনাম প্রকাশে ।\\nযেই তোমা দেখে, সেই কৃষ্ণপ্রেমে ভাসে ॥১৩॥
verses.transliteration: jagate karilā tumi kṛṣṇa-nāma prakāśe\\nyei tomā dekhe, sei kṛṣṇa-preme bhāse
verses.translation: "You have manifested the holy name of Kṛṣṇa throughout the entire world. Anyone who sees You is immediately absorbed in ecstatic love of Kṛṣṇa.

verses.devanagari: প্রেম-পরকাশ নহে কৃষ্ণশক্তি বিনে ।\\n‘কৃষ্ণ’ — এক প্রেমদাতা, শাস্ত্র-প্রমাণে ॥১৪॥
verses.transliteration: prema-parakāśa nahe kṛṣṇa-śakti vine\\n'kṛṣṇa'—eka prema-dātā, śāstra-pramāṇe
verses.translation: "Without being especially empowered by Kṛṣṇa, one cannot manifest ecstatic love of Kṛṣṇa, for Kṛṣṇa is the only one who gives ecstatic love. That is the verdict of all revealed scriptures.

verses.devanagari: সন্ত্ববতারা বহবঃ পুষ্করনাভস্য সর্বতোভদ্রাঃ ।\\nকৃষ্ণাদন্যঃ কো বা লতাস্বপি প্রেমদো ভবতি ।।” ॥ ১৫ ॥
verses.transliteration: santv avatārā bahavaḥ\\npuṣkara-nābhasya sarvato-bhadrāḥ\\nkṛṣṇād anyaḥ ko vā latāsv\\napi premado bhavati"
verses.translation: "There may be many all-auspicious incarnations of the Personality of Godhead, but who other than Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa can bestow love of God upon the surrendered souls?' "
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This is a verse written by Bilvamaṅgala Ṭhākura. it is found in the
Laghu-bhāgavatāmṛta
(1.5.37).

verses.devanagari: মহাপ্রভু কহে — “শুন, ভট্ট মহামতি ।\\nমায়াবাদী সন্ন্যাসী আমি, না জানি কৃষ্ণভক্তি ॥১৬॥
verses.transliteration: mahāprabhu kahe—"śuna, bhaṭṭa mahā-mati\\nmāyāvādī sannyāsī āmi, nā jāni kṛṣṇa-bhakti
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied, "My dear Vallabha Bhaṭṭa, you are a learned scholar. Kindly listen to Me. I am a sannyāsī of the Māyāvāda school. Therefore I have no chance of knowing what kṛṣṇa-bhakti is.

verses.devanagari: অদ্বৈতাচার্য-গোসাঞি — ‘সাক্ষাৎ ঈশ্বর’ ।\\nতাঁর সঙ্গে আমার মন হইল নির্মল ॥১৭॥
verses.transliteration: advaitācārya-gosāñi—'sākṣāt īśvara'\\ntāṅra saṅge āmāra mana ha-ila nirmala
verses.translation: "Nevertheless, My mind has become purified because I have associated with Advaita Ācārya, who is directly the Supreme Personality of Godhead.

verses.devanagari: সর্বশাস্ত্রে কৃষ্ণভক্ত্যে নাহি যাঁর সম ।\\nঅতএব ‘অদ্বৈত-আচার্য’ তাঁর নাম ॥১৮॥
verses.transliteration: sarva-śāstre kṛṣṇa-bhaktye nāhi yāṅra sama\\nataeva 'advaita-ācārya' tāṅra nāma
verses.translation: "He is unparalleled in His understanding of all the revealed scriptures and the devotional service of Lord Kṛṣṇa. Therefore He is called Advaita Ācārya.

verses.devanagari: যাঁহার কৃপাতে ম্লেচ্ছের হয় কৃষ্ণভক্তি ।\\nকে কহিতে পারে তাঁর বৈষ্ণবতা-শক্তি ? ॥১৯॥
verses.transliteration: yāṅhāra kṛpāte mlecchera haya kṛṣṇa-bhakti\\nke kahite pāre tāṅra vaiṣṇavatā-śakti?
verses.translation: "He is such a great personality that by His mercy He can convert even the meateaters [mlecchas] to the devotional service of Kṛṣṇa. Who, therefore, can estimate the power of His Vaiṣṇavism?
verses.purport:
PURPORT
It is extremely difficult to convert a
mleccha,
or meat-eater, into a devotee of Lord Kṛṣṇa. Therefore anyone who can do so is situated on the highest level of Vaiṣṇavism.

verses.devanagari: নিত্যানন্দ-অবধূত — ‘সাক্ষাৎ ঈশ্বর’ ।\\nভাবোন্মাদে মত্ত কৃষ্ণপ্রেমের সাগর ॥২০॥
verses.transliteration: nityānanda-avadhūta—'sākṣāt īśvara'\\nbhāvonmāde matta kṛṣṇa-premera sāgara
verses.translation: "Lord Nityānanda Prabhu, the avadhūta, is also directly the Supreme Personality of Godhead. He is always intoxicated with the madness of ecstatic love. Indeed, He is an ocean of love of Kṛṣṇa.

verses.devanagari: ষড়্দর্শন-বেত্তা ভট্টাচার্য-সার্বভৌম ।\\nষড়্দর্শনে জগদ্গুরু ভাগবতোত্তম ॥২১॥
verses.transliteration: ṣaḍ-darśana-vettā bhaṭṭācārya-sārvabhauma\\nṣaḍ-darśane jagad-guru bhāgavatottama
verses.translation: "Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya perfectly knows the six philosophical theses. He is therefore the spiritual master of the entire world in the six paths of philosophy. He is the best of devotees.

verses.devanagari: তেঁহ দেখাইলা মোরে ভক্তিযোগ-পার ।\\nতাঁর প্রসাদে জানিলুঁ ‘কৃষ্ণভক্তিযোগ’ সার ॥২২॥
verses.transliteration: teṅha dekhāilā more bhakti-yoga-pāra\\ntāṅra prasāde jāniluṅ 'kṛṣṇa-bhakti-yoga' sāra
verses.translation: "Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya has shown Me the limit of devotional service. Only by his mercy have I understood that devotional service to Kṛṣṇa is the essence of all mystic yoga.

verses.devanagari: রামানন্দ-রায় কৃষ্ণ-রসের ‘নিধান’ ।\\nতেঁহ জানাইলা — কৃষ্ণ — স্বয়ং ভগবান্ ॥২৩॥
verses.transliteration: rāmānanda-rāya kṛṣṇa-rasera 'nidhāna'\\nteṅha jānāilā—kṛṣṇa—svayaṁ bhagavān
verses.translation: "Śrīla Rāmānanda Rāya is the ultimate knower of the transcendental mellows of Lord Kṛṣṇa's devotional service. He has instructed Me that Lord Kṛṣṇa is the Supreme Personality of Godhead.

verses.devanagari: তাতে প্রেমভক্তি — ‘পুরুষার্থ-শিরোমণি’ ।\\nরাগমার্গে প্রেমভক্তি ‘সর্বাধিক’ জানি ॥২৪॥
verses.transliteration: tāte prema-bhakti—'puruṣārtha-śiromaṇi'\\nrāga-mārge prema-bhakti 'sarvādhika' jāni
verses.translation: "Through the mercy of Rāmānanda Rāya, I have understood that ecstatic love of Kṛṣṇa is the highest goal of life and that spontaneous love of Kṛṣṇa is the highest perfection.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Puruṣārtha
("the goal of life") generally refers to religion, economic development, satisfaction of the senses and, finally, liberation. However, above these four kinds of
puruṣārthas,
love of Godhead stands supreme. It is called
parama-puruṣārtha
(the supreme goal of life) or
puruṣārtha-śiromaṇi
(the most exalted of all
puruṣārthas
). Lord Kṛṣṇa is worshiped by regulative devotional service, but the highest perfection of devotional service is spontaneous love of Godhead.

verses.devanagari: দাস্য, সখ্য, বাৎসল্য, আর যে শৃঙ্গার ।\\nদাস, সখা, গুরু, কান্তা, — ‘আশ্রয়’ যাহার ॥২৫॥
verses.transliteration: dāsya, sakhya, vātsalya, āra ye śṛṅgāra\\ndāsa, sakhā, guru, kāntā,—'āśraya' yāhāra
verses.translation: "The servant, friend, superior and conjugal lover are the shelters of the transcendental mellows called dāsya, sakhya, vātsalya and śṛṅgāra.

verses.devanagari: ‘ঐশ্বর্যজ্ঞানযুক্ত’, ‘কেবল’-ভাব আর ।\\nঐশ্বর্য-জ্ঞানে না পাই ব্রজেন্দ্রকুমার ॥২৬॥
verses.transliteration: 'aiśvarya-jñāna-yukta', 'kevala'-bhāva āra\\naiśvarya-jñāne nā pāi vrajendra-kumāra
verses.translation: "There are two kinds of emotion [bhāva]. Emotion with an understanding of the Lord's full opulences is called aiśvarya-jñāna-yukta, and pure, uncontaminated emotion is called kevala. One cannot achieve shelter at the lotus feet of Kṛṣṇa, the son of Mahārāja Nanda, simply by knowing His opulences.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Vide
Madhya-līlā,
Chapter Nineteen, text 192.

verses.devanagari: নায়ং সুখাপো ভগবান্ দেহিনাং গোপিকাসুতঃ ।\\nজ্ঞানিনাঞ্চাত্মভূতানাং যথা ভক্তিমতামিহ ॥২৭॥
verses.transliteration: nāyaṁ sukhāpo bhagavān\\ndehināṁ gopikā-sutaḥ\\njñānināṁ cātma-bhūtānāṁ\\nyathā bhakti-matām iha
verses.translation: "The Supreme Personality of Godhead, Kṛṣṇa, the son of mother Yaśodā, is accessible to those devotees engaged in spontaneous loving service, but He is not as easily accessible to mental speculators, to those striving for self-realization by severe austerities and penances, or to those who consider the body the same as the self.'
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This verse is from
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
(10.9.21).

verses.devanagari: ‘আত্মভূত’-শব্দে কহে ‘পারিষদগণ’ ।\\nঐশ্বর্য-জ্ঞানে লক্ষ্মী না পাইলা ব্রজেন্দ্রনন্দন ॥২৮॥
verses.transliteration: 'ātma-bhūta'-śabde kahe 'pāriṣada-gaṇa'\\naiśvarya-jñāne lakṣmī nā pāilā vrajendra-nandana
verses.translation: "The word 'ātma-bhūta' means 'personal associates.' Through the understanding of opulence, the goddess of fortune could not receive the shelter of Kṛṣṇa; the son of Nanda Mahārāja.
verses.purport: PURPORT\nLakṣmī, the goddess of fortune, has complete knowledge of Kṛṣṇa's opulences, but she could not achieve the association of Kṛṣṇa by dint of such knowledge. The devotees in Vṛndāvana, however, actually enjoy the association of Kṛṣṇa.

verses.devanagari: নায়ং শ্রিয়োঽঙ্গ উ নিতান্তরতেঃ প্রসাদঃ\\nস্বর্যোষিতাং নলিনগন্ধরুচাং কুতোঽন্যাঃ ।\\nরাসোৎসবেঽস্য ভুজদণ্ডগৃহীতকণ্ঠ-\\nলব্ধাশিষাং য উদগাদ্ব্রজসুন্দরীণাম্ ॥২৯॥
verses.transliteration: rāsotsave 'sya bhuja-daṇḍa-gṛhīta-kaṇṭha-\\nlabdhāśiṣāṁ ya udagād vraja-sundarīṇām
verses.translation: "When Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa was dancing with the gopīs in the rāsa-līlā, the gopīs were embraced by the arms of the Lord. This transcendental favor was never bestowed upon the goddess of fortune or the other consorts in the spiritual world. Indeed, never was such a favor even imagined by the most beautiful girls in the heavenly planets, whose bodily luster and aroma resemble those of lotus flowers. And what to speak of worldly women who are very beautiful according to the material estimation?'
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This is a verse from
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
(10.47.60).

verses.devanagari: শুদ্ধভাবে সখা করে স্কন্ধে আরোহণ ।\\nশুদ্ধভাবে ব্রজেশ্বরী করেন বন্ধন ॥৩০॥
verses.transliteration: śuddha-bhāve sakhā kare skandhe ārohaṇa\\nśuddha-bhāve vrajeśvarī karena bandhana
verses.translation: "In pure Kṛṣṇa consciousness, a friend mounts the shoulder of Kṛṣṇa, and mother Yaśodā binds the Lord.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Śuddha-bhāva,
pure consciousness, is not dependent on an understanding of the Lord's opulences. Even without such opulences, the devotee in
śuddha-bhāva
is inclined to love Kṛṣṇa as a friend or son.

verses.devanagari: ‘মোর সখা’, ‘মোর পুত্র’, — এই ‘শুদ্ধ’ মন ।\\nঅতএব শুক-ব্যাস করে প্রশংসন ॥৩১॥
verses.transliteration: 'mora sakhā,' 'mora putra,'—ei 'śuddha' mana\\nataeva śuka-vyāsa kare praśaṁsana
verses.translation: "In pure Kṛṣṇa consciousness, without knowledge of the Lord's opulences, a devotee considers Kṛṣṇa his friend or son. Therefore this devotional attitude is praised even by Śukadeva Gosvāmī and Vyāsadeva, the supreme authority.

verses.devanagari: ইত্থং সতাং ব্রহ্মসুখানুভূত্যা\\nদাস্যং গতানাং পরদৈবতেন ।\\nমায়াশ্রিতানাং নরদারকেণ\\nসাকং বিজহ্রুঃ কৃতপুণ্যপুঞ্জাঃ ॥৩২॥
verses.transliteration: itthaṁ satāṁ brahma-sukhānubhūtyā\\ndāsyaṁ gatānāṁ para-daivatena\\nmāyāśritānāṁ nara-dārakeṇa\\nsākaṁ vijahruḥ kṛta-puṇya-puñjāḥ
verses.translation: "Those who are engaged in self-realization, appreciating the Brahman effulgence of the Lord, and those engaged in devotional service, accepting the Supreme Personality of Godhead as master, as well as those who are under the clutches of māyā, thinking the Lord an ordinary person, cannot understand that certain exalted personalities-after accumulating volumes of pious activities-are now playing with the Lord in friendship as cowherd boys.'
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This verse is from the
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
(10.12.11).

verses.devanagari: ত্রয্যা চোপনিষদ্ভিশ্চ সাংখ্যযোগৈশ্চ সাত্বতৈঃ ।\\nউপগীয়মানমাহাত্ম্যং হরিং সাঽমন্যতাত্মজম্ ॥৩৩॥
verses.transliteration: trayyā copaniṣadbhiś ca\\nsāṅkhya-yogaiś ca sātvataiḥ\\nupagīyamāna-māhātmyaṁ\\nhariṁ sāmanyatātmajam
verses.translation: "When mother Yaśodā saw all the universes within the mouth of Kṛṣṇa, she was certainly astonished for the time being. Nevertheless, she still considered the Lord her own son, although He is worshiped by great personalities who offer him sacrifices, great saints who understand the greatness of the Lord by studying the Upaniṣads, great philosophers who analytically study the universe, great yogīs who know him as the all-pervading Supersoul, and even devotees who accept the Lord as the Supreme Personality of Godhead.'
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This verse is from
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
(10.8.45).

verses.devanagari: নন্দঃ কিমকরোদ্ব্রহ্মন্ শ্রেয় এবং মহোদয়ম্ ।\\nযশোদা বা মহাভাগা পপৌ যস্যাঃ স্তনং হরিঃ ॥৩৪॥
verses.transliteration: nandaḥ kim akarod brahman\\nśreya evaṁ mahodayam\\nyaśodā vā mahā-bhāgā\\npapau yasyāḥ stanaṁ hariḥ
verses.translation: "O brāhmaṇa, what pious activities did Nanda Mahārāja perform to receive the Supreme Personality of Godhead Kṛṣṇa as his son? And what pious activities did mother Yaśodā perform that made the Absolute Supreme Personality of Godhead Kṛṣṇa call her "mother" and suck her breasts?'
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This verse is from
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
(10.8.46).

verses.devanagari: ঐশ্বর্য দেখিলেহ ‘শুদ্ধের’ নহে ঐশ্বর্য জ্ঞান ।\\nঅতএব ঐশ্বর্য হইতে ‘কেবল’-ভাব প্রধান ॥৩৫॥
verses.transliteration: aiśvarya dekhileha 'śuddhera' nahe aiśvarya-jñāna\\nataeva aiśvarya ha-ite 'kevala'-bhāva pradhāna
verses.translation: "Even if a pure devotee sees the opulence of Kṛṣṇa, he does not accept it. Therefore pure consciousness is more exalted than consciousness of the Lord's opulence.

verses.devanagari: এ সব শিখাইলা মোরে রায়-রামানন্দ ।\\nঅনর্গল রসবেত্তা প্রেমসুখানন্দ ॥৩৬॥
verses.transliteration: e saba śikhāilā more rāya-rāmānanda\\nanargala rasa-vettā prema-sukhānanda
verses.translation: "Rāmānanda Rāya is extremely aware of transcendental mellows. He is incessantly absorbed in the happiness of ecstatic love of Kṛṣṇa. It is he who has instructed Me all this.

verses.devanagari: কহন না যায় রামানন্দের প্রভাব ।\\nরায়-প্রসাদে জানিলুঁ ব্রজের ‘শুদ্ধ’ ভাব ॥৩৭॥
verses.transliteration: kahana nā yāya rāmānandera prabhāva\\nrāya-prasāde jāniluṅ vrajera 'śuddha' bhāva
verses.translation: "It is impossible to describe the influence and knowledge of Rāmānanda Rāya, for only by his mercy have I understood the unalloyed love of the residents of Vṛndāvana.

verses.devanagari: দামোদর-স্বরূপ — ‘প্রেমরস’ মূর্তিমান্ ।\\nযাঁর সঙ্গে হৈল ব্রজ-মধুর-রস-জ্ঞান ॥৩৮॥
verses.transliteration: dāmodara-svarūpa—'prema-rasa' mūrtimān\\nyāṅra saṅge haila vraja-madhura-rasa-jñāna
verses.translation: "The transcendental mellow of ecstatic love is personified by Svarūpa Dāmodara. By his association I have understood Vṛndāvana's transcendental mellow of conjugal love.

verses.devanagari: “শুদ্ধপ্রেম’ ব্রজদেবীর — কামগন্ধহীন ।\\n‘কৃষ্ণসুখতাৎপর্য’, — এই তার চিহ্ন ॥৩৯॥
verses.transliteration: 'śuddha-prema' vraja-devīra—kāma-gandha-hīna\\n'kṛṣṇa-sukha-tātparya',—ei tāra cihna
verses.translation: "The unalloyed love of the gopīs and Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī is without any trace of material lust. The criterion of such transcendental love is that its only purpose is to satisfy Kṛṣṇa.

verses.devanagari: যত্তে সুজাতচরণাম্বুরুহং স্তনেষু\\nভীতাঃ শনৈঃ প্রিয় দধীমহি কর্কশেষু ।\\nতেনাটবীমটসী তদ্ব্যথতে ন কিং স্বিৎ\\nকূর্পাদিভির্ভ্রমতি ধীর্ভবদায়ুষাং নঃ ॥৪০॥
verses.transliteration: yat te sujāta-caraṇāmburuhaṁ staneṣu\\nbhītāḥ śanaiḥ priya dadhīmahi karkaśeṣu\\ntenāṭavīm aṭasi tad vyathate na kiṁ svit\\nkūrpādibhir bhramati dhīr bhavad-āyuṣāṁ naḥ
verses.translation: "O dearly beloved! Your lotus feet are so soft that we place them gently on our breasts, fearing that Your feet will be hurt. Our lives rest only in You. Our minds, therefore, are filled with anxiety that Your tender feet might be wounded by pebbles as You roam about on the forest path.'
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This verse is spoken by the
gopīs
in
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
(10.31.19).

verses.devanagari: গোপীগণের শুদ্ধপ্রেম ঐশ্বর্যজ্ঞানহীন ।\\nপ্রেমেতে ভর্ৎসনা করে এই তার চিহ্ন ॥৪১॥
verses.transliteration: gopī-gaṇera śuddha-prema aiśvarya-jñāna-hīna\\npremete bhartsanā kare ei tāra cihna
verses.translation: "Obsessed with pure love, without knowledge of opulences, the gopīs sometimes chastised Kṛṣṇa. That is a symptom of pure ecstatic love.

verses.devanagari: পতিসুতান্বয়ভ্রাতৃবান্ধবা-\\nনতিবিলঙ্ঘ্য তেঽন্ত্যচ্যুতাগতাঃ ।\\nগতিবিদস্তবোদ্গীতমোহিতাঃ\\nকিতব যোষিতঃ কস্ত্যজেন্নিশি ॥৪২॥
verses.transliteration: pati-sutānvaya-bhrātṛ-bāndhavān\\nativilaṅghya te 'nty acyutāgatāḥ\\ngati-vidas tavodgīta-mohitāḥ\\nkitava yoṣitaḥ kas tyajen niśi
verses.translation: "O dear Kṛṣṇa, we gopīs have neglected the order of our husbands, sons, family, brothers and friends and have left their company to come to You. You know everything about our desires. We have come only because we are attracted by the supreme music of Your flute. But You are a great cheater, for who else would give up the company of young girls like us in the dead of night?'
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This verse is from
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
(10.31.16).

verses.devanagari: সর্বোত্তম ভজন এই সর্বভক্তি জিনি’ ।\\nঅতএব কৃষ্ণ কহে, — ‘আমি তোমার ঋণী’ ॥৪৩॥
verses.transliteration: sarvottama bhajana ei sarva-bhakti jini'\\nataeva kṛṣṇa kahe,—'āmi tomāra ṛṇī'
verses.translation: "The conjugal love of the gopīs is the most exalted devotional service, surpassing all other methods of bhakti. Therefore Lord Kṛṣṇa is obliged to say, 'My dear gopīs, I cannot repay you. Indeed, I am always indebted to you.'

verses.devanagari: ন পারয়েঽহং নিরবদ্যসংযুজাং\\nস্বসাধুকৃত্যং বিবুধায়ুষাপি বঃ ।\\nযা মাঽভজন্ দুর্জরগেহশৃঙ্খলাঃ\\nসংবৃশ্চ্য তদ্বঃ প্রতিযাতু সাধুনা ॥৪৪॥
verses.transliteration: na pāraye 'haṁ niravadya-saṁyujāṁ\\nsva-sādhu-kṛtyaṁ vibudhāyuṣāpi vaḥ\\nyā mābhajan durjaya-geha-śṛṅkhalāḥ\\nsaṁvṛścya tad vaḥ pratiyātu sādhunā
verses.translation: "O gopīs, I am not able to repay My debt for your spotless service, even within a lifetime of Brahmā. Your connection with Me is beyond reproach. You have worshiped Me, cutting off all domestic ties, which are difficult to break. Therefore please let your own glorious deeds be your compensation.'
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This is a quotation from
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
(10.32.22).

verses.devanagari: ঐশ্বর্য-জ্ঞান হৈতে কেবলা-ভাব — প্রধান  ।\\nপৃথিবীতে ভক্ত নাহি উদ্ধব-সমান ॥৪৫॥
verses.transliteration: aiśvarya-jñāna haite kevalā-bhāva—pradhāna\\npṛthivīte bhakta nāhi uddhava-samāna
verses.translation: "Completely distinct from love of Kṛṣṇa in opulence, pure love of Kṛṣṇa is on the highest level. On the surface of the world there is no devotee greater than Uddhava.

verses.devanagari: তেঁহ যাঁর পদধূলি করেন প্রার্থন  ।\\nস্বরূপের সঙ্গে পাইলুঁ এ সব শিক্ষণ ॥৪৬॥
verses.transliteration: teṅha yāṅra pada-dhūli karena prārthana\\nsvarūpera saṅge pāiluṅ e saba śikṣaṇa
verses.translation: "Uddhava desires to take on his head the dust of the gopīs' lotus feet. I have learned about all these transcendental loving affairs of Lord Kṛṣṇa from Svarūpa Dāmodara.

verses.devanagari: আসামহো চরণরেণুজুষামহং স্যাং\\nবৃন্দাবনে কিমপি গুল্মলতৌষধীনাম্ ।\\nযা দুস্ত্যজং স্বজনমার্যপথঞ্চ হিত্বা\\nভেজুর্মুকুন্দপদবীং শ্রুতিভির্বিমৃগ্যাম্ ॥৪৭॥
verses.transliteration: āsām aho caraṇa-reṇu-juṣām ahaṁ syāṁ\\nvṛndāvane kim api gulma-latauṣadhīnām\\nyā dustyajaṁ svajanam ārya-pathaṁ ca hitvā\\nbhejur mukunda-padavīṁ śrutibhir vimṛgyām
verses.translation: "The gopīs of Vṛndāvana have given up the association of their husbands, sons and other family members, who are very difficult to give up, and they have forsaken the path of chastity to take shelter of the lotus feet of Mukunda, Kṛṣṇa, which one should search for by Vedic knowledge. Oh, let me be fortunate enough to be one of the bushes, creepers or herbs in Vṛndāvana because the gopīs trample them and bless them with the dust of their lotus feet.'
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This verse from
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
(10.47.61) was spoken by Uddhava. When Uddhava was sent by Kṛṣṇa to see the condition of the
gopīs
in Vṛndāvana, he stayed there for a few months in their association and always talked with them about Kṛṣṇa. Although this greatly pleased the
gopīs
and other residents of Vrajabhūmi, Vṛndāvana, Uddhava saw that the
gopīs
were severely afflicted by their separation from Kṛṣṇa. Their hearts were so disturbed that their minds were sometimes deranged. Observing the unalloyed devotion and love of the
gopīs
for Kṛṣṇa, Uddhava desired to become a creeper, a blade of grass or an herb in Vṛndāvana so that sometimes the
gopīs
would trample him and he would receive the dust of their lotus feet on his head.

verses.devanagari: হরিদাস-ঠাকুর — মহাভাগবত-প্রধান ।\\nপ্রতি দিন লয় তেঁহ তিনলক্ষ নাম ॥৪৮॥
verses.transliteration: haridāsa-ṭhākura—mahā-bhāgavata-pradhāna\\nprati dina laya teṅha tina-lakṣa nāma
verses.translation: "Haridāsa Ṭhākura, the teacher of the holy name, is among the most exalted of all devotees. Every day he chants 300,000 holy names of the Lord.

verses.devanagari: নামের মহিমা আমি তাঁর ঠাঞি শিখিলুঁ ।\\nতাঁর প্রসাদে নামের মহিমা জানিলুঁ ॥৪৯॥
verses.transliteration: nāmera mahimā āmi tāṅra ṭhāñi śikhiluṅ\\ntāṅra prasāde nāmera mahimā jāniluṅ
verses.translation: "I have learned about the glories of the Lord's holy name from Haridāsa Ṭhākura, and by his mercy I have understood these glories.

verses.devanagari: আচার্যরত্ন আচার্যনিধি পণ্ডিত-গদাধর ।\\nজগদানন্দ, দামোদর, শঙ্কর, বক্রেশ্বর ॥৫০॥\\nকাশীশ্বর, মুকুন্দ, বাসুদেব, মুরারি ।\\nআর যত ভক্তগণ গৌড়ে অবতরি’ ॥৫১॥\\nকৃষ্ণ-নাম-প্রেম কৈলা জগতে প্রচার ।\\nইঁহা সবার সঙ্গে কৃষ্ণভক্তি যে আমার” ॥৫২॥
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇa-nāma-prema kailā jagate pracāra\\niṅhā sabāra saṅge kṛṣṇa-bhakti ye āmāra"
verses.translation: "Ācāryaratna, Ācāryanidhi, Gadādhara Paṇḍita, Jagadānanda, Dāmodara, Śaṅkara, Vakreśvara, Kāśīśvara, Mukunda, Vāsudeva, Murāri and many other devotees have descended in Bengal to preach to everyone the glories of the holy name of Kṛṣṇa and the value of love for Him. I have learned from them the meaning of devotional service to Kṛṣṇa."

verses.devanagari: ভট্টের হৃদয়ে দৃঢ় অভিমান জানি’ ।\\nভঙ্গী করি’ মহাপ্রভু কহে এত বাণী ॥৫৩॥
verses.transliteration: bhaṭṭera hṛdaye dṛḍha abhimāna jāni'\\nbhaṅgī kari' mahāprabhu kahe eta vāṇī
verses.translation: Knowing that Vallabha Bhaṭṭa's heart was full of pride, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu spoke these words, hinting at how one can learn about devotional service.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Vallabha Bhaṭṭa was greatly proud of his knowledge in devotional service, and therefore he wanted to speak about Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu without understanding the Lord's position. The Lord therefore hinted in many ways that if Vallabha Bhaṭṭa wanted to know what devotional service actually is, he would have to learn from all the devotees He mentioned, beginning with Advaita Ācārya, Lord Nityānanda, Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya and Rāmānanda Rāya. As Svarūpa Dāmodara has said, if one wants to learn the meaning of
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam,
one must take lessons from a realized soul. One should not proudly think that one can understand the transcendental loving service of the Lord simply by reading books. One must become a servant of a Vaiṣṇava. As Narottama dāsa Ṭhākura has confirmed,
chāḍiyā vaiṣṇava-sevā nistāra pāyeche kebā:
one cannot be in a transcendental position unless one very faithfully serves a pure Vaiṣṇava. One must accept a Vaiṣṇava
guru (ādau gurv-āśrayam),
and then by questions and answers one should gradually learn what pure devotional service to Kṛṣṇa is. That is called the
paramparā
system.

verses.devanagari: “আমি যে ‘বৈষ্ণব’, — ভক্তিসিদ্ধান্ত সব জানি । আমি সে ভাগবত-অর্থ উত্তম বাখানি ।।” ৫৪ ।। ভট্টের মনেতে এই ছিল দীর্ঘ গর্ব  ।\\nপ্রভুর বচন শুনি’ সে হইল খর্ব ॥৫৪॥
verses.transliteration: "āmi se'vaiṣṇava',—bhakti-siddhānta saba jāni\\nāmi se bhāgavata-artha uttama vākhāni"
verses.translation: "I am a great Vaiṣṇava. Having learned all the conclusions of Vaiṣṇava philosophy, I can understand the meaning of Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam and explain it very well."

verses.devanagari: ভট্টের মনেতে এই ছিল দীর্ঘ গর্ব ।\\nপ্রভুর বচন শুনি' সে হইল খর্ব ॥৫৫॥
verses.transliteration: bhaṭṭera manete ei chila dīrgha garva\\nprabhura vacana śuni' se ha-ila kharva
verses.translation: Such pride had existed for a long time within Vallabha Bhaṭṭa's mind, but as he heard the preaching of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, his pride was cut down.

verses.devanagari: প্রভুর মুখে বৈষ্ণবতা শুনিয়া সবার ।\\nভট্টের ইচ্ছা হৈল তাঁ-সবারে দেখিবার ॥৫৬॥
verses.transliteration: prabhura mukhe vaiṣṇavatā śuniyā sabāra\\nbhaṭṭera icchā haila tāṅ-sabāre dekhibāra
verses.translation: When Vallabha Bhaṭṭa heard from the mouth of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu about the pure Vaiṣṇavism of all these devotees, he immediately desired to see them.

verses.devanagari: ভট্ট কহে, — “এ সব বৈষ্ণব রহে কোন্ স্থানে ?\\nকোন্ প্রকারে পাইমু ইহাঁ-সবার দর্শনে ? ॥৫৭॥
verses.transliteration: bhaṭṭa kahe,—"e saba vaiṣṇava rahe kon sthāne?\\nkon prakāre pāimu ihāṅ-sabāra darśane?
verses.translation: Vallabha Bhaṭṭa said, "Where do all these Vaiṣṇavas live, and how can I see them?"

verses.devanagari: প্রভু কহে, — “কেহ গৌড়ে, কেহ দেশান্তরে ।\\nসব আসিয়াছে রথযাত্রা দেখিবারে ॥৫৮॥
verses.transliteration: prabhu kahe,—"keha gauḍe, keha deśāntare\\nsaba āsiyāche ratha-yātrā dekhibāre
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied, "Although some of them live in Bengal and some in other states, they have all come here to see the Ratha-yātrā festival.

verses.devanagari: ইহাঁই রহেন সবে, বাসা — নানা-স্থানে ।\\nইহাঁই পাইবা তুমি সবার দর্শনে ।।” ॥ ৫৯ ॥
verses.transliteration: ihāṅi rahena sabe, vāsā—nānā-sthāne\\nihāṅi pāibā tumi sabāra darśane"
verses.translation: "At present they are all living here. Their residences are in various quarters. Here you will get the audience of them all."

verses.devanagari: তবে ভট্ট কহে বহু বিনয় বচন ।\\nবহু দৈন্য করি’ প্রভুরে কৈল নিমন্ত্রণ ॥৬০॥
verses.transliteration: tabe bhaṭṭa kahe bahu vinaya vacana\\nbahu dainya kari' prabhure kaila nimantraṇa
verses.translation: Thereafter, with great submission and humility, Vallabha Bhaṭṭa invited Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to dine at his home.

verses.devanagari: আর দিন সব বৈষ্ণব প্রভু-স্থানে আইলা ।\\nসবা-সনে মহাপ্রভু ভট্টে মিলাইলা ॥৬১॥
verses.transliteration: āra dina saba vaiṣṇava prabhu-sthāne āilā\\nsabā-sane mahāprabhu bhaṭṭe milāilā
verses.translation: The next day, when all the Vaiṣṇavas came to the abode of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the Lord introduced Vallabha Bhaṭṭa to them all.

verses.devanagari: ‘বৈষ্ণবে’র তেজ দেখি’ ভট্টের চমৎকার ।\\nতাঁ-সবার আগে ভট্ট — খদ্যোত-আকার ॥৬২॥
verses.transliteration: 'vaiṣṇave'ra teja dekhi' bhaṭṭera camatkāra\\ntāṅ-sabāra āge bhaṭṭa—khadyota-ākāra
verses.translation: He was surprised to see the brilliance of their faces. Indeed, among them Vallabha Bhaṭṭa seemed just like a glowworm.

verses.devanagari: তবে ভট্ট বহু মহাপ্রসাদ আনাইল ।\\nগণ-সহ মহাপ্রভুরে ভোজন করাইল ॥৬৩॥
verses.transliteration: tabe bhaṭṭa bahu mahā-prasāda ānāila\\ngaṇa-saha mahāprabhure bhojana karāila
verses.translation: Then Vallabha Bhaṭṭa brought in a great quantity of Lord Jagannātha's mahā-prasāda and sumptuously fed Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and His associates.

verses.devanagari: পরমানন্দ পুরী-সঙ্গে সন্ন্যাসীর গণ ।\\nএকদিকে বৈসে সব করিতে ভোজন ॥৬৪॥
verses.transliteration: paramānanda purī-saṅge sannyāsīra gaṇa\\neka-dike vaise saba karite bhojana
verses.translation: All the sannyāsī associates of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu headed by Paramānanda Purī, sat on one side and thus partook of the prasāda.

verses.devanagari: অদ্বৈত, নিত্যানন্দ-রায় — পার্শ্বে দুইজন ।\\nমধ্যে মহাপ্রভু বসিলা, আগে-পাছে ভক্তগণ ॥৬৫॥
verses.transliteration: advaita, nityānanda-rāya—pārśve dui-jana\\nmadhye mahāprabhu vasilā, āge-pāche bhakta-gaṇa
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu sat in the midst of the devotees. Advaita Ācārya and Lord Nityānanda each sat on one side of the Lord. The other devotees sat in front of the Lord and behind Him.

verses.devanagari: গৌড়ের ভক্ত যত কহিতে না পারি ।\\nঅঙ্গনে বসিলা সব হঞা সারি সারি ॥৬৬॥
verses.transliteration: gauḍera bhakta yata kahite nā pāri\\naṅgane vasilā saba hañā sāri sāri
verses.translation: The devotees from Bengal, whom I am unable to count, all sat down in lines in the courtyard.

verses.devanagari: প্রভুর ভক্তগণ দেখি’ ভট্টের চমৎকার ।\\nপ্রত্যেকে সবার পদে কৈল নমস্কার ॥৬৭॥
verses.transliteration: prabhura bhakta-gaṇa dekhi' bhaṭṭera camatkāra\\npratyeke sabāra pade kaila namaskāra
verses.translation: When Vallabha Bhaṭṭa saw all the devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, he was greatly surprised, but in devotion he offered his obeisances at the lotus feet of each and every one of them.

verses.devanagari: স্বরূপ, জগদানন্দ, কাশীশ্বর, শঙ্কর ।\\nপরিবেশন করে, আর রাঘব, দামোদর ॥৬৮॥
verses.transliteration: svarūpa, jagadānanda, kāśīśvara, śaṅkara\\npariveśana kare, āra rāghava, dāmodara
verses.translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara, Jagadānanda, Kāśīśvara and Śaṅkara, along with Rāghava and Dāmodara Paṇḍita, took charge of distributing the prasāda.

verses.devanagari: মহাপ্রসাদ বল্লভ-ভট্ট বহু আনাইল ।\\nপ্রভু-সহ সন্ন্যাসিগণ ভোজনে বসিল ॥৬৯॥
verses.transliteration: mahā-prasāda vallabha-bhaṭṭa bahu ānāila\\nprabhu-saha sannyāsi-gaṇa bhojane vasila
verses.translation: Vallabha Bhaṭṭa had brought a large quantity of mahā-prasāda offered to Lord Jagannātha. Thus all the sannyāsīs sat down to eat with Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: প্রসাদ পায় বৈষ্ণবগণ বলে, ‘হরি’ ‘হরি’ ।\\nহরি হরি ধ্বনি উঠে সব ব্রহ্মাণ্ড ভরি’ ॥৭০॥
verses.transliteration: prasāda pāya vaiṣṇava-gaṇa bale, 'hari' 'hari'\\nhari hari dhvani uṭhe saba brahmāṇḍa bhari'
verses.translation: Accepting the prasāda, all the Vaiṣṇavas chanted the holy names Hari, Hari. The rising vibration of the holy name of Hari filled the entire universe.

verses.devanagari: মালা, চন্দন, গুবাক, পান অনেক আনিল ।\\nসবা’ পূজা করি’ ভট্ট আনন্দিত হৈল ॥৭১॥
verses.transliteration: mālā, candana, guvāka, pāna aneka ānila\\nsabā' pūjā kari' bhaṭṭa ānandita haila
verses.translation: When all the Vaiṣṇavas had finished eating, Vallabha Bhaṭṭa brought a large quantity of garlands, sandalwood pulp, spices and betel. He worshiped them very respectfully and became extremely happy.

verses.devanagari: রথযাত্রা-দিনে প্রভু কীর্তন আরম্ভিলা ।\\nপূর্ববৎ সাত সম্প্রদায় পৃথক্ করিলা ॥৭২॥
verses.transliteration: ratha-yātrā-dine prabhu kīrtana ārambhilā\\npūrvavat sāta sampradāya pṛthak karilā
verses.translation: On the day of the car festival, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu began the congregational chanting. As He had done previously, He divided all the devotees into seven groups.

verses.devanagari: অদ্বৈত, নিত্যানন্দ, হরিদাস, বক্রেশ্বর ।\\nশ্রীবাস, রাঘব, পণ্ডিত-গদাধর ॥৭৩॥\\nসাত জন সাত-ঠাঞি করেন নর্তন ।\\n‘হরিবোল’ বলি’ প্রভু করেন ভ্রমণ ॥৭৪॥
verses.transliteration: sāta jana sāta-ṭhāñi karena nartana\\n'hari-bola' bali' prabhu karena bhramaṇa
verses.translation: Seven devotees-Advaita, Nityānanda, Haridāsa Ṭhākura, Vakreśvara, Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura, Rāghava Paṇḍita and Gadādhara Paṇḍita-formed seven groups and began dancing. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, chanting "Hari bol," wandered from one group to another.

verses.devanagari: চৌদ্দ মাদল বাজে উচ্চ সঙ্কীর্তন ।\\nএক এক নর্তকের প্রেমে ভাসিল ভুবন ॥৭৫॥
verses.transliteration: caudda mādala bāje ucca saṅkīrtana\\neka eka nartakera preme bhāsila bhuvana
verses.translation: Fourteen mṛdaṅgas resounded with the loud congregational chanting, and in each group was a dancer whose dance of ecstatic love inundated the entire world.

verses.devanagari: দেখি’ বল্লভ-ভট্টের হৈল চমৎকার ।\\nআনন্দে বিহ্বল নাহি আপন-সাম্ভাল ॥৭৬॥
verses.transliteration: dekhi' vallabha-bhaṭṭera haila camatkāra\\nānande vihvala nāhi āpana-sāmbhāla
verses.translation: Seeing all this, Vallabha Bhaṭṭa was completely astonished. He was overwhelmed by transcendental bliss and lost himself.

verses.devanagari: তবে মহাপ্রভু সবার নৃত্য রাখিলা ।\\nপূর্ববৎ আপনে নৃত্য করিতে লাগিলা ॥৭৭॥
verses.transliteration: tabe mahāprabhu sabāra nṛtya rākhilā\\npūrvavat āpane nṛtya karite lāgilā
verses.translation: Then Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu stopped the dancing of the others, and as He had done previously, He personally began to dance.

verses.devanagari: প্রভুর সৌন্দর্য দেখি আর প্রেমোদয় ।\\n‘এই ত’ সাক্ষাৎ কৃষ্ণ’ ভট্টের হইল নিশ্চয় ॥৭৮॥
verses.transliteration: prabhura saundarya dekhi āra premodaya\\n'ei ta' sākṣāt kṛṣṇa' bhaṭṭera ha-ila niścaya
verses.translation: Seeing the beauty of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and the awakening of His ecstatic love, Vallabha Bhaṭṭa concluded, "Here is Lord Kṛṣṇa, without a doubt."

verses.devanagari: এই মত রথযাত্রা সকলে দেখিল ।\\nপ্রভুর চরিত্রে ভট্টের চমৎকার হৈল ॥৭৯॥
verses.transliteration: eta mata ratha-yātrā sakale dekhila\\nprabhura caritre bhaṭṭera camatkāra haila
verses.translation: Thus Vallabha Bhaṭṭa witnessed the car festival. He was simply astonished by the characteristics of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: যাত্রানন্তরে ভট্ট যাই মহাপ্রভু-স্থানে ।\\nপ্রভু-চরণে কিছু কৈল নিবেদনে ॥৮০॥
verses.transliteration: yātrānantare bhaṭṭa yāi mahāprabhu-sthāne\\nprabhu-caraṇe kichu kaila nivedane
verses.translation: One day, after the festival was over, Vallabha Bhaṭṭa went to the abode of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and submitted a request at the lotus feet of the Lord.

verses.devanagari: “ভাগবতের টীকা কিছু করিয়াছি লিখন ।\\nআপনে মহাপ্রভু যদি করেন শ্রবণ ।।” ॥ ৮১ ॥
verses.transliteration: "bhāgavatera ṭīkā kichu kariyāchi likhana\\nāpane mahāprabhu yadi karena śravaṇa"
verses.translation: "I have written some commentary on Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam," he said. "Would Your Lordship kindly hear it?"

verses.devanagari: প্রভু কহে, — “ভাগবতার্থ বুঝিতে না পারি ।\\nভাগবতার্থ শুনিতে আমি নহি অধিকারী ॥৮২॥
verses.transliteration: prabhu kahe,—"bhāgavatārtha bujhite nā pāri\\nbhāgavatārtha śunite āmi nahi adhikārī
verses.translation: The Lord replied, "I do not understand the meaning of Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam. Indeed, I am not a suitable person to hear its meaning.

verses.devanagari: বসি’ কৃষ্ণনাম মাত্র করিয়ে গ্রহণে ।\\nসংখ্যা-নাম পূর্ণ মোর নহে রাত্রি-দিনে ॥৮৩॥
verses.transliteration: vasi' kṛṣṇa-nāma mātra kariye grahaṇe\\nsaṅkhyā-nāma pūrṇa mora nahe rātri-dine
verses.translation: "I simply sit and try to chant the holy name of Kṛṣṇa, and although I chant all day and night, I nevertheless cannot complete the chanting of my prescribed number of rounds."

verses.devanagari: ভট্ট কহে, — “কৃষ্ণনামের অর্থ-ব্যাখ্যানে ।\\nবিস্তার কৈরাছি, তাহা করহ শ্রবণে ।।” ॥ ৮৪ ॥
verses.transliteration: bhaṭṭa kahe, "kṛṣṇa-nāmera artha-vyākhyāne\\nvistāra kairāchi, tāhā karaha śravaṇe"
verses.translation: Vallabha Bhaṭṭa said, "I have tried to describe elaborately the meaning of Kṛṣṇa's holy name. Kindly hear the explanation."

verses.devanagari: প্রভু কহে, — “কৃষ্ণনামের বহু অর্থ না মানি ।\\n‘শ্যামসুন্দর’ ‘যশোদানন্দন’, — এইমাত্র জানি ॥৮৫॥
verses.transliteration: prabhu kahe,—"kṛṣṇa-nāmera bahu artha nā māni\\n"śyāma-sundara' 'yaśodā-nandana,'—ei-mātra jāni
verses.translation: Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied, "I do not accept many different meanings for the holy name of Kṛṣṇa. I know only that Lord Kṛṣṇa is Śyāmasundara and Yaśodānandana. That's all I know.

verses.devanagari: তমালশ্যামলত্বিষি শ্রীযশোদাস্তনন্ধয়ে ।\\nকৃষ্ণনাম্নো রূঢ়িরিতি সর্বশাস্ত্র-বিনির্ণয়ঃ ॥৮৬॥
verses.transliteration: tamāla-śyāmala-tviṣi\\nśrī-yaśodā-stanandhaye\\nkṛṣṇa-nāmno rūḍhir iti\\nsarva-śāstra-vinirṇayaḥ
verses.translation: "The only purport of the holy name of Kṛṣṇa is that He is dark blue like a tamāla tree and is the son of mother Yaśodā. This is the conclusion of all the revealed scriptures.'
verses.purport: PURPORT\nThis is a verse from the\nNāma-kaumuḍī

verses.devanagari: এই অর্থ আমি মাত্র জানিয়ে নির্ধার ।\\nআর সর্ব-অর্থে মোর নাহি অধিকার ।।” ॥ ৮৭ ॥
verses.transliteration: ei artha āmi mātra jāniye nirdhāra\\nāra sarva-arthe mora nāhi adhikāra"
verses.translation: "I conclusively know these two names, Śyāmasundara and Yaśodānandana. I do not understand any other meanings, nor have I the capacity to understand them."

verses.devanagari: ফল্গুপ্রায় ভট্টের নামাদি সব-ব্যাখ্যা ।\\nসর্বজ্ঞ প্রভু জানি’ তারে করেন উপেক্ষা ॥৮৮॥
verses.transliteration: phalgu-prāya bhaṭṭera nāmādi saba-vyākhyā\\nsarvajña prabhu jāni' tāre karena upekṣā
verses.translation: Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is omniscient. Therefore He could understand that Vallabha Bhaṭṭa's explanations of Kṛṣṇa's name and Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam were useless. Therefore He did not care about them.

verses.devanagari: বিমনা হঞা ভট্ট গেলা নিজ-ঘর ।\\nপ্রভু-বিষয়ে ভক্তি কিছু হইল অন্তর ॥৮৯॥
verses.transliteration: vimanā hañā bhaṭṭa gelā nija-ghara\\nprabhu-viṣaye bhakti kichu ha-ila antara
verses.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu rigidly declined to hear his explanations, Vallabha Bhaṭṭa went home feeling morose. His faith and devotion to the Lord changed.

verses.devanagari: তবে ভট্ট গেলা পণ্ডিত-গোসাঞির ঠাঞি ।\\nনানা মতে প্রীতি করি’ করে আসা-যাই ॥৯০॥
verses.transliteration: tabe bhaṭṭa gelā paṇḍita-gosāñira ṭhāñi\\nnānā mate prīti kari' kare āsā-yāi
verses.translation: Thereafter, Vallabha Bhaṭṭa went to the home of Gadādhara Paṇḍita. He kept coming and going, showing affection in various ways, and thus maintained a relationship with him.

verses.devanagari: প্রভুর উপেক্ষায় সব নীলাচলের জন ।\\nভট্টের ব্যাখ্যান কিছু না করে শ্রবণ ॥৯১॥
verses.transliteration: prabhura upekṣāya saba nīlācalera jana\\nbhaṭṭera vyākhyāna kichu nā kare śravaṇa
verses.translation: Because Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu did not take Vallabha Bhaṭṭa very seriously, none of the people in Jagannātha Purī would hear any of his explanations.

verses.devanagari: লজ্জিত হৈল ভট্ট, হৈল অপমানে ।\\nদুঃখিত হঞা গেল পণ্ডিতের স্থানে ॥৯২॥
verses.transliteration: lajjita haila bhaṭṭa, haila apamāne\\nduḥkhita hañā gela paṇḍitera sthāne
verses.translation: Ashamed, insulted and unhappy, Vallabha Bhaṭṭa went to Gadādhara Paṇḍita.

verses.devanagari: দৈন্য করি’ কহে, — “নিলুঁ তোমার শরণ ।\\nতুমি কৃপা করি’ রাখ আমার জীবন ॥৯৩॥
verses.transliteration: dainya kari' kahe,—"niluṅ tomāra śaraṇa\\ntumi kṛpā kari' rākha āmāra jīvana
verses.translation: Approaching him with great humiIity, Vallabha Bhaṭṭa said, "I have taken shelter of you, my dear sir. Kindly be merciful to me and save my life.

verses.devanagari: কৃষ্ণনাম-ব্যাখ্যা যদি করহ শ্রবণ ।\\nতবে মোর লজ্জা-পঙ্ক হয় প্রক্ষালন ।।” ॥ ৯৪ ॥
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇa-nāma-vyākhyā yadi karaha śravaṇa\\ntabe mora lajjā-paṅka haya prakṣālana"
verses.translation: "Please hear my explanation of the meaning of Lord Kṛṣṇa's name. In that way the mud of the shame that has come upon me will be washed off."

verses.devanagari: সঙ্কটে পড়িল পণ্ডিত, করয়ে সংশয় ।\\nকি করিবেন, — একো, করিতে না পারে নিশ্চয় ॥৯৫॥
verses.transliteration: saṅkaṭe paḍila paṇḍita, karaye saṁśaya\\nki karibena,—eko, karite nā pāre niścaya
verses.translation: Thus Paṇḍita Gosāñi fell into a dilemma. He was in such doubt that he could not decide alone what to do.
verses.purport: PURPORT\nŚrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu did not take Vallabha Bhaṭṭa very seriously. Therefore Paṇḍita Gosāñi, or Gadādhara Gosāñi, fell into perplexity. What would be his position if he heard Vallabha Bhaṭṭa's explanation of Śrī Kṛṣṇa's name? Certainly Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would be displeased. Therefore Gadādhara Paṇḍita Gosāñi could not make a decision.

verses.devanagari: যদ্যপি পণ্ডিত আর না কৈলা অঙ্গীকার ।\\nভট্ট যাই’ তবু পড়ে করি’ বলাৎকার ॥৯৬॥
verses.transliteration: yadyapi paṇḍita āra nā kailā aṅgīkāra\\nbhaṭṭa yāi' tabu paḍe kari' balātkāra
verses.translation: Although Gadādhara Paṇḍita Gosāñi did not want to hear it, Vallabha Bhaṭṭa began to read his explanation with great force.

verses.devanagari: আভিজাত্যে পণ্ডিত করিতে নারে নিষেধন ।\\n“এ সঙ্কটে রাখ, কৃষ্ণ লইলাঙ শরণ ॥৯৭॥
verses.transliteration: ābhijātye paṇḍita karite nāre niṣedhana\\n"e saṅkaṭe rākha, kṛṣṇa la-ilāṅa śaraṇa
verses.translation: Because Vallabha Bhaṭṭa was a learned brāhmaṇa, Gadādhara Paṇḍita could not forbid him. Thus he began to think of Lord Kṛṣṇa. "My dear Lord Kṛṣṇa," he requested, "please protect me in this danger. I have taken shelter of You.

verses.devanagari: অন্তর্যামী প্রভু জানিবেন মোর মন ।\\nতাঁরে ভয় নাহি কিছু, ‘বিষম’ তাঁর গণ ।।” ॥ ৯৮ ॥
verses.transliteration: antaryāmī prabhu jānibena mora mana\\ntāṅre bhaya nāhi kichu, 'viṣama' tāṅra gaṇa"
verses.translation: "Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is present in everyone's heart, and He will certainly know my mind. Therefore I do not fear Him. His associates, however, are extremely critical."
verses.purport: PURPORT\nAs the Supreme Personality of Godhead, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu exists in everyone's heart. Therefore He would know the circumstances under which Paṇḍita Gosāñi agreed to hear Vallabha Bhaṭṭa's explanations, and certainly He would not be angry. However, the Vaiṣṇavas who were always with Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu might not understand Gadādhara Paṇḍita's inner consciousness, and they might accuse him of having compromised with Vallabha Bhaṭṭa, despite his having been neglected by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Gadādhara Paṇḍita Gosāñi was seriously thinking in this way.

verses.devanagari: যদ্যপি বিচারে পণ্ডিতের নাহি কিছু দোষ ।\\nতথাপি প্রভুর গণ তাঁরে করে প্রণয়-রোষ ॥৯৯॥
verses.transliteration: yadyapi vicāre paṇḍitera nāhi kichu doṣa\\ntathāpi prabhura gaṇa tāṅre kare praṇaya-roṣa
verses.translation: Although Gadādhara Paṇḍita Gosāñi was not in the least at fault, some of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's devotees showed affectionate anger toward him.

verses.devanagari: প্রত্যহ বল্লভ-ভট্ট আইসে প্রভু-স্থানে ।\\n‘উদ্গ্রাহাদি’ প্রায় করে আচার্যাদি-সনে ॥১০০॥
verses.transliteration: pratyaha vallabha-bhaṭṭa āise prabhu-sthāne\\n'udgrāhādi' prāya kare ācāryādi-sane
verses.translation: Every day, Vallabha Bhaṭṭa would come to the place of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to engage in unnecessary arguments with Advaita Ācārya and other great personalities, such as Svarūpa Dāmodara.

verses.devanagari: যেই কিছু করে ভট্ট ‘সিদ্ধান্ত’ স্থাপন ।\\nশুনিতেই আচার্য তাহা করেন খণ্ডন ॥১০১॥
verses.transliteration: yei kichu kare bhaṭṭa 'siddhānta' sthāpana\\nśunitei ācārya tāhā karena khaṇḍana
verses.translation: Whatever conclusions Vallabha Bhaṭṭa eagerly presented were refuted by personalities like Advaita Ācārya.

verses.devanagari: আচার্যাদি-আগে ভট্ট যবে যবে যায় ।\\nরাজহংস-মধ্যে যেন রহে বকপ্রায় ॥১০২॥
verses.transliteration: ācāryādi-āge bhaṭṭa yabe yabe yāya\\nrājahaṁsa-madhye yena rahe baka-prāya
verses.translation: Whenever Vallabha Bhaṭṭa entered the society of devotees, headed by Advaita Ācārya, he was like a duck in a society of white swans.

verses.devanagari: একদিন ভট্ট পুছিল আচার্যেরে ।\\n“জীব-‘প্রকৃতি’ ‘পতি’ করি’ মানয়ে কৃষ্ণেরে ॥১০৩॥
verses.transliteration: eka-dina bhaṭṭa puchila ācāryere\\n"jīva-'prakṛti' 'pati' kari' mānaye kṛṣṇere
verses.translation: One day Vallabha Bhaṭṭa said to Advaita Ācārya, "Every living entity is female [prakṛti] and considers Kṛṣṇa her husband [pati].

verses.devanagari: পতিব্রতা হঞা পতির নাম নাহি লয় ।\\nতোমরা কৃষ্ণনাম লহ, — কোন্ ধর্ম হয়?” ॥১০৪॥
verses.transliteration: pati-vratā hañā patira nāma nāhi laya\\ntomarā kṛṣṇa-nāma-laha,—kon dharma haya?"
verses.translation: "It is the duty of a chaste wife, devoted to her husband, not to utter her husband's name, but all of you chant the name of Kṛṣṇa. How can this be called a religious principle?"

verses.devanagari: আচার্য কহে, — “আগে তোমার ‘ধর্ম’ মূর্তিমান্ ।\\nইঁহারে পুছহ, ইঁহ করিবেন ইহার সমাধান ॥১০৫॥
verses.transliteration: ācārya kahe,—"āge tomāra 'dharma' mūrtimān\\niṅhāre puchaha, iṅha karibena ihāra samādhāna
verses.translation: Advaita Ācārya responded, "In front of you is Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the personification of religious principles. You should ask Him, for He will give you the proper answer."

verses.devanagari: শুনি’ প্রভু কহেন, — “তুমি না জান ধর্মমর্ম ।\\nস্বামি-আজ্ঞা পালে, — এই পতিব্রতা-ধর্ম ॥১০৬॥
verses.transliteration: śuni' prabhu kahena,—"tumi nā jāna dharma-marma\\nsvāmi-ājñā pāle,—ei pati-vratā-dharma
verses.translation: Hearing this, Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "My dear Vallabha Bhaṭṭa, you do not know religious principles. Actually, the first duty of a chaste woman is to carry out the order of her husband.

verses.devanagari: পতির আজ্ঞা, — নিরন্তর তাঁর নাম লইতে ।\\nপতির আজ্ঞা পতিব্রতা না পারে লঙ্ঘিতে ॥১০৭॥
verses.transliteration: patira ājñā,—nirantara tāṅra nāma la-ite\\npatira ājñā pati-vratā nā pāre laṅghite
verses.translation: "The order of Kṛṣṇa is to chant His name incessantly. Therefore one who is chaste and adherent to the husband Kṛṣṇa must chant the Lord's name, for she cannot deny the husband's order.

verses.devanagari: অতএব নাম লয়, নামের ‘ফল’ পায় ।\\nনামের ফলে কৃষ্ণপদে ‘প্রেম’ উপজায় ।।” ॥ ১০৮ ॥
verses.transliteration: ataeva nāma laya, nāmera 'phala' pāya\\nnāmera phale kṛṣṇa-pade 'prema' upajāya"
verses.translation: "Following this religious principle, a pure devotee of Lord Kṛṣṇa always chants the holy name. As a result of this, he gets the fruit of ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa."

verses.devanagari: শুনিয়া বল্লভ-ভট্ট হৈল নির্বচন  ।\\nঘরে যাই’ মনে দুঃখে করেন চিন্তন ॥১০৯॥
verses.transliteration: śuniyā vallabha-bhaṭṭa haila nirvacana\\nghare yāi' mane duḥkhe karena cintana
verses.translation: Hearing this, Vallabha Bhaṭṭa was speechless. He returned home greatly unhappy and began to consider thus.

verses.devanagari: “নিত্য আমার এই সভায় হয় কক্ষা-পাত ।\\nএকদিন উপরে যদি হয় মোর বাত্ ॥১১০॥\\nতবে সুখ হয়, আর সব লজ্জা যায় ।\\nস্ব-বচন স্থাপিতে আমি কি করি উপায়? ।।” ১১১ ॥১১১॥
verses.transliteration: tabe sukha haya, āra saba lajjā yāya\\nsva-vacana sthāpite āmi ki kari upāya?
verses.translation: "Every day I am defeated in this assembly. If by chance I am one day victorious, that will be a great source of happiness for me, and all my shame will go away. But what means shall I adopt to establish my statements?"

verses.devanagari: আর দিন আসি’ বসিলা প্রভুরে নমস্করি’  ।\\nসভাতে কহেন কিছু মনে গর্ব করি’ ॥১১২॥
verses.transliteration: āra dina āsi' vasilā prabhure namaskari'\\nsabhāte kahena kichu mane garva kari'
verses.translation: The next day when he came to the assembly of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, he sat down after offering obeisances to the Lord and said something with great pride.

verses.devanagari: “ভাগবতে স্বামীর ব্যাখ্যান কৈরাছি খণ্ডন  ।\\nলইতে না পারি তাঁর ব্যাখ্যান-বচন ॥১১৩॥
verses.transliteration: "bhāgavate svāmīra vyākhyāna kairāchi khaṇḍana\\nla-ite nā pāri tāṅra vyākhyāna-vacana
verses.translation: "In my commentary on Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam," he said, "I have refuted the explanations of Śrīdhara Svāmī. I cannot accept his explanations.

verses.devanagari: সেই ব্যাখ্যা করেন যাহাঁ যেই পড়ে আনি’ ।\\nএকবাক্যতা নাহি, তাতে ‘স্বামী’ নাহি মানি ।।” ॥ ১১৪ ॥
verses.transliteration: sei vyākhyā karena yāhāṅ yei paḍe āni'\\neka-vākyatā nāhi, tāte 'svāmī' nāhi māni"
verses.translation: "Whatever Śrīdhara Svāmī reads he explains according to the circumstances. Therefore he is inconsistent in his explanations and cannot be accepted as an authority."

verses.devanagari: প্রভু হাসি’ কহে, — “স্বামী না মানে যেই জন ।\\nবেশ্যার ভিতরে তারে করিয়ে গণন ।।” ॥ ১১৫ ॥
verses.transliteration: prabhu hāsi' kahe,—"svāmī nā māne yei jana\\nveśyāra bhitare tāre kariye gaṇana"
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu smilingly replied, "One who does not accept the svāmī [husband] as an authority I consider a prostitute."

verses.devanagari: এত কহি’ মহাপ্রভু মৌন ধরিলা ।\\nশুনিয়া সবার মনে সন্তোষ হইলা ॥১১৬॥
verses.transliteration: eta kahi' mahāprabhu mauna dharilā\\nśuniyā sabāra mane santoṣa ha-ilā
verses.translation: After saying this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was very grave. All the devotees present derived great satisfaction from hearing this statement.

verses.devanagari: জগতের হিত লাগি’ গৌর-অবতার ।\\nঅন্তরের অভিমান জানেন তাহার ॥১১৭॥
verses.transliteration: jagatera hita lāgi' gaura-avatāra\\nantarera abhimāna jānena tāhāra
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu descended as an incarnation for the benefit of the entire world. Thus He knew the mind of Vallabha Bhaṭṭa very well.

verses.devanagari: নানা অবজ্ঞানে ভট্টে শোধেন ভগবান্ ।\\nকৃষ্ণ যৈছে খণ্ডিলেন ইন্দ্রের অভিমান ॥১১৮॥
verses.transliteration: nānā avajñāne bhaṭṭe śodhena bhagavān\\nkṛṣṇa yaiche khaṇḍilena indrera abhimāna
verses.translation: By various hints and refutations, Lord Caitanya, the Supreme Personality of Godhead, corrected Vallabha Bhaṭṭa exactly as Kṛṣṇa had cut down the false pride of Indra.
verses.purport: PURPORT\nIndra, the King of heaven, was very proud of his position. Therefore when the residents of Vṛndāvana decided not to perform the Indra-yajña but to perform the Govardhana-yajña in accordance with the instructions of Kṛṣṇa, Indra, because of his false pride, wanted to chastise the residents of Vṛndāvana. Thinking himself extremely powerful, Indra poured incessant rain upon Vṛndāvana, but Lord Kṛṣṇa immediately cut down his pride by lifting the Govardhana Hill as an umbrella to save the residents of Vṛndāvana. In this way Kṛṣṇa proved Indra's power most insignificant in the presence of His own omnipotence.

verses.devanagari: অজ্ঞ জীব নিজ-‘হিতে’ ‘অহিত’ করি’ মানে ।\\nগর্ব চূর্ণ হৈলে, পাছে উঘাড়ে নয়নে ॥১১৯॥
verses.transliteration: ajña jīva nija-'hite' 'ahita' kari' māne\\ngarva cūrṇa haile, pāche ughāḍe nayane
verses.translation: An ignorant living being does not recognize his actual profit. Because of ignorance and material pride, he sometimes considers profit a loss, but when his pride is cut down he can actually see his true benefit.

verses.devanagari: ঘরে আসি’ রাত্র্যে ভট্ট চিন্তিতে লাগিল ।\\n“পূর্বে প্রয়াগে মোরে মহা-কৃপা কৈল ॥১২০॥
verses.transliteration: ghare āsi' rātrye bhaṭṭa cintite lāgila\\n"pūrve prayāge more mahā-kṛpā kaila
verses.translation: Returning home that night, Vallabha Bhaṭṭa thought, "Previously, at Prayāga, Lord Caitanya was very kind to me.

verses.devanagari: স্বগণ-সহিতে মোর মানিলা নিমন্ত্রণ ।\\nএবে কেনে প্রভুর মোতে ফিরি’ গেল মন? ॥১২১॥
verses.transliteration: svagaṇa-sahite mora mānilā nimantraṇa\\nebe kene prabhura mote phiri' gela mana?
verses.translation: "He accepted my invitation with His other devotees, and He was kind to me. Why has He now changed so much here at Jagannātha Purī?

verses.devanagari: ‘আমি জিতি’, — এই গর্ব-শূন্য হউক ইঁহার চিত ।\\nঈশ্বর-স্বভাব, — করেন সবাকার হিত ॥১২২॥
verses.transliteration: 'āmi jiti',—ei garva-śūnya ha-uka iṅhāra cita\\nīśvara-svabhāva,—karena sabākāra hita
verses.translation: "Being very proud of my learning, I am thinking, 'Let me become victorious.' Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, however, is trying to purify me by nullifying this false pride, for a characteristic of the Supreme Personality of Godhead is that He acts for everyone's welfare.

verses.devanagari: আপনা জানাইতে আমি করি অভিমান ।\\nসে গর্ব খণ্ডাইতে মোর করেন অপমান ॥১২৩॥
verses.transliteration: āpanā jānāite āmi kari abhimāna\\nse garva khaṇḍāite mora karena apamāna
verses.translation: "I am falsely proud, advertising myself as a learned scholar. Therefore Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu insults me just to favor me by cutting down this false pride.

verses.devanagari: আমার ‘হিত’ করেন, — ইহো আমি মানি ‘দুঃখ’ ।\\nকৃষ্ণের উপরে কৈল যেন ইন্দ্র মহামূর্খ ।।” ॥ ১২৪ ॥
verses.transliteration: āmāra 'hita' karena,—iho āmi māni 'duḥkha'\\nkṛṣṇera upare kaila yena indra mahā-mūrkha"
verses.translation: "He is actually acting for my benefit, although I interpret His actions as insults. This is exactly like the incident in which Lord Kṛṣṇa cut down Indra, the great, puffed-up fool, to correct him."

verses.devanagari: এত চিন্তি’ প্রাতে আসি’ প্রভুর চরণে ।\\nদৈন্য করি’ স্তুতি করি’ লইল শরণে ॥১২৫॥
verses.transliteration: eta cinti' prāte āsi' prabhura caraṇe\\ndainya kari' stuti kari' la-ila śaraṇe
verses.translation: Thinking in this way, Vallabha Bhaṭṭa approached Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu the next morning, and in great humility, offering many prayers, he sought shelter and surrendered at the lotus feet of the Lord.

verses.devanagari: “আমি অজ্ঞ জীব, — অজ্ঞোচিত কর্ম কৈলুঁ ।\\nতোমার আগে মূর্খ আমি পাণ্ডিত্য প্রকাশিলুঁ ॥১২৬॥
verses.transliteration: "āmi ajña jīva,—ajñocita karma kailuṅ\\ntomāra āge mūrkha āmi pāṇḍitya prakāśiluṅ
verses.translation: Vallabha Bhaṭṭa admitted, "I am a great fool, and indeed I have acted like a fool by trying to demonstrate to You my learning.

verses.devanagari: তুমি — ঈশ্বর, নিজোচিত কৃপা যে করিলা ।\\nঅপমান করি’ সর্ব গর্ব খণ্ডাইলা ॥১২৭॥
verses.transliteration: tumi—īśvara, nijocita kṛpā ye karilā\\napamāna kari' sarva garva khaṇḍāilā
verses.translation: "My dear Lord, You are the Supreme Personality of Godhead. You have showed mercy to me in a way just befitting Your position by insulting me to cut down all my false pride.

verses.devanagari: আমি — অজ্ঞ, ‘হিত’-স্থানে মানি ‘অপমানে’ ।\\nইন্দ্র যেন কৃষ্ণের নিন্দা করিল অজ্ঞানে ॥১২৮॥
verses.transliteration: āmi—ajña, 'hita'-sthāne māni 'apamāne'\\nindra yena kṛṣṇera nindā karila ajñāne
verses.translation: "I am an ignorant fool, for I interpret as an insult what is meant for my benefit, just like King Indra, who out of ignorance tried to surpass Kṛṣṇa, the Supreme Lord.

verses.devanagari: তোমার কৃপা-অঞ্জনে এবে গর্ব-আন্ধ্য গেল ।\\nতুমি এত কৃপা কৈলা, — এবে ‘জ্ঞান’ হৈল ॥১২৯॥
verses.transliteration: tomāra kṛpā-añjane ebe garva-āndhya gela\\ntumi eta kṛpā kailā,—ebe 'jñāna' haila
verses.translation: "My dear Lord, You have cured the blindness of my false pride by smearing my eyes with the ointment of Your mercy. You have bestowed so much mercy upon me that my ignorance is now gone.

verses.devanagari: অপরাধ কৈনু, ক্ষম, লইনু শরণ ।\\nকৃপা করি’ মোর মাথে ধরহ চরণ ।।” ॥ ১৩০ ॥
verses.transliteration: aparādha kainu, kṣama, la-inu śaraṇa\\nkṛpā kari' mora māthe dharaha caraṇa"
verses.translation: "My dear Lord, I have committed offenses. Please excuse me. I seek shelter of You. Please be merciful unto me by placing Your lotus feet on my head."

verses.devanagari: প্রভু কহে, — “তুমি ‘পণ্ডিত’ ‘মহাভাগবত’ ।\\nদুইগুণ যাহাঁ, তাহাঁ নাহি গর্ব-পর্বত ॥১৩১॥
verses.transliteration: prabhu kahe—"tumi 'paṇḍita' 'mahā-bhāgavata'\\ndui-guṇa yāhāṅ, tāhāṅ nāhi garva-parvata
verses.translation: Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "You are both a greatly learned scholar and a great devotee. Wherever there are two such attributes, there cannot be a mountain of false pride.

verses.devanagari: শ্রীধরস্বামী নিন্দি’ নিজ-টীকা কর !\\nশ্রীধরস্বামী নাহি মান’, — এত ‘গর্ব’ ধর! ॥১৩২॥
verses.transliteration: śrīdhara-svāmī nindi' nija-ṭīkā kara!\\nśrīdhara-svāmī nāhi māna',—eta 'garva' dhara!
verses.translation: "You have dared criticize Śrīdhara Svāmī, and you have begun your own commentary on Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam, not accepting his authority. That is your false pride.

verses.devanagari: শ্রীধরস্বামী-প্রসাদে ‘ভাগবত’ জানি ।\\nজগদ্গুরু শ্রীধরস্বামী ‘গুরু’ করি’ মানি ॥১৩৩॥
verses.transliteration: śrīdhara-svāmī-prasāde 'bhāgavata' jāni\\njagad-guru śrīdhara-svāmī 'guru' kari' māni
verses.translation: "Śrīdhara Svāmī is the spiritual master of the entire world because by his mercy we can understand Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam. I therefore accept him as a spiritual master.

verses.devanagari: শ্রীধর-উপরে গর্বে যে কিছু লিখিবে ।\\n‘অর্থব্যস্ত’ লিখন সেই, লোকে না মানিবে ॥১৩৪॥
verses.transliteration: śrīdhara-upare garve ye kichu likhibe\\n'artha-vyasta' likhana sei, loke nā mānibe
verses.translation: "Whatever you might write due to false pride, trying to surpass Śrīdhara Svāmī, would carry a contrary purport. Therefore no one would pay attention to it.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
has many
ṭīkās,
or commentaries, following the
paramparā
system, but Śrīdhara Svāmī's is first. The commentaries of all the other
ācāryas
follow his. The
paramparā
system does not allow one to deviate from the commentaries of the previous
ācāryas.
By depending upon the previous
ācāryas,
one can write beautiful commentaries. However, one cannot defy the previous
ācāryas.
The false pride that makes one think that he can write better than the previous
ācāryas
will make one's comments faulty. At the present moment it has become fashionable for everyone to write in his own way, but such writing is never accepted by serious devotees. Because of false pride, every scholar and philosopher wants to exhibit his learning by interpreting the
śāstras,
especially
Bhagavad-gītā
and
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam,
in his own way. This system of commenting in one's own way is fully condemned by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Therefore He says,
'artha-vyasta' likhana sei.
Commentaries written according to one's own philosophical way are never accepted; no one will appreciate such commentaries on the revealed scriptures.

verses.devanagari: শ্রীধরের অনুগত যে করে লিখন ।\\nসব লোক মান্য করি’ করিবে গ্রহণ ॥১৩৫॥
verses.transliteration: śrīdharera anugata ye kare likhana\\nsaba loka mānya kari' karibe grahaṇa
verses.translation: "One who comments on Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam following in the footsteps of Śrīdhara Svāmī will be honored and accepted by everyone.

verses.devanagari: শ্রীধরানুগত কর ভাগবত-ব্যাখ্যান ।\\nঅভিমান ছাড়ি’ ভজ কৃষ্ণ ভগবান্ ॥১৩৬॥
verses.transliteration: śrīdharānugata kara bhāgavata-vyākhyāna\\nabhimāna chāḍi' bhaja kṛṣṇa bhagavān
verses.translation: "Put forth your explanation of Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam following in the footsteps of Śrīdhara Svāmī. Giving up your false pride, worship the Supreme Personality of Godhead, Kṛṣṇa.

verses.devanagari: অপরাধ ছাড়ি’ কর কৃষ্ণসঙ্কীর্তন ।\\nঅচিরাৎ পাবে তবে কৃষ্ণের চরণ ।।” ॥ ১৩৭ ॥
verses.transliteration: aparādha chāḍi' kara kṛṣṇa-saṅkīrtana\\nacirāt pābe tabe kṛṣṇera caraṇa"
verses.translation: "Abandoning your offenses, chant the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra, the holy names of the Lord. Then very soon you will achieve shelter at the lotus feet of Kṛṣṇa."

verses.devanagari: ভট্ট কহে, — “যদি মোরে হইলা প্রসন্ন ।\\nএকদিন পুনঃ মোর মান’ নিমন্ত্রণ ।।” ॥ ১৩৮ ॥
verses.transliteration: bhaṭṭa kahe,—"yadi more ha-ilā prasanna\\neka-dina punaḥ mora māna' nimantraṇa"
verses.translation: Vallabha Bhaṭṭa Ācārya requested Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, "If You are actually pleased with me, please accept my invitation once again."

verses.devanagari: প্রভু অবতীর্ণ হৈলা জগৎ তারিতে ।\\nমানিলেন নিমন্ত্রণ, তারে সুখ দিতে ॥১৩৯॥
verses.transliteration: prabhu avatīrṇa hailā jagat tārite\\nmānilena nimantraṇa, tāre sukha dite
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, who had descended to deliver the entire universe, accepted the invitation of Vallabha Bhaṭṭa just to give him happiness.

verses.devanagari: জগতের ‘হিত’ হউক, — এই প্রভুর মন ।\\nদণ্ড করি’ করে তার হৃদয় শোধন ॥১৪০॥
verses.transliteration: jagatera 'hita' ha-uka—ei prabhura mana\\ndaṇḍa kari' kare tāra hṛdaya śodhana
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is always eager to see everyone in the material world happy. Therefore sometimes He chastises someone just to purify his heart.

verses.devanagari: স্বগণ-সহিত প্রভুর নিমন্ত্রণ কৈলা ।\\nমহাপ্রভু তারে তবে প্রসন্ন হইলা ॥১৪১॥
verses.transliteration: svagaṇa-sahita prabhura nimantraṇa kailā\\nmahāprabhu tāre tabe prasanna ha-ilā
verses.translation: When Vallabha Bhaṭṭa invited Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and His associates, the Lord was very pleased with him.

verses.devanagari: জগদানন্দ-পণ্ডিতের শুদ্ধ গাঢ় ভাব ।\\nসত্যভামা-প্রায় প্রেম ‘বাম্য-স্বভাব’ ॥১৪২॥
verses.transliteration: jagadānanda-paṇḍitera śuddha gāḍha bhāva\\nsatyabhāmā-prāya prema 'vāmya-svabhāva'
verses.translation: Jagadānanda Paṇḍita's pure ecstatic love for Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was very deep. It can be compared to the love of Satyabhāmā, who always quarreled with Lord Kṛṣṇa.

verses.devanagari: বার-বার প্রণয় কলহ করে প্রভু-সনে ।\\nঅন্যোঽন্যে খট্মটি চলে দুইজনে ॥১৪৩॥
verses.transliteration: bāra-bāra praṇaya kalaha kare prabhu-sane\\nanyonye khaṭmaṭi cale dui-jane
verses.translation: Jagadānanda Paṇḍita was accustomed to provoking loving quarrels with the Lord. There was always some disagreement between them.

verses.devanagari: গদাধর-পণ্ডিতের শুদ্ধ গাঢ় ভাব ।\\nরুক্মিণী-দেবীর যৈছে ‘দক্ষিণ-স্বভাব’ ॥১৪৪॥
verses.transliteration: gadādhara-paṇḍitera śuddha gāḍha bhāva\\nrukmiṇī-devīra yaiche 'dakṣiṇa-svabhāva'
verses.translation: Gadādhara Paṇḍita's pure ecstatic love for Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was also very deep. It was like that of Rukmiṇīdevī, who was always especially submissive to Kṛṣṇa.

verses.devanagari: তাঁর প্রণয়-রোষ দেখিতে প্রভুর ইচ্ছা হয় ।\\nঐশ্বর্য-জ্ঞানে তাঁর রোষ নাহি উপজয় ॥১৪৫॥
verses.transliteration: tāṅra praṇaya-roṣa dekhite prabhura icchā haya\\naiśvarya-jñāne tāṅra roṣa nāhi upajaya
verses.translation: Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu sometimes desired to see Gadādhara Paṇḍita's affectionate anger, but because of knowledge of the Lord's opulences, his anger was never invoked.
verses.purport: PURPORT\nJoking with Rukmiṇīdevī in Dvārakā, Kṛṣṇa once advised her to accept another husband because He thought Himself unfit for her. Rukmiṇīdevī, however, unable to understand His joking words, took them very seriously and immediately fell to the ground in fear of separation from Him. In the pastimes of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Jagadānanda Paṇḍita was always in disagreement with the Lord like Satyabhāmā, whereas Gadādhara Paṇḍita was always awed by the Lord's opulence and was therefore submissive to the Lord under all circumstances.

verses.devanagari: এই লক্ষ্য পাঞা প্রভু কৈলা রোষাভাস ।\\nশুনি’ পণ্ডিতের চিত্তে উপজিল ত্রাস ॥১৪৬॥
verses.transliteration: ei lakṣya pāñā prabhu kailā roṣābhāsa\\nśuni' paṇḍitera citte upajila trāsa
verses.translation: For this purpose Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu sometimes showed His apparent anger. Hearing of this anger inspired great fear in the heart of Gadādhara Paṇḍita.

verses.devanagari: পূর্বে যেন কৃষ্ণ যদি পরিহাস কৈল ।\\nশুনি’ রুক্মিণীর মনে ত্রাস উপজিল ॥১৪৭॥
verses.transliteration: pūrve yena kṛṣṇa yadi parihāsa kaila\\nśuni' rukmiṇīra mane trāsa upajila
verses.translation: Previously, in kṛṣṇa-līlā, when Lord Kṛṣṇa wanted to joke with Rukmiṇīdevī, she took His words seriously, and fear awoke within her mind.

verses.devanagari: বল্লভ-ভট্টের হয় বাৎসল্য-উপাসন  ।\\nবালগোপাল-মন্ত্রে তেঁহো করেন সেবন ॥১৪৮॥
verses.transliteration: vallabha-bhaṭṭera haya vātsalya-upāsana\\nbāla-gopāla-mantre teṅho karena sevana
verses.translation: Vallabha Bhaṭṭa was accustomed to worshiping the Lord as child Kṛṣṇa. Therefore he had been initiated into the Bāla-gopāla mantra and was thus worshiping the Lord.

verses.devanagari: পণ্ডিতের সনে তার মন ফিরি’ গেল  ।\\nকিশোরগোপাল-উপাসনায় মন দিল ॥১৪৯॥
verses.transliteration: paṇḍitera sane tāra mana phiri' gela\\nkiśora-gopāla-upāsanāya mana dila
verses.translation: In the association of Gadādhara Paṇḍita, his mind was converted, and he dedicated his mind to worshiping Kiśora-gopāla, Kṛṣṇa as a young boy.

verses.devanagari: পণ্ডিতের ঠাঞি চাহে মন্ত্রাদি শিখিতে ।\\nপণ্ডিত কহে, — “এই কর্ম নহে আমা হৈতে ॥১৫০॥
verses.transliteration: paṇḍitera ṭhāñi cāhe mantrādi śikhite\\npaṇḍita kahe,—"ei karma nahe āmā haite
verses.translation: Vallabha Bhaṭṭa wanted to be initiated by Gadādhara Paṇḍita, but Gadādhara Paṇḍita refused, saying, "The work of acting as a spiritual master is not possible for me.

verses.devanagari: আমি — পরতন্ত্র, আমার প্রভু — গৌরচন্দ্র ।\\nতাঁর আজ্ঞা বিনা আমি না হই ‘স্বতন্ত্র’ ॥১৫১॥
verses.transliteration: āmi—paratantra, āmāra prabhu—gauracandra\\ntāṅra ājñā vinā āmi nā ha-i 'svatantra'
verses.translation: "I am completely dependent. My Lord is Gauracandra, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. I cannot do anything independently, without His order.

verses.devanagari: তুমি যে আমার ঠাঞি কর আগমন ।\\nতাহাতেই প্রভু মোরে দেহ ওলাহন ।।” ॥ ১৫২ ॥
verses.transliteration: tumi ye āmāra ṭhāñi kara āgamana\\ntāhātei prabhu more dena olāhana"
verses.translation: "My dear Vallabha Bhaṭṭa, your coming to me is not appreciated by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Therefore He sometimes speaks to chastise me."

verses.devanagari: এইমত ভট্টের কথেক দিন গেল ।\\nশেষে যদি প্রভু তারে সুপ্রসন্ন হৈল ॥১৫৩॥\\nনিমন্ত্রণের দিনে পণ্ডিতে বোলাইলা ।\\nস্বরূপ, জগদানন্দ, গোবিন্দে পাঠাইলা ॥১৫৪॥
verses.transliteration: nimantraṇera dine paṇḍite bolāilā\\nsvarūpa, jagadānanda, govinde pāṭhāilā
verses.translation: Some days passed, and when Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, finally pleased with Vallabha Bhaṭṭa, accepted his invitation, the Lord sent Svarūpa Dāmodara, Jagadānanda Paṇḍita and Govinda to call for Gadādhara Paṇḍita.

verses.devanagari: পথে পণ্ডিতেরে স্বরূপ কহেন বচন ।\\n“পরীক্ষিতে প্রভু তোমারে কৈলা উপেক্ষণ ॥১৫৫॥
verses.transliteration: pathe paṇḍitere svarūpa kahena vacana\\n"parīkṣite prabhu tomāre kailā upekṣaṇa
verses.translation: On the way, Svarūpa Dāmodara said to Gadādhara Paṇḍita, "Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu wanted to test you. Therefore He neglected you.

verses.devanagari: তুমি কেনে আসি’ তাঁরে না দিলা ওলাহন ?\\nভীতপ্রায় হঞা কাঁহে করিলা সহন?” ॥১৫৬॥
verses.transliteration: tumi kene āsi' tāṅre nā dilā olāhana?\\nbhīta-prāya hañā kāṅhe karilā sahana?"
verses.translation: "Why did you not retaliate by reproaching Him? Why did you fearfully tolerate His criticism?"

verses.devanagari: পণ্ডিত কহেন, — প্রভু স্বতন্ত্র সর্বজ্ঞ-শিরোমণি ।\\nতাঁর সনে ‘হঠ’ করি, — ভাল নাহি মানি ॥১৫৭॥
verses.transliteration: paṇḍita kahena,—prabhu svatantra sarvajña-śiromaṇi\\ntāṅra sane 'haṭha' kari,—bhāla nāhi māni
verses.translation: Gadādhara Paṇḍita said, "Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is completely independent. He is the topmost omniscient personality. It would not look well for me to talk to Him as if His equal.

verses.devanagari: যেই কহে, সেই সহি নিজ-শিরে ধরি’ ।\\nআপনে করিবেন কৃপা গুণ-দোষ বিচারি’ ।।” ॥ ১৫৮ ॥
verses.transliteration: yei kahe, sei sahi nija-śire dhari'\\nāpane karibena kṛpā guṇa-doṣa vicāri' "
verses.translation: "I can tolerate whatever He says, bearing it upon my head. He will automatically be merciful to me after considering my faults and attributes."

verses.devanagari: এত বলি’ পণ্ডিত প্রভুর স্থানে আইলা ।\\nরোদন করিয়া প্রভুর চরণে পড়িলা ॥১৫৯॥
verses.transliteration: eta bali' paṇḍita prabhura sthāne āilā\\nrodana kariyā prabhura caraṇe paḍilā
verses.translation: After saying this, Gadādhara Paṇḍita went to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and fell down crying at the lotus feet of the Lord.

verses.devanagari: ঈষৎ হাসিয়া প্রভু কৈলা আলিঙ্গন  ।\\nসবারে শুনাঞা কহেন মধুর বচন ॥১৬০॥
verses.transliteration: īṣat hāsiyā prabhu kailā āliṅgana\\nsabāre śunāñā kahena madhura vacana
verses.translation: Smiling slightly, the Lord embraced him and spoke sweet words so that others would also hear.

verses.devanagari: “আমি চালাইলুঁ তোমা, তুমি না চলিলা  ।\\nক্রোধে কিছু না কহিলা, সকল সহিলা ॥১৬১॥
verses.transliteration: "āmi cālāiluṅ tomā, tumi nā calilā\\nkrodhe kichu nā kahilā, sakala sahilā
verses.translation: "I wanted to agitate you," the Lord said, "but you did not become agitated. Indeed, you could not say anything angry. Instead, you tolerated everything.

verses.devanagari: আমার ভঙ্গীতে তোমার মন না চলিলা ।\\nসুদৃঢ় সরলভাবে আমারে কিনিলা ।।” ॥ ১৬২ ॥
verses.transliteration: āmāra bhaṅgīte tomāra mana nā calilā\\nsudṛḍha sarala-bhāve āmāre kinilā"
verses.translation: "Your mind was not disturbed by My tricks. Rather, you stayed fixed in your simplicity. In this way you have purchased Me."

verses.devanagari: পণ্ডিতের ভাব-মুদ্রা কহন না যায় ।\\n‘গদাধর-প্রাণনাথ’ নাম হৈল যায় ॥১৬৩॥
verses.transliteration: paṇḍitera bhāva-mudrā kahana nā yāya\\n'gadādhara-prāṇa-nātha' nāma haila yāya
verses.translation: No one can describe the characteristics and ecstatic love of Gadādhara Paṇḍita. Therefore another name for Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is Gadādhara-prāṇanātha, "the life and soul of Gadādhara Paṇḍita."

verses.devanagari: পণ্ডিতে প্রভুর প্রসাদ কহন না যায় ।\\n‘গদাইর গৌরাঙ্গ’ বলি’ যাঁরে লোকে গায় ॥১৬৪॥
verses.transliteration: paṇḍite prabhura prasāda kahana nā yāya\\n'gadāira gaurāṅga' bali' yāṅre loke gāya
verses.translation: No one can say how merciful the Lord is to Gadādhara Paṇḍita, but people know the Lord as Gadāira Gaura, "the Lord Gaurāṅga of Gadādhara Paṇḍita."

verses.devanagari: চৈতন্যপ্রভুর লীলা কে বুঝিতে পারে ?\\nএকলীলায় বহে গঙ্গার শত শত ধারে ॥১৬৫॥
verses.transliteration: caitanya-prabhura līlā ke bujhite pāre?\\neka-līlāya vahe gaṅgāra śata śata dhāre
verses.translation: No one can understand the pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. They are like the Ganges, for hundreds and thousands of branches flow from even one of His activities.

verses.devanagari: পণ্ডিতের সৌজন্য, ব্রহ্মণ্যতা-গুণ ।\\nদৃঢ় প্রেমমুদ্রা লোকে করিলা খ্যাপন ॥১৬৬॥
verses.transliteration: paṇḍitera saujanya, brahmaṇyatā-guṇa\\ndṛḍha prema-mudrā loke karilā khyāpana
verses.translation: Gadādhara Paṇḍita is celebrated all over the world for his gentle behavior, his brahminical attributes and his steady love for Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: অভিমান-পঙ্ক ধুঞা ভট্টেরে শোধিলা ।\\nসেইদ্বারা আর সব লোকে শিখাইলা ॥১৬৭॥
verses.transliteration: abhimāna-paṅka dhuñā bhaṭṭere śodhilā\\nsei-dvārā āra saba loke śikhāilā
verses.translation: The Lord purified Vallabha Bhaṭṭa by cleansing him of the mud of false pride. By such activities the Lord also instructed others.

verses.devanagari: অন্তরে ‘অনুগ্রহ’, বাহ্যে ‘উপেক্ষার প্রায়’ ।\\nবাহ্যার্থ যেই লয়, সেই নাশ যায় ॥১৬৮॥
verses.transliteration: antare 'anugraha,' bāhye 'upekṣāra prāya'\\nbāhyārtha yei laya, sei nāśa yāya
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was actually always merciful within His heart, but He was sometimes externally negligent of His devotees. We should not be preoccupied with His external feature, however, for if we do so we shall be vanquished.

verses.devanagari: নিগূঢ় চৈতন্যলীলা বুঝিতে কা’র শক্তি ?\\nসেই বুঝে, গৌরচন্দ্রে যাঁর দৃঢ় ভক্তি ॥১৬৯॥
verses.transliteration: nigūḍha caitanya-līlā bujhite kā'ra śakti?\\nsei bujhe, gauracandre yāṅra dṛḍha bhakti
verses.translation: The pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu are very deep. Who can understand them? Only one who has firm, deep devotion to His lotus feet.

verses.devanagari: দিনান্তরে পণ্ডিত কৈল প্রভুর নিমন্ত্রণ ।\\nপ্রভু তাহাঁ ভিক্ষা কৈল লঞা নিজগণ ॥১৭০॥
verses.transliteration: dināntare paṇḍita kaila prabhura nimantraṇa\\nprabhu tāhāṅ bhikṣā kaila lañā nija-gaṇa
