Although such persons may call themselves preachers, live in Vṛndāvana or Navadvīpa, and also print many religious books, it is all for the same purpose, namely to earn a living to maintain their wives and children. They may also professionally recite the
Bhāgavatam
or other scriptures, worship the Deity in the temple and initiate disciples. Making a show of devotional paraphernalia, they may also collect money from the public and use it to cure the disease of some family member or near relative. Sometimes they become
bābājīs
or collect money on the plea of worshiping the poor, whom they call
daridra-nārāyaṇa,
or for social and political upliftment. Thus they spread a network of business schemes to collect money for sense gratification by cheating people in general who have no knowledge of pure devotional service. Such cheaters cannot understand that by offering devotional service to the Supreme Personality of Godhead, one can be elevated to a position of eternal servitude to the Lord, which is even greater than the position of Brahmā and other demigods. Unfortunately, fools have no understanding of the perpetual pleasure of devotional service.

verses.devanagari: তোমা লাগি’ রামানন্দ রাজ্য ত্যাগ কৈলা ।\\nতোমা লাগি’ সনাতন ‘বিষয়’ ছাড়িলা ॥৭০॥
verses.transliteration: tomā lāgi' rāmānanda rājya tyāga kailā\\ntomā lāgi' sanātana 'viṣaya' chāḍilā
verses.translation: "It is only for Your sake that Rāmānanda Rāya resigned from the governorship of South India and Sanātana Gosvāmī gave up his post as minister.

verses.devanagari: তোমা লাগি’ রঘুনাথ সকল ছাড়িল ।\\nহেথায় তাহার পিতা বিষয় পাঠাইল ॥৭১॥
verses.transliteration: tomā lāgi' raghunātha sakala chāḍila\\nhethāya tāhāra pitā viṣaya pāṭhāila
verses.translation: "It is for Your sake that Raghunātha dāsa gave up all his family relationships. His father sent money and men here to serve him.

verses.devanagari: তোমার চরণ-কৃপা হঞাছে তাহারে ।\\nছত্রে মাগি’ খায়, ‘বিষয়’ স্পর্শ নাহি করে ॥৭২॥
verses.transliteration: tomāra caraṇa-kṛpā hañāche tāhāre\\nchatre māgi' khāya, 'viṣaya' sparśa nāhi kare
verses.translation: "However, because he has received the mercy of Your lotus feet, he does not even accept his father's money. Instead he eats by begging alms from centers for the distribution of food.

verses.devanagari: রামানন্দের ভাই গোপীনাথ-মহাশয় ।\\nতোমা হৈতে বিষয়-বাঞ্ছা, তার ইচ্ছা নয় ॥৭৩॥
verses.transliteration: rāmānandera bhāi gopīnātha-mahāśaya\\ntomā haite viṣaya-vāñchā, tāra icchā naya
verses.translation: "Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka is a good gentleman. He does not desire material benefits from You.

verses.devanagari: তার দুঃখ দেখি’ তার সেবকাদিগণ ।\\nতোমারে জানাইল, — যাতে ‘অনন্যশরণ’ ॥৭৪॥
verses.transliteration: tāra duḥkha dekhi' tāra sevakādi-gaṇa\\ntomāre jānāila,—yāte 'ananya-śaraṇa'
verses.translation: "It is not Gopīnātha who sent all those men so that You would release him from his plight. Rather, his friends and servants, seeing his distressed condition, informed You because they all knew that Gopīnātha is a soul surrendered unto You.

verses.devanagari: সেই ‘শুদ্ধভক্ত’, যে তোমা ভজে তোমা লাগি’ ।\\nআপনার সুখ-দুঃখে হয় ভোগ-ভাগী’ ॥৭৫॥
verses.transliteration: sei 'śuddha-bhakta', ye tomā bhaje tomā lāgi'\\nāpanāra sukha-duḥkhe haya bhoga-bhogī'
verses.translation: "Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka is a pure devotee who worships You only for Your satisfaction. He does not care about his personal happiness or distress, for that is the business of a materialist.

verses.devanagari: তোমার অনুকম্পা চাহে, ভজে অনুক্ষণ ।\\nঅচিরাৎ মিলে তাঁরে তোমার চরণ ॥৭৬॥
verses.transliteration: tomāra anukampā cāhe, bhaje anukṣaṇa\\nacirāt mile tāṅre tomāra caraṇa
verses.translation: "One who engages in Your devotional service twenty-four hours a day, desiring only Your mercy, will very soon attain shelter at Your lotus feet.

verses.devanagari: তত্তেঽনুকম্পাং সুসমীক্ষমাণো\\nভুঞ্জান এবাত্মকৃতং বিপাকম্ ।\\nহৃদ্বাগ্বপুর্ভির্বিদধন্নমস্তে\\nজীবেত যো মুক্তিপদে স দায়ভাক্ ॥৭৭॥
verses.transliteration: tat te 'nukampāṁ susamīkṣamāṇo\\nbhuñjāna evātma-kṛtaṁ vipākam\\nhṛd-vāg-vapurbhir vidadhan namas te\\njīveta yo mukti-pade sa dāya-bhāk
verses.translation: "One who seeks Your compassion and thus tolerates all kinds of adverse conditions due to the karma of his past deeds, who engages always in Your devotional service with his mind, words and body, and who always offers obeisances unto You is certainly a bona fide candidate for becoming Your unalloyed devotee.'
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This is a verse from
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
(10.14.8).

verses.devanagari: এথা তুমি বসি’ রহ, কেনে যাবে আলালনাথ ?\\nকেহ তোমা না শুনাবে বিষয়ীর বাত্ ॥৭৮॥
verses.transliteration: ethā tumi vasi' raha, kene yābe ālālanātha?\\nkeha tomā nā śunābe viṣayīra vāt
verses.translation: "Kindly stay here at Jagannātha Purī. Why should You go to Ālālanātha? Henceforward, no one will approach You about material affairs."

verses.devanagari: যদি বা তোমার তারে রাখিতে হয় মন ।\\nআজি যে রাখিল, সেই করিবে রক্ষণ ।।” ॥ ৭৯ ॥
verses.transliteration: yadi vā tomāra tāre rākhite haya mana\\nāji ye rākhila, sei karibe rakṣaṇa"
verses.translation: Finally Kāśī Miśra told the Lord, "If You want to give protection to Gopīnātha, then Lord Jagannātha, who protected him today, will also protect him in the future."

verses.devanagari: এত বলি’ কাশীমিশ্র গেলা স্ব-মন্দিরে ।\\nমধ্যাহ্নে প্রতাপরুদ্র আইলা তাঁর ঘরে ॥৮০॥
verses.transliteration: eta bali' kāśī-miśra gelā sva-mandire\\nmadhyāhne pratāparudra āilā tāṅra ghare
verses.translation: After saying this, Kāśī Miśra left the abode of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and returned to his own temple. At noon King Pratāparudra came to Kāśī Miśra's home.

verses.devanagari: প্রতাপরুদ্রের এক আছয়ে নিয়মে  ।\\nযত দিন রহে তেঁহ শ্রীপুরুষোত্তমে ॥৮১॥
verses.transliteration: pratāparudrera eka āchaye niyame\\nyata dina rahe teṅha śrī-puruṣottame
verses.translation: As long as King Pratāparudra stayed in his capital, Puruṣottama, he performed one regular duty.

verses.devanagari: নিত্য আসি’ করে মিশ্রের পাদ সম্বাহন  ।\\nজগন্নাথ-সেবার করে ভিয়ান শ্রবণ ॥৮২॥
verses.transliteration: nitya āsi' kare miśrera pāda saṁvāhana\\njagannātha-sevāra kare bhiyāna śravaṇa
verses.translation: He would come daily to the house of Kāśī Miśra to massage his lotus feet. The King would also hear from him about how opulently Lord Jagannātha was served.

verses.devanagari: রাজা মিশ্রের চরণ যবে চাপিতে লাগিলা ।\\nতবে মিশ্র তাঁরে কিছু ভঙ্গীতে কহিলা ॥৮৩॥
verses.transliteration: rājā miśrera caraṇa yabe cāpite lāgilā\\ntabe miśra tāṅre kichu bhaṅgīte kahilā
verses.translation: When the King began pressing his lotus feet, Kāśī Miśra informed him about something through hints.

verses.devanagari: “দেব, শুন আর এক অপরূপ বাত্ !\\nমহাপ্রভু ক্ষেত্র ছাড়ি’ যাবেন আলালনাথ !” ॥ ৮৪ ॥
verses.transliteration: "deva, śuna āra eka aparūpa vāt!\\nmahāprabhu kṣetra chāḍi' yābena ālālanātha!"
verses.translation: "My dear King," he said, "please hear one uncommon item of news. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu wants to leave Jagannātha Purī and go to Ālālanātha."

verses.devanagari: শুনি রাজা দুঃখী হৈলা, পুছিলেন কারণ ।\\nতবে মিশ্র কহে তাঁরে সব বিবরণ ॥৮৫॥
verses.transliteration: śuni rājā duḥkhī hailā, puchilena kāraṇa\\ntabe miśra kahe tāṅre saba vivaraṇa
verses.translation: When the King heard that Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was going to Ālālanātha, he was very unhappy and inquired about the reason. Then Kāśī Miśra informed him of all the details.

verses.devanagari: “গোপীনাথ-পট্টনায়কে যবে চাঙ্গে চড়াইলা ।\\nতার সেবক সব আসি’ প্রভুরে কহিলা ॥৮৬॥
verses.transliteration: "gopīnātha-paṭṭanāyake yabe cāṅge caḍāilā\\ntāra sevaka saba āsi' prabhure kahilā
verses.translation: "When Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka was lifted onto the cāṅga," he said, "all his servants went to inform Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: শুনিয়া ক্ষোভিত হৈল মহাপ্রভুর মন ।\\nক্রোধে গোপীনাথে কৈলা বহুত ভর্ৎসন ॥৮৭॥
verses.transliteration: śuniyā kṣobhita haila mahāprabhura mana\\nkrodhe gopīnāthe kailā bahuta bhartsana
verses.translation: "Hearing about this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was extremely sorry at heart, and in anger He chastised Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka.

verses.devanagari: ‘অজিতেন্দ্রিয় হঞা করে রাজবিষয় ।\\nনানা অসৎপথে করে রাজদ্রব্য ব্যয় ॥৮৮॥
verses.transliteration: 'ajitendriya hañā kare rāja-viṣaya\\nnānā asat-pathe kare rāja-dravya vyaya
verses.translation: "Because he is mad after sense gratification,' the Lord said, 'he acts as a government servant but spends the government's revenue for various sinful activities.

verses.devanagari: ব্রহ্মস্ব-অধিক এই হয় রাজধন ।\\nতাহা হরি’ ভোগ করে মহাপাপী জন ॥৮৯॥
verses.transliteration: brahmasva-adhika ei haya rāja-dhana\\ntāhā hari' bhoga kare mahā-pāpī jana
verses.translation: "The revenue of the government is more sacred than the property of a brāhmaṇa. One who misappropriates the government's money and uses it to enjoy sense gratification is most sinful.

verses.devanagari: রাজার বর্তন খায়, আর চুরি করে ।\\nরাজদণ্ড্য হয় সেই শাস্ত্রের বিচারে ॥৯০॥
verses.transliteration: rājāra vartana khāya, āra curi kare\\nrāja-daṇḍya haya sei śāstrera vicāre
verses.translation: "One who serves the government but misappropriates the government's revenue is liable to be punished by the king. That is the verdict of all revealed scriptures.

verses.devanagari: নিজ-কৌড়ি মাগে, রাজা নাহি করে দণ্ড ।\\nরাজা — মহাধার্মিক, এই হয় পাপী ভণ্ড ! ॥ ৯১ ॥
verses.transliteration: nija-kauḍi māge, rājā nāhi kare daṇḍa\\nrājā—mahā-dhārmika, ei haya pāpī bhaṇḍa!
verses.translation: "The King wanted his revenue paid and did not want to enforce punishment. Therefore the King is certainly very religious. But Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka is a great cheat.

verses.devanagari: রাজ-কড়ি না দেয়, আমারে ফুকারে ।\\nএই মহাদুঃখ ইঁহা কে সহিতে পারে ? ॥ ৯২ ॥
verses.transliteration: rājā-kaḍi nā deya, āmāre phukāre\\nei mahā-duḥkha ihāṅ ke sahite pāre?
verses.translation: "He does not pay the revenue to the King, but he wants My help for release. This is a greatly sinful affair. I cannot tolerate it here.

verses.devanagari: আলালনাথ যাই’ তাহাঁ নিশ্চিন্তে রহিমু ।\\nবিষয়ীর ভাল মন্দ বার্তা না শুনিমু’ ।।” ॥ ৯৩ ॥
verses.transliteration: ālālanātha yāi' tāhāṅ niścinte rahimu\\nviṣayīra bhāla manda vārtā nā śunimu' "
verses.purport: PURPORT\n"Therefore I shall leave Jagannātha Purī and go to Ālālanātha, where I shall live peacefully and not hear about all these affairs of materialistic people.' "

verses.devanagari: এত শুনি’ কহে রাজা পাঞা মনে ব্যথা ।\\n“সব দ্রব্য ছাড়োঁ, যদি প্রভু রহেন এথা ॥৯৪॥
verses.transliteration: eta śuni' kahe rājā pāñā mane vyathā\\n"saba dravya chāḍoṅ, yadi prabhu rahena ethā
verses.translation: When King Pratāparudra heard all these details, he felt great pain in his mind. "I shall give up all that is due from Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka," he said, "if Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu stays here at Jagannātha Purī.

verses.devanagari: একক্ষণ প্রভুর যদি পাইয়ে দরশন ।\\nকোটিচিন্তামণি-লাভ নহে তার সম ॥৯৫॥
verses.transliteration: eka-kṣaṇa prabhura yadi pāiye daraśana\\nkoṭi-cintāmaṇi-lābha nahe tāra sama
verses.translation: "If even for a moment I could get an interview with Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, I would not care for the profit of millions of cintāmaṇi stones.

verses.devanagari: কোন্ ছার পদার্থ এই দুইলক্ষ কাহন ?\\nপ্রাণ-রাজ্য করোঁ প্রভুপদে নির্মঞ্ছন ।।” ॥ ৯৬ ॥
verses.transliteration: kon chāra padārtha ei dui-lakṣa kāhana?\\nprāṇa-rājya karoṅ prabhu-pade nirmañchana"
verses.translation: "I do not care about this small sum of 200,000 kāhanas. Not to speak of this, I would indeed sacrifice everything at the lotus feet of the Lord, including my life and kingdom."

verses.devanagari: মিশ্র কহে, “কৌড়ি ছাড়িবা, — নহে প্রভুর মন ।\\nতারা দুঃখ পায়, — এই না যায় সহন ।।” ॥ ৯৭ ॥
verses.transliteration: miśra kahe, "kauḍi chāḍibā,—nahe prabhura mana\\ntārā duḥkha pāya,—ei nā yāya sahana"
verses.translation: Kāśī Miśra hinted to the King, "It is not the Lord's desire that you forfeit the payment. He is unhappy only because the whole family is troubled."

verses.devanagari: রাজা কহে, — “তারে আমি দুঃখ নাহি দিয়ে ।\\nচাঙ্গে চড়া, খড়্গে ডারা, — আমি না জানিয়ে ॥৯৮॥
verses.transliteration: rājā kahe,—"tāre āmi duḥkha nāhi diye\\ncāṅge caḍā, khaḍge ḍārā,—āmi nā jāniye
verses.translation: The King replied, "I have no desire to give pain to Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka and his family, nor did I know about his being lifted on the cāṅga to be thrown on the swords and killed.

verses.devanagari: পুরুষোত্তম-জানারে তেঁহ কৈল পরিহাস ।\\nসেই ‘জানা’ তারে দেখাইল মিথ্যা ত্রাস ॥৯৯॥
verses.transliteration: puruṣottama-jānāre teṅha kaila parihāsa\\nsei 'jānā' tāre dekhāila mithyā trāsa
verses.translation: "He sneered at Puruṣottama Jānā. Therefore the prince tried to scare him as a punishment.

verses.devanagari: তুমি যাহ, প্রভুরে রাখহ যত্ন করি’ ।\\nএই মুই তাহারে ছাড়িনু সব কৌড়ি ।।” ॥ ১০০ ॥
verses.transliteration: tumi yāha, prabhure rākhaha yatna kari'\\nei mui tāhāre chāḍinu saba kauḍi"
verses.translation: "Go personally to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and keep Him at Jagannātha Purī with great attention. I shall excuse Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka from all his debts."

verses.devanagari: মিশ্র কহে, “কৌড়ি ছাড়িবা, — নহে প্রভুর মনে ।\\nকৌড়ি ছাড়িলে প্রভু কদাচিৎ দুঃখ মানে ।।” ॥ ১০১ ॥
verses.transliteration: miśra kahe, "kauḍi chāḍibā,—nahe prabhura mane\\nkauḍi chāḍile prabhu kadācit duḥkha māne"
verses.translation: Kāśī Miśra said, "Excusing Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka of all his debts will not make the Lord happy, for that is not His intention."

verses.devanagari: রাজা কহে, “কৌড়ি ছাড়িমু, — ইহা না কহিবা ।\\nসহজে মোর প্রিয় তা’রা, — ইহা জানাইবা ॥১০২॥
verses.transliteration: rājā kahe, "kauḍi chāḍimu,—ihā nā kahibā\\nsahaje mora priya tā'rā,—ihā jānāibā
verses.translation: The King said, "I shall absolve Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka of all his debts, but don't speak of this to the Lord. Simply let Him know that all the family members of Bhavānanda Rāya and Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka are naturally my dear friends.

verses.devanagari: ভবানন্দ-রায় — আমার পূজ্য-গর্বিত ।\\nতাঁর পুত্রগণে আমার সহজেই প্রীত ।।” ॥ ১০৩ ॥
verses.transliteration: bhavānanda-rāya—āmāra pūjya-garvita\\ntāṅra putra-gaṇe āmāra sahajei prīta"
verses.translation: "Bhavānanda Rāya is worthy of my worship and respect. Therefore I am always naturally affectionate to his sons."

verses.devanagari: এত বলি’ মিশ্রে নমস্করি’ রাজা ঘরে গেলা ।\\nগোপীনাথে ‘বড় জানায়’ ডাকিয়া আনিলা ॥১০৪॥
verses.transliteration: eta bali' miśre namaskari' rājā ghare gelā\\ngopīnāthe 'baḍa jānāya' ḍākiyā ānilā
verses.translation: After offering obeisances to Kāśī Miśra, the King returned to his palace and called for both Gopīnātha and the eldest prince.

verses.devanagari: রাজা কহে, — “সব কৌড়ি তোমারে ছাড়িলুঁ ।\\nসেই মালজাঠ্যা দণ্ড পাট তোমারে ত’ দিলুঁ ॥১০৫॥
verses.transliteration: rājā kahe,—"saba kauḍi tomāre chāḍiluṅ\\nsei mālajāṭhyā daṇḍa pāṭa tomāre ta' diluṅ
verses.translation: The King told Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka, "You are excused for all the money you owe the treasury, and the place known as Mālajāṭhyā Daṇḍapāṭa is again given to you for collections.

verses.devanagari: আর বার ঐছে না খাইহ রাজধন ।\\nআজি হৈতে দিলুঁ তোমায় দ্বিগুণ বর্তন ।।” ॥ ১০৬ ॥
verses.transliteration: āra bāra aiche nā khāiha rāja-dhana\\nāji haite diluṅ tomāya dviguṇa vartana"
verses.translation: "Do not again misappropriate the revenue of the government. In case you think your salary insufficient, henceforward it will be doubled."

verses.devanagari: এত বলি’ ‘নেতধটী’ তারে পরাইল ।\\n“প্রভু-আজ্ঞা লঞা যাহ, বিদায় তোমা দিল” ॥১০৭॥
verses.transliteration: eta bali' 'neta-dhaṭī' tāre parāila\\n"prabhu-ājñā lañā yāha, vidāya tomā dila"
verses.translation: After saying this, the King appointed him by offering him a silken wrapper for his body. "Go to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu," he said. "After taking permission from Him, go to your home. I bid you farewell. Now you may go."

verses.devanagari: পরমার্থে প্রভুর কৃপা, সেহ রহু দূরে ।\\nঅনন্ত তাহার ফল, কে বলিতে পারে ? ॥ ১০৮ ॥
verses.transliteration: paramārthe prabhura kṛpā, seha rahu dūre\\nananta tāhāra phala, ke balite pāre?
verses.translation: By the mercy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, one can certainly become spiritually advanced. Indeed, no one can estimate the results of His mercy.

verses.devanagari: ‘রাজ্য-বিষয়’-ফল এই — কৃপার ‘আভাসে’ !\\nতাহার গণনা কারো মনে নাহি আইসে ! ॥ ১০৯ ॥
verses.transliteration: 'rājya-viṣaya'-phala ei—kṛpāra 'ābhāse'!\\ntāhāra gaṇanā kāro mane nāhi āise!
verses.translation: Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka achieved the result of kingly opulence due to but a glimpse of the Lord's mercy. Therefore no one can calculate the full value of His mercy.

verses.devanagari: কাহাঁ চাঙ্গে চড়াঞা লয় ধন-প্রাণ !\\nকাহাঁ সব ছাড়ি’ সেই রাজ্যাদি-প্রদান ! ॥ ১১০ ॥
verses.transliteration: kāhāṅ cāṅge caḍāñā laya dhana-prāṇa!\\nkāhāṅ saba chāḍi' sei rājyādi-pradāna!
verses.translation: Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka was lifted onto the cāṅga to be killed, and all his money was taken away, but instead his debts were excused, and he was appointed collector in the same place.

verses.devanagari: কাহাঁ সর্বস্ব বেচি’ লয়, দেয়া না যায় কৌড়ি !\\nকাহাঁ দ্বিগুণ বর্তন, পরায় নেতধড়ি ! ॥ ১১১ ॥
verses.transliteration: kāhāṅ sarvasva veci' laya, deyā nā yāya kauḍi!\\nkāhāṅ dviguṇa vartana, parāya neta-dhaḍi!
verses.translation: On one hand Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka was unable to clear his debt even by selling all his possessions, but on the other his salary was doubled, and he was honored with the silken wrapper.

verses.devanagari: প্রভুর ইচ্ছা নাহি, তারে কৌড়ি ছাড়াইবে ।\\nদ্বিগুণ বর্তন করি’ পুনঃ ‘বিষয়’ দিবে ॥১১২॥
verses.transliteration: prabhura icchā nāhi, tāre kauḍi chāḍāibe\\ndviguṇa vartana kari' punaḥ 'viṣaya' dibe
verses.translation: It was not the desire of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu that Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka be excused of his debt to the government, nor was it His desire that his salary be doubled or that he be reappointed collector at the same place.

verses.devanagari: তথাপি তার সেবক আসি’ কৈল নিবেদন ।\\nতাতে ক্ষুব্ধ হৈল যবে মহাপ্রভুর মন ॥১১৩॥
verses.transliteration: tathāpi tāra sevaka āsi' kaila nivedana\\ntāte kṣubdha haila yabe mahāprabhura mana
verses.translation: When Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka's servant went to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and informed the Lord of his plight, the Lord was somewhat agitated and dissatisfied.

verses.devanagari: বিষয়-সুখ দিতে প্রভুর নাহি মনোবল ।\\nনিবেদন-প্রভাবেহ তবু ফলে এত ফল ॥১১৪॥
verses.transliteration: viṣaya-sukha dite prabhura nāhi manobala\\nnivedana-prabhāveha tabu phale eta phala
verses.translation: The Lord had no intention to award His devotee the happiness of material opulence, yet simply because of His being informed, such a great result was obtained.

verses.devanagari: কে কহিতে পারে গৌরের আশ্চর্য স্বভাব ?\\nব্রহ্মা-শিব আদি যাঁর না পায় অন্তর্ভাব ॥১১৫॥
verses.transliteration: ke kahite pāre gaurera āścarya svabhāva?\\nbrahmā-śiva ādi yāṅra nā pāya antarbhāva
verses.translation: No one can estimate the wonderful characteristics of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Even Lord Brahmā and Lord Śiva cannot understand the intentions of the Lord.

verses.devanagari: এথা কাশীমিশ্র আসি’ প্রভুর চরণে ।\\nরাজার চরিত্র সব কৈলা নিবেদনে ॥১১৬॥
verses.transliteration: ethā kāśī-miśra āsi' prabhura caraṇe\\nrājāra caritra saba kailā nivedane
verses.translation: Kāśī Miśra went to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and informed Him in detail of all the King's intentions.

verses.devanagari: প্রভু কহে, — “কাশীমিশ্র, কি তুমি করিলা ?\\nরাজ-প্রতিগ্রহ তুমি আমা’ করাইলা ?” ॥ ১১৭ ॥
verses.transliteration: prabhu kahe,—"kāśī-miśra, ki tumi karilā?\\nrāja-pratigraha tumi āmā' karāilā?"
verses.translation: Upon hearing about Kāśī Miśra's tactics with the King, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "Kāśī Miśra, what have you done? You have made Me indirectly take help from the King."
verses.purport: PURPORT\nWhen the King heard the details of Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka's unfortunate condemnation, he was induced to excuse his debt, in particular because he felt that Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was very sorry about this incident. The Lord did not like the idea that the money forfeited to Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka was indirectly a contribution to Him. Therefore He immediately protested.

verses.devanagari: মিশ্র কহে, — “শুন, প্রভু, রাজার বচনে  ।\\nঅকপটে রাজা এই কৈলা নিবেদনে ॥১১৮॥
verses.transliteration: miśra kahe,—"śuna, prabhu, rājāra vacane\\nakapaṭe rājā ei kailā nivedane
verses.translation: Kāśī Miśra said, "My dear Lord, the King has done this without reservations. Kindly hear his statement.

verses.devanagari: ‘প্রভু যেন নাহি জানেন, — রাজা আমার লাগিয়া  ।\\nদুইলক্ষ কাহন কৌড়ি দিলেক ছাড়িয়া ॥১১৯॥
verses.transliteration: 'prabhu yena nāhi jānena,—rājā āmāra lāgiyā\\ndui-lakṣa kāhana kauḍi dileka chāḍiyā
verses.translation: "The King said,'Speak to the Lord in such a way that He will not think, "For My sake the King has forfeited 200,000 kāhanas of kauḍis."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
The
kauḍi
is like an American cent or Japanese yen. In the old medium of exchange, the first unit of currency was a small conchshell called a
kauḍi.
Four
kauḍis
made one
gaṇḍā,
twenty
gaṇḍās
made one
paṇa,
and sixteen
paṇas
made one
kāhana.
Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka owed the government 200,000
kāhanas.
The King absolved him of this debt, reappointed him to his post and doubled his salary.

verses.devanagari: ভবানন্দের পুত্র সব — মোর প্রিয়তম ।\\nইঁহা-সবাকারে আমি দেখি আত্মসম ॥১২০॥
verses.transliteration: bhavānandera putra saba—mora priyatama\\niṅhā-sabākāre āmi dekhi ātma-sama
verses.translation: "Inform Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu that all the sons of Bhavānanda Rāya are especially dear to me. I consider them like members of my family.

verses.devanagari: অতএব যাহাঁ যাহাঁ দেই অধিকার ।\\nখায়, পিয়ে, লুটে, বিলায়, না করোঁ বিচার ॥১২১॥
verses.transliteration: ataeva yāhāṅ yāhāṅ dei adhikāra\\nkhāya, piye, luṭe, vilāya, nā karoṅ vicāra
verses.translation: "Therefore I have appointed them collectors in various places, and although they spend the government's money, eat, drink, plunder and distribute it as they like, I do not take them very seriously.

verses.devanagari: রাজমহিন্দার ‘রাজা’ কৈনু রাম-রায় ।\\nযে খাইল, যেবা দিল, নাহি লেখা-দায় ॥১২২॥
verses.transliteration: rājamahindāra 'rājā' kainu rāma-rāya\\nye khāila, yebā dila, nāhi lekhā-dāya
verses.translation: "I made Rāmānanda Rāya the governor of Rājamahendrī. There is practically no account of whatever money he took and distributed in that position.
verses.purport: PURPORT\nNear Rājamahendrī is a famous railway station. Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī notes that the present Rājamahendrī City is located on the northern bank of the Godāvarī. At the time when Rāmānanda Rāya was governor, however, the state capital, which was known as Vidyānagara or Vidyāpura, was located on the southern side of the Godāvarī, at the confluence of the Godāvarī and the sea. That was the part of the country which at that time was known as Rājamahendrī. North of Kaliṅga-deśa is Utkaliṅga, or the state of Orissa. The capital of southern Orissa was known as Rājamahendrī, but now the location of Rājamahendrī has changed.

verses.devanagari: গোপীনাথ এইমত ‘বিষয়’ করিয়া ।\\nদুইচারি-লক্ষ কাহন রহে ত’ খাঞা ॥১২৩॥
verses.transliteration: gopīnātha ei-mata 'viṣaya' kariyā\\ndui-cāri-lakṣa kāhana rahe ta' khāñā
verses.translation: "Having been appointed collector, Gopīnātha, in the same way, also generally spends two to four hundred thousand kāhanas as he likes.

verses.devanagari: কিছু দেয়, কিছু না দেয়, না করি বিচার ।\\n‘জানা’-সহিত অপ্রীত্যে দুঃখ পাইল এইবার ॥১২৪॥
verses.transliteration: kichu deya, kichu nā deya, nā kari vicāra\\njānā'-sahita aprītye duḥkha pāila ei-bāra
verses.translation: "Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka would collect some and pay some, spending it at will, but I would not consider this very seriously. This time, however, he was put in trouble because of a misunderstanding with the prince.

verses.devanagari: ‘জানা’ এত কৈলা, — ইহা মুই নাহি জানোঁ ।\\nভবানন্দের পুত্র-সবে আত্মসম মানোঁ ॥১২৫॥
verses.transliteration: 'jānā' eta kailā,—ihā mui nāhi jānoṅ\\nbhavānandera putra-sabe ātma-sama mānoṅ
verses.translation: "The prince created this situation without my knowledge, but actually I consider all the sons of Bhavānanda Rāya to be like my relatives.

verses.devanagari: তাঁহা লাগি’ দ্রব্য ছাড়ি, — ইহা মাৎ জানে ।\\n‘সহজেই মোর প্রীতি হয় তাহা-সনে’ ।।” ॥ ১২৬ ॥
verses.transliteration: tāṅhā lāgi' dravya chāḍi'—ihā māt jāne\\n'sahajei mora prīti haya tāhā-sane' "
verses.translation: "Because of my intimate relationship with them, I have absolved Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka of all his debts. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu does not know this fact. Whatever I have done is because of my intimate relationship with the family of Bhavānanda Rāya.' "

verses.devanagari: শুনিয়া রাজার বিনয় প্রভুর আনন্দ ।\\nহেনকালে আইলা তথা রায় ভবানন্দ ॥১২৭॥
verses.transliteration: śuniyā rājāra vinaya prabhura ānanda\\nhena-kāle āilā tathā rāya bhavānanda
verses.translation: Having heard from Kāśī Miśra all these statements concerning the King's mentality, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was very happy. At that time, Bhavānanda Rāya also arrived there.

verses.devanagari: পঞ্চপুত্র-সহিতে আসি’ পড়িলা চরণে ।\\nউঠাঞা প্রভু তাঁরে কৈলা আলিঙ্গনে ॥১২৮॥
verses.transliteration: pañca-putra-sahite āsi' paḍilā caraṇe\\nuṭhāñā prabhu tāṅre kailā āliṅgane
verses.translation: Bhavānanda Rāya, along with his five sons, fell at the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, who lifted him up and embraced him.

verses.devanagari: রামানন্দ-রায় আদি সবাই মিলিলা ।\\nভবানন্দ-রায় তবে বলিতে লাগিলা ॥১২৯॥
verses.transliteration: rāmānanda-rāya ādi sabāi mililā\\nbhavānanda-rāya tabe balite lāgilā
verses.translation: Thus Rāmānanda Rāya, all his brothers, and their father met Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Then Bhavānanda Rāya began speaking.

verses.devanagari: “তোমার কিঙ্কর এই সব মোর কুল ।\\nএ বিপদে রাখি’ প্রভু, পুনঃ নিলা মূল ॥১৩০॥
verses.transliteration: "tomāra kiṅkara ei saba mora kula\\ne vipade rākhi' prabhu, punaḥ nilā mūla
verses.translation: "All these members of my family," he said, "are Your eternal servants. You have saved us from this great danger. Therefore You have purchased us for a proper price.

verses.devanagari: ভক্তবাৎসল্য এবে প্রকট করিলা ।\\nপূর্বে যেন পঞ্চপাণ্ডবে বিপদে তারিলা ।।” ॥ ১৩১ ॥
verses.transliteration: bhakta-vātsalya ebe prakaṭa karilā\\npūrve yena pañca-pāṇḍave vipade tārilā"
verses.translation: "You have now demonstrated Your love for Your devotees, just as when You previously saved the five Pāṇḍavas from great danger."

verses.devanagari: ‘নেতধটী’-মাথে গোপীনাথ চরণে পড়িলা ।\\nরাজার কৃপা-বৃত্তান্ত সকল কহিলা ॥১৩২॥
verses.transliteration: 'netadhaṭī'-māthe gopīnātha caraṇe paḍilā\\nrājāra kṛpā-vṛttānta sakala kahilā
verses.translation: Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka, his head covered with the silken wrapper, fell at the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and described in detail the King's mercy toward him.

verses.devanagari: “বাকী-কৌড়ি বাদ, আর দ্বিগুণ বর্তন কৈলা ।\\nপুনঃ ‘বিষয়’ দিয়া ‘নেতধটী’ পরাইলা ॥১৩৩॥
verses.transliteration: "bākī-kauḍi bāda, āra dviguṇa vartana kailā\\npunaḥ 'viṣaya' diyā 'neta-dhaṭī' parāilā
verses.translation: "The King has excused me for the balance due," he said. "He has reappointed me to my post by honoring me with this silken cloth and has doubled my salary.

verses.devanagari: কাহাঁ চাঙ্গের উপর সেই মরণ-প্রমাদ !\\nকাঁহা ‘নেতধটী’ পুনঃ, — এসব প্রসাদ ! ॥ ১৩৪ ॥
verses.transliteration: kāhāṅ cāṅgera upara sei maraṇa-pramāda!\\nkāhāṅ 'neta-dhaṭī' punaḥ,—e-saba prasāda!
verses.translation: "I was lifted upon the cāṅga to be killed, but on the contrary I was honored with this silken cloth. This is all Your mercy.

verses.devanagari: চাঙ্গের উপরে তোমার চরণ ধ্যান কৈলুঁ ।\\nচরণ-স্মরণ-প্রভাবে এই ফল পাইলুঁ ॥১৩৫॥
verses.transliteration: cāṅgera upare tomāra caraṇa dhyāna kailuṅ\\ncaraṇa-smaraṇa-prabhāve ei phala pāiluṅ
verses.translation: "On the cāṅga I began meditating upon Your lotus feet, and the power of that remembrance has yielded all these results.

verses.devanagari: লোকে চমৎকার মোর এ সব দেখিয়া ।\\nপ্রশংসে তোমার কৃপা-মহিমা গাঞা ॥১৩৬॥
verses.transliteration: loke camatkāra mora e saba dekhiyā\\npraśaṁse tomāra kṛpā-mahimā gāñā
verses.translation: "Struck with wonder by my affairs, the populace is glorifying the greatness of Your mercy.

verses.devanagari: কিন্তু তোমার স্মরণের নহে এই ‘মুখ্যফল’ ।\\n‘ফলাভাস’ এই, — যাতে ‘বিষয়’ চঞ্চল ॥১৩৭॥
verses.transliteration: kintu tomāra smaraṇera nahe ei 'mukhya-phala'\\n'phalābhāsa' ei,—yāte 'viṣaya' cañcala
verses.translation: "However, my Lord, these are not the principal results of meditating upon Your lotus feet. Material opulence is very flickering. Therefore it is simply a glimpse of the result of Your mercy.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
One can achieve the highest perfection of life simply by meditating upon the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Generally people are concerned with the four religious principles, namely religion, material opulence, sense gratification and liberation. However, as indicated in
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam (dharmaḥ projjhita-kaitavo 'tra),
success in these four kinds of material and spiritual gain are not the true results of devotional service. The true result of devotional service is the actual development of one's dormant love for Kṛṣṇa in every circumstance. By the mercy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka could understand that the material benefits he had achieved were not the ultimate result of meditating upon His lotus feet. The true result comes when one is detached from material opulences. Therefore Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka prayed to the Lord for such detachment.

verses.devanagari: রাম-রায়ে, বাণীনাথে কৈলা ‘নির্বিষয়’ ।\\nসেই কৃপা মোতে নাহি, যাতে ঐছে হয় ! ॥ ১৩৮ ॥
verses.transliteration: rāma-rāye, vāṇīnāthe kailā 'nirviṣaya'\\nsei kṛpā mote nāhi, yāte aiche haya!
verses.translation: "Your real mercy has been granted to Rāmānanda Rāya and Vāṇīnātha Rāya, for You have detached them from all material opulence. I think that I have not been favored by such mercy.

verses.devanagari: শুদ্ধ কৃপা কর, গোসাঞি, ঘুচাহ ‘বিষয়’ ।\\nনির্বিণ্ণ হইনু, মোতে ‘বিষয়’ না হয় ।।” ॥ ১৩৯ ॥
verses.transliteration: śuddha kṛpā kara, gosāñi, ghucāha 'viṣaya'\\nnirviṇṇa ha-inu, mote 'viṣaya' nā haya"
verses.translation: "Kindly bestow upon me Your pure mercy so that I may also become renounced. I am no longer interested in material enjoyment."

verses.devanagari: প্রভু কহে, — সন্ন্যাসী যবে হইবা পঞ্চজন ।\\nকুটুম্ব-বাহুল্য তোমার কে করে ভরণ ? ॥ ১৪০ ॥
verses.transliteration: prabhu kahe,—sannyāsī yabe ha-ibā pañca-jana\\nkuṭumba-bāhulya tomāra ke kare bharaṇa?
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "If you all adopt the renounced order and lose interest in dealing with pounds, shillings and pence, who will take charge of maintaining your large family?

verses.devanagari: মহাবিষয় কর, কিবা বিরক্ত উদাস ।\\nজন্মে-জন্মে তুমি পঞ্চ — মোর ‘নিজদাস’ ॥১৪১॥
verses.transliteration: mahā-viṣaya kara, kibā virakta udāsa\\njanme-janme tumi pañca—mora 'nija-dāsa'
verses.translation: "Whether you are involved in material activities or become completely renounced, you five brothers are all My eternal servants, birth after birth.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura comments that one should remember that he is eternally a servant of Kṛṣṇa. Whether one is engaged in material activity involving pounds, shillings and pence or is in the renounced order, he should always think that he is an eternal servant of God, for that is the real position of the living being. Taking
sannyāsa
and dealing in pounds, shillings and pence are both external affairs. One should always consider how to please and satisfy Kṛṣṇa. Thus even if one is involved in great material affairs, he will not become attached. As soon as one forgets that he is an eternal servant of Kṛṣṇa, he becomes involved in material attachments. However, if one is always conscious that Kṛṣṇa is always the supreme master and that he is an eternal servant of Kṛṣṇa, he is a liberated person in any condition. Entangling material activities will not affect him.

verses.devanagari: কিন্তু মোর করিহ এক ‘আজ্ঞা’ পালন ।\\n‘ব্যয় না করিহ কিছু রাজার মূলধন’ ॥১৪২॥
verses.transliteration: kintu mora kariha eka 'ājñā' pālana\\n'vyaya nā kariha kichu rājāra mūla-dhana'
verses.translation: "However, just obey one order from Me. Do not spend any of the King's revenue.
verses.purport: PURPORT\nWhen a person forgets his position as an eternal servant of Kṛṣṇa, he commits many sinful activities, but one who maintains his position as an eternal servant of Kṛṣṇa cannot deviate from the path of morality, religion and ethics. At the present, people all over the world, especially in India, have forgotten their relationship with the Supreme Personality of Godhead and His eternal servants. Therefore the principles of morality, religion and ethics have almost disappeared. This situation is most unprofitable for human society. Therefore everyone should try to accept Kṛṣṇa consciousness and follow the principles of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: রাজার মূলধন দিয়া যে কিছু লভ্য হয় ।\\nসেই ধন করিহ নানা ধর্মে-কর্মে ব্যয় ॥১৪৩॥
verses.transliteration: rājāra mūla-dhana diyā ye kichu labhya haya\\nsei dhana kariha nānā dharme-karme vyaya
verses.translation: "First you should pay the revenue due the King, and then you may spend the balance for religious and fruitive activities.

verses.devanagari: অসদ্ব্যয় না করিহ, — যাতে দুইলোক যায় ।”\\nএত বলি’ সবাকারে দিলেন বিদায় ॥১৪৪॥
verses.transliteration: asad-vyaya nā kariha,—yāte dui-loka yāya"\\neta bali' sabākāre dilena vidāya
verses.translation: "Don't spend a farthing for sinful activities for which you will be the loser both in this life and the next." After saying this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu bade them farewell.

verses.devanagari: রায়ের ঘরে প্রভুর ‘কৃপা-বিবর্ত’ কহিল ।\\nভক্তবাৎসল্য-গুণ যাতে ব্যক্ত হৈল ॥১৪৫॥
verses.transliteration: rāyera ghare prabhura 'kṛpā-vivarta' kahila\\nbhakta-vātsalya-guṇa yāte vyakta haila
verses.translation: Thus the mercy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was spoken of in the family of Bhavānanda Rāya. That mercy was clearly demonstrated, although it appeared to be something different.
verses.purport: PURPORT\nThe result of advancement in spiritual knowledge is not material improvement, but Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu advised Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka how to use material opulence without incurring reactions to sinful life. From this advice, it appeared that the Lord encouraged Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka to enhance his material condition. Actually, however, He did not. In fact, this was but a manifestation of His great affection for His devotee.

verses.devanagari: সবায় আলিঙ্গিয়া প্রভু বিদায় যবে দিলা ।\\nহরিধ্বনি করি’ সব ভক্ত উঠি’ গেলা ॥১৪৬॥
verses.transliteration: sabāya āliṅgiyā prabhu vidāya yabe dilā\\nhari-dhvani kari' saba bhakta uṭhi' gelā
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu embraced them all and bade them farewell. Then all the devotees got up and left, loudly chanting the holy name of Hari.

verses.devanagari: প্রভুর কৃপা দেখি’ সবার হৈল চমৎকার ।\\nতাহারা বুঝিতে নারে প্রভুর ব্যবহার ॥১৪৭॥
verses.transliteration: prabhura kṛpā dekhi' sabāra haila camatkāra\\ntāhārā bujhite nāre prabhura vyavahāra
verses.translation: Seeing the extraordinary mercy the Lord granted to the family of Bhavānanda Rāya, everyone was struck with wonder. They could not understand the behavior of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: তারা সবে যদি কৃপা করিতে সাধিল ।\\n‘আমা’ হৈতে কিছু নহে — প্রভু তবে কহিল ॥১৪৮॥
verses.transliteration: tārā sabe yadi kṛpā karite sādhila\\n'āmā' haite kichu nahe—prabhu tabe kahila
verses.translation: Indeed, when all the devotees had requested the Lord to bestow His mercy upon Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka, the Lord had replied that He could do nothing.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
When a person is sinful, he loses both the chance for spiritual advancement and the chance for material opulence. If one enjoys the material world for sense gratification, he is certainly doomed. Advancement in material opulence is not the direct mercy of the Supreme Personality of Godhead; nevertheless, it indicates the indirect mercy of the Lord, for even a person too attached to material prosperity can gradually be detached and raised to the spiritual platform. Then he can offer causeless, purified service to the Lord. When Śrī Caitanya said,
āmā haite kichu nahe
("It is not My business to do anything"), He set the ideal example for a person in the renounced order. If a
sannyāsī
takes the side of a
viṣayī,
a person engaged in material activities, his character will be criticized. A person in the renounced order should not take interest in material activities, but if he does so out of affection for a particular person, that should be considered his special mercy.

verses.devanagari: গোপীনাথের নিন্দা, আর আপন-নির্বেদ ।\\nএইমাত্র কহিল — ইহার না বুঝিবে ভেদ ॥১৪৯॥
verses.transliteration: gopīnāthera nindā, āra āpana-nirveda\\nei-mātra kahila—ihāra nā bujhibe bheda
verses.translation: I have simply described the chastisement of Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's indifference. But the deep meaning of this behavior is very difficult to understand.

verses.devanagari: কাশীমিশ্রে না সাধিল, রাজারে না সাধিল ।\\nউদ্যোগ বিনা মহাপ্রভু এত ফল দিল ॥১৫০॥
verses.transliteration: kāśī-miśre nā sādhila, rājāre nā sādhila\\nudyoga vinā mahāprabhu eta phala dila
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu gave so much to Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka without directly making requests of either Kāśī Miśra or the King.

verses.devanagari: চৈতন্যচরিত্র এই পরম গম্ভীর ।\\nসেই বুঝে, তাঁর পদে যাঁর মন ‘ধীর’ ॥১৫১॥
verses.transliteration: caitanya-caritra ei parama gambhīra\\nsei bujhe' tāṅra pade yāṅra mana 'dhīra'
verses.translation: The intentions of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu are so deep that one can understand them only if he has complete faith in service to the lotus feet of the Lord.

verses.devanagari: যেই ইহাঁ শুনে প্রভুর বাৎসল্য-প্রকাশ ।\\nপ্রেমভক্তি পায়, তাঁর বিপদ যায় নাশ ॥১৫২॥
verses.transliteration: yei ihāṅ śune prabhura vātsalya-prakāśa\\nprema-bhakti pāya, tāṅra vipada yāya nāśa
verses.translation: Whether or not one understands it, if one hears of this incident concerning Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka's activities and Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's causeless mercy upon him, certainly he will be promoted to the platform of ecstatic love for the Lord, and for him all dangers will be nullified.

verses.devanagari: শ্রীরূপ-রঘুনাথ-পদে যার আশ ।\\nচৈতন্যচরিতামৃত কহে কৃষ্ণদাস ॥১৫৩॥
verses.transliteration: śrī-rūpa-raghunātha pade yāra āśa\\nśrī-caitanya-caritāmṛta kahe kṛṣṇadāsa
verses.translation: Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.
verses.purport: PURPORT\nThus end the Bhaktivedanta purports to Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā,  Ninth Chapter, describing the deliverance of Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka and the manifestation of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's causeless mercy to His devotee.

sections.title: Chapter 10: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu Accepts Prasāda from the Devotees

verses.devanagari: বন্দে শ্রীকৃষ্ণচৈতন্যং ভক্তানুগ্রহকাতরম্ ।\\nযেন কেনাপি সন্তুষ্টং ভক্তদত্তেন শ্রদ্ধয়া ॥১॥
verses.transliteration: vande śrī-kṛṣṇa-caitanyaṁ\\nbhaktānugraha-kātaram\\nyena kenāpi santuṣṭaṁ\\nbhakta-dattena śraddhayā
verses.translation: Let me offer my respectful obeisances unto Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, who is always pleased to accept anything given with faith and love by His devotees and is always ready to bestow mercy upon them.

verses.devanagari: জয় জয় গৌরচন্দ্র জয় নিত্যানন্দ ।\\nজয়াদ্বৈতচন্দ্র জয় গৌরভক্তবৃন্দ ॥২॥
verses.transliteration: jaya jaya gauracandra jaya nityānanda\\njayādvaita-candra jaya gaura-bhakta-vṛnda
verses.translation: All glories to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu! All glories to Lord Nityānanda Prabhu! All glories to Advaitacandra! All glories to all the devotees of Lord Caitanya!

verses.devanagari: বর্ষান্তরে সব ভক্ত প্রভুরে দেখিতে ।\\nপরম-আনন্দে সবে নীলাচল যাইতে ॥৩॥
verses.transliteration: varṣāntare saba bhakta prabhure dekhite\\nparama-ānande sabe nīlācala yāite
verses.translation: The next year, all the devotees were very pleased to go to Jagannātha Purī [Nīlācala] to see Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: অদ্বৈত আচার্য-গোসাঞি — সর্ব-অগ্রগণ্য ।\\nআচার্যরত্ন, আচার্যনিধি, শ্রীবাস আদি ধন্য ॥৪॥
verses.transliteration: advaitācārya-gosāñi—sarva-agra-gaṇya\\nācāryaratna, ācāryanidhi, śrīvāsa ādi dhanya
verses.translation: Advaita Ācārya Gosāñi led the party from Bengal. He was followed by Ācāryaratna, Ācāryanidhi, Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura and other glorious devotees.

verses.devanagari: যদ্যপি প্রভুর আজ্ঞা গৌড়ে রহিতে ।\\nতথাপি নিত্যানন্দ প্রেমে চলিলা দেখিতে ॥৫॥
verses.transliteration: yadyapi prabhura ājñā gauḍe rahite\\ntathāpi nityānanda preme calilā dekhite
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had ordered Lord Nityānanda to stay in Bengal, but nevertheless, because of ecstatic love, Lord Nityānanda also went to see Him.

verses.devanagari: অনুরাগের লক্ষণ এই, — ‘বিধি’ নাহি মানে ।\\nতাঁর আজ্ঞা ভাঙ্গে তাঁর সঙ্গের কারণে ॥৬॥
verses.transliteration: anurāgera lakṣaṇa ei,—'vidhi' nāhi māne\\ntāṅra ājñā bhāṅge tāṅra saṅgera kāraṇe
verses.translation: Indeed, it is a symptom of real affection that one breaks the order of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, not caring for the regulative principles, to associate with Him.

verses.devanagari: রাসে যৈছে ঘর যাইতে গোপীরে আজ্ঞা দিলা ।\\nতাঁর আজ্ঞা ভাঙ্গি তাঁর সঙ্গে সে রহিলা ॥৭॥
verses.transliteration: rāse yaiche ghara yāite gopīre ājñā dilā\\ntāṅra ājñā bhāṅgi' tāṅra saṅge se rahilā
verses.translation: During the rāsa dance, Kṛṣṇa asked all the gopīs to return home, but the gopīs neglected His order and stayed there for His association.

verses.devanagari: আজ্ঞা-পালনে কৃষ্ণের যৈছে পরিতোষ ।\\nপ্রেমে আজ্ঞা ভাঙ্গিলে হয় কোটিসুখ-পোষ ॥৮॥
verses.transliteration: ājñā-pālane kṛṣṇera yaiche paritoṣa\\npreme ājñā bhāṅgile haya koṭi-sukha-poṣa
verses.translation: If one carries out Kṛṣṇa's order, Kṛṣṇa is certainly pleased, but if one sometimes breaks His order due to ecstatic love, that gives Him millions of times greater happiness.

verses.devanagari: বাসুদেব-দত্ত, মুরারি-গুপ্ত, গঙ্গাদাস ।\\nশ্রীমান্-সেন, শ্রীমান্-পণ্ডিত, অকিঞ্চন কৃষ্ণদাস ॥৯॥\\nমুরারি, গরুড়-পণ্ডিত, বুদ্ধিমন্ত-খাঁন ।\\nসঞ্জয়-পুরুষোত্তম, পণ্ডিত-ভগবান্ ॥১০॥\\nশুক্লাম্বর, নৃসিংহানন্দ আর যত জন ।\\nসবাই চলিলা, নাম না যায় লিখন ॥১১॥
verses.transliteration: śuklāmbara, nṛsiṁhānanda āra yata jana\\nsabāi calilā, nāma nā yāya likhana
verses.translation: Vāsudeva Datta, Murāri Gupta, Gaṅgādāsa, Śrīmān Sena, Śrīmān Paṇḍita, Akiñcana Kṛṣṇadāsa, Murāri Gupta, Garuḍa Paṇḍita, Buddhimanta Khān, Sañjaya Puruṣottama, Bhagavān Paṇḍita, Śuklāmbara Brahmacārī, Nṛsiṁhānanda Brahmacārī and many others joined together to go to Jagannātha Purī. It would be impossible to mention the names of them all.

verses.devanagari: কুলীনগ্রামী, খণ্ডবাসী মিলিলা আসিয়া ।\\nশিবানন্দ-সেন চলিলা সবারে লঞা ॥১২॥
verses.transliteration: kulīna-grāmī, khaṇḍa-vāsī mililā āsiyā\\nśivānanda-sena calilā sabāre lañā
verses.translation: The inhabitants of Kulīna-grāma and Khaṇḍa also came and joined. Śivānanda Sena took the leadership and thus started taking care of them all.

verses.devanagari: রাঘব-পণ্ডিত চলে ঝালি সাজাইয়া ।\\nদময়ন্তী যত দ্রব্য দিয়াছে করিয়া ॥১৩॥
verses.transliteration: rāghava-paṇḍita cale jhāli sājāiyā\\ndamayantī yata dravya diyāche kariyā
verses.translation: Rāghava Paṇḍita came with bags full of food prepared very nicely by his sister, Damayantī.

verses.devanagari: নানা অপূর্ব ভক্ষ্যদ্রব্য প্রভুর যোগ্য ভোগ ।\\nবৎসরেক প্রভু যাহা করেন উপযোগ ॥১৪॥
verses.transliteration: nānā apūrva bhakṣya-dravya prabhura yogya bhoga\\nvatsareka prabhu yāhā karena upayoga
verses.translation: Damayantī made varieties of unparalleled food just suitable for Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to eat. The Lord ate it continually for one year.

verses.devanagari: আম্র-কাশন্দি, আদা-কাশন্দি ঝাল-কাশন্দি নাম ।\\nনেম্বু-আদা আম্রকোলি বিবিধ বিধান ॥১৫॥\\nআমিস্, আমখণ্ড, তৈলাম্র, আমসত্তা ।\\nযত্ন করি’ গুণ্ডা করি’ পুরাণ সুকুতা ॥১৬॥
verses.transliteration: āmsi, āma-khaṇḍa, tailāmra, āma-sattā\\nyatna kari' guṇḍā kari' purāṇa sukutā
verses.translation: These are the names of some of the pickles and condiments in the bags of Rāghava Paṇḍita: āmra-kāśandi, ādā-kāśandi, jhāla-kāśandi, nembu-ādā, āmra-koli, āmsi, āma-khaṇḍa, tailāmra and āma-sattā. With great attention, Damayantī also made dried bitter vegetables into a powder.

verses.devanagari: ‘সুকুতা’ বলি’ অবজ্ঞা না করিহ চিত্তে ।\\nসুকুতায় যে সুখ প্রভুর, তাহা নহে পঞ্চামৃতে ॥১৭॥
verses.transliteration: 'sukutā' bali' avajñā nā kariha citte\\nsukutāya ye sukha prabhura, tāhā nahe pañcāmṛte
verses.translation: Do not neglect sukutā because it is a bitter preparation. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu derived more happiness from eating this sukutā than from drinking pañcāmṛta [a preparation of milk, sugar, ghee, honey and curd].

verses.devanagari: ভাবগ্রাহী মহাপ্রভু স্নেহমাত্র লয় ।\\nসুকুতা পাতা কাশন্দিতে মহাসুখ পায় ॥১৮॥
verses.transliteration: bhāva-grāhī mahāprabhu sneha-mātra laya\\nsukutā pātā kāśandite mahā-sukha pāya
verses.translation: Since Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is the Supreme Personality of Godhead, He extracts the purpose from everything. He accepted Damayantī's affection for Him, and therefore He derived great pleasure even from the dried bitter leaves of sukutā and from kāśandi [a sour condiment].

verses.devanagari: ‘মনুষ্য’-বুদ্ধি দময়ন্তী করে প্রভুর পায় ।\\nগুরু-ভোজনে উদরে কভু ‘আম’ হঞা যায় ॥১৯॥
verses.transliteration: 'manuṣya'-buddhi damayantī kare prabhura pāya\\nguru-bhojane udare kabhu 'āma' hañā yāya
verses.translation: Because of her natural love for Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Damayantī considered the Lord an ordinary human being. Therefore she thought that He would become sick by overeating and there would be mucus within His abdomen.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Because of pure love, the devotees of Kṛṣṇa in Goloka Vṛndāvana, Vrajabhūmi, loved Kṛṣṇa as an ordinary human being like them. Yet although they considered Kṛṣṇa one of them, their love for Kṛṣṇa knew no bounds. Similarly, because of extreme love, devotees like Rāghava Paṇḍita and his sister, Damayantī, thought of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu as a human being, but their love for Him was boundless. By overeating, an ordinary human being becomes prone to a disease called
amla-pitta,
which is a product of indigestion characterized by acidity of the stomach. Damayantī thought that such a condition would afflict Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: সুকুতা খাইলে সেই আম হইবেক নাশ ।\\nএই স্নেহ মনে ভাবি’ প্রভুর উল্লাস ॥২০॥
verses.transliteration: sukutā khāile sei āma ha-ibeka nāśa\\nei sneha mane bhāvi' prabhura ullāsa
verses.translation: Because of sincere affection, she thought that eating this sukutā would cure the Lord's disease. Considering these affectionate thoughts of Damayantī, the Lord was very pleased.

verses.devanagari: প্রিয়েণ সংগ্রথ্য বিপক্ষ-সন্নিধা-\\nবুপাহিতাং বক্ষসি পীবরস্তনী ।\\nস্রজং ন কাচিদ্বিজহৌ জলাবিলাং\\nবসন্তি হি প্রেম্ণি গুণা ন বস্তুনি ॥২১॥
verses.transliteration: priyeṇa saṅgrathya vipakṣa-sannidhāv\\nupāhitāṁ vakṣasi pīvara-stanī\\nsrajaṁ na kācid vijahau jalāvilāṁ\\nvasanti hi premṇi guṇā na vastuni
verses.translation: "A dear lover strung a garland and placed it on the shoulder of his beloved in the presence of her co-wives. She had raised breasts and was very beautiful, yet although the garland was tainted with mud, she did not reject it, for its value lay not in material things but in love."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This is a verse from the
Kirātārjunīya
by Bhāravī.

verses.devanagari: ধনিয়া-মৌহরীর তণ্ডুল গুণ্ডা করিয়া ।\\nনাড়ু বান্ধিয়াছে চিনি-পাক করিয়া ॥২২॥
verses.transliteration: dhaniyā-mauharīra taṇḍula guṇḍā kariyā\\nnāḍu bāndhiyāche cini-pāka kariyā
verses.translation: Damayantī powdered coriander and anise seeds, cooked them with sugar and made them into small sweetmeats that were shaped like small balls.

verses.devanagari: শুণ্ঠিখণ্ড নাড়ু, আর আমপিত্তহর ।\\nপৃথক্ পৃথক্ বান্ধি’ বস্ত্রের কুথলী ভিতর ॥২৩॥
verses.transliteration: śuṇṭhi-khaṇḍa nāḍu, āra āma-pitta-hara\\npṛthak pṛthak bāndhi' vastrera kuthalī bhitara
verses.translation: She made balls of sweetmeats with dried ginger to remove mucus caused by too much bile. She put all these preparations separately into small cloth bags.

verses.devanagari: কোলিশুণ্ঠি, কোলিচূর্ণ, কোলিখণ্ড আর ।\\nকত নাম লইব, শতপ্রকার ‘আচার’ ॥২৪॥
verses.transliteration: koli-śuṇṭhi, koli-cūrṇa, koli-khaṇḍa āra\\nkata nāma la-iba, śata-prakāra 'ācāra'
verses.translation: She made a hundred varieties of condiments and pickles. She also made koli-śuṇṭhi, koli-cūrṇa, koli-khaṇḍa and many other preparations. How many should I name?

verses.devanagari: নারিকেল-খণ্ড নাড়ু, আর নাড়ু গঙ্গাজল ।\\nচিরস্থায়ী খণ্ডবিকার করিলা সকল ॥২৫॥
verses.transliteration: nārikela-khaṇḍa nāḍu, āra nāḍu gaṅgā-jala\\ncira-sthāyī khaṇḍa-vikāra karilā sakala
verses.translation: She made many sweetmeats shaped like balls. Some were made with powdered coconut, and others looked as white as the water of the Ganges. In this way she made many varieties of long-lasting sugar confections.

verses.devanagari: চিরস্থায়ী ক্ষীরসার, মণ্ডাদি-বিকার ।\\nঅমৃত-কর্পূর আদি অনেক প্রকার ॥২৬॥
verses.transliteration: cira-sthāyī kṣīra-sāra, maṇḍādi-vikāra\\namṛta-karpūra ādi aneka prakāra
verses.translation: She made long-lasting cheese, many varieties of sweetmeats with milk and cream, and many other varied preparations, such as amṛta-karpūra.

verses.devanagari: শালিকাচুটি-ধান্যের ‘আতপ’ চিড়া করি’ ।\\nনূতন-বস্ত্রের বড় কুথলী সব ভরি’ ॥২৭॥
verses.transliteration: śālikācuṭi-dhānyera 'ātapa' ciḍā kari'\\nnūtana-vastrera baḍa kuthalī saba bhari'
verses.translation: She made flat rice from fine, unboiled, śāli paddy and filled a large bag made of new cloth.

verses.devanagari: কতেক চিড়া হুড়ুম্ করি’ ঘৃতেতে ভাজিয়া ।\\nচিনি-পাকে নাড়ু কৈলা কর্পূরাদি দিয়া ॥২৮॥
verses.transliteration: kateka ciḍā huḍum kari' ghṛtete bhājiyā\\ncini-pāke nāḍu kailā karpūrādi diyā
verses.translation: She made some of the flat rice into puffed rice, fried it in ghee, cooked it in sugar juice, mixed in some camphor and rolled it into balls.

verses.devanagari: শালি-ধান্যের তণ্ডুল-ভাজা চূর্ণ করিয়া ।\\nঘৃতসিক্ত চূর্ণ কৈলা চিনি-পাক দিয়া ॥২৯॥\\nকর্পূর, মরিচ, লবঙ্গ, এলাচি, রসবাস ।\\nচূর্ণ দিয়া নাড়ু কৈলা পরম সুবাস ॥৩০॥
verses.transliteration: karpūra, marica, lavaṅga, elāci, rasavāsa\\ncūrṇa diyā nāḍu kailā parama suvāsa
verses.translation: She powdered fried grains of fine rice, moistened the powder with ghee and cooked it in a solution of sugar. Then she added camphor, black pepper, cloves, cardamom and other spices and rolled it into balls that were very palatable and aromatic.

verses.devanagari: শালি-ধান্যের খই পুনঃ ঘৃতেতে ভাজিয়া ।\\nচিনি-পাক উখ্ড়া কৈলা কর্পূরাদি দিয়া ॥৩১॥
verses.transliteration: śāli-dhānyera kha-i punaḥ ghṛtete bhājiyā\\ncini-pāka ukhḍā kailā karpūrādi diyā
verses.translation: She took parched rice from fine paddy, fried it in ghee, cooked it in a sugar solution, mixed in some camphor and thus made a preparation called ukhḍā or muḍki.

verses.devanagari: ফুট্কলাই চূর্ণ করি’ ঘৃতে ভাজাইল ।\\nচিনি-পাকে কর্পূরাদি দিয়া নাড়ু কৈল ॥৩২॥
verses.transliteration: phuṭkalāi cūrṇa kari' ghṛte bhājāila\\ncini-pāke karpūrādi diyā nāḍu kaila
verses.translation: Another variety of sweet was made with fused peas that were powdered, fried in ghee and then cooked in sugar juice. Camphor was mixed in, and then the sweet was rolled into a ball.

verses.devanagari: কহিতে না জানি নাম এ-জন্মে যাহার ।\\nঐছে নানা ভক্ষ্যদ্রব্য সহস্রপ্রকার ॥৩৩॥
verses.transliteration: kahite nā jāni nāma e-janme yāhāra\\naiche nānā bhakṣya-dravya sahasra-prakāra
verses.translation: I could not mention the names of all these wonderful eatables, even in a lifetime. Damayantī made hundreds and thousands of varieties.

verses.devanagari: রাঘবের আজ্ঞা, আর করেন দময়ন্তী ।\\nদুঁহার প্রভুতে স্নেহ পরম-ভকতি ॥৩৪॥
verses.transliteration: rāghavera ājñā, āra karena damayantī\\nduṅhāra prabhute sneha parama-bhakati
verses.translation: Damayantī made all these preparations following the order of her brother, Rāghava Paṇḍita. Both of them had unlimited affection for Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and were advanced in devotional service.

verses.devanagari: গঙ্গা-মৃত্তিকা আনি’ বস্ত্রেতে ছানিয়া ।\\nপাঁপড়ি করিয়া দিলা গন্ধদ্রব্য দিয়া ॥৩৫॥
verses.transliteration: gaṅgā-mṛttikā āni' vastrete chāniyā\\npāṅpaḍi kariyā dilā gandha-dravya diyā
verses.translation: Damayantī took earth from the Ganges, dried it, powdered it, strained it through a fine cloth, mixed in aromatic ingredients and rolled it into small balls.

verses.devanagari: পাতল মৃৎপাত্রে সন্ধানাদি ভরি’ ।\\nআর সব বস্তু ভরে বস্ত্রের কুথলী ॥৩৬॥
verses.transliteration: pātala mṛt-pātre sandhānādi bhari'\\nāra saba vastu bhare vastrera kuthalī
verses.translation: The condiments and similar items were put into thin earthen pots, and everything else was put into small cloth bags.

verses.devanagari: সামান্য ঝালি হৈতে দ্বিগুণ ঝালি কৈলা  ।\\nপারিপাটি করি’ সব ঝালি ভরাইলা ॥৩৭॥
verses.transliteration: sāmānya jhāli haite dviguṇa jhāli kailā\\npāripāṭi kari' saba jhāli bharāilā
verses.translation: From small bags Damayantī made bags that were twice as large. Then with great attention she filled all the large ones with the small ones.

verses.devanagari: ঝালি বান্ধি’ মোহর দিল আগ্রহ করিয়া  ।\\nতিন বোঝারি ঝালি বহে ক্রম করিয়া ॥৩৮॥
verses.transliteration: jhāli bāndhi' mohara dila āgraha kariyā\\ntina bojhāri jhāli vahe krama kariyā
verses.translation: She then wrapped and sealed each and every bag with great attention. The bags were carried by three bearers, one after another.

verses.devanagari: সংক্ষেপে কহিলুঁ এই ঝালির বিচার ।\\n‘রাঘবের ঝালি’ বলি’ বিখ্যাতি যাহার ॥৩৯॥
verses.transliteration: saṅkṣepe kahiluṅ ei jhālira vicāra\\n'rāghavera jhāli' bali' vikhyāti yāhāra
verses.translation: Thus I have briefly described the bags that have become famous as rāghavera jhāli.

verses.devanagari: ঝালির উপর ‘মুন্সিব’ মকরধ্বজ-কর ।\\nপ্রাণরূপে ঝালি রাখে হঞা তৎপর ॥৪০॥
verses.transliteration: jhālira upara 'munsiba' makaradhvaja-kara\\nprāṇa-rūpe jhāli rākhe hañā tatpara
verses.translation: The superintendent for all those bags was Makaradhvaja Kara, who kept them with great attention like his very life.

verses.devanagari: এইমতে বৈষ্ণব সব নীলাচলে আইলা ।\\nদৈবে জগন্নাথের সে দিন জল-লীলা ॥৪১॥
verses.transliteration: ei-mate vaiṣṇava saba nīlācale āilā\\ndaive jagannāthera se dina jala-līlā
verses.translation: Thus all the Vaiṣṇavas from Bengal went to Jagannātha Purī. By chance, they arrived on the day when Lord Jagannātha performs pastimes in the water.

verses.devanagari: নরেন্দ্রের জলে ‘গোবিন্দ’ নৌকাতে চড়িয়া ।\\nজলক্রীড়া করে সব ভক্তগণ লঞা ॥৪২॥
verses.transliteration: narendrera jale 'govinda' naukāte caḍiyā\\njala-krīḍā kare saba bhakta-gaṇa lañā
verses.translation: Boarding a boat in the waters of Narendra-sarovara, Lord Govinda performed His water pastimes with all the devotees.

verses.devanagari: সেইকালে মহাপ্রভু ভক্তগণ-সঙ্গে ।\\nনরেন্দ্রে আইলা দেখিতে জলকেলি-রঙ্গে ॥৪৩॥
verses.transliteration: sei-kāle mahāprabhu bhakta-gaṇa-saṅge\\nnarendre āilā dekhite jala-keli-raṅge
verses.translation: Then Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu arrived with His personal associates to see the jubilant pastimes of Lord Jagannātha in the Narendra-sarovara.

verses.devanagari: সেইকালে আইলা সব গৌড়ের ভক্তগণ ।\\nনরেন্দ্রেতে প্রভু-সঙ্গে হইল মিলন ॥৪৪॥
verses.transliteration: sei-kāle āilā saba gauḍera bhakta-gaṇa\\nnarendrete prabhu-saṅge ha-ila milana
verses.translation: At the same time, all the devotees from Bengal arrived at the lake and had a great meeting with the Lord.

verses.devanagari: ভক্তগণ পড়ে আসি’ প্রভুর চরণে ।\\nউঠাঞা প্রভু সবারে কৈলা আলিঙ্গনে ॥৪৫॥
verses.transliteration: bhakta-gaṇa paḍe āsi' prabhura caraṇe\\nuṭhāñā prabhu sabāre kailā āliṅgane
verses.translation: All the devotees immediately fell at the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, and the Lord lifted and embraced every one of them.

verses.devanagari: গৌড়ীয়া-সম্প্রদায় সব করেন কীর্তন ।\\nপ্রভুর মিলনে উঠে প্রেমের ক্রন্দন ॥৪৬॥
verses.transliteration: gauḍīyā-sampradāya saba karena kīrtana\\nprabhura milane uṭhe premera krandana
verses.translation: The Gauḍīya-sampradāya, consisting of all the devotees from Bengal, began congregational chanting. When they met the Lord, they began to cry loudly in ecstatic love.

verses.devanagari: জলক্রীড়া, বাদ্য, গীত, নর্তন, কীর্তন ।\\nমহাকোলাহল তীরে, সলিলে খেলন ॥৪৭॥
verses.transliteration: jala-krīḍā, vādya, gīta, nartana, kīrtana\\nmahā-kolāhala tīre, salile khelana
verses.translation: Because of the pastimes in the water, there was great jubilation on the shore, with music, singing, chanting, dancing and tumultuous crying.

verses.devanagari: গৌড়ীয়া-সঙ্কীর্তনে আর রোদন মিলিয়া ।\\nমহাকোলাহল হৈল ব্রহ্মাণ্ড ভরিয়া ॥৪৮॥
verses.transliteration: gauḍīyā-saṅkīrtane āra rodana miliyā\\nmahā-kolāhala haila brahmāṇḍa bhariyā
verses.translation: The chanting and crying of the Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇavas mixed and created a tumultuous sound vibration that filled the entire universe.

verses.devanagari: সব ভক্ত লঞা প্রভু নামিলেন জলে ।\\nসবা লঞা জলক্রীড়া করেন কুতূহলে ॥৪৯॥
verses.transliteration: saba bhakta lañā prabhu nāmilena jale\\nsabā lañā jala-krīḍā karena kutūhale
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu entered the water with His devotees and began His pastimes with them in great jubilation.

verses.devanagari: প্রভুর এই জলক্রীড়া দাস-বৃন্দাবন ।\\n‘চৈতন্যমঙ্গলে’ বিস্তারি’ করিয়াছেন বর্ণন ॥৫০॥
verses.transliteration: prabhura ei jala-krīḍā dāsa-vṛndāvana\\n'caitanya-maṅgale' vistāri' kariyāchena varṇana
verses.translation: In his Caitanya-maṅgala [now known as Caitanya-bhāgavata], Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura has given a detailed description of the activities the Lord performed in the water.

verses.devanagari: পুনঃ ইহাঁ বর্ণিলে পুনরুক্তি হয় ।\\nব্যর্থ লিখন হয়, আর গ্রন্থ বাড়য় ॥৫১॥
verses.transliteration: punaḥ ihāṅ varṇile punarukti haya\\nvyartha likhana haya, āra grantha bāḍaya
verses.translation: There is no use describing here the activities of the Lord again. It would simply be repetitious and would increase the size of this book.

verses.devanagari: জললীলা করি’ গোবিন্দ চলিলা আলয় ।\\nনিজগণ লঞা প্রভু গেলা দেবালয় ॥৫২॥
verses.transliteration: jala-līlā kari' govinda calilā ālaya\\nnija-gaṇa lañā prabhu gelā devālaya
verses.translation: After concluding His pastimes in the water, Lord Govinda returned to His residence. Then Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went to the temple, taking all His devotees with Him.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
The Deity referred to herein as Govinda is the
vijaya-vigraha
in the temple of Jagannātha. When there is a need to take Jagannātha somewhere, the
vijaya-vigraha
is taken because the body of Jagannātha is very heavy. The
vijaya-vigraha
in the Jagannātha temple is known as Govinda. For the pastimes in the Narendrasarovara, the
vijaya-vigraha
was carried there instead of Lord Jagannātha.

verses.devanagari: জগন্নাথ দেখি’ পুনঃ নিজ-ঘরে আইলা ।\\nপ্রসাদ আনাঞা ভক্তগণে খাওয়াইলা ॥৫৩॥
verses.transliteration: jagannātha dekhi' punaḥ nija-ghare āilā\\nprasāda ānāñā bhakta-gaṇe khāoyāilā
verses.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu returned to His residence after visiting the temple of Jagannātha, He asked for a large quantity of Lord Jagannātha's prasāda, which He then distributed among His devotees so that they could eat sumptuously.

verses.devanagari: ইষ্টগোষ্ঠী সবা লঞা কতক্ষণ কৈলা ।\\nনিজ নিজ পূর্ব-বাসায় সবায় পাঠাইলা ॥৫৪॥
verses.transliteration: iṣṭa-goṣṭhī sabā lañā kata-kṣaṇa kailā\\nnija nija pūrva-vāsāya sabāya pāṭhāilā
verses.translation: After talking with all the devotees for some time, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu asked them to occupy the individual residences in which they had lived the previous year.

verses.devanagari: গোবিন্দ-ঠাঞি রাঘব ঝালি সমর্পিলা ।\\nভোজন-গৃহের কোণে ঝালি গোবিন্দ রাখিলা ॥৫৫॥
verses.transliteration: govinda-ṭhāñi rāghava jhāli samarpilā\\nbhojana-gṛhera koṇe jhāli govinda rākhilā
verses.translation: Rāghava Paṇḍita delivered the bags of eatables to Govinda, who kept them in a corner of the dining room.

verses.devanagari: পূর্ব-বৎসরের ঝালি আজাড় করিয়া ।\\nদ্রব্য ভরিবারে রাখে অন্য গৃহে লঞা ॥৫৬॥
verses.transliteration: pūrva-vatsarera jhāli ājāḍa kariyā\\ndravya bharibāre rākhe anya gṛhe lañā
verses.translation: Govinda thoroughly emptied the bags from the previous year and kept them in another room to fill them with other goods.

verses.devanagari: আর দিন মহাপ্রভু নিজগণ লঞা ।\\nজগন্নাথ দেখিলেন শয্যোত্থানে যাঞা ॥৫৭॥
verses.transliteration: āra dina mahāprabhu nija-gaṇa lañā\\njagannātha dekhilena śayyotthāne yāñā
verses.translation: The next day, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went with His personal devotees to see Lord Jagannātha when Lord Jagannātha arose early in the morning.

verses.devanagari: বেড়া-সঙ্কীর্তন তাহাঁ আরম্ভ করিলা ।\\nসাত-সম্প্রদায় তবে গাইতে লাগিলা ॥৫৮॥
verses.transliteration: beḍā-saṅkīrtana tāhāṅ ārambha karilā\\nsāta-sampradāya tabe gāite lāgilā
verses.translation: After seeing Lord Jagannātha, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu began His all-encompassing saṅkīrtana. He formed seven groups, which then began to chant.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
For an explanation of the
beḍā-saṅkīrtana,
one may refer to
Madhya-līlā,
Chapter Eleven, verses 215-238.

verses.devanagari: সাত-সম্প্রদায়ে নৃত্য করে সাত জন  ।\\nঅদ্বৈত আচার্য, আর প্রভু-নিত্যানন্দ ॥৫৯॥
verses.transliteration: sāta-sampradāye nṛtya kare sāta jana\\nadvaita ācārya, āra prabhu-nityānanda
verses.translation: In each of the seven groups was a principal dancer like Advaita Ācārya and Lord Nityānanda.

verses.devanagari: বক্রেশ্বর, অচ্যুতানন্দ, পণ্ডিত-শ্রীবাস  ।\\nসত্যরাজ-খাঁন, আর নরহরিদাস ॥৬০॥
verses.transliteration: vakreśvara, acyutānanda, paṇḍita-śrīvāsa\\nsatyarāja-khāṅna, āra narahari-dāsa
verses.translation: The dancers in the other groups were Vakreśvara Paṇḍita, Acyutānanda, Paṇḍita Śrīvāsa, Satyarāja Khān and Narahari dāsa.

verses.devanagari: সাত-সম্প্রদায়ে প্রভু করেন ভ্রমণ ।\\n‘মোর সম্প্রদায়ে প্রভু’ — ঐছে সবার মন ॥৬১॥
verses.transliteration: sāta-sampradāye prabhu karena bhramaṇa\\n'mora sampradāye prabhu'—aiche sabāra mana
verses.translation: As Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu walked from one group to another inspecting them, the men in each group thought, "The Lord is within our group."

verses.devanagari: সঙ্কীর্তন-কোলাহলে আকাশ ভেদিল ।\\nসব জগন্নাথবাসী দেখিতে আইল ॥৬২॥
verses.transliteration: saṅkīrtana-kolāhale ākāśa bhedila\\nsaba jagannātha-vāsī dekhite āila
verses.translation: The congregational chanting made a tumultuous roar that filled the sky. All the inhabitants of Jagannātha Purī came to see the kīrtana.

verses.devanagari: রাজা আসি’ দূরে দেখে নিজগণ লঞা ।\\nরাজপত্নী সব দেখে অট্টালী চড়িয়া ॥৬৩॥
verses.transliteration: rājā āsi' dūre dekhe nija-gaṇa lañā\\nrāja-patnī saba dekhe aṭṭālī caḍiyā
verses.translation: Accompanied by his personal staff, the King also came there and watched from a distance, and all the queens watched from the elevated parts of the palace.

verses.devanagari: কীর্তন-আটোপে পৃথিবী করে টলমল ।\\n‘হরিধ্বনি’ করে লোক, হৈল কোলাহল ॥৬৪॥
verses.transliteration: kīrtana-āṭope pṛthivī kare ṭalamala\\n'hari-dhvani' kare loka, haila kolāhala
verses.translation: Due to the forceful vibration of kīrtana, the entire world began trembling. When everyone chanted the holy name, they made a tumultuous sound.

verses.devanagari: এইমত কতক্ষণ করাইলা কীর্তন ।\\nআপনে নাচিতে তবে প্রভুর হৈল মন ॥৬৫॥
verses.transliteration: ei-mata kata-kṣaṇa karāilā kīrtana\\nāpane nācite tabe prabhura haila mana
verses.translation: In this way the Lord had congregational chanting performed for some time, and then He Himself desired to dance.

verses.devanagari: সাত-দিকে সাত-সম্প্রদায় গায়, বাজায় ।\\nমধ্যে মহাপ্রেমাবেশে নাচে গৌর-রায় ॥৬৬॥
verses.transliteration: sāta-dike sāta-sampradāya gāya, bājāya\\nmadhye mahā-premāveśe nāce gaura-rāya
verses.translation: The seven groups began chanting and beating their drums in seven directions, and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu began dancing in the center in great ecstatic love.

verses.devanagari: উড়িয়া-পদ মহাপ্রভুর মনে স্মৃতি হৈল ।\\nস্বরূপেরে সেই পদ গাইতে আজ্ঞা দিল ॥৬৭॥
verses.transliteration: uḍiyā-pada mahāprabhura mane smṛti haila\\nsvarūpere sei pada gāite ājñā dila
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu remembered a line in the Orissan language and ordered Svarūpa Dāmodara to sing it.

verses.transliteration: "jagamohana-pari-muṇḍā yāu"
verses.translation: "Let my head fall at the feet of Jagannātha in the kīrtana hall known as Jagamohana."

verses.devanagari: এই পদে নৃত্য করেন পরম-আবেশে ।\\nসবলোক চৌদিকে প্রভুর প্রেম-জলে ভাসে ॥৬৯॥
verses.transliteration: ei pade nṛtya karena parama-āveśe\\nsaba-loka caudike prabhura prema-jale bhāse
verses.translation: Simply because of this line, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was dancing in greatly ecstatic love. People all around Him floated in the water of His tears.

verses.devanagari: ‘বোল্’ ‘বোল্’ বলেন প্রভু শ্রীবাহু তুলিয়া ।\\nহরিধ্বনি করে লোক আনন্দে ভাসিয়া ॥৭০॥
verses.transliteration: 'bol 'bol' balena prabhu śrī-bāhu tuliyā\\nhari-dhvani kare loka ānande bhāsiyā
verses.translation: Raising His two arms, the Lord said, "Chant! Chant!" Floating in transcendental bliss, the people responded by chanting the holy name of Hari.

verses.devanagari: প্রভু পড়ি’ মূর্ছা যায়, শ্বাস নাহি আর ।\\nআচম্বিতে উঠে প্রভু করিয়া হুঙ্কার ॥৭১॥
verses.transliteration: prabhu paḍi' mūrchā yāya, śvāsa nāhi āra\\nācambite uṭhe prabhu kariyā huṅkāra
verses.translation: The Lord fell to the ground unconscious, not even breathing. Then suddenly He stood up, making a loud sound.

verses.devanagari: সঘন পুলক, — যেন শিমুলের তরু ।\\nকভু প্রফুল্লিত অঙ্গ, কভু হয় সরু ॥৭২॥
verses.transliteration: saghana pulaka,—yena śimulera taru\\nkabhu praphullita aṅga, kabhu haya saru
verses.translation: The hairs on His body constantly stood up like the thorns on a śimula tree. Sometimes His body was swollen and sometimes lean and thin.

verses.devanagari: প্রতি রোম-কূপে হয় প্রস্বেদ, রক্তোদ্গম ।\\n‘জজ’ ‘গগ’ ‘পরি’ ‘মুমু’ — গদ্গদ বচন ॥৭৩॥
verses.transliteration: prati roma-kūpe haya prasveda, raktodgama\\njaja' 'gaga' 'pari' 'mumu'—gadgada vacana
verses.translation: He bled and perspired from every pore of His body. His voice faltered. Unable to say the line properly, He uttered only, "jaja gaga pari mumu."

verses.devanagari: এক এক দন্ত যেন পৃথক্ পৃথক্ নড়ে ।\\nঐছে নড়ে দন্ত, — যেন ভূমে খসি’ পড়ে ॥৭৪॥
verses.transliteration: eka eka danta yena pṛthak pṛthak naḍe\\naiche naḍe danta,—yena bhūme khasi' paḍe
verses.translation: All His teeth shook, as if each were separate from the others. Indeed, they seemed about to fall to the ground.

verses.devanagari: ক্ষণে ক্ষণে বাড়ে প্রভুর আনন্দ-আবেশ ।\\nতৃতীয় প্রহর হইল, নৃত্য নহে শেষ ॥৭৫॥
verses.transliteration: kṣaṇe kṣaṇe bāḍe prabhura ānanda-āveśa\\ntṛtīya prahara ha-ila, nṛtya nahe śeṣa
verses.translation: His transcendental bliss increased at every moment. Therefore even by midafternoon the dancing had not ended.

verses.devanagari: সব লোকের উথলিল আনন্দ-সাগর ।\\nসব লোক পাসরিল দেহ-আত্ম-ঘর ॥৭৬॥
verses.transliteration: saba lokera uthalila ānanda-sāgara\\nsaba loka pāsarila deha-ātma-ghara
verses.translation: The ocean of transcendental bliss overflowed, and everyone present forgot his body, mind and home.

verses.devanagari: তবে নিত্যানন্দ প্রভু সৃজিলা উপায় ।\\nক্রমে-ক্রমে কীর্তনীয়া রাখিল সবায় ॥৭৭॥
verses.transliteration: tabe nityānanda prabhu sṛjilā upāya\\nkrame-krame kīrtanīyā rākhila sabāya
verses.translation: Then Lord Nityānanda found a way to end the kīrtana. He gradually stopped all the chanters.

verses.devanagari: স্বরূপের সঙ্গে মাত্র এক সম্প্রদায় ।\\nস্বরূপের সঙ্গে সেহ মন্দস্বর গায় ॥৭৮॥
verses.transliteration: svarūpera saṅge mātra eka sampradāya\\nsvarūpera saṅge seha manda-svara gāya
verses.translation: Thus only one group continued chanting with Svarūpa Dāmodara, and they chanted very softly.

verses.devanagari: কোলাহল নাহি, প্রভুর কিছু বাহ্য হৈল ।\\nতবে নিত্যানন্দ সবার শ্রম জানাইল ॥৭৯॥
verses.transliteration: kolāhala nāhi, prabhura kichu bāhya haila\\ntabe nityānanda sabāra śrama jānāila
verses.translation: When there was no longer a tumultuous sound, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu returned to consciousness. Then Nityānanda Prabhu informed Him of the fatigue of the chanters and dancers.

verses.devanagari: ভক্তশ্রম জানি’ কৈলা কীর্তন সমাপন ।\\nসবা লঞা আসি’ কৈলা সমুদ্রে স্নপন ॥৮০॥
verses.transliteration: bhakta-śrama jāni' kailā kīrtana samāpana\\nsabā lañā āsi' kailā samudre snapana
verses.translation: Understanding the fatigue of the devotees, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu stopped the congregational chanting. Then He bathed in the sea, accompanied by them all.

verses.devanagari: সব লঞা প্রভু কৈলা প্রসাদ ভোজন ।\\nসবারে বিদায় দিলা করিতে শয়ন ॥৮১॥
verses.transliteration: saba lañā prabhu kailā prasāda bhojana\\nsabāre vidāya dilā karite śayana
verses.translation: Then Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu took prasāda with all of them and then asked them to return to their dwellings and take rest.

verses.devanagari: গম্ভীরার দ্বারে করেন আপনে শয়ন ।\\nগোবিন্দ আসিয়া করে পাদ-সম্বাহন ॥৮২॥
verses.transliteration: gambhīrāra dvāre karena āpane śayana\\ngovinda āsiyā kare pāda-samvāhana
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu lay down at the door of the Gambhīrā, and Govinda came there to massage His legs.

verses.devanagari: সর্বকাল আছে এই সুদৃঢ় ‘নিয়ম’ ।\\n‘প্রভু যদি প্রসাদ পাঞা করেন শয়ন ॥৮৩॥\\nগোবিন্দ আসিয়া করে পাদসম্বাহন ।\\nতবে যাই’ প্রভুর ‘শেষ’ করেন ভোজন ।।” ৮৪ ॥৮৪॥
verses.transliteration: govinda āsiyā kare pāda-samvāhana\\ntabe yāi' prabhura 'śeṣa' karena bhojana'
verses.translation: It was a steady, long-standing rule that Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would lie down to rest after lunch and Govinda would come to massage His legs. Then Govinda would honor the remnants of food left by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: সব দ্বার যুড়ি’ প্রভু করিয়াছেন শয়ন  ।\\nভিতরে যাইতে নারে, গোবিন্দ করে নিবেদন ॥৮৫॥
verses.transliteration: saba dvāra yuḍi' prabhu kariyāchena śayana\\nbhitare yāite nāre, govinda kare nivedana
verses.translation: This time when the Lord lay down, He occupied the entire doorway. Govinda could not enter the room, and therefore he made the following request.

verses.devanagari: ‘একপাশ হও, মোরে দেহ’ ভিতর যাইতে’  ।\\nপ্রভু কহে, — ‘শক্তি নাহি অঙ্গ চালাইতে’ ॥৮৬॥
verses.transliteration: 'eka-pāśa hao, more deha' bhitara yāite'\\nprabhu kahe,—'śakti nāhi aṅga cālāite'
verses.translation: "Kindly turn on one side. Let me pass to enter the room." However, the Lord replied, "I don't have the strength to move My body."

verses.devanagari: বার বার গোবিন্দ কহে একদিক্ হইতে ।\\nপ্রভু কহে, — ‘অঙ্গ আমি নারি চালাইতে ।।’ ॥ ৮৭ ॥
verses.transliteration: bāra bāra govinda kahe eka-dik ha-ite\\nprabhu kahe,—'aṅga āmi nāri cālāite'
verses.translation: Govinda made his request again and again, but the Lord replied, "I cannot move My body."

verses.devanagari: গোবিন্দ কহে, — ‘করিতে চাহি পাদ-সম্বাহন’ ।\\nপ্রভু কহে, — ‘কর বা না কর, যেই লয় তোমার মন’ ॥৮৮॥
verses.transliteration: govinda kahe,—'karite cāhi pāda-samvāhana'\\nprabhu kahe,—'kara vā nā kara, yei laya tomāra mana'
verses.translation: Govinda repeatedly requested, "I want to massage Your legs," but the Lord said, "Do it or don't do it. It depends upon your mind."

verses.devanagari: তবে গোবিন্দ বহির্বাস তাঁর উপরে দিয়া ।\\nভিতর-ঘরে গেলা মহাপ্রভুরে লঙ্ঘিয়া ॥৮৯॥
verses.transliteration: tabe govinda bahirvāsa tāṅra upare diyā\\nbhitara-ghare gelā mahāprabhure laṅghiyā
verses.translation: Then Govinda spread the Lord's wrapper over the Lord's body and in this way entered the room by crossing over Him.

verses.devanagari: পাদ-সম্বাহন কৈল, কটি-পৃষ্ঠ চাপিল ।\\nমধুর-মর্দনে প্রভুর পরিশ্রম গেল ॥৯০॥
verses.transliteration: pāda-samvāhana kaila, kaṭi-pṛṣṭha cāpila\\nmadhūra-mardane prabhura pariśrama gela
verses.translation: Govinda massaged the Lord's legs as usual. He pressed the Lord's waist and back very softly, and thus all the Lord's fatigue went away.

verses.devanagari: সুখে নিদ্রা হৈল প্রভুর, গোবিন্দ চাপে অঙ্গ ।\\nদণ্ড-দুই বই প্রভুর হৈলা নিদ্রা-ভঙ্গ ॥৯১॥
verses.transliteration: sukhe nidrā haila prabhura, govinda cāpe aṅga\\ndaṇḍa-dui ba-i prabhura hailā nidrā-bhaṅga
verses.translation: As Govinda stroked His body, the Lord slept very nicely for about forty-five minutes, and then His sleep broke.

verses.devanagari: গোবিন্দে দেখিয়া প্রভু বলে ক্রুদ্ধ হঞা  ।\\n‘আজি কেনে এতক্ষণ আছিস্ বসিয়া ? ৯২ ।। মোর নিদ্রা হৈলে কেনে না গেলা প্রসাদ খাইতে ?’ গোবিন্দ কহে — ‘দ্বারে শুইলা, যাইতে নাহি পথে ।।’ ৯৩ ॥৯২॥
verses.transliteration: govinde dekhiyā prabhu bale kruddha hañā\\n'āji kene eta-kṣaṇa āchis vasiyā?
verses.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu saw Govinda sitting by His side, He was somewhat angry. "Why have you been sitting here for so long today?" the Lord asked.

verses.devanagari: মোর নিদ্রা হৈলে কেনে না গেলা প্রসাদ খাইতে?' ।\\nগোবিন্দ কহে — 'দ্বারে শুইলা, যাইতে নাহি পথে' ॥৯৩॥
verses.transliteration: mora nidrā haile kene nā gelā prasāda khāite?'\\ngovinda kahe—'dvāre śuilā, yāite nāhi pathe'
verses.translation: "Why didn't you go to take your meal after I fell asleep?" the Lord asked. Govinda replied, "You were lying down, blocking the door, and there was no way to go."

verses.devanagari: প্রভু কহে, — ‘ভিতরে তবে আইলা কেমনে ?\\nতৈছে কেনে প্রসাদ লৈতে না কৈলা গমনে ?’ ॥ ৯৪ ॥
verses.transliteration: prabhu kahe,—'bhitare tabe āilā kemane?\\ntaiche kene prasāda laite nā kailā gamane?'
verses.translation: The Lord asked, "How did you enter the room? Why didn't you go out to take your lunch in the same way?"

verses.devanagari: গোবিন্দ কহে মনে — “আমার ‘সেবা’ সে ‘নিয়ম’  ।\\nঅপরাধ হউক, কিবা নরকে গমন ॥৯৫॥
verses.transliteration: govinda kahe mane—"āmāra 'sevā' se 'niyama'\\naparādha ha-uka, kibā narake gamana
verses.translation: Govinda mentally replied, "My duty is to serve, even if I have to commit offenses or go to hell.

verses.devanagari: ‘সেবা’ লাগি’ কোটি ‘অপরাধ’ নাহি গণি  ।\\nস্ব-নিমিত্ত ‘অপরাধাভাসে’ ভয় মানি ।।” ৯৬ ॥৯৬॥
verses.transliteration: 'sevā' lāgi' koṭi 'aparādha' nāhi gaṇi\\nsva-nimitta 'aparādhābhāse' bhaya māni"
verses.translation: "I would not mind committing hundreds and thousands of offenses for the service of the Lord, but I greatly fear committing even a glimpse of an offense for my own self."

verses.devanagari: এত সব মনে করি’ গোবিন্দ রহিলা ।\\nপ্রভু যে পুছিলা, তার উত্তর না দিলা ॥৯৭॥
verses.transliteration: eta saba mane kari' govinda rahilā\\nprabhu ye puchilā, tāra uttara nā dilā
verses.translation: Thinking in this way, Govinda kept silent. He did not reply to the Lord's inquiry.

verses.devanagari: প্রত্যহ প্রভুর নিদ্রায় যান প্রসাদ লইতে ।\\nসে দিবসের শ্রম দেখি’ লাগিলা চাপিতে ॥৯৮॥
verses.transliteration: pratyaha prabhura nidrāya yāna prasāda la-ite\\nse divasera śrama dekhi' lāgilā cāpite
verses.translation: It was Govinda's practice to go take lunch when the Lord was asleep. On that day, however, seeing the Lord's weariness, Govinda continued massaging His body.

verses.devanagari: যাইতেহ পথ নাহি, যাইবে কেমনে ?\\nমহা-অপরাধ হয় প্রভুর লঙ্ঘনে ॥৯৯॥
verses.transliteration: yāiteha patha nāhi, yāibe kemane?\\nmahā-aparādha haya prabhura laṅghane
verses.translation: There was no way to go. How could he leave? When he thought of crossing over the Lord's body, he considered it a great offense.

verses.devanagari: এই সব হয় ভক্তিশাস্ত্র-সূক্ষ্ম মর্ম ।\\nচৈতন্যের কৃপায় জানে এই সব ধর্ম ॥১০০॥
verses.transliteration: ei saba haya bhakti-śāstra-sūkṣma marma\\ncaitanyera kṛpāya jāne ei saba dharma
verses.translation: These are some of the finer points of etiquette in devotional service. Only one who has received the mercy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu can understand these principles.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Karmīs,
fruitive workers, cannot understand the finer conclusions of devotional service because they accept only its ritualistic value but do not understand how devotional service satisfies the Supreme Personality of Godhead. The
karmīs
view the formalities as a means of advancing in religion, economic development, sensual satisfaction and liberation. Although these are only material results of following religious principles, the
karmīs
consider them everything. Such ritualistic activities are called
karma. Karmīs
who adopt devotional service very loosely and who therefore remain on the platform of material activities are called
prākṛta-sahajiyās.
They cannot understand how pure devotional service is rendered in paternal and conjugal love, for this can be understood only by the special mercy bestowed by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu upon pure devotees.

verses.devanagari: ভক্ত-গুণ প্রকাশিতে প্রভু বড় রঙ্গী ।\\nএই সব প্রকাশিতে কৈলা এত ভঙ্গী ॥১০১॥
verses.transliteration: bhakta-guṇa prakāśite prabhu baḍa raṅgī\\nei saba prakāśite kailā eta bhaṅgī
verses.translation: The Lord is very interested in manifesting the exalted qualities of His devotees, and that is why He engineered this incident.

verses.devanagari: সঙ্ক্ষেপে কহিলুঁ এই পরিমুণ্ডা-নৃত্য ।\\nঅদ্যাপিহ গায় যাহা চৈতন্যের ভৃত্য ॥১০২॥
verses.transliteration: saṅkṣepe kahiluṅ ei pari-muṇḍā-nṛtya\\nadyāpiha gāya yāhā caitanyera bhṛtya
verses.translation: Thus I have briefly described Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's dancing in the hall of the Jagannātha temple. The servants of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu sing about this dancing even now.

verses.devanagari: এইমত মহাপ্রভু লঞা নিজগণ ।\\nগুণ্ডিচা-গৃহের কৈলা ক্ষালন, মার্জন ॥১০৩॥
verses.transliteration: ei-mata mahāprabhu lañā nija-gaṇa\\nguṇḍicā-gṛhera kailā kṣālana, mārjana
verses.translation: Accompanied by His personal associates, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu washed and swept the Guṇḍicā temple, cleansing it as usual.

verses.devanagari: পূর্ববৎ কৈলা প্রভু কীর্তন, নর্তন ।\\nপূর্ববৎ টোটায় কৈলা বন্য-ভোজন ॥১০৪॥
verses.transliteration: pūrvavat kailā prabhu kīrtana, nartana\\npūrvavat ṭoṭāya kailā vanya-bhojana
verses.translation: The Lord danced and chanted and then enjoyed a picnic in the garden as He had done before.

verses.devanagari: পূর্ববৎ রথ-আগে করিলা নর্তন ।\\nহেরাপঞ্চমী-যাত্রা কৈলা দরশন ॥১০৫॥
verses.transliteration: pūrvavat ratha-āge karilā nartana\\nherā-pañcamī-yātrā kailā daraśana
verses.translation: As previously, He danced in front of the Jagannātha cart and observed the festival of Herā-pañcamī.

verses.devanagari: চারিমাস বর্ষায় রহিলা সব ভক্তগণ ।\\nজন্মাষ্টমী আদি যাত্রা কৈলা দরশন ॥১০৬॥
verses.transliteration: cāri-māsa varṣāya rahilā saba bhakta-gaṇa\\njanmāṣṭamī ādi yātrā kailā daraśana
verses.translation: All the devotees from Bengal stayed in Jagannātha Purī for the four months of the rainy season and observed many other ceremonies, such as the anniversary of Lord Kṛṣṇa's birth.

verses.devanagari: পূর্বে যদি গৌড় হইতে ভক্তগণ আইল ।\\nপ্রভুরে কিছু খাওয়াইতে সবার ইচ্ছা হৈল ॥১০৭॥
verses.transliteration: pūrve yadi gauḍa ha-ite bhakta-gaṇa āila\\nprabhure kichu khāoyāite sabāra icchā haila
verses.translation: Formerly, when all the devotees had arrived from Bengal, they all desired to give Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu something to eat.

verses.devanagari: কেহ কোন প্রসাদ আনি’ দেয় গোবিন্দ-ঠাঞি ।\\n‘ইহা যেন অবশ্য ভক্ষণ করেন গোসাঞি’ ॥১০৮॥
verses.transliteration: keha kona prasāda āni' deya govinda-ṭhāñi\\n'ihā yena avaśya bhakṣaṇa karena gosāñi'
verses.translation: Each devotee would bring a certain type of prasāda. He would entrust it to Govinda and request him, "Please arrange that the Lord will surely eat this prasāda."

verses.devanagari: কেহ পৈড়, কেহ নাড়ু, কেহ পিঠাপানা ।\\nবহুমূল্য উত্তম-প্রসাদ-প্রকার যার নানা ॥১০৯॥
verses.transliteration: keha paiḍa, keha nāḍu, keha piṭhā-pānā\\nbahu-mūlya uttama-prasāda-prakāra yāra nānā
verses.translation: Some brought paiḍa [a coconut preparation], some brought sweetballs, and some brought cakes and sweet rice. The prasāda was of different varieties, all very costly.

verses.devanagari: ‘অমুক্ এই দিয়াছে’ গোবিন্দ করে নিবেদন ।\\n‘ধরি’ রাখ’ বলি’ প্রভু না করেন ভক্ষণ ॥১১০॥
