verses.transliteration: aṅge kāṅṭā lāgila, kichu nā jānila!\\nāste-vyaste govinda tāṅra pāchete dhāilā
verses.translation: Govinda ran very quickly behind the Lord, who did not feel any pain from the pricking of the thorns.

verses.devanagari: ধাঞা যায়েন প্রভু, স্ত্রী আছে অল্প দূরে ।\\nস্ত্রী গায়’ বলি’ গোবিন্দ প্রভুরে কৈলা কোলে ॥৮৩॥
verses.transliteration: dhāñā yāyena prabhu, strī āche alpa dūre\\nstrī gāya' bali' govinda prabhure kailā kole
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was running very rapidly, and the girl was only a short distance away. Just then Govinda caught the Lord in his arms and cried, "It is a woman singing!"

verses.devanagari: স্ত্রী-নাম শুনি’ প্রভুর বাহ্য হইলা ।\\nপুনরপি সেই পথে বাহুড়ি’ চলিলা ॥৮৪॥
verses.transliteration: strī-nāma śuni' prabhura bāhya ha-ilā\\npunarapi sei pathe bāhuḍi' calilā
verses.translation: As soon as He heard the word "woman," the Lord became externally conscious and turned back.

verses.devanagari: প্রভু কহে, — “গোবিন্দ, আজি রাখিলা জীবন ।\\nস্ত্রী-পরশ হৈলে আমার হইত মরণ ॥৮৫॥
verses.transliteration: prabhu kahe,—"govinda, āji rākhilā jīvana\\nstrī-paraśa haile āmāra ha-ita maraṇa
verses.translation: "My dear Govinda," He said, "you have saved My life. If I had touched the body of a woman, I would certainly have died.

verses.devanagari: এ-ঋণ শোধিতে আমি নারিমু তোমার ।”\\nগোবিন্দ কহে, — ‘জগন্নাথ রাখেন মুই কোন্ ছার’ ? ॥ ৮৬ ॥
verses.transliteration: e-ṛṇa śodhite āmi nārimu tomāra"\\ngovinda kahe,—jagannātha rākhena mui kon chāra'?
verses.translation: "I shall never be able to repay My debt to you." Govinda replied, "Lord Jagannātha has saved You. I am insignificant."

verses.devanagari: প্রভু কহে, — “গোবিন্দ, মোর সঙ্গে রহিবা ।\\nযাহাঁ তাহাঁ মোর রক্ষায় সাবধান হইবা ।।” ॥ ৮৭ ॥
verses.transliteration: prabhu kahe,—"govinda, mora saṅge rahibā\\nyāhāṅ tāhāṅ mora rakṣāya sāvadhāna ha-ibā"
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied, "My dear Govinda, you should stay with Me always. There is danger anywhere and everywhere; therefore you should protect Me very carefully."

verses.devanagari: এত বলি’ লেউটি’ প্রভু গেলা নিজ-স্থানে ।\\nশুনি’ মহা-ভয় হইল স্বরূপাদি-মনে ॥৮৮॥
verses.transliteration: eta bali' leuṭi' prabhu gelā nija-sthāne\\nśuni' mahā-bhaya ha-ila svarūpādi-mane
verses.translation: After saying this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu returned home. When Svarūpa Gosvāmī and His other attendants heard about the incident, they were very afraid.

verses.devanagari: এথা তপনমিশ্র-পুত্র রঘুনাথ-ভট্টাচার্য ।\\nপ্রভুরে দেখিতে চলিলা ছাড়ি’ সর্ব কার্য ॥৮৯॥
verses.transliteration: ethā tapana-miśra-putra raghunātha-bhaṭṭācārya\\nprabhure dekhite calilā chāḍi' sarva kārya
verses.translation: During this time, Raghunātha Bhaṭṭācārya, the son of Tapana Miśra, gave up all his duties and left home, intending to meet Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: কাশী হৈতে চলিলা তেঁহো গৌড়পথ দিয়া ।\\nসঙ্গে সেবক চলে তাঁর ঝালি বহিয়া ॥৯০॥
verses.transliteration: kāśī haite calilā teṅho gauḍa-patha diyā\\nsaṅge sevaka cale tāṅra jhāli vahiyā
verses.translation: Accompanied by one servant carrying his baggage, Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa started from Vārāṇasī and traveled along the path leading through Bengal.

verses.devanagari: পথে তারে মিলিলা বিশ্বাস-রামদাস ।\\nবিশ্বাসখানার কায়স্থ তেঁহো রাজার বিশ্বাস ॥৯১॥
verses.transliteration: pathe tāre mililā viśvāsa-rāmadāsa\\nviśvāsa-khānāra kāyastha teṅho rājāra viśvāsa
verses.translation: In Bengal he met Rāmadāsa Viśvāsa, who belonged to the kāyastha caste. He was one of the king's secretaries.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
The word
viśvāsa-khānāra kāyastha
indicates a secretary or clerk belonging to the
kāyastha
caste.
Kāyasthas
were usually secretaries to kings, governors or other important persons. It is said that anyone working in the government secretariat at this time was a
kāyastha.

verses.devanagari: সর্বশাস্ত্রে প্রবীণ, কাব্যপ্রকাশ-অধ্যাপক ।\\nপরমবৈষ্ণব, রঘুনাথ-উপাসক ॥৯২॥
verses.transliteration: sarva-śāstre pravīṇa, kāvya-prakāśa-adhyāpaka\\nparama-vaiṣṇava, raghunātha-upāsaka
verses.translation: Rāmadāsa Viśvāsa was very learned in all the revealed scriptures. He was a teacher of the famous book Kāvya-prakāśa and was known as an advanced devotee and worshiper of Raghunātha [Lord Rāmacandra].
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Commenting on the word
parama-vaiṣṇava,
Śrīla Bhaktivinoda Ṭhākura says that anyone who desires to merge into the existence of the Lord cannot be a pure Vaiṣṇava, but because Rāmadāsa Viśvāsa was a great devotee of Lord Rāmacandra, he was almost a Vaiṣṇava. In those days, no one could distinguish between a pure Vaiṣṇava and a pseudo Vaiṣṇava. Therefore Rāmadāsa Viśvāsa was known as a Vaiṣṇava because he worshiped Lord Rāmacandra.

verses.devanagari: অষ্টপ্রহর রামনাম জপেন রাত্রি-দিনে ।\\nসর্ব ত্যজি’ চলিলা জগন্নাথ-দরশনে ॥৯৩॥
verses.transliteration: aṣṭa-prahara rāma-nāma japena rātri-dine\\nsarva tyaji' calilā jagannātha-daraśane
verses.translation: Rāmadāsa had renounced everything and was going to see Lord Jagannātha. While traveling, he chanted the holy name of Lord Rāma twenty-four hours a day.

verses.devanagari: রঘুনাথ-ভট্টের সনে পথেতে মিলিলা ।\\nভট্টের ঝালি মাথে করি’ বহিয়া চলিলা ॥৯৪॥
verses.transliteration: raghunātha-bhaṭṭera sane pathete mililā\\nbhaṭṭera jhāli māthe kari' vahiyā calilā
verses.translation: When he met Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa on the way, he took Raghunātha's baggage on his head and carried it.

verses.devanagari: নানা সেবা করি’ করে পাদ-সম্বাহন ।\\nতাতে রঘুনাথের হয় সঙ্কুচিত মন ॥৯৫॥
verses.transliteration: nānā sevā kari' kare pāda-samvāhana\\ntāte raghunāthera haya saṅkucita mana
verses.translation: Rāmadāsa served Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa in various ways, even massaging his legs. Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa felt some hesitation in accepting all this service.

verses.devanagari: “তুমি বড় লোক, পণ্ডিত, মহাভাগবতে ।\\nসেবা না করিহ, সুখে চল মোর সাথে ।।” ॥ ৯৬ ॥
verses.transliteration: "tumi baḍa loka, paṇḍita, mahā-bhāgavate\\nsevā nā kariha, sukhe cala mora sāthe"
verses.translation: "You are a respectable gentleman, a learned scholar and a great devotee," he said. "Please do not try to serve me. Just come with me in a happy mood."

verses.devanagari: রামদাস কহে, — “আমি শূদ্র অধম !\\n‘ব্রাহ্মণের সেবা’, — এই মোর নিজ-ধর্ম ॥৯৭॥
verses.transliteration: rāmadāsa kahe,—"āmi śūdra adhama!\\n'brāhmaṇera sevā',—ei mora nija-dharma
verses.translation: Rāmadāsa replied, "I am a śūdra, a fallen soul. To serve a brāhmaṇa is my duty and religious principle.

verses.devanagari: সঙ্কোচ না কর তুমি, আমি — তোমার ‘দাস’ ।\\nতোমার সেবা করিলে হয় হৃদয়ে উল্লাস ।।” ॥ ৯৮ ॥
verses.transliteration: saṅkoca nā kara tumi, āmi—tomāra 'dāsa'\\ntomāra sevā karile haya hṛdaye ullāsa"
verses.translation: "Therefore please do not be hesitant. I am your servant, and when I serve you my heart becomes jubilant."

verses.devanagari: এত বলি’ ঝালি বহেন, করেন সেবনে ।\\nরঘুনাথের তারকমন্ত্র জপেন রাত্রি-দিনে ॥৯৯॥
verses.transliteration: eta bali' jhāli vahena, karena sevane\\nraghunāthera tāraka-mantra japena rātri-dine
verses.translation: Thus Rāmadāsa carried the baggage of Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa and served him sincerely. He constantly chanted the holy name of Lord Rāmacandra day and night.

verses.devanagari: এইমতে রঘুনাথ আইলা নীলাচলে ।\\nপ্রভুর চরণে যাঞা মিলিলা কুতূহলে ॥১০০॥
verses.transliteration: ei-mate raghunātha āilā nīlācale\\nprabhura caraṇe yāñā mililā kutūhale
verses.translation: Traveling in this way, Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa soon arrived at Jagannātha Purī. There, with great delight, he met Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and fell at His lotus feet.

verses.devanagari: দণ্ডপরণাম করি’ ভট্ট পড়িলা চরণে ।\\nপ্রভু ‘রঘুনাথ’ জানি কৈলা আলিঙ্গনে ॥১০১॥
verses.transliteration: daṇḍa-paraṇāma kari' bhaṭṭa paḍilā caraṇe\\nprabhu 'raghunātha' jāni kailā āliṅgane
verses.translation: Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa fell straight as a rod at the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Then the Lord embraced him, knowing well who he was.

verses.devanagari: মিশ্র আর শেখরের দণ্ডবৎ জানাইলা ।\\nমহাপ্রভু তাঁ-সবার বার্তা পুছিলা ॥১০২॥
verses.transliteration: miśra āra śekharera daṇḍavat jānāilā\\nmahāprabhu tāṅ-sabāra vārtā puchilā
verses.translation: Raghunātha offered respectful obeisances to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu on behalf of Tapana Miśra and Candraśekhara, and the Lord also inquired about them.

verses.devanagari: “ভাল হইল আইলা, দেখ ‘কমললোচন’ ।\\nআজি আমার এথা করিবা প্রসাদ ভোজন ।।” ॥ ১০৩ ॥
verses.transliteration: "bhāla ha-ila āilā, dekha 'kamala-locana'\\nāji āmāra ethā karibā prasāda bhojana"
verses.translation: "It is very good that you have come here," the Lord said. "Now go see the lotus-eyed Lord Jagannātha. Today you will accept prasāda here at My place."

verses.devanagari: গোবিন্দেরে কহি’ এক বাসা দেওয়াইলা ।\\nস্বরূপাদি ভক্তগণ-সনে মিলাইলা ॥১০৪॥
verses.transliteration: govindere kahi' eka vāsā deoyāilā\\nsvarūpādi bhakta-gaṇa-sane milāilā
verses.translation: The Lord asked Govinda to arrange for Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa's accommodations and then introduced him to all the devotees, headed by Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī.

verses.devanagari: এইমত প্রভু-সঙ্গে রহিলা অষ্টমাস ।\\nদিনে দিনে প্রভুর কৃপায় বাড়য়ে উল্লাস ॥১০৫॥
verses.transliteration: ei-mata prabhu-saṅge rahilā aṣṭa-māsa\\ndine dine prabhura kṛpāya bāḍaye ullāsa
verses.translation: Thus Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa lived with Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu continuously for eight months, and by the Lord's mercy he felt increased transcendental happiness every day.

verses.devanagari: মধ্যে মধ্যে মহাপ্রভুর করেন নিমন্ত্রণ ।\\nঘর-ভাত করেন, আর বিবিধ ব্যঞ্জন ॥১০৬॥
verses.transliteration: madhye madhye mahāprabhura karena nimantraṇa\\nghara-bhāta karena, āra vividha vyañjana
verses.translation: He would periodically cook rice with various vegetables and invite Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to his home.

verses.devanagari: রঘুনাথ-ভট্ট — পাকে অতি সুনিপুণ ।\\nযেই রান্ধে, সেই হয় অমৃতের সম ॥১০৭॥
verses.transliteration: raghunātha-bhaṭṭa—pāke ati sunipuṇa\\nyei rāndhe, sei haya amṛtera sama
verses.translation: Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa was an expert cook. Whatever he prepared tasted just like nectar.

verses.devanagari: পরম সন্তোষে প্রভু করেন ভোজন ।\\nপ্রভুর অবশিষ্ট-পাত্র ভট্টের ভক্ষণ ॥১০৮॥
verses.transliteration: parama santoṣe prabhu karena bhojana\\nprabhura avaśiṣṭa-pātra bhaṭṭera bhakṣaṇa
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would accept with great satisfaction all the food he prepared. After the Lord was satisfied, Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa would eat His remnants.

verses.devanagari: রামদাস যদি প্রথম প্রভুরে মিলিলা ।\\nমহাপ্রভু অধিক তাঁরে কৃপা না করিলা ॥১০৯॥
verses.transliteration: rāmadāsa yadi prathama prabhure mililā\\nmahāprabhu adhika tāṅre kṛpā nā karilā
verses.translation: When Rāmadāsa Viśvāsa met Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the Lord did not show him any special mercy, although this was their first meeting.

verses.devanagari: অন্তরে মুমুক্ষু তেঁহো, বিদ্যা-গর্ববান্ ।\\nসর্বচিত্ত-জ্ঞাতা প্রভু — সর্বজ্ঞ ভগবান্ ॥১১০॥
verses.transliteration: antare mumukṣu teṅho, vidyā-garvavān\\nsarva-citta-jñātā prabhu—sarvajña bhagavān
verses.translation: Within his heart, Rāmadāsa Viśvāsa was an impersonalist who desired to merge into the existence of the Lord, and he was very proud of his learning. Being the omniscient Supreme Personality of Godhead, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu can understand the heart of everyone, and thus He knew all these things.

verses.devanagari: রামদাস কৈলা তবে নীলাচলে বাস ।\\nপট্টনায়ক-গোষ্ঠীকে পড়ায় ‘কাব্যপ্রকাশ’ ॥১১১॥
verses.transliteration: rāmadāsa kailā tabe nīlācale vāsa\\npaṭṭanāyaka-goṣṭhīke paḍāya 'kāvya-prakāśa
verses.translation: Rāmadāsa Viśvāsa then took up residence in Jagannātha Purī and taught the Kāvya-prakāśa to the Paṭṭanāyaka family [the descendants of Bhavānanda Rāya].

verses.devanagari: অষ্টমাস রহি’ প্রভু ভট্টে বিদায় দিলা ।\\n‘বিবাহ না করিহ’ বলি’ নিষেধ করিলা ॥১১২॥
verses.transliteration: aṣṭa-māsa rahi' prabhu bhaṭṭe vidāya dilā\\n'vivāha nā kariha' bali' niṣedha karilā
verses.translation: After eight months, when Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu bade farewell to Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa, the Lord flatly forbade him to marry. "Do not marry," the Lord said.
verses.purport: PURPORT\nRaghunātha Bhaṭṭācārya had become a greatly advanced devotee while still unmarried. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu could see this, and therefore He advised him not to begin the process of material sense gratification. Marriage is a concession for people who are unable to control their senses. Raghunātha, however, being an advanced devotee of Kṛṣṇa, naturally had no desire for sense gratification. Therefore Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu advised him not to enter the bondage of marriage. Generally a person cannot make much advancement in spiritual consciousness if he is married. He becomes attached to his family and is prone to sense gratification. Thus his spiritual advancement is very slow or almost nil.

verses.devanagari: বৃদ্ধ মাতা-পিতার যাই’ করহ সেবন ।\\nবৈষ্ণব-পাশ ভাগবত কর অধ্যয়ন ॥১১৩॥
verses.transliteration: vṛddha mātā-pitāra yāi' karaha sevana\\nvaiṣṇava-pāśa bhāgavata kara adhyayana
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said to Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa, "When you return home, serve your aged father and mother, who are devotees, and try to study Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam from a pure Vaiṣṇava who has realized God."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
One should note how Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the Supreme Personality of Godhead, advised Raghunātha Bhaṭṭācārya to learn
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam.
He advised him to understand
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
not from professional men but from a real
bhāgavata,
devotee. He also advised Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa to serve his mother and father because they were both His devotees. Anyone who wishes to advance in Kṛṣṇa consciousness must try to serve the devotees of Kṛṣṇa. As Narottama dāsa Ṭhākura says,
chāḍiyā vaiṣṇava-sevā nistāra pāyeche kebā:
"Without serving a self-realized Vaiṣṇava, no one has ever been released from the materialistic way of life." Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would have never advised Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa to serve ordinary parents, but since his parents were Vaiṣṇavas, the Lord advised him to serve them.
One might ask "Why shouldn't ordinary parents be served?" As stated in
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
(5.5.18):
gurur na sa syāt sva-jano na sa syāt
pitā na sa syāj jananī na sā syāt
daivaṁ na tat syān na patiś ca sa syān
na mocayed yaḥ samupeta-mṛtyum
"One who cannot deliver his dependent from the path of birth and death should never become a spiritual master, a relative, a father or mother, or a worshipable demigod, nor should such a person become a husband." Everyone naturally gets a father and mother at the time of birth, but the real father and mother are they who can release their offspring from the clutches of imminent death. This is possible only for parents advanced in Kṛṣṇa consciousness. Therefore any parents who cannot enlighten their offspring in Kṛṣṇa consciousness cannot be accepted as a real father and mother. The following verse from the
Bhakti-rasāmṛta-sindhu
(1.2.200) confirms the uselessness of serving ordinary parents:
laukikī vaidikī vāpi
yā kriyā kriyate mune
hari-sevānukūlaiva
sa kāryā bhaktim icchatā
"One should perform only those activities-either worldly or prescribed by Vedic rules and regulations-which are favorable for the cultivation of Kṛṣṇa consciousness."
Concerning the study of
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam,
Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu clearly advises that one avoid hearing from a non-Vaiṣṇava professional reciter. In this connection Sanātana Gosvāmī quotes a verse from the
Padma Purāṇa:
avaiṣṇava-mukhodgīrṇaṁ
pūtaṁ hari-kathāmṛtam
śravaṇaṁ naiva kartavyaṁ
sarpocchiṣṭaṁ yathā payaḥ
"No one should hear or take lessons from a person who is not a Vaiṣṇava. Even if he speaks about Kṛṣṇa, such a lesson should not be accepted, for it is like milk touched by the lips of a serpent." Nowadays it is fashionable to observe Bhāgavata-saptāha and hear
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
from persons who are anything but advanced devotees or self-realized souls. There are even many Māyāvādīs who read
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
to throngs of people. Many Māyāvādīs have recently begun reciting
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
in Vṛndāvana, and because they can present the
Bhāgavatam
with word jugglery, twisting the meaning by grammatical tricks, materialistic persons who go to Vṛndāvana as a matter of spiritual fashion like to hear them. All this is clearly forbidden by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. We should note carefully that since these Māyāvādīs cannot personally know the meaning of
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam,
they can never deliver others by reciting it. On the other hand, an advanced devotee of the Lord is free from material bondage. He personifies the
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
in life and action. Therefore we advise that anyone who wants to learn the
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
must approach such a realized soul.

verses.devanagari: পুনরপি একবার আসিহ নীলাচলে ।”\\nএত বলি’ কণ্ঠ-মালা দিলা তাঁর গলে ॥১১৪॥
verses.transliteration: punarapi eka-bāra āsiha nīlācale"\\neta bali' kaṇṭha-mālā dilā tāṅra gale
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu concluded, "Come again to Nīlācala [Jagannātha Purī]." After saying this, the Lord put His own neck beads on Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa's neck.

verses.devanagari: আলিঙ্গন করি’ প্রভু বিদায় তাঁরে দিলা ।\\nপ্রেমে গর গর ভট্ট কান্দিতে লাগিলা ॥১১৫॥
verses.transliteration: āliṅgana kari' prabhu vidāya tāṅre dilā\\npreme gara gara bhaṭṭa kāndite lāgilā
verses.translation: Then the Lord embraced him and bade him farewell. Overwhelmed with ecstatic love, Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa began to cry due to imminent separation from Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: স্বরূপ-আদি ভক্ত-ঠাঞি আজ্ঞা মাগিয়া ।\\nবারাণসী আইলা ভট্ট প্রভুর আজ্ঞা পাঞা ॥১১৬॥
verses.transliteration: svarūpa-ādi bhakta-ṭhāñi ājñā māgiyā\\nvārāṇasī āilā bhaṭṭa prabhura ājñā pāñā
verses.translation: After taking permission from Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and all the devotees, headed by Svarūpa Dāmodara, Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa returned to Vārāṇasī.

verses.devanagari: চারিবৎসর ঘরে পিতা-মাতার সেবা কৈলা ।\\nবৈষ্ণব-পণ্ডিত-ঠাঞি ভাগবত পড়িলা ॥১১৭॥
verses.transliteration: cāri-vatsara ghare pitā-mātāra sevā kailā\\nvaiṣṇava-paṇḍita-ṭhāñi bhāgavata paḍilā
verses.translation: In accordance with the instructions of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, he continuously rendered service to his mother and father for four years. He also regularly studied the Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam from a self-realized Vaiṣṇava.

verses.devanagari: পিতা-মাতা কাশী পাইলে উদাসীন হঞা ।\\nপুনঃ প্রভুর ঠাঞি আইলা গৃহাদি ছাড়িয়া ॥১১৮॥
verses.transliteration: pitā-mātā kāśī pāile udāsīna hañā\\npunaḥ prabhura ṭhāñi āilā gṛhādi chāḍiyā
verses.translation: Then his parents died at Kāśī [Vārāṇasī], and he became detached. He therefore returned to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, giving up all relationships with his home.

verses.devanagari: পূর্ববৎ অষ্টমাস প্রভু-পাশ ছিলা  ।\\nঅষ্টমাস রহি’ পুনঃ প্রভু আজ্ঞা দিলা ॥১১৯॥
verses.transliteration: pūrvavat aṣṭa-māsa prabhu-pāśa chilā\\naṣṭa-māsa rahi' punaḥ prabhu ājñā dilā
verses.translation: As previously, Raghunātha remained continuously with Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu for eight months. Then the Lord gave him the following order.

verses.devanagari: “আমার আজ্ঞায়, রঘুনাথ, যাহ বৃন্দাবনে  ।\\nতাহাঁ যাঞা রহ রূপ-সনাতন-স্থানে ॥১২০॥
verses.transliteration: "āmāra ājñāya, raghunātha, yāha vṛndāvane\\ntāhāṅ yāñā raha rūpa-sanātana-sthāne
verses.translation: "My dear Raghunātha, go to Vṛndāvana, following My instructions, and place yourself under the care of Rūpa and Sanātana Gosvāmīs.

verses.devanagari: ভাগবত পড়, সদা লহ কৃষ্ণনাম ।\\nঅচিরে করিবেন কৃপা কৃষ্ণ ভগবান্ ।।” ॥ ১২১ ॥
verses.transliteration: bhāgavata paḍa, sadā laha kṛṣṇa-nāma\\nacire karibena kṛpā kṛṣṇa bhagavān"
verses.translation: "In Vṛndāvana you should chant the Hare Kṛṣṇa mantra twenty-four hours a day and read Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam continuously. Kṛṣṇa, the Supreme Personality of Godhead, will very soon bestow His mercy upon you."

verses.devanagari: এত বলি’ প্রভু তাঁরে আলিঙ্গন কৈলা ।\\nপ্রভুর কৃপাতে কৃষ্ণপ্রেমে মত্ত হৈলা ॥১২২॥
verses.transliteration: eta bali' prabhu tāṅre āliṅgana kailā\\nprabhura kṛpāte kṛṣṇa-preme matta hailā
verses.translation: After saying this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu embraced Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa, and by the Lord's mercy Raghunātha was enlivened with ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa.

verses.devanagari: চৌদ্দ-হাত জগন্নাথের তুলসীর মালা ।\\nছুটা-পান-বিড়া মহোৎসবে পাঞাছিলা ॥১২৩॥
verses.transliteration: caudda-hāta jagannāthera tulasīra mālā\\nchuṭā-pāna-viḍā mahotsave pāñāchilā
verses.translation: At a festival Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had been given some unspiced betel and a garland of tulasī leaves fourteen cubits long. The garland had been worn by Lord Jagannātha.

verses.devanagari: সেই মালা, ছুটা পান প্রভু তাঁরে দিলা ।\\n‘ইষ্টদেব’ করি’ মালা ধরিয়া রাখিলা ॥১২৪॥
verses.transliteration: sei mālā, chuṭā pāna prabhu tāṅre dilā\\n'iṣṭa-deva' kari' mālā dhariyā rākhilā
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu gave the garland and betel to Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa, who accepted them as a worshipable Deity, preserving them very carefully.

verses.devanagari: প্রভুর ঠাঞি আজ্ঞা লঞা গেলা বৃন্দাবনে ।\\nআশ্রয় করিলা আসি’ রূপ-সনাতনে ॥১২৫॥
verses.transliteration: prabhura ṭhāñi ājñā lañā gelā vṛndāvane\\nāśraya karilā āsi' rūpa-sanātane
verses.translation: Taking permission from Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa then departed for Vṛndāvana. When he arrived there, he put himself under the care of Rūpa and Sanātana Gosvāmīs.

verses.devanagari: রূপ-গোসাঞির সভায় করেন ভাগবত-পঠন ।\\nভাগবত পড়িতে প্রেমে আউলায় তাঁর মন ॥১২৬॥
verses.transliteration: rūpa-gosāñira sabhāya karena bhāgavata-paṭhana\\nbhāgavata paḍite preme āulāya tāṅra mana
verses.translation: When reciting Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam in the company of Rūpa and Sanātana, Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa would be overwhelmed with ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa.

verses.devanagari: অশ্রু, কম্প, গদ্গদ প্রভুর কৃপাতে ।\\nনেত্র কণ্ঠ রোধে বাষ্প, না পারে পড়িতে ॥১২৭॥
verses.transliteration: aśru, kampa, gadgada prabhura kṛpāte\\nnetra kaṇṭha rodhe bāṣpa, nā pāre paḍite
verses.translation: By the mercy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, he experienced the symptoms of ecstatic love-tears, trembling, and faltering of the voice. His eyes filled with tears, his throat became choked, and thus he could not recite Śrīmad Bhāgavatam.

verses.devanagari: পিকস্বর-কণ্ঠ, তাতে রাগের বিভাগ ।\\nএকশ্লোক পড়িতে ফিরায় তিন-চারি রাগ ॥১২৮॥
verses.transliteration: pika-svara-kaṇṭha, tāte rāgera vibhāga\\neka-śloka paḍite phirāya tina-cāri rāga
verses.translation: His voice was as sweet as a cuckoo's, and he would recite each verse of Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam in three or four tunes. Thus his recitations were very sweet to hear.

verses.devanagari: কৃষ্ণের সৌন্দর্য-মাধুর্য যবে পড়ে, শুনে ।\\nপ্রেমেতে বিহ্বল তবে, কিছুই না জানে ॥১২৯॥
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇera saundarya-mādhurya yabe paḍe, śune\\npremete vihvala tabe, kichui nā jāne
verses.translation: When he recited or heard about the beauty and sweetness of Kṛṣṇa, he would be overwhelmed with ecstatic love and become oblivious to everything.

verses.devanagari: গোবিন্দ-চরণে কৈলা আত্মসমর্পণ ।\\nগোবিন্দ-চরণারবিন্দ — যাঁর প্রাণধন ॥১৩০॥
verses.transliteration: govinda-caraṇe kailā ātma-samarpaṇa\\ngovinda-caraṇāravinda—yāṅra prāṇa-dhana
verses.translation: Thus Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa surrendered fully at the lotus feet of Lord Govinda, and those lotus feet became his life and soul.

verses.devanagari: নিজ শিষ্যে কহি’ গোবিন্দের মন্দির করাইলা ।\\nবংশী, মকর কুণ্ডলাদি ‘ভূষণ’ করি’ দিলা ॥১৩১॥
verses.transliteration: nija śiṣye kahi' govindera mandira karāilā\\nvaṁśī, makara, kuṇḍalādi 'bhūṣaṇa' kari' dilā
verses.translation: Subsequently Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa ordered his disciples to construct a temple for Govinda. He prepared various ornaments for Govinda, including a flute and earrings shaped like sharks

verses.devanagari: গ্রাম্যবার্তা না শুনে, না কহে জিহ্বায় ।\\nকৃষ্ণকথা-পূজাদিতে অষ্টপ্রহর যায় ॥১৩২॥
verses.transliteration: grāmya-vārtā nā śune, nā kahe jihvāya\\nkṛṣṇa-kathā-pūjādite aṣṭa-prahara yāya
verses.translation: Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa would neither hear nor speak about anything of the material world. He would simply discuss Kṛṣṇa and worship the Lord day and night.

verses.devanagari: বৈষ্ণবের নিন্দ্য-কর্ম নাহি পাড়ে কাণে ।\\nসবে কৃষ্ণ ভজন করে, — এইমাত্র জানে ॥১৩৩॥
verses.transliteration: vaiṣṇavera nindya-karma nāhi pāḍe kāṇe\\nsabe kṛṣṇa bhajana kare,—ei-mātra jāne
verses.translation: He would not listen to blasphemy of a Vaiṣṇava, nor would he listen to talk of a Vaiṣṇava's misbehavior. He knew only that everyone was engaged in Kṛṣṇa's service; he did not understand anything else.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa never did anything harmful to a Vaiṣṇava. In other words, he was never inattentive in the service of the Lord, nor did he ever violate the rules and regulations of a pure Vaiṣṇava. It is the duty of a Vaiṣṇava
ācārya
to prevent his disciples and followers from violating the principles of Vaiṣṇava behavior. He should always advise them to strictly follow the regulative principles, which will protect them from falling down. Although a Vaiṣṇava preacher may sometimes criticize others, Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa avoided this. Even if another Vaiṣṇava was actually at fault, Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa would not criticize him; he saw only that everyone was engaged in Kṛṣṇa's service. That is the position of a
mahā-bhāgavata.
Actually, even if one is serving
māyā,
in a higher sense he is also a servant of Kṛṣṇa. Because
māyā
is the servant of Kṛṣṇa, anyone serving
māyā
serves Kṛṣṇa indirectly. Therefore it is said:
keha māne, keha nā māne, saba tāṅra dāsa
ye nā māne, tāra haya sei pāpe nāśa
"Some accept Him, whereas others do not, yet everyone is His servant. One who does not accept Him, however, will be ruined by his sinful activities." (Cc. Ādi 6.85)

verses.devanagari: মহাপ্রভুর দত্ত মালা মননের কালে ।\\nপ্রসাদ-কড়ার-সহ বান্ধি লেন গলে ॥১৩৪॥
verses.transliteration: mahāprabhura datta mālā mananera kāle\\nprasāda-kaḍāra saha bāndhi lena gale
verses.translation: When Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa Gosvāmī was absorbed in remembrance of Lord Kṛṣṇa, he would take the tulasī garland and the prasāda of Lord Jagannātha given to him by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, bind them together and wear them on his neck.

verses.devanagari: মহাপ্রভুর কৃপায় কৃষ্ণপ্রেম অনর্গল ।\\nএই ত’ কহিলুঁ তাতে চৈতন্য-কৃপাফল ॥১৩৫॥
verses.transliteration: mahāprabhura kṛpāya kṛṣṇa-prema anargala\\nei ta' kahiluṅ tāte caitanya-kṛpā-phala
verses.translation: Thus I have described the powerful mercy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, by which Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa Gosvāmī remained constantly overwhelmed with ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa.

verses.devanagari: জগদানন্দের কহিলুঁ বৃন্দাবনগমন ।\\nতার মধ্যে দেবদাসীর গান-শ্রবণ ॥১৩৬॥\\nমহাপ্রভুর রঘুনাথে কৃপা-প্রেম-ফল ।\\nএকপরিচ্ছেদে তিন কথা কহিলুঁ সকল ॥১৩৭॥
verses.transliteration: mahāprabhura raghunāthe kṛpā-prema-phala\\neka-paricchede tina kathā kahiluṅ sakala
verses.translation: In this chapter I have spoken about three topics: Jagadānanda Paṇḍita's visit to Vṛndāvana, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's listening to the song of the deva-dāsī at the temple of Jagannātha, and how Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa Gosvāmī achieved ecstatic love of Kṛṣṇa by the mercy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: যে এইসকল কথা শুনে শ্রদ্ধা করি’ ।\\nতাঁরে কৃষ্ণপ্রেমধন দেন গৌরহরি ॥১৩৮॥
verses.transliteration: ye ei-sakala kathā śune śraddhā kari'\\ntāṅre kṛṣṇa-prema-dhana dena gaurahari
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu [Gaurahari] bestows ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa upon anyone who hears all these topics with faith and love.

verses.devanagari: শ্রীরূপ-রঘুনাথ-পদে যার আশ ।\\nচৈতন্যচরিতামৃত কহে কৃষ্ণদাস ॥১৩৯॥
verses.transliteration: śrī-rūpa-raghunātha-pade yāra āśa\\ncaitanya-caritāmṛta kahe kṛṣṇadāsa
verses.translation: Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.
verses.purport: PURPORT\nThus end the Bhaktivedanta purports to Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā,  Thirteenth Chapter, describing Jagadānanda Paṇḍita's visit to Vṛndāvana, the Lord's hearing the song of the deva-dāsī, and Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa Gosvāmī's achieving love of Kṛṣṇa.

sections.title: Chapter 14: Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's Feelings of Separation from Kṛṣṇa

verses.devanagari: কৃষ্ণবিচ্ছেদবিভ্রান্ত্যা মনসা বপুষা ধিয়া ।\\nযদ্যদ্ব্যধত্ত গৌরাঙ্গস্তল্লেশঃ কথ্যতেঽধুনা ॥১॥
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇa-viccheda-vibhrāntyā\\nmanasā vapuṣā dhiyā\\nyad yad vyadhatta gaurāṅgas\\ntal-leśaḥ kathyate 'dhunā
verses.translation: I shall now describe a very small portion of the activities performed by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu with His mind, intelligence and body when He was bewildered by strong feelings of separation from Kṛṣṇa.

verses.devanagari: জয় জয় শ্রীচৈতন্য স্বয়ং ভগবান্ ।\\nজয় জয় গৌরচন্দ্র ভক্তগণ-প্রাণ ॥২॥
verses.transliteration: jaya jaya śrī-caitanya svayaṁ bhagavān\\njaya jaya gauracandra bhakta-gaṇa-prāṇa
verses.translation: All glories to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the Supreme Personality of Godhead! All glories to Lord Gauracandra, the life and soul of His devotees.

verses.devanagari: জয় জয় নিত্যানন্দ চৈতন্য-জীবন ।\\nজয়াদ্বৈতাচার্য জয় গৌরপ্রিয়তম ॥৩॥
verses.transliteration: jaya jaya nityānanda caitanya-jīvana\\njayādvaitācārya jaya gaura-priyatama
verses.translation: All glories to Lord Nityānanda, who is Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's very life. And all glories to Advaita Ācārya, who is extremely dear to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: জয় স্বরূপ, শ্রীবাসাদি প্রভুভক্তগণ ।\\nশক্তি দেহ’, — করি যেন চৈতন্যবর্ণন ॥৪॥
verses.transliteration: jaya svarūpa, śrīvāsādi prabhu-bhakta-gaṇa\\nśakti deha',—kari yena caitanya-varṇana
verses.translation: All glories to Svarūpa Dāmodara and the devotees, headed by Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura. Please give me the strength to describe the character of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: প্রভুর বিরহোন্মাদ-ভাব গম্ভীর ।\\nবুঝিতে না পারে কেহ, যদ্যপি হয় ‘ধীর’ ॥৫॥
verses.transliteration: prabhura virahonmāda-bhāva gambhīra\\nbujhite nā pāre keha, yadyapi haya 'dhīra'
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's emotion of transcendental madness of separation from Kṛṣṇa is very deep and mysterious. Even though one is very advanced and learned, he cannot understand it.

verses.devanagari: বুঝিতে না পারি যাহা, বর্ণিতে কে পারে ?\\nসেই বুঝে, বর্ণে, চৈতন্য শক্তি দেন যাঁরে ॥৬॥
verses.transliteration: bujhite nā pāri yāhā, varṇite ke pāre?\\nsei bujhe, varṇe, caitanya śakti dena yāṅre
verses.translation: How can one describe unfathomable subject matters? It is possible only if Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu gives him the capability.

verses.devanagari: স্বরূপ-গোসাঞি আর রঘুনাথ-দাস ।\\nএই দুইর কড়চাতে এ-লীলা প্রকাশ ॥৭॥
verses.transliteration: svarūpa-gosāñi āra raghunātha-dāsa\\nei duira kaḍacāte e-līlā prakāśa
verses.translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī and Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī recorded all these transcendental activities of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu in their notebooks.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's transcendental feelings of separation from Kṛṣṇa and His consequent madness are not at all understandable by a person on the material platform. Nonetheless, a so-called party of devotees named
nadīyā-nāgarī
has sprung up and introduced the worship of Viṣṇupriyā. This certainly indicates their ignorance concerning Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's pastimes. In the opinion of Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura, such worship is a product of the imagination. Many other methods of worshiping Caitanya Mahāprabhu have also been introduced, but they have all been rejected by stalwart devotees like Bhaktivinoda Ṭhākura. The groups practicing such unauthorized worship have been listed by Śrīla Bhaktivinoda Ṭhākura:
āula, bāula, kartābhajā, neḍā, daraveśa, sāṅi
sahajiyā, sakhībhekī, smārta, jāta-gosāñi
ativāḍī, cūḍādhārī, gaurāṅga-nāgarī
Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī and Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī witnessed Caitanya Mahāprabhu's activities firsthand, and they recorded them in two notebooks. Therefore, without reference to these notebooks, one cannot understand the activities of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Anyone inventing some new method for worshiping Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is certainly unable to understand the Lord's pastimes, for he is bereft of the real process of approaching the Lord.

verses.devanagari: সেকালে এ-দুই রহেন মহাপ্রভুর পাশে ।\\nআর সব কড়চা-কর্তা রহেন দূরদেশে ॥৮॥
verses.transliteration: se-kāle e-dui rahena mahāprabhura pāśe\\nāra saba kaḍacā-kartā rahena dūra-deśe
verses.translation: In those days, Svarūpa Dāmodara and Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī lived with Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, whereas all other commentators lived far away from Him.
verses.purport: PURPORT\nBesides Svarūpa Dāmodara and Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī, there were many others who also recorded Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's activities. Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura believes that the people of the world would benefit greatly if such notes were available. It is a most unfortunate situation for human society that none of these notebooks are still extant.

verses.devanagari: ক্ষণে ক্ষণে অনুভবি’ এই দুইজন ।\\nসংক্ষেপে বাহুল্যে করেন কড়চা-গ্রন্থন ॥৯॥
verses.transliteration: kṣaṇe kṣaṇe anubhavi' ei dui-jana\\nsaṅkṣepe bāhulye karena kaḍacā-granthana
verses.translation: These two great personalities [Svarūpa Dāmodara and Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī] recorded the activities of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu moment by moment. They described these activities briefly as well as elaborately in their notebooks.
verses.purport: PURPORT\nFor future reference, we should remember that Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī recorded the pastimes briefly, whereas Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī recorded them elaborately. These two great personalities simply recorded the facts; they did not create any descriptive literary embellishments.

verses.devanagari: স্বরূপ — ‘সূত্রকর্তা’, রঘুনাথ — ‘বৃত্তিকার’ ।\\nতার বাহুল্য বর্ণি — পাঁজি-টীকা-ব্যবহার ॥১০॥
verses.transliteration: svarūpa—'sūtra-kartā', raghunātha—'vṛttikāra'\\ntāra bāhulya varṇi—pāṅji-ṭīkā-vyavahāra
verses.translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara wrote short codes, whereas Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī wrote elaborate descriptions. I shall now describe Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's activities more elaborately, as if fluffing out compressed cotton.
verses.purport: PURPORT\nPāṅji-ṭīkā\nmeans further explanations of a subject. Writing such explanations is likened to the process of fluffing out cotton.

verses.devanagari: তাতে বিশ্বাস করি’ শুন ভাবের বর্ণন ।\\nহইবে ভাবের জ্ঞান, পাইবা প্রেমধন ॥১১॥
verses.transliteration: tāte viśvāsa kari' śuna bhāvera varṇana\\nha-ibe bhāvera jñāna, pāibā prema-dhana
verses.translation: Please hear faithfully this description of Caitanya Mahāprabhu's ecstatic emotions. Thus you will come to know of His ecstatic love, and ultimately you will achieve love of Godhead.

verses.devanagari: কৃষ্ণ মথুরায় গেলে, গোপীর যে দশা হৈল ।\\nকৃষ্ণবিচ্ছেদে প্রভুর সে দশা উপজিল ॥১২॥
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇa mathurāya gele, gopīra ye daśā haila\\nkṛṣṇa-vicchede prabhura se daśā upajila
verses.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu felt separation from Kṛṣṇa, His condition exactly corresponded to the condition of the gopīs in Vṛndāvana after Kṛṣṇa's departure for Mathurā.

verses.devanagari: উদ্ধব-দর্শনে যৈছে রাধার বিলাপ ।\\nক্রমে ক্রমে হৈল প্রভুর সে উন্মাদ-বিলাপ ॥১৩॥
verses.transliteration: uddhava-darśane yaiche rādhāra vilāpa\\nkrame krame haila prabhura se unmāda-vilāpa
verses.translation: The lamentation of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī when Uddhava visited Vṛndāvana gradually became a feature of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's transcendental madness.

verses.devanagari: রাধিকার ভাবে প্রভুর সদা ‘অভিমান’ ।\\nসেই ভাবে আপনাকে হয় ‘রাধা’-জ্ঞান ॥১৪॥
verses.transliteration: rādhikāra bhāve prabhura sadā 'abhimāna'\\nsei bhāve āpanāke haya 'rādhā'-jñāna
verses.translation: Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī's emotions after seeing Uddhava exactly correspond to those of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. He always conceived of Himself in Her position and sometimes thought that He was Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī Herself.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura explains that the purport of the word
abhimāna,
or "self-conception," is that Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu thought Himself to be in the position of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī and was always ready to render service in that way. Although Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is Kṛṣṇa Himself, He assumed the complexion and emotions of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī and remained in that status. He never assumed the complexion or status of Lord Kṛṣṇa. Of course, Kṛṣṇa wanted to experience the role of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī; that is the original cause of His assuming the body of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Therefore pure Vaiṣṇavas never disturb Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's conception of being Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī.
Unfortunately, at the present time a group of so-called devotees maintain that Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is the enjoyer and that they are enjoyers as well. They have actually deviated from devotional service to the Lord. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu manifested Himself to show that cultivation of love for Kṛṣṇa in separation is the easiest way of success for all living entities. Despite this fact, there are some theosophists who declare that because Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is the Supreme Personality of Godhead, such cultivation is easy for Him but difficult for the living entity and that one can therefore approach Kṛṣṇa in any way he likes. To nullify this idea, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu demonstrated practically how one can achieve love of Kṛṣṇa by adopting Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī's mood in separation from Kṛṣṇa.

verses.devanagari: দিব্যোন্মাদে ঐছে হয়, কি ইহা বিস্ময় ?\\nঅধিরূঢ়-ভাবে দিব্যোন্মাদ-প্রলাপ হয় ॥১৫॥
verses.transliteration: divyonmāde aiche haya, ki ihā vismaya?\\nadhirūḍha-bhāve divyonmāda-pralāpa haya
verses.translation: Such is the state of transcendental madness. Why is it difficult to understand? When one is highly elevated in love of Kṛṣṇa, he becomes transcendentally mad and talks like a madman.

verses.devanagari: এতস্য মোহনাখ্যস্য গতিং কামপ্যুপেয়ুষঃ ।\\nভ্রমাভা কাপি বৈচিত্রী দিব্যোন্মাদ ইতীর্যতে ।\\nউদ্ঘূর্ণা-চিত্রজল্পাদ্যাস্তদ্ভেদা বহবৌ মতাঃ ॥১৬॥
verses.transliteration: etasya mohanākhyasya\\ngatiṁ kāmapy upeyuṣaḥ\\nbhramābhā kāpi vaicitrī\\ndivyonmāda itīryate\\nudghūrṇā-citra-jalpādyās\\ntad-bhedā bahavo matāḥ
verses.translation: "When the ecstatic emotion of enchantment gradually progresses, it becomes similar to bewilderment. Then one reaches the stage of astonishment [vaicitrī], which awakens transcendental madness. Udghūrṇā and citra-jalpa are two among the many divisions of transcendental madness."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This is a quotation from the
Ujjvala-nīlamaṇi
(
Sthāyibhāva-prakaraṇa
190).

verses.devanagari: একদিন মহাপ্রভু করিয়াছেন শয়ন ।\\nকৃষ্ণ রাসলীলা করে, — দেখিলা স্বপন ॥১৭॥
verses.transliteration: eka-dina mahāprabhu kariyāchena śayana\\nkṛṣṇa rāsa-līlā kare,—dekhilā svapana
verses.translation: One day while He was resting, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu dreamed He saw Kṛṣṇa performing His rāsa dance.

verses.devanagari: ত্রিভঙ্গ-সুন্দর-দেহ, মুরলীবদন ।\\nপীতাম্বর, বনমালা, মদনমোহন ॥১৮॥
verses.transliteration: tribhaṅga-sundara-deha, muralī-vadana\\npītāmbara, vana-mālā, madana-mohana
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu saw Lord Kṛṣṇa standing with His beautiful body curved in three places, holding His flute to His lips. Wearing yellow garments and garlands of forest flowers, He was enchanting even to Cupid.

verses.devanagari: মণ্ডলীবন্ধে গোপীগণ করেন নর্তন ।\\nমধ্যে রাধা-সহ নাচে ব্রজেন্দ্রনন্দন ॥১৯॥
verses.transliteration: maṇḍalī-bandhe gopī-gaṇa karena nartana\\nmadhye rādhā-saha nāce vrajendra-nandana
verses.translation: The gopīs were dancing in a circle, and in the middle of that circle, Kṛṣṇa, the son of Mahārāja Nanda, danced with Rādhārāṇī.

verses.devanagari: দেখি’ প্রভু সেই রসে আবিষ্ট হৈলা ।\\n‘বৃন্দাবনে কৃষ্ণ পাইনু’ — এই জ্ঞান কৈলা ॥২০॥
verses.transliteration: dekhi' prabhu sei rase āviṣṭa hailā\\n'vṛndāvane kṛṣṇa pāinu'—ei jñāna kailā
verses.translation: Seeing this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was overwhelmed with the transcendental mellow of the rāsa dance, and He thought, "Now I am with Kṛṣṇa in Vṛndāvana."

verses.devanagari: প্রভুর বিলম্ব দেখি’ গোবিন্দ জাগাইলা ।\\nজাগিলে ‘স্বপ্ন’-জ্ঞান হৈল, প্রভু দুঃখী হৈলা ॥২১॥
verses.transliteration: prabhura vilamba dekhi' govinda jāgāilā\\njāgile 'svapna'-jñāna haila, prabhu duḥkhī hailā
verses.translation: When Govinda saw that the Lord had not yet risen, he awakened Him. Understanding that He had only been dreaming, the Lord was somewhat unhappy.

verses.devanagari: দেহাভ্যাসে নিত্যকৃত্য করি’ সমাপন ।\\nকালে যাই’ কৈলা জগন্নাথ দরশন ॥২২॥
verses.transliteration: dehābhyāse nitya-kṛtya kari' samāpana\\nkāle yāi' kailā jagannātha daraśana
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu performed His customary daily duties, and at the usual time He went to see Lord Jagannātha in the temple.

verses.devanagari: যাবৎ কাল দর্শন করেন গরুড়ের পাছে ।\\nপ্রভুর আগে দর্শন করে লোক লাখে লাখে ॥২৩॥
verses.transliteration: yāvat kāla darśana karena garuḍera pāche\\nprabhura āge darśana kare loka lākhe lākhe
verses.translation: As He viewed Lord Jagannātha from behind the Garuḍa column, hundreds and thousands of people in front of Him were seeing the Deity.

verses.devanagari: উড়িয়া এক স্ত্রী ভীড়ে দর্শন না পাঞা ।\\nগরুড়ে চড়ি’ দেখে প্রভুর স্কন্ধে পদ দিয়া ॥২৪॥
verses.transliteration: uḍiyā eka strī bhīḍe darśana nā pāñā\\ngaruḍe caḍi' dekhe prabhura skandhe pada diyā
verses.translation: Suddenly, a woman from Orissa, unable to see Lord Jagannātha because of the crowd, climbed the column of Garuḍa, placing her foot on Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's shoulder.

verses.devanagari: দেখিয়া গোবিন্দ আস্তে-ব্যস্তে স্ত্রীকে বর্জিলা ।\\nতারে নামাইতে প্রভু গোবিন্দে নিষেধিলা ॥২৫॥
verses.transliteration: dekhiyā govinda āste-vyaste strīke varjilā\\ntāre nāmāite prabhu govinde niṣedhilā
verses.translation: When he saw this, Caitanya Mahāprabhu's personal secretary, Govinda, hastily got her down from her position. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, however, chastised him for this.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Because Garuḍa is the carrier of Lord Viṣṇu, he is the supreme Vaiṣṇava. Therefore to touch his body with one's feet or to climb the column of Garuḍa is certainly a
vaiṣṇava-aparādha,
an offense to a Vaiṣṇava. The woman was also offensive to Kṛṣṇa by putting her foot on the shoulder of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Seeing all these offenses, Govinda very hastily made her get down.

verses.devanagari: ‘আদিবস্যা’ এই স্ত্রীরে না কর বর্জন ।\\nকরুক যথেষ্ট জগন্নাথ দরশন ॥২৬॥
verses.transliteration: 'ādi-vasyā' ei strīre nā kara varjana\\nkaruka yatheṣṭa jagannātha daraśana
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said to Govinda, "O ādi-vasyā [uncivilized man], do not forbid this woman to climb the Garuḍa-stambha. Let her see Lord Jagannātha to her satisfaction."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
For an explanation of the word
ādi-vasyā,
refer to
Antya-līlā,
Chapter Ten, verse 116.

verses.devanagari: আস্তে-ব্যস্তে সেই নারী ভূমেতে নামিলা ।\\nমহাপ্রভুরে দেখি’ তাঁর চরণ বন্দিলা ॥২৭॥
verses.transliteration: āste-vyaste sei nārī bhūmete nāmilā\\nmahāprabhure dekhi' tāṅra caraṇa vandilā
verses.translation: When the woman came to her senses, however, she quickly climbed back down to the ground and, seeing Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, immediately begged at His lotus feet for forgiveness.

verses.devanagari: তার আর্তি দেখি’ প্রভু কহিতে লাগিলা ।\\n“এত আর্তি জগন্নাথ মোরে নাহি দিলা ! ॥ ২৮ ॥
verses.transliteration: tāra ārti dekhi' prabhu kahite lāgilā\\n"eta ārti jagannātha more nāhi dilā!
verses.translation: Seeing the woman's eagerness, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "Lord Jagannātha has not bestowed so much eagerness upon Me.
verses.purport: PURPORT\nThe woman was so eager to see Lord Jagannātha that she forgot she was offending the feet of a Vaiṣṇava by climbing the column of Garuḍa. She also neglected to consider that by putting her foot on the shoulder of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, she offended the Supreme Personality of Godhead. These are both grievous offenses that displease the Supreme Lord and Vaiṣṇavas. She was so eager to see Lord Jagannātha, however, that she committed all these offenses obliviously. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu praised her eagerness; He regretted that Lord Jagannātha had not bestowed such great eagerness upon Him.

verses.devanagari: জগন্নাথে আবিষ্ট ইহার তনু-মন-প্রাণে ।\\nমোর স্কন্ধে পদ দিয়াছে, তাহা নাহি জানে ॥২৯॥
verses.transliteration: jagannāthe āviṣṭa ihāra tanu-mana-prāṇe\\nmora skandhe pada diyāche, tāho nāhi jāne
verses.translation: "She has fully absorbed her body, mind and life in Lord Jagannātha. Therefore she was unaware that she was putting her foot on My shoulder.

verses.devanagari: অহো ভাগ্যবতী এই, বন্দি ইহার পায় ।\\nইহার প্রসাদে ঐছে আর্তি আমার বা হয়” ! ॥ ৩০ ॥
verses.transliteration: aho bhāgyavatī ei, vandi ihāra pāya\\nihāra prasāde aiche ārti āmāra vā haya"
verses.translation: "Alas! How fortunate this woman is! I pray at her feet that she favor Me with her great eagerness to see Lord Jagannātha."

verses.devanagari: পূর্বে আসি’ যবে কৈলা জগন্নাথ দরশন ।\\nজগন্নাথে দেখে — সাক্ষাৎ ব্রজেন্দ্রনন্দন ॥৩১॥
verses.transliteration: pūrve āsi' yabe kailā jagannātha daraśana\\njagannāthe dekhe—sākṣāt vrajendra-nandana
verses.translation: Just previously, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had been seeing Lord Jagannātha as the son of Mahārāja Nanda, Kṛṣṇa, in person.

verses.devanagari: স্বপ্নের দর্শনাবেশে তদ্রূপ হৈল মন ।\\nযাহাঁ তাহাঁ দেখে সর্বত্র মুরলী-বদন ॥৩২॥
verses.transliteration: svapnera darśanāveśe tad-rūpa haila mana\\nyāhāṅ tāhāṅ dekhe sarvatra muralī-vadana
verses.translation: Becoming fully absorbed in that vision, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had assumed the mood of the gopīs, so much so that everywhere He looked He saw Kṛṣṇa standing with His flute to His lips.

verses.devanagari: এবে যদি স্ত্রীরে দেখি’ প্রভুর বাহ্য হৈল ।\\nজগন্নাথ-সুভদ্রা-বলরামের স্বরূপ দেখিল ॥৩৩॥
verses.transliteration: ebe yadi strīre dekhi' prabhura bāhya haila\\njagannātha-subhadrā-balarāmera svarūpa dekhila
verses.translation: After seeing the woman, the Lord's external consciousness returned, and He saw the original Deity forms of Lord Jagannātha, Subhadrā and Lord Balarāma.

verses.devanagari: কুরুক্ষেত্রে দেখি’ কৃষ্ণে ঐছে হৈল মন ।\\n‘কাহাঁ কুরুক্ষেত্রে আইলাঙ, কাহাঁ বৃন্দাবন ?’ ॥ ৩৪ ॥
verses.transliteration: kurukṣetre dekhi' kṛṣṇe aiche haila mana\\n'kāhāṅ kurukṣetre āilāṅa, kāhāṅ vṛndāvana'
verses.translation: When He saw the Deities, Lord Caitanya thought He was seeing Kṛṣṇa in Kurukṣetra. He wondered, "Have I come to Kurukṣetra? Where is Vṛndāvana?"

verses.devanagari: প্রাপ্তরত্ন হারাঞা ঐছে ব্যগ্র হইলা ।\\nবিষণ্ণ হঞা প্রভু নিজ-বাসা আইলা ॥৩৫॥
verses.transliteration: prāpta-ratna hārāñā aiche vyagra ha-ilā\\nviṣaṇṇa hañā prabhu nija-vāsā āilā
verses.translation: Lord Caitanya grew very agitated, like a person who has just lost a recently acquired jewel. Then He became very morose and returned home.

verses.devanagari: ভূমির উপর বসি’ নিজ-নখে ভূমি লিখে ।\\nঅশ্রু-গঙ্গা নেত্রে বহে, কিছুই না দেখে ॥৩৬॥
verses.transliteration: bhūmira upara vasi' nija-nakhe bhūmi likhe\\naśru-gaṅgā netre vahe, kichui nā dekhe
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu sat down on the ground and began to mark it with His nails. He was blinded by tears, which flowed from His eyes like the Ganges.

verses.devanagari: ‘পাইলুঁ বৃন্দাবননাথ, পুনঃ হারাইলুঁ ।\\nকে মোর নিলেক কৃষ্ণ? কাহাঁ মুই আইনু’ ? ॥ ৩৭ ॥
verses.transliteration: 'pāiluṅ vṛndāvana-nātha, punaḥ hārāiluṅ\\nke mora nileka kṛṣṇa? kāhāṅ mui āinu'?
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "I found Kṛṣṇa, the Lord of Vṛndāvana, but I have lost Him again. Who has taken My Kṛṣṇa? Where have I come?"
verses.purport:
PURPORT
These are the feelings of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī. First Lord Caitanya felt that He had been taken to Vṛndāvana, where He saw Kṛṣṇa's
rāsa
dance with the
gopīs.
Then He was brought to Kurukṣetra to see Lord Jagannātha, His sister (Subhadrā) and Lord Balarāma. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu lost Vṛndāvana and Kṛṣṇa, the master of Vṛndāvana. At this time, Caitanya Mahāprabhu experienced
divyonmāda,
transcendental madness in separation from Kṛṣṇa. At Kurukṣetra, Kṛṣṇa displays His opulence, whereas in Vṛndāvana He is in His original position. Kṛṣṇa never goes even a step away from Vṛndāvana; therefore Kurukṣetra is less important for the
gopīs
than Vṛndāvana.
Although devotees who worship Kṛṣṇa in opulence (His Vaikuṇṭha aspect) may prefer to see Lord Kṛṣṇa at Kurukṣetra along with Subhadrā and Balarāma, the
gopīs
want to see Kṛṣṇa in Vṛndāvana, performing the
rāsa
dance with Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu showed by practical example how one can cultivate the mood of Rādhārāṇī and the other
gopīs
in separation from Kṛṣṇa. Devotees absorbed in this mood do not like to see Kṛṣṇa anywhere else but Vṛndāvana. Therefore Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu lamented, "I found Kṛṣṇa in Vṛndāvana, and now I have again lost Him and come to Kurukṣetra." Unless one is a very highly advanced devotee, he cannot understand these intricate feelings. The author of
Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta,
however, has tried to explain this
divyonmāda
as far as possible, and it is our duty simply to appreciate it as far as possible. Therefore the author has made the following request in verse 11:
tāte viśvāsa kari' śuna bhāvera varṇana
ha-ibe bhāvera jñāna, pāibā prema-dhana
"My dear readers, simply try to hear this description with faith and love. That will help you to understand transcendental ecstasy, and at last you will achieve love of Godhead very easily."

verses.devanagari: স্বপ্নাবেশে প্রেমে প্রভুর গর গর মন ।\\nবাহ্য হৈলে হয় — যেন হারাইল ধন ॥৩৮॥
verses.transliteration: svapnāveśe preme prabhura gara gara mana\\nbāhya haile haya—yena hārāila dhana
verses.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu dreamed of the rāsa dance, He was fully absorbed in transcendental bliss, but when His dream broke, He thought He had lost a precious jewel.

verses.devanagari: উন্মত্তের প্রায় প্রভু করেন গান-নৃত্য ।\\nদেহের স্বভাবে করেন স্নান-ভোজন-কৃত্য ॥৩৯॥
verses.transliteration: unmattera prāya prabhu karena gāna-nṛtya\\ndehera svabhāve karena snāna-bhojana-kṛtya
verses.translation: Thus Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would chant and dance, always absorbed in the bliss of transcendental madness. He carried out the necessities of the body, such as eating and bathing, merely out of habit.

verses.devanagari: রাত্রি হৈলে স্বরূপ-রামানন্দে লঞা ।\\nআপন মনের ভাব কহে উঘাড়িয়া ॥৪০॥
verses.transliteration: rātri haile svarūpa-rāmānande lañā\\nāpana manera bhāva kahe ughāḍiyā
verses.translation: At night, Lord Caitanya would reveal to Svarūpa Dāmodara and Rāmānanda Rāya the ecstatic feelings of His mind.

verses.devanagari: প্রাপ্তপ্রণষ্টাচ্যুতবিত্ত আত্মা\\nযযৌ বিষাদোজ্ঝিত-দেহগেহঃ ।\\nগৃহীতকাপালিকধর্মকো মে\\nবৃন্দাবনং সেন্দ্রিয়শিষ্যবৃন্দঃ ॥৪১॥
verses.transliteration: prāpta-praṇaṣṭācyuta-vitta ātmā\\nyayau viṣādojjhita-deha-gehaḥ\\ngṛhīta-kāpālika-dharmako me\\nvṛndāvanaṁ sendriya-śiṣya-vṛndaḥ
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "At first My mind somehow achieved the treasure of Kṛṣṇa, but it again lost Him. Therefore it gave up My body and home because of lamentation and accepted the religious principles of a kāpālika-yogī. Then My mind went to Vṛndāvana with its disciples, My senses.,"
verses.purport: PURPORT\nThis verse is clearly metaphorical.

verses.devanagari: প্রাপ্তরত্ন হারাঞা, তার গুণ সঙরিয়া,\\nমহাপ্রভু সন্তাপে বিহ্বল ।\\nরায় স্বরূপের কণ্ঠ ধরি’, কহে ‘হাহা হরি হরি’,\\nধৈর্য গেল, হইলা চপল ॥৪২॥
verses.transliteration: prāpta-ratna hārāñā, tāra guṇa saṅariyā,\\nmahāprabhu santāpe vihvala\\nrāya-svarūpera kaṇṭha dhari', kahe 'hāhā hari hari',\\ndhairya gela, ha-ilā capala
verses.translation: Having lost His acquired gem, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu became overwhelmed with lamentation by remembering its attributes. Then, grasping the necks of Rāmānanda Rāya and Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī, He cried, "Alas, where is My Lord Hari? Where is Hari?" Finally He became restless and lost all patience.

verses.devanagari: “শুন, বান্ধব, কৃষ্ণের মাধুরী ।\\nযার লোভে মোর মন, ছাড়ি’ লোক-বেদধর্ম,\\nযোগী হঞা হইল ভিখারী ।। ৪৩ ।। ধ্রু ।। ॥৪৩॥
verses.transliteration: "śuna, bāndhava, kṛṣṇera mādhurī\\nyāra lobhe mora mana, chāḍi' loka-veda-dharma,\\nyogī hañā ha-ila bhikhārī
verses.translation: "My dear friends," He said, "please hear of Kṛṣṇa's sweetness. Because of a great desire for that sweetness, My mind has given up all social and Vedic religious principles and taken to the profession of begging, exactly like a mystic yogī.

verses.devanagari: কৃষ্ণলীলা-মণ্ডল, শুদ্ধ শঙ্খকুণ্ডল,\\nগড়িয়াছে শুক কারিকর ।\\nসেই কুণ্ডল কাণে পরি’, তৃষ্ণা-লাউ-থালী ধরি’,\\nআশা-ঝুলি কান্ধের উপর ॥৪৪॥
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇa-līlā-maṇḍala, śuddha śaṅkha-kuṇḍala,\\ngaḍiyāche śuka kārikara\\nsei kuṇḍala kāṇe pari', tṛṣṇā-lāu-thālī dhari',\\nāśā-jhuli kāndhera upara
verses.translation: "The ring of Kṛṣṇa's rāsa-līlā, manufactured by Śukadeva Gosvāmī, the most auspicious craftsman, is as pure as an earring made from a conchshell. The yogī of My mind is wearing that earring upon his ear. From a gourd he has carved out the bowl of My aspirations, and he has taken the bag of My expectations on his shoulder.

verses.devanagari: চিন্তা-কান্থা উঢ়ি গায়, ধূলি-বিভূতি-মলিন-কায়,\\n‘হাহা কৃষ্ণ’ প্রলাপ-উত্তর ।\\nউদ্বেগ দ্বাদশ হাতে, লোভের ঝুলনি মাথে,\\nভিক্ষাভাবে ক্ষীণ কলেবর ॥৪৫॥
verses.transliteration: cintā-kānthā uḍhi gāya, dhūli-vibhūti-malina-kāya,\\n'hāhā kṛṣṇa' pralāpa-uttara\\nudvega dvādaśa hāte, lobhera jhulani māthe,\\nbhikṣābhāve kṣīṇa kalevara
verses.translation: "The yogī of My mind wears the torn quilt of anxiety on his dirty body, which is covered with dust and ashes. His only words are,'Alas! Kṛṣṇa!' He wears twelve bangles of distress on his wrist and a turban of greed on his head. Because he has not eaten anything, he is very thin.

verses.devanagari: ব্যাস, শুকাদি যোগিগণ, কৃষ্ণ আত্মা নিরঞ্জন,\\nব্রজে তাঁর যত লীলাগণ ।\\nভাগবতাদি শাস্ত্রগণে, করিয়াছে বর্ণনে,\\nসেই তর্জা পড়ে অনুক্ষণ ॥৪৬॥
verses.transliteration: vyāsa, śukādi yogi-gaṇa, kṛṣṇa ātmā nirañjana,\\nvraje tāṅra yata līlā-gaṇa\\nbhāgavatādi śāstra-gaṇe, kariyāche varṇane,\\nsei tarjā paḍe anukṣaṇa
verses.translation: "The great yogī of My mind always studies the poetry and discussions of Lord Kṛṣṇa's Vṛndāvana pastimes. In the Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam and other scriptures, great saintly yogīs like Vyāsadeva and Śukadeva Gosvāmī have described Lord Kṛṣṇa as the Supersoul, beyond all material contamination.

verses.devanagari: দশেন্দ্রিয়ে শিষ্য করি’, ‘মহা-বাউল’ নাম ধরি’,\\nশিষ্য লঞা করিল গমন ।\\nমোর দেহ স্ব-সদন, বিষয়-ভোগ মহাধন,\\nসব ছাড়ি’ গেলা বৃন্দাবন ॥৪৭॥
verses.transliteration: daśendriye śiṣya kari', 'mahā-bāula' nāma dhari',\\nśiṣya lañā karila gamana\\nmora deha sva-sadana, viṣaya-bhoga mahā-dhana,\\nsaba chāḍi' gelā vṛndāvana
verses.translation: "The mystic yogī of My mind has assumed the name Mahābāula and made disciples of My ten senses. Thus My mind has gone to Vṛndāvana, leaving aside the home of My body and the great treasure of material enjoyment.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu compares His mind to one of the mystic
yogīs
known as
bāula,
who makes at least ten disciples.

verses.devanagari: বৃন্দাবনে প্রজাগণ, যত স্থাবর-জঙ্গম,\\nবৃক্ষ-লতা গৃহস্থ-আশ্রমে ।\\nতার ঘরে ভিক্ষাটন, ফল-মূল-পত্রাশন,\\nএই বৃত্তি করে শিষ্যসনে ॥৪৮॥
verses.transliteration: vṛndāvane prajā-gaṇa, yata sthāvara-jaṅgama,\\nvṛkṣa-latā gṛhastha-āśrame\\ntāra ghare bhikṣāṭana, phala-mūla-patrāśana,\\nei vṛtti kare śiṣya-sane
verses.translation: "In Vṛndāvana, he goes from door to door begging alms with all his disciples. He begs from both the moving and the inert inhabitants—the citizens, the trees and the creepers. In this way he lives on fruits, roots and leaves.

verses.devanagari: কৃষ্ণ-গুণ-রূপ-রস, গন্ধ, শব্দ, পরশ,\\nসে সুধা আস্বাদে গোপীগণ ।\\nতা-সবার গ্রাস-শেষে, আনি’ পঞ্চেন্দ্রিয় শিষ্যে,\\nসে ভিক্ষায় রাখেন জীবন ॥৪৯॥
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇa-guṇa-rūpa-rasa, gandha, śabda, paraśa,\\nse sudhā āsvāde gopī-gaṇa\\ntā-sabāra grāsa-śeṣe, āni' pañcendriya śiṣye,\\nse bhikṣāya rākhena jīvana
verses.translation: "The gopīs of Vrajabhūmi always taste the nectar of Kṛṣṇa's attributes, His beauty, His sweetness, His aroma, the sound of His flute and the touch of His body. My mind's five disciples, the senses of perception, gather the remnants of that nectar from the gopīs and bring them to the yogī of My mind. The senses maintain their lives by eating those remnants.

verses.devanagari: শূন্যকুঞ্জমণ্ডপ-কোণে, যোগাভ্যাস কৃষ্ণধ্যানে,\\nতাহাঁ রহে লঞা শিষ্যগণ ।\\nকৃষ্ণ আত্মা নিরঞ্জন, সাক্ষাৎ দেখিতে মন,\\nধ্যানে রাত্রি করে জাগরণ ॥৫০॥
verses.transliteration: śūnya-kuñja-maṇḍapa-koṇe, yogābhyāsa kṛṣṇa-dhyāne,\\ntāhāṅ rahe lañā śiṣya-gaṇa\\nkṛṣṇa ātmā nirañjana, sākṣāt dekhite mana,\\ndhyāne rātri kare jāgaraṇa
verses.translation: "There is a solitary garden where Kṛṣṇa enjoys His pastimes, and in one corner of a pavilion in that garden, the yogī of My mind, along with his disciples, practices mystic yoga. Wanting to see Kṛṣṇa directly, this yogī remains awake throughout the night, meditating on Kṛṣṇa who is the Supersoul, uncontaminated by the three modes of nature.

verses.devanagari: মন কৃষ্ণবিয়োগী, দুঃখে মন হৈল যোগী,\\nসে বিয়োগে দশ দশা হয় ।\\nসে দশায় ব্যাকুল হঞা, মন গেল পলাঞা,\\nশূন্য মোর শরীর আলয় ।।” ॥ ৫১ ॥
verses.transliteration: mana kṛṣṇa-viyogī, duḥkhe mana haila yogī,\\nse viyoge daśa daśā haya\\nse daśāya vyākula hañā, mana gela palāñā,\\nśūnya mora śarīra ālaya"
verses.translation: "When My mind lost the association of Kṛṣṇa and could no longer see Him, he became depressed and took up mystic yoga. In the void of separation from Kṛṣṇa, he experienced ten transcendental transformations. Agitated by these transformations, My mind fled, leaving My body, his place of residence, empty. Thus I am completely in trance."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
In this verse, the outward activities of the
kāpālika
mendicants have been described, but not their actual life. The
kāpālika
mendicants are tantric materialists who carry skulls in their hands. They are not Vaiṣṇavas and have nothing to do with spiritual life. Therefore they are untouchable. Only an outward comparison has been made between the mind and their activities, but their behavior should never be imitated.

verses.devanagari: কৃষ্ণের বিয়োগে গোপীর দশ দশা হয় ।\\nসেই দশ দশা হয় প্রভুর উদয় ॥৫২॥
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇera viyoge gopīra daśa daśā haya\\nsei daśa daśā haya prabhura udaya
verses.translation: When the gopīs felt separation from Kṛṣṇa, they experienced ten kinds of bodily transformations. These same symptoms appeared on the body of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: চিন্তাত্র জাগরোদ্বেগৌ তানবং মলিনাঙ্গতা ।\\nপ্রলাপো ব্যাধিরুন্মাদো মোহো মৃত্যুর্দশা দশ ॥৫৩॥
verses.transliteration: cintātra jāgarodvegau\\ntānavaṁ malināṅgatā\\npralāpo vyādhir unmādo\\nmoho mṛtyur daśā daśa
verses.translation: "The ten bodily transformations resulting from separation from Kṛṣṇa are anxiety, wakefulness, mental agitation, thinness, uncleanliness, talking like a madman, disease, madness, illusion and death."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This verse is part of a description of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī's different traits from
Ujjvala-nīlamaṇi
by Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī. In this book, he elaborately explains the ten symptoms as follows.
Cintā. As stated in the
Haṁsadūta:
yadā yāto gopī-hṛdaya-madano nanda-sadanān
mukundo gāndinyās tanayam anurundhan madhu-purīm
tadāmāṅkṣīc cintā-sariti ghana-ghūrṇāparicayair
agādhāyāṁ vādhāmaya-payasi rādhā virahiṇī
"At the request of Akrūra, Kṛṣṇa and Balarāma left the house of Nanda Mahārāja for Mathurā. At that time, Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī's mind was disrupted, and She became almost mad because of extreme separation from Kṛṣṇa. She experienced great mental pain and agitation, which caused Her to drown in mental speculation in the river of anxiety. She thought, 'Now I am going to die, and when I die, Kṛṣṇa will surely come back to see Me again. But when He hears of My death from the people of Vṛndāvana, He will certainly be very unhappy. Therefore I shall not die.' " This is the explanation of the word
cintā.
Jāgara. As stated in the
Padyāvalī:
yāḥ paśyanti priyaṁ svapne
dhanyāstāḥ sakhi yoṣitaḥ
asmākaṁ tu gate kṛṣṇe
gatā nidrāpi vairiṇī
Thinking Herself very unfortunate, Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī addressed Her very dear friend Viśākhā, "My dear friend, if I could see Kṛṣṇa in My dreams, I would certainly be glorified for My great fortune. But what can I do? Sleep also plays mischievously with Me. Indeed, it has become My enemy. Therefore I have not slept since the departure of Kṛṣṇa."
Udvega. This word is also explained in the
Haṁsadūta
as follows:
mana me hā kaṣṭaṁ jvalati kim ahaṁ hanta karavai
na pāraṁ nāvāraṁ sumukhi kalayām yasya jaladheḥ
iyaṁ vande mūrdhnā sapadi tam upāyaṁ kathaya me
parāmṛśye yasmād dhṛti-kaṇikayāpi kṣaṇi-kayā
Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī addressed Lalitā, "My dear beautiful-faced Lalitā, I cannot express how My heart is burning. It is a great, unfathomable ocean of anxiety. Still, I wish to offer My obeisances at your lotus feet. What shall I do? Please consider My condition and advise Me how I can become peaceful. That is My desire."
Tānava is described as follows:
udañcad-vaktrāmbhoruha-vikṛtir antaḥ-kulaṣitā
sadāhārābhāva-glapita-kucakokā yadu-pate
viśuṣyanti rādhā tava viraha-tāpād anudinaṁ
nidāghe kuly eva kraśima-paripākaṁ prathayati
When Uddhava returned to Mathurā after visiting Vṛndāvana, Lord Kṛṣṇa inquired from him about Rādhārāṇī and Viśākhā. Uddhava replied as follows: "Consider the condition of the
gopīs!
Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī especially is in a very painful condition because of separation from You. She has grown skinny, and Her bodily luster is almost gone. Her heart is immersed in pain, and because She has given up eating, Her breast has become black, as if diseased. Because of separation from You, all the
gopīs,
especially Rādhārāṇī, appear like dried-up water holes under the scorching heat of the sun."
Malina-aṅgatā is described as follows:
hima-visara-viśīrṇāmbhoja-tulyānana-śrīḥ
khara-marud-aparajyad-bandhu-jīvopamauṣṭhī
agha-hara śarad-arkottāpitendīvarākṣī
tava viraha-vipatti-mlāpitāsīd viśākhā
Uddhava said to Kṛṣṇa, "O most auspicious Kṛṣṇa, please hear me. The tribulation caused by Your absence has made Viśākhā languid. Her lips tremble like trees in a strong wind. Her beautiful face is like a lotus flower that has withered under the snow, and Her eyes are like lotus petals scorched by the heat of the autumn sun."
Pralāpa is explained in
Lalita-mādhava
as follows:
kva nanda-kula-candramāḥ kva śikhi-candra-kālaṅkṛtiḥ
kva manda-muralī-ravaḥ kva nu surendra-nīla-dyutiḥ
kva rāsa-rasa-tāṇḍavī kva sakhi jīva-rakṣauṣadhir
nidhir mama suhṛttamaḥ kva tava hanta hā dhig-vidhiḥ
This is Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī's lamentation for Her beloved Kṛṣṇa, who was away from home. A woman whose husband has left home and gone to a foreign land is called
proṣita-bhartṛkā.
Lamenting for Kṛṣṇa in the same way as such a woman laments for her husband, Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī said, "My dear friend, where is the glory of the family of Mahārāja Nanda, who wears a half-moon ornament on His head? Where is Kṛṣṇa, whose hue is like that of the
indranīla
jewel and who plays so nicely on His flute? Where is your friend, the best of all men, so expert in dancing in the circle of the
rāsa
dance? Where is He who is the real medicine to save Me from dying of heart disease? I must condemn Providence, for he has caused Me so many tribulations by separating Me from Kṛṣṇa."
Vyādhi is also described in
Lalita-mādhava:
uttāpī puṭa-pākato 'pi garala-grāmād api kṣobhaṇo
dambholer api duḥsahaḥ kaṭur alaṁ hṛn-magna-śūlyād api
tīvraḥ prauḍha-visūcikāni-cayato 'py uccair mamāyaṁ balī
marmāṇy adya bhinatti gokula-pater viśleṣa-janmā jvaraḥ
Being greatly afflicted by the pain of separation from Kṛṣṇa, Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī said, "My dear Lalitā, kindly hear Me. I cannot bear suffering the fever of separation from Kṛṣṇa, nor can I explain it to you. It is something like gold melting in an earthen box. This fever produces more distress than poison, and it is more piercing than a thunderbolt. I suffer exactly like someone almost dead from cholera. To be giving Me so much pain, this fever must be very strong indeed."
Unmāda is explained as follows:
bhramati bhavana-garbhe nirnimittaṁ hasantī
prathayati tava vārtāṁ cetanācetaneṣu
lutḥati ca bhuvi rādhā kampitāṅgī murāre
viṣama-viraha-khedodgāri-vibhrānta-cittā
Uddhava said to Kṛṣṇa, "My dear Kṛṣṇa, all the
gopīs
are so afflicted by Your absence that they have become almost mad. O Murāri, at home Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī laughs unnecessarily and, like a madwoman, inquires about You from every entity without distinction, even from the stones. She rolls on the ground, unable to bear the agony of Your absence."
Moha is explained as follows:
nirundhe dainyābdhiṁ harati guru-cintā paribhavaṁ
vilumpaty unmādaṁ sthagayati balād bāṣpa-laharīm
idānīṁ kaṁsāre kuvalaya-dṛśaḥ kevalam idaṁ
vidhatte sācivyaṁ tava viraha-mūrcchā-sahacarī
Lalitā wrote Kṛṣṇa the following letter on Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī's behalf: "My dear Kṛṣṇa, separation from You has greatly agitated Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī's mind, and She has fallen unconscious on the ground. O enemy of Kaṁsa, You have now become a first-class politician, and therefore You can supposedly give relief to everyone. Therefore please consider the plight of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī, or very soon You will hear of Her death. Maybe at that time You will lament, although now You are jubilant."
Mṛtyu is explained in the
Haṁsadūta:
aye rāsa-krīḍā-rasika mama sakhyaṁ nava-navā
purā baddhā yena praṇaya-laharī hanta gahanā
sa cen muktāpekṣas tvam asi dhig imāṁ tūlaśakalaṁ
yad etasyā nāsā-nihitam idam adyāpi calati
In the following letter, Lalitā chastised Kṛṣṇa for staying in Mathurā: "Simply by dancing in the circle of the
rāsa
dance, You attracted Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī's love. Why are You now so indifferent to my dear friend Rādhārāṇī? She is lying nearly unconscious, thinking of Your pastimes. I shall determine whether She is alive by putting a cotton swab under Her nostrils, and if She is still living, I shall chastise Her."

verses.devanagari: এই দশ-দশায় প্রভু ব্যাকুল রাত্রিদিনে ।\\nকভু কোন দশা উঠে, স্থির নহে মনে ॥৫৪॥
verses.transliteration: ei daśa-daśāya prabhu vyākula rātri-dine\\nkabhu kona daśā uṭhe, sthira nahe mane
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was overwhelmed night and day by these ten ecstatic conditions. Whenever such symptoms arose, His mind became unsteady.

verses.devanagari: এত কহি’ মহাপ্রভু মৌন করিলা ।\\nরামানন্দ-রায় শ্লোক পড়িতে লাগিলা ॥৫৫॥
verses.transliteration: eta kahi' mahāprabhu mauna karilā\\nrāmānanda-rāya śloka paḍite lāgilā
verses.translation: After speaking in this way, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu fell silent. Then Rāma-nanda Rāya began to recite various verses.

verses.devanagari: স্বরূপ-গোসাঞি করে কৃষ্ণলীলা গান ।\\nদুই জনে কিছু কৈলা প্রভুর বাহ্য জ্ঞান ॥৫৬॥
verses.transliteration: svarūpa-gosāñi kare kṛṣṇa-līlā gāna\\ndui jane kichu kailā prabhura bāhya jñāna
verses.translation: Rāmānanda Rāya recited verses from Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam, and Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī sang of Kṛṣṇa's pastimes. In this way, they brought Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to external consciousness.

verses.devanagari: এইমত অর্ধরাত্রি কৈলা নির্যাপণ ।\\nভিতর-প্রকোষ্ঠে প্রভুরে করাইলা শয়ন ॥৫৭॥
verses.transliteration: ei-mata ardha-rātri kailā niryāpaṇa\\nbhitara-prakoṣṭhe prabhure karāilā śayana
verses.translation: After half the night had passed in this way, Rāmānanda Rāya and Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī made Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu lie down on His bed in the inner room.

verses.devanagari: রামানন্দ-রায় তবে গেলা নিজ ঘরে ।\\nস্বরূপ-গোবিন্দ দুঁহে শুইলেন দ্বারে ॥৫৮॥
verses.transliteration: rāmānanda-rāya tabe gelā nija ghare\\nsvarūpa-govinda duṅhe śuilena dvāre
verses.translation: Then Rāmānanda Rāya returned home, and Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī, along with Govinda, lay down in front of the door to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's room.

verses.devanagari: সব রাত্রি মহাপ্রভু করে জাগরণ ।\\nউচ্চ করি’ কহে কৃষ্ণনামসঙ্কীর্তন ॥৫৯॥
verses.transliteration: saba rātri mahāprabhu kare jāgaraṇa\\nucca kari' kahe kṛṣṇa-nāma-saṅkīrtana
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu remained awake throughout the entire night, chanting the Hare Kṛṣṇa mantra very loudly.

verses.devanagari: শব্দ না পাঞা স্বরূপ কপাট কৈলা দূরে ।\\nতিনদ্বার দেওয়া আছে, প্রভু নাহি ঘরে ! ॥ ৬০ ॥
verses.transliteration: śabda nā pāñā svarūpa kapāṭa kailā dūre\\ntina-dvāra deoyā āche, prabhu nāhi ghare!
verses.translation: After some time, Svarūpa Dāmodara could no longer hear Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu chanting. When he entered the room, he found the three doors locked, but Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had gone.

verses.devanagari: চিন্তিত হইল সবে প্রভুরে না দেখিয়া ।\\nপ্রভু চাহি’ বুলে সবে দেউটী জ্বালিয়া ॥৬১॥
verses.transliteration: cintita ha-ila sabe prabhure nā dekhiyā\\nprabhu cāhi' bule sabe deuṭī jvāliyā
verses.translation: All the devotees were very anxious when they saw that the Lord was not in His room. They wandered about searching for Him with a warning lamp.

verses.devanagari: সিংহদ্বারের উত্তর-দিশায় আছে এক ঠাঞি ।\\nতার মধ্যে পড়ি’ আছেন চৈতন্য-গোসাঞি ॥৬২॥
verses.transliteration: siṁha-dvārera uttara-diśāya āche eka ṭhāñi\\ntāra madhye paḍi' āchena caitanya-gosāñi
verses.translation: After searching for some time, they came upon Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu lying in a corner by the northern side of the Siṁha-dvāra gate.

verses.devanagari: দেখি’ স্বরূপ-গোসাঞি-আদি আনন্দিত হৈলা ।\\nপ্রভুর দশা দেখি’ পুনঃ চিন্তিতে লাগিলা ॥৬৩॥
verses.transliteration: dekhi' svarūpa-gosāñi-ādi ānandita hailā\\nprabhura daśā dekhi' punaḥ cintite lāgilā
verses.translation: At first they were overjoyed to see Him, but when they saw His condition, all the devotees, headed by Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī, were very anxious.

verses.devanagari: প্রভু পড়ি’ আছেন দীর্ঘ হাত পাঁচ-ছয় ।\\nঅচেতন দেহ, নাসায় শ্বাস নাহি বয় ॥৬৪॥
verses.transliteration: prabhu paḍi' āchena dīrgha hāta pāṅca-chaya\\nacetana deha, nāsāya śvāsa nāhi vaya
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was lying unconscious, and His body had become elongated to five or six cubits [eight or nine feet]. There was no breath from His nostrils.

verses.devanagari: এক এক হস্ত-পাদ — দীর্ঘ তিন তিন-হাত ।\\nঅস্থিগ্রন্থি ভিন্ন, চর্ম আছে মাত্র তাত ॥৬৫॥\\nহস্ত, পাদ, গ্রীবা, কটি, অস্থি, সন্ধি যত ।\\nএক এক বিতস্তি ভিন্ন হঞাছে তত ॥৬৬॥
verses.transliteration: hasta, pāda, grīvā, kaṭi, asthi sandhi yata\\neka eka vitasti bhinna hañāche tata
verses.translation: Each of His arms and legs had become three cubits long; only skin connected the separated joints. The Lord's body temperature, indicating life, was very low. All the joints in His arms, legs, neck and waist were separated by at least six inches.

verses.devanagari: চর্ম মাত্র উপরে, সন্ধি আছে দীর্ঘ হঞা ।\\nদুঃখিত হইলা সবে প্রভুরে দেখিয়া ॥৬৭॥
verses.transliteration: carma-mātra upare, sandhi āche dīrgha hañā\\nduḥkhita ha-ilā sabe prabhure dekhiyā
verses.translation: It appeared that only skin covered His elongated joints. Seeing the Lord's condition, all the devotees were very unhappy.

verses.devanagari: মুখে লালা-ফেন প্রভুর উত্তান-নয়ান ।\\nদেখিয়া সকল ভক্তের দেহ ছাড়ে প্রাণ ॥৬৮॥
verses.transliteration: mukhe lālā-phena prabhura uttāna-nayāna\\ndekhiyā sakala bhaktera deha chāḍe prāṇa
verses.translation: They almost died when they saw Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu with His mouth full of saliva and foam and His eyes turned upward.

verses.devanagari: স্বরূপ-গোসাঞি তবে উচ্চ করিয়া ।\\nপ্রভুর কাণে কৃষ্ণনাম কহে ভক্তগণ লঞা ॥৬৯॥
verses.transliteration: svarūpa-gosāñi tabe ucca kariyā\\nprabhura kāṇe kṛṣṇa-nāma kahe bhakta-gaṇa lañā
verses.translation: When they saw this, Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī and all the other devotees began to chant the holy name of Kṛṣṇa very loudly into Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's ear.

verses.devanagari: বহুক্ষণে কৃষ্ণনাম হৃদয়ে পশিলা ।\\n‘হরিবোল’ বলি’ প্রভু গর্জিয়া উঠিলা ॥৭০॥
verses.transliteration: bahu-kṣaṇe kṛṣṇa-nāma hṛdaye paśilā\\n'hari-bola' bali' prabhu garjiyā uṭhilā
verses.translation: After they chanted in this way for a long time, the holy name of Kṛṣṇa entered the heart of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, and He suddenly arose with a loud shout of "Hari bol."

verses.devanagari: চেতন পাইতে অস্থি-সন্ধি লাগিল ।\\nপূর্বপ্রায় যথাবৎ শরীর হইল ॥৭১॥
verses.transliteration: cetana pāite asthi-sandhi lāgila\\npūrva-prāya yathāvat śarīra ha-ila
verses.translation: As soon as the Lord returned to external consciousness, all His joints contracted, and His entire body returned to normal.

verses.devanagari: এই লীলা মহাপ্রভুর রঘুনাথদাস ।\\n‘গৌরাঙ্গস্তবকল্পবৃক্ষে’ করিয়াছেন প্রকাশ ॥৭২॥
verses.transliteration: ei līlā mahāprabhura raghunātha-dāsa\\n'gaurāṅga-stava-kalpavṛkṣe' kariyāche prakāśa
verses.translation: Śrīla Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī has described these pastimes elaborately in his book Gaurāṅga-stava-kalpavṛkṣa.

verses.devanagari: ক্বচিন্মিশ্রাবাসে ব্রজপতিসুতস্যোরুবিরহাৎ\\nশ্লথচ্ছ্রীসন্ধিত্বাদ্দধদধিকদৈর্ঘ্যং ভুজপদোঃ ।\\nলুঠন্ ভূমৌ কাক্বা বিকলবিকলং গদ্গদবচা\\nরুদন্ শ্রীগৌরাঙ্গো হৃদয় উদয়ন্মাং মদয়তি ॥৭৩॥
verses.transliteration: kvacin miśrāvāse vraja-pati-sutasyoru-virahāt\\nślathac chrī-sandhitvād dadhad-adhika-dairghyaṁ bhuja-padoḥ\\nluṭhan bhūmau kākvā vikala-vikalaṁ gadgada-vacā\\nrudan śrī-gaurāṅgo hṛdaya udayan māṁ madayati
verses.translation: "Sometimes Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would go to the house of Kāśī Miśra. There He would be greatly aggrieved, feeling separation from Kṛṣṇa. The joints of His transcendental body would slacken, and His arms and legs would become elongated. Rolling on the ground, the Lord would cry out in distress in a faltering voice and weep very sorrowfully. The appearance of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, awakening in my heart, maddens me."

verses.devanagari: সিংহদ্বারে দেখি’ প্রভুর বিস্ময় হইলা ।\\n‘কাঁহা কর কি’ — এই স্বরূপে পুছিলা ॥৭৪॥
verses.transliteration: siṁha-dvāre dekhi' prabhura vismaya ha-ilā\\n'kāṅhā kara ki'—ei svarūpe puchilā
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was very astonished to find Himself in front of the Siṁha-dvāra. He asked Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī, "Where am I? What am I doing here?"

verses.devanagari: স্বরূপ কহে, — ‘উঠ, প্রভু চল নিজ-ঘরে ।\\nতথাই তোমারে সব করিমু গোচরে ।।’ ॥ ৭৫ ॥
verses.transliteration: svarūpa kahe,—'uṭha, prabhu, cala nija-ghare\\ntathāi tomāre saba karimu gocare'
verses.translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara said, "My dear Lord, please get up. Let us go to Your place. There I shall tell You everything that has happened."

verses.devanagari: এত বলি’ প্রভুরে ধরি’ ঘরে লঞা গেলা ।\\nতাঁহার অবস্থা সব কহিতে লাগিলা ॥৭৬॥
verses.transliteration: eta bali' prabhure dhari' ghare lañā gelā\\ntāṅhāra avasthā saba kahite lāgilā
verses.translation: Thus all the devotees carried Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu back to His residence. Then they all described to Him what had happened.

verses.devanagari: শুনি’ মহাপ্রভু বড় হৈলা চমৎকার ।\\nপ্রভু কহে, — ‘কিছু স্মৃতি নাহিক আমার ! ॥ ৭৭ ॥
verses.transliteration: śuni' mahāprabhu baḍa hailā camatkāra\\nprabhu kahe,—'kichu smṛti nāhika āmāra
verses.translation: Hearing the description of His condition while lying near the Siṁha-dvāra, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was very astonished. He said, "I do not remember any of these things.

verses.devanagari: সবে দেখি — হয় মোর কৃষ্ণ বিদ্যমান ।\\nবিদ্যুৎপ্রায় দেখা দিয়া হয় অন্তর্ধান’ ॥৭৮॥
verses.transliteration: sabe dekhi—haya mora kṛṣṇa vidyamāna\\nvidyut-prāya dekhā diyā haya antardhāna'
verses.translation: "I can only remember that I saw My Kṛṣṇa, but only for an instant. He appeared before Me, and then, like lightning, immediately disappeared."

verses.devanagari: হেনকালে জগন্নাথের পাণি-শঙ্খ বাজিলা ।\\nস্নান করি’ মহাপ্রভু দরশনে গেলা ॥৭৯॥
verses.transliteration: hena-kāle jagannāthera pāṇi-śaṅkha bājilā\\nsnāna kari' mahāprabhu daraśane gelā
verses.translation: Just then, everyone heard the blowing of the conchshell at the Jagannātha temple. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu immediately took His bath and went to see Lord Jagannātha.

verses.devanagari: এই ত’ কহিলুঁ প্রভুর অদ্ভুত বিকার ।\\nযাহার শ্রবণে লোকে লাগে চমৎকার ॥৮০॥
verses.transliteration: ei ta' kahiluṅ prabhura adbhuta vikāra\\nyāhāra śravaṇe loke lāge camatkāra
verses.translation: Thus I have described the uncommon transformations of the body of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. When people hear about this, they are very astonished.

verses.devanagari: লোকে নাহি দেখে ঐছে, শাস্ত্রে নাহি শুনি ।\\nহেন ভাব ব্যক্ত করে ন্যাসি-চূড়ামণি ॥৮১॥
verses.transliteration: loke nāhi dekhi aiche, śāstre nāhi śuni\\nhena bhāva vyakta kare nyāsi-cūḍāmaṇi
verses.translation: No one has witnessed such bodily changes elsewhere, nor has anyone read of them in the revealed scriptures. Yet Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the supreme sannyāsī, exhibited these ecstatic symptoms.

verses.devanagari: শাস্ত্রলোকাতীত যেই যেই ভাব হয় ।\\nইতর-লোকের তাতে না হয় নিশ্চয় ॥৮২॥
verses.transliteration: śāstra-lokātīta yei yei bhāva haya\\nitara-lokera tāte nā haya niścaya
verses.translation: These ecstasies are not described in the śāstras, and they are inconceivable to common men. Therefore people in general do not believe in them.

verses.devanagari: রঘুনাথ-দাসের সদা প্রভুসঙ্গে স্থিতি ।\\nতাঁর মুখে শুনি’ লিখি করিয়া প্রতীতি ॥৮৩॥
verses.transliteration: raghunātha-dāsera sadā prabhu-saṅge sthiti\\ntāṅra mukhe śuni' likhi kariyā pratīti
verses.translation: Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī lived continuously with Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. I am simply recording whatever I have heard from him. Although common men do not believe in these pastimes, I believe in them totally.

verses.devanagari: একদিন মহাপ্রভু সমুদ্রে যাইতে ।\\n‘চটক’-পর্বত দেখিলেন আচম্বিতে ॥৮৪॥
verses.transliteration: eka-dina mahāprabhu samudre yāite\\n'caṭaka'-parvata dekhilena ācambite
verses.translation: One day, while Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was going to the sea to bathe, He suddenly saw a sand dune named Caṭaka-parvata.

verses.devanagari: গোবর্ধন-শৈল-জ্ঞানে আবিষ্ট হইলা ।\\nপর্বত-দিশাতে প্রভু ধাঞা চলিলা ॥৮৫॥
verses.transliteration: govardhana-śaila-jñāne āviṣṭa ha-ilā\\nparvata-diśāte prabhu dhāñā calilā
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu mistook the sand dune for Govardhana Hill and ran toward it.

verses.devanagari: হন্তায়মদ্রিরবলা হরিদাসবর্যো\\nযদ্রামকৃষ্ণচরণ-স্পরশ-প্রমোদঃ ।\\nমানং তনোতি সহ-গোগণয়োস্তয়োর্যৎ\\nপানীয়-সূযবস-কন্দর-কন্দমূলৈঃ ॥৮৬॥
verses.transliteration: hantāyam adrir abalā hari-dāsa-varyo\\nyad rāma-kṛṣṇa-caraṇa-sparaśa-pramodaḥ\\nmānaṁ tanoti saha-go-gaṇayos tayor yat\\npānīya-sūyavasa-kandara-kanda-mūlaiḥ
verses.translation: "Of all the devotees, this Govardhana Hill is the best! O My friends, this hill supplies Kṛṣṇa and Balarāma, as well as Their calves, cows and cowherd friends, with all kinds of necessities-water for drinking, very soft grass, caves, fruits, flowers and vegetables. In this way the hill offers respect to the Lord. Being touched by the lotus feet of Kṛṣṇa and Balarāma, Govardhana Hill appears very jubilant."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This is a quotation from
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
(10.21.18). It was spoken by the
gopīs
when Lord Kṛṣṇa and Balarāma entered the forest in the autumn. The
gopīs
spoke among themselves and glorified Kṛṣṇa and Balarāma for Their pastimes.

verses.devanagari: এই শ্লোক পড়ি’ প্রভু চলেন বায়ুবেগে ।\\nগোবিন্দ ধাইল পাছে, নাহি পায় লাগে ॥৮৭॥
verses.transliteration: ei śloka paḍi' prabhu calena vāyu-vege\\ngovinda dhāila pāche, nāhi pāya lāge
verses.translation: Reciting this verse, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu ran toward the sand dune as fast as the wind. Govinda ran after Him, but he could not approach Him.

verses.devanagari: ফুকার পড়িল, মহা-কোলাহল হইল ।\\nযেই যাহাঁ ছিল সেই উঠিয়া ধাইল ॥৮৮॥
verses.transliteration: phukāra paḍila, mahā-kolāhala ha-ila\\nyei yāhāṅ chila sei uṭhiyā dhāila
verses.translation: First one devotee shouted loudly, and then a tumultuous uproar arose as all the devotees stood up and began to run after the Lord.

verses.devanagari: স্বরূপ, জগদানন্দ, পণ্ডিত-গদাধর ।\\nরামাই, নন্দাই, আর পণ্ডিত-শঙ্কর ॥৮৯॥
verses.transliteration: svarūpa, jagadānanda, paṇḍita-gadādhara\\nrāmāi, nandāi, āra paṇḍita śaṅkara
