verses.translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī, Jagadānanda Paṇḍita, Gadādhara Paṇḍita, Rāmāi, Nandāi and Śaṅkara Paṇḍita are some of the devotees who ran after Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: পুরী-ভারতী-গোসাঞি আইলা সিন্ধুতীরে ।\\nভগবান্-আচার্য খঞ্জ চলিলা ধীরে ধীরে ॥৯০॥
verses.transliteration: purī-bhāratī-gosāñi āilā sindhu-tīre\\nbhagavān-ācārya khañja calilā dhīre dhīre
verses.translation: Paramānanda Purī and Brahmānanda Bhāratī also went toward the beach, and Bhagavān Ācārya, who was lame, followed them very slowly.

verses.devanagari: প্রথমে চলিলা প্রভু, — যেন বায়ু গতি ।\\nস্তম্ভভাব পথে হৈল, চলিতে নাহি শক্তি ॥৯১॥
verses.transliteration: prathame calilā prabhu,—yena vāyu-gati\\nstambha-bhāva pathe haila, calite nāhi śakti
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was running with the speed of the wind, but He suddenly became stunned in ecstasy and lost all strength to proceed further.

verses.devanagari: প্রতি-রোমকূপে মাংস — ব্রণের আকার ।\\nতার উপরে রোমোদ্গম — কদম্বপ্রকার ॥৯২॥
verses.transliteration: prati-roma-kūpe māṁsa—vraṇera ākāra\\ntāra upare romodgama—kadamba-prakāra
verses.translation: The flesh at each of His pores erupted like pimples, and His hair, standing on end, appeared like kadamba flowers.

verses.devanagari: প্রতি-রোমে প্রস্বেদ পড়ে রুধিরের ধার ।\\nকণ্ঠে ঘর্ঘর, নাহি বর্ণের উচ্চার ॥৯৩॥
verses.transliteration: prati-rome prasveda paḍe rudhirera dhāra\\nkaṇṭhe gharghara, nāhi varṇera uccāra
verses.translation: Blood and perspiration flowed incessantly from every pore of His body, and He could not speak a word but simply produced a gargling sound within His throat.

verses.devanagari: দুই নেত্রে ভরি’ অশ্রু বহয়ে অপার ।\\nসমুদ্রে মিলিলা যেন গঙ্গা-যমুনা-ধার ॥৯৪॥
verses.transliteration: dui netre bhari' aśru vahaye apāra\\nsamudre mililā yena gaṅgā-yamunā-dhāra
verses.translation: The Lord's eyes filled up and overflowed with unlimited tears, like the Ganges and Yamunā meeting in the sea.

verses.devanagari: বৈবর্ণ্যে শঙ্খপ্রায় শ্বেত হৈল অঙ্গ ।\\nতবে কম্প উঠে, — যেন সমুদ্রে তরঙ্গ ॥৯৫॥
verses.transliteration: vaivarṇye śaṅkha-prāya śveta haila aṅga\\ntabe kampa uṭhe,—yena samudre taraṅga
verses.translation: His entire body faded to the color of a white conchshell, and then He began to quiver, like the waves in the ocean.

verses.devanagari: কাঁপিতে কাঁপিতে প্রভু ভূমিতে পড়িলা ।\\nতবে ত’ গোবিন্দ প্রভুর নিকটে আইলা ॥৯৬॥
verses.transliteration: kāṅpite kāṅpite prabhu bhūmete paḍilā\\ntabe ta' govinda prabhura nikaṭe āilā
verses.translation: While quivering in this way, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu fell down on the ground. Then Govinda approached Him.

verses.devanagari: করঙ্গের জলে করে সর্বাঙ্গ সিঞ্চন ।\\nবহির্বাস লঞা করে অঙ্গ সংবীজন ॥৯৭॥
verses.transliteration: karaṅgera jale kare sarvāṅga siñcana\\nbahirvāsa lañā kare aṅga saṁvījana
verses.translation: Govinda sprinkled water from a karaṅga waterpot all over the Lord's body, and then, taking His own outer garment, he began to fan Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: স্বরূপাদিগণ তাহাঁ আসিয়া মিলিলা ।\\nপ্রভুর অবস্থা দেখি’ কান্দিতে লাগিলা ॥৯৮॥
verses.transliteration: svarūpādi-gaṇa tāhāṅ āsiyā mililā\\nprabhura avasthā dekhi' kāndite lāgilā
verses.translation: When Svarūpa Dāmodara and the other devotees reached the spot and saw the condition of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, they began to cry.

verses.devanagari: প্রভুর অঙ্গে দেখে অষ্টসাত্ত্বিক বিকার ।\\nআশ্চর্য সাত্ত্বিক দেখি’ হৈলা চমৎকার ॥৯৯॥
verses.transliteration: prabhura aṅge dekhe aṣṭa-sāttvika vikāra\\nāścarya sāttvika dekhi' hailā camatkāra
verses.translation: All eight kinds of transcendental transformations were visible in the Lord's body. All the devotees were struck with wonder to see such a sight.
verses.purport: PURPORT\nThe eight ecstatic symptoms are the state of being stunned, perspiration, standing of the hairs on end, faltering of the voice, trembling, fading of the body's color, tears and devastation.

verses.devanagari: উচ্চ সঙ্কীর্তন করে প্রভুর শ্রবণে ।\\nশীতল জলে করে প্রভুর অঙ্গ সম্মার্জনে ॥১০০॥
verses.transliteration: ucca saṅkīrtana kare prabhura śravaṇe\\nśītala jale kare prabhura aṅga sammārjane
verses.translation: The devotees loudly chanted the Hare Kṛṣṇa mantra near Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and washed His body with cold water.

verses.devanagari: এইমত বহুবার কীর্তন করিতে ।\\n‘হরিবোল’ বলি’ প্রভু উঠে আচম্বিতে ॥১০১॥
verses.transliteration: ei-mata bahu-bāra kīrtana karite\\n'hari-bola' bali' prabhu uṭhe ācambite
verses.translation: After the devotees had been chanting for a long time, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu suddenly stood up, shouting, "Hari bol!"

verses.devanagari: সানন্দে সকল বৈষ্ণব বলে ‘হরি’ ‘হরি’ ।\\nউঠিল মঙ্গলধ্বনি চতুর্দিক ভরি’ ॥১০২॥
verses.transliteration: sānande sakala vaiṣṇava bale 'hari' 'hari'\\nuṭhila maṅgala-dhvani catur-dik bhari'
verses.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu stood up, all the Vaiṣṇavas loudly chanted, "Hari! Hari!" in great jubilation. The auspicious sound filled the air in all directions.

verses.devanagari: উঠি’ মহাপ্রভু বিস্মিত, ইতি উতি চায় ।\\nযে দেখিতে চায়, তাহা দেখিতে না পায় ॥১০৩॥
verses.transliteration: uṭhi' mahāprabhu vismita, iti uti cāya\\nye dekhite cāya, tāhā dekhite nā pāya
verses.translation: Astonished, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu stood up and began looking here and there, trying to see something. But He could not catch sight of it.

verses.devanagari: ‘বৈষ্ণব’ দেখিয়া প্রভুর অর্ধবাহ্য হইল  ।\\nস্বরূপ-গোসাঞিরে কিছু কহিতে লাগিল ॥১০৪॥
verses.transliteration: 'vaiṣṇava' dekhiyā prabhura ardha-bāhya ha-ila\\nsvarūpa-gosāñire kichu kahite lāgila
verses.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu saw all the Vaiṣṇavas, He returned to partial external consciousness and spoke to Svarūpa Dāmodara.

verses.devanagari: “গোবর্ধন হৈতে মোরে কে ইহাঁ আনিল ? পাঞা কৃষ্ণের লীলা দেখিতে না পাইল ॥১০৫॥
verses.transliteration: "govardhana haite more ke ihāṅ ānila?\\npāñā kṛṣṇera līlā dekhite nā pāila
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "Who has brought Me here from Govardhana Hill? I was seeing Lord Kṛṣṇa's pastimes, but now I cannot see them.

verses.devanagari: ইহাঁ হৈতে আজি মুই গেনু গোবর্ধনে ।\\nদেখোঁ, — যদি কৃষ্ণ করেন গোধন-চারণে ॥১০৬॥
verses.transliteration: ihāṅ haite āji mui genu govardhane\\ndekhoṅ,—yadi kṛṣṇa karena godhana-cāraṇe
verses.translation: "Today I went from here to Govardhana Hill to find out if Kṛṣṇa were tending His cows there.

verses.devanagari: গোবর্ধনে চড়ি’ কৃষ্ণ বাজাইলা বেণু ।\\nগোবর্ধনের চৌদিকে চরে সব ধেনু ॥১০৭॥
verses.transliteration: govardhane caḍi' kṛṣṇa bājāilā veṇu\\ngovardhanera caudike care saba dhenu
verses.translation: "I saw Lord Kṛṣṇa climbing Govardhana Hill and playing His flute, surrounded on all sides by grazing cows.

verses.devanagari: বেণুনাদ শুনি’ আইলা রাধা-ঠাকুরাণী ।\\nসব সখীগণ-সঙ্গে করিয়া সাজনি ॥১০৮॥
verses.transliteration: veṇu-nāda śuni' āilā rādhā-ṭhākurāṇī\\nsaba sakhī-gaṇa-saṅge kariyā sājani
verses.translation: "Hearing the vibration of Kṛṣṇa's flute, Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī and all Her gopī friends came there to meet Him. They were all very nicely dressed.

verses.devanagari: রাধা লঞা কৃষ্ণ প্রবেশিলা কন্দরাতে ।\\nসখীগণ কহে মোরে ফুল উঠাইতে ॥১০৯॥
verses.transliteration: rādhā lañā kṛṣṇa praveśilā kandarāte\\nsakhī-gaṇa kahe more phula uṭhāite
verses.translation: "When Kṛṣṇa and Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī entered a cave together, the other gopīs asked Me to pick some flowers.

verses.devanagari: হেনকালে তুমি-সব কোলাহল কৈলা ।\\nতাহাঁ হৈতে ধরি’ মোরে ইহাঁ লঞা আইলা ॥১১০॥
verses.transliteration: hena-kāle tumi-saba kolāhala kailā\\ntāhāṅ haite dhari' more ihāṅ lañā āilā
verses.translation: "Just then, all of you made a tumultuous sound and carried Me from there to this place.

verses.devanagari: কেনে বা আনিলা মোরে বৃথা দুঃখ দিতে ।\\nপাঞা কৃষ্ণের লীলা, না পাইনু দেখিতে !” ॥ ১১১ ॥
verses.transliteration: kene vā ānilā more vṛthā duḥkha dite\\npāñā kṛṣṇera līlā, nā pāinu dekhite
verses.translation: "Why have you brought Me here, causing Me unnecessary pain? I had a chance to see Kṛṣṇa's pastimes, but I could not see them."

verses.devanagari: এত বলি’ মহাপ্রভু করেন ক্রন্দন ।\\nতাঁর দশা দেখি’ বৈষ্ণব করেন রোদন ॥১১২॥
verses.transliteration: eta bali' mahāprabhu karena krandana\\ntāṅra daśā dekhi' vaiṣṇava karena rodana
verses.translation: Saying this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu began to weep. When all the Vaiṣṇavas saw the Lord's condition, they also wept.

verses.devanagari: হেনকালে আইলা পুরী, ভারতী, — দুইজন ।\\nদুঁহে দেখি’ মহাপ্রভুর হইল সম্ভ্রম ॥১১৩॥
verses.transliteration: hena-kāle āilā purī, bhāratī,—dui-jana\\nduṅhe dekhi' mahāprabhura ha-ila sambhrama
verses.translation: At that time, Paramānanda Purī and Brahmānanda Bhāratī arrived. Seeing them, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu became somewhat respectful.

verses.devanagari: নিপট্ট-বাহ্য হইলে প্রভু দুঁহারে বন্দিলা ।\\nমহাপ্রভুরে দুইজন প্রেমালিঙ্গন কৈলা ॥১১৪॥
verses.transliteration: nipaṭṭa-bāhya ha-ile prabhu duṅhāre vandilā\\nmahāprabhure dui-jana premāliṅgana kailā
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu returned to complete external consciousness and immediately offered prayers to them. Then these two elderly gentlemen both embraced the Lord with loving affection.

verses.devanagari: প্রভু কহে, — ‘দুঁহে কেনে আইলা এত দূরে’ ?\\nপুরীগোসাঞি কহে, — ‘তোমার নৃত্য দেখিবারে’ ॥১১৫॥
verses.transliteration: prabhu kahe,—'duṅhe kene āilā eta dūre'?\\npurī-gosāñi kahe,—'tomāra nṛtya dekhibāre'
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said to Purī Gosvāmī and Brahmānanda Bhāratī, "Why have you both come so far?" Purī Gosvāmī replied, "Just to see Your dancing."

verses.devanagari: লজ্জিত হইলা প্রভু পুরীর বচনে ।\\nসমুদ্রঘাট আইলা সব বৈষ্ণব-সনে ॥১১৬॥
verses.transliteration: lajjita ha-ilā prabhu purīra vacane\\nsamudra-ghāṭa āilā saba vaiṣṇava-sane
verses.translation: When He heard this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was somewhat ashamed. Then He went to bathe in the sea with all the Vaiṣṇavas.

verses.devanagari: স্নান করি’ মহাপ্রভু ঘরেতে আইলা ।\\nসবা লঞা মহাপ্রসাদ ভোজন করিলা ॥১১৭॥
verses.transliteration: snāna kari' mahāprabhu gharete āilā\\nsabā lañā mahā-prasāda bhojana karilā
verses.translation: After bathing in the sea, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu returned to His residence with all the devotees. Then they all lunched on the remnants of food offered to Lord Jagannātha.

verses.devanagari: এই ত’ কহিলুঁ প্রভুর দিব্যোন্মাদ-ভাব ।\\nব্রহ্মাও কহিতে নারে যাহার প্রভাব ॥১১৮॥
verses.transliteration: ei ta' kahiluṅ prabhura divyonmāda-bhāva\\nbrahmāo kahite nāre yāhāra prabhāva
verses.translation: Thus I have described the transcendental ecstatic emotions of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Even Lord Brahmā cannot describe their influence.

verses.devanagari: ‘চটক’-গিরি-গমন-লীলা রঘুনাথদাস ।\\n‘গৌরাঙ্গস্তবকল্পবৃক্ষে’ করিয়াছেন প্রকাশ ॥১১৯॥
verses.transliteration: 'caṭaka'-giri-gamana-līlā raghunātha-dāsa\\n'gaurāṅga-stava-kalpavṛkṣe' kariyāchena prakāśa
verses.translation: In his book Gaurāṅga-stava-kalpavṛkṣa, Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī has very vividly described Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's pastime of running toward the Caṭaka-parvata sand dune.

verses.devanagari: সমীপে নীলাদ্রেবর্ধনগিরিপতিং লোকিতুমিতঃ ।\\nব্রজন্নস্মীত্যুক্ত্বা প্রমদ ইব ধাবন্নবধৃতো\\nগণৈঃ স্বৈর্গৌরাঙ্গো হৃদয় উদয়ন্মাং মদয়তি ॥১২০॥
verses.transliteration: samīpe nīlādreś caṭaka-giri-rājasya kalanād\\naye goṣṭhe govardhana-giri-patiṁ lokitum itaḥ\\nvrajann asmīty uktvā pramada iva dhāvann avadhṛto\\ngaṇaiḥ svair gaurāṅgo hṛdaya udayan māṁ madayati
verses.translation: "Near Jagannātha Purī was a great sand dune known as Caṭaka-parvata. Seeing that hill, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, 'Oh, I shall go to the land of Vraja to see Govardhana Hill.' Then He began running madly toward it, and all the Vaiṣṇavas ran after Him. This scene awakens in my heart and maddens me."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This verse is quoted from the
Gaurāṅga-stava-kalpavṛkṣa
(8).

verses.devanagari: এবে প্রভু যত কৈলা অলৌকিক-লীলা ।\\nকে বর্ণিতে পারে সেই মহাপ্রভুর খেলা ? ॥ ১২১ ॥
verses.transliteration: ebe prabhu yata kailā alaukika-līlā\\nke varṇite pāre sei mahāprabhura khelā?
verses.translation: Who can properly describe all the uncommon pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu? They are all simply His play.

verses.devanagari: সংক্ষেপে কহিয়া করি দিক্ দরশন ।\\nযেই ইহা শুনে, পায় কৃষ্ণের চরণ ॥১২২॥
verses.transliteration: saṅkṣepe kahiyā kari dik daraśana\\nyei ihā śune, pāya kṛṣṇera caraṇa
verses.translation: I have briefly described them just to give an indication of His transcendental pastimes. Nevertheless, anyone who hears this will certainly attain the shelter of Lord Kṛṣṇa's lotus feet.

verses.devanagari: শ্রীরূপ-রঘুনাথ-পদে যার আশ ।\\nচৈতন্যচরিতামৃত কহে কৃষ্ণদাস ॥১২৩॥
verses.transliteration: śrī-rūpa-raghunātha-pade yāra āśa\\ncaitanya-caritāmṛta kahe kṛṣṇadāsa
verses.translation: Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.
verses.purport: PURPORT\nThus end the Bhaktivedanta purports to Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā,  Fourteenth Chapter, describing Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's transcendental ecstatic emotions and His mistaking Caṭaka-parvata for Govardhana Hill.

sections.title: Chapter 15: The Transcendental Madness of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu

verses.devanagari: দুর্গমে কৃষ্ণভাবাব্ধৌ নিমগ্নোন্মগ্নচেতসা ।\\nগৌরেণ হরিণা প্রেমমর্যাদা ভূরি দর্শিতা ॥১॥
verses.transliteration: durgame kṛṣṇa-bhāvābdhau\\nnimagnonmagna-cetasā\\ngaureṇa hariṇā prema-\\nmaryādā bhūri darśitā
verses.translation: The ocean of ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa is very difficult to understand, even for such demigods as Lord Brahmā. By enacting His pastimes, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu submerged Himself in that ocean, and His heart was absorbed in that love. Thus He exhibited in various ways the exalted position of transcendental love for Kṛṣṇa.

verses.devanagari: জয় জয় শ্রীকৃষ্ণচৈতন্য অধীশ্বর ।\\nজয় নিত্যানন্দ পূর্ণানন্দ-কলেবর ॥২॥
verses.transliteration: jaya jaya śrī-kṛṣṇa-caitanya adhīśvara\\njaya nityānanda pūrṇānanda-kalevara
verses.translation: All glories to Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya, the Supreme Personality of Godhead! All glories to Lord Nityānanda, whose body is always filled with transcendental bliss!

verses.devanagari: জয়াদ্বৈতাচার্য কৃষ্ণচৈতন্য-প্রিয়তম ।\\nজয় শ্রীবাস-আদি প্রভুর ভক্তগণ ॥৩॥
verses.transliteration: jayādvaitācārya kṛṣṇa-caitanya-priyatama\\njaya śrīvāsa-ādi prabhura bhakta-gaṇa
verses.translation: All glories to Śrī Advaita Ācārya, who is very dear to Lord Caitanya! And all glories to the devotees of the Lord, headed by Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura!

verses.devanagari: এইমত মহাপ্রভু রাত্রি-দিবসে ।\\nআত্মস্ফূর্তি নাহি কৃষ্ণভাবাবেশে ॥৪॥
verses.transliteration: ei-mata mahāprabhu rātri-divase\\nātma-sphūrti nāhi kṛṣṇa-bhāvāveśe
verses.translation: Thus Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu forgot Himself throughout the entire day and night, being merged in an ocean of ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa.

verses.devanagari: কভু ভাবে মগ্ন, কভু অর্ধ-বাহ্যস্ফূর্তি ।\\nকভু বাহ্যস্ফূর্তি, — তিন রীতে প্রভুস্থিতি ॥৫॥
verses.transliteration: kabhu bhāve magna, kabhu ardha-bāhya-sphūrti\\nkabhu bāhya-sphūrti,—tina rīte prabhu-sthiti
verses.translation: The Lord would maintain Himself in three kinds of consciousness: sometimes He merged totally in ecstatic emotion, sometimes He was in partial external consciousness and sometimes in full external consciousness.

verses.devanagari: স্নান, দর্শন, ভোজন দেহ-স্বভাবে হয় ।\\nকুমারের চাক যেন সতত ফিরয় ॥৬॥
verses.transliteration: snāna, darśana, bhojana deha-svabhāve haya\\nkumārera cāka yena satata phiraya
verses.translation: Actually, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was always merged in ecstatic emotion, but just as a potter's wheel turns without the potter's touching it, the Lord's bodily activities, like bathing, going to the temple to see Lord Jagannātha, and taking lunch, went on automatically.

verses.devanagari: একদিন করেন প্রভু জগন্নাথ দরশন ।\\nজগন্নাথে দেখে সাক্ষাৎ ব্রজেন্দ্রনন্দন ॥৭॥
verses.transliteration: eka-dina karena prabhu jagannātha daraśana\\njagannāthe dekhe sākṣāt vrajendra-nandana
verses.translation: One day, while Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was looking at Lord Jagannātha in the temple, Lord Jagannātha appeared to be personally the son of Nanda Mahārāja, Śrī Kṛṣṇa.

verses.devanagari: একবারে স্ফুরে প্রভুর কৃষ্ণের পঞ্চগুণ ।\\nপঞ্চগুণে করে পঞ্চেন্দ্রিয় আকর্ষণ ॥৮॥
verses.transliteration: eka-bāre sphure prabhura kṛṣṇera pañca-guṇa\\npañca-guṇe kare pañcendriya ākarṣaṇa
verses.translation: When He realized Lord Jagannātha to be Kṛṣṇa Himself, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's five senses were immediately absorbed in attraction for the five attributes of Lord Kṛṣṇa.
verses.purport: PURPORT\nŚrī Kṛṣṇa's beauty attracted the eyes of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Kṛṣṇa's singing and the vibration of His flute attracted the Lord's ears, the transcendental fragrance of Kṛṣṇa's lotus feet attracted His nostrils, Kṛṣṇa's transcendental sweetness attracted His tongue, and Kṛṣṇa's bodily touch attracted the Lord's sensation of touch. Thus each of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's five senses was attracted by one of the five attributes of Lord Kṛṣṇa.

verses.devanagari: একমন পঞ্চদিকে পঞ্চগুণ টানে ।\\nটানাটানি প্রভুর মন হৈল অগেয়ানে ॥৯॥
verses.transliteration: eka-mana pañca-dike pañca-guṇa ṭāne\\nṭānāṭāni prabhura mana haila ageyāne
verses.translation: Just as in a tug-of-war, the single mind of Lord Caitanya was attracted in five directions by the five transcendental attributes of Lord Kṛṣṇa. Thus the Lord became unconscious.

verses.devanagari: হেনকালে ঈশ্বরের উপলভোগ সরিল ।\\nভক্তগণ মহাপ্রভুরে ঘরে লঞা আইল ॥১০॥
verses.transliteration: hena-kāle īśvarera upala-bhoga sarila\\nbhakta-gaṇa mahāprabhure ghare lañā āila
verses.translation: Just then, the upala-bhoga ceremony of Lord Jagannātha concluded, and the devotees who had accompanied Lord Caitanya to the temple brought Him back home.

verses.devanagari: স্বরূপ, রামানন্দ, — এই দুইজন লঞা ।\\nবিলাপ করেন দুঁহার কণ্ঠেতে ধরিয়া ॥১১॥
verses.transliteration: svarūpa, rāmānanda,—ei dui-jana lañā\\nvilāpa karena duṅhāra kaṇṭhete dhariyā
verses.translation: That night, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was attended by Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī and Rāmānanda Rāya. Keeping His hands around their necks, the Lord began to lament.

verses.devanagari: কৃষ্ণের বিয়োগে রাধার উৎকণ্ঠিত মন ।\\nবিশাখারে কহে আপন উৎকণ্ঠা-কারণ ॥১২॥
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇera viyoge rādhāra utkaṇṭhita mana\\nviśākhāre kahe āpana utkaṇṭhā-kāraṇa
verses.translation: When Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī was very agitated due to feeling great separation from Kṛṣṇa, She spoke a verse to Viśākhā explaining the cause of Her great anxiety and restlessness.

verses.devanagari: সেই শ্লোক পড়ি’ আপনে করে মনস্তাপ ।\\nশ্লোকের অর্থ শুনায় দুঁহারে করিয়া বিলাপ ॥১৩॥
verses.transliteration: sei śloka paḍi' āpane kare manastāpa\\nślokera artha śunāya duṅhāre kariyā vilāpa
verses.translation: Reciting that verse, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu expressed His burning emotions. Then, with great lamentation, He explained the verse to Svarūpa Dāmodara and Rāmānanda Rāya.

verses.devanagari: সৌন্দর্যামৃতসিন্ধুভঙ্গললনা-চিত্তাদ্রিসংপ্লাবকঃ\\nকর্ণানন্দি-সনর্মরম্যবচনঃ কোটীন্দুশীতাঙ্গকঃ ।\\nসৌরভ্যামৃতসংপ্লবাবৃতজগৎ পীযূষরম্যাধরঃ\\nশ্রীগোপেন্দ্রসুতঃ স কর্ষতি বলাৎ পঞ্চেন্দ্রিয়াণ্যালি মে ॥১৪॥
verses.transliteration: saundaryāmṛta-sindhu-bhaṅga-lalanā-cittādri-saṁplāvakaḥ\\nkarṇānandi-sanarma-ramya-vacanaḥ koṭīndu-śītāṅgakaḥ\\nsaurabhyāmṛta-samplavāvṛta-jagat pīyūṣa-ramyādharaḥ\\nśrī-gopendra-sutaḥ sa karṣati balāt pañcendriyāṇy āli me
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said:" 'Though the hearts of the gopīs are like high-standing hills, they are inundated by the waves of the nectarean ocean of Kṛṣṇa's beauty. His sweet voice enters their ears and gives them transcendental bliss. The touch of His body is cooler than millions and millions of moons together, and the nectar of His bodily fragrance overfloods the entire world. O My dear friend, that Kṛṣṇa, who is the son of Nanda Mahārāja and whose lips are exactly like nectar, is attracting My five senses by force.'
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This verse is found in
Govinda-līlāmṛta
(8.3).

verses.devanagari: কৃষ্ণ-রূপ-শব্দ-স্পর্শ, সৌরভ্য-অধর-রস,\\nযার মাধুর্য কহন না যায় ।\\nদেখি’ লোভে পঞ্চজন, এক অশ্ব — মোর মন,\\nচড়ি’ পঞ্চ পাঁচদিকে ধায় ॥১৫॥
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇa-rūpa-śabda-sparśa, saurabhya-adhara-rasa,\\nyāra mādhurya kahana nā yāya\\ndekhi' lobhe pañca-jana, eka aśva—mora mana,\\ncaḍi' pañca pāṅca-dike dhāya
verses.translation: "Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa's beauty, the sound of His words and the vibration of His flute, His touch, His fragrance and the taste of His lips are full of an indescribable sweetness. When all these features attract My five senses at once, My senses all ride together on the single horse of My mind but want to go in five different directions.

verses.devanagari: সখি হে, শুন মোর দুঃখের কারণ ।\\nমোর পঞ্চেন্দ্রিয়গণ, মহা-লম্পট দস্যুগণ,\\nসবে কহে, — হর’ পরধন ।। ১৬ ।। ধ্রু ।। ॥১৬॥
verses.transliteration: sakhi he, śuna mora duḥkhera kāraṇa\\nmora pañcendriya-gaṇa, mahā-lampaṭa dasyu-gaṇa,\\nsabe kahe,—hara' para-dhana
verses.translation: "O My dear friend, please hear the cause of My misery. My five senses are actually extravagant rogues. They know very well that Kṛṣṇa is the Supreme Personality of Godhead, but they still want to plunder Kṛṣṇa's property.

verses.devanagari: এক অশ্ব একক্ষণে, পাঁচ পাঁচ দিকে টানে,\\nএক মন কোন্ দিকে ধায় ?\\nএককালে সবে টানে, গেল ঘোড়ার পরাণে,\\nএই দুঃখ সহন না যায় ॥১৭॥
verses.transliteration: eka aśva eka-kṣaṇe, pāṅca pāṅca dike ṭāne,\\neka mana kon dike yāya?\\neka-kāle sabe ṭāne, gela ghoḍāra parāṇe,\\nei duḥkha sahana nā yāya
verses.translation: "My mind is just like a single horse being ridden by the five senses of perception, headed by sight. Each sense wants to ride that horse, and thus they pull My mind in five directions simultaneously. In what direction will it go? If they all pull at one time, certainly the horse will lose its life. How can I tolerate this atrocity?

verses.devanagari: ইন্দ্রিয়ে না করি রোষ, ইঁহা-সবার কাহাঁ দোষ,\\nকৃষ্ণরূপাদির মহা আকর্ষণ ।\\nরূপাদি পাঁচ পাঁচে টানে, গেল ঘোড়ার পরাণে,\\nমোর দেহে না রহে জীবন ॥১৮॥
verses.transliteration: indriye nā kari roṣa, iṅhā-sabāra kāhāṅ doṣa,\\nkṛṣṇa-rūpādira mahā ākarṣaṇa\\nrūpādi pāṅca pāṅce ṭāne, gela ghoḍāra parāṇe,\\nmora dehe nā rahe jīvana
verses.translation: "My dear friend, if you say, 'Just try to control Your senses,' what shall I say? I cannot become angry at My senses. Is it their fault? Kṛṣṇa's beauty, sounds, touch, fragrance and taste are by nature extremely attractive. These five features are attracting My senses, and each wants to drag My mind in a different direction. Thus the life of My mind is in great danger, just like a horse ridden in five directions at once. Thus I am also in danger of dying.

verses.devanagari: কৃষ্ণরূপামৃতসিন্ধু, তাহার তরঙ্গ-বিন্দু,\\nএকবিন্দু জগৎ ডুবায় ।\\nত্রিজগতে যত নারী, তার চিত্ত-উচ্চগিরি,\\nতাহা ডুবাই আগে উঠি’ ধায় ॥১৯॥
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇa-rūpāmṛta-sindhu, tāhāra taraṅga-bindu,\\neka-bindu jagat ḍubāya\\ntrijagate yata nārī, tāra citta-ucca-giri,\\ntāhā ḍubāi āge uṭhi' dhāya
verses.translation: "The consciousness of each woman within the three worlds is certainly like a high hill, but the sweetness of Kṛṣṇa's beauty is like an ocean. Even a drop of water from that ocean can flood the entire world and submerge all the high hills of consciousness.

verses.devanagari: কৃষ্ণের বচন-মাধুরী, নানা-রস নর্মধারী,\\nতার অন্যায় কথন না যায় ।\\nজগতের নারীর কাণে, মাধুরীগুণে বান্ধি’ টানে,\\nটানাটানি কাণের প্রাণ যায় ॥২০॥
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇera vacana-mādhurī, nānā-rasa-narma-dhārī,\\ntāra anyāya kathana nā yāya\\njagatera nārīra kāṇe, mādhurī-guṇe bāndhi' ṭāne,\\nṭānāṭāni kāṇera prāṇa yāya
verses.translation: "The sweetness of Kṛṣṇa's joking words plays indescribable havoc with the hearts of all women. His words bind a woman's ear to the qualities of their sweetness. Thus there is a tug-of-war, and the life of the ear departs.

verses.devanagari: কৃষ্ণ-অঙ্গ সুশীতল, কি কহিমু তার বল,\\nছটায় জিনে কোটীন্দু-চন্দন ।\\nসশৈল নারীর বক্ষ, তাহা আকর্ষিতে দক্ষ,\\nআকর্ষয়ে নারীগণ-মন ॥২১॥
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇa-aṅga suśītala, ki kahimu tāra bala,\\nchaṭāya jine koṭīndu-candana\\nsaśaila nārīra vakṣa, tāhā ākarṣite dakṣa,\\nākarṣaye nārī-gaṇa-mana
verses.translation: "Kṛṣṇa's transcendental body is so cool that it cannot be compared even to sandalwood pulp or to millions upon millions of moons. It expertly attracts the breasts of all women, which resemble high hills. Indeed, the transcendental body of Kṛṣṇa attracts the minds of all women within the three worlds.

verses.devanagari: কৃষ্ণাঙ্গ — সৌরভভর, মৃগমদ-মদহর,\\nনীলোৎপলের হরে গর্ব-ধন ।\\nজগৎ-নারীর নাসা, তার ভিতর পাতে বাসা,\\nনারীগণে করে আকর্ষণ ॥২২॥
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇāṅga—saurabhya-bhara, mṛga-mada-mada-hara,\\nnīlotpalera hare garva-dhana\\njagat-nārīra nāsā, tāra bhitara pāte vāsā,\\nnārī-gaṇe kare ākarṣaṇa
verses.translation: "The fragrance of Kṛṣṇa's body is more maddening than the aroma of musk, and it surpasses the fragrance of the bluish lotus flower. It enters the nostrils of all the women of the world and, making a nest there, thus attracts them.

verses.devanagari: কৃষ্ণের অধরামৃত, তাতে কর্পূর মন্দস্মিত,\\nস্ব-মাধুর্যে হরে নারীর মন ।\\nঅন্যত্র ছাড়ায় লোভ, না পাইলে মনে ক্ষোভ,\\nব্রজনারীগণের মূলধন ।।” ॥ ২৩ ॥
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇera adharāmṛta, tāte karpūra manda-smita,\\nsva-mādhurye hare nārīra mana\\nanyatra chāḍāya lobha, nā pāile mane kṣobha,\\nvraja-nārī-gaṇera mūla-dhana"
verses.translation: "Kṛṣṇa's lips are so sweet when combined with the camphor of His gentle smile that they attract the minds of all women, forcing them to give up all other attractions. If the sweetness of Kṛṣṇa's smile is unobtainable, great mental difficulties and lamentation result. That sweetness is the only wealth of the gopīs of Vṛndāvana."

verses.devanagari: এত কহি’ গৌরহরি, দুইজনার কণ্ঠ ধরি’,\\nকহে, — ‘শুন, স্বরূপ-রামরায় ।\\nকাহাঁ করোঁ, কাহাঁ যাঙ, কাহাঁ গেলে কৃষ্ণ পাঙ,\\nদুঁহে মোরে কহ সে উপায়’ ॥২৪॥
verses.transliteration: eta kahi' gaurahari, dui-janāra kaṇṭha dhari',\\nkahe,—'śuna, svarūpa-rāmarāya\\nkāhāṅ karoṅ, kāhāṅ yāṅa, kāhāṅ gele kṛṣṇa pāṅa,\\nduṅhe more kaha se upāya'
verses.translation: After speaking in this way, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu caught hold of the necks of Rāmānanda Rāya and Svarūpa Dāmodara. Then the Lord said, "My dear friends, please listen to Me. What shall I do? Where shall I go? Where can I go to get Kṛṣṇa? Please, both of you, tell Me how I can find Him."

verses.devanagari: এইমত গৌরপ্রভু প্রতি দিনে-দিনে ।\\nবিলাপ করেন স্বরূপ-রামানন্দ-সনে ॥২৫॥
verses.transliteration: ei-mata gaura-prabhu prati dine-dine\\nvilāpa karena svarūpa-rāmānanda-sane
verses.translation: Thus absorbed in transcendental pain, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu lamented day after day in the company of Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī and Rāmānanda Rāya.

verses.devanagari: সেই দুইজন প্রভুরে করে আশ্বাসন ।\\nস্বরূপ গায়, রায় করে শ্লোক পঠন ॥২৬॥
verses.transliteration: sei dui-jana prabhure kare āśvāsana\\nsvarūpa gāya, rāya kare śloka paṭhana
verses.translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī would sing appropriate songs, and Rāmānanda Rāya would recite suitable verses to enhance the ecstatic mood of the Lord. In this way they were able to pacify Him.

verses.devanagari: কর্ণামৃত, বিদ্যাপতি, শ্রীগীতগোবিন্দ ।\\nইহার শ্লোক-গীতে প্রভুর করায় আনন্দ ॥২৭॥
verses.transliteration: karṇāmṛta, vidyāpati, śrī-gīta-govinda\\nihāra śloka-gīte prabhura karāya ānanda
verses.translation: The Lord especially liked to hear Bilvamaṅgala Ṭhākura's Kṛṣṇa-karṇāmṛta, the poetry of Vidyāpati and Śrī Gīta-govinda by Jayadeva Gosvāmī. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu felt great pleasure in His heart when His associates chanted verses from these books.

verses.devanagari: একদিন মহাপ্রভু সমুদ্র-তীরে যাইতে ।\\nপুষ্পের উদ্যান তথা দেখেন আচম্বিতে ॥২৮॥
verses.transliteration: eka-dina mahāprabhu samudra-tīre yāite\\npuṣpera udyāna tathā dekhena ācambite
verses.translation: One day, while going to the beach by the sea, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu suddenly saw a flower garden.

verses.devanagari: বৃন্দাবন-ভ্রমে তাহাঁ পশিলা ধাঞা ।\\nপ্রেমাবেশে বুলে তাহাঁ কৃষ্ণ অন্বেষিয়া ॥২৯॥
verses.transliteration: vṛndāvana-bhrame tāhāṅ paśilā dhāñā\\npremāveśe bule tāhāṅ kṛṣṇa anveṣiyā
verses.translation: Lord Caitanya mistook that garden for Vṛndāvana and very quickly entered it. Absorbed in ecstatic love of Kṛṣṇa, He wandered throughout the garden, searching for Him.

verses.devanagari: রাসে রাধা লঞা কৃষ্ণ অন্তর্ধান কৈলা  ।\\nপাছে সখীগণ যৈছে চাহি’ বেড়াইলা ॥৩০॥
verses.transliteration: rāse rādhā lañā kṛṣṇa antardhāna kailā\\npāche sakhī-gaṇa yaiche cāhi' beḍāilā
verses.translation: After Kṛṣṇa disappeared with Rādhārāṇī during the rāsa dance, the gopīs wandered in the forest looking for Him. In the same way, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu wandered in that garden by the sea.

verses.devanagari: সেই ভাবাবেশে প্রভু প্রতি-তরুলতা  ।\\nশ্লোক পড়ি’ পড়ি’ চাহি’ বুলে যথা তথা ॥৩১॥
verses.transliteration: sei bhāvāveśe prabhu prati-taru-latā\\nśloka paḍi' paḍi' cāhi' bule yathā tathā
verses.translation: Absorbed in the ecstatic mood of the gopīs, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu wandered here and there. He began to inquire after Kṛṣṇa by quoting verses to all the trees and creepers.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then quoted the following three verses from
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
(10.30.9,7,8).

verses.devanagari: চূতপ্রিয়াল-পনসাসনকোবিদার-\\nজম্ব্বর্কবিল্ববকুলাম্রকদম্বনীপাঃ ।\\nযেঽন্যে পরার্থভবকা যমুনোপকূলাঃ\\nশংসন্তু কৃষ্ণপদবীং রহিতাত্মনাং নঃ ॥৩২॥
verses.transliteration: cūta-priyāla-panasāsana-kovidāra-\\njambv-arka-bilva-bakulāmra-kadamba-nīpāḥ\\nye 'nye parārtha-bhavakā yamunopakūlāḥ\\nśaṁsantu kṛṣṇa-padavīṁ rahitātmanāṁ naḥ
verses.translation: "(The gopīs said:) 'O cūta tree, priyāla tree, pasana, āsana and kovidāra! O jambu tree, O arka tree, O bel, bakula and mango! O kadamba tree, O nīpa tree and all other trees living on the bank of the Yamunā for the welfare of others, please let us know where Kṛṣṇa has gone. We have lost our minds and are almost dead.

verses.devanagari: কচ্চিত্তুলসি কল্যাণি গোবিন্দচরণপ্রিয়ে ।\\nসহ ত্বালিকুলৈর্বিভ্রদ্দৃষ্টস্তেঽতিপ্রিয়োঽচ্যুতঃ ॥৩৩॥
verses.transliteration: kaccit tulasi kalyāṇi\\ngovinda-caraṇa-priye\\nsaha tvāli-kulair bibhrad\\ndṛṣṭas te 'ti-priyo 'cyutaḥ
verses.translation: “ 'O all-auspicious tulasī plant, you are very dear to Govinda's lotus feet, and He is very dear to you. Have you seen Kṛṣṇa walking here wearing a garland of your leaves, surrounded by a swarm of bumblebees?

verses.devanagari: মালত্যদর্শি বঃ কচ্চিন্মল্লিকে জাতি যূথিকে ।\\nপ্রীতিং বো জনয়ন্ যাতঃ করস্পর্শেন মাধবঃ ॥৩৪॥
verses.transliteration: mālaty adarśi vaḥ kaccin\\nmallike jāti yūthike\\nprītiṁ vo janayan yātaḥ\\nkara-sparśena mādhavaḥ
verses.translation: “ 'O plants of mālatī flowers, mallikā flowers, jātī and yūthikā flowers, have you seen Kṛṣṇa passing this way, touching you with His hand to give you pleasure?' "

verses.devanagari: আম্র, পনস, পিয়াল, জম্বু, কোবিদার ।\\nতীর্থবাসী সবে, কর পর-উপকার ॥৩৫॥
verses.transliteration: āmra, panasa, piyāla, jambu, kovidāra\\ntīrtha-vāsī sabe, kara para-upakāra
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu continued: " 'O mango tree, O jackfruit tree, O piyāla, jambu and kovidāra trees, you are all inhabitants of a holy place. Therefore kindly act for the welfare of others.

verses.devanagari: কৃষ্ণ তোমার ইহাঁ আইলা, পাইলা দরশন ?\\nকৃষ্ণের উদ্দেশ কহি’ রাখহ জীবন ॥৩৬॥
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇa tomāra ihāṅ āilā, pāilā daraśana?\\nkṛṣṇera uddeśa kahi' rākhaha jīvana
verses.translation: “ 'Have you seen Kṛṣṇa coming this way? Kindly tell us which way He has gone and save our lives.'

verses.devanagari: উত্তর না পাঞা পুনঃ করে অনুমান  ।\\nএই সব — পুরুষ-জাতি, কৃষ্ণের সখার সমান ॥৩৭॥
verses.transliteration: uttara nā pāñā punaḥ kare anumāna\\nei saba—puruṣa-jāti, kṛṣṇera sakhāra samāna
verses.translation: "When the trees did not reply, the gopīs guessed,'Since all of these trees belong to the male class, all of them must be friends of Kṛṣṇa.

verses.devanagari: এ কেনে কহিবে কৃষ্ণের উদ্দেশ আমায় ? এ — স্ত্রীজাতি লতা, আমার সখীপ্রায় ॥৩৮॥
verses.transliteration: e kene kahibe kṛṣṇera uddeśa āmāya?\\ne—strī-jāti latā, āmāra sakhī-prāya
verses.translation: “ 'Why should the trees tell us where Kṛṣṇa has gone? Let us rather inquire from the creepers; they are female and therefore are like friends to us.

verses.devanagari: অবশ্য কহিবে, — পাঞাছে কৃষ্ণের দর্শনে ।\\nএত অনুমানি’ পুছে তুলস্যাদি-গণে ॥৩৯॥
verses.transliteration: avaśya kahibe,—pāñāche kṛṣṇera darśane\\neta anumāni' puche tulasy-ādi-gaṇe
verses.translation: “ 'They will certainly tell us where Kṛṣṇa has gone, since they have seen Him personally.' Guessing in this way, the gopīs inquired from the plants and creepers, headed by tulasī.

verses.devanagari: “তুলসি, মালতি, যূথি, মাধবি, মল্লিকে ।\\nতোমার প্রিয় কৃষ্ণ আইলা তোমার অন্তিকে ? ॥ ৪০ ॥
verses.transliteration: "tulasi, mālati, yūthi, mādhavi, mallike\\ntomāra priya kṛṣṇa āilā tomāra antike?
verses.translation: “ 'O tulasī! O mālatī! O yūthī, mādhavī and mallikā! Kṛṣṇa is very dear to you. Therefore He must have come near you.

verses.devanagari: তুমি-সব — হও আমার সখীর সমান ।\\nকৃষ্ণোদ্দেশ কহি’ সবে রাখহ পরাণ ।।” ॥ ৪১ ॥
verses.transliteration: tumi-saba—hao āmāra sakhīra samāna\\nkṛṣṇoddeśa kahi' sabe rākhaha parāṇa"
verses.translation: “ 'You are all just like dear friends to us. Kindly tell us which way Kṛṣṇa has gone and save our lives.'

verses.devanagari: উত্তর না পাঞা পুনঃ ভাবেন অন্তরে ।\\n‘এহ — কৃষ্ণদাসী, ভয়ে না কহে আমারে’ ॥৪২॥
verses.transliteration: uttara nā pāñā punaḥ bhāvena antare\\n'eha—kṛṣṇa-dāsī, bhaye nā kahe āmāre'
verses.translation: "When they still received no reply, the gopīs thought, 'These plants are all Kṛṣṇa's maidservants, and out of fear they will not speak to us.'

verses.devanagari: আগে মৃগীগণ দেখি’ কৃষ্ণাঙ্গগন্ধ পাঞা ।\\nতার মুখ দেখি’ পুছেন নির্ণয় করিয়া ॥৪৩॥
verses.transliteration: āge mṛgī-gaṇa dekhi' kṛṣṇāṅga-gandha pāñā\\ntāra mukha dekhi' puchena nirṇaya kariyā
verses.translation: "The gopīs then came upon a group of she-deer. Smelling the aroma of Kṛṣṇa's body and seeing the faces of the deer, the gopīs inquired from them to ascertain if Kṛṣṇa was nearby.

verses.devanagari: অপ্যেণ-পত্ন্যুপগতঃ প্রিয়য়েহ গাত্রৈ-\\nস্তন্বন্ দৃশাং সখি সুনির্বৃতিমচ্যুতো বঃ ।\\nকান্তাঙ্গসঙ্গকুচকুঙ্কুম-রঞ্জিতায়াঃ\\nকুন্দস্রজঃ কুলপতেরিহ বাতি গন্ধঃ ॥৪৪॥
verses.transliteration: apy eṇa-patny upagataḥ priyayeha gātrais\\ntanvan dṛśāṁ sakhi sunirvṛtim acyuto vaḥ\\nkāntāṅga-saṅga-kuca-kuṅkuma-rañjitāyāḥ\\nkunda-srajaḥ kula-pater iha vāti gandhaḥ
verses.translation: “ 'O wife of the deer, Lord Kṛṣṇa has been embracing His beloved, and thus the kuṅkuma powder on Her raised breasts has covered His garland of kunda flowers. The fragrance of this garland is flowing here. O my dear friend, have you seen Kṛṣṇa passing this way with His dearmost companion, increasing the pleasure of the eyes of all of you?'
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This verse is quoted from
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
(10.30.11).

verses.devanagari: “কহ, মৃগি, রাধা-সহ শ্রীকৃষ্ণ সর্বথা ।\\nতোমায় সুখ দিতে আইলা? নাহিক অন্যথা ॥৪৫॥
verses.transliteration: "kaha, mṛgi, rādhā-saha śrī-kṛṣṇa sarvathā\\ntomāya sukha dite āilā? nāhika anyathā
verses.translation: “ 'O dear doe, Śrī Kṛṣṇa is always very pleased to give you pleasure. Kindly inform us whether He passed this way in the company of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī. We think They must certainly have come this way.

verses.devanagari: রাধা-প্রিয়সখী আমরা, নহি বহিরঙ্গ ।\\nদূর হৈতে জানি তার যৈছে অঙ্গ-গন্ধ ॥৪৬॥
verses.transliteration: rādhā-priya-sakhī āmarā, nahi bahiraṅga\\ndūra haite jāni tāra yaiche aṅga-gandha
verses.translation: “ 'We are not outsiders. Being very dear friends of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī, we can perceive the bodily fragrance of Kṛṣṇa from a distance.

verses.devanagari: রাধা-অঙ্গ-সঙ্গে কুচকুঙ্কুম-ভূষিত ।\\nকৃষ্ণ-কুন্দমালা-গন্ধে বায়ু — সুবাসিত ॥৪৭॥
verses.transliteration: rādhā-aṅga-saṅge kuca-kuṅkuma-bhūṣita\\nkṛṣṇa-kunda-mālā-gandhe vāyu—suvāsita
verses.translation: “ 'Kṛṣṇa has been embracing Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī, and the kuṅkuma powder on Her breasts has mixed with the garland of kunda flowers decorating His body. The fragrance of the garland has scented the entire atmosphere.

verses.devanagari: কৃষ্ণ ইহাঁ ছাড়ি’ গেলা, ইহোঁ — বিরহিণী ।\\nকিবা উত্তর দিবে এই — না শুনে কাহিনী ।।” ॥ ৪৮ ॥
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇa ihāṅ chāḍi' gelā, ihoṅ—virahiṇī\\nkibā uttara dibe ei—nā śune kāhinī"
verses.translation: “ 'Lord Kṛṣṇa has left this place, and therefore the deer are feeling separation. They do not hear our words; therefore how can they reply?'

verses.devanagari: আগে বৃক্ষগণ দেখে পুষ্প ফলভরে ।\\nশাখা সব পড়িয়াছে পৃথিবী-উপরে ॥৪৯॥
verses.transliteration: āge vṛkṣa-gaṇa dekhe puṣpa-phala-bhare\\nśākhā saba paḍiyāche pṛthivī-upare
verses.translation: "The gopīs then came upon many trees so laden with fruits and flowers that their branches bent down to the ground.

verses.devanagari: কৃষ্ণে দেখি’ এই সব করেন নমস্কার ।\\nকৃষ্ণগমন পুছে তারে করিয়া নির্ধার ॥৫০॥
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇe dekhi' ei saba karena namaskāra\\nkṛṣṇa-gamana puche tāre kariyā nirdhāra
verses.translation: "The gopīs thought that because all the trees must have seen Kṛṣṇa pass by they were offering respectful obeisances to Him. To be certain, the gopīs inquired from the trees.

verses.devanagari: বাহুং প্রিয়াংস উপধায় গৃহীতপদ্মো\\nরামানুজস্তুলসিকালিকুলৈর্মদান্ধৈঃ ।\\nঅন্বীয়মান ইহ বস্তরবঃ প্রণামং\\nকিংবাভিনন্দতি চরন্ প্রণয়াবলোকৈঃ ॥৫১॥
verses.transliteration: bāhuṁ priyāṁsa upadhāya gṛhīta-padmo\\nrāmānujas tulasikāli-kulair madāndhaiḥ\\nanvīyamāna iha vas taravaḥ praṇāmaṁ\\nkiṁvābhinandati caran praṇayāvalokaiḥ
verses.translation: “ 'O trees, kindly tell us whether Balarāma's younger brother, Kṛṣṇa, welcomed your obeisances with loving glances as He passed this way, resting one hand on the shoulder of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī, holding a lotus flower in the other, and being followed by a swarm of bumblebees maddened by the fragrance of tulasī leaves.'
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This verse is quoted from
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
(10.30.12).

verses.devanagari: প্রিয়া-মুখে ভৃঙ্গ পড়ে, তাহা নিবারিতে ।\\nলীলাপদ্ম চালাইতে হৈল অন্যচিত্তে ॥৫২॥
verses.transliteration: priyā-mukhe bhṛṅga paḍe, tāhā nivārite\\nlīlā-padma cālāite haila anya-citte
verses.translation: “ 'To stop the bumblebees from landing on the face of His beloved, He whisked them away with the lotus flower in His hand, and thus His mind was slightly diverted.

verses.devanagari: তোমার প্রণামে কি কৈরাছেন অবধান ?\\nকিবা নাহি করেন, কহ বচনপ্রমাণ ॥৫৩॥
verses.transliteration: tomāra praṇāme ki kairāchena avadhāna?\\nkibā nāhi karena, kaha vacana-pramāṇa
verses.translation: “ 'Did He or did He not pay attention while You offered Him obeisances? Kindly give evidence supporting your words.

verses.devanagari: কৃষ্ণের বিয়োগে এই সেবক দুঃখিত ।\\nকিবা উত্তর দিবে? ইহার নাহিক সম্বিৎ ।।” ॥ ৫৪ ॥
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇera viyoge ei sevaka duḥkhita\\nkibā uttara dibe? ihāra nāhika samvit"
verses.translation: “ 'Separation from Kṛṣṇa has made these servants very unhappy. Having lost consciousness, how can they answer us?'

verses.devanagari: এত বলি’ আগে চলে যমুনার কূলে ।\\nদেখে, — তাহাঁ কৃষ্ণ হয় কদম্বের তলে ॥৫৫॥
verses.transliteration: eta bali' āge cale yamunāra kūle\\ndekhe,—tāhāṅ kṛṣṇa haya kadambera tale
verses.translation: "Saying this, the gopīs stepped onto the beach by the Yamunā River. There they saw Lord Kṛṣṇa beneath a kadamba tree.

verses.devanagari: কোটিমন্মথমোহন মুরলীবদন ।\\nঅপার সৌন্দর্যে হরে জগন্নেত্র-মন ॥৫৬॥
verses.transliteration: koṭi-manmatha-mohana muralī-vadana\\napāra saundarye hare jagan-netra-mana
verses.translation: "Standing there with His flute to His lips, Kṛṣṇa, who enchants millions upon millions of Cupids, attracted the eyes and minds of all the world with His unlimited beauty."

verses.devanagari: সৌন্দর্য দেখিয়া ভূমে পড়ে মূর্চ্ছা পাঞা ।\\nহেনকালে স্বরূপাদি মিলিলা আসিয়া ॥৫৭॥
verses.transliteration: saundarya dekhiyā bhūme paḍe mūrcchā pāñā\\nhena-kāle svarūpādi mililā āsiyā
verses.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu saw the transcendental beauty of Kṛṣṇa, He fell down on the ground unconscious. At that time, all the devotees, headed by Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī, joined Him in the garden.

verses.devanagari: পূর্ববৎ সর্বাঙ্গে সাত্ত্বিকভাবসকল ।\\nঅন্তরে আনন্দ-আস্বাদ, বাহিরে বিহ্বল ॥৫৮॥
verses.transliteration: pūrvavat sarvāṅge sāttvika-bhāva-sakala\\nantare ānanda-āsvāda, bāhire vihvala
verses.translation: Just as before, they saw all the symptoms of transcendental ecstatic love manifested in the body of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Although externally He appeared bewildered, He was tasting transcendental bliss within.

verses.devanagari: পূর্ববৎ সবে মিলি’ করাইলা চেতন ।\\nউঠিয়া চৌদিকে প্রভু করেন দর্শন ॥৫৯॥
verses.transliteration: pūrvavat sabe mili' karāilā cetana\\nuṭhiyā caudike prabhu karena darśana
verses.translation: Once again all the devotees brought Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu back to consciousness by a concerted effort. Then the Lord got up and began wandering here and there, looking all around.

verses.devanagari: “কাহাঁ গেলা কৃষ্ণ? এখনি পাইনু দরশন !\\nতাঁহার সৌন্দর্য মোর হরিল নেত্র-মন ! ॥ ৬০ ॥
verses.transliteration: "kāhāṅ gelā kṛṣṇa? ekhani pāinu daraśana!\\ntāṅhāra saundarya mora harila netra-mana!
verses.translation: Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "Where has My Kṛṣṇa gone? I saw Him just now, and His beauty has captured My eyes and mind.

verses.devanagari: পুনঃ কেনে না দেখিয়ে মুরলী-বদন!\\nতাঁহার দর্শন-লোভে ভ্রময় নয়ন ।।” ॥ ৬১ ॥
verses.transliteration: punaḥ kene nā dekhiye muralī-vadana!\\ntāṅhāra darśana-lobhe bhramaya nayana"
verses.translation: "Why can't I again see Kṛṣṇa holding His flute to His lips? My eyes are wandering in hopes of seeing Him once more."

verses.devanagari: বিশাখারে রাধা যৈছে শ্লোক কহিলা ।\\nসেই শ্লোক মহাপ্রভু পড়িতে লাগিলা ॥৬২॥
verses.transliteration: viśākhāre rādhā yaiche śloka kahilā\\nsei śloka mahāprabhu paḍite lāgilā
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then recited the following verse, which was spoken by Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī to Her dear friend Viśākhā.

verses.devanagari: নবাম্বুদ-লসদ্দ্যুতির্নবতড়িন্মনোজ্ঞাম্বরঃ\\nসুচিত্রমুরলীস্ফুরচ্ছরদমন্দচন্দ্রাননঃ ।\\nময়ূরদলভূষিতঃ সুভগতারহারপ্রভঃ\\nস মে মদনমোহনঃ সখি তনোতি নেত্রস্পৃহাম্ ॥৬৩॥
verses.transliteration: navāmbuda-lasad-dyutir nava-taḍin-manojñāmbaraḥ\\nsucitra-muralī-sphurac-charad-amanda-candrānanaḥ\\nmayūra-dala-bhūṣitaḥ subhaga-tāra-hāra-prabhaḥ\\nsa me madana-mohanaḥ sakhi tanoti netra-spṛhām
verses.translation: "My dear friend, the luster of Kṛṣṇa's body is more brilliant than a newly formed cloud, and His yellow dress is more attractive than newly arrived lightning. A peacock feather decorates His head, and on His neck hangs a lovely necklace of brilliant pearls. As He holds His charming flute to His lips, His face looks as beautiful as the full autumn moon. By such beauty, Madana-mohana, the enchanter of Cupid, is increasing the desire of my eyes to see Him."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This verse is also found in the
Govinda-līlāmṛta
(8.4).

verses.devanagari: নবঘনস্নিগ্ধবর্ণ, দলিতাঞ্জন-চিক্কণ,\\nইন্দীবর-নিন্দি সুকোমল ।\\nজিনি’ উপমান-গণ, হরে সবার নেত্র-মন,\\nকৃষ্ণকান্তি পরম প্রবল ॥৬৪॥
verses.transliteration: nava-ghana-snigdha-varṇa, dalitāñjana-cikkaṇa,\\nindīvara-nindi sukomala\\njini' upamāna-gaṇa, hare sabāra netra-mana,\\nkṛṣṇa-kānti parama prabala
verses.translation: Caitanya Mahāprabhu continued: "Śrī Kṛṣṇa's complexion is as polished as powdered eye ointment. It surpasses the beauty of a newly formed cloud and is softer than a blue lotus flower. Indeed, His complexion is so pleasing that it attracts the eyes and mind of everyone, and it is so powerful that it defies all comparison.

verses.devanagari: কহ, সখি, কি করি উপায় ?\\nকৃষ্ণাদ্ভুত বলাহক, মোর নেত্র-চাতক,\\nনা দেখি’ পিয়াসে মরি’ যায় ।। ৬৫ ।। ধ্রু ।। ॥৬৫॥
verses.transliteration: kaha, sakhi, ki kari upāya?\\nkṛṣṇādbhuta balāhaka, mora netra-cātaka,\\nnā dekhi' piyāse mari' yāya
verses.translation: "My dear friend, please tell me what I should do. Kṛṣṇa is as attractive as a wonderful cloud, and My eyes are just like cātaka birds, which are dying of thirst because they do not see such a cloud.

verses.devanagari: সৌদামিনী পীতাম্বর, স্থির নহে নিরন্তর,\\nমুক্তাহার বকপাঁতি ভাল ।\\nইন্দ্রধনু-শিখিপাখা, উপরে দিয়াছে দেখা,\\nআর ধনু বৈজয়ন্তী-মাল ॥৬৬॥
verses.transliteration: saudāminī pītāmbara, sthira nahe nirantara,\\nmuktā-hāra baka-pāṅti bhāla\\nindra-dhanu śikhi-pākhā, upare diyāche dekhā,\\nāra dhanu vaijayantī-māla
verses.translation: "Kṛṣṇa's yellow dress looks exactly like restless lightning in the sky, and the pearl necklace on His neck appears like a line of ducks flying below a cloud. Both the peacock feather on His head and His vaijayantī garland [containing flowers of five colors] resemble rainbows.

verses.devanagari: মুরলীর কলধ্বনি, মধুর গর্জন শুনি’,\\nবৃন্দাবনে নাচে ময়ূরচয় ।\\nঅকলঙ্ক পূর্ণকল, লাবণ্য-জ্যোৎস্না ঝলমল,\\nচিত্রচন্দ্রের তাহাতে উদয় ॥৬৭॥
verses.transliteration: muralīra kala-dhvani, madhura garjana śuni',\\nvṛndāvane nāce mayūra-caya\\nakalaṅka pūrṇa-kala, lāvaṇya-jyotsnā jhalamala,\\ncitra-candrera tāhāte udaya
verses.translation: "The luster of Kṛṣṇa's body is as beautiful as a spotless full moon that has just risen, and the vibration of His flute sounds exactly like the sweet thundering of a newly formed cloud. When the peacocks in Vṛndāvana hear that vibration, they all begin to dance.

verses.devanagari: লীলামৃত-বরিষণে, সিঞ্চে চৌদ্দ ভুবনে,\\nহেন মেঘ যবে দেখা দিল ।\\nদুর্দৈব-ঝঞ্ঝাপবনে, মেঘে নিল অন্যস্থানে,\\nমরে চাতক, পিতে না পাইল ॥৬৮॥
verses.transliteration: līlāmṛta-variṣaṇe, siñce caudda bhuvane'\\nhena megha yabe dekhā dila\\ndurdaiva-jhañjhā-pavane, meghe nila anya-sthāne,\\nmare cātaka, pite nā pāila
verses.translation: "The cloud of Kṛṣṇa's pastimes is drenching the fourteen worlds with a shower of nectar. Unfortunately, when that cloud appeared, a whirlwind arose and blew it away from Me. Being unable to see the cloud, the cātaka bird of My eyes is almost dead from thirst."

verses.devanagari: পুনঃ কহে, — ‘হায় হায়, পড় পড় রামরায়’,\\nকহে প্রভু গদ্গদ আখ্যানে ।\\nরামানন্দ পড়ে শ্লোক, শুনি’ প্রভুর হর্ষ-শোক,\\nআপনে প্রভু করেন ব্যাখ্যানে ॥৬৯॥
verses.transliteration: punaḥ kahe,—'hāya hāya, paḍa paḍa rāma-raya',\\nkahe prabhu gadgada ākhyāne\\nrāmānanda paḍe śloka, śuni' prabhura harṣa-śoka,\\nāpane prabhu karena vyākhyāne
verses.translation: In a faltering voice, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu again said, "Alas, go on reading, Rāma Rāya." Thus Rāmānanda Rāya began to read a verse. While listening to this verse, the Lord was sometimes very jubilant and sometimes overcome by lamentation. Afterwards the Lord personally explained the verse.

verses.devanagari: বীক্ষ্যালকাবৃতমুখং তব কুণ্ডলশ্রি\\nগণ্ডস্থলাধরসুধং হসিতাবলোকম্ ।\\nদত্তাভয়ঞ্চ ভুজদণ্ডযুগং বিলোক্য\\nবক্ষঃ শ্রিয়ৈকরমণঞ্চ ভবাম দাস্যঃ ॥৭০॥
verses.transliteration: vīkṣyālakāvṛta-mukhaṁ tava kuṇḍala-śri-\\ngaṇḍa-sthalādhara-sudhaṁ hasitāvalokam\\ndattābhayaṁ ca bhuja-daṇḍa-yugaṁ vilokya\\nvakṣaḥ śriyaika-ramaṇaṁ ca bhavāma dāsyaḥ
verses.translation: "Dear Kṛṣṇa, by seeing Your beautiful face decorated with tresses of hair, by seeing the beauty of Your earrings falling on Your cheeks, and by seeing the nectar of Your lips, the beauty of Your smiling glances, Your two arms, which assure complete fearlessness, and Your broad chest, whose beauty arouses conjugal attraction, we have simply surrendered ourselves to becoming Your maidservants.'
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This verse quoted from
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
(10.29.39) was spoken by the
gopīs
when they arrived before Kṛṣṇa for the
rāsa
dance.

verses.devanagari: কৃষ্ণ জিনি’ পদ্ম-চান্দ, পাতিয়াছে মুখ ফান্দ,\\nতাতে অধর-মধুস্মিত চার ।\\nব্রজনারী আসি’ আসি’, ফান্দে পড়ি’ হয় দাসী,\\nছাড়ি’ লাজ-পতি-ঘর-দ্বার ॥৭১॥
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇa jini' padma-cānda, pātiyāche mukha phānda,\\ntāte adhara-madhu-smita cāra\\nvraja-nārī āsi' āsi', phānde paḍi' haya dāsī,\\nchāḍi' lāja-pati-ghara-dvāra
verses.translation: "After conquering the moon and the lotus flower, Kṛṣṇa wished to capture the doelike gopīs. Thus He spread the noose of His beautiful face, and within that noose He placed the bait of His sweet smile to misguide the gopīs. The gopīs fell prey to that trap and became Kṛṣṇa's maidservants, giving up their homes, families, husbands and prestige.

verses.devanagari: বান্ধব কৃষ্ণ করে ব্যাধের আচার ।\\nনাহি মানে ধর্মাধর্ম, হরে নারী-মৃগী-মর্ম,\\nকরে নানা উপায় তাহার ।। ৭২ ।। ধ্রু ।। ॥৭২॥
verses.transliteration: bāndhava kṛṣṇa kare vyādhera ācāra\\nnāhi māne dharmādharma, hare nārī-mṛgī-marma,\\nkare nānā upāya tāhāra
verses.translation: "My dear friend, Kṛṣṇa acts just like a hunter. This hunter does not care for piety or impiety; He simply creates many devices to conquer the cores of the hearts of the doelike gopīs.

verses.devanagari: গণ্ডস্থল ঝলমল, নাচে মকর-কুণ্ডল,\\nসেই নৃত্যে হরে নারীচয় ।\\nসস্মিত কটাক্ষ-বাণে, তা-সবার হৃদয়ে হানে,\\nনারী-বধে নাহি কিছু ভয় ॥৭৩॥
verses.transliteration: gaṇḍa-sthala jhalamala, nāce makara-kuṇḍala,\\nsei nṛtye hare nārī-caya\\nsasmita kaṭākṣa-bāṇe, tā-sabāra hṛdaye hāne,\\nnārī-vadhe nāhi kichu bhaya
verses.translation: "The earrings dancing on Kṛṣṇa's cheeks are shaped like sharks, and they shine very brightly. These dancing earrings attract the minds of all women. Over and above this, Kṛṣṇa pierces the hearts of women with the arrows of His sweetly smiling glances. He is not at all afraid to kill women in this way.

verses.devanagari: অতি উচ্চ সুবিস্তার, লক্ষ্মী-শ্রীবৎস-অলঙ্কার,\\nকৃষ্ণের যে ডাকাতিয়া বক্ষ ।\\nব্রজদেবী লক্ষ লক্ষ, তা-সবার মনোবক্ষ,\\nহরিদাসী করিবারে দক্ষ ॥৭৪॥
verses.transliteration: ati ucca suvistāra, lakṣmī-śrīvatsa-alaṅkāra,\\nkṛṣṇera ye ḍākātiyā vakṣa\\nvraja-devī lakṣa lakṣa, tā-sabāra mano-vakṣa,\\nhari-dāsī karibāre dakṣa
verses.translation: "On Kṛṣṇa's chest are the ornaments of Śrīvatsa and the mark indicating the residence of the goddess of fortune. His chest, which is as broad as a plunderer's, attracts thousands upon thousands of damsels of Vraja, conquering their minds and breasts by force. Thus they all become maidservants of the Supreme Personality of Godhead.

verses.devanagari: সুললিত দীর্ঘার্গল, কৃষ্ণের ভুজযুগল,\\nভুজ নহে, — কৃষ্ণসর্পকায় ।\\nদুই শৈল-ছিদ্রে পৈশে, নারীর হৃদয়ে দংশে,\\nমরে নারী সে বিষজ্বালায় ॥৭৫॥
verses.transliteration: sulalita dīrghārgala, kṛṣṇera bhuja-yugala,\\nbhuja nahe,—kṛṣṇa-sarpa-kāya\\ndui śaila-chidre paiśe, nārīra hṛdaye daṁśe,\\nmare nārī se viṣa-jvālāya
verses.translation: "The two very beautiful arms of Kṛṣṇa are just like long bolts. They also resemble the bodies of black snakes that enter the space between the two hill- The Transcendental Madness of Lord Caitanya like breasts of women and bite their hearts. The women then die from the burning poison.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
In other words, the
gopīs
become very agitated by lusty desires; they are burning due to the poisonous bite inflicted by the black snakes of Kṛṣṇa's beautiful arms.

verses.devanagari: কৃষ্ণ-কর-পদতল, কোটিচন্দ্র-সুশীতল,\\nজিনি’ কর্পূর-বেণামূল-চন্দন ।\\nএকবার যার স্পর্শে, স্মরজ্বালা-বিষ নাশে,\\nযার স্পর্শে লুব্ধ নারী-মন ॥৭৬॥
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇa-kara-pada-tala, koṭi-candra-suśītala,\\njini' karpūra-veṇā-mūla-candana\\neka-bāra yāra sparśe, smara-jvālā-viṣa nāśe,\\nyāra sparśe lubdha nārī-mana
verses.translation: "The combined cooling effect of camphor, roots of khasakhasa and sandalwood is surpassed by the coolness of Kṛṣṇa's palms and the soles of His feet, which are cooler and more pleasing than millions upon millions of moons. If women are touched by them even once, their minds are enticed, and the burning poison of lusty desire for Kṛṣṇa is immediately vanquished."

verses.devanagari: এতেক বিলাপ করি’ প্রেমাবেশে গৌরহরি,\\nএই অর্থে পড়ে এক শ্লোক ।\\nযেই শ্লোক পড়ি’ রাধা, বিশাখারে কহে বাধা,\\nউঘাড়িয়া হৃদয়ের শোক ॥৭৭॥
verses.transliteration: eteka vilāpa kari' premāveśe gaurahari,\\nei arthe paḍe eka śloka\\nsei śloka paḍi' rādhā, viśākhāre kahe bādhā,\\nughāḍiyā hṛdayera śoka
verses.translation: Lamenting in ecstatic love, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then recited the following verse, which was spoken by Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī while exposing the lamentation of Her heart to Her friend Śrīmatī Viśākhā.

verses.devanagari: হরিণ্মণিকবাটিকাপ্রততহারিবক্ষঃস্থলঃ\\nস্মরার্ততরুণীমনঃকলুষহারিদোরর্গলঃ ।\\nসুধাংশুহরিচন্দনোৎপলসিতাভ্রশীতাঙ্গকঃ\\nস মে মদনমোদনঃ সখি তনোতি বক্ষঃস্পৃহাম্ ॥৭৮॥
verses.transliteration: harinmaṇi-kavāṭikā-pratata-hāri-vakṣaḥ-sthalaḥ\\nsmarārta-taruṇī-manaḥ-kaluṣa-hāri-dor-argalaḥ\\nsudhāṁśu-hari-candanotpala-sitābhra-śītāṅgakaḥ\\nsa me madana-mohanaḥ sakhi tanoti vakṣaḥ-spṛhām
verses.translation: "My dear friend, Kṛṣṇa's chest is as broad and attractive as a door made of indranīla gems, and His two arms, strong as bolts, can relieve the mental anguish of young girls distressed by lusty desires for Him. His body is cooler than the moon, sandalwood, the lotus flower and camphor. In this way, Madana-mohana, the attractor of Cupid, is increasing the desire of My breasts."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This verse is also found in the
Govinda-līlāmṛta
(8.7).

verses.devanagari: প্রভু কহে, — “কৃষ্ণ মুঞি এখনই পাইনু ।\\nআপনার দুর্দৈবে পুনঃ হারাইনু ॥৭৯॥
verses.transliteration: prabhu kahe,—"kṛṣṇa muñi ekhana-i pāinu\\nāpanāra durdaive punaḥ hārāinu
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then said, "I just now had Kṛṣṇa, but unfortunately I have lost Him again.

verses.devanagari: চঞ্চল-স্বভাব কৃষ্ণের, না রয় একস্থানে ।\\nদেখা দিয়া মন হরি’ করে অন্তর্ধানে ॥৮০॥
verses.transliteration: cañcala-svabhāva kṛṣṇera, nā raya eka-sthāne\\ndekhā diyā mana hari' kare antardhāne
verses.translation: "By nature, Kṛṣṇa is very restless; He does not stay in one place. He meets with someone, enchants his mind and then disappears.

verses.devanagari: তাসাং তৎসৌভগমদং বীক্ষ্য মানঞ্চ কেশবঃ ।\\nপ্রশমায় প্রসাদায় তত্রৈবান্তরধীয়ত ॥৮১॥
verses.transliteration: tāsāṁ tat-saubhaga-madaṁ\\nvīkṣya mānaṁ ca keśavaḥ\\npraśamāya prasādāya\\ntatraivāntaradhīyata
verses.translation: “ 'The gopīs became proud of their great fortune. To subdue their sense of superiority and show them special favor, Keśava, the subduer of even Lord Brahmā and Lord Śiva, disappeared from the rāsa dance.' "
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This verse quoted from
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
(10.29.48) was spoken by Śukadeva Gosvāmī to Mahārāja Parīkṣit.

verses.devanagari: স্বরূপ-গোসাঞিরে কহেন, — “গাও এক গীত ।\\nযাতে আমার হৃদয়ের হয়ে ত’ ‘সম্বিৎ’ ।।” ॥ ৮২ ॥
verses.transliteration: svarūpa-gosāñire kahena,—"gāo eka gīta\\nyāte āmāra hṛdayera haye ta' 'samvit' "
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then said to Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī: "Please sing a song that will bring consciousness to My heart."

verses.devanagari: স্বরূপ-গোসাঞি তবে মধুর করিয়া ।\\nগীতগোবিন্দের পদ গায় প্রভুরে শুনাঞা ॥৮৩॥
verses.transliteration: svarūpa-gosāñi tabe madhura kariyā\\ngīta-govindera pada gāya prabhure śunāñā
verses.translation: Thus for the pleasure of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī began very sweetly singing the following verse from Gīta-govinda.

verses.devanagari: রাসে হরিমিহ বিহিতবিলাসম্ ।\\nস্মরতি মনো মম কৃতপরিহাসম্ ॥৮৪॥
verses.transliteration: rāse harim iha vihita-vilāsam\\nsmarati mano mama kṛta-parihāsam
verses.translation: "Here in the arena of the\nrāsa\ndance, I remember Kṛṣṇa, who is always fond of joking and performing pastimes."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This verse is quoted from
Gīta-govinda
(2.3).

verses.devanagari: স্বরূপ-গোসাঞি যবে এই পদ গাহিলা ।\\nউঠি’ প্রেমাবেশে প্রভু নাচিতে লাগিলা ॥৮৫॥
verses.transliteration: svarūpa-gosāñi yabe ei pada gāhilā\\nuṭhi' premāveśe prabhu nācite lāgilā
verses.translation: When Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī sang this special song, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu immediately got up and began to dance in ecstatic love.

verses.devanagari: ‘অষ্টসাত্ত্বিক’ ভাব অঙ্গে প্রকট হইল ।\\nহর্ষাদি ‘ব্যভিচারী’ সব উথলিল ॥৮৬॥
verses.transliteration: 'aṣṭa-sāttvika' bhāva aṅge prakaṭa ha-ila\\nharṣādi 'vyabhicārī' saba uthalila
verses.translation: At that time, all eight kinds of spiritual transformations became manifest in Lord Caitanya's body. The thirty-three symptoms of vyabhicārī-bhāva, beginning with lamentation and jubilation, became prominent as well.

verses.devanagari: ভাবোদয়, ভাব-সন্ধি, ভাব-শাবল্য ।\\nভাবে-ভাবে মহাযুদ্ধে সবার প্রাবল্য ॥৮৭॥
verses.transliteration: bhāvodaya, bhāva-sandhi, bhāva-śābalya\\nbhāve-bhāve mahā-yuddhe sabāra prābalya
verses.translation: All the ecstatic symptoms, such as bhāvodaya, bhāva-sandhi and bhāva-śābalya, awakened in the body of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. A great fight arose between one emotion and another, and each of them became prominent.

verses.devanagari: সেই পদ পুনঃ পুনঃ করায় গায়ন ।\\nপুনঃ পুনঃ আস্বাদয়ে, করেন নর্তন ॥৮৮॥
verses.transliteration: sei pada punaḥ punaḥ karāya gāyana\\npunaḥ punaḥ āsvādaye, karena nartana
verses.translation: Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu had Svarūpa Dāmodara sing the same verse again and again. Each time he sang it, the Lord tasted it anew, and thus He danced again and again.

verses.devanagari: এইমত নৃত্য যদি হইল বহুক্ষণ ।\\nস্বরূপ-গোসাঞি পদ কৈলা সমাপন ॥৮৯॥
verses.transliteration: ei-mata nṛtya yadi ha-ila bahu-kṣaṇa\\nsvarūpa-gosāñi pada kailā samāpana
verses.translation: After the Lord had been dancing for a long time, Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī stopped singing the verse.

verses.devanagari: ‘বল্’ ‘বল্’ বলি’ প্রভু কহেন বারবার ।\\nনা গায় স্বরূপ-গোসাঞি শ্রম দেখি’ তাঁর ॥৯০॥
verses.transliteration: 'bal' 'bal' bali' prabhu kahena bāra-bāra\\nnā gāya svarūpa-gosāñi śrama dekhi' tāṅra
verses.translation: Over and over again Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "Go on! Sing! Sing!" But Svarūpa Dāmodara, seeing the Lord's fatigue, did not resume singing.

verses.devanagari: ‘বল্’ ‘বল্’ প্রভু বলেন, ভক্তগণ শুনি’ ।\\nচৌদিকেতে সবে মেলি’ করে হরিধ্বনি ॥৯১॥
verses.transliteration: 'bal' 'bal' prabhu balena, bhakta-gaṇa śuni'\\ncaudikete sabe meli' kare hari-dhvani
verses.translation: When the devotees heard Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu say, "Go on singing!" they all gathered around Him and began to chant the holy name of Hari in unison.

verses.devanagari: রামানন্দ-রায় তবে প্রভুরে বসাইলা ।\\nবীজনাদি করি’ প্রভুর শ্রম ঘুচাইলা ॥৯২॥
verses.transliteration: rāmānanda-rāya tabe prabhure vasāilā\\nvījanādi kari' prabhura śrama ghucāilā
verses.translation: At that time, Rāmānanda Rāya made the Lord sit down and dissipated His fatigue by fanning Him.

verses.devanagari: প্রভুরে লঞা গেলা সবে সমুদ্রের তীরে ।\\nস্নান করাঞা পুনঃ তাঁরে লঞা আইলা ঘরে ॥৯৩॥
verses.transliteration: prabhure lañā gelā sabe samudrera tīre\\nsnāna karāñā punaḥ tāṅre lañā āilā ghare
verses.translation: Then all the devotees took Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to the beach and bathed Him. Finally they brought Him back home.

verses.devanagari: ভোজন করাঞা প্রভুরে করাইলা শয়ন ।\\nরামানন্দ-আদি সবে গেলা নিজ-স্থান ॥৯৪॥
verses.transliteration: bhojana karāñā prabhure karāilā śayana\\nrāmānanda-ādi sabe gelā nija-sthāna
verses.translation: After they fed Him lunch, they made Him lie down. Then all the devotees, headed by Rāmānanda Rāya, returned to their respective homes.

verses.devanagari: এই ত’ কহিলুঁ প্রভুর উদ্যান-বিহার ।\\nবৃন্দাবন-ভ্রমে যাঁহা প্রবেশ তাঁহার ॥৯৫॥
verses.transliteration: ei ta' kahiluṅ prabhura udyāna-vihāra\\nvṛndāvana-bhrame yāhāṅ praveśa tāṅhāra
verses.translation: Thus I have described Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's pastimes in the garden, which He entered, mistaking it for Vṛndāvana.

verses.devanagari: প্রলাপ সহিত এই উন্মাদ-বর্ণন ।\\nশ্রীরূপ-গোসাঞি ইহা করিয়াছেন বর্ণন ॥৯৬॥
verses.transliteration: pralāpa sahita ei unmāda-varṇana\\nśrī-rūpa-gosāñi ihā kariyāchena varṇana
verses.translation: There He exhibited transcendental madness and ecstatic ravings, which Śrī Rūpa Gosvāmī has described very nicely in his Stava-mālā as follows.

verses.devanagari: পয়োরাশেস্তীরে স্ফুরদুপবনালীকলনয়া\\nমুহুর্বৃন্দারণ্যস্মরণজনিতপ্রেমবিবশঃ ।\\nক্বচিৎ কৃষ্ণাবৃত্তিপ্রচলরসনো ভক্তিরসিকঃ\\nস চৈতন্যঃ কিং মে পুনরপি দৃশোর্যাস্যতি পদম্ ॥৯৭॥
verses.transliteration: payorāśes tīre sphurad-upavanālī-kalanayā\\nmuhur vṛndāraṇya-smaraṇa-janita-prema-vivaśaḥ\\nkvacit kṛṣṇāvṛtti-pracala-rasano bhakti-rasikaḥ\\nsa caitanyaḥ kiṁ me punarapi dṛśor yāsyati padam
verses.translation: "Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is the topmost of all devotees. Sometimes, while walking on the beach, He would see a beautiful garden nearby and mistake it for the forest of Vṛndāvana. Thus He would be completely overwhelmed by ecstatic love of Kṛṣṇa and begin to dance and chant the holy name. His tongue worked incessantly as He chanted, 'Kṛṣṇa! Kṛṣṇa!' Will He again become visible before the path of My eyes?"
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This quotation is from the first
Caitanyāṣṭaka,
verse 6, in Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī's
Stava-mālā.

verses.devanagari: অনন্ত চৈতন্যলীলা না যায় লিখন ।\\nদিঙ্মাত্র দেখাঞা তাহা করিয়ে সূচন ॥৯৮॥
verses.transliteration: ananta caitanya-līlā nā yāya likhana\\ndiṅ-mātra dekhāñā tāhā kariye sūcana
verses.translation: The pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu are unlimited; it is not possible to write of them properly. I can only give an indication of them as I try to introduce them.

verses.devanagari: শ্রীরূপ-রঘুনাথ-পদে যার আশ ।\\nচৈতন্যচরিতামৃত কহে কৃষ্ণদাস ॥৯৯॥
verses.transliteration: śrī-rūpa-raghunātha-pade yāra āśa\\ncaitanya-caritāmṛta kahe kṛṣṇadāsa
verses.translation: Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.
verses.purport: PURPORT\nThus end the Bhaktivedanta purports to Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā,  Fifteenth Chapter, describing Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's pastimes in the garden by the sea.

sections.title: Chapter 16: Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu Tastes Nectar from the Lips of Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa

verses.devanagari: বন্দে শ্রীকৃষ্ণচৈতন্যং কৃষ্ণভাবামৃতং হি যঃ ।\\nআস্বাদ্যাস্বাদয়ন্ ভক্তান্ প্রেমদীক্ষামশিক্ষয়ৎ ॥১॥
verses.transliteration: vande śrī-kṛṣṇa-caitanyaṁ\\nkṛṣṇa-bhāvāmṛtaṁ hi yaḥ\\nāsvādyāsvādayan bhaktān\\nprema-dīkṣām aśikṣayat
verses.translation: Let me offer my respectful obeisances unto Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, who personally tasted the nectar of ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa and then instructed His devotees how to taste it. Thus He enlightened them about ecstatic love of Kṛṣṇa to initiate them into transcendental knowledge.

verses.devanagari: জয় জয় শ্রীচৈতন্য জয় নিত্যানন্দ ।\\nজয়াদ্বৈতচন্দ্র জয় গৌরভক্তবৃন্দ ॥২॥
verses.transliteration: jaya jaya śrī-caitanya jaya nityānanda\\njayādvaita-candra jaya gaura-bhakta-vṛnda
verses.translation: All glories to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu! All glories to Lord Nityānanda! All glories to Advaita Ācārya! And all glories to all the devotees of the Lord!

verses.devanagari: এইমত মহাপ্রভু রহেন নীলাচলে ।\\nভক্তগণ-সঙ্গে সদা প্রেম-বিহ্বলে ॥৩॥
verses.transliteration: ei-mata mahāprabhu rahena nīlācale\\nbhakta-gaṇa-saṅge sadā prema-vihvale
verses.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu thus stayed at Jagannātha Purī in the association of His devotees, always merged in ecstatic devotional love.

verses.devanagari: বর্ষান্তরে আইলা সব গৌড়ের ভক্তগণ ।\\nপূর্ববৎ আসি’ কৈল প্রভুর মিলন ॥৪॥
verses.transliteration: varṣāntare āilā saba gauḍera bhakta-gaṇa\\npūrvavat āsi' kaila prabhura milana
verses.translation: The next year, as usual, all the devotees from Bengal went to Jagannātha Purī, and, as in previous years, there was a meeting between Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and the devotees.

verses.devanagari: তাঁ-সবার সঙ্গে আইল কালিদাস নাম ।\\nকৃষ্ণনাম বিনা তেঁহো নাহি কহে আন ॥৫॥
verses.transliteration: tāṅ-sabāra saṅge āila kālidāsa nāma\\nkṛṣṇa-nāma vinā teṅho nāhi kahe āna
verses.translation: Along with the devotees from Bengal came a gentleman named Kālidāsa. He never uttered anything but the holy name of Kṛṣṇa.

verses.devanagari: মহাভাগবত তেঁহো সরল উদার ।\\nকৃষ্ণনাম-‘সঙ্কেতে’ চালায় ব্যবহার ॥৬॥
verses.transliteration: mahā-bhāgavata teṅho sarala udāra\\nkṛṣṇa-nāma-'saṅkete' cālāya vyavahāra
verses.translation: Kālidāsa was a very advanced devotee, yet he was simple and liberal. He would chant the holy name of Kṛṣṇa while performing all his ordinary dealings.

verses.devanagari: কৌতুকেতে তেঁহো যদি পাশক খেলায় ।\\n‘হরে কৃষ্ণ’ ‘কৃষ্ণ’ করি’ পাশক চালায় ॥৭॥
verses.transliteration: kautukete teṅho yadi pāśaka khelāya\\n'hare kṛṣṇa' 'kṛṣṇa' kari' pāśaka cālāya
verses.translation: When he used to throw dice in jest, he would throw the dice while chanting Hare Kṛṣṇa.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
In this connection Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura warns the men of this age not to imitate the jesting of a
mahā-bhāgavata
like Kālidāsa. If someone imitates him by playing with dice or gambling while chanting the Hare Kṛṣṇa
mahā-mantra,
he will certainly become a victim of offenses unto the holy name. As it is said,
hari-nāma-bale pāpe pravṛtti:
one must not commit sinful activities on the strength of chanting the Hare Kṛṣṇa
mantra.
Playing with dice is certainly gambling, but it is clearly said here that Kālidāsa did this only in jest. A
mahā-bhāgavata
can do anything, but he never forgets the basic principles. Therefore it is said,
vaiṣṇavera kriyā-mudrā vijñeha nā bujhaya:
"No one can understand the activities of a pure devotee." We should not imitate Kālidāsa.

verses.devanagari: রঘুনাথ-দাসের তেঁহো হয় জ্ঞাতি-খুড়া ।\\nবৈষ্ণবের উচ্ছিষ্ট খাইতে তেঁহো হৈল বুড়া ॥৮॥
verses.transliteration: raghunātha-dāsera teṅho haya jñāti-khuḍā\\nvaiṣṇavera ucchiṣṭa khāite teṅho haila buḍā
verses.translation: Kālidāsa was an uncle of Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī. Throughout his entire life, even in his old age, he tried to eat the remnants of food left by Vaiṣṇavas.

verses.devanagari: গৌড়দেশে হয় যত বৈষ্ণবের গণ ।\\nসবার উচ্ছিষ্ট তেঁহো করিল ভোজন ॥৯॥
verses.transliteration: gauḍa-deśe haya yata vaiṣṇavera gaṇa\\nsabāra ucchiṣṭa teṅho karila bhojana
verses.translation: Kālidāsa ate the remnants of food of as many Vaiṣṇavas as there were in Bengal.

verses.devanagari: ব্রাহ্মণ-বৈষ্ণব যত — ছোট, বড় হয় ।\\nউত্তম-বস্তু ভেট লঞা তাঁর ঠাঞি যায় ॥১০॥
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇa-vaiṣṇava yata—choṭa, baḍa haya\\nuttama-vastu bheṭa lañā tāṅra ṭhāñi yāya
verses.translation: He would go to all the Vaiṣṇavas born in brāhmaṇa families, be they neophyte or advanced devotees, and present them gifts of first-class eatables.

verses.devanagari: তাঁর ঠাঞি শেষ-পাত্র লয়েন মাগিয়া ।\\nকাহাঁ না পায়, তবে রহে লুকাঞা ॥১১॥
verses.transliteration: tāṅra ṭhāñi śeṣa-pātra layena māgiyā\\nkāhāṅ nā pāya, tabe rahe lukāñā
verses.translation: He would beg remnants of food from such Vaiṣṇavas, and if he did not receive any, he would hide.

verses.devanagari: ভোজন করিলে পাত্র ফেলাঞা যায় ।\\nলুকাঞা সেই পাত্র আনি’ চাটি’ খায় ॥১২॥
verses.transliteration: bhojana karile pātra phelāñā yāya\\nlukāñā sei pātra āni' cāṭi' khāya
verses.translation: After the Vaiṣṇavas finished eating, they would throw away their dishes or leaves, and Kālidāsa would come out of hiding, take the leaves and lick up the remnants.

verses.devanagari: শূদ্র-বৈষ্ণবের ঘরে যায় ভেট লঞা ।\\nএইমত তাঁর উচ্ছিষ্ট খায় লুকাঞা ॥১৩॥
verses.transliteration: śūdra-vaiṣṇavera ghare yāya bheṭa lañā\\nei-mata tāṅra ucchiṣṭa khāya lukāñā
verses.translation: He would also take gifts to the homes of Vaiṣṇavas born in śūdra families. Then he would hide and eat the remnants of food they threw away in this manner.

verses.devanagari: ভূঁইমালি-জাতি, ‘বৈষ্ণব’ — ‘ঝড়ু’ তাঁর নাম ।\\nআম্রফল লঞা তেঁহো গেলা তাঁর স্থান ॥১৪॥
verses.transliteration: bhūṅimāli-jāti, 'vaiṣṇava'—'jhaḍu' tāṅra nāma\\nāmra-phala lañā teṅho gelā tāṅra sthāna
verses.translation: There was a great Vaiṣṇava named Jhaḍu Ṭhākura, who belonged to the bhūṅimāli caste. Kālidāsa went to his home, taking mangoes with him.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura remarks that both Kālidāsa and Jhaḍu Ṭhākura are worshiped at a place called Śrīpāṭabāṭī, in the village known as Bhedo or Bhaduyā. This village is situated about three miles south of the village of Kṛṣṇapura, the birthplace of Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī, which is about one mile west of the Byāṇḍel junction of the Burdwan line. A post office there is named Devānanda-pura. Jhaḍu Ṭhākura used to worship the Deity of Śrī Madana-gopāla. The Deity is still worshiped by one Rāmaprasāda dāsa, who belongs to the
rāmāyet
community. It is said that the Deity worshiped by Kālidāsa had been worshiped until now in the village of Śaṅkhya on the bank of the Sarasvatī River, but the Deity has been taken away by a gentleman named Matilāla Caṭṭopādhyāya from the village of Triveṇī. The Deity is now being worshiped at his place.

verses.devanagari: আম্র ভেট দিয়া তাঁর চরণ বন্দিলা ।\\nতাঁর পত্নীরে তবে নমস্কার কৈলা ॥১৫॥
verses.transliteration: āmra bheṭa diyā tāṅra caraṇa vandilā\\ntāṅra patnīre tabe namaskāra kailā
verses.translation: Kālidāsa presented the mangoes to Jhaḍu Ṭhākura and offered him respectful obeisances. Then he also offered respectful obeisances to the Ṭhākura's wife.

verses.devanagari: পত্নী-সহিত তেঁহো আছেন বসিয়া ।\\nবহু সম্মান কৈলা কালিদাসেরে দেখিয়া ॥১৬॥
verses.transliteration: patnī-sahita teṅho āchena vasiyā\\nbahu sammāna kailā kālidāsere dekhiyā
verses.translation: When Kālidāsa went to Jhaḍu Ṭhākura, he saw that saintly person sitting with his wife. As soon as Jhaḍu Ṭhākura saw Kālidāsa, he likewise offered his respectful obeisances unto him.

verses.devanagari: ইষ্টগোষ্ঠী কতক্ষণ করি’ তাঁর সনে  ।\\nঝড়ু-ঠাকুর কহে তাঁরে মধুর বচনে ॥১৭॥
verses.transliteration: iṣṭagoṣṭhī kata-kṣaṇa kari' tāṅra sane\\njhaḍu-ṭhākura kahe tāṅre madhura vacane
verses.translation: After a discussion for some time with Kālidāsa, Jhaḍu Ṭhākura said something to him in sweet words.

verses.devanagari: “আমি — নীচজাতি, তুমি, — অতিথি সর্বোত্তম  ।\\nকোন্ প্রকারে করিমু আমি তোমার সেবন ? ১৮ ॥১৮॥
verses.transliteration: "āmi—nīca-jāti, tumi,—atithi sarvottama\\nkon prakāre karimu āmi tomāra sevana?
verses.translation: "I belong to a low caste, and you are a very respectable guest. How shall I serve you?

verses.devanagari: আজ্ঞা দেহ’, — ব্রাহ্মণ-ঘরে অন্ন লঞা দিয়ে ।\\nতাহাঁ তুমি প্রসাদ পাও, তবে আমি জীয়ে ।।” ॥ ১৯ ॥
verses.transliteration: ājñā deha',—brāhmaṇa-ghare anna lañā diye\\ntāhāṅ tumi prasāda pāo, tabe āmi jīye"
verses.translation: "If you will permit me, I shall send some food to a brāhmaṇa's house, and there you may take prasāda. If you do so, I shall then live very comfortably."

verses.devanagari: কালিদাস কহে, — “ঠাকুর, কৃপা কর মোরে ।\\nতোমার দর্শনে আইনু মুই পতিত পামরে ॥২০॥
verses.transliteration: kālidāsa kahe,—"ṭhākura, kṛpā kara more\\ntomāra darśane āinu mui patita pāmare
verses.translation: Kālidāsa replied, "My dear sir, please bestow your mercy upon me. I have come to see you, although I am very fallen and sinful.

verses.devanagari: পবিত্র হইনু মুই পাইনু দরশন ।\\nকৃতার্থ হইনু, মোর সফল জীবন ॥২১॥
verses.transliteration: pavitra ha-inu mui pāinu daraśana\\nkṛtārtha ha-inu, mora saphala jīvana
verses.translation: "Simply by seeing you, I have become purified. I am very obligated to you, for my life is now successful.

verses.devanagari: এক বাঞ্ছা হয়, — যদি কৃপা করি’ কর ।\\nপাদরজ দেহ’, পাদ মোর মাথে ধর ।।” ॥ ২২ ॥
verses.transliteration: eka vāñchā haya,—yadi kṛpā kari' kara\\npāda-raja deha', pāda mora māthe dhara"
verses.translation: "My dear sir, I have one desire. Please be merciful to me by kindly placing your feet upon my head so that the dust on your feet may touch it."

verses.devanagari: ঠাকুর কহে, — “ঐছে বাত্ কহিতে না যুয়ায় ।\\nআমি — নীচজাতি, তুমি — সুসজ্জন রায় ।।” ॥ ২৩ ॥
verses.transliteration: ṭhākura kahe,—"aiche vāt kahite nā yuyāya\\nāmi—nīca-jāti, tumi—susajjana rāya"
verses.translation: Jhaḍu Ṭhākura replied, "It does not befit you to ask this of me. I belong to a very low-caste family, whereas you are a respectable rich gentleman."

verses.devanagari: তবে কালিদাস শ্লোক পড়ি’ শুনাইল ।\\nশুনি’ ঝড়ু-ঠাকুরের বড় সুখ হইল ॥২৪॥
verses.transliteration: tabe kālidāsa śloka paḍi' śunāila\\nśuni' jhaḍu-ṭhākurera baḍa sukha ha-ila
verses.translation: Kālidāsa then recited some verses, which Jhaḍu Ṭhākura was very happy to hear.

verses.devanagari: ন মেঽভক্তশ্চতুর্বেদী মদ্ভক্তঃ শ্বপচঃ প্রিয়ঃ ।\\nতস্মৈ দেয়ং ততো গ্রাহ্যং স চ পূজ্যো যথা হ্যহম্ ॥২৫॥
verses.transliteration: na me 'bhaktaś catur-vedī\\nmad-bhaktaḥ śva-pacaḥ priyaḥ\\ntasmai deyaṁ tato grāhyaṁ\\nsa ca pūjyo yathā hy aham
verses.translation: "Even though one is a very learned scholar in Sanskrit literature, if he is not engaged in pure devotional service, he is not accepted as My devotee. But if someone born in a family of dog-eaters is a pure devotee with no motives for enjoyment through fruitive activity or mental speculation, he is very dear to Me. All respect should be given to him, and whatever he offers should be accepted, for such devotees are indeed as worshipable as I am.'
verses.purport: PURPORT\nThis verse spoken by the Supreme Personality of Godhead is found in\nHari-bhakti-vilāsa.

verses.devanagari: বিপ্রাদ্দ্বিষড়্গুণযুতাদরবিন্দনাভ-\\nপাদারবিন্দবিমুখাৎ শ্বপচং বরিষ্ঠম্ ।\\nমন্যে তদর্পিতমনোবচনেহিতার্থ-\\nপ্রাণং পুনাতি স কুলং ন তু ভূরিমানঃ ॥২৬॥
verses.transliteration: viprād dvi-ṣaḍ-guṇa-yutād aravinda-nābha-\\npādāravinda-vimukhāt śva-pacaṁ variṣṭham\\nmanye tad-arpita-mano-vacanehitārtha-\\nprāṇaṁ punāti sa kulaṁ na tu bhūri-mānaḥ
verses.translation: "A person may be born in a brāhmaṇa family and have all twelve brahminical qualities, but if in spite of being qualified he is not devoted to the lotus feet of Lord Kṛṣṇa, who has a navel shaped like a lotus, he is not as good as a caṇḍāla who has dedicated his mind, words, activities, wealth and life to the service of the Lord. Simply to take birth in a brāhmaṇa family or to have brahminical qualities is not sufficient. One must become a pure devotee of the Lord. If a śva-paca or caṇḍāla is a devotee, he delivers not only himself but his whole family, whereas a brāhmaṇa who is not a devotee but simply has brahminical qualifications cannot even purify himself, not to speak of his family.'
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This and the following verse are quoted from
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
(7.9.10 and 3.33.7).

verses.devanagari: অহো বত শ্বপচোঽতো গরীয়ান্\\nযজ্জিহ্বাগ্রে বর্ততে নাম তুভ্যম্ ।\\nতেপুস্তপস্তে জুহুবুঃ সস্নুরার্যা\\nব্রহ্মানূচুর্নাম গৃণন্তি যে তে ॥২৭॥
verses.transliteration: aho bata śva-paco 'to garīyān\\nyaj-jihvāgre vartate nāma tubhyam\\ntepus tapas te juhuvuḥ sasnur āryā\\nbrahmānūcur nāma gṛṇanti ye te
verses.translation: "My dear Lord, anyone who always keeps Your holy name on his tongue is greater than an initiated brāhmaṇa. Although he may be born in a family of dog-eaters and therefore, by material calculations, be the lowest of men, he is glorious nevertheless. That is the wonderful power of chanting the holy name of the Lord. One who chants the holy name is understood to have performed all kinds of austerities. He has studied all the Vedas, he has performed all the great sacrifices mentioned in the Vedas, he has already taken his bath in all the holy places of pilgrimage, and it is he who is factually the Āryan.' "

verses.devanagari: শুনি’ ঠাকুর কহে, — “শাস্ত্র এই সত্য কয় ।\\nসেই শ্রেষ্ঠ, ঐছে যাঁতে কৃষ্ণভক্তি হয় ॥২৮॥
verses.transliteration: śuni' ṭhākura kahe,—"śāstra ei satya kaya\\nsei śreṣṭha, aiche yāṅte kṛṣṇa-bhakti haya
verses.translation: Hearing these quotations from the revealed scripture Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam, Jhaḍu Ṭhākura replied, "Yes, this is true, for it is the version of śāstra. It is true, however, for one who is genuinely advanced in devotion to Kṛṣṇa.

verses.devanagari: আমি — নীচজাতি, আমার নাহি কৃষ্ণ ভক্তি ।\\nঅন্য ঐছে হয়, আমায় নাহি ঐছে শক্তি ।।” ॥ ২৯ ॥
verses.transliteration: āmi—nīca-jāti, āmāra nāhi kṛṣṇa-bhakti\\nanya aiche haya, āmāya nāhi aiche śakti"
verses.translation: "Such a position may befit others, but I do not possess such spiritual power. I belong to a lower class and have not even a pinch of devotion to Kṛṣṇa."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
In his statement, Jhaḍu Ṭhākura presents himself as being born in a low-caste family and not having the qualifications of a bona fide devotee of Lord Kṛṣṇa. He accepts the statements declaring a lowborn person highly exalted if he is a Vaiṣṇava. However, he feels that these descriptions from
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
appropriately describe others, but not himself. Jhaḍu Ṭhākura's attitude is quite befitting a real Vaiṣṇava, for a Vaiṣṇava never considers himself exalted, even if he factually is. He is always meek and humble and never thinks that he is an advanced devotee. He assigns himself to a lower position, but that does not mean that he is indeed low. Sanātana Gosvāmī once said that he belonged to a low-caste family, for although he was born in a
brāhmaṇa
family, he had associated with
mlecchas
and
yavanas
in his service as a government minister. Similarly, Jhaḍu Ṭhākura presented himself as someone who belonged to a low caste, but he was actually elevated above many persons born in
brāhmaṇa
families. Not only is there evidence for this in
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam,
as quoted by Kālidāsa in verses 26 and 27; there is also considerable evidence for this conclusion in other śāstras. For example, in the
Mahābhārata, Vana-parva,
Chapter 180, it is stated:
śūdre tu yad bhavel lakṣma
dvije tac ca na vidyate
na vai śūdro bhavec chūdro
brāhmaṇo na ca brāhmaṇaḥ
"If the characteristics of a
brāhmaṇa
are found in a
śūdra
and not in a
brāhmaṇa,
that
śūdra
should not be known as a
śūdra,
and that
brāhmaṇa
should not be known as a
brāhmaṇa.
"
Similarly, in the
Vana-parva,
Chapter 211, it is said:
śūdra-yonau hi jātasya
sad-guṇānupatiṣṭhataḥ
ārjave vartamānasya
brāhmaṇyam abhijāyate
"If a person born in a
śūdra
family has developed the qualities of a
brāhmaṇa,
such as
satya
[truthfulness],
śama
[peacefulness],
dama
[self-control] and
ārjava
[simplicity], he attains the exalted position of a
brāhmaṇa.
"
In the
Anuśāsana-parva,
Chapter 163, it is said:
sthito brāhmaṇa-dharmeṇa
brāhmaṇyam upajīvati
kṣatriyo vātha vaiśyo vā
brahma-bhūyaḥ sa gacchati
ebhis tu karmabhir devi
śubhair ācaritais tathā
śūdro brāhmaṇatāṁ yāti
vaiśyaḥ kṣatriyatāṁ vrajet
na yonir nāpi saṁskāro
na śrutaṁ na ca santatiḥ
kāraṇāni dvijatvasya
vṛttam eva tu kāraṇam
"If one is factually situated in the occupation of a
brāhmaṇa,
he must be considered a
brāhmaṇa,
even if born of a
kṣatriya
or
vaiśya
family.
"O Devī, if even a
śūdra
is actually engaged in the occupation and pure behavior of a
brāhmaṇa,
he becomes a
brāhmaṇa.
Moreover, a
vaiśya
can become a
kṣatriya.
"Therefore, neither the source of one's birth, nor his reformation, nor his education is the criterion of a
brāhmaṇa.
The
vṛtta,
or occupation, is the real standard by which one is known as a
brāhmaṇa.
"
We have seen that a person who is not the son of a doctor and has not attended a medical college is sometimes able to practice medicine. By practical knowledge of how to perform a surgical operation, how to mix medicine and how to give certain medicines for certain diseases, a person can receive a certificate and be registered as a medical practitioner in the practical field. He can do a medical man's work and be known as a doctor. Although qualified medical men may consider him a quack, the government will recognize his work. Especially in India, there are many such doctors who perform their medical services perfectly. They are accepted even by the government. Similarly, if one is engaged in brahminical service or occupational duties, he must be considered a
brāhmaṇa
despite the family in which he is born. That is the verdict of all the
śāstras.
In the
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
(7.11.35), it is said:
yasya yal lakṣaṇaṁ proktaṁ
puṁso varṇābhivyañjakam
yad anyatrāpi dṛśyeta
tat tenaiva vinirdiśet
This is a statement by Nārada Muni to Mahārāja Yudhiṣṭhira, wherein Nārada says that the symptoms of a
brāhmaṇa, kṣatriya
and
vaiśya
are all described in
śāstra.
Therefore, if one is found exhibiting the symptoms and qualities of a
brāhmaṇa
and serving in a
brahminical
occupation, even if he is not born a
brāhmaṇa
or
kṣatriya,
